```{r}
# =========================================================
# FOUNDATION.R
# - Build core derived objects from rawdata_* files
# - Save key figures as PNG and SVG
# - Save selected derived tables for supplementary use
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(sf)
  library(showtext)
  library(sysfonts)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(rnaturalearth)
  library(rnaturalearthdata)
  library(geodist)
  library(cluster)
  library(svglite)
  library(grid)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Global settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!"noto" %in% sysfonts::font_families()) {
  sysfonts::font_add_google("Noto Sans KR", "noto")
}

# Use showtext for screen/PNG output only
showtext_auto(TRUE)

base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "noto") +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title    = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text     = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title  = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text   = element_text(size = 14)
  )

clu_pal <- c(
  "1" = "#4E79A7",
  "2" = "#E15759",
  "3" = "#59A14F",
  "4" = "#B07AA1"
)

pick_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  n <- tolower(names(df))
  i <- match(tolower(candidates), n)
  i <- i[!is.na(i)]
  if (length(i)) return(names(df)[i[1]])

  j <- which(Reduce(`|`, lapply(tolower(candidates), function(x) grepl(x, n, fixed = TRUE))))
  if (length(j)) return(names(df)[j[1]])

  NA_character_
}

norm_name <- function(x) {
  str_squish(str_trim(as.character(x)))
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300,
                           bg = "white") {
  # PNG: use showtext
  showtext_auto(TRUE)
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = bg
  )

  # SVG: disable showtext and write through svglite directly
  showtext_auto(FALSE)
  svglite::svglite(
    file = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    fix_text_size = FALSE,
    system_fonts = list(
      sans  = "Arial",
      serif = "Times New Roman",
      mono  = "Courier New"
    )
  )
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
  showtext_auto(TRUE)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Load raw data
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- read_csv("rawdata_metadata.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    village_name = as.character(village_name),
    village_name_norm = norm_name(village_name)
  )

df_vil_coord <- read_csv("rawdata_village coord.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
asv_raw <- read_csv("rawdata_asv level.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Build village table
#    - vil_id assigned by longitude ASC, then latitude, then label
#    - vil_n obtained from metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
vil_n_tbl <- meta %>%
  count(village_name_norm, name = "vil_n")

lat_col <- pick_col(df_vil_coord, c("latitude", "lat"))
lon_col <- pick_col(df_vil_coord, c("longitude", "lon", "long"))
lab_col <- pick_col(df_vil_coord, c("village_name", "village", "name"))

if (is.na(lat_col) || is.na(lon_col)) {
  stop("Latitude/longitude columns were not found in rawdata_village coord.csv.")
}
if (is.na(lab_col)) {
  lab_col <- names(df_vil_coord)[1]
}

vil_tbl <- df_vil_coord %>%
  rename(lat = !!lat_col, lon = !!lon_col, label = !!lab_col) %>%
  mutate(
    lat = as.numeric(lat),
    lon = as.numeric(lon),
    label = as.character(label),
    label_norm = norm_name(label)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon)) %>%
  arrange(lon, lat, label) %>%
  mutate(vil_id = sprintf("V%02d", row_number())) %>%
  left_join(vil_n_tbl, by = c("label_norm" = "village_name_norm")) %>%
  mutate(
    vil_n   = as.integer(vil_n),
    vil_lab = sprintf("%s (n=%s)", vil_id, ifelse(is.na(vil_n), "NA", vil_n))
  )

pts <- vil_tbl %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Build ASV objects
#    - asv_tax   : ASV-to-taxonomy table
#    - asv_abund : abundance matrix
#    - asv_pa    : presence/absence matrix using 0.001 threshold
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sample_cols <- grep("^S\\d{4}$", names(asv_raw), value = TRUE)
if (length(sample_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No sample columns matching the S0001 format were found.")
}
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "Taxon") %in% names(asv_raw)))

asv_tax <- asv_raw %>%
  select(ASV, Taxon) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(ASV)

asv_abund <- asv_raw %>%
  select(ASV, all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(sample_cols), as.numeric)) %>%
  arrange(ASV)

asv_pa <- asv_abund %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(sample_cols), ~ as.integer(. >= 0.001)))

stopifnot(identical(asv_tax$ASV, asv_abund$ASV))
stopifnot(identical(asv_abund$ASV, asv_pa$ASV))

# Derived tables for reproducibility / supplementary support
write_csv(vil_tbl,   "derived_village_table.csv")
write_csv(meta,      "derived_meta_norm.csv")
write_csv(asv_tax,   "derived_asv_tax.csv")
write_csv(asv_abund, "derived_asv_abund.csv")
write_csv(asv_pa,    "derived_asv_pa.csv")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Base map layers and location figures
# ---------------------------------------------------------
kr_land  <- ne_countries(scale = "large", country = "South Korea", returnclass = "sf")
kr_coast <- ne_coastline(scale = "large", returnclass = "sf")

st_kr <- ne_states(country = "South Korea", returnclass = "sf")
jeolla <- st_kr %>%
  filter(
    grepl("Jeollabuk|North Jeolla|Jeonbuk", name, ignore.case = TRUE) |
    grepl("Jeollanam|South Jeolla|Jeonnam", name, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )

pts_in <- pts[st_within(pts, st_union(jeolla), sparse = FALSE)[, 1], ]

p_nation <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = kr_land, fill = "grey95", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = kr_coast, color = "grey65", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_sf(
    data = pts,
    shape = 21, size = 3,
    fill = "#1f78b4", color = "white", stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(124, 132), ylim = c(33, 39), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Village locations in South Korea",
    x = "Longitude (°E)",
    y = "Latitude (°N)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#eaf3ff", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey90")
  )

print(p_nation)
save_plot_both(p_nation, "village_map_nation_highres", width = 8, height = 6)

p_jeolla <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = kr_land, fill = "grey95", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_sf(data = jeolla, fill = NA, color = "#999999", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(
    data = pts,
    shape = 21, size = 3,
    fill = "#1f78b4", color = "white", stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = pts_in,
    aes(label = vil_lab, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 10,
    box.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.size = 0.25,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    segment.alpha = 0.6,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(126, 128.2), ylim = c(34.5, 35.5), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Village locations in Jeolla Province",
    x = "Longitude (°E)",
    y = "Latitude (°N)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#eaf3ff", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey90")
  )

print(p_jeolla)
save_plot_both(p_jeolla, "village_map_Jeolla_highres_zoom_with_labels", width = 8, height = 6)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Village clustering using Haversine distance and PAM
#    - Cluster labels assigned from west to east
# ---------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(2025)
user_k <- 4
best_k <- as.integer(user_k)

coords <- pts %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(lon, lat)

D_km <- geodist::geodist(coords, measure = "haversine") / 1000
D_km <- as.dist(D_km)

pam_fit <- pam(D_km, k = best_k, diss = TRUE)
cluster_new <- as.character(pam_fit$clustering)

cent <- pts %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(cluster_new = cluster_new) %>%
  group_by(cluster_new) %>%
  summarise(
    cen_lon = mean(lon, na.rm = TRUE),
    cen_lat = mean(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(cen_lon) %>%
  mutate(cluster = sprintf("%d", row_number()))

map_new_to_ordered <- setNames(cent$cluster, cent$cluster_new)

pts_cluster <- pts %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_new = factor(cluster_new, levels = cent$cluster_new),
    cluster     = factor(map_new_to_ordered[cluster_new], levels = as.character(1:best_k))
  )

p_map_hi <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = kr_land, fill = "grey95", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_sf(data = kr_coast, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_sf(data = jeolla, fill = NA, color = "#999999", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(
    data = pts_cluster,
    aes(fill = cluster),
    shape = 21, size = 3.5,
    color = "white", stroke = 0.3
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(126, 127.8), ylim = c(34.5, 35.5), expand = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clu_pal, drop = FALSE, name = "Cluster") +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Village clusters in Jeolla Province (Haversine + PAM, k=%d)", best_k),
    x = "Longitude (°E)",
    y = "Latitude (°N)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#eaf3ff", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

print(p_map_hi)
save_plot_both(p_map_hi, sprintf("village_clusters_Jeolla_highres_k%d", best_k), width = 8, height = 6)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Merge cluster assignment into metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
vil_map <- pts_cluster %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    village_name = as.character(label),
    village_name_norm = norm_name(label),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    cluster = as.character(cluster)
  ) %>%
  distinct(village_name_norm, .keep_all = TRUE)

merged <- meta %>%
  left_join(
    vil_map %>% select(village_name_norm, vil_id, cluster),
    by = "village_name_norm"
  ) %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = names(clu_pal)))

miss_vil <- merged %>%
  filter(is.na(cluster)) %>%
  distinct(village_name)

if (nrow(miss_vil) > 0) {
  message(
    "Unmatched villages after normalization: ",
    paste(miss_vil$village_name, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

tbl_village <- merged %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster)) %>%
  count(village_name, vil_id, cluster, name = "n_samples") %>%
  arrange(cluster, desc(n_samples))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6-1) Load village-level social interaction questionnaire
#      - Available for a subset of villages
#      - Village-level annotation table for downstream analyses
# ---------------------------------------------------------
social_raw <- read_csv("social_interaction_questionary.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    shared_meal_time = as.character(shared_meal_time)
  )

# Check required columns
social_required <- c(
  "vil_id",
  "hall_attend_n",
  "hall_gather_freq",
  "hall_stability",
  "shared_meal_freq",
  "shared_meal_time",
  "food_share_freq",
  "intervillage_freq",
  "intervillage_n"
)

missing_social_cols <- setdiff(social_required, names(social_raw))
if (length(missing_social_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing columns in social_interaction_questionary.csv: ",
    paste(missing_social_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Check duplicate village IDs
social_duplicate <- social_raw %>%
  count(vil_id) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(social_duplicate) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Duplicate vil_id values found in social_interaction_questionary.csv: ",
    paste(social_duplicate$vil_id, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Ensure score variables are numeric
social_score_vars <- c(
  "hall_attend_n",
  "hall_gather_freq",
  "hall_stability",
  "shared_meal_freq",
  "food_share_freq",
  "intervillage_freq",
  "intervillage_n"
)

social_raw <- social_raw %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(social_score_vars), as.numeric))

# Attach geographic cluster and village sample count
social_village <- social_raw %>%
  left_join(
    vil_map %>% select(vil_id, cluster),
    by = "vil_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    tbl_village %>% select(vil_id, n_samples),
    by = "vil_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(cluster, levels = names(clu_pal))
  )

# Basic quality check
social_unmatched <- social_village %>%
  filter(is.na(cluster))

if (nrow(social_unmatched) > 0) {
  message(
    "Unmatched questionnaire villages: ",
    paste(social_unmatched$vil_id, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Composite scores
# Each score is calculated as the row mean of z-scored questionnaire variables.
# Missing values are ignored when at least one component is available.
z_score <- function(x) {
  as.numeric(scale(x))
}

social_village <- social_village %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(social_score_vars),
      z_score,
      .names = "{.col}_z"
    ),
    within_social_score = rowMeans(
      across(c(
        hall_attend_n_z,
        hall_gather_freq_z,
        hall_stability_z,
        shared_meal_freq_z,
        food_share_freq_z
      )),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    food_sharing_score = rowMeans(
      across(c(
        shared_meal_freq_z,
        food_share_freq_z
      )),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    intervillage_score = rowMeans(
      across(c(
        intervillage_freq_z,
        intervillage_n_z
      )),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    within_social_score = ifelse(is.nan(within_social_score), NA_real_, within_social_score),
    food_sharing_score = ifelse(is.nan(food_sharing_score), NA_real_, food_sharing_score),
    intervillage_score = ifelse(is.nan(intervillage_score), NA_real_, intervillage_score)
  )

# Response coverage summary
social_coverage <- tibble(
  total_villages = nrow(tbl_village),
  questionnaire_villages = n_distinct(social_village$vil_id),
  questionnaire_villages_matched = sum(!is.na(social_village$cluster)),
  questionnaire_villages_unmatched = sum(is.na(social_village$cluster)),
  questionnaire_coverage_pct = 100 * questionnaire_villages_matched / total_villages
)

cat("\nSocial interaction questionnaire coverage\n")
print(social_coverage)

cat("\nQuestionnaire villages by cluster\n")
print(
  social_village %>%
    filter(!is.na(cluster)) %>%
    count(cluster, name = "n_questionnaire_villages") %>%
    arrange(cluster)
)

# Save derived questionnaire tables
write_csv(social_raw, "derived_social_interaction_questionnaire_raw.csv")
write_csv(social_village, "derived_social_interaction_questionnaire_village.csv")
write_csv(social_coverage, "supplementary_social_questionnaire_coverage.csv")


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Sample count plots and summary tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
v_cnt_all <- tbl_village %>%
  mutate(vil_index = row_number())

p_bar_all <- ggplot(v_cnt_all, aes(x = vil_index, y = n_samples, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clu_pal, drop = FALSE, name = "Cluster") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of sample counts by village",
    x = "Village order (sorted index)",
    y = "Number of samples"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "lines"))

print(p_bar_all)
save_plot_both(p_bar_all, "bar_samples_per_village_indexed", width = 8, height = 6)

tbl_cluster <- tbl_village %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_villages     = n(),
    total_samples  = sum(n_samples),
    mean_samples   = mean(n_samples),
    sd_samples     = sd(n_samples),
    min_samples    = min(n_samples),
    max_samples    = max(n_samples),
    median_samples = median(n_samples),
    IQR_samples    = IQR(n_samples),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

tbl_overall <- tibble(
  total_villages   = nrow(tbl_village),
  total_samples    = sum(tbl_village$n_samples),
  mean_per_village = mean(tbl_village$n_samples),
  sd_per_village   = sd(tbl_village$n_samples),
  min_per_village  = min(tbl_village$n_samples),
  max_per_village  = max(tbl_village$n_samples)
)

cat("\nOverall summary\n")
print(tbl_overall)

cat("\nCluster-wise summary\n")
print(tbl_cluster)

cat("\nTop 10 villages by sample count\n")
print(head(tbl_village, 10))

write_csv(vil_map,      "derived_village_cluster_map.csv")
write_csv(merged,       "derived_meta_with_cluster.csv")
write_csv(tbl_village,  "supplementary_sample_count_by_village.csv")
write_csv(tbl_cluster,  "supplementary_sample_count_by_cluster.csv")
write_csv(tbl_overall,  "supplementary_sample_count_overall.csv")

p_box <- ggplot(tbl_village, aes(x = cluster, y = n_samples, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clu_pal, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Sample counts per village by cluster",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Number of samples"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p_box)
save_plot_both(p_box, "box_samples_per_village_by_cluster", width = 8, height = 6)

v_cnt_clu <- tbl_village %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_samples), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(vil_index = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

p_bar_facet <- ggplot(v_cnt_clu, aes(x = vil_index, y = n_samples, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~cluster, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clu_pal, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of village sample counts by cluster",
    x = "Village order within cluster",
    y = "Number of samples"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p_bar_facet)
save_plot_both(p_bar_facet, "bar_samples_per_village_by_cluster_facet", width = 12, height = 6)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Standalone validation of geographic PAM cluster number
# - Purpose:
#   Evaluate whether k = 4 is a reasonable choice for PAM clustering
#   based on inter-village Haversine distance.
#
# This chunk does NOT overwrite the primary k = 4 objects.
#
# Required objects from FOUNDATION:
#   vil_tbl or pts
#   base_theme
#   save_plot_both()
#
# Outputs:
#   k_validity_diag_tbl
#   cluster_k_validation_silhouette_gap.png/.svg
#   supplementary_cluster_k_validation_silhouette_gap.csv
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(cluster)
  library(geodist)
  library(patchwork)
  library(sf)
})

stopifnot(exists("base_theme"), exists("save_plot_both"))

set.seed(2025)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Parameters
# ---------------------------------------------------------
k_candidates_diag <- 2:8
primary_k_diag <- 4
B_gap_diag <- 500   # Increase to 1000 for final manuscript if needed

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Prepare village coordinate table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (exists("vil_tbl")) {
  coords_diag <- vil_tbl %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    transmute(
      vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
      village_name = as.character(label),
      lon = as.numeric(lon),
      lat = as.numeric(lat)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat)) %>%
    distinct(vil_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
} else if (exists("pts")) {
  coords_diag <- pts %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    transmute(
      vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
      village_name = as.character(label),
      lon = as.numeric(lon),
      lat = as.numeric(lat)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat)) %>%
    distinct(vil_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
} else {
  stop("Either vil_tbl or pts must exist.")
}

if (nrow(coords_diag) <= max(k_candidates_diag)) {
  stop("Number of villages must be larger than the maximum candidate k.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Haversine distance matrix
# ---------------------------------------------------------
D_diag_mat <- geodist::geodist(
  x = coords_diag %>% dplyr::select(lon, lat),
  measure = "haversine"
) / 1000

rownames(D_diag_mat) <- coords_diag$vil_id
colnames(D_diag_mat) <- coords_diag$vil_id

D_diag <- as.dist(D_diag_mat)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Utility: PAM fit summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
calc_pam_summary_diag <- function(D_dist, k) {
  fit <- cluster::pam(D_dist, k = k, diss = TRUE)

  clu <- fit$clustering
  clu_size <- table(clu)

  tibble(
    k = k,
    avg_silhouette_width = fit$silinfo$avg.width,
    min_cluster_size = min(as.integer(clu_size)),
    max_cluster_size = max(as.integer(clu_size)),
    cluster_sizes = paste(as.integer(clu_size), collapse = ",")
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Average silhouette width
# ---------------------------------------------------------
silhouette_diag_tbl <- lapply(k_candidates_diag, function(k) {
  calc_pam_summary_diag(D_diag, k)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Manual gap statistic for PAM with Haversine distance
#    - Uses within-cluster distance to PAM medoids
#    - Null data generated from uniform lon/lat bounding box
# ---------------------------------------------------------

calc_pam_wss_diag <- function(D_mat, k) {
  D_dist <- as.dist(D_mat)
  fit <- cluster::pam(D_dist, k = k, diss = TRUE)

  clu <- fit$clustering
  id_med <- fit$id.med

  w_total <- 0

  for (cc in sort(unique(clu))) {
    members <- which(clu == cc)
    medoid_idx <- id_med[cc]

    if (length(members) > 0) {
      w_total <- w_total + sum(D_mat[members, medoid_idx], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }

  w_total
}

# Observed Wk
obs_wk_diag <- lapply(k_candidates_diag, function(k) {
  tibble(
    k = k,
    Wk_obs = calc_pam_wss_diag(D_diag_mat, k),
    log_Wk_obs = log(Wk_obs)
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Null reference distribution
lon_range_diag <- range(coords_diag$lon, na.rm = TRUE)
lat_range_diag <- range(coords_diag$lat, na.rm = TRUE)
n_vil_diag <- nrow(coords_diag)

gap_null_list_diag <- vector("list", B_gap_diag)

for (b in seq_len(B_gap_diag)) {
  null_coords <- tibble(
    lon = runif(n_vil_diag, min = lon_range_diag[1], max = lon_range_diag[2]),
    lat = runif(n_vil_diag, min = lat_range_diag[1], max = lat_range_diag[2])
  )

  D_null_mat <- geodist::geodist(
    x = null_coords %>% dplyr::select(lon, lat),
    measure = "haversine"
  ) / 1000

  gap_null_list_diag[[b]] <- lapply(k_candidates_diag, function(k) {
    tibble(
      b = b,
      k = k,
      Wk_null = calc_pam_wss_diag(D_null_mat, k),
      log_Wk_null = log(Wk_null)
    )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows()
}

gap_null_diag_tbl <- bind_rows(gap_null_list_diag)

gap_diag_tbl <- gap_null_diag_tbl %>%
  group_by(k) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_log_Wk_null = mean(log_Wk_null, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_log_Wk_null = sd(log_Wk_null, na.rm = TRUE),
    gap_se = sqrt(1 + 1 / B_gap_diag) * sd_log_Wk_null,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(obs_wk_diag, by = "k") %>%
  mutate(
    gap = mean_log_Wk_null - log_Wk_obs
  )

# Gap max rule
gap_k_max_diag <- gap_diag_tbl %>%
  filter(gap == max(gap, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(k)

# Tibshirani firstSEmax-like rule:
# choose the smallest k such that Gap(k) >= Gap(k+1) - SE(k+1)
gap_firstSE_tbl_diag <- gap_diag_tbl %>%
  arrange(k) %>%
  mutate(
    next_gap = lead(gap),
    next_se = lead(gap_se),
    firstSE_condition = gap >= next_gap - next_se
  )

gap_k_firstSE_diag <- gap_firstSE_tbl_diag %>%
  filter(firstSE_condition) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(k)

if (length(gap_k_firstSE_diag) == 0) {
  gap_k_firstSE_diag <- gap_k_max_diag
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Combine validity diagnostics
# ---------------------------------------------------------
k_validity_diag_tbl <- silhouette_diag_tbl %>%
  left_join(
    gap_diag_tbl %>%
      dplyr::select(k, Wk_obs, log_Wk_obs, gap, gap_se),
    by = "k"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    primary_k = k == primary_k_diag,
    selected_by_max_silhouette = k == k[which.max(avg_silhouette_width)],
    selected_by_max_gap = k == gap_k_max_diag,
    selected_by_gap_firstSE = k == gap_k_firstSE_diag
  )

cat("\nCluster-number validation for geographic PAM clustering\n")
print(k_validity_diag_tbl)

cat("\nSelected k values by diagnostic criteria\n")
print(
  tibble(
    criterion = c(
      "maximum average silhouette width",
      "maximum gap statistic",
      "gap statistic firstSE rule",
      "primary analysis"
    ),
    selected_k = c(
      k_validity_diag_tbl$k[which.max(k_validity_diag_tbl$avg_silhouette_width)],
      gap_k_max_diag,
      gap_k_firstSE_diag,
      primary_k_diag
    )
  )
)

write_csv(
  k_validity_diag_tbl,
  "supplementary_cluster_k_validation_silhouette_gap.csv"
)

write_csv(
  gap_null_diag_tbl,
  "derived_cluster_k_validation_gap_null_distribution.csv"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Diagnostic plots
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_silhouette_diag <- ggplot(
  k_validity_diag_tbl,
  aes(x = k, y = avg_silhouette_width)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "black") +
  geom_point(
    data = k_validity_diag_tbl %>% filter(primary_k),
    aes(x = k, y = avg_silhouette_width),
    size = 4.2,
    shape = 21,
    fill = "#4E79A7",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = primary_k_diag,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k_candidates_diag) +
  labs(
    title = "Average silhouette width",
    subtitle = "PAM clustering based on inter-village Haversine distance",
    x = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y = "Average silhouette width"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_gap_diag <- ggplot(
  k_validity_diag_tbl,
  aes(x = k, y = gap)
) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = gap - gap_se, ymax = gap + gap_se),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.45,
    color = "grey35"
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "black") +
  geom_point(
    data = k_validity_diag_tbl %>% filter(primary_k),
    aes(x = k, y = gap),
    size = 4.2,
    shape = 21,
    fill = "#4E79A7",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = primary_k_diag,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k_candidates_diag) +
  labs(
    title = "Gap statistic",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Manual PAM gap statistic with Haversine distance; B = ",
      B_gap_diag,
      " null simulations"
    ),
    x = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y = "Gap statistic"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_cluster_k_validation_diag <- p_silhouette_diag | p_gap_diag

print(p_cluster_k_validation_diag)

save_plot_both(
  p_cluster_k_validation_diag,
  "cluster_k_validation_silhouette_gap",
  width = 12,
  height = 5
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Optional simple interpretation table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
k_validation_summary_diag <- tibble(
  metric = c(
    "maximum average silhouette width",
    "maximum gap statistic",
    "gap statistic firstSE rule",
    "primary k"
  ),
  selected_k = c(
    k_validity_diag_tbl$k[which.max(k_validity_diag_tbl$avg_silhouette_width)],
    gap_k_max_diag,
    gap_k_firstSE_diag,
    primary_k_diag
  )
)

write_csv(
  k_validation_summary_diag,
  "supplementary_cluster_k_validation_selected_k_summary.csv"
)

print(k_validation_summary_diag)
```


```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(vegan)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Pairwise Jaccard similarity (sample-sample) using ASV P/A
# - required inputs from FOUNDATION: merged, asv_pa
# - output objects:
#     pa_mat, pw_anno,
#     vill_summary, clu_summary,
#     vill_pair, clu_pair,
#     village_intra_jaccard,
#     wilcox_village, wilcox_cluster
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("merged"), exists("asv_pa"))
stopifnot("ASV" %in% names(asv_pa))
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "vil_id", "village_name", "cluster") %in% names(merged)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Keep only shared samples
# ---------------------------------------------------------
all_samples <- intersect(as.character(merged$sampleid), setdiff(names(asv_pa), "ASV"))
if (length(all_samples) == 0) {
  stop("No shared samples were found between merged$sampleid and asv_pa sample columns.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Build sample x ASV matrix
#    - rows: samples
#    - columns: ASVs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pa_mat <- asv_pa %>%
  select(ASV, all_of(all_samples)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("ASV") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  t()

pa_mat[is.na(pa_mat)] <- 0L
ids <- rownames(pa_mat)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1B) Remove all-zero samples to avoid NaN in Jaccard
# ---------------------------------------------------------
nz_mask <- rowSums(pa_mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
if (any(!nz_mask)) {
  message("Removing all-zero samples: ", paste(ids[!nz_mask], collapse = ", "))
}

pa_mat <- pa_mat[nz_mask, , drop = FALSE]
ids <- rownames(pa_mat)

if (nrow(pa_mat) < 2) {
  stop("Fewer than two valid samples remain after removing all-zero samples.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Compute Jaccard distance and similarity
# ---------------------------------------------------------
dist_jac <- vegdist(pa_mat, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)

dist_to_long <- function(d, ids) {
  m <- as.matrix(d)
  ut <- which(upper.tri(m), arr.ind = TRUE)

  tibble(
    sample1 = ids[ut[, 1]],
    sample2 = ids[ut[, 2]],
    jaccard_dist = m[ut],
    jaccard_sim  = 1 - m[ut]
  )
}

pw <- dist_to_long(dist_jac, ids)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Annotate pairwise table with metadata
#    - vil_id is added for downstream village-level analyses
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_min_pw <- merged %>%
  select(sampleid, vil_id, village_name, cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    village_name = as.character(village_name),
    cluster = as.character(cluster)
  )

pw_anno <- pw %>%
  left_join(meta_min_pw, by = c("sample1" = "sampleid")) %>%
  rename(
    vil_id1 = vil_id,
    vil1 = village_name,
    clu1 = cluster
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_min_pw, by = c("sample2" = "sampleid")) %>%
  rename(
    vil_id2 = vil_id,
    vil2 = village_name,
    clu2 = cluster
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    same_village = vil_id1 == vil_id2,
    same_cluster = clu1 == clu2
  )

if (any(is.na(pw_anno$vil_id1)) || any(is.na(pw_anno$vil_id2))) {
  warning("Missing vil_id values were detected in the pairwise annotation table.")
}
if (any(is.na(pw_anno$vil1)) || any(is.na(pw_anno$vil2))) {
  warning("Missing village_name values were detected in the pairwise annotation table.")
}
if (any(is.na(pw_anno$clu1)) || any(is.na(pw_anno$clu2))) {
  warning("Missing cluster values were detected in the pairwise annotation table.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4A) Same-village vs different-village summary and test
# ---------------------------------------------------------
vill_summary <- pw_anno %>%
  group_by(same_village) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sim = mean(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_sim   = sd(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    n        = n(),
    se_sim   = sd_sim / sqrt(n),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

wilcox_village <- wilcox.test(jaccard_sim ~ same_village, data = pw_anno)

print(vill_summary)
print(wilcox_village)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4B) Same-cluster vs different-cluster summary and test
# ---------------------------------------------------------
clu_summary <- pw_anno %>%
  group_by(same_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sim = mean(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_sim   = sd(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    n        = n(),
    se_sim   = sd_sim / sqrt(n),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

wilcox_cluster <- wilcox.test(jaccard_sim ~ same_cluster, data = pw_anno)

print(clu_summary)
print(wilcox_cluster)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4C) Mean similarity by village pair and cluster pair
# ---------------------------------------------------------
vill_pair <- pw_anno %>%
  mutate(
    vil_id1 = as.character(vil_id1),
    vil_id2 = as.character(vil_id2),
    village_pair = paste(pmin(vil_id1, vil_id2), pmax(vil_id1, vil_id2), sep = " vs "),
    vpair = paste(pmin(vil1, vil2), pmax(vil1, vil2), sep = " vs ")
  ) %>%
  group_by(village_pair, vpair) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sim = mean(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_sim = sd(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_sim))

clu_pair <- pw_anno %>%
  mutate(
    clu1  = as.character(clu1),
    clu2  = as.character(clu2),
    cpair = paste(pmin(clu1, clu2), pmax(clu1, clu2), sep = " vs ")
  ) %>%
  group_by(cpair) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sim = mean(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_sim = sd(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_sim))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4D) Village-level intra-village mean Jaccard
#     - Mean Jaccard similarity among all sample pairs
#       within each village
#     - This is directly linkable to social_village by vil_id
# ---------------------------------------------------------
village_intra_jaccard <- pw_anno %>%
  filter(
    same_village,
    !is.na(vil_id1),
    !is.na(clu1)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    vil_id = vil_id1,
    village_name = vil1,
    cluster = clu1
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    intra_jaccard_mean = mean(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    intra_jaccard_sd = sd(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    intra_jaccard_se = intra_jaccard_sd / sqrt(n()),
    n_intra_pairs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    merged %>%
      distinct(sampleid, vil_id) %>%
      count(vil_id, name = "n_samples"),
    by = "vil_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    intra_jaccard_pct = 100 * intra_jaccard_mean,
    cluster = factor(cluster, levels = as.character(1:4))
  ) %>%
  arrange(cluster, desc(intra_jaccard_mean))

print(village_intra_jaccard)

# Optional: attach social questionnaire data if it already exists
if (exists("social_village")) {
  village_intra_social <- village_intra_jaccard %>%
    left_join(
      social_village %>%
        select(
          vil_id,
          hall_attend_n,
          hall_gather_freq,
          hall_stability,
          shared_meal_freq,
          shared_meal_time,
          food_share_freq,
          intervillage_freq,
          intervillage_n,
          within_social_score,
          food_sharing_score,
          intervillage_score
        ),
      by = "vil_id"
    )

  cat("\nVillage-level intra Jaccard linked to social questionnaire\n")
  print(
    village_intra_social %>%
      summarise(
        n_villages = n(),
        n_with_social = sum(!is.na(within_social_score)),
        n_without_social = sum(is.na(within_social_score))
      )
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Export tables
# - derived: large intermediate table for reproducibility
# - supplementary: compact summary/statistics tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(pw_anno,      "derived_pairwise_jaccard_annot.csv")
write_csv(vill_summary, "supplementary_jaccard_summary_same_village.csv")
write_csv(clu_summary,  "supplementary_jaccard_summary_same_cluster.csv")
write_csv(vill_pair,    "supplementary_jaccard_mean_by_village_pair.csv")
write_csv(clu_pair,     "supplementary_jaccard_mean_by_cluster_pair.csv")

write_csv(
  village_intra_jaccard,
  "supplementary_village_intra_jaccard.csv"
)

if (exists("village_intra_social")) {
  write_csv(
    village_intra_social,
    "derived_village_intra_jaccard_social.csv"
  )
}

write_csv(
  tibble(
    test = c("same_village", "same_cluster"),
    statistic = c(unname(wilcox_village$statistic), unname(wilcox_cluster$statistic)),
    p_value   = c(wilcox_village$p.value, wilcox_cluster$p.value)
  ),
  "supplementary_jaccard_wilcox_results.csv"
)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(rstatix)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Jaccard pairwise plots
# - required inputs:
#     base_theme, clu_pal, save_plot_both()
#     pw_anno_jac (preferred) or pw_anno (fallback)
# - output objects:
#     pw_c_jac, stat_test_jac, p_c_violin_jac
#     intra_vil, inter_pair, cmp_jac, stat_jac, p_overall_jaccard
#     intra_vil_social [optional, if social_village exists]
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("base_theme"), exists("clu_pal"), exists("save_plot_both"))
stopifnot(exists("pw_anno_jac") || exists("pw_anno"))

fmt_p_label <- function(p, prefix = "P") {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    paste0(prefix, " = NA"),
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      paste0(prefix, " = ", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2)),
      paste0(prefix, " = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3))
    )
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Select pairwise annotation object
#    - preferred: pw_anno_jac
#    - fallback : pw_anno
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (exists("pw_anno_jac")) {
  pw_use <- pw_anno_jac
} else {
  pw_use <- pw_anno
}

stopifnot(all(c("jaccard_sim", "vil1", "vil2", "clu1", "clu2") %in% names(pw_use)))

has_vil_id <- all(c("vil_id1", "vil_id2") %in% names(pw_use))

if (!has_vil_id) {
  warning(
    "vil_id1 and vil_id2 were not found in pw_use. ",
    "Village-level outputs will fall back to village_name-based IDs."
  )
}

# Add same_village / same_cluster if absent
if (!"same_village" %in% names(pw_use)) {
  if (has_vil_id) {
    pw_use <- pw_use %>% mutate(same_village = (vil_id1 == vil_id2))
  } else {
    pw_use <- pw_use %>% mutate(same_village = (vil1 == vil2))
  }
}

if (!"same_cluster" %in% names(pw_use)) {
  pw_use <- pw_use %>% mutate(same_cluster = (clu1 == clu2))
}

# =========================================================
# Cluster-level intra vs inter comparison
# - Each pair is assigned to both clu1 and clu2
# - Wilcoxon test performed within each cluster
# - P-values adjusted by BH
# =========================================================
pw_c_jac <- pw_use %>%
  filter(!is.na(jaccard_sim), !is.na(clu1), !is.na(clu2)) %>%
  mutate(kind = ifelse(same_cluster, "intra", "inter")) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(clu1, clu2), names_to = "role", values_to = "cluster") %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = names(clu_pal)))

comparisons <- list(c("intra", "inter"))

stat_test_jac <- pw_c_jac %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  wilcox_test(jaccard_sim ~ kind) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "cluster", dodge = 0.7, comparisons = comparisons) %>%
  mutate(p_label = fmt_p_label(p.adj, prefix = "Padj"))

p_c_violin_jac <- ggplot(pw_c_jac, aes(x = cluster, y = jaccard_sim, fill = kind)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.16,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_test_jac,
    label = "p_label",
    tip.length = 0,
    hide.ns = TRUE,
    step.increase = 0.06,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4.5,
    bracket.size = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("intra" = "#FF6B6B", "inter" = "grey80"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Cluster-level ASV sharing rate",
    subtitle = "Statistics: two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test with Benjamini-Hochberg correction; Padj shown",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "ASV sharing rate"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p_c_violin_jac)

save_plot_both(
  p_c_violin_jac,
  "cluster_intra_vs_inter_violin_jaccard",
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

# =========================================================
# Overall mean ASV sharing rate (%)
# - intra: mean pairwise similarity within each village
# - inter: mean pairwise similarity for each undirected village pair
# - Wilcoxon test: intra villages vs inter village pairs
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Intra: village-wise mean
# - If vil_id1/vil_id2 exist, use vil_id as the primary key.
# - This output can be directly linked to social_village by vil_id.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (has_vil_id) {
  intra_vil <- pw_use %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(jaccard_sim),
      same_village,
      !is.na(vil_id1),
      !is.na(clu1)
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      vil_id = vil_id1,
      cluster = clu1
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_jac = mean(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_jac = sd(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_pairs = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      kind = "intra",
      id = vil_id,
      mean_jac_pct = 100 * mean_jac,
      cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = names(clu_pal))
    ) %>%
    arrange(cluster, desc(mean_jac))
} else {
  intra_vil <- pw_use %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(jaccard_sim),
      same_village,
      !is.na(vil1)
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      village_name = vil1,
      cluster = clu1
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_jac = mean(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_jac = sd(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_pairs = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      kind = "intra",
      id = village_name,
      mean_jac_pct = 100 * mean_jac,
      cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = names(clu_pal))
    ) %>%
    arrange(cluster, desc(mean_jac))
}

# Attach sample count if merged is available
if (exists("merged") && "vil_id" %in% names(intra_vil) && all(c("sampleid", "vil_id") %in% names(merged))) {
  intra_vil <- intra_vil %>%
    left_join(
      merged %>%
        distinct(sampleid, vil_id) %>%
        count(vil_id, name = "n_samples"),
      by = "vil_id"
    ) %>%
    relocate(n_samples, .after = cluster)
}

# Optional: attach social questionnaire data
if (exists("social_village") && "vil_id" %in% names(intra_vil)) {
  social_cols <- intersect(
    c(
      "vil_id",
      "hall_attend_n",
      "hall_gather_freq",
      "hall_stability",
      "shared_meal_freq",
      "shared_meal_time",
      "food_share_freq",
      "intervillage_freq",
      "intervillage_n",
      "within_social_score",
      "food_sharing_score",
      "intervillage_score"
    ),
    names(social_village)
  )

  intra_vil_social <- intra_vil %>%
    left_join(
      social_village %>% select(all_of(social_cols)),
      by = "vil_id"
    )

  cat("\nIntra-village Jaccard linked to social questionnaire\n")
  print(
    intra_vil_social %>%
      summarise(
        n_villages = n(),
        n_with_social = sum(!is.na(within_social_score)),
        n_without_social = sum(is.na(within_social_score))
      )
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Inter: undirected village-pair mean
# - If vil_id1/vil_id2 exist, use vil_id pair as the primary ID.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (has_vil_id) {
  inter_pair <- pw_use %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(jaccard_sim),
      !same_village,
      !is.na(vil_id1),
      !is.na(vil_id2)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      v1 = as.character(vil_id1),
      v2 = as.character(vil_id2),
      village_pair = paste(pmin(v1, v2), pmax(v1, v2), sep = " - ")
    ) %>%
    group_by(village_pair) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_jac = mean(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_jac = sd(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_pairs = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      kind = "inter",
      id = village_pair,
      mean_jac_pct = 100 * mean_jac
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_jac))
} else {
  inter_pair <- pw_use %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(jaccard_sim),
      !same_village,
      !is.na(vil1),
      !is.na(vil2)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      v1 = as.character(vil1),
      v2 = as.character(vil2),
      village_pair = paste(pmin(v1, v2), pmax(v1, v2), sep = " - ")
    ) %>%
    group_by(village_pair) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_jac = mean(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_jac = sd(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_pairs = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      kind = "inter",
      id = village_pair,
      mean_jac_pct = 100 * mean_jac
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_jac))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Combine intra-village means and inter-village-pair means
# for the overall comparison plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cmp_jac <- bind_rows(
  intra_vil %>% select(kind, id, mean_jac),
  inter_pair %>% select(kind, id, mean_jac)
) %>%
  mutate(mean_jac = mean_jac * 100)

stat_jac <- cmp_jac %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_jac)) %>%
  wilcox_test(mean_jac ~ kind) %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "kind") %>%
  mutate(p_label = fmt_p_label(p, prefix = "P"))

p_overall_jaccard <- ggplot(cmp_jac, aes(x = kind, y = mean_jac, fill = kind)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6, color = "black", width = 0.8) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.15,
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.8,
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_jac,
    label = "p_label",
    hide.ns = TRUE,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4.5,
    tip.length = 0.0,
    bracket.size = 0.5,
    y.position = max(cmp_jac$mean_jac, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("intra" = "#FF6B6B", "inter" = "grey80")) +
  labs(
    title = "Overall mean ASV sharing rate",
    subtitle = "Statistics: two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test; P shown",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean ASV sharing rate (%)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p_overall_jaccard)

save_plot_both(
  p_overall_jaccard,
  "overall_intra_vs_inter_jaccard_allpairs_percent",
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Export tables
# - supplementary: figure source data and statistics
# - derived: social-linked table if available
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(pw_c_jac,      "supplementary_cluster_intra_vs_inter_pairwise_jaccard.csv")
write_csv(stat_test_jac, "supplementary_cluster_intra_vs_inter_pairwise_jaccard_stats.csv")
write_csv(intra_vil,     "supplementary_overall_jaccard_intra_village_mean.csv")
write_csv(inter_pair,    "supplementary_overall_jaccard_inter_villagepair_mean.csv")
write_csv(cmp_jac,       "supplementary_overall_jaccard_intra_vs_inter_compare.csv")
write_csv(stat_jac,      "supplementary_overall_jaccard_intra_vs_inter_stats.csv")

if (exists("intra_vil_social")) {
  write_csv(
    intra_vil_social,
    "derived_overall_jaccard_intra_village_mean_social.csv"
  )
}
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Figure: village-wise mean intra-village sharing rate
# - required inputs:
#     pw_anno
#     base_theme, clu_pal, save_plot_both()
# - uses only:
#     vil_id1, vil_id2, clu1, jaccard_sim
# - output:
#     village_intra_mean_tbl
#     p_village_intra_mean
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("pw_anno"))
stopifnot(exists("base_theme"), exists("clu_pal"), exists("save_plot_both"))
stopifnot(all(c("vil_id1", "vil_id2", "clu1", "jaccard_sim") %in% names(pw_anno)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Village-wise mean intra-village Jaccard
#    - mean of all within-village sample-pair similarities
# ---------------------------------------------------------
village_intra_mean_tbl <- pw_anno %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(jaccard_sim),
    !is.na(vil_id1),
    !is.na(vil_id2),
    vil_id1 == vil_id2
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    vil_id = vil_id1,
    cluster = clu1
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_intra = mean(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_intra = sd(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_intra_pairs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_intra_pct = mean_intra * 100,
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = names(clu_pal))
  )

# Optional: add sample count
if (exists("merged") && all(c("sampleid", "vil_id") %in% names(merged))) {
  village_intra_mean_tbl <- village_intra_mean_tbl %>%
    left_join(
      merged %>%
        distinct(sampleid, vil_id) %>%
        count(vil_id, name = "n_samples"),
      by = "vil_id"
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Order villages by mean intra sharing rate
# ---------------------------------------------------------
village_intra_mean_tbl <- village_intra_mean_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_intra_pct)) %>%
  arrange(mean_intra_pct) %>%
  mutate(
    vil_id = factor(vil_id, levels = vil_id)
  )

print(village_intra_mean_tbl)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_village_intra_mean <- ggplot(
  village_intra_mean_tbl,
  aes(x = mean_intra_pct, y = vil_id, color = cluster)
) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, xend = mean_intra_pct, y = vil_id, yend = vil_id),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clu_pal, drop = FALSE, name = "Cluster") +
  labs(
    title = "Village-wise mean intra-village ASV sharing rate",
    subtitle = "Each point represents the mean Jaccard similarity across all within-village sample pairs",
    x = "Mean intra-village ASV sharing rate (%)",
    y = "Village ID"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_village_intra_mean)

save_plot_both(
  p_village_intra_mean,
  "village_mean_intra_sharing_rate",
  width = 8,
  height = 14
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Export source data
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(
  village_intra_mean_tbl,
  "supplementary_village_mean_intra_sharing_rate.csv"
)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(geodist)
  library(ggdendro)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Build dendrogram order table for heatmap
# - generates village order using the same dendrogram logic
# - output objects: order_tbl_core, leaf_lab_tbl_core
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("vil_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("merged"))
stopifnot(exists("clu_pal"))

# Optional packages
has_dendsort   <- requireNamespace("dendsort", quietly = TRUE)
has_dendextend <- requireNamespace("dendextend", quietly = TRUE)

# Fallback defaults
if (!exists("hc_method")) hc_method <- "average"

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Build village information table
# - use existing village_info_tbl / village_lab_map if available
# - otherwise construct them here
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("village_info_tbl")) {
  village_info_tbl <- vil_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      village_name = as.character(label),
      vil_id = as.character(vil_id)
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      merged %>%
        transmute(
          village_name = as.character(village_name),
          cluster = as.character(cluster)
        ) %>%
        distinct(),
      by = "village_name"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      vil_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", vil_id)))
    ) %>%
    distinct(village_name, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

if (!exists("village_lab_map")) {
  village_lab_map <- vil_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      village_name = as.character(label),
      vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
      village_lab = as.character(vil_lab)
    ) %>%
    distinct()
}

if (!exists("cluster_order_target")) {
  cluster_order_target <- names(clu_pal)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Build coordinate table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
vil_map_df <- vil_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    village_name = as.character(label),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    lon = as.numeric(lon),
    lat = as.numeric(lat)
  ) %>%
  distinct()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Compute Haversine distance and build dendrogram
# ---------------------------------------------------------
vil_cent_df <- vil_map_df %>%
  distinct(village_name, vil_id, lon, lat)

dist_mat <- geodist::geodist(
  x = vil_cent_df %>% select(lon, lat),
  measure = "haversine"
) / 1000

rownames(dist_mat) <- vil_cent_df$village_name
colnames(dist_mat) <- vil_cent_df$village_name

hc_raw <- hclust(as.dist(dist_mat), method = hc_method)
dend_raw <- as.dendrogram(hc_raw)

if (has_dendsort) {
  dend_raw <- dendsort::dendsort(dend_raw)
}

leaf_order_tbl_core <- labels(dend_raw) %>%
  tibble(village_name = .) %>%
  left_join(village_info_tbl, by = "village_name") %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_rank = match(cluster, cluster_order_target),
    cluster_rank = ifelse(is.na(cluster_rank), 999, cluster_rank),
    vil_num = ifelse(is.na(vil_num), Inf, vil_num)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Define desired final leaf order
# ---------------------------------------------------------
desired_leaf_order_core <- leaf_order_tbl_core %>%
  arrange(cluster_rank, vil_num, village_name) %>%
  pull(village_name)

if (has_dendextend) {
  dend_ord_core <- dendextend::rotate(dend_raw, order = desired_leaf_order_core)
} else {
  warning("Package 'dendextend' is not available; using reorder() instead. Final leaf order may not match exactly.")
  weight_vec <- leaf_order_tbl_core$cluster_rank * 10000 + leaf_order_tbl_core$vil_num
  names(weight_vec) <- leaf_order_tbl_core$village_name
  dend_ord_core <- reorder(dend_raw, wts = weight_vec, agglo.FUN = mean)
}

dend_labels_final_core <- labels(dend_ord_core)

order_tbl_core <- tibble(
  village_name = dend_labels_final_core,
  dendro_order = seq_along(dend_labels_final_core)
) %>%
  left_join(
    village_info_tbl %>% select(village_name, vil_id, cluster, vil_num),
    by = "village_name"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Add village labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if ("village_name" %in% names(village_lab_map)) {
  order_tbl_core <- order_tbl_core %>%
    left_join(
      village_lab_map %>% select(village_name, village_lab),
      by = "village_name"
    )
} else {
  order_tbl_core <- order_tbl_core %>%
    left_join(
      village_lab_map %>% select(vil_id, village_lab),
      by = "vil_id"
    )
}

order_tbl_core <- order_tbl_core %>%
  mutate(
    village_lab = ifelse(is.na(village_lab) | village_lab == "", vil_id, village_lab)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Build dendrogram label table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
dend_dat_core <- ggdendro::dendro_data(dend_ord_core, type = "rectangle")

leaf_lab_tbl_core <- dend_dat_core$labels %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(village_name = label) %>%
  left_join(order_tbl_core, by = "village_name") %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = names(clu_pal))) %>%
  arrange(x)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Export derived tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(order_tbl_core,    "derived_order_tbl_core.csv")
write_csv(leaf_lab_tbl_core, "derived_leaf_lab_tbl_core.csv")

# Quick check
print(order_tbl_core)
print(leaf_lab_tbl_core)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Core ASV heatmap (prevalence >= 90% within village)
# - required inputs:
#     asv_pa, asv_tax, merged, vil_tbl, base_theme,
#     order_tbl_core, save_plot_both()
# - output:
#     p_core
#     core_ASV_heatmap_clustered
# - x-axis village labels use village_lab ordered by order_tbl_core$dendro_order
# =========================================================

stopifnot(
  exists("asv_pa"),
  exists("asv_tax"),
  exists("merged"),
  exists("vil_tbl"),
  exists("base_theme"),
  exists("order_tbl_core"),
  exists("save_plot_both")
)
stopifnot("ASV" %in% names(asv_pa))
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "village_name", "cluster") %in% names(merged)))
stopifnot(all(c("village_name", "dendro_order") %in% names(order_tbl_core)))

ASV_col <- names(asv_pa)[1]
sample_cols <- setdiff(names(asv_pa), ASV_col)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Sample-village(+cluster) metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
vil_map_lab <- vil_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    village_name = as.character(label),
    vil_lab = as.character(vil_lab),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id)
  ) %>%
  distinct()

meta_sv <- merged %>%
  transmute(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    village_name = as.character(village_name),
    cluster_id = as.character(cluster)
  ) %>%
  left_join(vil_map_lab, by = "village_name")

all_samples <- intersect(meta_sv$sampleid, sample_cols)
if (length(all_samples) == 0) {
  stop("No shared samples were found between merged$sampleid and asv_pa sample columns.")
}
meta_sv <- meta_sv %>% filter(sampleid %in% all_samples)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Final village order table from order_tbl_core
# ---------------------------------------------------------
order_tbl_core_use <- order_tbl_core %>%
  mutate(village_name = as.character(village_name)) %>%
  {
    if ("village_lab" %in% names(.)) {
      mutate(., village_lab_use = as.character(village_lab))
    } else if ("vil_lab" %in% names(.)) {
      mutate(., village_lab_use = as.character(vil_lab))
    } else {
      left_join(., vil_map_lab, by = "village_name") %>%
        mutate(village_lab_use = as.character(vil_lab))
    }
  }

village_order_tbl <- order_tbl_core_use %>%
  transmute(
    village_name = as.character(village_name),
    leaf_order = as.integer(dendro_order),
    vil_lab = as.character(village_lab_use),
    vil_id = if ("vil_id" %in% names(order_tbl_core_use)) as.character(vil_id) else NA_character_,
    cluster_id = if ("cluster" %in% names(order_tbl_core_use)) as.character(cluster) else NA_character_
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_sv %>% distinct(village_name, cluster_id),
    by = "village_name",
    suffix = c("", "_meta")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_id = dplyr::coalesce(cluster_id, cluster_id_meta),
    vil_lab = dplyr::coalesce(vil_lab, vil_id, village_name)
  ) %>%
  select(village_name, vil_lab, vil_id, cluster_id, leaf_order) %>%
  distinct(village_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(leaf_order)

village_levels <- village_order_tbl %>%
  arrange(leaf_order) %>%
  pull(vil_lab)

cluster_levels <- village_order_tbl %>%
  arrange(leaf_order) %>%
  pull(cluster_id) %>%
  unique()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Prevalence-based core definition (>= 90%)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pa_long <- asv_pa %>%
  select(ASV = all_of(ASV_col), all_of(all_samples)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ASV, names_to = "sampleid", values_to = "pa") %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    pa = as.integer(replace_na(pa, 0) > 0)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_sv %>% select(sampleid, village_name, vil_lab, vil_id, cluster_id),
    by = "sampleid"
  )

prev_tbl <- pa_long %>%
  group_by(village_name, vil_lab, vil_id, cluster_id, ASV) %>%
  summarise(prev = mean(pa), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(core = as.integer(prev >= 0.9))

keep_asv <- prev_tbl %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(vcount = sum(core), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(vcount > 0) %>%
  pull(ASV)

prev_core <- prev_tbl %>%
  filter(ASV %in% keep_asv)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Taxon label
#    - do not use g__uncultured / g__unknown / g__unclassified as genus labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
lab_map <- asv_tax %>%
  transmute(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    Taxon,
    g = str_extract(Taxon, "g__[^;|]*"),
    f = str_extract(Taxon, "f__[^;|]*"),
    o = str_extract(Taxon, "o__[^;|]*"),
    c = str_extract(Taxon, "c__[^;|]*"),
    p = str_extract(Taxon, "p__[^;|]*"),
    d = str_extract(Taxon, "d__[^;|]*")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      g:d,
      ~ str_trim(ifelse(
        is.na(.) | . %in% c("g__", "f__", "o__", "c__", "p__", "d__", ""),
        NA, .
      ))
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    g = ifelse(g %in% c("g__uncultured", "g__unknown", "g__unclassified"), NA, g),
    label_name = coalesce(g, f, o, c, p, d, "unclassified"),
    asv_label = paste0(label_name, " | ", ASV)
  ) %>%
  select(ASV, asv_label)

prev_core <- prev_core %>%
  mutate(ASV = as.character(ASV)) %>%
  left_join(lab_map, by = "ASV")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Y-axis order: number of core-positive villages
# ---------------------------------------------------------
row_order <- prev_core %>%
  group_by(asv_label) %>%
  summarise(vcount = sum(core, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(vcount), asv_label) %>%
  pull(asv_label)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Apply final x-axis order from order_tbl_core
# ---------------------------------------------------------
prev_core <- prev_core %>%
  left_join(
    village_order_tbl %>% select(village_name, leaf_order),
    by = "village_name"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    asv_label = factor(asv_label, levels = row_order),
    vil_lab = factor(vil_lab, levels = village_levels),
    cluster_id = factor(cluster_id, levels = cluster_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(leaf_order)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_core <- ggplot(prev_core, aes(x = vil_lab, y = asv_label, fill = factor(core))) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("0" = "grey", "1" = "#2878b5"),
    labels = c("0" = "non-core", "1" = "core (>= 90%)"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  facet_grid(. ~ cluster_id, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Core ASV per village (dendrogram ordered, prevalence >= 90%)",
    x = "Village (ordered by final dendrogram leaf order)",
    y = "Taxon | ASV"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

print(p_core)

save_plot_both(
  p_core,
  "core_ASV_heatmap_clustered",
  width = 12,
  height = 10
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Export tables
# - supplementary: figure source data
# - derived: village order table used for plotting
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(prev_core,         "supplementary_core_ASV_prevalence_table.csv")
write_csv(village_order_tbl, "derived_core_ASV_village_order_table.csv")
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Core ASV summaries from prev_core
# - required input: prev_core (from the core heatmap chunk)
# - expected columns:
#     village_name, vil_lab, cluster_id, ASV, asv_label, core
# - output objects:
#     core_count_by_village, core_list_by_village,
#     core_count_by_cluster, core_label_freq_by_village
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("prev_core"))

need_cols <- c("village_name", "vil_lab", "cluster_id", "ASV", "asv_label", "core")
miss <- setdiff(need_cols, names(prev_core))
if (length(miss)) {
  stop("Required columns are missing in prev_core: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Number of core ASVs per village
# ---------------------------------------------------------
core_count_by_village <- prev_core %>%
  filter(core == 1) %>%
  distinct(vil_lab, ASV) %>%   # defensive de-duplication
  count(vil_lab, name = "n_core_asv") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_core_asv))

print(core_count_by_village)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Detailed core ASV list per village
# ---------------------------------------------------------
core_list_by_village <- prev_core %>%
  filter(core == 1) %>%
  distinct(vil_lab, ASV, asv_label) %>%
  arrange(vil_lab, asv_label) %>%
  select(vil_lab, ASV, asv_label)

print(core_list_by_village)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Helper to inspect one village
# ---------------------------------------------------------
view_core <- function(vil_lab_query) {
  prev_core %>%
    filter(vil_lab == vil_lab_query, core == 1) %>%
    distinct(vil_lab, ASV, asv_label) %>%
    arrange(asv_label) %>%
    select(vil_lab, ASV, asv_label)
}

# Example
# view_core("V01 (n=12)")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Number of core ASVs per cluster
# - cluster_id is already present in prev_core
# ---------------------------------------------------------
core_count_by_cluster <- prev_core %>%
  filter(core == 1) %>%
  distinct(cluster_id, vil_lab, ASV) %>%   # avoid duplicate village-level counting
  count(cluster_id, name = "n_core_asv") %>%
  arrange(cluster_id)

print(core_count_by_cluster)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Frequency of core label_name per village
# ---------------------------------------------------------
core_label_freq_by_village <- prev_core %>%
  filter(core == 1) %>%
  distinct(vil_lab, ASV, asv_label) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(
    asv_label,
    delim = " | ",
    names = c("label_name", "ASV_id"),
    too_few = "align_start"
  ) %>%
  group_by(vil_lab, label_name) %>%
  summarise(n_core = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(vil_lab, desc(n_core))

print(core_label_freq_by_village)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Export tables
# - supplementary: summary and listing tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(core_count_by_village,      "supplementary_core_asv_count_by_village.csv")
write_csv(core_list_by_village,       "supplementary_core_asv_list_by_village.csv")
write_csv(core_count_by_cluster,      "supplementary_core_asv_count_by_cluster.csv")
write_csv(core_label_freq_by_village, "supplementary_core_label_freq_by_village.csv")
```
