```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# =========================================================
# Core/cluster-core sweeps and cluster-core Jaccard
# - required inputs:
#     asv_pa, merged, vil_tbl, base_theme, clu_pal,
#     order_tbl_core, save_plot_both()
# - optional input:
#     asv_tax
# - output figures:
#     
#     cluster_core_ASV_jaccard_heatmap
# =========================================================

stopifnot(
  exists("asv_pa"),
  exists("merged"),
  exists("vil_tbl"),
  exists("base_theme"),
  exists("clu_pal"),
  exists("order_tbl_core"),
  exists("save_plot_both")
)
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "village_name", "cluster") %in% names(merged)))
stopifnot("ASV" %in% names(asv_pa))

ASV_col     <- names(asv_pa)[1]
sample_cols <- setdiff(names(asv_pa), ASV_col)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Sample -> village/cluster + village label
# ---------------------------------------------------------
vil_map_lab <- vil_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    village_name = as.character(label),
    vil_lab = as.character(vil_lab)
  ) %>%
  distinct()

meta_sv <- merged %>%
  transmute(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    village_name = as.character(village_name),
    cluster_id = as.character(cluster)
  ) %>%
  left_join(vil_map_lab, by = "village_name") %>%
  filter(!is.na(vil_lab))

all_samples <- intersect(meta_sv$sampleid, sample_cols)
if (length(all_samples) == 0) {
  stop("No shared samples were found between merged$sampleid and asv_pa sample columns.")
}
meta_sv <- meta_sv %>% filter(sampleid %in% all_samples)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Village x-axis order from the final dendrogram order
# ---------------------------------------------------------
order_tbl_core_use <- order_tbl_core %>%
  mutate(village_name = as.character(village_name)) %>%
  {
    if ("village_lab" %in% names(.)) {
      mutate(., village_lab_use = as.character(village_lab))
    } else if ("vil_lab" %in% names(.)) {
      mutate(., village_lab_use = as.character(vil_lab))
    } else {
      left_join(., vil_map_lab, by = "village_name") %>%
        mutate(village_lab_use = as.character(vil_lab))
    }
  }

village_order_tbl <- order_tbl_core_use %>%
  transmute(
    village_name = as.character(village_name),
    dendro_order = as.integer(dendro_order),
    vil_lab = as.character(village_lab_use),
    cluster_id = if ("cluster" %in% names(order_tbl_core_use)) as.character(cluster) else NA_character_
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_sv %>% distinct(village_name, cluster_id),
    by = "village_name",
    suffix = c("", "_meta")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_id = dplyr::coalesce(cluster_id, cluster_id_meta),
    vil_lab = dplyr::coalesce(vil_lab, village_name)
  ) %>%
  select(village_name, vil_lab, cluster_id, dendro_order) %>%
  distinct(village_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(dendro_order)

village_levels <- village_order_tbl %>%
  arrange(dendro_order) %>%
  pull(vil_lab)

cluster_levels <- names(clu_pal)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Build pa_long and prev_tbl once
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pa_long <- asv_pa %>%
  select(ASV = all_of(ASV_col), all_of(all_samples)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ASV, names_to = "sampleid", values_to = "pa") %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    pa = as.integer(replace_na(pa, 0) > 0)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_sv %>% select(sampleid, village_name, vil_lab, cluster_id),
    by = "sampleid"
  )

prev_tbl <- pa_long %>%
  group_by(village_name, vil_lab, cluster_id, ASV) %>%
  summarise(prev = mean(pa), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_id = factor(as.character(cluster_id), levels = cluster_levels)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Cluster-core sweep
#    - village core: prev >= thr
#    - cluster-core: core in at least frac_min of villages within a cluster
# ---------------------------------------------------------
build_cluster_core <- function(thr, frac_min = 0.5) {
  prev_vil <- prev_tbl %>%
    mutate(core = as.integer(prev >= thr)) %>%
    distinct(village_name, vil_lab, cluster_id, ASV, core)

  prev_vil %>%
    group_by(cluster_id, ASV) %>%
    summarise(
      n_vil_core = sum(core > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_vil = n_distinct(village_name),
      frac_core = ifelse(n_vil > 0, n_vil_core / n_vil, 0),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      cluster_core = as.integer(frac_core >= frac_min),
      threshold = thr
    )
}

thresholds_A <- seq(0.5, 0.9, by = 0.1)
core_sweep <- bind_rows(lapply(thresholds_A, build_cluster_core))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3A) Optional taxon label map
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (exists("asv_tax")) {
  lab_map <- asv_tax %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = as.character(ASV),
      Taxon,
      g = str_extract(Taxon, "g__[^;|]*"),
      f = str_extract(Taxon, "f__[^;|]*"),
      o = str_extract(Taxon, "o__[^;|]*"),
      c = str_extract(Taxon, "c__[^;|]*"),
      p = str_extract(Taxon, "p__[^;|]*"),
      d = str_extract(Taxon, "d__[^;|]*")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        g:d,
        ~ ifelse(
          is.na(.) | . %in% c("g__", "f__", "o__", "c__", "p__", "d__", ""),
          NA, .
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      g = ifelse(g %in% c("g__uncultured", "g__unknown", "g__unclassified"), NA, g),
      label_name = coalesce(g, f, o, c, p, d, "unclassified"),
      asv_label = paste0(label_name, " | ", ASV)
    ) %>%
    select(ASV, asv_label)

  core_sweep <- core_sweep %>%
    mutate(ASV = as.character(ASV)) %>%
    left_join(lab_map, by = "ASV")
} else {
  core_sweep <- core_sweep %>%
    mutate(asv_label = as.character(ASV))
}

core_sweep <- core_sweep %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_id = factor(as.character(cluster_id), levels = cluster_levels),
    threshold = factor(threshold, levels = thresholds_A)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Top rows for heatmaps
# ---------------------------------------------------------
core_top <- core_sweep %>%
  filter(frac_core >= 0.5) %>%
  group_by(threshold, cluster_id) %>%
  slice_max(frac_core, n = 100, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4A)  x = threshold, facet = cluster, y = ASV
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_sweep_A <- ggplot(core_top, aes(x = threshold, y = asv_label, fill = frac_core)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(. ~ cluster_id, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0.5, 1), name = "Core fraction") +
  labs(
    title = "Core ASV across prevalence thresholds (faceted by cluster)",
    x = "Prevalence threshold (core >= x)",
    y = "ASV"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )

print(p_sweep_A)
save_plot_both(
  p_sweep_A,
  "core_sweep_heatmap_byCluster",
  width = 10,
  height = 7
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4B)  x = cluster, facet = threshold, y = ASV
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_sweep_B <- ggplot(core_top, aes(x = cluster_id, y = asv_label, fill = frac_core)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(. ~ threshold, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0.5, 1), name = "Core fraction") +
  labs(
    title = "Core ASV across prevalence thresholds (faceted by threshold)",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "ASV"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )

print(p_sweep_B)
save_plot_both(
  p_sweep_B,
  "core_sweep_heatmap_byThreshold",
  width = 10,
  height = 7
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) village-wise core % across prevalence thresholds
#    - thresholds from 1.00 to 0.01
#    - x: village label in dendrogram order
#    - y: threshold (%)
#    - fill: core_pct
# ---------------------------------------------------------
thresholds_v <- seq(1, 0.01, by = -0.01)

core_counts <- bind_rows(lapply(thresholds_v, function(thr) {
  prev_tbl %>%
    group_by(village_name, vil_lab, cluster_id) %>%
    summarise(core_count = sum(prev >= thr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(threshold = thr)
}))

tot_by_vil <- prev_tbl %>%
  group_by(village_name, vil_lab, cluster_id) %>%
  summarise(total_detected = sum(prev > 0), .groups = "drop")

core_heat_pct <- core_counts %>%
  left_join(tot_by_vil, by = c("village_name", "vil_lab", "cluster_id")) %>%
  left_join(
    village_order_tbl %>% select(village_name, dendro_order),
    by = "village_name"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    threshold_pct = threshold * 100,
    core_pct = ifelse(total_detected > 0, 100 * core_count / total_detected, 0),
    core_pct = ifelse(core_pct == 0, NA, core_pct),
    cluster_id = factor(as.character(cluster_id), levels = cluster_levels),
    vil_lab = factor(vil_lab, levels = village_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(dendro_order)

p_core_heat_pct <- ggplot(
  core_heat_pct,
  aes(x = vil_lab, y = threshold_pct, fill = core_pct)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 10),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#440154", "#3B528B", "#21908C", "#5DC863", "#FDE725"),
    limits = c(0, 100),
    oob = scales::squish,
    na.value = "grey80",
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    labels = c("0", "20", "40", "60", "80", "100"),
    name = "Core ASV (%)"
  ) +
  facet_grid(. ~ cluster_id, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Village-wise core ASV percentage across prevalence thresholds",
    x = "Village (final dendrogram leaf order)",
    y = "Prevalence threshold"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1.2, size = 10),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )

print(p_core_heat_pct)
save_plot_both(
  p_core_heat_pct,
  "core_counts_percent_threshold_sweep_by_village",
  width = 16,
  height = 10
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Cluster-core ASV set Jaccard heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
prev_thresh <- 0.90
frac_thresh <- 0.50

pc <- prev_tbl %>%
  mutate(core = as.integer(prev >= prev_thresh)) %>%
  distinct(village_name, cluster_id, ASV, core)

clu_core <- pc %>%
  group_by(cluster_id, ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    n_vil_core = sum(core > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_vil = n_distinct(village_name),
    frac_core = ifelse(n_vil > 0, n_vil_core / n_vil, 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(cluster_core = as.integer(frac_core >= frac_thresh))

mat <- clu_core %>%
  mutate(cluster_id = factor(as.character(cluster_id), levels = cluster_levels)) %>%
  select(cluster_id, ASV, cluster_core) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = ASV, values_from = cluster_core, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("cluster_id") %>%
  as.matrix()

intersect_mat <- mat %*% t(mat)
sizes <- rowSums(mat)
union_mat <- outer(sizes, sizes, "+") - intersect_mat
jaccard_mat <- ifelse(union_mat > 0, intersect_mat / union_mat, 0)

df_j <- as.data.frame(as.table(jaccard_mat))
names(df_j) <- c("cluster_i", "cluster_j", "jaccard")

p_j <- ggplot(df_j, aes(cluster_i, cluster_j, fill = jaccard)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", jaccard)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 1), name = "Jaccard") +
  labs(
    title = sprintf(
      "Jaccard similarity of cluster-core ASV sets\n(village core >= %.0f%%, cluster-core >= %.0f%% of villages)",
      prev_thresh * 100, frac_thresh * 100
    ),
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Cluster"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

print(p_j)
save_plot_both(
  p_j,
  "cluster_core_ASV_jaccard_heatmap",
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Cluster-specific signature ASV list
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sig_list <- clu_core %>%
  select(cluster_id, ASV, cluster_core) %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  mutate(sum_core = sum(cluster_core, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(sum_core == 1, cluster_core == 1) %>%
  arrange(cluster_id, ASV)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Export tables
# - supplementary: source tables for figures/results
# - derived: ordering table used for plotting
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(core_sweep,         "supplementary_cluster_core_sweep_table.csv")
write_csv(core_top,           "supplementary_cluster_core_sweep_top_table.csv")
write_csv(core_heat_pct,      "supplementary_village_core_threshold_sweep_table.csv")
write_csv(df_j,               "supplementary_cluster_core_ASV_jaccard_table.csv")
write_csv(sig_list,           "supplementary_cluster_signature_core_ASV.csv")
write_csv(village_order_tbl,  "derived_cluster_core_village_order_table.csv")
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(vegan)
  library(rstatix)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Alpha diversity (Shannon) by cluster
# - required inputs:
#     merged, clu_pal, base_theme, save_plot_both()
#     asv_abund (preferred) or asv_pa
# - output:
#     p_alpha
#     alpha_diversity_cluster_with_pvals
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("merged"), exists("clu_pal"), exists("base_theme"), exists("save_plot_both"))
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "cluster", "village_name") %in% names(merged)))

if (!exists("asv_abund") && !exists("asv_pa")) {
  stop("Either asv_abund or asv_pa is required.")
}

fmt_p_label <- function(p, prefix = "P") {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    paste0(prefix, " = NA"),
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      paste0(prefix, " = ", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2)),
      paste0(prefix, " = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3))
    )
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Select abundance matrix
# ---------------------------------------------------------
abund_df <- if (exists("asv_abund")) asv_abund else asv_pa
ASV_col <- names(abund_df)[1]
sample_cols <- setdiff(names(abund_df), ASV_col)
cluster_levels <- names(clu_pal)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Keep shared samples and align ordering
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_min_alpha <- merged %>%
  select(sampleid, cluster, village_name) %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = cluster_levels),
    village_name = as.character(village_name)
  )

common_samples <- intersect(meta_min_alpha$sampleid, sample_cols)
if (length(common_samples) < 3) {
  stop("Too few shared samples were found. Please check sampleid and abundance matrix columns.")
}

meta_ord <- meta_min_alpha %>%
  filter(sampleid %in% common_samples)

# rows = samples, columns = ASVs
A <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(abund_df[, common_samples, drop = FALSE])))
colnames(A) <- abund_df[[ASV_col]]
A[is.na(A)] <- 0
A <- as.matrix(A)

# Reorder to match metadata
A <- A[meta_ord$sampleid, , drop = FALSE]

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Compute alpha diversity
# ---------------------------------------------------------
alpha_df <- tibble::tibble(
  sampleid = rownames(A),
  richness = rowSums(A > 0),
  shannon  = vegan::diversity(A, index = "shannon"),
  pielou   = ifelse(richness > 0, shannon / log(richness), NA_real_)
) %>%
  left_join(meta_ord, by = "sampleid")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Statistics: Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn (BH)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
kw_alpha <- kruskal_test(alpha_df, shannon ~ cluster) %>%
  mutate(p_label = fmt_p_label(p, prefix = "P"))

dunn_alpha <- dunn_test(alpha_df, shannon ~ cluster, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  mutate(
    group1 = factor(as.character(group1), levels = cluster_levels),
    group2 = factor(as.character(group2), levels = cluster_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(group1, group2) %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    group1 = as.character(group1),
    group2 = as.character(group2),
    p_label = fmt_p_label(p.adj, prefix = "Padj")
  )

# Bracket y positions
y_range <- range(alpha_df$shannon, na.rm = TRUE)
y_min   <- y_range[1]
y_max   <- y_range[2]
y_step  <- diff(y_range) * 0.06

if (!is.finite(y_step) || y_step == 0) {
  y_step <- 0.1
}

if (nrow(dunn_alpha) > 0) {
  dunn_alpha <- dunn_alpha %>%
    mutate(y.position = y_max + y_step * (row_number() + 1))
}

y_upper <- if (nrow(dunn_alpha) > 0) {
  max(dunn_alpha$y.position) + y_step * 1.5
} else {
  y_max + y_step * 1.5
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_alpha <- ggplot(alpha_df, aes(x = cluster, y = shannon, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_violin(
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = 1,
    color = "black",
    width = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.22,
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.95,
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clu_pal, drop = FALSE) +
  {
    if (nrow(dunn_alpha) > 0) {
      ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
        dunn_alpha,
        label = "p_label",
        tip.length = 0,
        bracket.size = 0.6,
        size = 4.5,
        step.increase = 0,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      list()
    }
  } +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min, y_upper)) +
  labs(
    title = "Alpha diversity (Shannon) by cluster",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Statistics: Kruskal-Wallis test (",
      kw_alpha$p_label[1],
      "); pairwise Dunn test with Benjamini-Hochberg correction, Padj shown"
    ),
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Shannon index"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_alpha)

save_plot_both(
  p_alpha,
  "alpha_diversity_cluster_with_pvals",
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Export tables
# - supplementary: sample-wise alpha diversity and statistics
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(alpha_df,   "supplementary_alpha_diversity_by_sample.csv")
write_csv(kw_alpha,   "supplementary_alpha_diversity_kruskal_result.csv")
write_csv(dunn_alpha, "supplementary_alpha_diversity_dunn_bh_result.csv")
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(vegan)
  library(rstatix)
})

# =========================================================
# Alpha (Shannon) vs intra/inter Jaccard (per sample)
# - main figures:
#     
# - required inputs:
#     merged, asv_pa, alpha_df, clu_pal, base_theme, save_plot_both()
# - optional derived input:
#     pw_anno_jac
# - output objects:
#     alpha_join, p_intra, p_delta
# =========================================================

stopifnot(
  exists("merged"),
  exists("asv_pa"),
  exists("alpha_df"),
  exists("clu_pal"),
  exists("base_theme"),
  exists("save_plot_both")
)
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "cluster", "village_name") %in% names(merged)))
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "shannon") %in% names(alpha_df)))

cluster_levels <- names(clu_pal)

fmt_p_label <- function(p, prefix = "P") {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    paste0(prefix, " = NA"),
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      paste0(prefix, " = ", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2)),
      paste0(prefix, " = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3))
    )
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Build pw_anno_jac (upper-triangle pairwise table) if absent
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("pw_anno_jac")) {
  ASV_col <- names(asv_pa)[1]
  sample_cols <- setdiff(names(asv_pa), ASV_col)

  all_samples <- intersect(as.character(merged$sampleid), sample_cols)
  if (length(all_samples) < 3) {
    stop("Too few shared samples were found. Please check merged$sampleid and asv_pa.")
  }

  M <- asv_pa %>%
    select(ASV = all_of(ASV_col), all_of(all_samples)) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("ASV") %>%
    as.matrix()

  pa_mat <- t(M)
  pa_mat[is.na(pa_mat)] <- 0L
  pa_mat <- (pa_mat > 0) * 1L

  rs <- rowSums(pa_mat)
  if (any(rs == 0)) {
    pa_mat <- pa_mat[rs > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  ids <- rownames(pa_mat)

  dist_jac <- vegan::vegdist(pa_mat, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)

  to_long_upper <- function(d, ids) {
    m <- as.matrix(d)
    ut <- which(upper.tri(m), arr.ind = TRUE)
    tibble::tibble(
      sample1 = ids[ut[, 1]],
      sample2 = ids[ut[, 2]],
      jaccard_dist = m[ut],
      jaccard_sim = 1 - m[ut]
    )
  }

  pw <- to_long_upper(dist_jac, ids)

  meta_min_pw <- merged %>%
    select(sampleid, village_name, cluster) %>%
    mutate(
      sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
      village_name = as.character(village_name),
      cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = cluster_levels)
    )

  pw_anno_jac <- pw %>%
    left_join(meta_min_pw, by = c("sample1" = "sampleid")) %>%
    rename(vil1 = village_name, clu1 = cluster) %>%
    left_join(meta_min_pw, by = c("sample2" = "sampleid")) %>%
    rename(vil2 = village_name, clu2 = cluster) %>%
    mutate(
      same_cluster = (clu1 == clu2),
      same_village = (vil1 == vil2)
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Compute per-sample mean intra/inter similarity (cluster-based)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
by_sample_c <- pw_anno_jac %>%
  mutate(kind = ifelse(same_cluster, "intra", "inter")) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(sample1, sample2), names_to = "role", values_to = "sampleid") %>%
  group_by(sampleid, kind) %>%
  summarise(mean_sim = mean(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = kind, values_from = mean_sim)

alpha_join <- alpha_df %>%
  select(sampleid, cluster, shannon, richness, pielou) %>%
  left_join(by_sample_c, by = "sampleid") %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = cluster_levels),
    delta = intra - inter
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Correlation labels (overall + per cluster; Spearman)
#    - BH/FDR correction applied across overall + clusters
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_corr_labels <- function(df, yvar, cluster_levels) {
  ysym <- rlang::sym(yvar)

  overall <- rstatix::cor_test(df, shannon, !!ysym, method = "spearman") %>%
    mutate(
      test_scope = "overall",
      cluster = NA_character_
    )

  byclu <- df %>%
    mutate(cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = cluster_levels)) %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    rstatix::cor_test(shannon, !!ysym, method = "spearman") %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      test_scope = "within_cluster",
      cluster = as.character(cluster)
    )

  corr_tbl <- bind_rows(overall, byclu) %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
      label = ifelse(
        is.na(cluster),
        sprintf("Overall: rho = %.2f, %s", cor, fmt_p_label(p_adj, prefix = "Padj")),
        sprintf("C%s: rho = %.2f, %s", cluster, cor, fmt_p_label(p_adj, prefix = "Padj"))
      )
    )

  yr <- range(df[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
  xr <- range(df$shannon, na.rm = TRUE)

  y_top <- yr[2] - 0.02 * diff(yr)
  x_left <- xr[1] + 0.02 * diff(xr)

  if (!is.finite(diff(yr)) || diff(yr) == 0) {
    y_top <- yr[2]
  }
  if (!is.finite(diff(xr)) || diff(xr) == 0) {
    x_left <- xr[1]
  }

  corr_tbl <- corr_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      label_order = ifelse(is.na(cluster), 0, match(cluster, cluster_levels))
    ) %>%
    arrange(label_order) %>%
    mutate(
      label.x = x_left,
      label.y = y_top - row_number() * 0.05 * max(diff(yr), 1e-6)
    ) %>%
    select(-label_order)

  corr_tbl
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
#  Per-sample intra vs Shannon
# ---------------------------------------------------------
lab1 <- make_corr_labels(alpha_join, "intra", cluster_levels)

p_intra <- ggplot(alpha_join, aes(shannon, intra)) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm", se = TRUE,
    color = "black", fill = "grey50",
    alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(color = cluster, fill = cluster),
    method = "lm", se = TRUE,
    alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(color = cluster), alpha = 0.65, size = 1.8) +
  geom_text(
    data = lab1,
    aes(x = label.x, y = label.y, label = label, color = cluster),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
    size = 5,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clu_pal, name = "Cluster", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clu_pal, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Per-sample intra-cluster similarity vs Shannon",
    subtitle = "Statistics: Spearman rank correlation; rho and BH-adjusted P shown",
    x = "Shannon index",
    y = "Mean ASV sharing rate (intra)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

print(p_intra)

save_plot_both(
  p_intra,
  "scatter_intra_vs_shannon_with_corr_fixed",
  width = 10,
  height = 7
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
#  Per-sample delta (intra - inter) vs Shannon
# ---------------------------------------------------------
lab2 <- make_corr_labels(alpha_join, "delta", cluster_levels)

p_delta <- ggplot(alpha_join, aes(shannon, delta)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 3, color = "grey60") +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm", se = TRUE,
    color = "black", fill = "grey50",
    alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(color = cluster, fill = cluster),
    method = "lm", se = TRUE,
    alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(color = cluster), alpha = 0.65, size = 1.8) +
  geom_text(
    data = lab2,
    aes(x = label.x, y = label.y, label = label, color = cluster),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
    size = 5,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clu_pal, name = "Cluster", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clu_pal, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Per-sample (intra - inter) similarity vs Shannon",
    subtitle = "Statistics: Spearman rank correlation; rho and BH-adjusted P shown",
    x = "Shannon index",
    y = "Delta ASV sharing rate (intra - inter)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

print(p_delta)

save_plot_both(
  p_delta,
  "scatter_delta_vs_shannon_with_corr_fixed",
  width = 10,
  height = 7
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Export tables
# - supplementary: source data
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(alpha_join, "supplementary_alpha_join_intra_inter_jaccard.csv")
write_csv(lab1, "supplementary_corr_shannon_intra_jaccard_BH.csv")
write_csv(lab2, "supplementary_corr_shannon_delta_jaccard_BH.csv")
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Jaccard-based PCoA with dashed cluster ellipses + PERMANOVA
# - required inputs:
#     asv_pa, merged, base_theme, clu_pal, save_plot_both()
# - output:
#     p_pcoa
#     pcoa_jaccard_samples_ellipse_dashed_PERMANOVA
# ---------------------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(vegan)
  library(ape)
  library(readr)
})

stopifnot(
  exists("asv_pa"),
  exists("merged"),
  exists("clu_pal"),
  exists("base_theme"),
  exists("save_plot_both")
)
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "cluster", "village_name") %in% names(merged)))

fmt_p_label <- function(p, prefix = "P") {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    paste0(prefix, " = NA"),
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      paste0(prefix, " = ", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2)),
      paste0(prefix, " = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3))
    )
  )
}

ASV_col <- names(asv_pa)[1]
sample_cols <- setdiff(names(asv_pa), ASV_col)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Keep only shared samples
# ---------------------------------------------------------
all_samples <- intersect(as.character(merged$sampleid), sample_cols)
if (length(all_samples) < 3) {
  stop("Too few shared samples were found. Please check merged$sampleid and asv_pa sample columns.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Presence/absence matrix (rows = samples, columns = ASVs)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
M <- asv_pa %>%
  select(ASV = all_of(ASV_col), all_of(all_samples)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("ASV") %>%
  as.matrix()

pa_mat <- t(M)
pa_mat[is.na(pa_mat)] <- 0L
pa_mat <- (pa_mat > 0) * 1L

# Remove all-zero samples
row_sums <- rowSums(pa_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
if (any(row_sums == 0)) {
  drop_ids <- rownames(pa_mat)[row_sums == 0]
  message("Removing samples with no detected ASVs: ", paste(drop_ids, collapse = ", "))
  pa_mat <- pa_mat[row_sums > 0, , drop = FALSE]
}

if (nrow(pa_mat) < 3) {
  stop("Fewer than three valid samples remain after removing all-zero samples.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Jaccard distance -> PCoA
# ---------------------------------------------------------
d_jac <- vegdist(pa_mat, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)
pco <- ape::pcoa(d_jac)

scores <- as.data.frame(pco$vectors[, 1:2, drop = FALSE])
colnames(scores) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
scores$sampleid <- rownames(scores)

var_exp <- pco$values$Relative_eig[1:2] * 100
lx <- sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[1])
ly <- sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[2])

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Merge metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_min_pcoa <- merged %>%
  select(sampleid, cluster, village_name) %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = names(clu_pal))
  )

plot_df <- scores %>%
  left_join(meta_min_pcoa, by = "sampleid") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster))

# Explicitly align distance matrix and metadata for PERMANOVA
sample_keep <- intersect(rownames(as.matrix(d_jac)), plot_df$sampleid)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  filter(sampleid %in% sample_keep) %>%
  mutate(sampleid = factor(sampleid, levels = sample_keep)) %>%
  arrange(sampleid) %>%
  mutate(sampleid = as.character(sampleid))

d_jac <- as.dist(as.matrix(d_jac)[sample_keep, sample_keep])

if (nrow(plot_df) < 3) {
  stop("Fewer than three valid samples remain for PCoA/PERMANOVA.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) PERMANOVA (Jaccard ~ cluster)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(123)
perm <- vegan::adonis2(d_jac ~ cluster, data = plot_df, permutations = 999)

R2  <- perm$R2[1]
pvl <- perm$`Pr(>F)`[1]
p_label <- fmt_p_label(pvl, prefix = "P")

subt <- sprintf(
  "Statistics: PERMANOVA (adonis2, 999 permutations), R^2 = %.3f, %s; 95%% confidence ellipses",
  R2, p_label
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) PCoA with dashed ellipses
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_pcoa <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = cluster)) +
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(group = cluster),
    type = "norm",
    level = 0.95,
    geom = "path",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clu_pal, drop = FALSE, name = "Cluster") +
  labs(
    title = "PCoA of sample-level ASV composition (Jaccard)",
    subtitle = subt,
    x = lx,
    y = ly
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(1.2, "lines")
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5, alpha = 1)))

print(p_pcoa)

save_plot_both(
  p_pcoa,
  "pcoa_jaccard_samples_ellipse_dashed_PERMANOVA",
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Export tables
# - supplementary: PCoA coordinates and PERMANOVA results
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(plot_df, "supplementary_pcoa_jaccard_sample_coordinates.csv")

write_csv(
  tibble::tibble(
    term = rownames(as.data.frame(perm))[1],
    R2 = R2,
    p_value = pvl,
    permutations = 999
  ),
  "supplementary_pcoa_jaccard_permanova_result.csv"
)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(vegan)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
})

# =========================================================
# Beta diversity dispersion (betadisper, Jaccard) by cluster
# + PERMANOVA summary in subtitle
# - required inputs:
#     merged, asv_pa, clu_pal, base_theme, save_plot_both()
# - output:
#     p_disp
#     beta_diversity_jaccard_cluster_sigonly
# - note:
#     the PCoA figure is handled separately 
# =========================================================

stopifnot(
  exists("merged"),
  exists("clu_pal"),
  exists("base_theme"),
  exists("save_plot_both"),
  exists("asv_pa")
)
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "cluster") %in% names(merged)))

fmt_p_label <- function(p, prefix = "P") {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    paste0(prefix, " = NA"),
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      paste0(prefix, " = ", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2)),
      paste0(prefix, " = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3))
    )
  )
}

ASV_col <- names(asv_pa)[1]
sample_cols <- setdiff(names(asv_pa), ASV_col)

meta_min_bd <- merged %>%
  select(sampleid, cluster) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = names(clu_pal))
  )

common_samples <- intersect(meta_min_bd$sampleid, sample_cols)
if (length(common_samples) < 3) {
  stop("Too few shared samples were found. Please check sampleid and ASV table columns.")
}

meta_ord <- meta_min_bd %>%
  filter(sampleid %in% common_samples)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Sample x ASV matrix
# ---------------------------------------------------------
A <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(asv_pa[, common_samples, drop = FALSE])))
colnames(A) <- asv_pa[[ASV_col]]
A[is.na(A)] <- 0
A <- as.matrix(A)
A <- A[meta_ord$sampleid, , drop = FALSE]

# Presence/absence
PA <- (A > 0) * 1
rs <- rowSums(PA)

if (any(rs == 0)) {
  drop_ids <- rownames(PA)[rs == 0]
  message("Removing samples with no detected ASVs: ", paste(drop_ids, collapse = ", "))

  keep <- rs > 0
  PA <- PA[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  meta_ord <- meta_ord[match(rownames(PA), meta_ord$sampleid), , drop = FALSE]
}

grp <- factor(meta_ord$cluster, levels = names(clu_pal))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Jaccard distance
# ---------------------------------------------------------
dist_jac <- vegdist(PA, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) PERMANOVA (summary for subtitle)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(123)
perm_adonis <- adonis2(dist_jac ~ grp, permutations = 999, by = "margin")
adonis_R2 <- perm_adonis$R2[1]
adonis_p  <- perm_adonis$`Pr(>F)`[1]
adonis_p_label <- fmt_p_label(adonis_p, prefix = "P")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Betadisper + permutation test + Tukey HSD
#    - retain significant pairs only
# ---------------------------------------------------------
bd <- betadisper(dist_jac, group = grp)

set.seed(123)
perm_bd <- permutest(bd, permutations = 999)
global_p_disp <- perm_bd$tab[1, "Pr(>F)"]
disp_p_label <- fmt_p_label(global_p_disp, prefix = "P")

tuk <- TukeyHSD(bd)
tuk_df <- as.data.frame(tuk$group)
tuk_df$contrast <- rownames(tuk_df)

tuk_df <- tuk_df %>%
  tidyr::separate(contrast, into = c("group1", "group2"), sep = "-") %>%
  transmute(
    group1,
    group2,
    p.adj = `p adj`
  ) %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = fmt_p_label(p.adj, prefix = "Padj")
  )

df_plot <- tibble::tibble(
  sampleid = rownames(PA),
  cluster = grp,
  dist = as.numeric(bd$distances)
)

ymax <- max(df_plot$dist) * 1.10
step <- diff(range(df_plot$dist)) * 0.06

if (!is.finite(step) || step == 0) {
  step <- 0.05
}

if (nrow(tuk_df) > 0) {
  tuk_df <- tuk_df %>%
    mutate(y.position = ymax + (row_number() * step))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Plot 
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_disp <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = cluster, y = dist, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_violin(
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = 1,
    color = "black",
    width = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.22,
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.95,
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  {
    if (nrow(tuk_df) > 0) {
      ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
        tuk_df,
        label = "p_label",
        tip.length = 0,
        bracket.size = 0.5,
        hide.ns = TRUE,
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 4.5,
        color = "black"
      )
    } else {
      list()
    }
  } +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clu_pal, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Beta diversity dispersion (Jaccard) by cluster",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Statistics: betadisper permutation test (999 permutations, ",
      disp_p_label,
      "); PERMANOVA (adonis2, 999 permutations, R^2 = ",
      sprintf("%.3f", adonis_R2),
      ", ",
      adonis_p_label,
      "); Tukey HSD Padj shown for significant pairs only"
    ),
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Jaccard distance to centroid"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(
      min(df_plot$dist) * 0.98,
      ymax + step * (max(1, nrow(tuk_df)) + 2)
    )
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_disp)

save_plot_both(
  p_disp,
  "beta_diversity_jaccard_cluster_sigonly",
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Export tables
# - supplementary: sample-wise distances and statistical results
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(df_plot, "supplementary_betadisper_jaccard_distances_by_sample.csv")
write_csv(tuk_df,  "supplementary_betadisper_tukey_sig_pairs.csv")

write_csv(
  tibble::tibble(
    term = "cluster",
    R2 = adonis_R2,
    p_value = adonis_p,
    permutations = 999
  ),
  "supplementary_betadisper_permanova_result.csv"
)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
})

# =========================================================
# Main figure for each cluster
#   Left: log2FC_pos (detected-only) enrichment direction
#   Right: prevalence z-score heatmap (ASV-wise across clusters)
#
# Required inputs:
#   - asv_abund (ASV x samples)
#   - merged (sampleid, cluster, village_name)
#   - base_theme, clu_pal, save_plot_both()
#
# Optional input:
#   - asv_tax (ASV, Taxon)
#
# Outputs:
#   - main_log2FCpos_plus_prevZ_C{K}.png/.svg   (K in 1..4)
#   - supplementary_cluster_signature_table_C{K}.csv
#   - supplementary_cluster_signature_candidates_C{K}.csv
# =========================================================

stopifnot(
  exists("asv_abund"),
  exists("merged"),
  exists("clu_pal"),
  exists("base_theme"),
  exists("save_plot_both")
)
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "cluster") %in% names(merged)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Build ab_long once: relPct(%) + pres(0/1) + cluster
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ASV_col <- names(asv_abund)[1]
sample_cols <- setdiff(names(asv_abund), ASV_col)

meta_min <- merged %>%
  select(sampleid, cluster) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = names(clu_pal))
  )

common_samples <- intersect(meta_min$sampleid, sample_cols)
if (length(common_samples) < 3) {
  stop("Too few shared samples were found. Please check sampleid and abundance matrix columns.")
}
meta_min <- meta_min %>% filter(sampleid %in% common_samples)

ab_long <- asv_abund %>%
  select(ASV = all_of(ASV_col), all_of(common_samples)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ASV, names_to = "sampleid", values_to = "abund") %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    abund = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(abund)),
    abund = replace_na(abund, 0),
    pres = as.integer(abund >= 0.001)
  ) %>%
  group_by(sampleid) %>%
  mutate(
    tot = sum(abund, na.rm = TRUE),
    relPct = ifelse(tot > 0, 100 * abund / tot, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(meta_min, by = "sampleid") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) ASV label map (optional)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_label_map <- function(asv_ids) {
  if (!exists("asv_tax")) {
    return(tibble(
      ASV = as.character(asv_ids),
      show_label = as.character(asv_ids)
    ))
  }

  lab_map <- asv_tax %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = as.character(ASV),
      Taxon,
      g = str_extract(Taxon, "g__[^;|]*"),
      f = str_extract(Taxon, "f__[^;|]*"),
      o = str_extract(Taxon, "o__[^;|]*"),
      c = str_extract(Taxon, "c__[^;|]*"),
      p = str_extract(Taxon, "p__[^;|]*"),
      d = str_extract(Taxon, "d__[^;|]*")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        g:d,
        ~ ifelse(
          is.na(.) | . %in% c("g__", "f__", "o__", "c__", "p__", "d__", ""),
          NA, .
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      g = ifelse(g %in% c("g__uncultured", "g__unknown", "g__unclassified"), NA, g),
      label_name = coalesce(g, f, o, c, p, d, "unclassified"),
      show_label = paste0(label_name, " | ", ASV)
    ) %>%
    select(ASV, show_label) %>%
    distinct()

  tibble(ASV = as.character(asv_ids)) %>%
    left_join(lab_map, by = "ASV") %>%
    mutate(show_label = ifelse(is.na(show_label) | show_label == "", ASV, show_label))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Cluster vs Others stats table
#    - prevalence: Fisher's exact test + BH
#    - abundance: detected-only Wilcoxon + BH
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cluster_vs_others <- function(target_cluster, eps = 1e-6) {
  dat <- ab_long %>%
    mutate(group = ifelse(as.character(cluster) == as.character(target_cluster), "Target", "Others"))

  # Prevalence Fisher + BH
  prev_counts <- dat %>%
    group_by(ASV, group) %>%
    summarise(
      n_pres = sum(pres, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_samp = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = group,
      values_from = c(n_pres, n_samp),
      values_fill = 0
    )

  prev_stats <- prev_counts %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      p_prev = tryCatch(
        fisher.test(matrix(c(
          n_pres_Target, n_samp_Target - n_pres_Target,
          n_pres_Others, n_samp_Others - n_pres_Others
        ), nrow = 2))$p.value,
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      ),
      prev_T = ifelse(n_samp_Target > 0, n_pres_Target / n_samp_Target, NA_real_),
      prev_O = ifelse(n_samp_Others > 0, n_pres_Others / n_samp_Others, NA_real_),
      d_prev = prev_T - prev_O
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(p_prev_adj = p.adjust(p_prev, method = "BH")) %>%
    select(ASV, prev_T, prev_O, d_prev, p_prev, p_prev_adj)

  # Detected-only abundance (>= 0.1%) Wilcoxon + BH + log2FC_pos
  ab_pos <- dat %>% filter(pres == 1)

  ab_wide <- ab_pos %>%
    group_by(ASV, group) %>%
    summarise(
      vec = list(relPct),
      mean_pos = mean(relPct, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_pos = sum(!is.na(relPct)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = group,
      values_from = c(vec, mean_pos, n_pos),
      values_fill = list(mean_pos = 0, n_pos = 0)
    )

  ab_stats <- ab_wide %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      log2FC_pos = log2((mean_pos_Target + eps) / (mean_pos_Others + eps)),
      p_abund_pos = tryCatch(
        wilcox.test(unlist(vec_Target), unlist(vec_Others))$p.value,
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(p_abund_pos_adj = p.adjust(p_abund_pos, method = "BH")) %>%
    select(
      ASV,
      mean_pos_T = mean_pos_Target,
      mean_pos_O = mean_pos_Others,
      n_pos_T = n_pos_Target,
      n_pos_O = n_pos_Others,
      log2FC_pos,
      p_abund_pos,
      p_abund_pos_adj
    )

  all_asv <- union(prev_stats$ASV, ab_stats$ASV)
  lab_map <- make_label_map(all_asv)

  prev_stats %>%
    full_join(ab_stats, by = "ASV") %>%
    left_join(lab_map, by = "ASV") %>%
    mutate(target_cluster = as.character(target_cluster)) %>%
    mutate(
      sig_prev = !is.na(p_prev_adj) & p_prev_adj < 0.05,
      sig_abpos = !is.na(p_abund_pos_adj) & p_abund_pos_adj < 0.05,
      sig_cat = case_when(
        sig_prev & sig_abpos ~ "Both",
        sig_prev ~ "Prev only",
        sig_abpos ~ "Abund(det) only",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Candidate selection (bidirectional; enriched + depleted)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pick_bidir <- function(df, top_each = 15) {
  df_ok <- df %>% filter(!is.na(log2FC_pos) | !is.na(d_prev))

  prev_up <- df_ok %>% filter(sig_prev) %>% arrange(desc(d_prev)) %>% slice_head(n = top_each)
  prev_dn <- df_ok %>% filter(sig_prev) %>% arrange(d_prev) %>% slice_head(n = top_each)

  ab_up <- df_ok %>% filter(sig_abpos) %>% arrange(desc(log2FC_pos)) %>% slice_head(n = top_each)
  ab_dn <- df_ok %>% filter(sig_abpos) %>% arrange(log2FC_pos) %>% slice_head(n = top_each)

  bind_rows(prev_up, prev_dn, ab_up, ab_dn) %>%
    distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Main plot builder
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_main_panel <- function(df_all, cand, target_cluster) {
  if (nrow(cand) == 0) {
    p_empty <- ggplot() +
      annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = paste0("No candidate ASVs for cluster ", target_cluster), size = 6) +
      xlim(-1, 1) + ylim(-1, 1) +
      labs(
        title = sprintf("Cluster %s vs Others", target_cluster),
        subtitle = "No candidate ASVs passed the current selection criteria"
      ) +
      base_theme +
      theme(
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank()
      )
    return(p_empty)
  }

  # ---- Left panel: effect plot (log2FC_pos) ----
  plot_eff <- df_all %>%
    filter(ASV %in% cand$ASV) %>%
    arrange(desc(log2FC_pos)) %>%
    mutate(show_label = factor(show_label, levels = show_label))

  cat_pal <- c(
    "NS" = "grey75",
    "Prev only" = "#66c2a5",
    "Abund(det) only" = "#fc8d62",
    "Both" = "#377EB8"
  )

  p_eff <- ggplot(plot_eff, aes(x = log2FC_pos, y = show_label, color = sig_cat)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(size = 2.8, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = cat_pal,
      name = "Significance\n(Fisher exact + Wilcoxon,\nBH-adjusted Padj < 0.05)"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("Cluster %s vs Others (detected-only): enrichment direction", target_cluster),
      subtitle = "Statistics: prevalence by Fisher's exact test with Benjamini-Hochberg correction; detected-only abundance by two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test with Benjamini-Hochberg correction",
      x = "log2FC_pos (Target / Others) among detected samples",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.key.size = grid::unit(1.2, "lines")
    )

  # ---- Right panel: prevalence z-score heatmap ----
  row_order <- levels(plot_eff$show_label)
  label_map <- plot_eff %>% distinct(ASV, show_label)

  prev_mat <- ab_long %>%
    filter(ASV %in% plot_eff$ASV) %>%
    group_by(cluster, ASV) %>%
    summarise(prev = mean(pres, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(label_map, by = "ASV") %>%
    mutate(
      cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = names(clu_pal)),
      show_label = factor(show_label, levels = row_order)
    )

  prev_wide <- prev_mat %>%
    select(show_label, cluster, prev) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = cluster, values_from = prev, values_fill = 0)

  clv <- names(clu_pal)

  prev_wide_z <- prev_wide %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      mu = mean(c_across(all_of(clv)), na.rm = TRUE),
      sdv = sd(c_across(all_of(clv)), na.rm = TRUE),
      across(all_of(clv), ~ ifelse(is.na(sdv) | sdv == 0, 0, (.x - mu) / sdv))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(show_label, all_of(clv)) %>%
    mutate(show_label = factor(show_label, levels = row_order))

  prev_z_long <- prev_wide_z %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(clv), names_to = "cluster", values_to = "z") %>%
    mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = clv))

  z_lim <- max(abs(prev_z_long$z), na.rm = TRUE)
  z_lim <- ifelse(is.finite(z_lim) && z_lim > 0, z_lim, 1)

  p_prev_z <- ggplot(prev_z_long, aes(x = cluster, y = show_label, fill = z)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#3B4CC0",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#B40426",
      limits = c(-z_lim, z_lim),
      name = "Prevalence\nz-score"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Prevalence by cluster (ASV-wise z-score)",
      subtitle = "Descriptive panel: z-score computed within each ASV across clusters",
      x = "Cluster",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )

  p_eff + p_prev_z + plot_layout(widths = c(2.6, 1.2))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Run for all clusters
# ---------------------------------------------------------
targets <- names(clu_pal)

sig_res <- list()

for (tg in targets) {
  message("=== Main signature figure: target cluster ", tg, " ===")

  df_all <- cluster_vs_others(target_cluster = tg)
  cand <- pick_bidir(df_all, top_each = 15)
  p_main <- make_main_panel(df_all, cand, tg)

  # store objects for later supplementary export
  sig_res[[as.character(tg)]] <- list(
    target_cluster = as.character(tg),
    df_all = df_all,
    cand = cand,
    p_main = p_main
  )

  save_plot_both(
    p_main,
    sprintf("main_log2FCpos_plus_prevZ_C%s", tg),
    width = 14,
    height = 10
  )

 
  readr::write_csv(df_all, sprintf("supplementary_cluster_signature_table_C%s.csv", tg))
  readr::write_csv(cand,  sprintf("supplementary_cluster_signature_candidates_C%s.csv", tg))
}
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(ggdendro)
  library(geodist)
  library(readr)
})

stopifnot(exists("asv_pa"), exists("merged"), exists("base_theme"), exists("save_plot_both"))
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "village_name") %in% names(merged)))

# =========================================================
# A) Village-wise intra vs inter (k = 3 nearest villages)
#    using Jaccard similarity on presence/absence data
# - output objects:
#     vil_cmp, nn_tbl, D, p_dumbbell
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Jaccard similarity matrix J (sample x sample)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ASV_col <- names(asv_pa)[1]
sample_cols <- setdiff(names(asv_pa), ASV_col)

all_samples <- intersect(as.character(merged$sampleid), sample_cols)
if (length(all_samples) < 3) {
  stop("Too few shared samples were found.")
}

M <- as.matrix(asv_pa[, all_samples, drop = FALSE])
M[is.na(M)] <- 0
M <- (M > 0) * 1L
samples <- colnames(M)

Ixy <- crossprod(M)
k   <- colSums(M)
Uxy <- outer(k, k, "+") - Ixy
J   <- Ixy / Uxy
diag(J) <- NA
J[Uxy == 0] <- NA
colnames(J) <- rownames(J) <- samples

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Village -> sample list
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_min_v <- merged %>%
  select(sampleid, village_name) %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    village_name = as.character(village_name)
  ) %>%
  filter(sampleid %in% samples) %>%
  distinct()

vil_list <- split(meta_min_v$sampleid, meta_min_v$village_name)

vil_n <- tibble(
  village_name = names(vil_list),
  n_samples = vapply(vil_list, length, integer(1))
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Village coordinates + village_id
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (exists("vil_tbl")) {
  vil_coord <- vil_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      village_name = as.character(label),
      lat = as.numeric(lat),
      lon = as.numeric(lon)
    ) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    filter(village_name %in% names(vil_list))

  vil_id_map <- vil_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      village_name = as.character(label),
      village_id = as.character(vil_id)
    ) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    filter(village_name %in% names(vil_list))

} else if (exists("df_vil_coord")) {

  pick_col <- function(df, candidates) {
    nm <- names(df)
    hit <- candidates[candidates %in% nm][1]
    if (is.na(hit)) stop("Cannot find any of: ", paste(candidates, collapse = ", "))
    hit
  }

  latc <- pick_col(df_vil_coord, c("latitude", "lat", "위도"))
  lonc <- pick_col(df_vil_coord, c("longitude", "lon", "long", "경도"))
  labc <- pick_col(df_vil_coord, c("village_name", "village", "name", "마을", "마을명"))

  vil_coord <- df_vil_coord %>%
    transmute(
      village_name = as.character(.data[[labc]]),
      lat = as.numeric(.data[[latc]]),
      lon = as.numeric(.data[[lonc]])
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(village_name), !is.na(lat), !is.na(lon)) %>%
    group_by(village_name) %>%
    summarise(lat = mean(lat), lon = mean(lon), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(village_name %in% names(vil_list))

  vil_id_map <- vil_coord %>%
    arrange(lon, lat) %>%
    mutate(village_id = sprintf("V%02d", row_number())) %>%
    select(village_name, village_id)

} else {
  stop("Either vil_tbl or df_vil_coord is required.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Haversine distance matrix D (km) + k-nearest neighbors
# ---------------------------------------------------------
haversine_km <- function(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) {
  R <- 6371.0088
  toRad <- pi / 180
  dlat <- (lat2 - lat1) * toRad
  dlon <- (lon2 - lon1) * toRad
  a <- sin(dlat / 2)^2 + cos(lat1 * toRad) * cos(lat2 * toRad) * sin(dlon / 2)^2
  2 * R * asin(pmin(1, sqrt(a)))
}

vn <- vil_coord$village_name
nV <- length(vn)

D <- matrix(NA_real_, nV, nV, dimnames = list(vn, vn))
for (i in seq_len(nV)) {
  for (j in seq_len(nV)) {
    D[i, j] <- if (i == j) {
      Inf
    } else {
      haversine_km(vil_coord$lat[i], vil_coord$lon[i], vil_coord$lat[j], vil_coord$lon[j])
    }
  }
}

k_neigh <- 3
nn_tbl <- lapply(vn, function(v) {
  ord <- order(D[v, ], na.last = NA)
  nb <- colnames(D)[ord][1:k_neigh]
  tibble(village_name = v, neigh = nb, dist_km = D[v, nb])
}) %>% bind_rows()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Intra / inter(k=3) summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
mean_upper <- function(mat) {
  if (nrow(mat) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  mean(mat[upper.tri(mat)], na.rm = TRUE)
}

mean_between <- function(Jmat, idxA, idxB) {
  if (length(idxA) == 0 || length(idxB) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(Jmat[idxA, idxB, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
}

intra_df <- tibble(village_name = names(vil_list)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    intra = {
      ids <- vil_list[[village_name]]
      mean_upper(J[ids, ids, drop = FALSE])
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

inter_k_df <- nn_tbl %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    inter_pair = {
      a <- village_name
      b <- neigh
      mean_between(J, vil_list[[a]], vil_list[[b]])
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(village_name) %>%
  summarise(inter_k3 = mean(inter_pair, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

vil_cmp <- intra_df %>%
  left_join(inter_k_df, by = "village_name") %>%
  left_join(vil_n, by = "village_name") %>%
  left_join(vil_id_map, by = "village_name") %>%
  mutate(
    intra_pct    = 100 * intra,
    inter_k3_pct = 100 * inter_k3,
    delta_pct    = intra_pct - inter_k3_pct
  )

# =========================================================
# B) Figure: dumbbell plot
# =========================================================
plot_long <- vil_cmp %>%
  select(village_id, n_samples, intra_pct, inter_k3_pct) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(intra_pct, inter_k3_pct), names_to = "type", values_to = "mean_jac_pct") %>%
  mutate(
    type = recode(
      type,
      intra_pct = "Intra (within-village)",
      inter_k3_pct = "Inter (mean of 3 nearest villages)"
    ),
    type = factor(
      type,
      levels = c("Inter (mean of 3 nearest villages)", "Intra (within-village)")
    )
  )

y_order <- vil_cmp %>% arrange(desc(intra_pct)) %>% pull(village_id)
plot_long$village_id <- factor(plot_long$village_id, levels = y_order)

seg_df <- vil_cmp %>%
  mutate(village_id = factor(village_id, levels = y_order)) %>%
  transmute(village_id, x = inter_k3_pct, xend = intra_pct, n_samples)

pal <- c(
  "Intra (within-village)" = "#E41A1C",
  "Inter (mean of 3 nearest villages)" = "grey35"
)
shp <- c(
  "Intra (within-village)" = 16,
  "Inter (mean of 3 nearest villages)" = 17
)

p_dumbbell <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = seg_df,
    aes(y = village_id, yend = village_id, x = x, xend = xend),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    color = "grey70"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_long,
    aes(x = mean_jac_pct, y = village_id, color = type, shape = type, size = n_samples),
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shp, name = NULL) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "N samples", range = c(2, 6)) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 6)),
    shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 6))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Village-wise ASV sharing rate: intra vs inter (k = 3 nearest)",
    subtitle = "Y-axis sorted by intra (descending); labels are V01.. assigned by longitude",
    x = "Mean ASV sharing rate (%)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

print(p_dumbbell)
save_plot_both(
  p_dumbbell,
  "village_intra_vs_inter_k3_dumbbell",

)

# =========================================================
# C) Optional: actual global dendrogram + dumbbell
#    - branch structure and leaf order aligned to the global dendrogram
# =========================================================
stopifnot(exists("clu_pal"))
stopifnot(exists("vil_tbl") || exists("df_vil_coord"))

has_dendsort   <- requireNamespace("dendsort", quietly = TRUE)
has_dendextend <- requireNamespace("dendextend", quietly = TRUE)

if (!exists("hc_method")) hc_method <- "average"

# ---------------------------------------------------------

      ) %>%

  } else {

  }
}

if (!exists("village_lab_map")) {
  if (exists("vil_tbl")) {
    village_lab_map <- vil_tbl %>%
      transmute(
        village_name = as.character(label),

  }
}

if (!exists("cluster_order_target")) {
  cluster_order_target <- names(clu_pal)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# C-2) Rebuild global dendrogram using the same logic
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (exists("vil_tbl")) {
  vil_map_df <- vil_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      village_name = as.character(label),
      vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
      lon = as.numeric(lon),
      lat = as.numeric(lat)
    ) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    filter(village_name %in% vil_cmp$village_name)

} else {

  pick_col <- function(df, candidates) {
    nm <- names(df)
    hit <- candidates[candidates %in% nm][1]
    if (is.na(hit)) stop("Cannot find any of: ", paste(candidates, collapse = ", "))
    hit
  }

  latc <- pick_col(df_vil_coord, c("latitude", "lat", "위도"))
  lonc <- pick_col(df_vil_coord, c("longitude", "lon", "long", "경도"))
  labc <- pick_col(df_vil_coord, c("village_name", "village", "name", "마을", "마을명"))

  vil_map_df <- df_vil_coord %>%
    transmute(
      village_name = as.character(.data[[labc]]),
      lon = as.numeric(.data[[lonc]]),
      lat = as.numeric(.data[[latc]])
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(village_name), !is.na(lat), !is.na(lon)) %>%
    group_by(village_name) %>%
    summarise(lon = mean(lon), lat = mean(lat), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(vil_id_map %>% rename(vil_id = village_id), by = "village_name") %>%
    filter(village_name %in% vil_cmp$village_name)
}

vil_cent_df <- vil_map_df %>%
  distinct(village_name, vil_id, lon, lat)

dist_mat <- geodist::geodist(
  x = vil_cent_df %>% select(lon, lat),
  measure = "haversine"
) / 1000

rownames(dist_mat) <- vil_cent_df$village_name
colnames(dist_mat) <- vil_cent_df$village_name

hc_raw <- hclust(as.dist(dist_mat), method = hc_method)
dend_raw <- as.dendrogram(hc_raw)

if (has_dendsort) {
  dend_raw <- dendsort::dendsort(dend_raw)
}

leaf_order_tbl_core <- labels(dend_raw) %>%
  tibble::tibble(village_name = .) %>%
  left_join(village_info_tbl, by = "village_name") %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_rank = match(cluster, cluster_order_target),
    cluster_rank = ifelse(is.na(cluster_rank), 999, cluster_rank),
    vil_num = ifelse(is.na(vil_num), Inf, vil_num)
  )

desired_leaf_order_core <- leaf_order_tbl_core %>%
  arrange(cluster_rank, vil_num, village_name) %>%
  pull(village_name)

if (has_dendextend) {
  dend_ord_core <- dendextend::rotate(dend_raw, order = desired_leaf_order_core)
} else {
  warning("Package 'dendextend' is not available; using reorder() instead. Final leaf order may not match exactly.")
  weight_vec <- leaf_order_tbl_core$cluster_rank * 10000 + leaf_order_tbl_core$vil_num
  names(weight_vec) <- leaf_order_tbl_core$village_name
  dend_ord_core <- reorder(dend_raw, wts = weight_vec, agglo.FUN = mean)
}

dend_labels_final_core <- labels(dend_ord_core)

order_tbl_core_plot <- tibble::tibble(
  village_name = dend_labels_final_core,
  dendro_order = seq_along(dend_labels_final_core)
) %>%
  left_join(
    village_info_tbl %>% select(village_name, vil_id, cluster, vil_num),
    by = "village_name"
  )

if ("village_name" %in% names(village_lab_map)) {
  order_tbl_core_plot <- order_tbl_core_plot %>%
    left_join(
      village_lab_map %>% select(village_name, village_lab),
      by = "village_name"
    )
} else {
  order_tbl_core_plot <- order_tbl_core_plot %>%
    left_join(
      village_lab_map %>% select(vil_id, village_lab),
      by = "vil_id"
    )
}

order_tbl_core_plot <- order_tbl_core_plot %>%
  mutate(
    village_lab = ifelse(is.na(village_lab) | village_lab == "", vil_id, village_lab)
  ) %>%
  filter(village_name %in% vil_cmp$village_name)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# C-3) Align dumbbell y-axis to the actual global dendrogram
# ---------------------------------------------------------
y_order_id <- order_tbl_core_plot %>%
  arrange(dendro_order) %>%
  left_join(vil_id_map, by = "village_name") %>%
  mutate(village_id = dplyr::coalesce(village_id, vil_id)) %>%
  pull(village_id)

n_y <- length(y_order_id)
id_to_y <- setNames(seq_along(y_order_id), y_order_id)

plot_long_num <- plot_long %>%
  mutate(
    village_id = as.character(village_id),
    y_num = id_to_y[village_id]
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(y_num))

seg_df_num <- seg_df %>%
  mutate(
    village_id = as.character(village_id),
    y_num = id_to_y[village_id]
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(y_num))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# C-4) Actual dendrogram panel
# ---------------------------------------------------------
dd <- ggdendro::dendro_data(dend_ord_core, type = "rectangle")

p_den <- ggplot(dd$segments) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = y, y = x, xend = yend, yend = xend),
    linewidth = 0.4,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  scale_x_reverse(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1, n_y), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 0, 5, 5))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# C-5) Dumbbell with actual dendrogram-aligned y-axis
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_dumbbell_num <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = seg_df_num,
    aes(y = y_num, yend = y_num, x = x, xend = xend),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    color = "grey70"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_long_num,
    aes(x = mean_jac_pct, y = y_num, color = type, shape = type, size = n_samples),
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shp, name = NULL) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "N samples", range = c(2, 6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq_len(n_y),
    labels = y_order_id,
    limits = c(1, n_y),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 6)),
    shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 6))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Village-wise ASV sharing rate: intra vs inter (k = 3 nearest)",
    subtitle = "Y-axis ordered by the actual global village dendrogram",
    x = "Mean ASV sharing rate (%)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(1.2, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 0)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# C-6) Combine
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_combo2 <- p_den + p_dumbbell_num + plot_layout(widths = c(1.0, 2.2))
print(p_combo2)

save_plot_both(
  p_combo2,
  "village_intra_vs_inter_k3_dumbbell_with_dendrogram",
  width = 12,
  height = 14
)

# =========================================================
# D) Optional significance ring
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# D-1) Significance test per village: intra > inter(k = 3)
# - uses: J, vil_list, nn_tbl
# - output: vil_sig
# ---------------------------------------------------------
get_intra_vals <- function(Jmat, ids) {
  if (length(ids) < 2) return(numeric(0))
  x <- Jmat[ids, ids, drop = FALSE]
  v <- x[upper.tri(x)]
  v <- v[is.finite(v)]
  as.numeric(v)
}

get_between_vals <- function(Jmat, idsA, idsB) {
  if (length(idsA) < 1 || length(idsB) < 1) return(numeric(0))
  x <- Jmat[idsA, idsB, drop = FALSE]
  v <- as.vector(x)
  v <- v[is.finite(v)]
  as.numeric(v)
}

neigh_list <- split(nn_tbl$neigh, nn_tbl$village_name)

vil_sig <- tibble(village_name = names(vil_list)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    intra_vals = list(get_intra_vals(J, vil_list[[village_name]])),
    inter_vals = list({
      nbs <- neigh_list[[village_name]]
      if (is.null(nbs) || length(nbs) == 0) return(numeric(0))
      unlist(
        lapply(nbs, function(nb) {
          get_between_vals(J, vil_list[[village_name]], vil_list[[nb]])
        }),
        use.names = FALSE
      )
    }),
    n_intra = length(intra_vals),
    n_inter = length(inter_vals),
    med_intra = if (n_intra > 0) median(intra_vals) else NA_real_,
    med_inter = if (n_inter > 0) median(inter_vals) else NA_real_,
    p_value = if (n_intra > 1 && n_inter > 1) {
      suppressWarnings(
        wilcox.test(unlist(intra_vals), unlist(inter_vals), alternative = "greater")$p.value
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    sig_vil = !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05
  ) %>%
  select(village_name, n_intra, n_inter, med_intra, med_inter, p_value, p_adj, sig_vil)

vil_cmp <- vil_cmp %>% left_join(vil_sig, by = "village_name")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# D-2) Add significance rings on dumbbell
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sig_ids <- vil_cmp %>% filter(sig_vil) %>% pull(village_id)

p_dumbbell_ring <- p_dumbbell +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_long %>% filter(village_id %in% sig_ids, type == "Intra (within-village)"),
    aes(x = mean_jac_pct, y = village_id, size = n_samples),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 1, color = "black", stroke = 0.9, alpha = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_long %>% filter(village_id %in% sig_ids, type == "Inter (mean of 3 nearest villages)"),
    aes(x = mean_jac_pct, y = village_id, size = n_samples),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 2, color = "black", stroke = 0.9, alpha = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    subtitle = "Circled villages: one-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test on pairwise Jaccard values (intra > inter of 3 nearest villages), Benjamini-Hochberg corrected Padj < 0.05"
  )

print(p_dumbbell_ring)

save_plot_both(
  p_dumbbell_ring,
  "village_intra_vs_inter_k3_dumbbell_with_significance",
  width = 10,
  height = 14
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Export tables
# - supplementary: main village-wise comparison and significance table
# - derived: nearest-neighbor table and distance matrix
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(vil_cmp, "supplementary_village_intra_vs_inter_k3_summary.csv")
write_csv(vil_sig, "supplementary_village_intra_vs_inter_k3_significance_table.csv")
write_csv(nn_tbl,  "derived_village_k3_nearest_neighbor_table.csv")

write_csv(
  as.data.frame(D) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("village_name"),
  "derived_village_haversine_distance_matrix_km.csv"
)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(sf)
  library(rnaturalearth)
  library(rnaturalearthdata)
  library(readr)
})

stopifnot(exists("vil_cmp"), exists("base_theme"), exists("save_plot_both"))
stopifnot(all(c("village_name", "intra_pct", "inter_k3_pct") %in% names(vil_cmp)))
stopifnot(any(c("sig_vil", "p_adj") %in% names(vil_cmp)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Background layers
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("kr_land")) {
  kr_land <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(
    scale = "large",
    country = "South Korea",
    returnclass = "sf"
  )
}

if (!exists("kr_coast")) {
  kr_coast <- rnaturalearth::ne_coastline(
    scale = "large",
    returnclass = "sf"
  )
}

if (!exists("jeolla")) {
  st_kr <- rnaturalearth::ne_states(
    country = "South Korea",
    returnclass = "sf"
  )

  jeolla <- st_kr %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      grepl("Jeollabuk|North Jeolla|Jeonbuk|전라북", name, ignore.case = TRUE) |
      grepl("Jeollanam|South Jeolla|Jeonnam|전라남", name, ignore.case = TRUE)
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Coordinate table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (exists("vil_coord")) {
  coord_df <- vil_coord %>%
    transmute(
      village_name = as.character(village_name),
      lon = as.numeric(lon),
      lat = as.numeric(lat)
    )
} else if (exists("vil_tbl")) {
  coord_df <- vil_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      village_name = as.character(label),
      lon = as.numeric(lon),
      lat = as.numeric(lat)
    ) %>%
    distinct()
} else {
  stop("Either vil_coord or vil_tbl is required.")
}

coord_df <- coord_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) intra > inter labels + significance
# ---------------------------------------------------------
map_df <- coord_df %>%
  left_join(
    vil_cmp %>%
      transmute(
        village_name = as.character(village_name),
        intra_pct,
        inter_k3_pct,
        sig_vil = if ("sig_vil" %in% names(vil_cmp)) {
          as.logical(sig_vil)
        } else {
          !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05
        },
        p_adj = if ("p_adj" %in% names(vil_cmp)) p_adj else NA_real_
      ),
    by = "village_name"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    flag = case_when(
      !is.na(intra_pct) & !is.na(inter_k3_pct) & intra_pct > inter_k3_pct ~ "gt",
      !is.na(intra_pct) & !is.na(inter_k3_pct) ~ "le",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

n_gt <- sum(map_df$flag == "gt", na.rm = TRUE)
n_le <- sum(map_df$flag == "le", na.rm = TRUE)
n_sig <- sum(map_df$flag == "gt" & map_df$sig_vil, na.rm = TRUE)

lab_gt <- sprintf("Intra > Inter (n=%d)", n_gt)
lab_le <- sprintf("Intra <= Inter (n=%d)", n_le)

map_df <- map_df %>%
  mutate(
    intra_gt_inter_lab = case_when(
      flag == "gt" ~ lab_gt,
      flag == "le" ~ lab_le,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(intra_gt_inter_lab))

fill_vals <- setNames(
  c("red3", "grey70"),
  c(lab_gt, lab_le)
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) sf points
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pts_map <- map_df %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

pts_sig_only <- pts_map %>%
  filter(flag == "gt", sig_vil)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_map_jeolla <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = kr_land, fill = "grey95", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_sf(data = kr_coast, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_sf(data = jeolla, fill = NA, color = "#999999", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(
    data = pts_map,
    aes(fill = intra_gt_inter_lab),
    shape = 21,
    size = 3.6,
    color = "white",
    stroke = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = pts_sig_only,
    shape = 21,
    size = 5.2,
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 1.0
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(126, 127.8),
    ylim = c(34.5, 35.5),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_vals, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "Villages where intra > inter (k = 3)",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Red: intra_pct > inter_k3_pct; grey: intra_pct <= inter_k3_pct; black ring: significant villages (Padj < 0.05, n=%d)",
      n_sig
    ),
    x = "Longitude (°E)",
    y = "Latitude (°N)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#eaf3ff", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

print(p_map_jeolla)

save_plot_both(
  p_map_jeolla,
  "map_Jeolla_intra_gt_inter_with_significance",
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Export table
# - supplementary: figure source data
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(
  map_df,
  "supplementary_map_Jeolla_intra_gt_inter_with_significance_table.csv"
)
```
