#fig1b panels
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Fig. 1b add-on:
# Cluster-wise zoom maps of village-level delta sharing
#
# Run this block AFTER the existing Fig. 1b code that creates:
#   vil_cmp
#
# Required objects:
#   vil_cmp
#   merged
#   base_theme
#   save_plot_both()
#
# Optional/expected objects:
#   vil_tbl or vil_coord
#   kr_land, kr_coast, jeolla
#   clu_pal
#
# Output:
#   fig1_cluster_zoom_maps/
#     plots/
#       fig1b_cluster_zoom_delta_sharing_common_scale.png/.svg
#       fig1b_cluster_zoom_delta_sharing_common_scale_sig_labels.png/.svg
#     tables/
#       fig1_cluster_zoom_delta_sharing_source_data.csv
#       fig1_cluster_zoom_common_scale_bbox.csv
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(sf)
  library(patchwork)
  library(rnaturalearth)
  library(rnaturalearthdata)
  library(readr)
  library(grid)
  library(scales)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Checks and output directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("vil_cmp"))
stopifnot(exists("merged"))
stopifnot(exists("base_theme"))
stopifnot(exists("save_plot_both"))

stopifnot(all(c("village_name", "intra_pct", "inter_k3_pct", "delta_pct") %in% names(vil_cmp)))

OUTDIR_FIG1_MAP <- "fig1_cluster_zoom_maps"
dir.create(OUTDIR_FIG1_MAP, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_FIG1_MAP, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_FIG1_MAP, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Background map layers
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("kr_land")) {
  kr_land <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(
    scale = "large",
    country = "South Korea",
    returnclass = "sf"
  )
}

if (!exists("kr_coast")) {
  kr_coast <- rnaturalearth::ne_coastline(
    scale = "large",
    returnclass = "sf"
  )
}

if (!exists("jeolla")) {
  st_kr <- rnaturalearth::ne_states(
    country = "South Korea",
    returnclass = "sf"
  )
  
  jeolla <- st_kr %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      grepl("Jeollabuk|North Jeolla|Jeonbuk|전라북", name, ignore.case = TRUE) |
        grepl("Jeollanam|South Jeolla|Jeonnam|전라남", name, ignore.case = TRUE)
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Coordinate table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (exists("vil_coord")) {
  coord_df <- vil_coord %>%
    transmute(
      village_name = as.character(village_name),
      lon = as.numeric(lon),
      lat = as.numeric(lat)
    ) %>%
    distinct()
  
} else if (exists("vil_tbl")) {
  coord_df <- vil_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      village_name = as.character(label),
      vil_id_from_coord = as.character(vil_id),
      lon = as.numeric(lon),
      lat = as.numeric(lat)
    ) %>%
    distinct()
  
} else {
  stop("Either vil_coord or vil_tbl is required.")
}

coord_df <- coord_df %>%
  mutate(
    village_name = as.character(village_name),
    lon = as.numeric(lon),
    lat = as.numeric(lat)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(village_name), !is.na(lon), !is.na(lat))

# Always ensure vil_id_from_coord exists
if (!"vil_id_from_coord" %in% names(coord_df)) {
  if (exists("vil_tbl")) {
    coord_df <- coord_df %>%
      left_join(
        vil_tbl %>%
          transmute(
            village_name = as.character(label),
            vil_id_from_coord = as.character(vil_id)
          ) %>%
          distinct(),
        by = "village_name"
      )
  } else {
    coord_df <- coord_df %>%
      mutate(vil_id_from_coord = NA_character_)
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Cluster annotation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cluster_map <- merged %>%
  transmute(
    village_name = as.character(village_name),
    cluster = as.character(cluster)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(village_name), !is.na(cluster)) %>%
  distinct()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Village ID map
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if ("village_id" %in% names(vil_cmp)) {
  vil_id_map <- vil_cmp %>%
    transmute(
      village_name = as.character(village_name),
      village_id_map = as.character(village_id)
    ) %>%
    distinct()
  
} else if ("vil_id" %in% names(vil_cmp)) {
  vil_id_map <- vil_cmp %>%
    transmute(
      village_name = as.character(village_name),
      village_id_map = as.character(vil_id)
    ) %>%
    distinct()
  
} else if ("vil_id_from_coord" %in% names(coord_df)) {
  vil_id_map <- coord_df %>%
    transmute(
      village_name = as.character(village_name),
      village_id_map = as.character(vil_id_from_coord)
    ) %>%
    distinct()
  
} else {
  vil_id_map <- tibble(
    village_name = unique(as.character(vil_cmp$village_name)),
    village_id_map = unique(as.character(vil_cmp$village_name))
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Build map source table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
map_zoom_df <- coord_df %>%
  select(village_name, lon, lat, vil_id_from_coord) %>%
  left_join(
    vil_cmp %>%
      transmute(
        village_name = as.character(village_name),
        village_id_from_cmp = if ("village_id" %in% names(vil_cmp)) {
          as.character(village_id)
        } else if ("vil_id" %in% names(vil_cmp)) {
          as.character(vil_id)
        } else {
          NA_character_
        },
        n_samples,
        intra_pct,
        inter_k3_pct,
        delta_pct,
        sig_vil = if ("sig_vil" %in% names(vil_cmp)) {
          as.logical(sig_vil)
        } else if ("p_adj" %in% names(vil_cmp)) {
          !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05
        } else {
          FALSE
        },
        p_adj = if ("p_adj" %in% names(vil_cmp)) p_adj else NA_real_
      ),
    by = "village_name"
  ) %>%
  left_join(cluster_map, by = "village_name") %>%
  left_join(vil_id_map, by = "village_name") %>%
  mutate(
    village_id = dplyr::coalesce(
      village_id_from_cmp,
      village_id_map,
      vil_id_from_coord,
      village_name
    ),
    cluster = factor(
      as.character(cluster),
      levels = if (exists("clu_pal")) names(clu_pal) else sort(unique(as.character(cluster)))
    ),
    intra_gt_inter = !is.na(delta_pct) & delta_pct > 0,
    sig_intra_gt_inter = intra_gt_inter & sig_vil,
    sig_label = ifelse(sig_intra_gt_inter, "Padj < 0.05", "Not significant")
  ) %>%
  select(
    village_name,
    village_id,
    cluster,
    lon,
    lat,
    n_samples,
    intra_pct,
    inter_k3_pct,
    delta_pct,
    intra_gt_inter,
    sig_vil,
    sig_intra_gt_inter,
    p_adj,
    sig_label
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster), !is.na(delta_pct), !is.na(lon), !is.na(lat))

if (nrow(map_zoom_df) == 0) {
  stop("No villages available for cluster zoom map after joining coordinates, cluster, and vil_cmp.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Shared color scale for delta sharing
# ---------------------------------------------------------
delta_limit <- max(abs(map_zoom_df$delta_pct), na.rm = TRUE)
delta_limit <- ceiling(delta_limit * 10) / 10

delta_breaks <- pretty(
  range(map_zoom_df$delta_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
  n = 5
)

delta_breaks <- delta_breaks[
  delta_breaks >= -delta_limit & delta_breaks <= delta_limit
]

delta_cols <- c(
  low = "#2166AC",
  mid = "grey96",
  high = "#B2182B"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Shared point-size scale
# ---------------------------------------------------------
n_sample_limits <- range(map_zoom_df$n_samples, na.rm = TRUE)

if (!is.finite(n_sample_limits[1]) || !is.finite(n_sample_limits[2])) {
  n_sample_limits <- c(1, 2)
}

if (n_sample_limits[1] == n_sample_limits[2]) {
  n_sample_limits <- n_sample_limits + c(-0.5, 0.5)
}

point_size_range <- c(2.8, 6.4)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Same geographic span for all cluster panels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cluster_bbox_tbl <- map_zoom_df %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    min_lon = min(lon, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_lon = max(lon, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_lat = min(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_lat = max(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    center_lon = mean(range(lon, na.rm = TRUE)),
    center_lat = mean(range(lat, na.rm = TRUE)),
    lon_span_raw = max_lon - min_lon,
    lat_span_raw = max_lat - min_lat,
    n_villages = n(),
    n_intra_gt_inter = sum(intra_gt_inter, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig = sum(sig_intra_gt_inter, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lon_span_common <- max(cluster_bbox_tbl$lon_span_raw, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.35
lat_span_common <- max(cluster_bbox_tbl$lat_span_raw, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.35

lon_span_common <- max(lon_span_common, 0.25)
lat_span_common <- max(lat_span_common, 0.25)

cluster_bbox_tbl <- cluster_bbox_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    xlim_min = center_lon - lon_span_common / 2,
    xlim_max = center_lon + lon_span_common / 2,
    ylim_min = center_lat - lat_span_common / 2,
    ylim_max = center_lat + lat_span_common / 2
  )

write_csv(
  map_zoom_df,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FIG1_MAP, "tables", "fig1_cluster_zoom_delta_sharing_source_data.csv")
)

write_csv(
  cluster_bbox_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FIG1_MAP, "tables", "fig1_cluster_zoom_common_scale_bbox.csv")
)

cat("\n===== Cluster zoom map summary =====\n")
print(
  cluster_bbox_tbl %>%
    select(cluster, n_villages, n_intra_gt_inter, n_sig, lon_span_raw, lat_span_raw)
)

cat("\nCommon longitude span:", lon_span_common, "\n")
cat("Common latitude span :", lat_span_common, "\n")
cat("Delta color limit    :", delta_limit, "\n")
cat("Delta breaks         :", paste(delta_breaks, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Point size limits    :", paste(n_sample_limits, collapse = " - "), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Plot function for one cluster
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_cluster_zoom_map <- function(clu_id, show_labels = FALSE, label_sig_only = TRUE) {
  
  clu_id <- as.character(clu_id)
  
  bbox <- cluster_bbox_tbl %>%
    filter(as.character(cluster) == clu_id) %>%
    slice(1)
  
  df_clu <- map_zoom_df %>%
    filter(as.character(cluster) == clu_id)
  
  pts_clu <- df_clu %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
  
  # Draw each village once only:
  # significant villages are drawn as their original point with thicker black border,
  # not as an additional outer ring.
  pts_non_sig <- pts_clu %>%
    filter(!sig_intra_gt_inter)
  
  pts_sig <- pts_clu %>%
    filter(sig_intra_gt_inter)
  
  if (show_labels) {
    if (label_sig_only) {
      label_df <- df_clu %>% filter(sig_intra_gt_inter)
    } else {
      label_df <- df_clu
    }
  } else {
    label_df <- df_clu %>% filter(FALSE)
  }
  
  label_sf <- label_df %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(
      data = kr_land,
      fill = "grey96",
      color = "grey82",
      linewidth = 0.22
    ) +
    geom_sf(
      data = kr_coast,
      color = "grey75",
      linewidth = 0.20
    ) +
    geom_sf(
      data = jeolla,
      fill = NA,
      color = "grey65",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    geom_sf(
      data = pts_non_sig,
      aes(fill = delta_pct, size = n_samples),
      shape = 21,
      color = "grey35",
      stroke = 0.35,
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    geom_sf(
      data = pts_sig,
      aes(fill = delta_pct, size = n_samples),
      shape = 21,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 1.15,
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    {
      if (show_labels && nrow(label_sf) > 0) {
        geom_sf_text(
          data = label_sf,
          aes(label = village_id),
          size = 3.0,
          fontface = "bold",
          nudge_y = 0.018,
          color = "black"
        )
      }
    } +
    coord_sf(
      xlim = c(bbox$xlim_min, bbox$xlim_max),
      ylim = c(bbox$ylim_min, bbox$ylim_max),
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = delta_cols["low"],
      mid = delta_cols["mid"],
      high = delta_cols["high"],
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-delta_limit, delta_limit),
      breaks = delta_breaks,
      oob = scales::squish,
      name = expression(Delta~"sharing (%)")
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      limits = n_sample_limits,
      range = point_size_range,
      name = "No. samples"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Cluster ", clu_id),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "n = ", bbox$n_villages,
        "; intra > inter = ", bbox$n_intra_gt_inter,
        "; significant = ", bbox$n_sig
      ),
      x = "Longitude (°E)",
      y = "Latitude (°N)"
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9.5, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9.5, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#EAF3FF", color = NA),
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.25),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Create and save INDIVIDUAL cluster zoom maps
#     - continuous delta-sharing version
#     - binary intra>inter version
# ---------------------------------------------------------

cluster_levels_present <- map_zoom_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster)) %>%
  pull(cluster) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  unique()

cluster_levels_present <- intersect(
  if (exists("clu_pal")) names(clu_pal) else sort(cluster_levels_present),
  cluster_levels_present
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10B) Common helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# binary colors
binary_fill_cols <- c(
  "Intra > inter" = "#C43C39",
  "Intra ≤ inter" = "#D9D9D9"
)

# size legend breaks
sample_size_breaks <- c(10, 20, 30, 40)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10C) Individual map function
#      mode = "delta" or "binary"
# ---------------------------------------------------------

make_cluster_zoom_map_individual <- function(clu_id,
                                             mode = c("delta", "binary"),
                                             show_labels = FALSE,
                                             label_sig_only = TRUE) {
  
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  clu_id <- as.character(clu_id)
  
  bbox <- cluster_bbox_tbl %>%
    filter(as.character(cluster) == clu_id) %>%
    slice(1)
  
  df_clu <- map_zoom_df %>%
    filter(as.character(cluster) == clu_id) %>%
    mutate(
      intra_binary = ifelse(intra_gt_inter, "Intra > inter", "Intra ≤ inter"),
      intra_binary = factor(intra_binary, levels = c("Intra > inter", "Intra ≤ inter"))
    )
  
  pts_clu <- df_clu %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
  
  pts_non_sig <- pts_clu %>%
    filter(!sig_intra_gt_inter)
  
  pts_sig <- pts_clu %>%
    filter(sig_intra_gt_inter)
  
  if (show_labels) {
    if (label_sig_only) {
      label_df <- df_clu %>% filter(sig_intra_gt_inter)
    } else {
      label_df <- df_clu
    }
  } else {
    label_df <- df_clu %>% filter(FALSE)
  }
  
  label_sf <- label_df %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(
      data = kr_land,
      fill = "grey96",
      color = "grey82",
      linewidth = 0.22
    ) +
    geom_sf(
      data = kr_coast,
      color = "grey75",
      linewidth = 0.20
    ) +
    geom_sf(
      data = jeolla,
      fill = NA,
      color = "grey65",
      linewidth = 0.25
    )
  
  if (mode == "delta") {
    
    p <- p +
      geom_sf(
        data = pts_non_sig,
        aes(fill = delta_pct, size = n_samples),
        shape = 21,
        color = "grey35",
        stroke = 0.35,
        alpha = 1
      ) +
      geom_sf(
        data = pts_sig,
        aes(fill = delta_pct, size = n_samples),
        shape = 21,
        color = "black",
        stroke = 1.15,
        alpha = 1
      ) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = delta_cols["low"],
        mid = delta_cols["mid"],
        high = delta_cols["high"],
        midpoint = 0,
        limits = c(-delta_limit, delta_limit),
        breaks = delta_breaks,
        oob = scales::squish,
        name = expression(Delta~"sharing (%)")
      ) +
      guides(
        fill = guide_colorbar(
          order = 1,
          title.position = "top",
          title.hjust = 0.5,
          barwidth = unit(4.8, "cm"),
          barheight = unit(0.35, "cm")
        )
      )
    
    title_txt <- paste0("Cluster ", clu_id)
    caption_txt <- "Black border indicates significant intra > inter villages (Padj < 0.05)."
    
  } else if (mode == "binary") {
    
    p <- p +
      geom_sf(
        data = pts_non_sig,
        aes(fill = intra_binary, size = n_samples),
        shape = 21,
        color = "grey35",
        stroke = 0.35,
        alpha = 1
      ) +
      geom_sf(
        data = pts_sig,
        aes(fill = intra_binary, size = n_samples),
        shape = 21,
        color = "black",
        stroke = 1.15,
        alpha = 1
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = binary_fill_cols,
        drop = FALSE,
        name = NULL
      ) +
      guides(
        fill = guide_legend(
          order = 1,
          title.position = "top",
          override.aes = list(size = 4)
        )
      )
    
    title_txt <- paste0("Cluster ", clu_id)
    caption_txt <- "Red = villages with higher mean within-village than nearest-neighbor inter-village sharing. Black border indicates Padj < 0.05."
  }
  
  p <- p +
    {
      if (show_labels && nrow(label_sf) > 0) {
        geom_sf_text(
          data = label_sf,
          aes(label = village_id),
          size = 3.0,
          fontface = "bold",
          nudge_y = 0.018,
          color = "black"
        )
      }
    } +
    coord_sf(
      xlim = c(bbox$xlim_min, bbox$xlim_max),
      ylim = c(bbox$ylim_min, bbox$ylim_max),
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      limits = n_sample_limits,
      range = point_size_range,
      breaks = sample_size_breaks,
      name = "N samples"
    ) +
    guides(
      size = guide_legend(
        order = 2,
        title.position = "top",
        override.aes = list(
          fill = "black",
          color = "black",
          shape = 21,
          stroke = 0.25,
          alpha = 1
        )
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_txt,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "n = ", bbox$n_villages,
        "; intra > inter = ", bbox$n_intra_gt_inter,
        "; significant = ", bbox$n_sig
      ),
      x = "Longitude (°E)",
      y = "Latitude (°N)",
      caption = caption_txt
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8.5, color = "black"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#EAF3FF", color = NA),
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.25),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.35, "cm"),
      legend.key.width = unit(0.75, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Save continuous delta-sharing plots
# ---------------------------------------------------------

cluster_plot_list_delta <- list()

for (cl in cluster_levels_present) {
  
  p_now <- make_cluster_zoom_map_individual(
    clu_id = cl,
    mode = "delta",
    show_labels = FALSE,
    label_sig_only = TRUE
  )
  
  cluster_plot_list_delta[[paste0("Cluster_", cl)]] <- p_now
  
  print(p_now)
  
  save_plot_both(
    p_now,
    file.path(
      OUTDIR_FIG1_MAP,
      "plots",
      paste0("cluster_", cl, "_zoom_delta_sharing")
    ),
    width = 7.2,
    height = 7.0
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Save binary intra>inter plots
# ---------------------------------------------------------

cluster_plot_list_binary <- list()

for (cl in cluster_levels_present) {
  
  p_now_bin <- make_cluster_zoom_map_individual(
    clu_id = cl,
    mode = "binary",
    show_labels = FALSE,
    label_sig_only = TRUE
  )
  
  cluster_plot_list_binary[[paste0("Cluster_", cl)]] <- p_now_bin
  
  print(p_now_bin)
  
  save_plot_both(
    p_now_bin,
    file.path(
      OUTDIR_FIG1_MAP,
      "plots",
      paste0("cluster_", cl, "_zoom_intra_binary")
    ),
    width = 7.2,
    height = 7.0
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 13) Optional labeled versions
# ---------------------------------------------------------

cluster_plot_list_delta_labeled <- list()
cluster_plot_list_binary_labeled <- list()

for (cl in cluster_levels_present) {
  
  p_now_delta_lab <- make_cluster_zoom_map_individual(
    clu_id = cl,
    mode = "delta",
    show_labels = TRUE,
    label_sig_only = TRUE
  )
  
  cluster_plot_list_delta_labeled[[paste0("Cluster_", cl)]] <- p_now_delta_lab
  
  save_plot_both(
    p_now_delta_lab,
    file.path(
      OUTDIR_FIG1_MAP,
      "plots",
      paste0("cluster_", cl, "_zoom_delta_sharing_sig_labels")
    ),
    width = 7.2,
    height = 7.0
  )
  
  p_now_binary_lab <- make_cluster_zoom_map_individual(
    clu_id = cl,
    mode = "binary",
    show_labels = TRUE,
    label_sig_only = TRUE
  )
  
  cluster_plot_list_binary_labeled[[paste0("Cluster_", cl)]] <- p_now_binary_lab
  
  save_plot_both(
    p_now_binary_lab,
    file.path(
      OUTDIR_FIG1_MAP,
      "plots",
      paste0("cluster_", cl, "_zoom_intra_binary_sig_labels")
    ),
    width = 7.2,
    height = 7.0
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14) Console summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n===== Individual cluster zoom maps saved =====\n")
cat("Output directory:", OUTDIR_FIG1_MAP, "\n")
cat("Clusters:", paste(cluster_levels_present, collapse = ", "), "\n")

cat("\n[Continuous delta-sharing version]\n")
for (cl in cluster_levels_present) {
  cat(
    " - ",
    file.path(
      OUTDIR_FIG1_MAP,
      "plots",
      paste0("cluster_", cl, "_zoom_delta_sharing.png/.svg")
    ),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}

cat("\n[Binary intra>inter version]\n")
for (cl in cluster_levels_present) {
  cat(
    " - ",
    file.path(
      OUTDIR_FIG1_MAP,
      "plots",
      paste0("cluster_", cl, "_zoom_intra_binary.png/.svg")
    ),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}

cat("\n[Optional labeled delta-sharing version]\n")
for (cl in cluster_levels_present) {
  cat(
    " - ",
    file.path(
      OUTDIR_FIG1_MAP,
      "plots",
      paste0("cluster_", cl, "_zoom_delta_sharing_sig_labels.png/.svg")
    ),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}

cat("\n[Optional labeled binary version]\n")
for (cl in cluster_levels_present) {
  cat(
    " - ",
    file.path(
      OUTDIR_FIG1_MAP,
      "plots",
      paste0("cluster_", cl, "_zoom_intra_binary_sig_labels.png/.svg")
    ),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(rstatix)
  library(patchwork)
})

# =========================================================
# Social questionnaire vs intra > inter status
# - prettier violin figure version
# - p-value line moved upward
# - straight horizontal line without lower ticks
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("vil_cmp"), exists("social_village"))
stopifnot(exists("base_theme"), exists("save_plot_both"))
stopifnot("vil_id" %in% names(social_village))
stopifnot(all(c("intra_pct", "inter_k3_pct", "delta_pct") %in% names(vil_cmp)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    "NA",
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2),
      formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)
    )
  )
}

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Build analysis table using vil_id only
# ---------------------------------------------------------
id_col <- dplyr::case_when(
  "vil_id" %in% names(vil_cmp) ~ "vil_id",
  "village_id" %in% names(vil_cmp) ~ "village_id",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

if (is.na(id_col)) {
  stop("vil_cmp must contain either 'vil_id' or 'village_id'.")
}

vil_cmp_base <- vil_cmp %>%
  mutate(
    vil_id = as.character(.data[[id_col]]),
    intra_gt_inter = !is.na(delta_pct) & delta_pct > 0
  )

if ("sig_vil" %in% names(vil_cmp_base)) {
  vil_cmp_base <- vil_cmp_base %>%
    mutate(sig_intra_gt_inter = as.logical(sig_vil))
} else if ("p_adj" %in% names(vil_cmp_base)) {
  vil_cmp_base <- vil_cmp_base %>%
    mutate(sig_intra_gt_inter = !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05)
} else {
  vil_cmp_base <- vil_cmp_base %>%
    mutate(sig_intra_gt_inter = NA)
}

vil_cmp_base <- vil_cmp_base %>%
  dplyr::select(
    vil_id,
    dplyr::any_of(c(
      "n_samples",
      "intra_pct",
      "inter_k3_pct",
      "delta_pct",
      "p_value",
      "p_adj"
    )),
    intra_gt_inter,
    sig_intra_gt_inter
  )

social_required <- c(
  "vil_id",
  "cluster",
  "hall_attend_n",
  "hall_gather_freq",
  "hall_stability",
  "shared_meal_freq",
  "shared_meal_time",
  "food_share_freq",
  "intervillage_freq",
  "intervillage_n",
  "within_social_score",
  "food_sharing_score",
  "intervillage_score"
)

missing_social <- setdiff(social_required, names(social_village))
if (length(missing_social) > 0) {
  stop("Missing columns in social_village: ", paste(missing_social, collapse = ", "))
}

# shared_meal_time label standardization
meal_time_levels <- c("breakfast", "lunch", "dinner", "snack", "irregular")

social_intra_status <- vil_cmp_base %>%
  left_join(
    social_village %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(social_required)) %>%
      mutate(vil_id = as.character(vil_id)),
    by = "vil_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    intra_status = ifelse(intra_gt_inter, "Intra > inter", "Intra <= inter"),
    intra_status = factor(intra_status, levels = c("Intra <= inter", "Intra > inter")),
    sig_status = ifelse(sig_intra_gt_inter, "Significant intra > inter", "Not significant"),
    sig_status = factor(sig_status, levels = c("Not significant", "Significant intra > inter")),
    shared_meal_time = case_when(
      as.character(shared_meal_time) %in% c("아침", "breakfast") ~ "breakfast",
      as.character(shared_meal_time) %in% c("점심", "lunch") ~ "lunch",
      as.character(shared_meal_time) %in% c("저녁", "dinner") ~ "dinner",
      as.character(shared_meal_time) %in% c("간식", "snack") ~ "snack",
      as.character(shared_meal_time) %in% c("일정하지 않음", "irregular") ~ "irregular",
      as.character(shared_meal_time) %in% c("해당 없음", "NA", "") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(shared_meal_time)
    ),
    shared_meal_time = factor(shared_meal_time, levels = meal_time_levels)
  )

cat("\nSocial questionnaire coverage for intra > inter analysis\n")
print(
  social_intra_status %>%
    summarise(
      n_total_villages = n(),
      n_with_social = sum(!is.na(within_social_score)),
      n_without_social = sum(is.na(within_social_score)),
      n_intra_gt_inter = sum(intra_gt_inter, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_intra_le_inter = sum(!intra_gt_inter, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_intra_gt_inter_with_social = sum(intra_gt_inter & !is.na(within_social_score), na.rm = TRUE),
      n_intra_le_inter_with_social = sum(!intra_gt_inter & !is.na(within_social_score), na.rm = TRUE),
      n_sig_intra_gt_inter = sum(sig_intra_gt_inter, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_sig_intra_gt_inter_with_social = sum(sig_intra_gt_inter & !is.na(within_social_score), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
)

write_csv(
  social_intra_status,
  "derived_social_questionnaire_intra_gt_inter_status.csv"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Define questionnaire variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
composite_vars <- c(
  "within_social_score",
  "food_sharing_score",
  "intervillage_score"
)

item_vars <- c(
  "hall_attend_n",
  "hall_gather_freq",
  "hall_stability",
  "shared_meal_freq",
  "food_share_freq",
  "intervillage_freq",
  "intervillage_n"
)

numeric_score_vars <- intersect(
  c(composite_vars, item_vars),
  names(social_intra_status)
)

var_label_map <- c(
  within_social_score = "Within-village social interaction score",
  food_sharing_score = "Shared meal/food-sharing composite score",
  intervillage_score = "Inter-village interaction score",
  hall_attend_n = "Hall attendance size score",
  hall_gather_freq = "Hall gathering frequency score",
  hall_stability = "Hall attendee stability score",
  shared_meal_freq = "Shared meal frequency score",
  food_share_freq = "Food-sharing frequency score",
  intervillage_freq = "Inter-village visit/meal frequency score",
  intervillage_n = "Inter-village participant number score"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Wilcoxon tests for numeric questionnaire variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
wilcox_one <- function(df, xvar, group_var = "intra_gt_inter") {
  dat <- df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[group_var]]),
      is.finite(.data[[xvar]])
    ) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(.data[[group_var]], levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)))

  if (nrow(dat) < 3 || n_distinct(dat$group) < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      n = nrow(dat),
      n_le = sum(dat$group == FALSE),
      n_gt = sum(dat$group == TRUE),
      median_le = NA_real_,
      median_gt = NA_real_,
      mean_le = NA_real_,
      mean_gt = NA_real_,
      p_two_sided = NA_real_,
      p_one_sided_higher_gt = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  wt_two <- suppressWarnings(
    wilcox.test(dat[[xvar]] ~ dat$group, alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE)
  )

  wt_one <- suppressWarnings(
    wilcox.test(dat[[xvar]] ~ dat$group, alternative = "less", exact = FALSE)
  )

  tibble(
    n = nrow(dat),
    n_le = sum(dat$group == FALSE),
    n_gt = sum(dat$group == TRUE),
    median_le = median(dat[[xvar]][dat$group == FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_gt = median(dat[[xvar]][dat$group == TRUE], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_le = mean(dat[[xvar]][dat$group == FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_gt = mean(dat[[xvar]][dat$group == TRUE], na.rm = TRUE),
    p_two_sided = wt_two$p.value,
    p_one_sided_higher_gt = wt_one$p.value
  )
}

social_numeric_tests <- tibble(score_var = numeric_score_vars) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(res = list(wilcox_one(social_intra_status, score_var))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unnest(res) %>%
  mutate(
    variable_type = case_when(
      score_var %in% composite_vars ~ "Composite score",
      score_var %in% item_vars ~ "Original questionnaire item",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    score_label = recode(score_var, !!!var_label_map),
    effect_direction = case_when(
      mean_gt > mean_le ~ "higher in intra > inter",
      mean_gt < mean_le ~ "lower in intra > inter",
      TRUE ~ "no difference"
    ),
    p_adj_two_sided = p.adjust(p_two_sided, method = "BH"),
    p_adj_one_sided_higher_gt = p.adjust(p_one_sided_higher_gt, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(variable_type, p_adj_one_sided_higher_gt)

print(social_numeric_tests)

write_csv(
  social_numeric_tests,
  "supplementary_social_numeric_scores_by_intra_gt_inter_status_wilcoxon.csv"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Logistic regression
# ---------------------------------------------------------
logistic_one <- function(df, xvar, adjusted = TRUE) {
  keep_cols <- c("intra_gt_inter", xvar)

  if (adjusted) {
    keep_cols <- c(keep_cols, intersect(c("n_samples", "cluster"), names(df)))
  }

  dat <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(keep_cols)) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(intra_gt_inter),
      is.finite(.data[[xvar]])
    ) %>%
    mutate(intra_gt_inter = as.integer(intra_gt_inter))

  if ("n_samples" %in% names(dat)) {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(is.finite(n_samples))
  }

  if ("cluster" %in% names(dat)) {
    dat <- dat %>% mutate(cluster = factor(cluster))
  }

  if (nrow(dat) < 10 || length(unique(dat$intra_gt_inter)) < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      n = nrow(dat),
      odds_ratio = NA_real_,
      conf_low = NA_real_,
      conf_high = NA_real_,
      beta = NA_real_,
      se = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  covars <- xvar

  if (adjusted && "n_samples" %in% names(dat)) {
    covars <- c(covars, "n_samples")
  }

  if (
    adjusted &&
    "cluster" %in% names(dat) &&
    n_distinct(dat$cluster[!is.na(dat$cluster)]) > 1
  ) {
    covars <- c(covars, "cluster")
  }

  form <- reformulate(covars, response = "intra_gt_inter")

  fit <- tryCatch(
    glm(form, data = dat, family = binomial()),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(tibble(
      n = nrow(dat),
      odds_ratio = NA_real_,
      conf_low = NA_real_,
      conf_high = NA_real_,
      beta = NA_real_,
      se = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  co <- summary(fit)$coefficients

  if (!xvar %in% rownames(co)) {
    return(tibble(
      n = stats::nobs(fit),
      odds_ratio = NA_real_,
      conf_low = NA_real_,
      conf_high = NA_real_,
      beta = NA_real_,
      se = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  beta <- unname(co[xvar, "Estimate"])
  se <- unname(co[xvar, "Std. Error"])

  tibble(
    n = stats::nobs(fit),
    odds_ratio = exp(beta),
    conf_low = exp(beta - 1.96 * se),
    conf_high = exp(beta + 1.96 * se),
    beta = beta,
    se = se,
    p_value = unname(co[xvar, "Pr(>|z|)"])
  )
}

social_logistic_results <- expand.grid(
  score_var = numeric_score_vars,
  model = c("unadjusted", "adjusted"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    res = list(
      logistic_one(
        social_intra_status,
        score_var,
        adjusted = model == "adjusted"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unnest(res) %>%
  mutate(
    variable_type = case_when(
      score_var %in% composite_vars ~ "Composite score",
      score_var %in% item_vars ~ "Original questionnaire item",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    score_label = recode(score_var, !!!var_label_map)
  ) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(model, variable_type, p_adj)

print(social_logistic_results)

write_csv(
  social_logistic_results,
  "supplementary_social_numeric_scores_intra_gt_inter_logistic.csv"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Pretty plot helper
#    - p-value line moved upward
#    - straight line without lower ticks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_status_boxplot_pretty <- function(df, score_var, filename, ylab, title) {

  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(intra_status),
      is.finite(.data[[score_var]])
    )

  stat_row <- social_numeric_tests %>%
    filter(score_var == !!score_var) %>%
    slice(1)

  n_tbl <- plot_df %>%
    count(intra_status)

  x_lab_map <- setNames(
    paste0(n_tbl$intra_status, "\n(n = ", n_tbl$n, ")"),
    n_tbl$intra_status
  )

  stat_lab <- if (nrow(stat_row) == 1) {
    paste0(
      "One-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test: raw P = ",
      fmt_p(stat_row$p_one_sided_higher_gt),
      ", BH-FDR = ",
      fmt_p(stat_row$p_adj_one_sided_higher_gt)
    )
  } else {
    "One-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test: raw P = NA, BH-FDR = NA"
  }

  group_cols <- c(
    "Intra <= inter" = "#C9CDD1",
    "Intra > inter"  = "#4E79A7"
  )

  y_min <- min(plot_df[[score_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(plot_df[[score_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_rng <- y_max - y_min
  if (!is.finite(y_rng) || y_rng == 0) y_rng <- 1

  # line/text 위치를 더 위로 조정
  line_y   <- y_max + 0.16 * y_rng
  text_y_1 <- y_max + 0.24 * y_rng
  text_y_2 <- y_max + 0.32 * y_rng
  y_upper  <- y_max + 0.42 * y_rng
  y_lower  <- y_min - 0.04 * y_rng

  raw_label <- if (nrow(stat_row) == 1) {
    paste0("raw P = ", fmt_p(stat_row$p_one_sided_higher_gt))
  } else {
    "raw P = NA"
  }

  fdr_label <- if (nrow(stat_row) == 1) {
    paste0("FDR = ", fmt_p(stat_row$p_adj_one_sided_higher_gt))
  } else {
    "FDR = NA"
  }

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = intra_status, y = .data[[score_var]], fill = intra_status)
  ) +
    geom_violin(
      width = 0.86,
      trim = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.22,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.22,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha = 0.85,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.08,
      height = 0,
      size = 2.6,
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 0.35,
      color = "black",
      fill = "white",
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun = median,
      geom = "point",
      shape = 23,
      size = 3.0,
      fill = "black",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    # 일자선만 표시
    annotate(
      "segment",
      x = 1, xend = 2,
      y = line_y, yend = line_y,
      linewidth = 0.45,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    # p-value 텍스트 두 줄
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1.5, y = text_y_1,
      label = raw_label,
      size = 3.4
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1.5, y = text_y_2,
      label = fdr_label,
      size = 3.4
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_lab_map) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(y_lower, y_upper),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = stat_lab,
      x = NULL,
      y = ylab
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey25"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(16, 24, 12, 12)
    )

  print(p)
  save_plot_both(p, filename, width = 6.5, height = 5.8)

  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(rstatix)
  library(patchwork)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(ggbeeswarm)
})

# =========================================================
# Social questionnaire vs intra > inter status
# - beeswarm figure version with p-value brackets
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("vil_cmp"), exists("social_village"))
stopifnot(exists("base_theme"), exists("save_plot_both"))
stopifnot("vil_id" %in% names(social_village))
stopifnot(all(c("intra_pct", "inter_k3_pct", "delta_pct") %in% names(vil_cmp)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    "NA",
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2),
      formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)
    )
  )
}

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Build analysis table using vil_id only
# ---------------------------------------------------------
id_col <- dplyr::case_when(
  "vil_id" %in% names(vil_cmp) ~ "vil_id",
  "village_id" %in% names(vil_cmp) ~ "village_id",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

if (is.na(id_col)) {
  stop("vil_cmp must contain either 'vil_id' or 'village_id'.")
}

vil_cmp_base <- vil_cmp %>%
  mutate(
    vil_id = as.character(.data[[id_col]]),
    intra_gt_inter = !is.na(delta_pct) & delta_pct > 0
  )

if ("sig_vil" %in% names(vil_cmp_base)) {
  vil_cmp_base <- vil_cmp_base %>%
    mutate(sig_intra_gt_inter = as.logical(sig_vil))
} else if ("p_adj" %in% names(vil_cmp_base)) {
  vil_cmp_base <- vil_cmp_base %>%
    mutate(sig_intra_gt_inter = !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05)
} else {
  vil_cmp_base <- vil_cmp_base %>%
    mutate(sig_intra_gt_inter = NA)
}

vil_cmp_base <- vil_cmp_base %>%
  select(
    vil_id,
    any_of(c(
      "n_samples",
      "intra_pct",
      "inter_k3_pct",
      "delta_pct",
      "p_value",
      "p_adj"
    )),
    intra_gt_inter,
    sig_intra_gt_inter
  )

social_required <- c(
  "vil_id",
  "cluster",
  "hall_attend_n",
  "hall_gather_freq",
  "hall_stability",
  "shared_meal_freq",
  "shared_meal_time",
  "food_share_freq",
  "intervillage_freq",
  "intervillage_n",
  "within_social_score",
  "food_sharing_score",
  "intervillage_score"
)

missing_social <- setdiff(social_required, names(social_village))
if (length(missing_social) > 0) {
  stop("Missing columns in social_village: ", paste(missing_social, collapse = ", "))
}

# Standardize shared_meal_time labels
meal_time_levels <- c("breakfast", "lunch", "dinner", "snack", "irregular")

social_intra_status <- vil_cmp_base %>%
  left_join(
    social_village %>%
      select(all_of(social_required)) %>%
      mutate(vil_id = as.character(vil_id)),
    by = "vil_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    intra_status = ifelse(intra_gt_inter, "Intra > inter", "Intra <= inter"),
    intra_status = factor(intra_status, levels = c("Intra <= inter", "Intra > inter")),
    sig_status = ifelse(sig_intra_gt_inter, "Significant intra > inter", "Not significant"),
    sig_status = factor(sig_status, levels = c("Not significant", "Significant intra > inter")),
    shared_meal_time = case_when(
      as.character(shared_meal_time) %in% c("아침", "breakfast") ~ "breakfast",
      as.character(shared_meal_time) %in% c("점심", "lunch") ~ "lunch",
      as.character(shared_meal_time) %in% c("저녁", "dinner") ~ "dinner",
      as.character(shared_meal_time) %in% c("간식", "snack") ~ "snack",
      as.character(shared_meal_time) %in% c("일정하지 않음", "irregular") ~ "irregular",
      as.character(shared_meal_time) %in% c("해당 없음", "NA", "") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(shared_meal_time)
    ),
    shared_meal_time = factor(shared_meal_time, levels = meal_time_levels)
  )

cat("\nSocial questionnaire coverage for intra > inter analysis\n")
print(
  social_intra_status %>%
    summarise(
      n_total_villages = n(),
      n_with_social = sum(!is.na(within_social_score)),
      n_without_social = sum(is.na(within_social_score)),
      n_intra_gt_inter = sum(intra_gt_inter, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_intra_le_inter = sum(!intra_gt_inter, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_intra_gt_inter_with_social = sum(intra_gt_inter & !is.na(within_social_score), na.rm = TRUE),
      n_intra_le_inter_with_social = sum(!intra_gt_inter & !is.na(within_social_score), na.rm = TRUE),
      n_sig_intra_gt_inter = sum(sig_intra_gt_inter, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_sig_intra_gt_inter_with_social = sum(sig_intra_gt_inter & !is.na(within_social_score), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
)

write_csv(
  social_intra_status,
  "derived_social_questionnaire_intra_gt_inter_status.csv"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Define questionnaire variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
composite_vars <- c(
  "within_social_score",
  "food_sharing_score",
  "intervillage_score"
)

item_vars <- c(
  "hall_attend_n",
  "hall_gather_freq",
  "hall_stability",
  "shared_meal_freq",
  "food_share_freq",
  "intervillage_freq",
  "intervillage_n"
)

numeric_score_vars <- intersect(
  c(composite_vars, item_vars),
  names(social_intra_status)
)

var_label_map <- c(
  within_social_score = "Within-village social interaction score",
  food_sharing_score = "Shared meal/food-sharing composite score",
  intervillage_score = "Inter-village interaction score",
  hall_attend_n = "Hall attendance size score",
  hall_gather_freq = "Hall gathering frequency score",
  hall_stability = "Hall attendee stability score",
  shared_meal_freq = "Shared meal frequency score",
  food_share_freq = "Food-sharing frequency score",
  intervillage_freq = "Inter-village visit/meal frequency score",
  intervillage_n = "Inter-village participant number score"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Wilcoxon tests for numeric questionnaire variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
wilcox_one <- function(df, xvar, group_var = "intra_gt_inter") {
  dat <- df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[group_var]]),
      is.finite(.data[[xvar]])
    ) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(.data[[group_var]], levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)))

  if (nrow(dat) < 3 || n_distinct(dat$group) < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      n = nrow(dat),
      n_le = sum(dat$group == FALSE),
      n_gt = sum(dat$group == TRUE),
      median_le = NA_real_,
      median_gt = NA_real_,
      mean_le = NA_real_,
      mean_gt = NA_real_,
      p_two_sided = NA_real_,
      p_one_sided_higher_gt = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  wt_two <- suppressWarnings(
    wilcox.test(dat[[xvar]] ~ dat$group, alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE)
  )

  # alternative = "less":
  # group FALSE is expected to have lower score than group TRUE.
  # In other words, scores are tested as higher in intra > inter villages.
  wt_one <- suppressWarnings(
    wilcox.test(dat[[xvar]] ~ dat$group, alternative = "less", exact = FALSE)
  )

  tibble(
    n = nrow(dat),
    n_le = sum(dat$group == FALSE),
    n_gt = sum(dat$group == TRUE),
    median_le = median(dat[[xvar]][dat$group == FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_gt = median(dat[[xvar]][dat$group == TRUE], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_le = mean(dat[[xvar]][dat$group == FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_gt = mean(dat[[xvar]][dat$group == TRUE], na.rm = TRUE),
    p_two_sided = wt_two$p.value,
    p_one_sided_higher_gt = wt_one$p.value
  )
}

social_numeric_tests <- tibble(score_var = numeric_score_vars) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(res = list(wilcox_one(social_intra_status, score_var))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unnest(res) %>%
  mutate(
    variable_type = case_when(
      score_var %in% composite_vars ~ "Composite score",
      score_var %in% item_vars ~ "Original questionnaire item",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    score_label = recode(score_var, !!!var_label_map),
    effect_direction = case_when(
      mean_gt > mean_le ~ "higher in intra > inter",
      mean_gt < mean_le ~ "lower in intra > inter",
      TRUE ~ "no difference"
    ),
    p_adj_two_sided = p.adjust(p_two_sided, method = "BH"),
    p_adj_one_sided_higher_gt = p.adjust(p_one_sided_higher_gt, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(variable_type, p_adj_one_sided_higher_gt)

print(social_numeric_tests)

write_csv(
  social_numeric_tests,
  "supplementary_social_numeric_scores_by_intra_gt_inter_status_wilcoxon.csv"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Logistic regression
# ---------------------------------------------------------
logistic_one <- function(df, xvar, adjusted = TRUE) {
  keep_cols <- c("intra_gt_inter", xvar)

  if (adjusted) {
    keep_cols <- c(keep_cols, intersect(c("n_samples", "cluster"), names(df)))
  }

  dat <- df %>%
    select(all_of(keep_cols)) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(intra_gt_inter),
      is.finite(.data[[xvar]])
    ) %>%
    mutate(intra_gt_inter = as.integer(intra_gt_inter))

  if ("n_samples" %in% names(dat)) {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(is.finite(n_samples))
  }

  if ("cluster" %in% names(dat)) {
    dat <- dat %>% mutate(cluster = factor(cluster))
  }

  if (nrow(dat) < 10 || length(unique(dat$intra_gt_inter)) < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      n = nrow(dat),
      odds_ratio = NA_real_,
      conf_low = NA_real_,
      conf_high = NA_real_,
      beta = NA_real_,
      se = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  covars <- xvar

  if (adjusted && "n_samples" %in% names(dat)) {
    covars <- c(covars, "n_samples")
  }

  if (
    adjusted &&
    "cluster" %in% names(dat) &&
    n_distinct(dat$cluster[!is.na(dat$cluster)]) > 1
  ) {
    covars <- c(covars, "cluster")
  }

  form <- reformulate(covars, response = "intra_gt_inter")

  fit <- tryCatch(
    glm(form, data = dat, family = binomial()),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(tibble(
      n = nrow(dat),
      odds_ratio = NA_real_,
      conf_low = NA_real_,
      conf_high = NA_real_,
      beta = NA_real_,
      se = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  co <- summary(fit)$coefficients

  if (!xvar %in% rownames(co)) {
    return(tibble(
      n = stats::nobs(fit),
      odds_ratio = NA_real_,
      conf_low = NA_real_,
      conf_high = NA_real_,
      beta = NA_real_,
      se = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  beta <- unname(co[xvar, "Estimate"])
  se <- unname(co[xvar, "Std. Error"])

  tibble(
    n = stats::nobs(fit),
    odds_ratio = exp(beta),
    conf_low = exp(beta - 1.96 * se),
    conf_high = exp(beta + 1.96 * se),
    beta = beta,
    se = se,
    p_value = unname(co[xvar, "Pr(>|z|)"])
  )
}

social_logistic_results <- expand.grid(
  score_var = numeric_score_vars,
  model = c("unadjusted", "adjusted"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    res = list(
      logistic_one(
        social_intra_status,
        score_var,
        adjusted = model == "adjusted"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unnest(res) %>%
  mutate(
    variable_type = case_when(
      score_var %in% composite_vars ~ "Composite score",
      score_var %in% item_vars ~ "Original questionnaire item",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    score_label = recode(score_var, !!!var_label_map)
  ) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(model, variable_type, p_adj)

print(social_logistic_results)

write_csv(
  social_logistic_results,
  "supplementary_social_numeric_scores_intra_gt_inter_logistic.csv"
)

meal_time_tbl <- social_intra_status %>%

# Remove all-zero columns before Fisher test

} else {

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Beeswarm plot helper with median/IQR and p-value bracket
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_status_beeswarm_pretty <- function(df, score_var, filename, ylab, title) {

  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(intra_status),
      is.finite(.data[[score_var]])
    )

  stat_row <- social_numeric_tests %>%
    filter(score_var == !!score_var) %>%
    slice(1)

  n_tbl <- plot_df %>%
    count(intra_status)

  x_lab_map <- setNames(
    paste0(n_tbl$intra_status, "\n(n = ", n_tbl$n, ")"),
    n_tbl$intra_status
  )

  stat_lab <- if (nrow(stat_row) == 1) {
    paste0(
      "One-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test: raw P = ",
      fmt_p(stat_row$p_one_sided_higher_gt),
      ", BH-FDR = ",
      fmt_p(stat_row$p_adj_one_sided_higher_gt)
    )
  } else {
    "One-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test: raw P = NA, BH-FDR = NA"
  }

  bracket_label <- if (nrow(stat_row) == 1) {
    paste0(
      "raw P = ", fmt_p(stat_row$p_one_sided_higher_gt),
      "\nFDR = ", fmt_p(stat_row$p_adj_one_sided_higher_gt)
    )
  } else {
    "raw P = NA\nFDR = NA"
  }

  group_cols <- c(
    "Intra <= inter" = "#9DA3A6",
    "Intra > inter"  = "#4E79A7"
  )

  y_min <- min(plot_df[[score_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(plot_df[[score_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_rng <- y_max - y_min
  if (!is.finite(y_rng) || y_rng == 0) y_rng <- 1

  bracket_y <- y_max + 0.12 * y_rng
  y_upper   <- y_max + 0.32 * y_rng
  y_lower   <- y_min - 0.05 * y_rng

  bracket_df <- tibble(
    group1 = "Intra <= inter",
    group2 = "Intra > inter",
    y.position = bracket_y,
    label = bracket_label
  )

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = intra_status, y = .data[[score_var]], color = intra_status)
  ) +
    ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(
      width = 0.23,
      size = 2.8,
      alpha = 0.88,
      method = "quasirandom",
      varwidth = FALSE
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun.data = function(x) {
        tibble(
          y = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
          ymin = quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
          ymax = quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
        )
      },
      geom = "errorbar",
      width = 0.18,
      linewidth = 0.55,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun = median,
      geom = "crossbar",
      width = 0.42,
      fatten = 0,
      linewidth = 0.65,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
      bracket_df,
      label = "label",
      xmin = "group1",
      xmax = "group2",
      y.position = "y.position",
      tip.length = 0.015,
      bracket.size = 0.45,
      size = 3.4,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_lab_map) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(y_lower, y_upper),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = stat_lab,
      x = NULL,
      y = ylab
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey25"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(12, 24, 12, 12)
    )

  print(p)
  save_plot_both(p, filename, width = 6.5, height = 5.8)

  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Social questionnaire response category vs village-level sharing rate
# - x-axis: response category
# - y-axis: intra-village ASV sharing rate (intra_pct)
# - point color: intra_status
# - one point = one village
# - beeswarm style
#
# Required input:
#   social_intra_status
#   base_theme
#   save_plot_both()
#
# Main outputs:
#   social_item_intra_y_long
#   social_item_intra_trend_stats
#   social_meal_time_intra_stats
#   p_social_item_intra_beeswarm_combined
#   p_shared_meal_time_intra_beeswarm
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(patchwork)
  library(ggbeeswarm)
})

stopifnot(exists("social_intra_status"))
stopifnot(exists("base_theme"), exists("save_plot_both"))
stopifnot(all(c("vil_id", "intra_status", "intra_pct") %in% names(social_intra_status)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    "NA",
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2),
      formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)
    )
  )
}

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))
}

median_iqr_fun <- function(x) {
  tibble(
    y = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    ymin = quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    ymax = quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Define questionnaire items
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ordinal_item_vars <- c(
  "hall_attend_n",
  "hall_gather_freq",
  "hall_stability",
  "shared_meal_freq",
  "food_share_freq",
  "intervillage_freq",
  "intervillage_n"
)

ordinal_item_vars <- intersect(ordinal_item_vars, names(social_intra_status))

item_label_map <- c(
  hall_attend_n = "Hall attendance size",
  hall_gather_freq = "Hall gathering frequency",
  hall_stability = "Hall attendee stability",
  shared_meal_freq = "Shared meal frequency",
  food_share_freq = "Food-sharing frequency",
  intervillage_freq = "Inter-village visit/meal frequency",
  intervillage_n = "Inter-village participant number"
)

# If you want custom wording for each response category,
# replace these labels.
default_response_map <- c(
  "0" = "0",
  "1" = "1",
  "2" = "2",
  "3" = "3"
)

response_label_map_list <- list(
  hall_attend_n     = default_response_map,
  hall_gather_freq  = default_response_map,
  hall_stability    = default_response_map,
  shared_meal_freq  = default_response_map,
  food_share_freq   = default_response_map,
  intervillage_freq = default_response_map,
  intervillage_n    = default_response_map
)

group_cols <- c(
  "Intra <= inter" = "#A7ADB3",
  "Intra > inter"  = "#4E79A7"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Build long table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
social_item_intra_y_long <- social_intra_status %>%
  dplyr::select(
    vil_id,
    intra_status,
    intra_pct,
    dplyr::all_of(ordinal_item_vars)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(ordinal_item_vars),
    names_to = "item_var",
    values_to = "response"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(intra_status),
    !is.na(intra_pct),
    !is.na(response)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    intra_status = factor(
      intra_status,
      levels = c("Intra <= inter", "Intra > inter")
    ),
    item_label = recode(item_var, !!!item_label_map),
    response_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(response)),
    response_chr = as.character(response)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(response_num), is.finite(intra_pct))

write_csv(
  social_item_intra_y_long,
  "derived_social_item_response_vs_intra_rate_long.csv"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Trend statistics for ordinal items
#    Response category (ordered numeric) vs intra_pct
# ---------------------------------------------------------
spearman_one <- function(df_one) {
  if (nrow(df_one) < 3 ||
      n_distinct(df_one$response_num) < 2 ||
      n_distinct(df_one$intra_pct) < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      n = nrow(df_one),
      rho = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  ct <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(df_one$response_num, df_one$intra_pct,
             method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  )

  tibble(
    n = nrow(df_one),
    rho = unname(ct$estimate),
    p_value = ct$p.value
  )
}

social_item_intra_trend_stats <- social_item_intra_y_long %>%
  group_by(item_var, item_label) %>%
  group_modify(~ spearman_one(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

print(social_item_intra_trend_stats)

write_csv(
  social_item_intra_trend_stats,
  "supplementary_social_item_response_vs_intra_rate_spearman.csv"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Plot helper for ordinal items
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_intra_rate_beeswarm_plot <- function(item_name, filename, title = NULL) {

  plot_df_raw <- social_item_intra_y_long %>%
    filter(item_var == item_name)

  if (nrow(plot_df_raw) == 0) {
    message("Skipping ", item_name, ": no data.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  levs_num <- sort(unique(plot_df_raw$response_num))
  levs_chr <- as.character(levs_num)

  if (length(levs_chr) < 2) {
    message("Skipping ", item_name, ": fewer than 2 response categories.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  response_label_map <- response_label_map_list[[item_name]]
  if (is.null(response_label_map)) {
    response_label_map <- setNames(levs_chr, levs_chr)
  } else {
    miss <- setdiff(levs_chr, names(response_label_map))
    if (length(miss) > 0) response_label_map[miss] <- miss
    response_label_map <- response_label_map[levs_chr]
  }

  plot_df <- plot_df_raw %>%
    mutate(
      response_f = factor(as.character(response_num), levels = levs_chr)
    )

  stat_row <- social_item_intra_trend_stats %>%
    filter(item_var == item_name) %>%
    slice(1)

  subtitle_txt <- if (nrow(stat_row) == 1) {
    paste0(
      "Spearman trend: rho = ", fmt_num(stat_row$rho, 2),
      ", raw P = ", fmt_p(stat_row$p_value),
      ", BH-FDR = ", fmt_p(stat_row$p_adj),
      ", n = ", stat_row$n
    )
  } else {
    "Spearman trend: rho = NA, raw P = NA, BH-FDR = NA"
  }

  if (is.null(title)) {
    title <- item_label_map[[item_name]]
  }

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = response_f,
      y = intra_pct,
      color = intra_status,
      group = interaction(response_f, intra_status)
    )
  ) +
    ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(
      dodge.width = 0.72,
      width = 0.20,
      size = 2.6,
      alpha = 0.85,
      varwidth = FALSE
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      aes(group = intra_status),
      fun.data = median_iqr_fun,
      geom = "errorbar",
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
      width = 0.14,
      linewidth = 0.50,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      aes(group = intra_status),
      fun = median,
      geom = "point",
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
      shape = 95,
      size = 8,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = response_label_map[levs_chr], drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle_txt,
      x = "Response category",
      y = "Mean intra-village ASV sharing rate (%)",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9.5, color = "grey25"),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
    )

  print(p)

  save_plot_both(
    p,
    filename,
    width = 7.0,
    height = 5.8
  )

  invisible(p)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Generate plots for ordinal items
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_hall_attend_intra_resp <- make_intra_rate_beeswarm_plot(

if (length(plot_list_resp) > 0) {

  save_plot_both(

    height = 22
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) shared_meal_time
#    - nominal variable
#    - x-axis = meal-time category
#    - y-axis = intra_pct
#    - point color = intra_status
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if ("shared_meal_time" %in% names(social_intra_status)) {

  meal_time_levels <- c("breakfast", "lunch", "dinner", "snack", "irregular")

  social_meal_time_intra_long <- social_intra_status %>%
    mutate(
      shared_meal_time = as.character(shared_meal_time),
      shared_meal_time = na_if(shared_meal_time, "NA"),
      shared_meal_time = na_if(shared_meal_time, ""),
      shared_meal_time = factor(shared_meal_time, levels = meal_time_levels),
      intra_status = factor(
        intra_status,
        levels = c("Intra <= inter", "Intra > inter")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(shared_meal_time),
      !is.na(intra_status),
      is.finite(intra_pct)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(vil_id, intra_status, intra_pct, shared_meal_time)

  if (nrow(social_meal_time_intra_long) > 0) {

    social_meal_time_intra_stats <- tryCatch(
      {
        kw <- kruskal.test(intra_pct ~ shared_meal_time, data = social_meal_time_intra_long)
        tibble(
          test = "Kruskal-Wallis",
          p_value = kw$p.value,
          n = nrow(social_meal_time_intra_long)
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        tibble(
          test = "Kruskal-Wallis",
          p_value = NA_real_,
          n = nrow(social_meal_time_intra_long)
        )
      }
    )

    print(social_meal_time_intra_stats)

    write_csv(
      social_meal_time_intra_long,
      "derived_shared_meal_time_vs_intra_rate_long.csv"
    )

    write_csv(
      social_meal_time_intra_stats,
      "supplementary_shared_meal_time_vs_intra_rate_kruskal.csv"
    )

    p_shared_meal_time_intra_beeswarm <- ggplot(
      social_meal_time_intra_long,
      aes(
        x = shared_meal_time,
        y = intra_pct,
        color = intra_status,
        group = interaction(shared_meal_time, intra_status)
      )
    ) +
      ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(
        dodge.width = 0.72,
        width = 0.20,
        size = 2.6,
        alpha = 0.85,
        varwidth = FALSE
      ) +
      stat_summary(
        aes(group = intra_status),
        fun.data = median_iqr_fun,
        geom = "errorbar",
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
        width = 0.14,
        linewidth = 0.50,
        color = "black"
      ) +
      stat_summary(
        aes(group = intra_status),
        fun = median,
        geom = "point",
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
        shape = 95,
        size = 8,
        color = "black"
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = group_cols, drop = FALSE) +
      scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
      labs(
        title = "Shared meal time",
        subtitle = paste0(
          "Kruskal-Wallis test: raw P = ",
          fmt_p(social_meal_time_intra_stats$p_value[1]),
          ", n = ",
          social_meal_time_intra_stats$n[1]
        ),
        x = "Shared meal time",
        y = "Mean intra-village ASV sharing rate (%)",
        color = NULL
      ) +
      base_theme +
      theme(
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9.5, color = "grey25"),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
      )

    print(p_shared_meal_time_intra_beeswarm)

    save_plot_both(
      p_shared_meal_time_intra_beeswarm,
      "social_shared_meal_time_vs_intra_rate_beeswarm",
      width = 7.0,
      height = 5.8
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
})

# =========================================================
# Social questionnaire item distributions by intra > inter status
# - For each questionnaire item:
#   1) show response-category proportions
#   2) test distribution difference by Fisher's exact test
#   3) test ordered trend by ordinal logistic regression (MASS::polr)
#
# Required inputs:
#   vil_cmp
#   social_village
#   base_theme
#   save_plot_both()
#
# Important:
#   - Uses vil_id only
#   - village_name is not used
#   - delta_pct is used only to define intra_gt_inter
#   - shared_meal_time is treated as nominal (Fisher only)
#   - MASS is not loaded with library(MASS) to avoid select() masking
#   - Individual plots use fixed size, fixed bar width, fixed y-axis, fixed panel aspect ratio
#
# Main outputs:
#   social_intra_status
#   social_item_dist_long
#   social_item_fisher_results
#   social_item_ordinal_results
#   social_meal_time_fisher
#   p_social_item_dist_combined
#   p_shared_meal_time_dist
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("vil_cmp"), exists("social_village"))
stopifnot(exists("base_theme"), exists("save_plot_both"))
stopifnot("vil_id" %in% names(social_village))
stopifnot(all(c("intra_pct", "inter_k3_pct", "delta_pct") %in% names(vil_cmp)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Helper functions and fixed plotting geometry
# ---------------------------------------------------------
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    "NA",
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2),
      formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)
    )
  )
}

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))
}

INDIVIDUAL_PLOT_WIDTH  <- 7.2
INDIVIDUAL_PLOT_HEIGHT <- 5.8

BAR_WIDTH <- 0.62
PANEL_ASPECT_RATIO <- 1.15

COMMON_BAR_THEME <- base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9.5, color = "grey25"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.7, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8),
    aspect.ratio = PANEL_ASPECT_RATIO
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Build analysis table using vil_id only
# ---------------------------------------------------------
id_col <- dplyr::case_when(
  "vil_id" %in% names(vil_cmp) ~ "vil_id",
  "village_id" %in% names(vil_cmp) ~ "village_id",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

if (is.na(id_col)) {
  stop("vil_cmp must contain either 'vil_id' or 'village_id'.")
}

vil_cmp_base <- vil_cmp %>%
  mutate(
    vil_id = as.character(.data[[id_col]]),
    intra_gt_inter = !is.na(delta_pct) & delta_pct > 0
  )

if ("sig_vil" %in% names(vil_cmp_base)) {
  vil_cmp_base <- vil_cmp_base %>%
    mutate(sig_intra_gt_inter = as.logical(sig_vil))
} else if ("p_adj" %in% names(vil_cmp_base)) {
  vil_cmp_base <- vil_cmp_base %>%
    mutate(sig_intra_gt_inter = !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05)
} else {
  vil_cmp_base <- vil_cmp_base %>%
    mutate(sig_intra_gt_inter = NA)
}

vil_cmp_base <- vil_cmp_base %>%
  dplyr::select(
    vil_id,
    dplyr::any_of(c(
      "n_samples",
      "intra_pct",
      "inter_k3_pct",
      "delta_pct",
      "p_value",
      "p_adj"
    )),
    intra_gt_inter,
    sig_intra_gt_inter
  )

social_required <- c(
  "vil_id",
  "cluster",
  "hall_attend_n",
  "hall_gather_freq",
  "hall_stability",
  "shared_meal_freq",
  "shared_meal_time",
  "food_share_freq",
  "intervillage_freq",
  "intervillage_n"
)

missing_social <- setdiff(social_required, names(social_village))
if (length(missing_social) > 0) {
  stop("Missing columns in social_village: ", paste(missing_social, collapse = ", "))
}

meal_time_levels <- c("breakfast", "lunch", "dinner", "snack", "irregular")

social_intra_status <- vil_cmp_base %>%
  left_join(
    social_village %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(social_required)) %>%
      mutate(vil_id = as.character(vil_id)),
    by = "vil_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    intra_status = ifelse(intra_gt_inter, "Intra > inter", "Intra <= inter"),
    intra_status = factor(intra_status, levels = c("Intra <= inter", "Intra > inter")),
    shared_meal_time = na_if(as.character(shared_meal_time), "NA"),
    shared_meal_time = na_if(shared_meal_time, ""),
    shared_meal_time = factor(shared_meal_time, levels = meal_time_levels)
  )

cat("\nSocial questionnaire coverage\n")
print(
  social_intra_status %>%
    summarise(
      n_total_villages = n(),
      n_intra_gt_inter = sum(intra_gt_inter, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_intra_le_inter = sum(!intra_gt_inter, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_with_social_any = sum(
        if_any(
          dplyr::all_of(c(
            "hall_attend_n",
            "hall_gather_freq",
            "hall_stability",
            "shared_meal_freq",
            "shared_meal_time",
            "food_share_freq",
            "intervillage_freq",
            "intervillage_n"
          )),
          ~ !is.na(.x)
        )
      )
    )
)

write_csv(
  social_intra_status,
  "derived_social_questionnaire_intra_gt_inter_status.csv"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Define item variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ordinal_item_vars <- c(
  "hall_attend_n",
  "hall_gather_freq",
  "hall_stability",
  "shared_meal_freq",
  "food_share_freq",
  "intervillage_freq",
  "intervillage_n"
)

ordinal_item_vars <- intersect(ordinal_item_vars, names(social_intra_status))

item_label_map <- c(
  hall_attend_n = "Hall attendance size",
  hall_gather_freq = "Hall gathering frequency",
  hall_stability = "Hall attendee stability",
  shared_meal_freq = "Shared meal frequency",
  food_share_freq = "Food-sharing frequency",
  intervillage_freq = "Inter-village visit/meal frequency",
  intervillage_n = "Inter-village participant number"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Long table for ordinal items
# ---------------------------------------------------------
social_item_dist_long <- social_intra_status %>%
  dplyr::select(
    vil_id,
    intra_status,
    dplyr::all_of(ordinal_item_vars)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(ordinal_item_vars),
    names_to = "item_var",
    values_to = "response"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(intra_status), !is.na(response)) %>%
  mutate(
    item_label = recode(item_var, !!!item_label_map),
    response_chr = as.character(response)
  )

write_csv(
  social_item_dist_long,
  "derived_social_questionnaire_item_distribution_long.csv"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Fisher exact test for ordinal items
# ---------------------------------------------------------
safe_fisher_item <- function(df_one) {
  tab <- table(df_one$intra_status, df_one$response_chr)

  if (nrow(tab) < 2 || ncol(tab) < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      n = nrow(df_one),
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  ft <- suppressWarnings(fisher.test(tab))

  tibble(
    n = nrow(df_one),
    p_value = ft$p.value
  )
}

social_item_fisher_results <- social_item_dist_long %>%
  group_by(item_var, item_label) %>%
  group_modify(~ safe_fisher_item(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

print(social_item_fisher_results)

write_csv(
  social_item_fisher_results,
  "supplementary_social_item_distribution_fisher.csv"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Ordinal logistic regression for ordinal items
#    Outcome: response category (ordered)
#    Predictor: intra_status
#    OR > 1 means higher response is more likely in Intra > inter villages
# ---------------------------------------------------------
safe_polr_item <- function(df_one) {

  levs <- sort(unique(df_one$response_chr))

  dat <- df_one %>%
    mutate(
      response_ord = ordered(response_chr, levels = levs),
      intra_status = factor(
        intra_status,
        levels = c("Intra <= inter", "Intra > inter")
      )
    )

  if (
    nrow(dat) < 5 ||
    n_distinct(dat$intra_status) < 2 ||
    n_distinct(dat$response_ord) < 2
  ) {
    return(tibble(
      n = nrow(dat),
      beta = NA_real_,
      se = NA_real_,
      z_value = NA_real_,
      odds_ratio = NA_real_,
      conf_low = NA_real_,
      conf_high = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(
    MASS::polr(response_ord ~ intra_status, data = dat, Hess = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(tibble(
      n = nrow(dat),
      beta = NA_real_,
      se = NA_real_,
      z_value = NA_real_,
      odds_ratio = NA_real_,
      conf_low = NA_real_,
      conf_high = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  co <- coef(summary(fit))
  rn <- rownames(co)
  target_row <- rn[grepl("^intra_status", rn)]

  if (length(target_row) != 1) {
    return(tibble(
      n = nrow(dat),
      beta = NA_real_,
      se = NA_real_,
      z_value = NA_real_,
      odds_ratio = NA_real_,
      conf_low = NA_real_,
      conf_high = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  beta <- unname(co[target_row, "Value"])
  se <- unname(co[target_row, "Std. Error"])
  zval <- beta / se
  pval <- 2 * pnorm(abs(zval), lower.tail = FALSE)

  tibble(
    n = nrow(dat),
    beta = beta,
    se = se,
    z_value = zval,
    odds_ratio = exp(beta),
    conf_low = exp(beta - 1.96 * se),
    conf_high = exp(beta + 1.96 * se),
    p_value = pval
  )
}

    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
```
