```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Plot helper for ordinal items
#    - fixed bar width, fixed y-axis length, fixed panel aspect
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_item_prop_plot <- function(item_name, filename, title = NULL) {

  plot_df_raw <- social_item_dist_long %>%
    filter(item_var == item_name)

  if (nrow(plot_df_raw) == 0) return(NULL)

  levs <- sort(unique(plot_df_raw$response_chr))

  plot_df <- plot_df_raw %>%
    mutate(response_chr = factor(response_chr, levels = levs)) %>%
    count(intra_status, response_chr, name = "n") %>%
    tidyr::complete(
      intra_status,
      response_chr = factor(levs, levels = levs),
      fill = list(n = 0)
    ) %>%
    group_by(intra_status) %>%
    mutate(
      prop = n / sum(n),
      label = ifelse(prop >= 0.08, scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1), "")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  n_tbl <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(intra_status) %>%
    summarise(n_total = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

  x_lab_map <- setNames(
    paste0(n_tbl$intra_status, "\n(n = ", n_tbl$n_total, ")"),
    n_tbl$intra_status
  )

  fisher_row <- social_item_fisher_results %>%
    filter(item_var == item_name) %>%
    slice(1)

  ord_row <- social_item_ordinal_results %>%
    filter(item_var == item_name) %>%
    slice(1)

  subtitle_txt <- paste0(
    "Fisher raw P = ", fmt_p(fisher_row$p_value),
    ", FDR = ", fmt_p(fisher_row$p_adj),
    " | Ordinal logit OR = ", fmt_num(ord_row$odds_ratio, 2),
    " (95% CI ", fmt_num(ord_row$conf_low, 2), "-", fmt_num(ord_row$conf_high, 2), ")",
    ", raw P = ", fmt_p(ord_row$p_value),
    ", FDR = ", fmt_p(ord_row$p_adj)
  )

  if (is.null(title)) {
    title <- item_label_map[[item_name]]
  }

  pal <- c("#D9D9D9", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#08519C")
  pal_use <- setNames(pal[seq_along(levs)], levs)

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = intra_status, y = prop, fill = response_chr)
  ) +
    geom_col(
      width = BAR_WIDTH,
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 3.2,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = pal_use,
      breaks = levs,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = "Response"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_lab_map) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
      labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle_txt,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Proportion of villages"
    ) +
    COMMON_BAR_THEME

  print(p)

  save_plot_both(
    p,
    filename,
    width = INDIVIDUAL_PLOT_WIDTH,
    height = INDIVIDUAL_PLOT_HEIGHT
  )

  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(patchwork)
  library(purrr)
  library(scales)
})

# =========================================================
# Social questionnaire vs village-level intra sharing rate
# - Composite scores: scatter plots if columns exist
# - Original questionnaire items: photo-style beeswarm plots
#
# Required input:
#   social_intra_status
#   base_theme, save_plot_both()
#
# Required package for beeswarm plot:
#   ggbeeswarm
#
# Main outputs:
#   social_intra_rank_tbl
#   social_intra_cor
#   social_intra_lm
#   p_social_intra_composite_combined   [if composite scores exist]
#   p_social_intra_items_combined
#
# Update in this version:
#   - bracket vertical ticks removed
#   - bracket p-value labels spaced further apart
#   - mean labels separated from bracket lines
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("social_intra_status"))
stopifnot(exists("base_theme"), exists("save_plot_both"))
stopifnot(all(c("vil_id", "intra_pct") %in% names(social_intra_status)))

if (!requireNamespace("ggbeeswarm", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'ggbeeswarm' is required. Install it with install.packages('ggbeeswarm').")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    "NA",
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2),
      formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)
    )
  )
}

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Define questionnaire variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Composite score columns are optional.
candidate_composite_vars <- c(
  "within_social_score",
  "food_sharing_score",
  "intervillage_score"
)

composite_vars <- intersect(candidate_composite_vars, names(social_intra_status))

# Original numeric/ordinal questionnaire items.
candidate_item_vars <- c(
  "hall_attend_n",
  "hall_gather_freq",
  "hall_stability",
  "shared_meal_freq",
  "food_share_freq",
  "intervillage_freq",
  "intervillage_n"
)

item_vars <- intersect(candidate_item_vars, names(social_intra_status))

score_vars <- c(composite_vars, item_vars)

if (length(score_vars) == 0) {
  stop("No questionnaire score/item columns were found in social_intra_status.")
}

var_label_map <- c(
  within_social_score = "Within-village social interaction score",
  food_sharing_score = "Shared meal/food-sharing composite score",
  intervillage_score = "Inter-village interaction score",
  hall_attend_n = "Hall attendance size score",
  hall_gather_freq = "Hall gathering frequency score",
  hall_stability = "Hall attendee stability score",
  shared_meal_freq = "Shared meal frequency score",
  food_share_freq = "Food-sharing frequency score",
  intervillage_freq = "Inter-village visit/meal frequency score",
  intervillage_n = "Inter-village participant number score"
)

cat("\nComposite variables found:\n")
print(composite_vars)

cat("\nOriginal questionnaire item variables found:\n")
print(item_vars)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Prepare analysis table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
social_intra_rank_tbl <- social_intra_status %>%
  mutate(
    intra_rank_high = dplyr::min_rank(desc(intra_pct)),
    intra_rank_low = dplyr::min_rank(intra_pct),
    intra_percentile = 100 * percent_rank(intra_pct)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    vil_id,
    dplyr::any_of(c("n_samples", "cluster")),
    intra_pct,
    intra_rank_high,
    intra_rank_low,
    intra_percentile,
    dplyr::all_of(score_vars)
  )

write_csv(
  social_intra_rank_tbl,
  "derived_social_questionnaire_intra_sharing_rank_table.csv"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Spearman correlation:
#    questionnaire score vs intra_pct
# ---------------------------------------------------------
spearman_one <- function(df, xvar, yvar = "intra_pct") {
  x <- df[[xvar]]
  y <- df[[yvar]]

  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  n_ok <- sum(ok)

  if (n_ok < 3) {
    return(tibble(n = n_ok, rho = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_))
  }

  ct <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  )

  tibble(
    n = n_ok,
    rho = unname(ct$estimate),
    p_value = ct$p.value
  )
}

social_intra_cor <- tibble(score_var = score_vars) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(res = list(spearman_one(social_intra_rank_tbl, score_var, "intra_pct"))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unnest(res) %>%
  mutate(
    variable_type = case_when(
      score_var %in% composite_vars ~ "Composite score",
      score_var %in% item_vars ~ "Original questionnaire item",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    score_label = recode(score_var, !!!var_label_map),
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(variable_type, p_adj)

print(social_intra_cor)

write_csv(
  social_intra_cor,
  "supplementary_social_scores_vs_intra_sharing_spearman.csv"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Optional linear model:
#    intra_pct ~ questionnaire score
#    adjusted model: + n_samples + cluster
# ---------------------------------------------------------
lm_one <- function(df, xvar, yvar = "intra_pct", adjusted = TRUE) {
  keep_cols <- c(yvar, xvar)

  if (adjusted) {
    keep_cols <- c(keep_cols, intersect(c("n_samples", "cluster"), names(df)))
  }

  dat <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(keep_cols)) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data[[xvar]]),
      is.finite(.data[[yvar]])
    )

  if ("n_samples" %in% names(dat)) {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(is.finite(n_samples))
  }

  if ("cluster" %in% names(dat)) {
    dat <- dat %>% mutate(cluster = factor(cluster))
  }

  if (nrow(dat) < 10) {
    return(tibble(
      n = nrow(dat),
      beta = NA_real_,
      se = NA_real_,
      t_value = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      adj_r2 = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  covars <- xvar

  if (adjusted && "n_samples" %in% names(dat)) {
    covars <- c(covars, "n_samples")
  }

  if (
    adjusted &&
    "cluster" %in% names(dat) &&
    n_distinct(dat$cluster[!is.na(dat$cluster)]) > 1
  ) {
    covars <- c(covars, "cluster")
  }

  form <- reformulate(covars, response = yvar)

  fit <- tryCatch(
    lm(form, data = dat),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(tibble(
      n = nrow(dat),
      beta = NA_real_,
      se = NA_real_,
      t_value = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      adj_r2 = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  co <- summary(fit)$coefficients

  if (!xvar %in% rownames(co)) {
    return(tibble(
      n = stats::nobs(fit),
      beta = NA_real_,
      se = NA_real_,
      t_value = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      adj_r2 = summary(fit)$adj.r.squared
    ))
  }

  tibble(
    n = stats::nobs(fit),
    beta = unname(co[xvar, "Estimate"]),
    se = unname(co[xvar, "Std. Error"]),
    t_value = unname(co[xvar, "t value"]),
    p_value = unname(co[xvar, "Pr(>|t|)"]),
    adj_r2 = summary(fit)$adj.r.squared
  )
}

social_intra_lm <- expand.grid(
  score_var = score_vars,
  model = c("unadjusted", "adjusted"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    res = list(
      lm_one(
        social_intra_rank_tbl,
        score_var,
        yvar = "intra_pct",
        adjusted = model == "adjusted"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unnest(res) %>%
  mutate(
    variable_type = case_when(
      score_var %in% composite_vars ~ "Composite score",
      score_var %in% item_vars ~ "Original questionnaire item",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    score_label = recode(score_var, !!!var_label_map)
  ) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(model, variable_type, p_adj)

print(social_intra_lm)

write_csv(
  social_intra_lm,
  "supplementary_social_scores_vs_intra_sharing_lm.csv"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Pretty scatter plot helper for composite scores
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_intra_scatter_pretty <- function(df, score_var, filename, xlab, title) {
  if (!score_var %in% names(df)) {
    message("Skipping ", score_var, ": column not found.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data[[score_var]]),
      is.finite(intra_pct)
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) < 3) {
    message("Skipping ", score_var, ": fewer than 3 valid observations.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  stat_row <- social_intra_cor %>%
    filter(score_var == !!score_var) %>%
    slice(1)

  stat_lab <- if (nrow(stat_row) == 1) {
    sprintf(
      "Spearman rho = %s, raw P = %s, BH-FDR = %s, n = %s",
      fmt_num(stat_row$rho, 2),
      fmt_p(stat_row$p_value),
      fmt_p(stat_row$p_adj),
      stat_row$n
    )
  } else {
    "Spearman rho = NA, raw P = NA, BH-FDR = NA"
  }

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = .data[[score_var]], y = intra_pct)
  ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 2.8,
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 0.35,
      color = "black",
      fill = "#4E79A7",
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      se = TRUE,
      color = "black",
      fill = "grey75",
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = stat_lab,
      x = xlab,
      y = "Mean intra-village ASV sharing rate (%)"
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey25"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  print(p)

  save_plot_both(
    p,
    filename,
    width = 7,
    height = 5.5
  )

  invisible(p)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Helper for pairwise Wilcoxon on categorical item plots
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pairwise_wilcox_df <- function(dat, group_var = "response_f", yvar = "intra_pct") {
  levs <- levels(dat[[group_var]])

  if (length(levs) < 2) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  cmb <- combn(levs, 2, simplify = FALSE)

  purrr::map_dfr(cmb, function(x) {
    dsub <- dat %>%
      filter(.data[[group_var]] %in% x)

    if (n_distinct(dsub[[group_var]]) < 2) {
      return(tibble(
        group1 = x[1],
        group2 = x[2],
        p = NA_real_
      ))
    }

    wt <- tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(
        stats::as.formula(paste(yvar, "~", group_var)),
        data = dsub,
        exact = FALSE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    tibble(
      group1 = x[1],
      group2 = x[2],
      p = if (is.null(wt)) NA_real_ else wt$p.value
    )
  })
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Photo-style beeswarm plot helper for original items
#    - revised:
#      1) no vertical bracket ticks
#      2) larger vertical spacing between p-value labels
#      3) mean labels and brackets separated to avoid overlap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_intra_swarm_pretty <- function(df, score_var, filename, xlab = NULL, title,
                                    max_compare = 3,
                                    response_label_map = NULL) {

  if (!score_var %in% names(df)) {
    message("Skipping ", score_var, ": column not found.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data[[score_var]]),
      is.finite(intra_pct)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      response_num = .data[[score_var]],
      response_chr = as.character(response_num)
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) < 3) {
    message("Skipping ", score_var, ": fewer than 3 valid observations.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  levs_num <- sort(unique(plot_df$response_num))
  levs_chr <- as.character(levs_num)

  if (length(levs_chr) < 2) {
    message("Skipping ", score_var, ": fewer than 2 response categories.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  if (is.null(response_label_map)) {
    response_label_map <- setNames(levs_chr, levs_chr)
  } else {
    miss <- setdiff(levs_chr, names(response_label_map))
    if (length(miss) > 0) {
      response_label_map[miss] <- miss
    }
    response_label_map <- response_label_map[levs_chr]
  }

  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(
      response_f = factor(response_chr, levels = levs_chr)
    )

  n_tbl <- plot_df %>%
    count(response_f, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(
      label_main = unname(response_label_map[as.character(response_f)]),
      x_lab = paste0(label_main, "\n(n = ", n, ")")
    )

  x_lab_map <- setNames(n_tbl$x_lab, n_tbl$response_f)

  mean_tbl <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(response_f) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_intra = mean(intra_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  pair_tbl <- pairwise_wilcox_df(
    plot_df,
    group_var = "response_f",
    yvar = "intra_pct"
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p)) %>%
    arrange(p)

  if (nrow(pair_tbl) > max_compare) {
    pair_tbl <- pair_tbl %>%
      slice_head(n = max_compare)
  }

  y_max <- max(plot_df$intra_pct, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(plot_df$intra_pct, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_rng <- max(1, y_max - y_min)

  # Mean labels: above points but below brackets
  mean_y <- y_max + y_rng * 0.08

  mean_tbl <- mean_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      x = match(response_f, levs_chr),
      y = mean_y,
      lab = paste0(fmt_num(mean_intra, 1), "%")
    )

  # Brackets: horizontal lines only, no vertical ticks
  # Wider comparisons are placed first to reduce visual crossing/overlap
  if (nrow(pair_tbl) > 0) {
    pair_tbl <- pair_tbl %>%
      mutate(
        x1 = match(group1, levs_chr),
        x2 = match(group2, levs_chr),
        span = abs(x2 - x1)
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(span), p) %>%
      mutate(
        y = y_max + y_rng * (0.20 + 0.12 * (row_number() - 1)),
        y_text = y + y_rng * 0.035,
        p_lab = fmt_p(p)
      )
  }

  pal_base <- c("#56B4E9", "#66CC44", "#4C78A8", "#FC8D62", "#CC79A7")
  pal_use <- setNames(pal_base[seq_along(levs_chr)], levs_chr)

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = response_f, y = intra_pct, color = response_f)
  ) +
    ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(
      width = 0.30,
      varwidth = TRUE,
      size = 2.6,
      alpha = 0.75,
      stroke = 0.25
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pal_use, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_lab_map) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = ifelse(is.null(xlab), "", xlab),
      y = "Mean intra-village ASV sharing rate (%)"
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(10, 22, 22, 10)
    )

  # Mean labels above each response category
  p <- p +
    geom_text(
      data = mean_tbl,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3.8,
      fontface = "bold"
    )

  # Horizontal bracket lines and p-value labels
  # No vertical ticks are drawn.
  if (nrow(pair_tbl) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_segment(
        data = pair_tbl,
        aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        linewidth = 0.55,
        color = "black"
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = pair_tbl,
        aes(x = (x1 + x2) / 2, y = y_text, label = p_lab),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 3.8
      )
  }

  y_top <- if (nrow(pair_tbl) > 0) {
    max(pair_tbl$y_text, na.rm = TRUE) + y_rng * 0.10
  } else {
    mean_y + y_rng * 0.14
  }

  p <- p +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(
        min(0, y_min - y_rng * 0.05),
        y_top
      ),
      clip = "off"
    )

  print(p)

  save_plot_both(
    p,
    filename,
    width = 7.4,
    height = 5.8
  )

  invisible(p)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Composite score plots
#    - run only if composite score columns exist
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_within_intra_rank <- NULL
p_food_intra_rank <- NULL
p_intervillage_intra_rank <- NULL
p_social_intra_composite_combined <- NULL

if ("within_social_score" %in% names(social_intra_rank_tbl)) {
  p_within_intra_rank <- make_intra_scatter_pretty(
    social_intra_rank_tbl,
    score_var = "within_social_score",
    filename = "social_composite_within_score_vs_intra_sharing_rate_pretty",
    xlab = "Within-village social interaction score",
    title = "Within-village social interaction"
  )
}

if ("food_sharing_score" %in% names(social_intra_rank_tbl)) {
  p_food_intra_rank <- make_intra_scatter_pretty(
    social_intra_rank_tbl,
    score_var = "food_sharing_score",
    filename = "social_composite_food_related_score_vs_intra_sharing_rate_pretty",
    xlab = "Shared meal / food-sharing composite score",
    title = "Shared meal / food-sharing composite score"
  )
}

if ("intervillage_score" %in% names(social_intra_rank_tbl)) {
  p_intervillage_intra_rank <- make_intra_scatter_pretty(
    social_intra_rank_tbl,
    score_var = "intervillage_score",
    filename = "social_composite_intervillage_score_vs_intra_sharing_rate_pretty",
    xlab = "Inter-village interaction score",
    title = "Inter-village interaction score"
  )
}

composite_plot_list <- list(
  p_within_intra_rank,
  p_food_intra_rank,
  p_intervillage_intra_rank
)

composite_plot_list <- composite_plot_list[
  !vapply(composite_plot_list, is.null, logical(1))
]

if (length(composite_plot_list) > 0) {
  p_social_intra_composite_combined <- wrap_plots(
    plotlist = composite_plot_list,
    nrow = 1
  )

  print(p_social_intra_composite_combined)

  save_plot_both(
    p_social_intra_composite_combined,
    "social_composite_scores_vs_intra_sharing_rate_combined_pretty",
    width = 18,
    height = 5.8
  )
} else {
  message("No composite score columns were found. Composite scatter plots were skipped.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Response label maps for item plots
#    Replace these labels with exact questionnaire wording if needed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
default_4level_map <- c(
  "0" = "0",
  "1" = "1",
  "2" = "2",
  "3" = "3"
)

response_label_map_list <- list(
  hall_attend_n     = default_4level_map,
  hall_gather_freq  = default_4level_map,
  hall_stability    = default_4level_map,
  shared_meal_freq  = default_4level_map,
  food_share_freq   = default_4level_map,
  intervillage_freq = default_4level_map,
  intervillage_n    = default_4level_map
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Original questionnaire item plots
#     - run only for columns that exist
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_item_if_exists <- function(score_var, filename, xlab, title) {
  if (!score_var %in% item_vars) {
    message("Skipping ", score_var, ": not found in item_vars.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  make_intra_swarm_pretty(
    social_intra_rank_tbl,
    score_var = score_var,
    filename = filename,
    xlab = xlab,
    title = title,
    response_label_map = response_label_map_list[[score_var]]
  )
}

p_hall_attend_intra <- plot_item_if_exists(
  "hall_attend_n",
  "social_item_hall_attend_n_vs_intra_sharing_rate_swarm",

p_hall_gather_intra <- plot_item_if_exists(

p_hall_stability_intra <- plot_item_if_exists(

p_shared_meal_intra <- plot_item_if_exists(

p_food_share_intra <- plot_item_if_exists(

p_inter_freq_intra <- plot_item_if_exists(

)

p_inter_n_intra <- plot_item_if_exists(
  "intervillage_n",
  "social_item_intervillage_n_vs_intra_sharing_rate_swarm",
  "Inter-village participant number",
  "Inter-village participant number"
)

item_plot_list <- list(
  p_hall_attend_intra,
  p_hall_gather_intra,
  p_hall_stability_intra,
  p_shared_meal_intra,
  p_food_share_intra,

item_plot_list <- item_plot_list[

]

if (length(item_plot_list) > 0) {

  )
} else {

}
```

#ST_extended data fig 1
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(tibble)
})

# =========================================================
# Supplementary Table for Extended Data Fig. 1
# Social questionnaire vs intra > inter status
#
# Outputs:
#   1) ST_social_questionnaire_village_scores.csv
#   2) ST_social_questionnaire_statistical_tests.csv
#
# Required objects:
#   social_intra_status
#   social_numeric_tests
#   social_item_fisher_results
#   social_item_ordinal_results
#   social_meal_time_fisher
#   meal_time_tbl
#
# Excluded:
#   intervillage_score
#   intervillage_freq
#   intervillage_n
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("social_intra_status"))
stopifnot(exists("social_numeric_tests"))
stopifnot(exists("social_item_fisher_results"))
stopifnot(exists("social_item_ordinal_results"))
stopifnot(exists("social_meal_time_fisher"))
stopifnot(exists("meal_time_tbl"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) If composite scores are missing because social_intra_status
#    was rebuilt by the item-distribution code, attach them again
#    from social_village.
# ---------------------------------------------------------

if (
  (!"within_social_score" %in% names(social_intra_status) ||
   !"food_sharing_score" %in% names(social_intra_status)) &&
  exists("social_village")
) {
  social_intra_status <- social_intra_status %>%
    select(
      -any_of(c(
        "within_social_score",
        "food_sharing_score",
        "within_social_score.x",
        "within_social_score.y",
        "food_sharing_score.x",
        "food_sharing_score.y"
      ))
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      social_village %>%
        select(
          vil_id,
          within_social_score,
          food_sharing_score
        ) %>%
        mutate(vil_id = as.character(vil_id)),
      by = "vil_id"
    )
}

stopifnot(all(c(
  "vil_id",
  "intra_pct",
  "inter_k3_pct",
  "delta_pct",
  "intra_gt_inter",
  "intra_status",
  "within_social_score",
  "food_sharing_score",
  "hall_attend_n",
  "hall_gather_freq",
  "hall_stability",
  "shared_meal_freq",
  "food_share_freq",
  "shared_meal_time"
) %in% names(social_intra_status)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Village-level table
# ---------------------------------------------------------

st_village_scores <- social_intra_status %>%
  transmute(
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    cluster = if ("cluster" %in% names(.)) as.character(cluster) else NA_character_,
    n_samples = if ("n_samples" %in% names(.)) as.integer(n_samples) else NA_integer_,

    intra_sharing_pct = round(intra_pct, 4),
    inter_k3_sharing_pct = round(inter_k3_pct, 4),
    delta_sharing_pct = round(delta_pct, 4),

    intra_gt_inter = as.logical(intra_gt_inter),
    intra_status = as.character(intra_status),
    sig_intra_gt_inter = if ("sig_intra_gt_inter" %in% names(.)) {
      as.logical(sig_intra_gt_inter)
    } else {
      NA
    },

    within_social_score = round(within_social_score, 4),
    food_sharing_score = round(food_sharing_score, 4),

    hall_attend_n_score = hall_attend_n,
    hall_gather_freq_score = hall_gather_freq,
    hall_stability_score = hall_stability,
    shared_meal_freq_score = shared_meal_freq,
    food_share_freq_score = food_share_freq,
    shared_meal_time = as.character(shared_meal_time)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(intra_gt_inter), desc(delta_sharing_pct), vil_id)

readr::write_csv(
  st_village_scores,
  "ST_social_questionnaire_village_scores.csv"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Statistical-test summary table
#    Panels:
#      a,b   : one-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum tests
#      c-g   : Fisher's exact test + ordinal logistic regression
#      h     : Fisher's exact test only
# ---------------------------------------------------------

panel_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~panel, ~variable,              ~variable_label,
  "a",    "within_social_score",  "Within-village social interaction composite score",
  "b",    "food_sharing_score",   "Shared meal / food-sharing composite score",
  "c",    "hall_attend_n",        "Hall attendance size",
  "d",    "hall_gather_freq",     "Hall gathering frequency",
  "e",    "hall_stability",       "Hall attendee stability",
  "f",    "shared_meal_freq",     "Shared meal frequency",
  "g",    "food_share_freq",      "Food-sharing frequency",
  "h",    "shared_meal_time",     "Shared meal time"
)

# a,b: composite score Wilcoxon tests
st_test_composite <- social_numeric_tests %>%
  filter(score_var %in% c("within_social_score", "food_sharing_score")) %>%
  left_join(
    panel_map,
    by = c("score_var" = "variable")
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    panel = panel,
    variable = as.character(score_var),
    variable_label = variable_label,
    variable_type = "Composite score",

    test = "One-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test",
    n_total = as.integer(n),
    n_intra_le_inter = as.integer(n_le),
    n_intra_gt_inter = as.integer(n_gt),

    median_intra_le_inter = round(median_le, 4),
    median_intra_gt_inter = round(median_gt, 4),
    mean_intra_le_inter = round(mean_le, 4),
    mean_intra_gt_inter = round(mean_gt, 4),

    effect_size_or_beta = NA_real_,
    odds_ratio = NA_real_,
    odds_ratio_ci_low = NA_real_,
    odds_ratio_ci_high = NA_real_,

    raw_p = signif(p_one_sided_higher_gt, 4),
    adjusted_p_or_FDR = signif(p_adj_one_sided_higher_gt, 4),

    interpretation = "One-sided test of higher score in Intra > inter villages"
  )

# c-g: item-level Fisher and ordinal logistic regression
keep_item_vars <- c(
  "hall_attend_n",
  "hall_gather_freq",
  "hall_stability",
  "shared_meal_freq",
  "food_share_freq"
)

st_test_items <- social_item_fisher_results %>%
  filter(item_var %in% keep_item_vars) %>%
  select(
    item_var,
    fisher_n = n,
    fisher_p = p_value,
    fisher_p_adj = p_adj
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    social_item_ordinal_results %>%
      filter(item_var %in% keep_item_vars) %>%
      select(
        item_var,
        ordinal_n = n,
        ordinal_beta = beta,
        ordinal_or = odds_ratio,
        ordinal_ci_low = conf_low,
        ordinal_ci_high = conf_high,
        ordinal_p = p_value,
        ordinal_p_adj = p_adj
      ),
    by = "item_var"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    panel_map,
    by = c("item_var" = "variable")
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    panel = panel,
    variable = as.character(item_var),
    variable_label = variable_label,
    variable_type = "Ordinal questionnaire item",

    test = "Fisher's exact test; ordinal logistic regression",
    n_total = as.integer(fisher_n),
    n_intra_le_inter = NA_integer_,
    n_intra_gt_inter = NA_integer_,

    median_intra_le_inter = NA_real_,
    median_intra_gt_inter = NA_real_,
    mean_intra_le_inter = NA_real_,
    mean_intra_gt_inter = NA_real_,

    effect_size_or_beta = round(ordinal_beta, 4),
    odds_ratio = round(ordinal_or, 4),
    odds_ratio_ci_low = round(ordinal_ci_low, 4),
    odds_ratio_ci_high = round(ordinal_ci_high, 4),

    raw_p = signif(fisher_p, 4),
    adjusted_p_or_FDR = signif(fisher_p_adj, 4),

    interpretation = paste0(
      "Raw/adjusted P values are from Fisher's exact test. ",
      "Odds ratio is from ordinal logistic regression; OR > 1 indicates higher odds of a higher response category in Intra > inter villages. ",
      "Ordinal-logit raw P = ", signif(ordinal_p, 4),
      "; ordinal-logit FDR = ", signif(ordinal_p_adj, 4), "."
    )
  )

# h: shared meal time, nominal Fisher only
st_test_meal_time <- tibble(
  panel = "h",
  variable = "shared_meal_time",
  variable_label = "Shared meal time",
  variable_type = "Nominal questionnaire item",

  test = "Fisher's exact test",
  n_total = as.integer(sum(meal_time_tbl$n, na.rm = TRUE)),
  n_intra_le_inter = NA_integer_,
  n_intra_gt_inter = NA_integer_,

  median_intra_le_inter = NA_real_,
  median_intra_gt_inter = NA_real_,
  mean_intra_le_inter = NA_real_,
  mean_intra_gt_inter = NA_real_,

  effect_size_or_beta = NA_real_,
  odds_ratio = NA_real_,
  odds_ratio_ci_low = NA_real_,
  odds_ratio_ci_high = NA_real_,

  raw_p = signif(social_meal_time_fisher$p_value[1], 4),
  adjusted_p_or_FDR = NA_real_,

  interpretation = "Shared meal time was treated as a nominal categorical variable; ordinal logistic regression was not applied."
)

st_statistical_tests <- bind_rows(
  st_test_composite,
  st_test_items,
  st_test_meal_time
) %>%
  mutate(
    panel = factor(panel, levels = letters[1:8])
  ) %>%
  arrange(panel) %>%
  mutate(panel = as.character(panel))

readr::write_csv(
  st_statistical_tests,
  "ST_social_questionnaire_statistical_tests.csv"
)

cat("\nSaved supplementary tables:\n")
cat("- ST_social_questionnaire_village_scores.csv\n")
cat("- ST_social_questionnaire_statistical_tests.csv\n")
```



```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(readr)
  library(showtext)
})

# =========================================================
# Final: separate prevalence heatmaps + SD/RSD strips
# - Panel 1:
#     Global core ASVs (global prevalence >= 50)
# - Panel 2:
#     Village-enriched ASVs (max village prevalence >= 50 and global <= 20)
# - right annotation strips:
#     SD  = village-level prevalence SD
#     RSD = 100 * SD / mean village prevalence
#
# Outputs:
#   village_ASV_prevalence_globalCore_withGenus_SD_RSDstrip.png/.svg
#   village_ASV_prevalence_villageEnriched_withGenus_SD_RSDstrip.png/.svg
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Preconditions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs <- c("meta", "vil_tbl", "asv_tax", "asv_pa", "base_theme", "order_tbl_core", "save_plot_both")
miss <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss)) {
  stop("Required FOUNDATION objects are missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "village_name") %in% names(meta)))
stopifnot(all(c("label", "vil_id", "lon", "lat") %in% names(vil_tbl)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "Taxon") %in% names(asv_tax)))
stopifnot("ASV" %in% names(asv_pa))
stopifnot(all(c("village_name", "dendro_order") %in% names(order_tbl_core)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) meta_min
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ASV_col <- names(asv_pa)[1]
sample_cols <- setdiff(names(asv_pa), c(ASV_col, "Taxon"))

meta_min_tmp <- meta %>%
  transmute(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    village_name = as.character(village_name)
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(sampleid %in% sample_cols)

if (nrow(meta_min_tmp) == 0) {
  stop("No shared samples were found between meta and asv_pa.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) village_id / village_lab + global label
# ---------------------------------------------------------
vil_n_tmp <- meta_min_tmp %>%
  distinct(sampleid, village_name) %>%
  count(village_name, name = "n_samples")

vil_id_map2_tmp <- vil_tbl %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    village_name = as.character(label),
    village_id = as.character(vil_id)
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(vil_n_tmp, by = "village_name") %>%
  mutate(
    n_samples = replace_na(n_samples, 0L),
    village_lab = sprintf("%s (n=%d)", village_id, n_samples)
  )

N_total <- meta_min_tmp %>%
  distinct(sampleid) %>%
  nrow()

global_lab <- sprintf("Global (N=%d)", N_total)

x_levels <- c(
  order_tbl_core %>%
    select(village_name, dendro_order) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    left_join(
      vil_id_map2_tmp %>% select(village_name, village_lab),
      by = "village_name"
    ) %>%
    arrange(dendro_order) %>%
    pull(village_lab),
  global_lab
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Taxon label
#    - do not use g__uncultured / g__unknown / g__unclassified as genus labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
extract_label_name <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- NA_character_

  out <- vapply(x, function(s) {
    if (is.na(s)) return("Unassigned")

    s2 <- trimws(s)

    get_rank <- function(pattern) {
      m <- regmatches(s2, regexpr(pattern, s2, perl = TRUE))
      if (length(m) == 1 && nchar(m) > 0) m else NA_character_
    }

    g <- get_rank("g__[^;|]*")
    f <- get_rank("f__[^;|]*")
    o <- get_rank("o__[^;|]*")
    c <- get_rank("c__[^;|]*")
    p <- get_rank("p__[^;|]*")
    d <- get_rank("d__[^;|]*")

    vals <- c(g, f, o, c, p, d)
    vals <- trimws(vals)
    vals[vals %in% c("g__", "f__", "o__", "c__", "p__", "d__", "")] <- NA_character_

    if (!is.na(vals[1]) && vals[1] %in% c("g__uncultured", "g__unknown", "g__unclassified")) {
      vals[1] <- NA_character_
    }

    lab <- dplyr::coalesce(vals[1], vals[2], vals[3], vals[4], vals[5], vals[6], "Unassigned")
    if (is.na(lab) || lab == "") "Unassigned" else lab
  }, character(1))

  out
}

asv_genus_tmp <- asv_tax %>%
  transmute(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    Genus = extract_label_name(Taxon)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus) | Genus == "", "Unassigned", Genus)
  ) %>%
  distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) PA long -> prev_vil / prev_global
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_pa_sub <- asv_pa %>%
  select(ASV = all_of(ASV_col), all_of(meta_min_tmp$sampleid)) %>%
  mutate(across(-ASV, ~ as.integer(replace_na(.x, 0) > 0)))

pa_long_tmp <- asv_pa_sub %>%
  pivot_longer(-ASV, names_to = "sampleid", values_to = "pres") %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    pres = as.integer(pres)
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_min_tmp, by = "sampleid") %>%
  filter(!is.na(village_name))

prev_vil_tmp <- pa_long_tmp %>%
  group_by(ASV, village_name) %>%
  summarise(
    prev = mean(pres, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    vil_id_map2_tmp %>% select(village_name, village_lab),
    by = "village_name"
  )

prev_global_tmp <- pa_long_tmp %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    prev = mean(pres, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(village_lab = global_lab)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3.5) Village-level mean / SD / RSD (excluding global)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
EPS_RSD <- 1e-8

asv_var_tmp <- prev_vil_tmp %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_prev_vil = mean(prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_sd = sd(prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_rsd = ifelse(abs(mean_prev_vil) > EPS_RSD, 100 * prev_sd / mean_prev_vil, NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) ASV classification
# ---------------------------------------------------------
global_core_thr <- 50
vil_hi_thr <- 50
global_low_thr <- 20

asv_pick_tmp <- prev_vil_tmp %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    max_vil = max(prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    prev_global_tmp %>% transmute(ASV, global_prev = prev),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    class = case_when(
      global_prev >= global_core_thr ~ "Global core",
      max_vil >= vil_hi_thr & global_prev <= global_low_thr ~ "Village-enriched",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    delta = max_vil - global_prev
  )

pick_core_tmp <- asv_pick_tmp %>%
  filter(class == "Global core") %>%
  arrange(desc(global_prev), desc(max_vil), ASV)

pick_enr_tmp <- asv_pick_tmp %>%
  filter(class == "Village-enriched") %>%
  arrange(desc(delta), desc(max_vil), desc(global_prev), ASV)

message("Global core ASVs used: ", nrow(pick_core_tmp))
message("Village-enriched ASVs used: ", nrow(pick_enr_tmp))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Heatmap tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_class_core_tmp <- pick_core_tmp %>%
  select(ASV, class, global_prev, max_vil, delta) %>%
  distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)

asv_class_enr_tmp <- pick_enr_tmp %>%
  select(ASV, class, global_prev, max_vil, delta) %>%
  distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)

prev_heat_core_tmp <- bind_rows(
  prev_vil_tmp %>% select(ASV, village_lab, prev),
  prev_global_tmp %>% select(ASV, village_lab, prev)
) %>%
  filter(ASV %in% pick_core_tmp$ASV) %>%
  left_join(asv_class_core_tmp, by = "ASV") %>%
  left_join(asv_genus_tmp, by = "ASV") %>%
  left_join(asv_var_tmp, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_lab = paste0(Genus, " | ", ASV),
    village_lab = factor(village_lab, levels = x_levels)
  )

prev_heat_enr_tmp <- bind_rows(
  prev_vil_tmp %>% select(ASV, village_lab, prev),
  prev_global_tmp %>% select(ASV, village_lab, prev)
) %>%
  filter(ASV %in% pick_enr_tmp$ASV) %>%
  left_join(asv_class_enr_tmp, by = "ASV") %>%
  left_join(asv_genus_tmp, by = "ASV") %>%
  left_join(asv_var_tmp, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_lab = paste0(Genus, " | ", ASV),
    village_lab = factor(village_lab, levels = x_levels)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5.1) Explicit prevalence bins
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pal_use <- c(
  "0" = "grey95",
  "0–<20" = "grey80",
  "20–<50" = "#fee08b",
  "50–<75" = "#f46d43",
  "75–100" = "#a50026"
)

bin_prev_fun <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      prev_bin = case_when(
        is.na(prev) ~ NA_character_,
        prev == 0 ~ "0",
        prev > 0 & prev < 20 ~ "0–<20",
        prev >= 20 & prev < 50 ~ "20–<50",
        prev >= 50 & prev < 75 ~ "50–<75",
        prev >= 75 ~ "75–100",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      prev_bin = factor(
        prev_bin,
        levels = c("0", "0–<20", "20–<50", "50–<75", "75–100")
      )
    )
}

prev_heat_core_tmp <- bin_prev_fun(prev_heat_core_tmp)
prev_heat_enr_tmp <- bin_prev_fun(prev_heat_enr_tmp)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Row order
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_lab_lookup_core <- prev_heat_core_tmp %>%
  distinct(ASV, ASV_lab)

asv_lab_lookup_enr <- prev_heat_enr_tmp %>%
  distinct(ASV, ASV_lab)

# Global core: sort by descending SD
asv_order_core <- pick_core_tmp %>%
  left_join(
    asv_var_tmp %>% select(ASV, prev_sd),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(prev_sd), desc(global_prev), desc(max_vil), desc(delta), ASV) %>%
  pull(ASV)

# Village-enriched: sort by descending SD
asv_order_enr <- pick_enr_tmp %>%
  left_join(
    asv_var_tmp %>% select(ASV, prev_sd),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(prev_sd), desc(delta), desc(max_vil), desc(global_prev), ASV) %>%
  pull(ASV)

asv_order_core_lab <- asv_lab_lookup_core$ASV_lab[match(asv_order_core, asv_lab_lookup_core$ASV)]
asv_order_enr_lab <- asv_lab_lookup_enr$ASV_lab[match(asv_order_enr, asv_lab_lookup_enr$ASV)]

asv_order_core_lab <- asv_order_core_lab[!is.na(asv_order_core_lab)]
asv_order_enr_lab <- asv_order_enr_lab[!is.na(asv_order_enr_lab)]

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_prev_panel <- function(df, asv_levels_lab, title, subtitle) {
  df2 <- df %>%
    mutate(ASV_lab = factor(ASV_lab, levels = rev(asv_levels_lab)))

  ggplot(df2, aes(x = village_lab, y = ASV_lab, fill = prev_bin)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.12) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = x_levels, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = pal_use,
      drop = FALSE,
      na.value = "grey95",
      name = "Prevalence (%)\n(bin)"
    ) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
    )
}

make_var_strips <- function(df, asv_levels_lab, show_legends = TRUE) {
  var_df <- df %>%
    distinct(ASV, ASV_lab, prev_sd, prev_rsd) %>%
    mutate(ASV_lab = factor(ASV_lab, levels = rev(asv_levels_lab)))

  sd_df <- var_df %>%
    transmute(ASV_lab, metric = "SD", value = prev_sd)

  rsd_df <- var_df %>%
    transmute(ASV_lab, metric = "RSD", value = prev_rsd)

  p_sd <- ggplot(sd_df, aes(x = metric, y = ASV_lab, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.12) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "grey95",
      high = "#2166ac",
      name = "Village-level\nprevalence SD"
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = if (show_legends) "right" else "none"
    )

  p_rsd <- ggplot(rsd_df, aes(x = metric, y = ASV_lab, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.12) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "grey95",
      high = "#762a83",
      name = "Village-level\nprevalence RSD"
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = if (show_legends) "right" else "none"
    )

  p_sd + p_rsd + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Panel summaries
# ---------------------------------------------------------
core_sum <- pick_core_tmp %>%
  left_join(asv_var_tmp, by = "ASV") %>%
  summarise(
    n_asv = n(),
    med_sd = median(prev_sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    med_rsd = median(prev_rsd, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

enr_sum <- pick_enr_tmp %>%
  left_join(asv_var_tmp, by = "ASV") %>%
  summarise(
    n_asv = n(),
    med_sd = median(prev_sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    med_rsd = median(prev_rsd, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Plots
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_core_main <- make_prev_panel(
  prev_heat_core_tmp,
  asv_order_core_lab,
  "Village-level ASV prevalence (+ Global) — Global core",
  paste0(
    "All ASVs with global prevalence >= 50% (n=", core_sum$n_asv, "). ",
    "Median SD = ", sprintf("%.1f", core_sum$med_sd),
    ", median RSD = ", sprintf("%.1f", core_sum$med_rsd)
  )
)

p_core_var <- make_var_strips(
  prev_heat_core_tmp,
  asv_order_core_lab,
  show_legends = TRUE
)

p_global_core <- p_core_main + p_core_var + plot_layout(widths = c(30, 4))
print(p_global_core)

save_plot_both(
  p_global_core,
  "village_ASV_prevalence_globalCore_withGenus_SD_RSDstrip",
  width = 18,
  height = 8
)

p_enr_main <- make_prev_panel(
  prev_heat_enr_tmp,
  asv_order_enr_lab,
  "Village-level ASV prevalence (+ Global) — Village-enriched",
  paste0(
    "All ASVs with max village >= 50% and global <= 20% (n=", enr_sum$n_asv, "). ",
    "Median SD = ", sprintf("%.1f", enr_sum$med_sd),
    ", median RSD = ", sprintf("%.1f", enr_sum$med_rsd)
  )
)

p_enr_var <- make_var_strips(
  prev_heat_enr_tmp,
  asv_order_enr_lab,
  show_legends = TRUE
)

p_village_enriched <- p_enr_main + p_enr_var + plot_layout(widths = c(30, 4))
print(p_village_enriched)

save_plot_both(
  p_village_enriched,
  "village_ASV_prevalence_villageEnriched_withGenus_SD_RSDstrip",
  width = 18,
  height = 14
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Export tables
# - supplementary: figure source data and selected ASV lists
# - derived: ASV-level prevalence variability summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(asv_var_tmp,        "derived_village_prevalence_mean_sd_rsd_by_asv.csv")
write_csv(prev_heat_core_tmp, "supplementary_globalCore_prevalence_heatmap_data.csv")
write_csv(prev_heat_enr_tmp,  "supplementary_villageEnriched_prevalence_heatmap_data.csv")
write_csv(pick_core_tmp,      "supplementary_globalCore_selected_asv.csv")
write_csv(pick_enr_tmp,       "supplementary_villageEnriched_selected_asv.csv")
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Final: overlaid density plots (Global core vs Village-enriched)
# - three stacked panels:
#     1) Global prevalence
#     2) Village-level prevalence SD
#     3) Village-level prevalence RSD
#
# Outputs:
#   asv_class_overlaidDensity_globalPrev_SD_RSD_core_vs_enriched.png/.svg
#   asv_density_globalPrev_core_vs_enriched.png/.svg
#   asv_density_SD_core_vs_enriched.png/.svg
#   asv_density_RSD_core_vs_enriched.png/.svg
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Preconditions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs <- c("meta", "asv_pa", "base_theme", "save_plot_both")
miss <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss)) {
  stop("Required FOUNDATION objects are missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "village_name") %in% names(meta)))
stopifnot("ASV" %in% names(asv_pa))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
global_core_thr <- 50
vil_hi_thr <- 50
global_low_thr <- 20
EPS_RSD <- 1e-8

class_pal <- c(
  "Global core" = "#1b9e77",
  "Village-enriched" = "#d95f02"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Theme
# ---------------------------------------------------------
theme_den_final <- base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

theme_den_single <- theme_den_final +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Prepare PA long table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ASV_col <- names(asv_pa)[1]
sample_cols <- setdiff(names(asv_pa), c(ASV_col, "Taxon"))

meta_min_den <- meta %>%
  transmute(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    village_name = as.character(village_name)
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(sampleid %in% sample_cols)

if (nrow(meta_min_den) == 0) {
  stop("No shared samples were found between meta and asv_pa.")
}

asv_pa_sub_den <- asv_pa %>%
  select(ASV = all_of(ASV_col), all_of(meta_min_den$sampleid)) %>%
  mutate(across(-ASV, ~ as.integer(replace_na(.x, 0) > 0)))

pa_long_den <- asv_pa_sub_den %>%
  pivot_longer(-ASV, names_to = "sampleid", values_to = "pres") %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    pres = as.integer(pres)
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_min_den, by = "sampleid") %>%
  filter(!is.na(village_name))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Village prevalence / global prevalence
# ---------------------------------------------------------
prev_vil_den <- pa_long_den %>%
  group_by(ASV, village_name) %>%
  summarise(
    prev = mean(pres, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

prev_global_den <- pa_long_den %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    global_prev = mean(pres, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) ASV-wise mean / SD / RSD across villages
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_sum_den <- prev_vil_den %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_prev_vil = mean(prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_sd = sd(prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_rsd = ifelse(
      abs(mean_prev_vil) > EPS_RSD,
      100 * prev_sd / mean_prev_vil,
      NA_real_
    ),
    max_vil = max(prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(prev_global_den, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    class = case_when(
      global_prev >= global_core_thr ~ "Global core",
      max_vil >= vil_hi_thr & global_prev <= global_low_thr ~ "Village-enriched",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Keep only core vs enriched
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_df_den <- asv_sum_den %>%
  filter(class %in% c("Global core", "Village-enriched")) %>%
  mutate(
    class = factor(class, levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched"))
  )

stopifnot(nrow(plot_df_den) > 0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Panel 1: Global prevalence
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p1 <- ggplot(plot_df_den, aes(x = global_prev, color = class, fill = class)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 1.1, adjust = 1.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = class_pal, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_pal, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
  labs(
    x = "Global prevalence (%)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_den_single

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Panel 2: SD
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p2 <- ggplot(plot_df_den, aes(x = prev_sd, color = class, fill = class)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 1.1, adjust = 1.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = class_pal, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_pal, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
  labs(
    x = "Village-level prevalence SD (%)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_den_single

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Panel 3: RSD
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p3 <- ggplot(
  plot_df_den %>% filter(is.finite(prev_rsd)),
  aes(x = prev_rsd, color = class, fill = class)
) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 1.1, adjust = 1.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = class_pal, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_pal, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
  labs(
    x = "Village-level prevalence RSD (%)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_den_single

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Combined plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_all_den <- (p1 + theme(legend.position = "top")) /
  (p2 + theme(legend.position = "none")) /
  (p3 + theme(legend.position = "none")) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1))

print(p_all_den)

save_plot_both(
  p_all_den,
  "asv_class_overlaidDensity_globalPrev_SD_RSD_core_vs_enriched",
  width = 9,
  height = 10
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Individual panel saves
# ---------------------------------------------------------
save_plot_both(
  p1,
  "asv_density_globalPrev_core_vs_enriched",
  width = 9,
  height = 3.2
)

save_plot_both(
  p2,
  "asv_density_SD_core_vs_enriched",
  width = 9,
  height = 3.2
)

save_plot_both(
  p3,
  "asv_density_RSD_core_vs_enriched",
  width = 9,
  height = 3.2
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Export table
# - supplementary: source data for the density plots
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(
  asv_sum_den,
  "supplementary_asv_class_overlaidDensity_globalPrev_SD_RSD_core_vs_enriched_data.csv"
)
```
