```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(showtext)
})

# =========================================================
# Village-enriched ASVs:
# one plot per ASV showing village prevalence profiles
#
# Required FOUNDATION objects:
#   meta       : sample metadata (sampleid, village_name)
#   vil_tbl    : village table with label, vil_id
#   asv_pa     : ASV presence/absence table
#   base_theme : common plot theme
#   save_plot_both()
#
# Optional:
#   asv_tax    : ASV, Taxon for labels
#
# Outputs:
#   folder: village_enriched_ASV_profiles/
#   one PNG + SVG per ASV
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Preconditions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs <- c("meta", "vil_tbl", "asv_pa", "base_theme", "save_plot_both")
miss <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss)) {
  stop("Required FOUNDATION objects are missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "village_name") %in% names(meta)))
stopifnot(all(c("label", "vil_id") %in% names(vil_tbl)))
stopifnot("ASV" %in% names(asv_pa))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
global_core_thr <- 50
vil_hi_thr <- 50
global_low_thr <- 20

OUT_DIR <- "village_enriched_ASV_profiles"
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1.1) Prevalence bins / palette
#     - matched to the heatmap code
# ---------------------------------------------------------
prev_bin_levels <- c("0", "0–<20", "20–<50", "50–<75", "75–100")

prev_bin_pal <- c(
  "0" = "grey95",
  "0–<20" = "grey80",
  "20–<50" = "#fee08b",
  "50–<75" = "#f46d43",
  "75–100" = "#a50026"
)

bin_prev_common <- function(prev) {
  out <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(prev) ~ NA_character_,
    prev == 0 ~ "0",
    prev > 0 & prev < 20 ~ "0–<20",
    prev >= 20 & prev < 50 ~ "20–<50",
    prev >= 50 & prev < 75 ~ "50–<75",
    prev >= 75 ~ "75–100",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
  factor(out, levels = prev_bin_levels)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Tax label helper
#    - do not use g__uncultured / g__unknown / g__unclassified as genus labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
extract_label_name <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- NA_character_

  out <- vapply(x, function(s) {
    if (is.na(s)) return("Unassigned")

    s2 <- trimws(s)

    get_rank <- function(pattern) {
      m <- regmatches(s2, regexpr(pattern, s2, perl = TRUE))
      if (length(m) == 1 && nchar(m) > 0) m else NA_character_
    }

    g <- get_rank("g__[^;|]*")
    f <- get_rank("f__[^;|]*")
    o <- get_rank("o__[^;|]*")
    c <- get_rank("c__[^;|]*")
    p <- get_rank("p__[^;|]*")
    d <- get_rank("d__[^;|]*")

    vals <- c(g, f, o, c, p, d)
    vals <- trimws(vals)
    vals[vals %in% c("g__", "f__", "o__", "c__", "p__", "d__", "")] <- NA_character_

    if (!is.na(vals[1]) && vals[1] %in% c("g__uncultured", "g__unknown", "g__unclassified")) {
      vals[1] <- NA_character_
    }

    lab <- dplyr::coalesce(vals[1], vals[2], vals[3], vals[4], vals[5], vals[6], "Unassigned")
    if (is.na(lab) || lab == "") "Unassigned" else lab
  }, character(1))

  out
}

if (exists("asv_tax") && all(c("ASV", "Taxon") %in% names(asv_tax))) {
  asv_label_tbl <- asv_tax %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = as.character(ASV),
      Genus = extract_label_name(Taxon),
      Taxon = as.character(Taxon)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus) | Genus == "", "Unassigned", Genus),
      ASV_lab = paste0(Genus, " | ", ASV)
    ) %>%
    distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)
} else {
  asv_label_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
    ASV = character(),
    Genus = character(),
    Taxon = character(),
    ASV_lab = character()
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Prepare metadata / PA long
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ASV_col <- names(asv_pa)[1]
sample_cols <- setdiff(names(asv_pa), c(ASV_col, "Taxon"))

meta_min <- meta %>%
  transmute(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    village_name = as.character(village_name)
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(sampleid %in% sample_cols)

if (nrow(meta_min) == 0) {
  stop("No shared samples were found between meta and asv_pa.")
}

vil_map <- vil_tbl %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    village_name = as.character(label),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id)
  ) %>%
  distinct()

meta_min <- meta_min %>%
  left_join(vil_map, by = "village_name")

asv_pa_sub <- asv_pa %>%
  select(ASV = all_of(ASV_col), all_of(meta_min$sampleid)) %>%
  mutate(across(-ASV, ~ as.integer(replace_na(.x, 0) > 0)))

pa_long <- asv_pa_sub %>%
  pivot_longer(-ASV, names_to = "sampleid", values_to = "pres") %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    pres = as.integer(pres)
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_min, by = "sampleid") %>%
  filter(!is.na(village_name))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Village prevalence / global prevalence
# ---------------------------------------------------------
prev_vil <- pa_long %>%
  group_by(ASV, village_name, vil_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_village = n(),
    n_detected = sum(pres, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev = mean(pres, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

prev_global <- pa_long %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    global_prev = mean(pres, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Select village-enriched ASVs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_pick <- prev_vil %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    max_vil = max(prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(prev_global, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    class = case_when(
      global_prev >= global_core_thr ~ "Global core",
      max_vil >= vil_hi_thr & global_prev <= global_low_thr ~ "Village-enriched",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    delta = max_vil - global_prev
  )

pick_enr <- asv_pick %>%
  filter(class == "Village-enriched") %>%
  arrange(desc(delta), desc(max_vil), desc(global_prev), ASV)

if (nrow(pick_enr) == 0) {
  stop("No village-enriched ASVs were identified.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Plot data
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_df_all <- prev_vil %>%
  semi_join(pick_enr %>% select(ASV), by = "ASV") %>%
  left_join(
    pick_enr %>% select(ASV, global_prev, max_vil, delta),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    asv_label_tbl %>% select(any_of(c("ASV", "ASV_lab", "Genus"))),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_lab = ifelse(is.na(ASV_lab), ASV, ASV_lab),
    prev_bin = bin_prev_common(prev),
    is_ge50 = prev >= 50,
    is_ge75 = prev >= 75
  )

target_tbl <- plot_df_all %>%
  arrange(ASV, desc(prev), vil_id, village_name) %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    ASV,
    target_village = village_name,
    target_vil_id = vil_id,
    target_prev = prev
  )

plot_df_all <- plot_df_all %>%
  left_join(target_tbl, by = "ASV")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Safe filename helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
safe_file <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("_+", "_", x)
  x
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Make one plot per ASV
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_ids <- unique(plot_df_all$ASV)

for (a in asv_ids) {
  df_a <- plot_df_all %>%
    filter(ASV == a) %>%
    arrange(desc(prev), vil_id, village_name)

  if (nrow(df_a) == 0) next

  village_levels <- df_a %>%
    mutate(village_lab = ifelse(!is.na(vil_id), vil_id, village_name)) %>%
    pull(village_lab)

  df_a <- df_a %>%
    mutate(
      village_lab = ifelse(!is.na(vil_id), vil_id, village_name),
      village_lab = factor(village_lab, levels = village_levels),
      prev_bin = factor(prev_bin, levels = prev_bin_levels)
    )

  asv_title <- unique(df_a$ASV_lab)[1]
  gprev <- unique(df_a$global_prev)[1]
  mxprev <- unique(df_a$max_vil)[1]
  delt <- unique(df_a$delta)[1]
  tvil <- unique(df_a$target_vil_id)[1]
  tvprev <- unique(df_a$target_prev)[1]
  n_ge50 <- sum(df_a$prev >= 50, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_ge75 <- sum(df_a$prev >= 75, na.rm = TRUE)

  p <- ggplot(df_a, aes(x = village_lab, y = prev)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = prev_bin), width = 0.75, alpha = 0.95) +
    geom_hline(
      aes(yintercept = 50, linetype = "Village prevalence = 50%"),
      linewidth = 0.7,
      color = "#b2182b",
      show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      aes(yintercept = gprev, linetype = "Global prevalence"),
      linewidth = 0.7,
      color = "#2166ac",
      show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "Village prevalence = 50%" = 2,
        "Global prevalence" = 3
      ),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = prev_bin_pal,
      drop = FALSE,
      na.value = "grey95",
      name = "Village prevalence (%)"
    ) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(order = 1),
      linetype = guide_legend(order = 2)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = asv_title,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Global prev = ", sprintf("%.1f", gprev),
        " | Max village prev = ", sprintf("%.1f", mxprev),
        " | Delta = ", sprintf("%.1f", delt),
        " | Target = ", tvil, " (", sprintf("%.1f", tvprev), ")",
        " | n(prev >= 50) = ", n_ge50,
        " | n(prev >= 75) = ", n_ge75
      ),
      x = "Village",
      y = "Prevalence (%)"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  out_base <- file.path(
    OUT_DIR,
    paste0(
      sprintf("%03d", match(a, asv_ids)),
      "_",
      safe_file(a)
    )
  )

  save_plot_both(
    p,
    out_base,
    width = 14,
    height = 6
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Summary table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
profile_summary_tbl <- plot_df_all %>%
  group_by(ASV, ASV_lab, global_prev, max_vil, delta, target_vil_id, target_prev) %>%
  summarise(
    n_vil_ge50 = sum(prev >= 50, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_vil_ge75 = sum(prev >= 75, na.rm = TRUE),
    villages_ge50 = paste(vil_id[prev >= 50], collapse = ","),
    villages_ge75 = paste(vil_id[prev >= 75], collapse = ","),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(delta), desc(max_vil), desc(global_prev), ASV)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Export tables
# - supplementary: summary and plot source data
# ---------------------------------------------------------
readr::write_csv(
  profile_summary_tbl,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "supplementary_village_enriched_ASV_profile_summary.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  plot_df_all,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "supplementary_village_enriched_ASV_profile_plot_data.csv")
)
```

#village-enriched ASV prevalence profile_final
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(geodist)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggdendro)
  library(patchwork)
  library(readr)
})

has_dendsort   <- requireNamespace("dendsort", quietly = TRUE)
has_dendextend <- requireNamespace("dendextend", quietly = TRUE)

# =========================================================
# Full pipeline (no classification)
# - Haversine dendrogram order
# - cluster 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 leaf order enforced as much as possible
# - within each cluster, vil_id numeric order
# - dendrogram profile plotting + saving
#
# Required objects:
#   merged         : sampleid, village_name, cluster
#   vil_tbl        : data.frame with label, vil_id, lat, lon
#   asv_pa         : ASV x sample PA matrix (0/1)
#   save_plot_both : save helper from FOUNDATION
#
# Optional:
#   asv_tax
#   order_tbl_core
#   base_theme
#
# Outputs:
#   dendro_pattern_profiles_noclassification/
#     └─ all/
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Preconditions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs <- c("merged", "vil_tbl", "asv_pa", "save_plot_both")
miss <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss)) {
  stop("Required objects are missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "village_name", "cluster") %in% names(merged)))
stopifnot(all(c("label", "vil_id", "lat", "lon") %in% names(vil_tbl)))
stopifnot("ASV" %in% names(asv_pa))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Theme / settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("base_theme")) {
  base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title    = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.text     = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title  = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      legend.text   = element_text(size = 9)
    )
}

if (!exists("clu_pal")) {
  clu_pal <- c(
    "1" = "#4E79A7",
    "2" = "#E15759",
    "3" = "#59A14F",
    "4" = "#B07AA1"
  )
}

global_low_thr <- 20
vil_hi_thr     <- 50
halo_thr       <- 20

hc_method <- "average"
cluster_order_target <- c("1", "2", "3", "4")

leaf_label_size <- 9
strip_height_y  <- 0.24

PLOT_DIR <- "dendro_pattern_profiles_noclassification"
dir.create(PLOT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(PLOT_DIR, "all"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

safe_file <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("_+", "_", x)
  x
}

extract_vil_num <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", x)))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1.1) Prevalence bins / palette
#     - matched to the prevalence heatmap code
#     - dummy legend layer is used so all bins appear in per-ASV plots
# ---------------------------------------------------------
prev_bin_levels <- c("0", "0–<20", "20–<50", "50–<75", "75–100")

prev_bin_pal <- c(
  "0" = "grey95",
  "0–<20" = "grey80",
  "20–<50" = "#fee08b",
  "50–<75" = "#f46d43",
  "75–100" = "#a50026"
)

bin_prev_common <- function(prev) {
  out <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(prev) ~ NA_character_,
    prev == 0 ~ "0",
    prev > 0 & prev < 20 ~ "0–<20",
    prev >= 20 & prev < 50 ~ "20–<50",
    prev >= 50 & prev < 75 ~ "50–<75",
    prev >= 75 ~ "75–100",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
  factor(out, levels = prev_bin_levels)
}

extract_label_name <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- NA_character_

  out <- vapply(x, function(s) {
    if (is.na(s)) return("Unassigned")

    s2 <- trimws(s)

    get_rank <- function(pattern) {
      m <- regmatches(s2, regexpr(pattern, s2, perl = TRUE))
      if (length(m) == 1 && nchar(m) > 0) m else NA_character_
    }

    g <- get_rank("g__[^;|]*")
    f <- get_rank("f__[^;|]*")
    o <- get_rank("o__[^;|]*")
    c <- get_rank("c__[^;|]*")
    p <- get_rank("p__[^;|]*")
    d <- get_rank("d__[^;|]*")

    vals <- c(g, f, o, c, p, d)
    vals <- trimws(vals)
    vals[vals %in% c("g__", "f__", "o__", "c__", "p__", "d__", "")] <- NA_character_

    if (!is.na(vals[1]) && vals[1] %in% c("g__uncultured", "g__unknown", "g__unclassified")) {
      vals[1] <- NA_character_
    }

    lab <- dplyr::coalesce(vals[1], vals[2], vals[3], vals[4], vals[5], vals[6], "Unassigned")
    if (is.na(lab) || lab == "") "Unassigned" else lab
  }, character(1))

  out
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Metadata preparation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ASV_col <- names(asv_pa)[1]
sample_cols <- setdiff(names(asv_pa), c(ASV_col, "Taxon"))

meta_use <- merged %>%
  transmute(
    sampleid     = as.character(sampleid),
    village_name = as.character(village_name),
    cluster      = as.character(cluster)
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(sampleid %in% sample_cols)

if (nrow(meta_use) == 0) {
  stop("No shared samples were found between merged and asv_pa.")
}

vil_map_df <- vil_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    village_name = as.character(label),
    vil_id       = as.character(vil_id),
    lat          = as.numeric(lat),
    lon          = as.numeric(lon)
  ) %>%
  distinct()

meta_use <- meta_use %>%
  left_join(
    vil_map_df %>% select(village_name, vil_id) %>% distinct(),
    by = "village_name"
  )

if (any(is.na(meta_use$vil_id))) {
  warning("Some village_name values could not be matched to vil_tbl.")
}

village_cluster_tbl <- merged %>%
  transmute(
    village_name = as.character(village_name),
    cluster      = as.character(cluster)
  ) %>%
  distinct()

dup_vil_cluster <- village_cluster_tbl %>%
  count(village_name) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(dup_vil_cluster) > 0) {
  warning("Some village_name values map to multiple clusters. The first value will be used.")
  village_cluster_tbl <- village_cluster_tbl %>%
    group_by(village_name) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()
}

village_info_tbl <- vil_map_df %>%
  left_join(village_cluster_tbl, by = "village_name") %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = as.character(cluster),
    vil_num = extract_vil_num(vil_id)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2.1) Village label map preparation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (exists("order_tbl_core") && "village_name" %in% names(order_tbl_core)) {
  if ("village_lab" %in% names(order_tbl_core)) {
    village_lab_map <- order_tbl_core %>%
      transmute(
        village_name = as.character(village_name),
        village_lab = as.character(village_lab)
      ) %>%
      distinct()
  } else if ("vil_lab" %in% names(order_tbl_core)) {
    village_lab_map <- order_tbl_core %>%
      transmute(
        village_name = as.character(village_name),
        village_lab = as.character(vil_lab)
      ) %>%
      distinct()
  } else {
    village_lab_map <- vil_tbl %>%
      transmute(
        village_name = as.character(label),
        village_lab = as.character(vil_id)
      ) %>%
      distinct()
  }
} else {
  village_lab_map <- vil_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      village_name = as.character(label),
      village_lab = as.character(vil_id)
    ) %>%
    distinct()
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Haversine distance + dendrogram order
#    - prefer order_tbl_core if already available
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (exists("order_tbl_core") &&
    all(c("village_name", "dendro_order") %in% names(order_tbl_core))) {

  order_tbl <- order_tbl_core %>%
    mutate(village_name = as.character(village_name)) %>%
    {
      if ("village_lab" %in% names(.)) {
        mutate(., village_lab = as.character(village_lab))
      } else if ("vil_lab" %in% names(.)) {
        mutate(., village_lab = as.character(vil_lab))
      } else {
        left_join(., village_lab_map, by = "village_name")
      }
    } %>%
    left_join(
      village_info_tbl %>% select(village_name, vil_id, cluster, vil_num),
      by = "village_name",
      suffix = c("", "_info")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      vil_id = dplyr::coalesce(as.character(vil_id), as.character(vil_id_info)),
      cluster = dplyr::coalesce(as.character(cluster), as.character(cluster_info)),
      vil_num = dplyr::coalesce(as.numeric(vil_num), as.numeric(vil_num_info)),
      village_lab = ifelse(is.na(village_lab) | village_lab == "", vil_id, village_lab)
    ) %>%
    select(village_name, dendro_order, vil_id, cluster, vil_num, village_lab) %>%
    distinct(village_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    arrange(dendro_order)

  vil_cent_df <- vil_map_df %>%
    distinct(village_name, vil_id, lon, lat)

  dist_mat <- geodist::geodist(
    x = vil_cent_df %>% select(lon, lat),
    measure = "haversine"
  ) / 1000

  rownames(dist_mat) <- vil_cent_df$village_name
  colnames(dist_mat) <- vil_cent_df$village_name

  hc_raw <- hclust(as.dist(dist_mat), method = hc_method)
  dend_raw <- as.dendrogram(hc_raw)

  if (has_dendsort) {
    dend_raw <- dendsort::dendsort(dend_raw)
  }

  desired_leaf_order <- order_tbl %>%
    arrange(dendro_order) %>%
    pull(village_name)

  if (has_dendextend) {
    dend_ord <- dendextend::rotate(dend_raw, order = desired_leaf_order)
  } else {
    warning("Package 'dendextend' is not available; using reorder() instead. Final leaf order may not match exactly.")
    leaf_order_tbl <- labels(dend_raw) %>%
      tibble::tibble(village_name = .) %>%
      left_join(village_info_tbl, by = "village_name") %>%
      mutate(
        cluster_rank = match(cluster, cluster_order_target),
        cluster_rank = ifelse(is.na(cluster_rank), 999, cluster_rank),
        vil_num = ifelse(is.na(vil_num), Inf, vil_num)
      )

    weight_vec <- leaf_order_tbl$cluster_rank * 10000 + leaf_order_tbl$vil_num
    names(weight_vec) <- leaf_order_tbl$village_name
    dend_ord <- reorder(dend_raw, wts = weight_vec, agglo.FUN = mean)
  }

} else {

  vil_cent_df <- vil_map_df %>%
    distinct(village_name, vil_id, lon, lat)

  dist_mat <- geodist::geodist(
    x = vil_cent_df %>% select(lon, lat),
    measure = "haversine"
  ) / 1000

  rownames(dist_mat) <- vil_cent_df$village_name
  colnames(dist_mat) <- vil_cent_df$village_name

  hc_raw <- hclust(as.dist(dist_mat), method = hc_method)
  dend_raw <- as.dendrogram(hc_raw)

  if (has_dendsort) {
    dend_raw <- dendsort::dendsort(dend_raw)
  }

  leaf_order_tbl <- labels(dend_raw) %>%
    tibble(village_name = .) %>%
    left_join(village_info_tbl, by = "village_name") %>%
    mutate(
      cluster_rank = match(cluster, cluster_order_target),
      cluster_rank = ifelse(is.na(cluster_rank), 999, cluster_rank),
      vil_num = ifelse(is.na(vil_num), Inf, vil_num)
    )

  desired_leaf_order <- leaf_order_tbl %>%
    arrange(cluster_rank, vil_num, village_name) %>%
    pull(village_name)

  if (has_dendextend) {
    dend_ord <- dendextend::rotate(dend_raw, order = desired_leaf_order)
  } else {
    warning("Package 'dendextend' is not available; using reorder() instead. Final leaf order may not match exactly.")
    weight_vec <- leaf_order_tbl$cluster_rank * 10000 + leaf_order_tbl$vil_num
    names(weight_vec) <- leaf_order_tbl$village_name
    dend_ord <- reorder(dend_raw, wts = weight_vec, agglo.FUN = mean)
  }

  dend_labels_final <- labels(dend_ord)

  order_tbl <- tibble(
    village_name = dend_labels_final,
    dendro_order = seq_along(dend_labels_final)
  ) %>%
    left_join(
      village_info_tbl %>% select(village_name, vil_id, cluster, vil_num),
      by = "village_name"
    ) %>%
    left_join(village_lab_map, by = "village_name") %>%
    mutate(
      village_lab = ifelse(is.na(village_lab) | village_lab == "", vil_id, village_lab)
    )
}

dend_dat <- ggdendro::dendro_data(dend_ord, type = "rectangle")

leaf_lab_tbl <- dend_dat$labels %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(village_name = label) %>%
  left_join(order_tbl, by = "village_name") %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = names(clu_pal))) %>%
  arrange(x)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Optional ASV labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (exists("asv_tax") && all(c("ASV", "Taxon") %in% names(asv_tax))) {
  asv_label_tbl <- asv_tax %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = as.character(ASV),
      Genus = extract_label_name(Taxon)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus) | Genus == "", "Unassigned", Genus),
      ASV_lab = paste0(Genus, " | ", ASV)
    ) %>%
    distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)
} else if ("Taxon" %in% names(asv_pa)) {
  asv_label_tbl <- asv_pa %>%
    select(ASV = all_of(ASV_col), Taxon) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = as.character(ASV),
      ASV_lab = paste0(extract_label_name(Taxon), " | ", ASV)
    )
} else {
  asv_label_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
    ASV = unique(asv_pa[[ASV_col]]),
    ASV_lab = unique(asv_pa[[ASV_col]])
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) PA long and prevalence
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_pa_sub <- asv_pa %>%
  select(ASV = all_of(ASV_col), all_of(meta_use$sampleid)) %>%
  mutate(across(-ASV, ~ as.integer(replace_na(.x, 0) > 0)))

pa_long <- asv_pa_sub %>%
  pivot_longer(-ASV, names_to = "sampleid", values_to = "pres") %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    pres = as.integer(pres)
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_use, by = "sampleid") %>%
  filter(!is.na(village_name), !is.na(vil_id), !is.na(cluster))

global_prev_tbl <- pa_long %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    global_prev = mean(pres, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

prev_vil <- pa_long %>%
  group_by(ASV, village_name, vil_id, cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_village = n(),
    n_detected = sum(pres, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev = mean(pres, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    order_tbl %>% select(village_name, dendro_order, village_lab),
    by = "village_name"
  )

full_grid <- expand.grid(
  ASV = unique(prev_vil$ASV),
  village_name = order_tbl %>% arrange(dendro_order) %>% pull(village_name),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  left_join(order_tbl, by = "village_name")

prev_vil_full <- full_grid %>%
  left_join(
    prev_vil,
    by = c("ASV", "village_name", "vil_id", "dendro_order", "village_lab")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = ifelse(is.na(cluster.x), cluster.y, cluster.x),
    n_village = ifelse(is.na(n_village), 0L, n_village),
    n_detected = ifelse(is.na(n_detected), 0L, n_detected),
    prev = ifelse(is.na(prev), 0, prev)
  ) %>%
  select(-cluster.x, -cluster.y)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Candidate ASVs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
candidate_tbl <- prev_vil_full %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    max_vil = max(prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(global_prev_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  filter(global_prev <= global_low_thr, max_vil >= vil_hi_thr)

candidate_asv <- candidate_tbl$ASV
message("Candidate ASVs = ", length(candidate_asv))

# 7) Plot panels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_leaf_strip_panel <- function(show_labels = TRUE) {
  strip_df <- leaf_lab_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      y_strip = 0.92,
      h_strip = strip_height_y,
      y_text = 0.22
    )

  ggplot(strip_df, aes(x = x)) +
    geom_tile(
      aes(y = y_strip, fill = cluster),
      width = 0.98,
      height = strip_df$h_strip[1],
      show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    {
      if (show_labels) {
        geom_text(
          aes(y = y_text, label = village_lab),
          angle = 90,
          size = leaf_label_size / 2.8,
          vjust = 0.5,
          hjust = 0.3
        )
      }
    } +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = clu_pal,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = "Cluster"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = leaf_lab_tbl$x,
      labels = NULL,
      expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1.25),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 5.5, b = 12, l = 5.5),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

make_tree_panel <- function() {
  max_y <- max(dend_dat$segments$y, dend_dat$segments$yend, na.rm = TRUE)

  ggplot() +
    geom_segment(
      data = dend_dat$segments,
      aes(
        x = x,
        y = max_y - y,
        xend = xend,
        yend = max_y - yend
      ),
      linewidth = 0.35,
      color = "grey25"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = leaf_lab_tbl$x,
      labels = NULL,
      expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Height") +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 5.5, b = 5.5, l = 5.5),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Plot function
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_one_asv_pattern <- function(asv_id,
                                 prev_tbl = prev_vil_full,
                                 global_tbl = global_prev_tbl,
                                 label_tbl = asv_label_tbl,
                                 show_dend_labels = TRUE) {

  df_a <- prev_tbl %>%
    filter(ASV == asv_id) %>%
    arrange(dendro_order) %>%
    left_join(
      leaf_lab_tbl %>% select(village_name, x),
      by = "village_name"
    )

  if (nrow(df_a) == 0) return(NULL)

  gp <- global_tbl %>%
    filter(ASV == asv_id) %>%
    pull(global_prev)
  if (length(gp) == 0) gp <- NA_real_

  lb <- label_tbl %>%
    filter(ASV == asv_id) %>%
    pull(ASV_lab)
  if (length(lb) == 0) lb <- as.character(asv_id)

  srt <- sort(df_a$prev, decreasing = TRUE)
  max_vil <- ifelse(length(srt) >= 1, srt[1], NA_real_)
  second_vil <- ifelse(length(srt) >= 2, srt[2], 0)
  delta <- max_vil - second_vil
  n_peak50 <- sum(df_a$prev >= vil_hi_thr, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_ge20 <- sum(df_a$prev >= halo_thr, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_ge75 <- sum(df_a$prev >= 75, na.rm = TRUE)

  subtitle_txt <- paste0(
    "global=", sprintf("%.1f", gp),
    " | max=", sprintf("%.1f", max_vil),
    " | delta=", sprintf("%.1f", delta),
    " | n(vil>=50)=", n_peak50,
    " | n(vil>=75)=", n_ge75,
    " | n(vil>=20)=", n_ge20
  )

  df_a <- df_a %>%
    mutate(
      prev_bin = factor(bin_prev_common(prev), levels = prev_bin_levels)
    )

  # Dummy legend layer:
  # Ensures all prevalence bins are present in the legend
  # even if some bins are absent for this ASV.
  legend_dummy_df <- tibble(
    x = df_a$x[1],
    y = 0,
    prev_bin = factor(prev_bin_levels, levels = prev_bin_levels)
  )

  p_bar <- ggplot(df_a, aes(x = x, y = prev)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = prev_bin), width = 0.86, color = NA) +
    geom_point(
      data = legend_dummy_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y, fill = prev_bin),
      shape = 22,
      size = 0,
      alpha = 0,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = vil_hi_thr, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.5, color = "#b2182b") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = halo_thr, linetype = 3, linewidth = 0.5, color = "#ef8a62") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = gp, linetype = 3, linewidth = 0.5, color = "#2166ac") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = prev_bin_pal,
      limits = prev_bin_levels,
      breaks = prev_bin_levels,
      drop = FALSE,
      na.translate = FALSE,
      name = "Village prevalence (%)"
    ) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(
        title = "Village prevalence (%)",
        override.aes = list(
          alpha = 1,
          size = 5,
          shape = 22,
          color = NA
        )
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = leaf_lab_tbl$x,
      labels = leaf_lab_tbl$village_lab,
      expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
    labs(
      title = lb,
      subtitle = subtitle_txt,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Prevalence (%)"
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(t = 5.5, r = 5.5, b = 0, l = 5.5),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  p_strip <- make_leaf_strip_panel(show_labels = show_dend_labels)
  p_tree <- make_tree_panel()

  p_bar / p_strip / p_tree + plot_layout(heights = c(3.2, 0.8, 1.1))
}

asv_order <- candidate_tbl %>%

for (i in seq_along(asv_order)) {
```

#node score calculation 
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
})

# =========================================================
# Node score for candidate_asv only
# - uses objects already created in the prevalence-profile pipeline:
#     prev_vil_full, dend_ord, candidate_asv, order_tbl_core
# - version without village_name in output
# - version without n_leaf weighting:
#     final_node_score = node_mean * compactness
#
# Scoring terminology:
#   score 3   = majority-prevalence village, prevalence >= 50%
#   score 2   = intermediate-prevalence village, prevalence 20-<50%
#   score 0.5 = low-level detection, prevalence >0-<20%
#   score 0   = absence, prevalence = 0%
#
# Note:
#   Villages with prevalence >=75% are included in the >=50% category
#   for village-enriched ASV node scoring.
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs2 <- c(
  "prev_vil_full",
  "dend_ord",
  "candidate_asv",
  "candidate_tbl",
  "asv_label_tbl",
  "order_tbl_core"
)

miss2 <- need_objs2[!vapply(need_objs2, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss2)) {
  stop("Required objects are missing: ", paste(miss2, collapse = ", "))
}

stopifnot(all(c("village_name", "dendro_order") %in% names(order_tbl_core)))

message("candidate_asv count = ", length(candidate_asv))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Scoring rules
# ---------------------------------------------------------
score_prev <- function(prev,
                       halo_thr = 20,
                       hi_thr = 50,
                       grey_score = 0.5) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(prev)      ~ 0,
    prev >= hi_thr   ~ 3,
    prev >= halo_thr ~ 2,
    prev > 0         ~ grey_score,
    TRUE             ~ 0
  )
}

positive_from_score <- function(score) {
  as.integer(score >= 2)   # majority- or intermediate-prevalence villages
}

longest_run_ones <- function(x) {
  x <- as.integer(x)
  if (length(x) == 0) return(0L)
  rr <- rle(x)
  if (!any(rr$values == 1)) return(0L)
  max(rr$lengths[rr$values == 1])
}

count_positive_blocks <- function(x) {
  x <- as.integer(x)
  if (length(x) == 0) return(0L)
  rr <- rle(x)
  sum(rr$values == 1)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Internal node -> descendant leaves
# ---------------------------------------------------------
get_internal_descendants <- function(dend) {
  out <- list()
  node_id <- 0L
  labs <- labels(dend)

  assign_leaf_idx <- function(x) {
    if (is.leaf(x)) {
      attr(x, "leaf_index") <- match(attr(x, "label"), labs)
      return(x)
    } else {
      for (i in seq_along(x)) {
        x[[i]] <- assign_leaf_idx(x[[i]])
      }
      return(x)
    }
  }

  walk_dend <- function(x) {
    if (is.leaf(x)) {
      return(attr(x, "leaf_index"))
    } else {
      child_idx <- unlist(lapply(x, walk_dend), use.names = FALSE)
      node_id <<- node_id + 1L
      out[[paste0("node", node_id)]] <<- sort(unique(child_idx))
      return(child_idx)
    }
  }

  dend2 <- assign_leaf_idx(dend)
  walk_dend(dend2)
  out
}

internal_nodes <- get_internal_descendants(dend_ord)

leaf_order <- order_tbl_core %>%
  select(village_name, dendro_order) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(dendro_order) %>%
  pull(village_name)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Score one ASV across all internal nodes
# ---------------------------------------------------------
calc_one_asv_nodes <- function(asv_id,
                               prev_tbl = prev_vil_full,
                               internal_nodes,
                               leaf_order,
                               halo_thr = 20,
                               hi_thr = 50,
                               grey_score = 0.5) {

  df_asv <- prev_tbl %>%
    filter(ASV == asv_id) %>%
    select(any_of(c(
      "ASV", "village_name", "vil_id", "village_lab",
      "cluster", "dendro_order", "prev"
    ))) %>%
    distinct(village_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    right_join(
      tibble(
        village_name = leaf_order,
        leaf_index = seq_along(leaf_order)
      ),
      by = "village_name"
    ) %>%
    arrange(leaf_index)

  if (nrow(df_asv) == 0) return(NULL)

  if (!"prev" %in% names(df_asv)) df_asv$prev <- 0
  df_asv$prev[is.na(df_asv$prev)] <- 0

  for (nm in c("vil_id", "village_lab", "cluster", "dendro_order")) {
    if (!nm %in% names(df_asv)) df_asv[[nm]] <- NA
  }

  df_asv <- df_asv %>%
    mutate(
      leaf_score = score_prev(
        prev,
        halo_thr = halo_thr,
        hi_thr = hi_thr,
        grey_score = grey_score
      ),
      positive = positive_from_score(leaf_score)
    )

  node_tbl <- purrr::imap_dfr(internal_nodes, function(idx, node_name) {
    sub <- df_asv[idx, , drop = FALSE]

    scores <- sub$leaf_score
    pos <- sub$positive

    n_leaf       <- length(scores)
    n_positive   <- sum(pos, na.rm = TRUE)
    longest_run  <- longest_run_ones(pos)
    n_blocks     <- count_positive_blocks(pos)
    node_mean    <- mean(scores, na.rm = TRUE)
    compactness  <- ifelse(n_positive < 2, 0, longest_run / n_positive)

    final_score  <- node_mean * compactness

    tibble(
      ASV = asv_id,
      node = node_name,

      n_leaf = n_leaf,
      n_positive = n_positive,
      longest_run = longest_run,
      n_blocks = n_blocks,

      node_mean = node_mean,
      compactness = compactness,
      final_node_score = final_score,

      n_majority_ge50 = sum(scores == 3, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_intermediate_20_49 = sum(scores == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_low_detection_0_19 = sum(scores == grey_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_absent = sum(scores == 0, na.rm = TRUE),

      leaf_start = min(idx),
      leaf_end = max(idx),

      village_labs = paste(ifelse(is.na(sub$village_lab), sub$vil_id, sub$village_lab), collapse = ","),
      prev_values = paste(sprintf("%.1f", sub$prev), collapse = ","),
      score_values = paste(scores, collapse = ","),
      positive_pattern = paste(pos, collapse = ",")
    )
  })

  leaf_tbl <- df_asv %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = asv_id,
      leaf_index,
      village_lab,
      vil_id,
      cluster,
      prev,
      leaf_score,
      positive,
      prevalence_category = case_when(
        leaf_score == 3 ~ "majority_ge50",
        leaf_score == 2 ~ "intermediate_20_49",
        leaf_score == grey_score ~ "low_detection_0_19",
        leaf_score == 0 ~ "absent",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  list(
    node_tbl = node_tbl,
    leaf_tbl = leaf_tbl
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Run only for candidate ASVs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
target_asv <- intersect(unique(candidate_asv), unique(prev_vil_full$ASV))
message("Target ASVs used for node scoring = ", length(target_asv))

res_list <- purrr::map(
  target_asv,
  ~ calc_one_asv_nodes(
    asv_id = .x,
    prev_tbl = prev_vil_full,
    internal_nodes = internal_nodes,
    leaf_order = leaf_order,
    halo_thr = 20,
    hi_thr = 50,
    grey_score = 0.5
  )
)

valid_idx <- !purrr::map_lgl(res_list, is.null)
res_list <- res_list[valid_idx]

node_score_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(res_list, "node_tbl")
leaf_score_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(res_list, "leaf_tbl")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) ASV summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_summary_tbl <- node_score_tbl %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    df <- .x

    max_score <- max(df$final_node_score, na.rm = TRUE)

    tied_df <- df %>%
      filter(final_node_score == max_score)

    best_row <- tied_df %>%
      arrange(
        desc(n_positive),
        desc(compactness),
        desc(node_mean),
        desc(n_leaf),
        node
      ) %>%
      slice(1)

    tibble(
      max_node_score = max_score,
      sum_node_score = sum(df$final_node_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_node_score = mean(df$final_node_score, na.rm = TRUE),

      n_best_nodes = nrow(tied_df),
      best_nodes_all = paste(tied_df$node, collapse = ","),
      best_node = best_row$node,

      best_node_size = best_row$n_leaf,
      best_node_n_positive = best_row$n_positive,
      best_node_compactness = best_row$compactness,
      best_node_mean = best_row$node_mean,
      best_leaf_start = best_row$leaf_start,
      best_leaf_end = best_row$leaf_end,
      best_village_labs = best_row$village_labs,
      best_prev_values = best_row$prev_values,
      best_score_values = best_row$score_values,
      best_positive_pattern = best_row$positive_pattern,

      best_node_n_majority_ge50 = best_row$n_majority_ge50,
      best_node_n_intermediate_20_49 = best_row$n_intermediate_20_49,
      best_node_n_low_detection_0_19 = best_row$n_low_detection_0_19,
      best_node_n_absent = best_row$n_absent,

      n_nodes_scored = nrow(df),
      n_nodes_positive = sum(df$n_positive >= 2, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

leaf_summary_tbl <- leaf_score_tbl %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    max_leaf_score = max(leaf_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_majority_ge50_leaf = sum(leaf_score == 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_intermediate_20_49_leaf = sum(leaf_score == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_low_detection_0_19_leaf = sum(leaf_score == 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_positive_leaf = sum(positive == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_absent_leaf = sum(leaf_score == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

asv_summary_tbl <- asv_summary_tbl %>%
  left_join(leaf_summary_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  left_join(candidate_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  left_join(asv_label_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  arrange(desc(max_node_score), desc(sum_node_score), ASV)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Export tables
# - supplementary: ASV-level summary
# - derived: node- and leaf-level scoring tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
readr::write_csv(
  node_score_tbl,
  "derived_candidate_node_score_table_noNleafWeight.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  leaf_score_tbl,
  "derived_candidate_leaf_score_table_noNleafWeight.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  asv_summary_tbl,
  "supplementary_candidate_asv_summary_localsharing_noNleafWeight.csv"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Quick view
# ---------------------------------------------------------
print(
  asv_summary_tbl %>%
    select(
      ASV, ASV_lab,
      max_node_score, sum_node_score,
      best_node_size, best_node_n_positive,
      best_node_n_majority_ge50,
      best_node_n_intermediate_20_49,
      best_node_n_low_detection_0_19,
      n_majority_ge50_leaf,
      n_intermediate_20_49_leaf,
      n_low_detection_0_19_leaf,
      n_positive_leaf,
      best_village_labs, best_score_values,
      best_positive_pattern, global_prev, max_vil
    ),
  n = 20
)
```

#target node asv list 
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
})

# =========================================================
# Function: get top ASVs for a user-specified node
# Required:
#   node_score_tbl
# Optional:
#   asv_label_tbl
#
# Compatible with updated node_score_tbl column names:
#   n_majority_ge50
#   n_intermediate_20_49
#   n_low_detection_0_19
#   n_absent
# =========================================================

if (!exists("node_score_tbl")) {
  stop("Required object is missing: node_score_tbl")
}

get_top_asv_for_node <- function(target_node,
                                 node_tbl = node_score_tbl,
                                 label_tbl = if (exists("asv_label_tbl")) asv_label_tbl else NULL,
                                 min_target_score = 0,
                                 min_n_positive = 2,
                                 top_n = 30) {

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 0) Basic checks
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(node_tbl))

  required_cols <- c(
    "node", "ASV", "final_node_score",
    "n_leaf", "n_positive", "longest_run",
    "n_blocks", "node_mean", "compactness",
    "leaf_start", "leaf_end",
    "village_labs", "prev_values",
    "score_values", "positive_pattern"
  )

  missing_required <- setdiff(required_cols, names(node_tbl))
  if (length(missing_required) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Required columns are missing in node_tbl: ",
      paste(missing_required, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 0.1) Backward-compatible column standardization
  #      - supports old red/yellow/grey/none names if needed
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  node_tbl <- node_tbl %>%
    {
      if (!"n_majority_ge50" %in% names(.) && "n_red" %in% names(.)) {
        rename(., n_majority_ge50 = n_red)
      } else {
        .
      }
    } %>%
    {
      if (!"n_intermediate_20_49" %in% names(.) && "n_yellow" %in% names(.)) {
        rename(., n_intermediate_20_49 = n_yellow)
      } else {
        .
      }
    } %>%
    {
      if (!"n_low_detection_0_19" %in% names(.) && "n_grey" %in% names(.)) {
        rename(., n_low_detection_0_19 = n_grey)
      } else {
        .
      }
    } %>%
    {
      if (!"n_absent" %in% names(.) && "n_none" %in% names(.)) {
        rename(., n_absent = n_none)
      } else {
        .
      }
    }

  optional_count_cols <- c(
    "n_majority_ge50",
    "n_intermediate_20_49",
    "n_low_detection_0_19",
    "n_absent"
  )

  missing_count_cols <- setdiff(optional_count_cols, names(node_tbl))
  if (length(missing_count_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Node prevalence-count columns are missing in node_tbl: ",
      paste(missing_count_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 1) Normalize node input
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  target_node_chr <- as.character(target_node)

  if (!target_node_chr %in% unique(node_tbl$node)) {
    stop("The requested node was not found in node_score_tbl$node: ", target_node_chr)
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 2) Rows for the target node
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  target_df <- node_tbl %>%
    filter(node == target_node_chr) %>%
    rename(
      target_score = final_node_score,
      target_n_leaf = n_leaf,
      target_n_positive = n_positive,
      target_longest_run = longest_run,
      target_n_blocks = n_blocks,
      target_node_mean = node_mean,
      target_compactness = compactness,
      target_n_majority_ge50 = n_majority_ge50,
      target_n_intermediate_20_49 = n_intermediate_20_49,
      target_n_low_detection_0_19 = n_low_detection_0_19,
      target_n_absent = n_absent,
      target_leaf_start = leaf_start,
      target_leaf_end = leaf_end,
      target_village_labs = village_labs,
      target_prev_values = prev_values,
      target_score_values = score_values,
      target_positive_pattern = positive_pattern
    )

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 3) ASV-wise ranking and contrast
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  rank_tbl <- node_tbl %>%
    group_by(ASV) %>%
    arrange(desc(final_node_score), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      node_rank_within_asv = row_number()
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  target_rank_tbl <- rank_tbl %>%
    filter(node == target_node_chr) %>%
    select(ASV, node_rank_within_asv)

  other_best_tbl <- node_tbl %>%
    filter(node != target_node_chr) %>%
    group_by(ASV) %>%
    summarise(
      best_other_score = max(final_node_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      best_other_node = node[which.max(final_node_score)],
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  best_overall_tbl <- node_tbl %>%
    group_by(ASV) %>%
    summarise(
      best_overall_score = max(final_node_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      best_overall_node = node[which.max(final_node_score)],
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 4) Merge and derive contrast metrics
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  out <- target_df %>%
    left_join(target_rank_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
    left_join(other_best_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
    left_join(best_overall_tbl, by = "ASV")

  if (!is.null(label_tbl) && all(c("ASV", "ASV_lab") %in% names(label_tbl))) {
    out <- out %>%
      left_join(label_tbl %>% select(ASV, ASV_lab), by = "ASV")
  }

  out <- out %>%
    mutate(
      best_other_score = ifelse(is.na(best_other_score), 0, best_other_score),
      contrast_diff = target_score - best_other_score,
      contrast_ratio = ifelse(best_other_score > 0, target_score / best_other_score, Inf),
      is_best_node_for_asv = (best_overall_node == target_node_chr)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      target_score > min_target_score,
      target_n_positive >= min_n_positive
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(is_best_node_for_asv),
      desc(target_score),
      desc(contrast_diff),
      node_rank_within_asv,
      ASV
    ) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n)

  out
}
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tibble)
  library(patchwork)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# HEATMAP: ASV x all nodes
# - node ordering is based on bottom-up node level
#   level 1 = node directly joining two leaves
#   level 2 = node joining level-1 nodes
#   ...
#
# Required objects:
#   node_score_tbl
#   asv_summary_tbl
#   dend_ord
#   base_theme
#   save_plot_both()
#
# Output:
#   candidate_allnode_heatmap_byBottomupLevel.png/.svg
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs3 <- c("node_score_tbl", "asv_summary_tbl", "dend_ord", "base_theme", "save_plot_both")
miss3 <- need_objs3[!vapply(need_objs3, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss3)) {
  stop("Required objects are missing: ", paste(miss3, collapse = ", "))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Bottom-up node level
#    level 1 = pair node
# ---------------------------------------------------------
get_internal_node_levels_bottomup <- function(dend) {
  out <- list()
  node_id <- 0L
  labs <- labels(dend)

  assign_leaf_idx <- function(x) {
    if (is.leaf(x)) {
      attr(x, "leaf_index") <- match(attr(x, "label"), labs)
      return(x)
    } else {
      for (i in seq_along(x)) {
        x[[i]] <- assign_leaf_idx(x[[i]])
      }
      return(x)
    }
  }

  walk_dend <- function(x) {
    if (is.leaf(x)) {
      return(list(
        leaf_idx = attr(x, "leaf_index"),
        level = 0L
      ))
    } else {
      child_info <- lapply(x, walk_dend)
      child_idx  <- unlist(lapply(child_info, `[[`, "leaf_idx"), use.names = FALSE)
      child_lev  <- unlist(lapply(child_info, `[[`, "level"), use.names = FALSE)

      this_level <- max(child_lev) + 1L

      node_id <<- node_id + 1L
      out[[paste0("node", node_id)]] <<- tibble(
        node = paste0("node", node_id),
        node_level = this_level
      )

      return(list(
        leaf_idx = child_idx,
        level = this_level
      ))
    }
  }

  dend2 <- assign_leaf_idx(dend)
  walk_dend(dend2)

  bind_rows(out)
}

node_level_tbl <- get_internal_node_levels_bottomup(dend_ord)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Node metadata for column order
#    ordering: node_level -> leaf_start -> leaf_end -> node
# ---------------------------------------------------------
node_meta <- node_score_tbl %>%
  group_by(node) %>%
  summarise(
    n_leaf = first(n_leaf),
    leaf_start = first(leaf_start),
    leaf_end = first(leaf_end),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(node_level_tbl, by = "node") %>%
  arrange(node_level, leaf_start, leaf_end, node) %>%
  mutate(
    node_order = row_number()
  )

node_levels <- node_meta$node

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) ASV row order
#    default: descending sum_node_score
# ---------------------------------------------------------
row_meta <- asv_summary_tbl %>%
  arrange(desc(sum_node_score), desc(max_node_score), ASV) %>%
  mutate(
    asv_order = row_number(),
    ASV_lab = dplyr::coalesce(ASV_lab, ASV)
  )

asv_levels <- row_meta$ASV

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Heatmap dataframe
# ---------------------------------------------------------
heat_df <- node_score_tbl %>%
  select(ASV, node, final_node_score) %>%
  left_join(
    node_meta %>% select(node, node_order, n_leaf, node_level, leaf_start, leaf_end),
    by = "node"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    row_meta %>% select(ASV, asv_order, ASV_lab),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    node = factor(node, levels = node_levels),
    ASV = factor(ASV, levels = asv_levels)
  )

heat_df$ASV_lab <- factor(
  heat_df$ASV_lab,
  levels = row_meta$ASV_lab[match(asv_levels, row_meta$ASV)]
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Top annotation for node level
# ---------------------------------------------------------
anno_df <- node_meta %>%
  transmute(
    node = factor(node, levels = node_levels),
    x = factor(node, levels = node_levels),
    node_level = factor(node_level, levels = sort(unique(node_level)))
  )

levs <- levels(anno_df$node_level)
level_cols <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(c("#FEE8C8", "#E34A33"))(length(levs)),
  levs
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Optional level boundary positions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
level_boundary_df <- node_meta %>%
  group_by(node_level) %>%
  summarise(
    xmin = min(node_order) - 0.5,
    xmax = max(node_order) + 0.5,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

vline_pos <- level_boundary_df$xmax[-nrow(level_boundary_df)]

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Heatmap plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_heat <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = node, y = ASV_lab, fill = final_node_score)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = vline_pos, color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.35) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    name = "Node score"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "All internal nodes (ordered by bottom-up node level)",
    y = "Village-enriched ASVs"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 12),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 5.5, b = 5.5, l = 5.5)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Top annotation plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_anno <- ggplot(anno_df, aes(x = x, y = 1, fill = node_level)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = vline_pos, color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.35) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = level_cols,
    name = "Bottom-up\nnode level",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5.5, r = 5.5, b = 0, l = 5.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Combine
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_allnode_heatmap <- p_anno / p_heat + plot_layout(heights = c(0.25, 6))

print(p_allnode_heatmap)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Save
# ---------------------------------------------------------
save_plot_both(
  p_allnode_heatmap,
  "candidate_allnode_heatmap_byBottomupLevel",
  width = 18,
  height = 14
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Export tables
# - derived: row/column metadata used for the heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(
  node_meta,
  "derived_candidate_allnode_heatmap_colmeta_byBottomupLevel.csv"
)

write_csv(
  row_meta,
  "derived_candidate_allnode_heatmap_rowmeta.csv"
)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Summary scatter with compact_mass_ratio
# - one point = one ASV
# - x = sum_node_score
# - y = max_node_score
# - size = best_node_size (log-scaled for plotting)
# - color = compact_mass_ratio
#
# compact_mass_ratio =
#   sum of node scores from compact nodes / total sum_node_score
#
# compact node definition:
#   compactness >= compact_thr AND n_positive >= min_compact_positive
#
# Required:
#   asv_summary_tbl
#   node_score_tbl
#   base_theme
#   save_plot_both()
#
# Output:
#   candidate_summary_scatter_compactMassRatio.png/.svg
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs <- c("asv_summary_tbl", "node_score_tbl", "base_theme", "save_plot_both")
miss <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss)) {
  stop("Required objects are missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Parameters
# ---------------------------------------------------------
compact_thr <- 0.8
min_compact_positive <- 2

# Label filter
min_best_node_size <- 4
max_best_node_size <- 20
min_best_node_n_positive <- 3
min_best_node_compactness <- 0.5
top_n_label <- 15

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Compact-node summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
compact_summary_tbl <- node_score_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    is_compact_node = compactness >= compact_thr & n_positive >= min_compact_positive
  ) %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    n_compact_nodes = sum(is_compact_node, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_compact_node_score = sum(final_node_score[is_compact_node], na.rm = TRUE),
    max_compact_node_score = ifelse(
      any(is_compact_node),
      max(final_node_score[is_compact_node], na.rm = TRUE),
      0
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Prepare plotting table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_df <- asv_summary_tbl %>%
  left_join(compact_summary_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    n_compact_nodes = replace_na(n_compact_nodes, 0L),
    sum_compact_node_score = replace_na(sum_compact_node_score, 0),
    max_compact_node_score = replace_na(max_compact_node_score, 0),
    concentration = ifelse(sum_node_score > 0, max_node_score / sum_node_score, NA_real_),
    compact_mass_ratio = ifelse(sum_node_score > 0, sum_compact_node_score / sum_node_score, 0),
    best_node_size_plot = log2(best_node_size + 1),
    ASV_lab_plot = dplyr::coalesce(ASV_lab, ASV)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(sum_node_score),
    is.finite(max_node_score),
    is.finite(best_node_size_plot),
    is.finite(compact_mass_ratio)
  )

if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
  stop("No valid data are available for the scatter plot. Please check the score/size/color variables.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Label rule with filters
# ---------------------------------------------------------
label_df <- plot_df %>%
  filter(
    best_node_size >= min_best_node_size,
    best_node_size <= max_best_node_size,
    best_node_n_positive >= min_best_node_n_positive,
    best_node_compactness >= min_best_node_compactness
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(max_node_score),
    desc(compact_mass_ratio),
    desc(sum_node_score),
    desc(best_node_size),
    ASV
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n_label)

if (nrow(label_df) < 5) {
  message("Too few ASVs passed the strict labeling criteria. Using relaxed criteria instead.")
  label_df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(
      best_node_size >= 3,
      best_node_size <= 30,
      best_node_n_positive >= 2,
      best_node_compactness >= 0.33
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(max_node_score),
      desc(compact_mass_ratio),
      desc(sum_node_score),
      desc(best_node_size),
      ASV
    ) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n_label)
}

label_df <- label_df %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(sum_node_score),
    is.finite(max_node_score),
    is.finite(best_node_size_plot),
    is.finite(compact_mass_ratio)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Scatter plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_scatter <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = sum_node_score,
    y = max_node_score,
    size = best_node_size_plot,
    color = compact_mass_ratio
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Best node size",
    range = c(2.5, 9),
    breaks = log2(c(2, 5, 10, 20, 40, 80) + 1),
    labels = c(2, 5, 10, 20, 40, 80)
  ) +
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "#FEE8C8",
    high = "#B2182B",
    limits = c(0, 1),
    name = "Compact mass ratio"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Node-score summary across village-enriched ASVs",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Compact node: compactness >= ", compact_thr,
      " and n_positive >= ", min_compact_positive
    ),
    x = "Sum node score",
    y = "Max node score"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

if (nrow(label_df) > 0) {
  p_scatter <- p_scatter +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(label = ASV_lab_plot),
      size = 4,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      segment.size = 0.25,
      segment.color = "black",
      segment.alpha = 0.8,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      show.legend = FALSE
    )
}

print(p_scatter)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Save
# ---------------------------------------------------------
save_plot_both(
  p_scatter,
  "candidate_summary_scatter_compactMassRatio",
  width = 11,
  height = 8
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Export table
# - supplementary: source data for the summary scatter
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(
  plot_df %>%
    select(
      ASV, ASV_lab_plot,
      max_node_score, sum_node_score, mean_node_score,
      best_node, best_node_size, best_node_n_positive, best_node_compactness,
      n_compact_nodes, sum_compact_node_score, max_compact_node_score,
      compact_mass_ratio, concentration
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(max_node_score), desc(compact_mass_ratio), desc(sum_node_score), ASV),
  "supplementary_candidate_summary_scatter_compactMassRatio_table.csv"
)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Rule-based subtype classification using node level
#
# Final priority rule:
#   Regional > Nearby > Single
#
# Core interpretation:
# - majority-prevalence village:
#     village-level prevalence >= 50%, leaf score = 3
# - positive village:
#     village-level prevalence >= 20%, leaf score >= 2
# - nearby/regional sharing must include at least one
#   majority-prevalence village within a contiguous positive run
# - final subtype is assigned by the largest sharing scale detected
#
# Node-type definitions
#
# 1) Single-village node
#    - an isolated majority-prevalence village exists in the node
#    - the majority-prevalence village is NOT part of a contiguous
#      positive run of length >= 2
#
# 2) Nearby-village node
#    - node_level in 1, 2, 3
#    - a contiguous positive run exists
#    - the run includes at least one majority-prevalence village
#    - longest_run is 2 or 3
#
# 3) Regional node
#    - node_level >= 4
#    - compactness >= 0.75
#    - longest_run >= 4
#    - at least one majority-prevalence village is included
#      in the longest contiguous positive run
#
# ASV subtype assignment
#   Regional sharing:
#       has_regional == TRUE
#   Nearby-village sharing:
#       has_nearby == TRUE and no regional
#   Single-village dominant:
#       has_single_village == TRUE and no nearby/regional
#   Mixed sharing pattern:
#       none of the above
#
# Required:
#   node_score_tbl
#   asv_summary_tbl
#   dend_ord
#
# Outputs:
#   asv_subtype_tbl
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs <- c("node_score_tbl", "asv_summary_tbl", "dend_ord")
miss <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss)) {
  stop("Required objects are missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0.1) Backward-compatible column standardization
#      Supports old node_score_tbl column names if needed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
node_score_tbl <- node_score_tbl %>%
  {
    if (!"n_majority_ge50" %in% names(.) && "n_red" %in% names(.)) {
      rename(., n_majority_ge50 = n_red)
    } else {
      .
    }
  } %>%
  {
    if (!"n_intermediate_20_49" %in% names(.) && "n_yellow" %in% names(.)) {
      rename(., n_intermediate_20_49 = n_yellow)
    } else {
      .
    }
  } %>%
  {
    if (!"n_low_detection_0_19" %in% names(.) && "n_grey" %in% names(.)) {
      rename(., n_low_detection_0_19 = n_grey)
    } else {
      .
    }
  } %>%
  {
    if (!"n_absent" %in% names(.) && "n_none" %in% names(.)) {
      rename(., n_absent = n_none)
    } else {
      .
    }
  }

required_node_cols <- c(
  "ASV", "node",
  "n_leaf", "n_positive", "longest_run",
  "n_blocks", "node_mean", "compactness",
  "final_node_score",
  "n_majority_ge50",
  "leaf_start", "leaf_end",
  "village_labs", "score_values", "positive_pattern"
)

missing_node_cols <- setdiff(required_node_cols, names(node_score_tbl))
if (length(missing_node_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required columns are missing in node_score_tbl: ",
    paste(missing_node_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Bottom-up node level
#    level 1 = pair node
# ---------------------------------------------------------
get_internal_node_levels_bottomup <- function(dend) {
  out <- list()
  node_id <- 0L
  labs <- labels(dend)

  assign_leaf_idx <- function(x) {
    if (is.leaf(x)) {
      attr(x, "leaf_index") <- match(attr(x, "label"), labs)
      return(x)
    } else {
      for (i in seq_along(x)) {
        x[[i]] <- assign_leaf_idx(x[[i]])
      }
      return(x)
    }
  }

  walk_dend <- function(x) {
    if (is.leaf(x)) {
      return(list(
        leaf_idx = attr(x, "leaf_index"),
        level = 0L
      ))
    } else {
      child_info <- lapply(x, walk_dend)
      child_idx  <- unlist(lapply(child_info, `[[`, "leaf_idx"), use.names = FALSE)
      child_lev  <- unlist(lapply(child_info, `[[`, "level"), use.names = FALSE)

      this_level <- max(child_lev) + 1L

      node_id <<- node_id + 1L
      out[[paste0("node", node_id)]] <<- tibble(
        node = paste0("node", node_id),
        node_level = this_level
      )

      return(list(
        leaf_idx = child_idx,
        level = this_level
      ))
    }
  }

  dend2 <- assign_leaf_idx(dend)
  walk_dend(dend2)

  bind_rows(out)
}

node_level_tbl <- get_internal_node_levels_bottomup(dend_ord)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------
parse_num_vec <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || x == "") return(numeric(0))
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(strsplit(x, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]))
}

parse_int_vec <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || x == "") return(integer(0))
  suppressWarnings(as.integer(strsplit(x, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]))
}

# Does the longest contiguous positive run contain
# at least one majority-prevalence leaf?
majority_in_longest_run_fun <- function(score_str, pos_str) {
  scores <- parse_num_vec(score_str)
  pos    <- parse_int_vec(pos_str)

  if (length(scores) == 0 || length(pos) == 0 || length(scores) != length(pos)) {
    return(FALSE)
  }

  rr <- rle(pos)
  if (!any(rr$values == 1L)) return(FALSE)

  ends <- cumsum(rr$lengths)
  starts <- ends - rr$lengths + 1L

  run_df <- tibble(
    value = rr$values,
    len   = rr$lengths,
    start = starts,
    end   = ends
  ) %>%
    filter(value == 1L)

  max_len <- max(run_df$len)
  longest_runs <- run_df %>% filter(len == max_len)

  any(vapply(seq_len(nrow(longest_runs)), function(i) {
    idx <- longest_runs$start[i]:longest_runs$end[i]
    any(scores[idx] == 3, na.rm = TRUE)
  }, logical(1)))
}

# Is any majority-prevalence leaf included in a contiguous
# positive run of length >= min_run?
majority_in_any_run_fun <- function(score_str, pos_str, min_run = 2L) {
  scores <- parse_num_vec(score_str)
  pos    <- parse_int_vec(pos_str)

  if (length(scores) == 0 || length(pos) == 0 || length(scores) != length(pos)) {
    return(FALSE)
  }

  rr <- rle(pos)
  if (!any(rr$values == 1L)) return(FALSE)

  ends <- cumsum(rr$lengths)
  starts <- ends - rr$lengths + 1L

  run_df <- tibble(
    value = rr$values,
    len   = rr$lengths,
    start = starts,
    end   = ends
  ) %>%
    filter(value == 1L, len >= min_run)

  if (nrow(run_df) == 0) return(FALSE)

  any(vapply(seq_len(nrow(run_df)), function(i) {
    idx <- run_df$start[i]:run_df$end[i]
    any(scores[idx] == 3, na.rm = TRUE)
  }, logical(1)))
}

# Is there at least one isolated majority-prevalence leaf?
has_isolated_majority_fun <- function(score_str, pos_str) {
  scores <- parse_num_vec(score_str)
  pos    <- parse_int_vec(pos_str)

  if (length(scores) == 0 || length(pos) == 0 || length(scores) != length(pos)) {
    return(FALSE)
  }

  majority_idx <- which(scores == 3)
  if (length(majority_idx) == 0) return(FALSE)

  rr <- rle(pos)
  ends <- cumsum(rr$lengths)
  starts <- ends - rr$lengths + 1L

  run_df <- tibble(
    value = rr$values,
    len   = rr$lengths,
    start = starts,
    end   = ends
  )

  majority_in_nonisolated_run <- rep(FALSE, length(majority_idx))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(run_df))) {
    if (run_df$value[i] == 1L && run_df$len[i] >= 2L) {
      idx <- run_df$start[i]:run_df$end[i]
      majority_in_nonisolated_run <- majority_in_nonisolated_run | (majority_idx %in% idx)
    }
  }

  any(!majority_in_nonisolated_run)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Attach node level + run-based helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------
node_score_lvl_tbl <- node_score_tbl %>%
  left_join(node_level_tbl, by = "node") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    majority_in_longest_run = majority_in_longest_run_fun(score_values, positive_pattern),
    majority_in_any_run_ge2 = majority_in_any_run_fun(score_values, positive_pattern, min_run = 2L),
    has_isolated_majority   = has_isolated_majority_fun(score_values, positive_pattern)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

if (any(is.na(node_score_lvl_tbl$node_level))) {
  stop("Some nodes could not be mapped to node_level.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Flag node types
# ---------------------------------------------------------
node_flag_tbl <- node_score_lvl_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    is_single_village_node =
      has_isolated_majority,

    is_nearby_node =
      node_level %in% c(1, 2, 3) &
      n_majority_ge50 >= 1 &
      majority_in_any_run_ge2 &
      longest_run >= 2 &
      longest_run <= 3,

    is_regional_node =
      node_level >= 4 &
      compactness >= 0.75 &
      longest_run >= 4 &
      majority_in_longest_run
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Subtype assignment by ASV
#    final 3-class priority:
#      Regional > Nearby > Single
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtype_core_tbl <- node_flag_tbl %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    has_single_village = any(is_single_village_node, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_nearby = any(is_nearby_node, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_regional = any(is_regional_node, na.rm = TRUE),

    n_single_village_nodes = sum(is_single_village_node, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nearby_nodes = sum(is_nearby_node, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_regional_nodes = sum(is_regional_node, na.rm = TRUE),

    single_nodes_all = paste(node[is_single_village_node], collapse = ","),
    nearby_nodes_all = paste(node[is_nearby_node], collapse = ","),
    regional_nodes_all = paste(node[is_regional_node], collapse = ","),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    single_nodes_all = ifelse(single_nodes_all == "", NA_character_, single_nodes_all),
    nearby_nodes_all = ifelse(nearby_nodes_all == "", NA_character_, nearby_nodes_all),
    regional_nodes_all = ifelse(regional_nodes_all == "", NA_character_, regional_nodes_all),

    subtype = case_when(
      has_regional ~ "Regional sharing",
      has_nearby ~ "Nearby-village sharing",
      has_single_village ~ "Single-village dominant",
      TRUE ~ "Single-village dominant"
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Merge with ASV summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_subtype_tbl <- asv_summary_tbl %>%
  left_join(subtype_core_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    has_single_village = replace_na(has_single_village, FALSE),
    has_nearby = replace_na(has_nearby, FALSE),
    has_regional = replace_na(has_regional, FALSE),

    n_single_village_nodes = replace_na(n_single_village_nodes, 0L),
    n_nearby_nodes = replace_na(n_nearby_nodes, 0L),
    n_regional_nodes = replace_na(n_regional_nodes, 0L),

    subtype = replace_na(subtype, "Single-village dominant")
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(
      subtype,
      levels = c(
        "Single-village dominant",
        "Nearby-village sharing",
        "Regional sharing"
      )
    ),
    desc(max_node_score),
    desc(sum_node_score),
    ASV
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Subtype counts
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtype_count_tbl <- asv_subtype_tbl %>%
  count(subtype, sort = TRUE)

print(subtype_count_tbl)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Quick view
# ---------------------------------------------------------
print(
  asv_subtype_tbl %>%
    select(
      ASV, ASV_lab,
      subtype,
      max_node_score, sum_node_score,
      best_node, best_node_size, best_node_n_positive, best_node_compactness,
      has_single_village, has_nearby, has_regional,
      n_single_village_nodes, n_nearby_nodes, n_regional_nodes,
      single_nodes_all, nearby_nodes_all, regional_nodes_all,
      best_village_labs, best_positive_pattern
    ),
  n = 30
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Optional inspection tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
single_node_inspect_tbl <- node_flag_tbl %>%
  filter(is_single_village_node) %>%
  select(
    ASV, node, node_level,
    n_leaf, n_positive, longest_run, n_majority_ge50,
    has_isolated_majority,
    village_labs, score_values, positive_pattern
  ) %>%
  arrange(ASV, node_level, node)

nearby_node_inspect_tbl <- node_flag_tbl %>%
  filter(is_nearby_node) %>%
  select(
    ASV, node, node_level,
    n_leaf, n_positive, longest_run, n_majority_ge50,
    majority_in_any_run_ge2,
    village_labs, score_values, positive_pattern
  ) %>%
  arrange(ASV, node_level, node)

regional_node_inspect_tbl <- node_flag_tbl %>%
  filter(is_regional_node) %>%
  select(
    ASV, node, node_level,
    n_leaf, n_positive, longest_run, compactness, n_majority_ge50,
    majority_in_longest_run,
    village_labs, score_values, positive_pattern
  ) %>%
  arrange(ASV, node_level, node)

print(single_node_inspect_tbl, n = 20)
print(nearby_node_inspect_tbl, n = 20)
print(regional_node_inspect_tbl, n = 20)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Export tables
# - supplementary: final subtype table
# - derived: node-level inspection tables
```
