```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
readr::write_csv(
  asv_subtype_tbl,
  "supplementary_candidate91_asv_subtypes_byNodeLevel_v7.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  single_node_inspect_tbl,
  "derived_candidate91_single_node_inspect_v7.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  nearby_node_inspect_tbl,
  "derived_candidate91_nearby_node_inspect_v7.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  regional_node_inspect_tbl,
  "derived_candidate91_regional_node_inspect_v7.csv"
)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Organize existing ASV profile plots into subtype folders
# - 3-class version:
#     Single-village dominant / Nearby-village sharing / Regional sharing
# - uses object:
#     asv_subtype_tbl
#
# Assumes original plot files are in:
#   dendro_pattern_profiles_noclassification/all
#
# Output:
#   dendro_pattern_profiles_noclassification/by_subtype_v7/
#     ├─ Single-village dominant/
#     ├─ Nearby-village sharing/
#     └─ Regional sharing/
#
# Note:
#   both PNG and SVG are copied if available
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("asv_subtype_tbl")) {
  stop("Required object is missing: asv_subtype_tbl")
}

asv_subtype_tbl_use <- asv_subtype_tbl %>%
  filter(subtype %in% c(
    "Single-village dominant",
    "Nearby-village sharing",
    "Regional sharing"
  ))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Paths
# ---------------------------------------------------------
src_dir  <- file.path("dendro_pattern_profiles_noclassification", "all")
dst_root <- file.path("dendro_pattern_profiles_noclassification", "by_subtype_v7")

if (!dir.exists(src_dir)) {
  stop("Source plot directory does not exist: ", src_dir)
}

dir.create(dst_root, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Subtype folders
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtypes <- c(
  "Single-village dominant",
  "Nearby-village sharing",
  "Regional sharing"
)

for (st in subtypes) {
  dir.create(file.path(dst_root, st), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) List source plot files
#    - keep both PNG and SVG
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_files <- list.files(
  src_dir,
  pattern = "\\.(png|svg)$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (length(plot_files) == 0) {
  stop("No source plot files were found in: ", src_dir)
}

plot_tbl <- tibble(
  src_file = plot_files,
  file_name = basename(plot_files)
) %>%
  mutate(
    ext = tools::file_ext(file_name),
    stem = sub("\\.[^.]+$", "", file_name)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------
safe_file <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("_+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("^_|_$", "", x)
  x
}

match_one_asv_stem <- function(asv_id, stem_vec) {
  hit <- stem_vec[str_detect(stem_vec, fixed(asv_id))]
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  hit[1]
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Match files to ASV
#    - match by stem, then recover png/svg pairs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
file_match_tbl <- asv_subtype_tbl_use %>%
  mutate(
    matched_stem = vapply(
      ASV,
      function(x) match_one_asv_stem(x, unique(plot_tbl$stem)),
      character(1)
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Unmatched report
# ---------------------------------------------------------
unmatched_tbl <- file_match_tbl %>%
  filter(is.na(matched_stem))

if (nrow(unmatched_tbl) > 0) {
  message("Number of ASVs without matched plot files: ", nrow(unmatched_tbl))
  print(
    unmatched_tbl %>% select(ASV, ASV_lab, subtype),
    n = min(20, nrow(unmatched_tbl))
  )
}

matched_tbl <- file_match_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(matched_stem)) %>%
  group_by(subtype) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_node_score), desc(sum_node_score), ASV, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    subtype_rank = row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

matched_file_tbl <- matched_tbl %>%
  select(subtype, subtype_rank, ASV, ASV_lab, max_node_score, sum_node_score, matched_stem) %>%
  left_join(
    plot_tbl %>% select(src_file, file_name, ext, stem),
    by = c("matched_stem" = "stem")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    src_path = src_file,
    new_file_name = paste0(
      sprintf("%03d", subtype_rank), "_",
      safe_file(ASV), "_",
      file_name
    ),
    dst_path = file.path(dst_root, subtype, new_file_name)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Copy files into subtype folders
#    - use copy to preserve original files
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ok <- file.copy(
  from = matched_file_tbl$src_path,
  to = matched_file_tbl$dst_path,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

matched_file_tbl$copy_ok <- ok

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Representative ASV per subtype
#    - top one by max/sum score within each subtype
# ---------------------------------------------------------
rep_tbl <- matched_tbl %>%
  group_by(subtype) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_node_score), desc(sum_node_score), ASV, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

print(
  rep_tbl %>%
    select(subtype, ASV, ASV_lab, max_node_score, sum_node_score),
  n = nrow(rep_tbl)
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Export tables
# - supplementary: mapping and representative summary
# - derived: unmatched report
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(
  matched_file_tbl %>%
    select(
      subtype, subtype_rank,
      ASV, ASV_lab,
      max_node_score, sum_node_score,
      matched_stem, file_name, ext, new_file_name, copy_ok
    ),
  file.path(dst_root, "supplementary_asv_plot_subtype_mapping_v7.csv")
)

write_csv(
  unmatched_tbl %>%
    select(ASV, ASV_lab, subtype),
  file.path(dst_root, "derived_asv_plot_unmatched_v7.csv")
)

write_csv(
  rep_tbl %>%
    select(
      subtype, ASV, ASV_lab,
      max_node_score, sum_node_score
    ),
  file.path(dst_root, "supplementary_asv_plot_representatives_v7.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
summary_tbl <- matched_file_tbl %>%
  count(subtype, ext, sort = TRUE)

print(summary_tbl)

message("Done: plot files were organized into subtype-specific folders.")
message("Output directory: ", dst_root)
```

#global core ASV profiles
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggdendro)
  library(patchwork)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Global core ASV profiles (all)
# - dendrogram-aligned prevalence profile
# - no subtype classification
# - save one PNG + SVG per ASV
#
# Required objects:
#   prev_heat_core_tmp
#   pick_core_tmp
#   asv_var_tmp
#   order_tbl_core
#   dend_ord
#   clu_pal
#   save_plot_both()
#
# Optional:
#   asv_label_tbl
#   base_theme
#
# Output:
#   global_core_ASV_profiles/
#     └─ all/
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs <- c(
  "prev_heat_core_tmp", "pick_core_tmp", "asv_var_tmp",
  "order_tbl_core", "dend_ord", "clu_pal", "save_plot_both"
)

miss <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss)) {
  stop("Required objects are missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "village_lab", "prev") %in% names(prev_heat_core_tmp)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "global_prev") %in% names(pick_core_tmp)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "prev_sd", "prev_rsd") %in% names(asv_var_tmp)))
stopifnot(all(c("village_name", "dendro_order") %in% names(order_tbl_core)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Theme / settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("base_theme")) {
  base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title    = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.text     = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title  = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      legend.text   = element_text(size = 9)
    )
}

leaf_label_size <- 9
strip_height_y  <- 0.24

global_core_hi_thr  <- 75
global_core_mid_thr <- 50

PLOT_DIR <- "global_core_ASV_profiles"
dir.create(PLOT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(PLOT_DIR, "all"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

safe_file <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("_+", "_", x)
  x
}

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) y else x
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1.1) Prevalence bins / palette
#     - matched to the main prevalence heatmap
#     - dummy legend layer is used so all bins appear in per-ASV plots
# ---------------------------------------------------------
prev_bin_levels <- c("0", "0–<20", "20–<50", "50–<75", "75–100")

prev_bin_pal <- c(
  "0" = "grey95",
  "0–<20" = "grey80",
  "20–<50" = "#fee08b",
  "50–<75" = "#f46d43",
  "75–100" = "#a50026"
)

bin_prev_common <- function(prev) {
  out <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(prev) ~ NA_character_,
    prev == 0 ~ "0",
    prev > 0 & prev < 20 ~ "0–<20",
    prev >= 20 & prev < 50 ~ "20–<50",
    prev >= 50 & prev < 75 ~ "50–<75",
    prev >= 75 ~ "75–100",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  factor(out, levels = prev_bin_levels)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Village order / leaf labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if ("village_lab" %in% names(order_tbl_core)) {
  leaf_order_tbl <- order_tbl_core %>%
    select(
      village_name,
      dendro_order,
      village_lab,
      cluster = any_of(c("cluster", "cluster_id"))
    ) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(dendro_order)

} else if ("vil_lab" %in% names(order_tbl_core)) {
  leaf_order_tbl <- order_tbl_core %>%
    select(
      village_name,
      dendro_order,
      village_lab = vil_lab,
      cluster = any_of(c("cluster", "cluster_id"))
    ) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(dendro_order)

} else {
  stop("order_tbl_core must contain either 'village_lab' or 'vil_lab'.")
}

leaf_order <- leaf_order_tbl$village_lab

dend_dat <- ggdendro::dendro_data(dend_ord, type = "rectangle")

leaf_lab_tbl <- dend_dat$labels %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(village_name = label) %>%
  left_join(order_tbl_core, by = "village_name")

if ("cluster" %in% names(leaf_lab_tbl)) {
  leaf_lab_tbl <- leaf_lab_tbl %>%
    mutate(cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = names(clu_pal)))

} else if ("cluster_id" %in% names(leaf_lab_tbl)) {
  leaf_lab_tbl <- leaf_lab_tbl %>%
    mutate(cluster = factor(as.character(cluster_id), levels = names(clu_pal)))

} else {
  stop("order_tbl_core must contain either 'cluster' or 'cluster_id'.")
}

if ("village_lab" %in% names(leaf_lab_tbl)) {
  leaf_lab_tbl <- leaf_lab_tbl

} else if ("vil_lab" %in% names(leaf_lab_tbl)) {
  leaf_lab_tbl <- leaf_lab_tbl %>%
    mutate(village_lab = vil_lab)

} else {
  stop("order_tbl_core must contain either 'village_lab' or 'vil_lab'.")
}

leaf_lab_tbl <- leaf_lab_tbl %>%
  arrange(x)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Label table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (exists("asv_label_tbl") && all(c("ASV", "ASV_lab") %in% names(asv_label_tbl))) {
  label_tbl <- asv_label_tbl %>%
    select(ASV, ASV_lab) %>%
    distinct()
} else {
  label_tbl <- pick_core_tmp %>%
    transmute(ASV, ASV_lab = ASV) %>%
    distinct()
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Core prevalence table (village only, ordered)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
core_prev_tbl <- prev_heat_core_tmp %>%
  filter(ASV %in% pick_core_tmp$ASV) %>%
  filter(village_lab %in% leaf_order) %>%
  select(ASV, village_lab, prev) %>%
  left_join(
    pick_core_tmp %>% select(ASV, global_prev),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    asv_var_tmp %>% select(ASV, prev_sd, prev_rsd),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    label_tbl,
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_lab = coalesce(ASV_lab, ASV),
    prev_bin = factor(bin_prev_common(prev), levels = prev_bin_levels)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Panels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_leaf_strip_panel <- function(show_labels = TRUE) {
  strip_df <- leaf_lab_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      y_strip = 0.92,
      h_strip = strip_height_y,
      y_text  = 0.22
    )

  ggplot(strip_df, aes(x = x)) +
    geom_tile(
      aes(y = y_strip, fill = cluster),
      width = 0.98,
      height = strip_df$h_strip[1],
      show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    {
      if (show_labels) {
        geom_text(
          aes(y = y_text, label = village_lab),
          angle = 90,
          size = leaf_label_size / 2.8,
          vjust = 0.5,
          hjust = 0.3
        )
      }
    } +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = clu_pal,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = "Cluster"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = leaf_lab_tbl$x,
      labels = NULL,
      expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1.25),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 5.5, b = 12, l = 5.5),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

make_tree_panel <- function() {
  max_y <- max(dend_dat$segments$y, dend_dat$segments$yend, na.rm = TRUE)

  ggplot() +
    geom_segment(
      data = dend_dat$segments,
      aes(
        x = x,
        y = max_y - y,
        xend = xend,
        yend = max_y - yend
      ),
      linewidth = 0.35,
      color = "grey25"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = leaf_lab_tbl$x,
      labels = NULL,
      expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Height") +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 5.5, b = 5.5, l = 5.5),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) One profile plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_one_global_core_profile <- function(asv_id,
                                         prev_tbl = core_prev_tbl,
                                         show_dend_labels = TRUE) {

  df_a <- prev_tbl %>%
    filter(ASV == asv_id) %>%
    right_join(
      tibble(village_lab = leaf_order),
      by = "village_lab"
    ) %>%
    arrange(match(village_lab, leaf_order))

  if (nrow(df_a) == 0) return(NULL)

  df_a <- df_a %>%
    mutate(
      prev = replace_na(prev, 0),
      x = seq_len(n()),
      prev_bin = factor(bin_prev_common(prev), levels = prev_bin_levels)
    )

  asv_title <- unique(na.omit(df_a$ASV_lab))[1] %||% as.character(asv_id)
  gp   <- unique(na.omit(df_a$global_prev))[1] %||% NA_real_
  psd  <- unique(na.omit(df_a$prev_sd))[1] %||% NA_real_
  prsd <- unique(na.omit(df_a$prev_rsd))[1] %||% NA_real_

  max_vil <- max(df_a$prev, na.rm = TRUE)
  min_vil <- min(df_a$prev, na.rm = TRUE)
  range_v <- max_vil - min_vil
  n_ge75  <- sum(df_a$prev >= global_core_hi_thr, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_ge50  <- sum(df_a$prev >= global_core_mid_thr, na.rm = TRUE)

  subtitle_txt <- paste0(
    "global=", sprintf("%.1f", gp),
    " | max=", sprintf("%.1f", max_vil),
    " | min=", sprintf("%.1f", min_vil),
    " | range=", sprintf("%.1f", range_v),
    " | SD=", sprintf("%.1f", psd),
    " | RSD=", sprintf("%.1f", prsd),
    " | n(vil>=75)=", n_ge75,
    " | n(vil>=50)=", n_ge50
  )

  # Dummy legend layer:
  # Ensures all prevalence bins are present in the legend
  # even if some bins are absent for this ASV.
  legend_dummy_df <- tibble(
    x = df_a$x[1],
    y = 0,
    prev_bin = factor(prev_bin_levels, levels = prev_bin_levels)
  )

  p_bar <- ggplot(df_a, aes(x = x, y = prev)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = prev_bin), width = 0.86, color = NA) +
    geom_point(
      data = legend_dummy_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y, fill = prev_bin),
      shape = 22,
      size = 0,
      alpha = 0,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = global_core_hi_thr,
      linetype = 2,
      linewidth = 0.5,
      color = "#b2182b"
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = global_core_mid_thr,
      linetype = 3,
      linewidth = 0.5,
      color = "#ef8a62"
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = gp,
      linetype = 3,
      linewidth = 0.5,
      color = "#2166ac"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = prev_bin_pal,
      limits = prev_bin_levels,
      breaks = prev_bin_levels,
      drop = FALSE,
      na.translate = FALSE,
      name = "Village prevalence (%)"
    ) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(
        title = "Village prevalence (%)",
        override.aes = list(
          alpha = 1,
          size = 5,
          shape = 22,
          color = NA
        )
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = df_a$x,
      labels = df_a$village_lab,
      expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
    labs(
      title = asv_title,
      subtitle = subtitle_txt,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Prevalence (%)"
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(t = 5.5, r = 5.5, b = 0, l = 5.5),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  p_strip <- make_leaf_strip_panel(show_labels = show_dend_labels)
  p_tree  <- make_tree_panel()

  p_bar / p_strip / p_tree + plot_layout(heights = c(3.2, 0.8, 1.1))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Save all
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_order <- pick_core_tmp %>%
  arrange(desc(global_prev), desc(max_vil), ASV) %>%
  pull(ASV)

for (i in seq_along(asv_order)) {
  a <- asv_order[[i]]
  p <- plot_one_global_core_profile(a)

  if (is.null(p)) next

  out_base <- file.path(
    PLOT_DIR, "all",
    paste0(sprintf("%03d", i), "_", safe_file(a), "_global_core_profile")
  )

  save_plot_both(
    p,
    out_base,
    width = 16,
    height = 9.5
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Summary export
# ---------------------------------------------------------
global_core_profile_summary_tbl <- core_prev_tbl %>%
  group_by(ASV, ASV_lab, global_prev, prev_sd, prev_rsd) %>%
  summarise(
    max_vil = max(prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_vil = min(prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    range_vil = max_vil - min_vil,
    n_vil_ge75 = sum(prev >= global_core_hi_thr, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_vil_ge50 = sum(prev >= global_core_mid_thr, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(global_prev), desc(max_vil), ASV)

write_csv(
  global_core_profile_summary_tbl,
  file.path(PLOT_DIR, "supplementary_global_core_profile_summary.csv")
)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Global-core ASV subtype classification
# - very-high-prevalence version
# - positive village = prevalence >= 75%
# - no intermediate-prevalence support
# - keep node-level-based logic
#
# Required:
#   prev_heat_core_tmp
#   pick_core_tmp
#   order_tbl_core
#   dend_ord
#
# Optional:
#   asv_label_tbl
#
# Outputs:
#   global_core_node_tbl_veryHigh
#   global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs <- c("prev_heat_core_tmp", "pick_core_tmp", "order_tbl_core", "dend_ord")
miss <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss)) {
  stop("Required objects are missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "village_lab", "prev") %in% names(prev_heat_core_tmp)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "global_prev") %in% names(pick_core_tmp)))
stopifnot(all(c("village_name", "dendro_order") %in% names(order_tbl_core)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Parameters
# ---------------------------------------------------------
very_high_thr <- 75

nearby_node_levels <- c(1, 2, 3)
regional_node_level_min <- 4
regional_compactness_thr <- 0.75

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Leaf order
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if ("village_lab" %in% names(order_tbl_core)) {
  leaf_order_tbl <- order_tbl_core %>%
    select(village_name, dendro_order, village_lab) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(dendro_order)
} else if ("vil_lab" %in% names(order_tbl_core)) {
  leaf_order_tbl <- order_tbl_core %>%
    select(village_name, dendro_order, village_lab = vil_lab) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(dendro_order)
} else {
  stop("order_tbl_core must contain either 'village_lab' or 'vil_lab'.")
}

leaf_order <- leaf_order_tbl$village_lab

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Core prevalence table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
core_prev_tbl <- prev_heat_core_tmp %>%
  filter(ASV %in% pick_core_tmp$ASV) %>%
  filter(village_lab %in% leaf_order) %>%
  select(ASV, village_lab, prev) %>%
  left_join(
    pick_core_tmp %>% select(ASV, global_prev),
    by = "ASV"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------
longest_run_ones <- function(x) {
  x <- as.integer(x)
  if (length(x) == 0) return(0L)
  rr <- rle(x)
  if (!any(rr$values == 1)) return(0L)
  max(rr$lengths[rr$values == 1])
}

count_positive_blocks <- function(x) {
  x <- as.integer(x)
  if (length(x) == 0) return(0L)
  rr <- rle(x)
  sum(rr$values == 1)
}

parse_int_vec <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || x == "") return(integer(0))
  suppressWarnings(as.integer(strsplit(x, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]))
}

has_isolated_very_high_fun <- function(pos_str) {
  pos <- parse_int_vec(pos_str)
  if (length(pos) == 0) return(FALSE)

  very_high_idx <- which(pos == 1L)
  if (length(very_high_idx) == 0) return(FALSE)

  rr <- rle(pos)
  ends <- cumsum(rr$lengths)
  starts <- ends - rr$lengths + 1L

  run_df <- tibble(
    value = rr$values,
    len   = rr$lengths,
    start = starts,
    end   = ends
  )

  very_high_in_nonisolated_run <- rep(FALSE, length(very_high_idx))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(run_df))) {
    if (run_df$value[i] == 1L && run_df$len[i] >= 2L) {
      idx <- run_df$start[i]:run_df$end[i]
      very_high_in_nonisolated_run <- very_high_in_nonisolated_run | (very_high_idx %in% idx)
    }
  }

  any(!very_high_in_nonisolated_run)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Bottom-up node levels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
get_internal_node_levels_bottomup <- function(dend) {
  out <- list()
  node_id <- 0L
  labs <- labels(dend)

  assign_leaf_idx <- function(x) {
    if (is.leaf(x)) {
      attr(x, "leaf_index") <- match(attr(x, "label"), labs)
      return(x)
    } else {
      for (i in seq_along(x)) {
        x[[i]] <- assign_leaf_idx(x[[i]])
      }
      return(x)
    }
  }

  walk_dend <- function(x) {
    if (is.leaf(x)) {
      return(list(
        leaf_idx = attr(x, "leaf_index"),
        level = 0L
      ))
    } else {
      child_info <- lapply(x, walk_dend)
      child_idx <- unlist(lapply(child_info, `[[`, "leaf_idx"), use.names = FALSE)
      child_lev <- unlist(lapply(child_info, `[[`, "level"), use.names = FALSE)

      this_level <- max(child_lev) + 1L

      node_id <<- node_id + 1L
      out[[paste0("node", node_id)]] <<- tibble(
        node = paste0("node", node_id),
        node_level = this_level
      )

      return(list(
        leaf_idx = child_idx,
        level = this_level
      ))
    }
  }

  dend2 <- assign_leaf_idx(dend)
  walk_dend(dend2)

  bind_rows(out)
}

node_level_tbl <- get_internal_node_levels_bottomup(dend_ord)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Internal node descendants
# ---------------------------------------------------------
get_internal_descendants <- function(dend) {
  out <- list()
  node_id <- 0L
  labs <- labels(dend)

  assign_leaf_idx <- function(x) {
    if (is.leaf(x)) {
      attr(x, "leaf_index") <- match(attr(x, "label"), labs)
      return(x)
    } else {
      for (i in seq_along(x)) {
        x[[i]] <- assign_leaf_idx(x[[i]])
      }
      return(x)
    }
  }

  walk_dend <- function(x) {
    if (is.leaf(x)) {
      return(attr(x, "leaf_index"))
    } else {
      child_idx <- unlist(lapply(x, walk_dend), use.names = FALSE)
      node_id <<- node_id + 1L
      out[[paste0("node", node_id)]] <<- sort(unique(child_idx))
      return(child_idx)
    }
  }

  dend2 <- assign_leaf_idx(dend)
  walk_dend(dend2)

  out
}

internal_nodes <- get_internal_descendants(dend_ord)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Score one ASV using very-high-prevalence villages only
# ---------------------------------------------------------
calc_one_global_core_very_high <- function(asv_id,
                                           prev_tbl = core_prev_tbl,
                                           internal_nodes,
                                           leaf_order,
                                           very_high_thr = 75) {

  df_asv <- prev_tbl %>%
    filter(ASV == asv_id) %>%
    select(ASV, village_lab, prev, global_prev) %>%
    right_join(
      tibble(
        village_lab = leaf_order,
        leaf_index = seq_along(leaf_order)
      ),
      by = "village_lab"
    ) %>%
    arrange(leaf_index)

  if (nrow(df_asv) == 0) return(NULL)

  df_asv <- df_asv %>%
    mutate(
      prev = replace_na(prev, 0),
      positive = as.integer(prev >= very_high_thr)
    )

  node_tbl <- purrr::imap_dfr(internal_nodes, function(idx, node_name) {
    sub <- df_asv[idx, , drop = FALSE]

    pos <- sub$positive

    n_leaf      <- length(pos)
    n_positive  <- sum(pos, na.rm = TRUE)
    longest_run <- longest_run_ones(pos)
    n_blocks    <- count_positive_blocks(pos)
    compactness <- ifelse(n_positive < 2, 0, longest_run / n_positive)
    final_score <- compactness

    tibble(
      ASV = asv_id,
      node = node_name,
      n_leaf = n_leaf,
      n_positive = n_positive,
      longest_run = longest_run,
      n_blocks = n_blocks,
      compactness = compactness,
      final_node_score = final_score,
      leaf_start = min(idx),
      leaf_end = max(idx),
      village_labs = paste(sub$village_lab, collapse = ","),
      prev_values = paste(sprintf("%.1f", sub$prev), collapse = ","),
      positive_pattern = paste(pos, collapse = ",")
    )
  })

  leaf_tbl <- df_asv %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = asv_id,
      leaf_index,
      village_lab,
      prev,
      global_prev,
      positive,
      prevalence_category = ifelse(positive == 1L, "very_high_ge75", "below_75")
    )

  list(
    node_tbl = node_tbl,
    leaf_tbl = leaf_tbl
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Run all global-core ASVs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
target_asv <- unique(pick_core_tmp$ASV)

res_list <- purrr::map(
  target_asv,
  ~ calc_one_global_core_very_high(
    asv_id = .x,
    prev_tbl = core_prev_tbl,
    internal_nodes = internal_nodes,
    leaf_order = leaf_order,
    very_high_thr = very_high_thr
  )
)

valid_idx <- !purrr::map_lgl(res_list, is.null)
res_list <- res_list[valid_idx]

global_core_node_tbl_veryHigh <- purrr::map_dfr(res_list, "node_tbl")
global_core_leaf_tbl_veryHigh <- purrr::map_dfr(res_list, "leaf_tbl")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Attach node levels + isolated very-high-prevalence flag
# ---------------------------------------------------------
global_core_node_tbl_veryHigh <- global_core_node_tbl_veryHigh %>%
  left_join(node_level_tbl, by = "node") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    has_isolated_very_high = has_isolated_very_high_fun(positive_pattern)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Flag node types
# ---------------------------------------------------------
global_core_node_flag_tbl_veryHigh <- global_core_node_tbl_veryHigh %>%
  mutate(
    is_single_node =
      has_isolated_very_high,

    is_nearby_node =
      node_level %in% nearby_node_levels &
      n_positive >= 2 &
      longest_run >= 2 &
      longest_run <= 3,

    is_regional_node =
      node_level >= regional_node_level_min &
      n_positive >= 4 &
      longest_run >= 4 &
      compactness >= regional_compactness_thr
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Subtype assignment
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtype_core_tbl_veryHigh <- global_core_node_flag_tbl_veryHigh %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    has_single = any(is_single_node, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_nearby = any(is_nearby_node, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_regional = any(is_regional_node, na.rm = TRUE),

    n_single_nodes = sum(is_single_node, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nearby_nodes = sum(is_nearby_node, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_regional_nodes = sum(is_regional_node, na.rm = TRUE),

    single_nodes_all = paste(node[is_single_node], collapse = ","),
    nearby_nodes_all = paste(node[is_nearby_node], collapse = ","),
    regional_nodes_all = paste(node[is_regional_node], collapse = ","),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    single_nodes_all = ifelse(single_nodes_all == "", NA_character_, single_nodes_all),
    nearby_nodes_all = ifelse(nearby_nodes_all == "", NA_character_, nearby_nodes_all),
    regional_nodes_all = ifelse(regional_nodes_all == "", NA_character_, regional_nodes_all),

    subtype = case_when(
      has_regional ~ "Regional-structured core",
      has_nearby   ~ "Nearby-structured core",
      has_single   ~ "Single-peaked core",
      TRUE         ~ "Uniform core"
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) ASV summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
global_core_asv_summary_veryHigh <- global_core_node_tbl_veryHigh %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    df <- .x

    max_score <- max(df$final_node_score, na.rm = TRUE)
    tied_df <- df %>% filter(final_node_score == max_score)

    best_row <- tied_df %>%
      arrange(
        desc(n_positive),
        desc(compactness),
        desc(longest_run),
        desc(n_leaf),
        node
      ) %>%
      slice(1)

    tibble(
      max_node_score = max_score,
      sum_node_score = sum(df$final_node_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_node_score = mean(df$final_node_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      best_node = best_row$node,
      best_node_size = best_row$n_leaf,
      best_node_n_positive = best_row$n_positive,
      best_node_compactness = best_row$compactness,
      best_longest_run = best_row$longest_run,
      best_leaf_start = best_row$leaf_start,
      best_leaf_end = best_row$leaf_end,
      best_village_labs = best_row$village_labs,
      best_prev_values = best_row$prev_values,
      best_positive_pattern = best_row$positive_pattern
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

leaf_summary_tbl_veryHigh <- global_core_leaf_tbl_veryHigh %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    n_very_high_ge75_leaf = sum(positive == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh <- global_core_asv_summary_veryHigh %>%
  left_join(leaf_summary_tbl_veryHigh, by = "ASV") %>%
  left_join(
    pick_core_tmp %>% select(ASV, global_prev, max_vil),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(subtype_core_tbl_veryHigh, by = "ASV")

if (exists("asv_label_tbl") && all(c("ASV", "ASV_lab") %in% names(asv_label_tbl))) {
  global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh <- global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
    left_join(asv_label_tbl %>% select(ASV, ASV_lab), by = "ASV")
} else {
  global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh <- global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
    mutate(ASV_lab = ASV)
}

global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh <- global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
  arrange(
    factor(
      subtype,
      levels = c(
        "Uniform core",
        "Single-peaked core",
        "Nearby-structured core",
        "Regional-structured core"
      )
    ),
    desc(max_node_score),
    desc(sum_node_score),
    ASV
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 13) Quick summaries
# ---------------------------------------------------------
global_core_subtype_count_tbl_veryHigh <- global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
  count(subtype, sort = TRUE)

print(global_core_subtype_count_tbl_veryHigh)

print(
  global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
    select(
      ASV, ASV_lab, subtype,
      global_prev, max_vil,
      n_very_high_ge75_leaf,
      max_node_score, sum_node_score,
      best_node, best_node_size, best_node_n_positive, best_node_compactness,
      best_village_labs, best_prev_values, best_positive_pattern
    ),
  n = 30
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14) Export tables
# - supplementary: final subtype table
# - derived: node/leaf scoring tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
readr::write_csv(
  global_core_node_tbl_veryHigh,
  "derived_global_core_node_tbl_veryHigh.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  global_core_leaf_tbl_veryHigh,
  "derived_global_core_leaf_tbl_veryHigh.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh,
  "supplementary_global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh.csv"
)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Organize global-core ASV profile plots into subtype folders
# - uses:
#     global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh
# - assumes original profile plots are in:
#     global_core_ASV_profiles/all
#
# Output:
#   global_core_ASV_profiles/by_subtype_veryHigh/
#     ├─ Uniform core/
#     ├─ Single-peaked core/
#     ├─ Nearby-structured core/
#     └─ Regional-structured core/
#
# Note:
#   both PNG and SVG are copied if available
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh")) {
  stop("Required object is missing: global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Paths
# ---------------------------------------------------------
src_dir  <- file.path("global_core_ASV_profiles", "all")
dst_root <- file.path("global_core_ASV_profiles", "by_subtype_veryHigh")

if (!dir.exists(src_dir)) {
  stop("Source plot directory does not exist: ", src_dir)
}

dir.create(dst_root, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Subtype folders
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtypes <- c(
  "Uniform core",
  "Single-peaked core",
  "Nearby-structured core",
  "Regional-structured core"
)

for (st in subtypes) {
  dir.create(file.path(dst_root, st), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Source plot files
#    - keep both PNG and SVG
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_files <- list.files(
  src_dir,
  pattern = "\\.(png|svg)$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (length(plot_files) == 0) {
  stop("No source plot files were found in: ", src_dir)
}

plot_tbl <- tibble(
  src_file  = plot_files,
  file_name = basename(plot_files)
) %>%
  mutate(
    ext = tools::file_ext(file_name),
    stem = sub("\\.[^.]+$", "", file_name)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------
safe_file <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("_+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("^_|_$", "", x)
  x
}

match_one_asv_stem <- function(asv_id, stem_vec) {
  hit <- stem_vec[str_detect(stem_vec, fixed(asv_id))]
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  hit[1]
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Match files to ASV
#    - match by stem, then recover png/svg pairs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
file_match_tbl <- global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
  mutate(
    matched_stem = vapply(
      ASV,
      function(x) match_one_asv_stem(x, unique(plot_tbl$stem)),
      character(1)
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Unmatched report
# ---------------------------------------------------------
unmatched_tbl <- file_match_tbl %>%
  filter(is.na(matched_stem))

if (nrow(unmatched_tbl) > 0) {
  message("Number of global-core ASVs without matched plot files: ", nrow(unmatched_tbl))
  print(
    unmatched_tbl %>% select(ASV, ASV_lab, subtype),
    n = min(20, nrow(unmatched_tbl))
  )
}

matched_tbl <- file_match_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(matched_stem)) %>%
  group_by(subtype) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_node_score), desc(sum_node_score), ASV, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    subtype_rank = row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

matched_file_tbl <- matched_tbl %>%
  select(subtype, subtype_rank, ASV, ASV_lab, max_node_score, sum_node_score, matched_stem) %>%
  left_join(
    plot_tbl %>% select(src_file, file_name, ext, stem),
    by = c("matched_stem" = "stem")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    src_path = src_file,
    new_file_name = paste0(
      sprintf("%03d", subtype_rank), "_",
      safe_file(ASV), "_",
      file_name
    ),
    dst_path = file.path(dst_root, subtype, new_file_name)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Copy files into subtype folders
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ok <- file.copy(
  from = matched_file_tbl$src_path,
  to   = matched_file_tbl$dst_path,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

matched_file_tbl$copy_ok <- ok

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Representative ASV per subtype
# ---------------------------------------------------------
rep_tbl <- matched_tbl %>%
  group_by(subtype) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_node_score), desc(sum_node_score), ASV, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

print(
  rep_tbl %>%
    select(subtype, ASV, ASV_lab, max_node_score, sum_node_score),
  n = nrow(rep_tbl)
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Export tables
# - supplementary: mapping and representative summary
# - derived: unmatched report
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(
  matched_file_tbl %>%
    select(
      subtype, subtype_rank,
      ASV, ASV_lab,
      max_node_score, sum_node_score,
      matched_stem, file_name, ext, new_file_name, copy_ok
    ),
  file.path(dst_root, "supplementary_global_core_plot_subtype_mapping_veryHigh.csv")
)

write_csv(
  unmatched_tbl %>%
    select(ASV, ASV_lab, subtype),
  file.path(dst_root, "derived_global_core_plot_unmatched_veryHigh.csv")
)

write_csv(
  rep_tbl %>%
    select(
      subtype, ASV, ASV_lab,
      max_node_score, sum_node_score
    ),
  file.path(dst_root, "supplementary_global_core_plot_representatives_veryHigh.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
summary_tbl <- matched_file_tbl %>%
  count(subtype, ext, sort = TRUE)

print(summary_tbl)

message("Done: global-core profile plot files were organized into subtype-specific folders.")
message("Output directory: ", dst_root)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Heatmap of village-enriched ASVs ordered by subtype
# - sum-first ordering
# - thinner max/sum strips
# - prevalence bins matched to main prevalence heatmap
#
# Required:
#   prev_vil_full
#   global_prev_tbl
#   asv_subtype_tbl
#   order_tbl_core
#   base_theme
#   save_plot_both()
#
# Output:
#   village_enriched_ASV_heatmap_bySubtype_v7.png/.svg
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs <- c(
  "prev_vil_full",
  "global_prev_tbl",
  "asv_subtype_tbl",
  "order_tbl_core",
  "base_theme",
  "save_plot_both"
)

miss <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss)) {
  stop("Required objects are missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

target_asv <- unique(asv_subtype_tbl$ASV)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0.1) Prevalence bins / palette
#     - matched to the main prevalence heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
prev_bin_levels <- c("0", "0–<20", "20–<50", "50–<75", "75–100")

prev_bin_pal <- c(
  "0" = "grey95",
  "0–<20" = "grey80",
  "20–<50" = "#fee08b",
  "50–<75" = "#f46d43",
  "75–100" = "#a50026"
)

bin_prev_common <- function(prev) {
  out <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(prev) ~ NA_character_,
    prev == 0 ~ "0",
    prev > 0 & prev < 20 ~ "0–<20",
    prev >= 20 & prev < 50 ~ "20–<50",
    prev >= 50 & prev < 75 ~ "50–<75",
    prev >= 75 ~ "75–100",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
  factor(out, levels = prev_bin_levels)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) ASV labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_lab_use <- if (exists("asv_label_tbl") && all(c("ASV", "ASV_lab") %in% names(asv_label_tbl))) {
  asv_label_tbl %>%
    filter(ASV %in% target_asv) %>%
    distinct(ASV, ASV_lab) %>%
    rename(ASV_lab_join = ASV_lab)
} else {
  asv_subtype_tbl %>%
    transmute(ASV, ASV_lab_join = ASV) %>%
    distinct()
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Village order / labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if ("village_lab" %in% names(order_tbl_core)) {
  village_order_tbl <- order_tbl_core %>%
    select(village_name, dendro_order, village_lab) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(dendro_order)
} else if ("vil_lab" %in% names(order_tbl_core)) {
  village_order_tbl <- order_tbl_core %>%
    select(village_name, dendro_order, village_lab = vil_lab) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(dendro_order)
} else {
  stop("order_tbl_core must contain either 'village_lab' or 'vil_lab'.")
}

village_levels <- c(village_order_tbl$village_lab, "Global")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Subtype order
#    top -> bottom
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtype_levels <- c(
  "Regional sharing",
  "Nearby-village sharing",
  "Single-village dominant"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Prevalence data
# ---------------------------------------------------------
prev_vil_use <- prev_vil_full %>%
  filter(ASV %in% target_asv) %>%
  select(ASV, village_name, village_lab, dendro_order, prev) %>%
  distinct()

prev_global_use <- global_prev_tbl %>%
  filter(ASV %in% target_asv) %>%
  transmute(
    ASV,
    village_lab = "Global",
    prev = global_prev
  )

heat_df <- bind_rows(
  prev_vil_use %>% select(ASV, village_lab, prev),
  prev_global_use
) %>%
  left_join(
    asv_subtype_tbl %>%
      select(
        ASV, subtype,
        max_node_score, sum_node_score,
        best_node_size, best_node_n_positive
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(asv_lab_use, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_lab_final = ifelse(is.na(ASV_lab_join) | ASV_lab_join == "", ASV, ASV_lab_join),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = subtype_levels),
    village_lab = factor(village_lab, levels = village_levels),
    prev_bin = bin_prev_common(prev)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Row order within subtype
#    sum_node_score first
# ---------------------------------------------------------
row_meta <- asv_subtype_tbl %>%
  filter(ASV %in% target_asv) %>%
  left_join(asv_lab_use, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_lab_final = ifelse(is.na(ASV_lab_join) | ASV_lab_join == "", ASV, ASV_lab_join),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = subtype_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    subtype,
    desc(sum_node_score),
    desc(max_node_score),
    desc(best_node_n_positive),
    desc(best_node_size),
    ASV
  ) %>%
  mutate(row_order = row_number())

asv_levels_top_to_bottom <- row_meta$ASV_lab_final

heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_lab = factor(ASV_lab_final, levels = rev(asv_levels_top_to_bottom))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Left subtype annotation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
anno_left_df <- row_meta %>%
  transmute(
    ASV_lab = factor(ASV_lab_final, levels = rev(asv_levels_top_to_bottom)),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = subtype_levels)
  )

subtype_cols <- c(
  "Regional sharing" = "#7570b3",
  "Nearby-village sharing" = "#d95f02",
  "Single-village dominant" = "#1b9e77"
)

p_left <- ggplot(anno_left_df, aes(x = 1, y = ASV_lab, fill = subtype)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = subtype_cols,
    drop = FALSE,
    name = "Subtype",
    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 2, 0),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 0, 5.5, 8)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Main prevalence heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_main <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = village_lab, y = ASV_lab, fill = prev_bin)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = prev_bin_pal,
    limits = prev_bin_levels,
    drop = FALSE,
    na.value = "grey95",
    name = "Prevalence (%)"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = village_levels, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Village-enriched ASVs ordered by subtype",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 18),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 5.5, 5.5, 0)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Right summary strips
#    - node-score metrics, not prevalence-bin colors
# ---------------------------------------------------------
strip_df <- row_meta %>%
  transmute(
    ASV_lab = factor(ASV_lab_final, levels = rev(asv_levels_top_to_bottom)),
    max_node_score,
    sum_node_score
  )

p_right_max <- ggplot(strip_df, aes(x = "Max", y = ASV_lab, fill = max_node_score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "grey95",
    high = "#1b9e77",
    name = "Max node score",
    limits = c(0, max(strip_df$max_node_score, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 0, 5.5, 0)
  )

p_right_sum <- ggplot(strip_df, aes(x = "Sum", y = ASV_lab, fill = sum_node_score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "grey95",
    high = "#b15928",
    name = "Sum node score",
    limits = c(0, max(strip_df$sum_node_score, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 5.5, 5.5, 0)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Combine
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_heat_by_subtype <- (p_left + p_main + p_right_max + p_right_sum) +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(0.5, 14, 0.7, 0.7),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "horizontal"
  )

print(p_heat_by_subtype)

save_plot_both(
  p_heat_by_subtype,
  "village_enriched_ASV_heatmap_bySubtype_v7",
  width = 19,
  height = 14
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Export tables
# - supplementary: heatmap source table
# - derived: row ordering table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(
  heat_df,
  "supplementary_village_enriched_ASV_heatmap_bySubtype_v7_data.csv"
)

write_csv(
  row_meta,
  "derived_village_enriched_ASV_heatmap_bySubtype_v7_rowmeta.csv"
)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Heatmap of global-core ASVs ordered by very-high subtype
# - subtype based on prevalence >=75% node-level structure
# - prevalence bins matched to main prevalence heatmap
# - right strips: max/sum node score only
#
# Required:
#   prev_heat_core_tmp
#   pick_core_tmp
#   global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh
#   order_tbl_core
#   base_theme
#   save_plot_both()
#
# Optional:
#   asv_label_tbl
#
# Output:
#   global_core_ASV_heatmap_bySubtype_veryHigh.png/.svg
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs <- c(
  "prev_heat_core_tmp",
  "pick_core_tmp",
  "global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh",
  "order_tbl_core",
  "base_theme",
  "save_plot_both"
)

miss <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss)) {
  stop("Required objects are missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "village_lab", "prev") %in% names(prev_heat_core_tmp)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "global_prev") %in% names(pick_core_tmp)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "subtype", "max_node_score", "sum_node_score") %in% names(global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh)))
stopifnot(all(c("village_name", "dendro_order") %in% names(order_tbl_core)))

target_asv <- unique(global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh$ASV)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0.1) Prevalence bins / palette
#     - matched to the main prevalence heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
prev_bin_levels <- c("0", "0–<20", "20–<50", "50–<75", "75–100")

prev_bin_pal <- c(
  "0" = "grey95",
  "0–<20" = "grey80",
  "20–<50" = "#fee08b",
  "50–<75" = "#f46d43",
  "75–100" = "#a50026"
)

bin_prev_common <- function(prev) {
  out <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(prev) ~ NA_character_,
    prev == 0 ~ "0",
    prev > 0 & prev < 20 ~ "0–<20",
    prev >= 20 & prev < 50 ~ "20–<50",
    prev >= 50 & prev < 75 ~ "50–<75",
    prev >= 75 ~ "75–100",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  factor(out, levels = prev_bin_levels)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) ASV labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_lab_use <- if (exists("asv_label_tbl") && all(c("ASV", "ASV_lab") %in% names(asv_label_tbl))) {
  asv_label_tbl %>%
    filter(ASV %in% target_asv) %>%
    distinct(ASV, ASV_lab) %>%
    rename(ASV_lab_join = ASV_lab)

} else if ("ASV_lab" %in% names(global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh)) {
  global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
    filter(ASV %in% target_asv) %>%
    distinct(ASV, ASV_lab) %>%
    rename(ASV_lab_join = ASV_lab)

} else {
  global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
    transmute(ASV, ASV_lab_join = ASV) %>%
    distinct()
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Village order / labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if ("village_lab" %in% names(order_tbl_core)) {
  village_order_tbl <- order_tbl_core %>%
    select(village_name, dendro_order, village_lab) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(dendro_order)

} else if ("vil_lab" %in% names(order_tbl_core)) {
  village_order_tbl <- order_tbl_core %>%
    select(village_name, dendro_order, village_lab = vil_lab) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(dendro_order)

} else {
  stop("order_tbl_core must contain either 'village_lab' or 'vil_lab'.")
}

village_levels <- c(village_order_tbl$village_lab, "Global")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Subtype order
#    top -> bottom
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtype_levels <- c(
  "Regional-structured core",
  "Nearby-structured core",
  "Single-peaked core",
  "Uniform core"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Prevalence data
# ---------------------------------------------------------
prev_vil_use <- prev_heat_core_tmp %>%
  filter(ASV %in% target_asv) %>%
  filter(village_lab %in% village_order_tbl$village_lab) %>%
  select(ASV, village_lab, prev) %>%
  distinct()

prev_global_use <- pick_core_tmp %>%
  filter(ASV %in% target_asv) %>%
  transmute(
    ASV,
    village_lab = "Global",
    prev = global_prev
  )

heat_df <- bind_rows(
  prev_vil_use,
  prev_global_use
) %>%
  left_join(
    global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
      select(
        ASV, subtype,
        max_node_score, sum_node_score,
        best_node_size, best_node_n_positive
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(asv_lab_use, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_lab_final = ifelse(
      is.na(ASV_lab_join) | ASV_lab_join == "",
      ASV,
      ASV_lab_join
    ),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = subtype_levels),
    village_lab = factor(village_lab, levels = village_levels),
    prev_bin = bin_prev_common(prev)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Row order within subtype
#    - structured subtype first
#    - within subtype: sum_node_score first
# ---------------------------------------------------------
row_meta <- global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
  filter(ASV %in% target_asv) %>%
  left_join(asv_lab_use, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_lab_final = ifelse(
      is.na(ASV_lab_join) | ASV_lab_join == "",
      ASV,
      ASV_lab_join
    ),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = subtype_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    subtype,
    desc(sum_node_score),
    desc(max_node_score),
    desc(best_node_n_positive),
    desc(best_node_size),
    ASV
  ) %>%
  mutate(row_order = row_number())

asv_levels_top_to_bottom <- row_meta$ASV_lab_final

heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_lab = factor(ASV_lab_final, levels = rev(asv_levels_top_to_bottom))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Left subtype annotation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
anno_left_df <- row_meta %>%
  transmute(
    ASV_lab = factor(ASV_lab_final, levels = rev(asv_levels_top_to_bottom)),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = subtype_levels)
  )

subtype_cols <- c(
  "Regional-structured core" = "#7570b3",
  "Nearby-structured core"   = "#d95f02",
  "Single-peaked core"       = "#1b9e77",
  "Uniform core"             = "grey70"
)

p_left <- ggplot(anno_left_df, aes(x = 1, y = ASV_lab, fill = subtype)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = subtype_cols,
    drop = FALSE,
    name = "Subtype",
    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 2, 0),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 0, 5.5, 8)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Main prevalence heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_main <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = village_lab, y = ASV_lab, fill = prev_bin)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = prev_bin_pal,
    limits = prev_bin_levels,
    drop = FALSE,
    na.value = "grey95",
    name = "Prevalence (%)"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = village_levels, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Global-core ASVs ordered by very-high-prevalence subtype",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 18),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 5.5, 5.5, 0)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Right summary strips
#    - node-score metrics only
# ---------------------------------------------------------
strip_df <- row_meta %>%
  transmute(
    ASV_lab = factor(ASV_lab_final, levels = rev(asv_levels_top_to_bottom)),
    max_node_score,
    sum_node_score
  )

p_right_max <- ggplot(strip_df, aes(x = "Max", y = ASV_lab, fill = max_node_score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "grey95",
    high = "#1b9e77",
    name = "Max node score",
    limits = c(0, max(strip_df$max_node_score, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 0, 5.5, 0)
  )

p_right_sum <- ggplot(strip_df, aes(x = "Sum", y = ASV_lab, fill = sum_node_score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "grey95",
    high = "#b15928",
    name = "Sum node score",
    limits = c(0, max(strip_df$sum_node_score, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 5.5, 5.5, 0)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Combine
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_heat_by_subtype <- (p_left + p_main + p_right_max + p_right_sum) +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(0.5, 14, 0.7, 0.7),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "horizontal"
  )

print(p_heat_by_subtype)

save_plot_both(
  p_heat_by_subtype,
  "global_core_ASV_heatmap_bySubtype_veryHigh",
  width = 19,
  height = 14
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Export tables
# - supplementary: heatmap source table
# - derived: row ordering table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(
  heat_df,
  "supplementary_global_core_ASV_heatmap_bySubtype_veryHigh_data.csv"
)

write_csv(
  row_meta,
  "derived_global_core_ASV_heatmap_bySubtype_veryHigh_rowmeta.csv"
)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Combined heatmap:
#   Global-core ASVs + Village-enriched ASVs
# - rows grouped by ASV class and subtype
# - columns: villages ordered by dendrogram + Global
# - fill: prevalence bins
# - right strips: max/sum node score
#
# Required:
#   prev_heat_core_tmp
#   pick_core_tmp
#   global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh
#   prev_vil_full
#   global_prev_tbl
#   asv_subtype_tbl
#   order_tbl_core
#   base_theme
#   save_plot_both()
#
# Optional:
#   asv_label_tbl
#
# Output:
#   combined_globalCore_villageEnriched_ASV_heatmap_bySubtype.png/.svg
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs <- c(
  "prev_heat_core_tmp",
  "pick_core_tmp",
  "global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh",
  "prev_vil_full",
  "global_prev_tbl",
  "asv_subtype_tbl",
  "order_tbl_core",
  "base_theme",
  "save_plot_both"
)

miss <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss)) {
  stop("Required objects are missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "village_lab", "prev") %in% names(prev_heat_core_tmp)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "global_prev") %in% names(pick_core_tmp)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "subtype", "max_node_score", "sum_node_score") %in% names(global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "village_lab", "prev") %in% names(prev_vil_full)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "global_prev") %in% names(global_prev_tbl)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "subtype", "max_node_score", "sum_node_score") %in% names(asv_subtype_tbl)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0.1) Prevalence bins / palette
# ---------------------------------------------------------
prev_bin_levels <- c("0", "0–<20", "20–<50", "50–<75", "75–100")

prev_bin_pal <- c(
  "0" = "grey95",
  "0–<20" = "grey80",
  "20–<50" = "#fee08b",
  "50–<75" = "#f46d43",
  "75–100" = "#a50026"
)

bin_prev_common <- function(prev) {
  out <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(prev) ~ NA_character_,
    prev == 0 ~ "0",
    prev > 0 & prev < 20 ~ "0–<20",
    prev >= 20 & prev < 50 ~ "20–<50",
    prev >= 50 & prev < 75 ~ "50–<75",
    prev >= 75 ~ "75–100",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  factor(out, levels = prev_bin_levels)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Village order / labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if ("village_lab" %in% names(order_tbl_core)) {
  village_order_tbl <- order_tbl_core %>%
    select(village_name, dendro_order, village_lab) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(dendro_order)

} else if ("vil_lab" %in% names(order_tbl_core)) {
  village_order_tbl <- order_tbl_core %>%
    select(village_name, dendro_order, village_lab = vil_lab) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(dendro_order)

} else {
  stop("order_tbl_core must contain either 'village_lab' or 'vil_lab'.")
}

village_levels <- c(village_order_tbl$village_lab, "Global")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) ASV labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
all_target_asv <- unique(c(
  global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh$ASV,

))

asv_lab_use <- if (exists("asv_label_tbl") && all(c("ASV", "ASV_lab") %in% names(asv_label_tbl))) {

    filter(ASV %in% all_target_asv) %>%
    distinct(ASV, ASV_lab) %>%
    rename(ASV_lab_join = ASV_lab)
} else {
  tibble(
    ASV = all_target_asv,
    ASV_lab_join = all_target_asv
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Global-core data
# ---------------------------------------------------------
gc_target_asv <- unique(global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh$ASV)

gc_prev_vil <- prev_heat_core_tmp %>%
  filter(ASV %in% gc_target_asv) %>%

gc_prev_global <- pick_core_tmp %>%

  )

gc_heat_df <- bind_rows(gc_prev_vil, gc_prev_global) %>%
  left_join(

        ASV, subtype,

        best_node_size, best_node_n_positive
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_class = "Global core"
  )

gc_row_meta <- global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
  filter(ASV %in% gc_target_asv) %>%
  select(
    ASV, subtype,
    max_node_score, sum_node_score,
    best_node_size, best_node_n_positive
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_class = "Global core"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Village-enriched data
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ve_target_asv <- unique(asv_subtype_tbl$ASV)

ve_prev_vil <- prev_vil_full %>%
  filter(ASV %in% ve_target_asv) %>%
  filter(village_lab %in% village_order_tbl$village_lab) %>%

ve_prev_global <- global_prev_tbl %>%

  )

ve_heat_df <- bind_rows(ve_prev_vil, ve_prev_global) %>%
  left_join(

        ASV, subtype,

      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_class = "Village-enriched"
  )

ve_row_meta <- asv_subtype_tbl %>%
  filter(ASV %in% ve_target_asv) %>%
  select(
    ASV, subtype,
    max_node_score, sum_node_score,
    best_node_size, best_node_n_positive
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_class = "Village-enriched"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Combine heatmap data
# ---------------------------------------------------------
heat_df <- bind_rows(gc_heat_df, ve_heat_df) %>%
  left_join(asv_lab_use, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_lab_final = ifelse(
      is.na(ASV_lab_join) | ASV_lab_join == "",
      ASV,
      ASV_lab_join
    ),
    village_lab = factor(village_lab, levels = village_levels),
    prev_bin = bin_prev_common(prev)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Combined row order
# ---------------------------------------------------------
class_levels <- c(
  "Global core",
  "Village-enriched"
)

gc_subtype_levels <- c(
  "Regional-structured core",
  "Nearby-structured core",
  "Single-peaked core",
  "Uniform core"
)

ve_subtype_levels <- c(
  "Regional sharing",
  "Nearby-village sharing",
  "Single-village dominant"
)

subtype_levels_all <- c(gc_subtype_levels, ve_subtype_levels)

row_meta <- bind_rows(gc_row_meta, ve_row_meta) %>%
  left_join(asv_lab_use, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_lab_final = ifelse(
      is.na(ASV_lab_join) | ASV_lab_join == "",
      ASV,
      ASV_lab_join
    ),
    ASV_class = factor(ASV_class, levels = class_levels),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = subtype_levels_all)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    ASV_class,
    subtype,
    desc(sum_node_score),
    desc(max_node_score),
    desc(best_node_n_positive),
    desc(best_node_size),
    ASV
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    row_order = row_number()
  )

# Make row labels unique if duplicated ASV labels exist
row_meta <- row_meta %>%
  mutate(
    row_label = paste0(ASV_lab_final, " [", ASV_class, "]")
  )

heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  left_join(
    row_meta %>% select(ASV, ASV_class, row_label),
    by = c("ASV", "ASV_class")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_row = factor(row_label, levels = rev(row_meta$row_label))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Left annotations: ASV class + subtype
# ---------------------------------------------------------
anno_left_df <- row_meta %>%

  )

class_cols <- c(

)

p_left_class <- ggplot(anno_left_df, aes(x = "Class", y = ASV_row, fill = ASV_class)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = class_cols,

  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +

    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 0, 5.5, 8)

p_left_subtype <- ggplot(anno_left_df, aes(x = "Subtype", y = ASV_row, fill = subtype)) +

  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Main prevalence heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_main <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = village_lab, y = ASV_row, fill = prev_bin)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +

  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = village_levels, drop = FALSE) +

  ) +
  base_theme +

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Right summary strips: Max / Sum node score
# ---------------------------------------------------------
strip_df <- row_meta %>%
  transmute(
    ASV_row = factor(row_label, levels = rev(row_meta$row_label)),

p_right_max <- ggplot(strip_df, aes(x = "Max", y = ASV_row, fill = max_node_score)) +

    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),

p_right_sum <- ggplot(strip_df, aes(x = "Sum", y = ASV_row, fill = sum_node_score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(

    high = "#b15928",

  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +

    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 5.5, 5.5, 0)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Combine
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_combined_heatmap <- (
  p_left_class +

    p_main +

) +
  plot_layout(

    guides = "collect"
  ) &

    legend.position = "top",

  )

print(p_combined_heatmap)

save_plot_both(

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Export tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(

  "supplementary_combined_globalCore_villageEnriched_ASV_heatmap_bySubtype_data.csv"
)

write_csv(
  row_meta,
  "derived_combined_globalCore_villageEnriched_ASV_heatmap_bySubtype_rowmeta.csv"
```
