```{r}
# ============================================================
# Village-level local enrichment (intra > inter villages only)
# + abundance significance marks on heatmap
#
# FOUNDATION prerequisites:
#   - asv_raw  : original ASV abundance table
#   - merged   : metadata table
#   - vil_tbl  : village coordinate / label table
#   - vil_cmp  : village-wise intra/inter comparison table
#   - save_plot_both()
#
# Outputs:
#   - fig_sigASV_heatmap_allSig_stair_vlab_abMark.png/.svg
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
})

fmt_p_label <- function(p, prefix = "Padj") {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    NA_character_,
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      paste0(prefix, "=", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2)),
      paste0(prefix, "=", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3))
    )
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Preconditions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("asv_raw"), exists("merged"), exists("vil_cmp"), exists("save_plot_both"))

if (!exists("base_theme")) {
  base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.title    = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.text     = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title  = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      legend.text   = element_text(size = 14)
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) ASV alias + columns
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv <- asv_raw
ASV_col <- "ASV"
tax_col <- "Taxon"
stopifnot(all(c(ASV_col, tax_col) %in% names(asv)))

sample_cols <- setdiff(names(asv), c(ASV_col, tax_col))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) meta_min from merged
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "village_name") %in% names(merged)))

meta_min <- merged %>%
  transmute(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    village_name = as.character(village_name)
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(sampleid %in% sample_cols)

stopifnot(nrow(meta_min) > 0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Build vil_id_map2 (village_name -> village_id / village_lab)
#    - prefer vil_tbl from FOUNDATION
#    - otherwise fallback to merged + vil_id
# ---------------------------------------------------------
norm_name <- function(x) str_squish(str_trim(as.character(x)))

vil_n_tbl <- meta_min %>%
  mutate(village_name_norm = norm_name(village_name)) %>%
  count(village_name_norm, name = "n_samples")

if (exists("vil_tbl")) {
  stopifnot(all(c("label", "vil_id") %in% names(vil_tbl)))

  vil_id_map2 <- vil_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      village_name = as.character(label),
      village_name_norm = norm_name(label),
      village_id = as.character(vil_id)
    ) %>%
    distinct(village_name_norm, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    left_join(vil_n_tbl, by = "village_name_norm") %>%
    mutate(
      n_samples = as.integer(n_samples),
      village_lab = sprintf(
        "%s (n=%s)",
        village_id,
        ifelse(is.na(n_samples), "NA", n_samples)
      )
    ) %>%
    select(village_name, village_id, n_samples, village_lab, village_name_norm)

} else {
  if (!("vil_id" %in% names(merged))) {
    stop("Neither vil_tbl nor merged$vil_id is available. Please create village IDs first.")
  }

  vil_id_map2 <- merged %>%
    transmute(
      village_name = as.character(village_name),
      village_name_norm = norm_name(village_name),
      village_id = as.character(vil_id)
    ) %>%
    distinct(village_name_norm, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    left_join(vil_n_tbl, by = "village_name_norm") %>%
    mutate(
      n_samples = as.integer(n_samples),
      village_lab = sprintf(
        "%s (n=%s)",
        village_id,
        ifelse(is.na(n_samples), "NA", n_samples)
      )
    ) %>%
    select(village_name, village_id, n_samples, village_lab, village_name_norm)
}

stopifnot(all(c("village_name", "village_id", "village_lab") %in% names(vil_id_map2)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Extend vil_cmp with village_lab and keep intra > inter villages
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(all(c("village_name", "delta_pct") %in% names(vil_cmp)))

vil_cmp2 <- vil_cmp %>%
  mutate(
    village_name = as.character(village_name),
    village_name_norm = norm_name(village_name)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    vil_id_map2 %>% select(village_name_norm, village_id, village_lab),
    by = "village_name_norm"
  )

v_intra_gt_inter_lab <- vil_cmp2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(delta_pct), delta_pct > 0) %>%
  distinct(village_lab) %>%
  pull(village_lab)

message("Number of intra>inter villages (village_lab): ", length(v_intra_gt_inter_lab))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Build PA long table and attach village_lab
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_min2 <- meta_min %>%
  mutate(village_name_norm = norm_name(village_name)) %>%
  left_join(
    vil_id_map2 %>% select(village_name_norm, village_lab),
    by = "village_name_norm"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(village_lab)) %>%
  distinct(sampleid, village_lab)

stopifnot(nrow(meta_min2) > 0)

asv_pa2 <- asv %>%
  select(all_of(c(ASV_col, tax_col, sample_cols))) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(sample_cols), ~ as.integer(replace_na(., 0) >= 0.001)))

pa_long <- asv_pa2 %>%
  select(all_of(c(ASV_col, sample_cols))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_cols), names_to = "sampleid", values_to = "pres") %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    pres = as.integer(pres)
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_min2, by = "sampleid") %>%
  filter(!is.na(village_lab))

N_total <- pa_long %>%
  distinct(sampleid) %>%
  nrow()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Counts by (village_lab, ASV)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
vil_n <- pa_long %>%
  distinct(sampleid, village_lab) %>%
  count(village_lab, name = "n_v")

vil_asv_k <- pa_long %>%
  group_by(village_lab, ASV) %>%
  summarise(k_v = sum(pres, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

asv_k_total <- pa_long %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(k_total = sum(pres, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

df_cnt <- vil_asv_k %>%
  left_join(vil_n, by = "village_lab") %>%
  left_join(asv_k_total, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    n_rest = N_total - n_v,
    k_rest = k_total - k_v
  ) %>%
  filter(village_lab %in% v_intra_gt_inter_lab)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Fisher exact test (one-sided) + BH within village
# ---------------------------------------------------------
fisher_one <- function(k_v, n_v, k_rest, n_rest) {
  if (any(is.na(c(k_v, n_v, k_rest, n_rest)))) return(list(p = NA_real_, or = NA_real_))
  if (n_v <= 0 || n_rest <= 0) return(list(p = NA_real_, or = NA_real_))
  if (k_v < 0 || k_rest < 0) return(list(p = NA_real_, or = NA_real_))
  if (k_v > n_v || k_rest > n_rest) return(list(p = NA_real_, or = NA_real_))

  mat <- matrix(c(k_v, n_v - k_v, k_rest, n_rest - k_rest), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)

  out <- tryCatch({
    ft <- fisher.test(mat, alternative = "greater")
    list(p = unname(ft$p.value), or = unname(ft$estimate))
  }, error = function(e) list(p = NA_real_, or = NA_real_))

  out
}

res <- df_cnt %>%
  mutate(
    prev_v = 100 * (k_v / n_v),
    prev_rest = 100 * (k_rest / n_rest),
    delta_prev = prev_v - prev_rest
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    tmp = list(fisher_one(k_v, n_v, k_rest, n_rest)),
    p = tmp$p,
    OR = tmp$or
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-tmp) %>%
  group_by(village_lab) %>%
  mutate(q = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Genus label + village_id join
# ---------------------------------------------------------
extract_genus_fallback <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- NA_character_

  vapply(x, function(s) {
    if (is.na(s)) return("Unassigned")
    s2 <- trimws(s)

    m <- regmatches(s2, regexpr("g__[^;|]+", s2, perl = TRUE))
    if (length(m) == 1 && nchar(m) > 0) return(m)

    if (grepl(";", s2, fixed = TRUE)) {
      toks <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(s2, ";", fixed = TRUE)))
      toks <- toks[nzchar(toks)]
      if (length(toks) > 0) return(toks[length(toks)])
    }

    "Unassigned"
  }, character(1))
}

tax_map <- asv %>%
  select(all_of(c(ASV_col, tax_col))) %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = as.character(.data[[ASV_col]]),
    Taxon = as.character(.data[[tax_col]]),
    Genus = extract_genus_fallback(Taxon)
  ) %>%
  distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(ASV, Genus, Taxon)

res <- res %>%
  mutate(ASV = as.character(ASV)) %>%
  left_join(tax_map, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(ASV_lab = paste0(Genus, " | ", ASV)) %>%
  left_join(vil_id_map2 %>% select(village_id, village_lab), by = "village_lab")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Prevalence hits + staircase ordering
# ---------------------------------------------------------
q_cut <- 0.05
min_delta <- 0

res_sig <- res %>%
  filter(!is.na(q), q < q_cut, delta_prev > min_delta)

sig_summary2 <- res_sig %>%
  group_by(village_lab) %>%
  summarise(
    sig_count = n(),
    sig_sum_delta = sum(delta_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(vil_id_map2 %>% select(village_lab, village_id, village_name), by = "village_lab") %>%
  left_join(vil_cmp2 %>% select(village_lab, delta_pct, intra_pct, inter_k3_pct), by = "village_lab")

vil_keep <- sig_summary2 %>%
  filter(sig_count > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(sig_count), desc(sig_sum_delta), village_id) %>%
  pull(village_lab)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9.5) sigcount bar plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_sigcount <- sig_summary2 %>%
  filter(sig_count > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    village_lab = factor(village_lab, levels = vil_keep)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = village_lab, y = sig_count, fill = delta_pct)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey85", high = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    title = "Number of locally enriched ASVs per village (intra > inter)",
    subtitle = "Statistics: one-sided Fisher's exact test with Benjamini-Hochberg correction; village-level enriched ASVs defined as Padj < 0.05 and delta_prev > 0",
    x = "Village (sorted by sig_count)",
    y = "Significant enriched ASV count",
    fill = "delta_pct"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

print(p_sigcount)

save_plot_both(
  p_sigcount,
  "fig_sigcount_bar_vlab",
  width = 14,
  height = 6
)

build_stair_asv_order <- function(df, vil_levels) {
  seen <- character(0)
  out <- character(0)

  for (v in vil_levels) {
    v_asv <- df %>%
      filter(village_lab == v) %>%
      arrange(desc(delta_prev), q, desc(OR)) %>%
      pull(ASV_lab) %>%
      unique()

    v_new <- setdiff(v_asv, seen)
    if (length(v_new) > 0) {
      out <- c(out, v_new)
      seen <- c(seen, v_new)
    }
  }

  all_asv <- df %>% pull(ASV_lab) %>% unique()
  c(out, setdiff(all_asv, out))
}

asv_order_stair <- build_stair_asv_order(
  df = res_sig %>% filter(village_lab %in% vil_keep),
  vil_levels = vil_keep
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Abundance significance marks on prevalence hits only
#    - exact Padj labels instead of symbols
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_keep <- res_sig %>% distinct(ASV) %>% pull(ASV)

ab_long <- asv %>%
  filter(.data[[ASV_col]] %in% asv_keep) %>%
  select(all_of(c(ASV_col, sample_cols))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_cols), names_to = "sampleid", values_to = "abund") %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    abund = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(abund)),
    abund = replace_na(abund, 0)
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_min2, by = "sampleid") %>%
  filter(!is.na(village_lab)) %>%
  rename(ASV = !!sym(ASV_col))

key_tbl <- res_sig %>% distinct(village_lab, ASV)

min_n_all <- 5
min_n_pos <- 3

wilcox_greater_safe <- function(x, y) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  y <- y[!is.na(y)]

  if (length(x) < 1 || length(y) < 1) return(NA_real_)
  if (length(unique(c(x, y))) <= 1) return(NA_real_)

  tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(x, y, alternative = "greater", exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}

ab_long_split <- split(ab_long, ab_long$ASV)

ab_tests <- key_tbl %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  group_modify(function(.x, .y) {
    asv_id <- .y$ASV[[1]]
    a <- ab_long_split[[asv_id]]

    if (is.null(a) || nrow(a) == 0) {
      return(tibble(village_lab = .x$village_lab, p_all = NA_real_, p_pos = NA_real_))
    }

    purrr::map_dfr(.x$village_lab, function(v) {
      x_all <- a$abund[a$village_lab == v]
      y_all <- a$abund[a$village_lab != v]

      p_all <- NA_real_
      if (length(x_all) >= min_n_all && length(y_all) >= min_n_all) {
        p_all <- wilcox_greater_safe(x_all, y_all)
      }

      x_pos <- x_all[x_all >= 0.001]
      y_pos <- y_all[y_all >= 0.001]

      p_pos <- NA_real_
      if (length(x_pos) >= min_n_pos && length(y_pos) >= min_n_pos) {
        p_pos <- wilcox_greater_safe(x_pos, y_pos)
      }

      tibble(village_lab = v, p_all = p_all, p_pos = p_pos)
    })
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(village_lab) %>%
  mutate(
    q_all = p.adjust(p_all, method = "BH"),
    q_pos = p.adjust(p_pos, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

res_sig2 <- res_sig %>%
  left_join(ab_tests, by = c("village_lab", "ASV")) %>%
  mutate(
    mark_star = ifelse(!is.na(q_all) & q_all < 0.05, "*", ""),
    mark_dag  = ifelse(!is.na(q_pos) & q_pos < 0.05, "†", ""),
    mark_abund = paste0(mark_star, mark_dag)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Final heatmap (with exact Padj labels)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
heat_df <- res_sig2 %>%
  filter(village_lab %in% vil_keep) %>%
  mutate(
    village_lab = factor(village_lab, levels = vil_keep),
    ASV_lab = factor(ASV_lab, levels = rev(asv_order_stair))
  )

p_heat_mark <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = village_lab, y = ASV_lab, fill = delta_prev)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_text(
    data = heat_df %>% filter(mark_abund != ""),
    aes(label = mark_abund),
    inherit.aes = TRUE,
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    title = "Village signature ASVs (prevalence hits) + abundance annotation",
    subtitle = "Statistics: prevalence by one-sided Fisher's exact test with Benjamini-Hochberg correction (Padj < 0.05, delta_prev > 0); * indicates BH-adjusted Padj < 0.05 from one-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum tests using all samples including zeros, and † indicates BH-adjusted Padj < 0.05 from one-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum tests using detected-only samples",
    x = "Village (sorted by sig_count)",
    y = "Genus | ASV (staircase order)",
    fill = "delta_prev (%)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

n_asv <- n_distinct(heat_df$ASV_lab)
h <- max(6, min(22, 0.12 * n_asv + 4))

print(p_heat_mark)

save_plot_both(
  p_heat_mark,
  "fig_sigASV_heatmap_allSig_stair_vlab_abMark",
  width = 14,
  height = h
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Export tables
# - supplementary: final heatmap source data
# - derived: abundance test table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(res_sig2, "supplementary_res_sig_with_abundance_marks.csv")
write_csv(ab_tests, "derived_abundance_tests_for_marks.csv")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Cluster-wise intra-village pairs:
#   Bray-Curtis similarity (relative abundance) vs Jaccard similarity (PA)
#
# FOUNDATION objects required:
#   asv_raw
#   merged
#   vil_tbl
#   clu_pal        [optional]
#   base_theme     [optional]
#   save_plot_both
#
# Outputs:
#   - CL<k>_intraPairs_scatter_allVillages_colorAll_LM_Spearman.png/.svg
#   - optional folder CL<k>_perVillage/ with per-village plots
#   - ALLCL_intraPairs_scatter_pooled_byCluster.png/.svg
#
# Notes:
#   - Individual cluster pooled plots and per-village plots show raw P values.
#   - The all-cluster pooled plot applies BH/FDR correction across
#     Overall + C1-C4 labels, separately for LM P values and Spearman P values.
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(vegan)
  library(readr)
  library(sf)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Preconditions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("asv_raw"), exists("merged"), exists("vil_tbl"), exists("save_plot_both"))

if (!exists("clu_pal")) {
  clu_pal <- c(
    "1" = "#4E79A7",
    "2" = "#E15759",
    "3" = "#59A14F",
    "4" = "#B07AA1"
  )
}

if (!exists("base_theme")) {
  base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.title    = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.text     = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title  = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      legend.text   = element_text(size = 14)
    )
}

ASV_col <- "ASV"
tax_col <- "Taxon"

stopifnot(all(c(ASV_col, tax_col) %in% names(asv_raw)))
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "village_name", "cluster") %in% names(merged)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
SAVE_ALL_VILLAGES <- TRUE
MIN_PAIRS_PER_VILLAGE <- 10
SAVE_POOLED_ALLCLUSTERS <- TRUE

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Village label mapping
# ---------------------------------------------------------
vil_tbl_plain <- vil_tbl %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(label = as.character(label)) %>%
  select(label, vil_lab)

meta_min <- merged %>%
  transmute(
    sampleid     = as.character(sampleid),
    cluster      = as.character(cluster),
    village_name = as.character(village_name)
  ) %>%
  left_join(vil_tbl_plain, by = c("village_name" = "label")) %>%
  mutate(
    village_lab = dplyr::coalesce(as.character(vil_lab), village_name),
    cluster     = factor(cluster, levels = names(clu_pal))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster), !is.na(sampleid), !is.na(village_lab)) %>%
  distinct(sampleid, cluster, village_lab)

sample_cols <- setdiff(names(asv_raw), c(ASV_col, tax_col))

meta_min <- meta_min %>%
  filter(sampleid %in% sample_cols)

stopifnot(nrow(meta_min) > 10)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------
fmt_p_label <- function(p, prefix = "P") {
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(p))

  out[is.na(p)] <- paste0(prefix, "=NA")

  idx_e <- !is.na(p) & p < 0.001
  out[idx_e] <- paste0(prefix, "=", formatC(p[idx_e], format = "e", digits = 2))

  idx_f <- !is.na(p) & p >= 0.001
  out[idx_f] <- paste0(prefix, "=", formatC(p[idx_f], format = "f", digits = 3))

  out
}

# Return statistics as a table rather than directly making labels.
stat_LM_Spearman <- function(df, x, y, label_prefix = "Overall") {
  d <- df %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[x]]), is.finite(.data[[y]]))

  xr <- range(d[[x]], na.rm = TRUE)
  yr <- range(d[[y]], na.rm = TRUE)

  label_x <- xr[1] + 0.02 * diff(xr)
  label_y <- yr[2] - 0.02 * diff(yr)

  if (!is.finite(label_x)) label_x <- NA_real_
  if (!is.finite(label_y)) label_y <- NA_real_

  if (nrow(d) < 5 || length(unique(d[[x]])) < 3 || length(unique(d[[y]])) < 3) {
    return(tibble(
      label_prefix = label_prefix,
      r2 = NA_real_,
      p_lm = NA_real_,
      rho = NA_real_,
      p_sp = NA_real_,
      label.x = label_x,
      label.y = label_y
    ))
  }

  fit <- lm(d[[y]] ~ d[[x]])
  sm  <- summary(fit)

  r2   <- unname(sm$r.squared)
  p_lm <- unname(coef(sm)[2, 4])

  sp <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(
      d[[x]],
      d[[y]],
      method = "spearman",
      use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  )

  rho  <- unname(sp$estimate)
  p_sp <- unname(sp$p.value)

  tibble(
    label_prefix = label_prefix,
    r2 = r2,
    p_lm = p_lm,
    rho = rho,
    p_sp = p_sp,
    label.x = label_x,
    label.y = label_y
  )
}

# Make labels with either raw P or BH-adjusted Padj.
make_LM_Spearman_label <- function(tbl, adjust = FALSE) {
  tbl %>%
    mutate(
      p_lm_plot = if (adjust) p.adjust(p_lm, method = "BH") else p_lm,
      p_sp_plot = if (adjust) p.adjust(p_sp, method = "BH") else p_sp,
      p_prefix  = if (adjust) "Padj" else "P",
      label = sprintf(
        "%s: LM R²=%.2f, %s | Spearman rho=%.2f, %s",
        label_prefix,
        r2,
        fmt_p_label(p_lm_plot, p_prefix),
        rho,
        fmt_p_label(p_sp_plot, p_prefix)
      )
    )
}

make_pairs_one_village <- function(v, ids, Jsim, Bsim) {
  ids <- intersect(ids, rownames(Jsim))
  ids <- intersect(ids, rownames(Bsim))

  if (length(ids) < 2) return(NULL)

  ut <- which(upper.tri(matrix(0, length(ids), length(ids))), arr.ind = TRUE)

  tibble(
    village  = v,
    sample1  = ids[ut[, 1]],
    sample2  = ids[ut[, 2]],
    sharing  = Jsim[cbind(ids[ut[, 1]], ids[ut[, 2]])],
    bray_sim = Bsim[cbind(ids[ut[, 1]], ids[ut[, 2]])]
  )
}

build_Jsim <- function(asv_df, keep_samples) {
  tmp_pa <- asv_df %>%
    select(all_of(c(ASV_col, keep_samples))) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(keep_samples), ~ as.integer(replace_na(as.numeric(.), 0) >= 0.001)))

  M_asv_by_samp <- as.matrix(tmp_pa[, -1, drop = FALSE])
  rownames(M_asv_by_samp) <- tmp_pa[[ASV_col]]

  M <- t(M_asv_by_samp)

  Ixy <- tcrossprod(M)
  kA  <- rowSums(M)
  Uxy <- outer(kA, kA, "+") - Ixy

  Jsim <- Ixy / Uxy
  diag(Jsim) <- NA_real_
  Jsim[is.nan(Jsim)] <- NA_real_

  Jsim
}

build_Bsim <- function(asv_df, keep_samples) {
  tmp_ab <- asv_df %>%
    select(all_of(c(ASV_col, keep_samples)))

  X_asv_by_samp <- as.matrix(tmp_ab[, -1, drop = FALSE])
  rownames(X_asv_by_samp) <- tmp_ab[[ASV_col]]

  X <- t(X_asv_by_samp)

  rs <- rowSums(X, na.rm = TRUE)
  keep_nonzero <- rs > 0

  X <- X[keep_nonzero, , drop = FALSE]
  rs <- rs[keep_nonzero]

  X_rel <- X / rs
  X_rel[is.na(X_rel)] <- 0

  Dbray <- vegan::vegdist(X_rel, method = "bray")
  Bsim  <- 1 - as.matrix(Dbray)

  diag(Bsim) <- NA_real_

  Bsim
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Cluster loop
# ---------------------------------------------------------
clusters <- levels(meta_min$cluster)
clusters <- clusters[!is.na(clusters)]

pair_list_all_clusters <- list()

for (clu in clusters) {

  meta_c <- meta_min %>%
    filter(cluster == clu) %>%
    select(sampleid, village_lab) %>%
    distinct()

  if (nrow(meta_c) < 10) {
    message("Skip cluster ", clu, " (too few samples)")
    next
  }

  keep_samples <- intersect(meta_c$sampleid, sample_cols)

  if (length(keep_samples) < 10) {
    message("Skip cluster ", clu, " (too few samples after intersection)")
    next
  }

  vil2samp <- split(meta_c$sampleid, meta_c$village_lab)

  Jsim <- build_Jsim(asv_raw, keep_samples)
  Bsim <- build_Bsim(asv_raw, keep_samples)

  pair_df <- bind_rows(
    Map(
      make_pairs_one_village,
      names(vil2samp),
      vil2samp,
      MoreArgs = list(Jsim = Jsim, Bsim = Bsim)
    )
  ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(sharing), is.finite(bray_sim)) %>%
    mutate(cluster = factor(clu, levels = clusters))

  if (nrow(pair_df) < 10) {
    message("Skip cluster ", clu, " (too few intra pairs)")
    next
  }

  message(
    "Cluster ", clu,
    " | villages=", n_distinct(pair_df$village),
    " | pairs=", nrow(pair_df)
  )

  pair_list_all_clusters[[as.character(clu)]] <- pair_df

  write_csv(
    pair_df,
    paste0("supplementary_CL", clu, "_intraPairs_pairs_used_for_pooledPlot.csv")
  )

  # Cluster-specific pooled plot: raw P shown.
  lab_all <- stat_LM_Spearman(
    pair_df,
    "bray_sim",
    "sharing",
    label_prefix = "Overall"
  ) %>%
    make_LM_Spearman_label(adjust = FALSE)

  write_csv(
    lab_all,
    paste0("derived_CL", clu, "_pooledPlot_LM_Spearman_label.csv")
  )

  p_all <- ggplot(pair_df, aes(bray_sim, sharing)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = village), alpha = 0.25, size = 0.9) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      se = TRUE,
      color = "black",
      fill = "grey60",
      linewidth = 1.0
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = lab_all,
      aes(x = label.x, y = label.y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4.0,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Cluster ", clu, ": within-village pairs (pooled)"),
      subtitle = "Statistics: linear regression and Spearman rank correlation; R², rho, and P shown",
      x = "Bray-Curtis similarity (1 - distance)",
      y = "ASV sharing rate (Jaccard similarity)"
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  save_plot_both(
    p_all,
    paste0("CL", clu, "_intraPairs_scatter_allVillages_colorAll_LM_Spearman"),
    width = 10,
    height = 7
  )

  # -------------------------
  # Per-village plots
  # -------------------------
  if (isTRUE(SAVE_ALL_VILLAGES)) {
    out_dir <- paste0("CL", clu, "_perVillage")
    dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

    vlist <- sort(unique(pair_df$village))

    for (v in vlist) {
      dfv <- pair_df %>%
        filter(village == v)

      if (nrow(dfv) < MIN_PAIRS_PER_VILLAGE) next

      safe_v <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-\\(\\)\\. ]", "_", v)

      write_csv(
        dfv,
        file.path(out_dir, paste0("derived_CL", clu, "_V_", safe_v, "_pairs_used_for_villagePlot.csv"))
      )

      # Per-village plot: raw P shown.
      lab_v <- stat_LM_Spearman(
        dfv,
        "bray_sim",
        "sharing",
        label_prefix = "Village"
      ) %>%
        make_LM_Spearman_label(adjust = FALSE)

      write_csv(
        lab_v,
        file.path(out_dir, paste0("derived_CL", clu, "_V_", safe_v, "_LM_Spearman_label.csv"))
      )

      pv <- ggplot(dfv, aes(bray_sim, sharing)) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 0.9, color = "grey30") +
        geom_smooth(
          method = "lm",
          se = TRUE,
          color = "black",
          fill = "grey60",
          linewidth = 0.9
        ) +
        geom_text(
          data = lab_v,
          aes(x = label.x, y = label.y, label = label),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          hjust = 0,
          vjust = 1,
          size = 4.0,
          color = "black"
        ) +
        labs(
          title = paste0("Cluster ", clu, " | Village ", v),
          subtitle = "Statistics: linear regression and Spearman rank correlation; R², rho, and P shown",
          x = "Bray-Curtis similarity",
          y = "ASV sharing rate"
        ) +
        base_theme +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
        )

      save_plot_both(
        pv,
        file.path(out_dir, paste0("CL", clu, "_V_", safe_v, "_LM_Spearman")),
        width = 7,
        height = 5
      )
    }
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Pooled across clusters
#    - BH/FDR correction applied here
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (isTRUE(SAVE_POOLED_ALLCLUSTERS)) {

  pair_df_all <- bind_rows(pair_list_all_clusters)

  if (nrow(pair_df_all) > 10) {

    write_csv(
      pair_df_all,
      "supplementary_ALLCL_intraPairs_pairs_used_for_pooledByCluster.csv"
    )

    stats_label_by_cluster <- function(df) {
      d0 <- df %>%
        filter(is.finite(bray_sim), is.finite(sharing))

      xr <- range(d0$bray_sim, na.rm = TRUE)
      yr <- range(d0$sharing, na.rm = TRUE)

      x_left <- xr[1] + 0.02 * diff(xr)
      y_top  <- yr[2] - 0.02 * diff(yr)
      step   <- 0.06 * diff(yr)

      overall <- stat_LM_Spearman(
        d0,
        "bray_sim",
        "sharing",
        label_prefix = "Overall"
      ) %>%
        mutate(cluster = NA_character_)

      byc <- bind_rows(lapply(levels(d0$cluster), function(cc) {
        stat_LM_Spearman(
          d0 %>% filter(cluster == cc),
          "bray_sim",
          "sharing",
          label_prefix = paste0("C", cc)
        ) %>%
          mutate(cluster = as.character(cc))
      }))

      bind_rows(overall, byc) %>%
        make_LM_Spearman_label(adjust = TRUE) %>%
        mutate(
          label_order = ifelse(is.na(cluster), 0, match(cluster, levels(d0$cluster))),
          label.x = x_left,
          label.y = y_top - label_order * step
        ) %>%
        select(-label_order)
    }

    lab_all <- stats_label_by_cluster(pair_df_all)

    write_csv(
      lab_all,
      "derived_ALLCL_pooledByCluster_LM_Spearman_labels_BH.csv"
    )

    p_combined <- ggplot(pair_df_all, aes(bray_sim, sharing)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = cluster), alpha = 0.20, size = 0.9) +
      geom_smooth(
        aes(color = cluster, fill = cluster),
        method = "lm",
        se = TRUE,
        alpha = 0.10,
        linewidth = 1.0
      ) +
      geom_smooth(
        method = "lm",
        se = FALSE,
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 1.1
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = lab_all %>% filter(is.na(cluster)),
        aes(x = label.x, y = label.y, label = label),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        hjust = 0,
        vjust = 1,
        size = 4.2,
        color = "black"
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = lab_all %>% filter(!is.na(cluster)),
        aes(
          x = label.x,
          y = label.y,
          label = label,
          color = factor(cluster, levels = names(clu_pal))
        ),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        hjust = 0,
        vjust = 1,
        size = 4.2,
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = clu_pal, drop = FALSE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = clu_pal, guide = "none") +
      labs(
        title = "All clusters pooled: within-village pairs",
        subtitle = "Statistics: cluster-specific and overall linear regression plus Spearman rank correlation; R², rho, and BH-adjusted P shown",
        x = "Bray-Curtis similarity",
        y = "ASV sharing rate"
      ) +
      base_theme

    save_plot_both(
      p_combined,
      "ALLCL_intraPairs_scatter_pooled_byCluster",
      width = 10,
      height = 7
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(vegan)
  library(geodist)
  library(sf)
  library(readr)
})

# ============================================================
# Cluster-wise inter-only (within-cluster) distance vs sharing
# - distance: village-village haversine distance (km)
# - sharing : sample-pair Jaccard similarity (PA)
# - aggregate: village-pair mean sharing (inter-only)
# - weighted LM: weights = number of sample-pairs per village-pair
# - permutation: shuffle sharing_mean across village-pairs (distance fixed)
#
# FOUNDATION required:
#   asv        : raw ASV table (ASV, Taxon, sample columns)
#   meta_min   : at least sampleid, cluster, village_name (village_lab optional)
#   vil_tbl    : village table from FOUNDATION
#   clu_pal    : optional named palette for clusters
#   base_theme : optional common theme
#   save_plot_both()
#
# Outputs:
#   - DIST_vs_SHARING_INTERONLY_WEIGHTED_CL<k>_villageMean_interOnly_weighted_perm_bin.png/.svg
# ============================================================

# =======================
# Settings
# =======================
ASV_col <- "ASV"
tax_col <- "Taxon"

if (!exists("clu_pal")) {
  clu_pal <- c(
    "1" = "#4E79A7",
    "2" = "#E15759",
    "3" = "#59A14F",
    "4" = "#B07AA1"
  )
}

OUT_PREFIX <- "DIST_vs_SHARING_INTERONLY_WEIGHTED"

N_PERM <- 5000
set.seed(20260211)

K_BINS_DEFAULT <- 10
LOESS_SPAN <- 0.75

SAVE_ALL_POOLED <- FALSE
SAVE_POOLED_ALLCLUSTERS <- FALSE

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0) b else a

fmt_p_label <- function(p, prefix = "P") {
  if (is.na(p)) {
    paste0(prefix, "=NA")
  } else if (p < 0.001) {
    paste0(prefix, "=", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2))
  } else {
    paste0(prefix, "=", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3))
  }
}

# =======================
# Preconditions
# =======================
stopifnot(exists("asv"), exists("meta_min"), exists("vil_tbl"), exists("save_plot_both"))
stopifnot(all(c(ASV_col, tax_col) %in% names(asv)))
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "cluster") %in% names(meta_min)))
stopifnot(any(c("village_lab", "village_name") %in% names(meta_min)))
stopifnot(all(c("label", "vil_lab") %in% names(vil_tbl)))

sample_cols <- setdiff(names(asv), c(ASV_col, tax_col))

# =======================
# Theme
# =======================
if (!exists("base_theme")) {
  base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
    )
}

plot_theme_interonly <- base_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# =======================
# 0) Build village mapping from vil_tbl
# =======================
vil_tbl_plain <- vil_tbl %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    village_name = as.character(label),
    village_lab = as.character(vil_lab)
  ) %>%
  distinct(village_name, village_lab)

meta_min2 <- meta_min %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    cluster = as.character(cluster)
  ) %>%
  { if ("village_lab" %in% names(.)) mutate(., village_lab = as.character(village_lab)) else . } %>%
  { if ("village_name" %in% names(.)) mutate(., village_name = as.character(village_name)) else . } %>%
  { if (!("village_name" %in% names(.)) && "village_lab" %in% names(.)) {
      left_join(., vil_tbl_plain %>% distinct(village_lab, village_name), by = "village_lab")
    } else .
  } %>%
  { if (!("village_lab" %in% names(.)) && "village_name" %in% names(.)) {
      left_join(., vil_tbl_plain, by = "village_name")
    } else .
  } %>%
  { if ("village_name" %in% names(.) && "village_lab" %in% names(.)) {
      left_join(., vil_tbl_plain, by = "village_name", suffix = c("", ".tbl")) %>%
        mutate(village_lab = dplyr::coalesce(village_lab.tbl, village_lab)) %>%
        select(-village_lab.tbl)
    } else .
  } %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(cluster, levels = names(clu_pal)),
    village_lab = dplyr::coalesce(
      as.character(village_lab),
      if ("village_name" %in% names(.)) as.character(village_name) else NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sampleid), !is.na(cluster), !is.na(village_lab)) %>%
  distinct(sampleid, cluster, village_lab) %>%
  filter(sampleid %in% sample_cols)

stopifnot(nrow(meta_min2) > 10)

# =======================
# 0.5) vil_coord2 prep
# =======================
if (!exists("vil_coord2")) {
  if (exists("vil_coord")) {
    stopifnot(any(c("village_name", "label") %in% names(vil_coord)))
    stopifnot(all(c("lat", "lon") %in% names(vil_coord)))

    name_col <- if ("village_name" %in% names(vil_coord)) "village_name" else "label"

    vil_coord2 <- vil_coord %>%
      dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
      transmute(
        village_name = as.character(.data[[name_col]]),
        lat = as.numeric(lat),
        lon = as.numeric(lon)
      ) %>%
      left_join(vil_tbl_plain, by = "village_name") %>%
      mutate(village_lab = dplyr::coalesce(village_lab, village_name)) %>%
      left_join(meta_min2 %>% distinct(village_lab, cluster), by = "village_lab") %>%
      transmute(
        village_lab = as.character(village_lab),
        lat = as.numeric(lat),
        lon = as.numeric(lon),
        cluster = as.character(cluster)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(village_lab), is.finite(lat), is.finite(lon), !is.na(cluster)) %>%
      distinct(village_lab, lat, lon, cluster)

    message("[OK] built vil_coord2 from vil_coord: n=", nrow(vil_coord2))
  } else {
    stop("Neither vil_coord2 nor vil_coord is available. Coordinates are required for this analysis.")
  }
}

stopifnot(all(c("village_lab", "lat", "lon", "cluster") %in% names(vil_coord2)))

# =======================
# 1) Coordinates + village distance
# =======================
coord_src <- vil_coord2 %>%
  transmute(
    village = as.character(village_lab),
    lat = as.numeric(lat),
    lon = as.numeric(lon),
    cluster = as.character(cluster)
  ) %>%
  distinct(village, lat, lon, cluster) %>%
  filter(is.finite(lat), is.finite(lon))

stopifnot(nrow(coord_src) >= 2)

Vdist_km <- geodist::geodist(coord_src[, c("lon", "lat")], measure = "haversine") / 1000
rownames(Vdist_km) <- coord_src$village
colnames(Vdist_km) <- coord_src$village

get_vdist_km <- function(v1, v2) {
  v1 <- as.character(v1)
  v2 <- as.character(v2)
  if (identical(v1, v2)) return(0)
  if (!(v1 %in% rownames(Vdist_km)) || !(v2 %in% colnames(Vdist_km))) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(Vdist_km[v1, v2])
}

# =======================
# 2) meta aligned
# =======================
meta_s <- meta_min2 %>%
  transmute(
    sampleid = sampleid,
    cluster = as.character(cluster),
    village = as.character(village_lab)
  ) %>%
  distinct(sampleid, cluster, village) %>%
  filter(sampleid %in% sample_cols) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster), !is.na(village)) %>%
  filter(village %in% coord_src$village)

stopifnot(nrow(meta_s) > 10)

clu_levels <- names(clu_pal)
meta_s <- meta_s %>% mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = clu_levels))

s2v <- setNames(meta_s$village, meta_s$sampleid)
s2clu <- setNames(as.character(meta_s$cluster), meta_s$sampleid)

# =======================
# 3) Jaccard similarity
# =======================
keep_samples <- meta_s$sampleid

tmp_pa <- asv %>%
  select(all_of(c(ASV_col, keep_samples))) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(keep_samples), ~ as.integer(replace_na(as.numeric(.), 0) >= 0.001)))

M_asv_by_samp <- as.matrix(tmp_pa[, -1, drop = FALSE])
rownames(M_asv_by_samp) <- tmp_pa[[ASV_col]]
M <- t(M_asv_by_samp)

Ixy <- tcrossprod(M)
kA <- rowSums(M)
Uxy <- outer(kA, kA, "+") - Ixy
Jsim <- Ixy / Uxy
diag(Jsim) <- NA_real_
Jsim[is.nan(Jsim)] <- NA_real_

# =======================
# 4) Sample pairs -> village-pair means
# =======================
ids <- meta_s$sampleid
ut <- which(upper.tri(matrix(0, length(ids), length(ids))), arr.ind = TRUE)

pair_df_all <- tibble(sample1 = ids[ut[, 1]], sample2 = ids[ut[, 2]]) %>%
  mutate(
    village1 = s2v[sample1],
    village2 = s2v[sample2],
    cluster1 = s2clu[sample1],
    cluster2 = s2clu[sample2],
    sharing = Jsim[cbind(sample1, sample2)],
    distance_km = mapply(get_vdist_km, village1, village2),
    within_cluster = (cluster1 == cluster2),
    within_village = (village1 == village2)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(sharing), is.finite(distance_km))

pair_df_vmean <- pair_df_all %>%
  filter(within_cluster, !within_village) %>%
  mutate(
    vA = pmin(village1, village2),
    vB = pmax(village1, village2),
    cluster = factor(cluster1, levels = clu_levels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(cluster, vA, vB) %>%
  summarise(
    distance_km = first(distance_km),
    sharing_mean = mean(sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_pairs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(distance_km), is.finite(sharing_mean), n_pairs > 0)

write_csv(
  pair_df_vmean,
  sprintf("supplementary_%s_villagePairMean_INTERONLY_withinCluster.csv", OUT_PREFIX)
)

# =======================
# 5) Distance-bin summary
# =======================
make_quantile_bins <- function(x, k) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  ux <- length(unique(x))
  if (ux < 2) return(NULL)
  k_eff <- min(k, ux)
  probs <- seq(0, 1, length.out = k_eff + 1)
  br <- unique(as.numeric(quantile(x, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)))
  if (length(br) < 3) return(NULL)
  br
}

bin_summary_one_cluster <- function(df, k_bins = K_BINS_DEFAULT) {
  d <- df %>% filter(is.finite(distance_km), is.finite(sharing_mean), n_pairs > 0)
  if (nrow(d) < 5) return(NULL)

  br <- make_quantile_bins(d$distance_km, k_bins)
  if (is.null(br)) return(NULL)

  d2 <- d %>%
    mutate(bin = cut(distance_km, breaks = br, include.lowest = TRUE, right = TRUE)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(bin))

  if (nrow(d2) < 5) return(NULL)

  d2 %>%
    group_by(cluster, bin) %>%
    summarise(
      bin_lo = min(distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
      bin_hi = max(distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
      bin_mid = median(distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_village_pairs = n(),
      sum_w = sum(n_pairs, na.rm = TRUE),
      sharing_wmean = weighted.mean(sharing_mean, w = n_pairs, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(bin_mid)
}

bin_summaries <- bind_rows(lapply(levels(pair_df_vmean$cluster), function(cc) {
  bin_summary_one_cluster(pair_df_vmean %>% filter(cluster == cc), k_bins = K_BINS_DEFAULT)
}))

write_csv(
  bin_summaries,
  sprintf("derived_%s_distanceBinSummary_byCluster.csv", OUT_PREFIX)
)

# =======================
# 6) Permutation test per cluster
# =======================
weighted_lm_stats <- function(d) {
  fit <- lm(sharing_mean ~ distance_km, data = d, weights = n_pairs)
  sm <- summary(fit)
  list(
    slope = unname(coef(fit)[2]),
    r2 = unname(sm$r.squared),
    p = unname(coef(sm)[2, 4])
  )
}

spearman_stats <- function(d) {
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(d$distance_km, d$sharing_mean, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  list(rho = unname(ct$estimate), p = unname(ct$p.value))
}

perm_test_cluster <- function(d, n_perm = N_PERM) {
  d <- d %>% filter(is.finite(distance_km), is.finite(sharing_mean), n_pairs > 0)
  if (nrow(d) < 5 || length(unique(d$distance_km)) < 3) {
    return(tibble(
      cluster = unique(d$cluster)[1] %||% NA_character_,
      n_village_pairs = nrow(d),
      sum_w_pairs = sum(d$n_pairs),
      slope_wLM = NA_real_,
      r2_wLM = NA_real_,
      p_wLM_slope = NA_real_,
      p_perm_wLM_slope = NA_real_,
      rho_spearman = NA_real_,
      p_spearman = NA_real_,
      p_perm_spearman = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  obs_lm <- weighted_lm_stats(d)
  obs_sp <- spearman_stats(d)

  y <- d$sharing_mean
  perm_slope <- numeric(n_perm)
  perm_rho <- numeric(n_perm)

  for (b in seq_len(n_perm)) {
    dp <- d
    dp$sharing_mean <- sample(y, replace = FALSE)
    perm_slope[b] <- weighted_lm_stats(dp)$slope
    perm_rho[b] <- spearman_stats(dp)$rho
  }

  p_perm_slope <- (sum(abs(perm_slope) >= abs(obs_lm$slope)) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)
  p_perm_rho <- (sum(abs(perm_rho) >= abs(obs_sp$rho)) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)

  tibble(
    cluster = unique(d$cluster),
    n_village_pairs = nrow(d),
    sum_w_pairs = sum(d$n_pairs),
    slope_wLM = obs_lm$slope,
    r2_wLM = obs_lm$r2,
    p_wLM_slope = obs_lm$p,
    p_perm_wLM_slope = p_perm_slope,
    rho_spearman = obs_sp$rho,
    p_spearman = obs_sp$p,
    p_perm_spearman = p_perm_rho
  )
}

perm_results <- bind_rows(lapply(levels(pair_df_vmean$cluster), function(cc) {
  perm_test_cluster(pair_df_vmean %>% filter(cluster == cc), n_perm = N_PERM)
}))

write_csv(
  perm_results,
  sprintf("derived_%s_permutationResults_byCluster.csv", OUT_PREFIX)
)

# =======================
# 7) Cluster plots
# =======================
plot_cluster <- function(cc) {
  df <- pair_df_vmean %>% filter(cluster == cc)
  if (nrow(df) < 3) return(NULL)

  col <- clu_pal[[as.character(cc)]] %||% "grey40"

  st <- perm_results %>% filter(cluster == cc)
  st_lab <- if (nrow(st) == 1) {
    paste(
      sprintf("Weighted LM slope=%.4f | R²=%.2f", st$slope_wLM, st$r2_wLM),
      sprintf("%s | %s", fmt_p_label(st$p_wLM_slope, "P"), fmt_p_label(st$p_perm_wLM_slope, "Pperm")),
      sprintf("Spearman ρ=%.2f | %s | %s", st$rho_spearman, fmt_p_label(st$p_spearman, "P"), fmt_p_label(st$p_perm_spearman, "Pperm")),
      sprintf("n(vpairs)=%d | sum_w=%d", st$n_village_pairs, st$sum_w_pairs),
      sep = "\n"
    )
  } else "Stats: NA"

  bins <- bin_summaries %>% filter(cluster == cc)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(distance_km, sharing_mean)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 2.0, color = col) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "loess", se = TRUE, span = LOESS_SPAN, linewidth = 1.1,
      color = col, fill = col, alpha = 0.12
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.1, linetype = "dashed",
      color = col, aes(weight = n_pairs)
    ) +
    {
      if (nrow(bins) > 0)
        geom_point(
          data = bins, aes(x = bin_mid, y = sharing_wmean),
          inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 21, stroke = 0.8, size = 3.2,
          color = "black", fill = col, alpha = 0.9
        )
    } +
    {
      if (nrow(bins) > 0)
        geom_line(
          data = bins, aes(x = bin_mid, y = sharing_wmean),
          inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9, color = "black", alpha = 0.9
        )
    } +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = min(df$distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
      y = max(df$sharing_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      label = st_lab, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4.5, color = col
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Cluster ", cc, ": distance vs ASV sharing (inter-only, village-pair mean)"),
      subtitle = "Statistics: weighted linear regression and Spearman rank correlation; labels show observed P and permutation Pperm. Solid = LOESS, dashed = weighted LM, black points/line = distance-bin weighted means.",
      x = "Distance between villages (km) (inter-only)",
      y = "Mean ASV sharing rate (cross-village sample pairs)"
    ) +
    plot_theme_interonly

  out_base <- sprintf("%s_CL%s_villageMean_interOnly_weighted_perm_bin", OUT_PREFIX, cc)
  save_plot_both(p, out_base, width = 12, height = 8)

  p
}

invisible(lapply(levels(pair_df_vmean$cluster), plot_cluster))

message("DONE (cluster-wise inter-only weighted_perm_bin). Outputs prefix: ", OUT_PREFIX)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# CL2 (Cluster 2) — mountain-block analysis
#
# INPUT:

# -----------------------------

fmt_p_label <- function(p, prefix = "P") {
  out <- ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    paste0(prefix, "=NA"),
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      paste0(prefix, "=", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2)),
      paste0(prefix, "=", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3))
    )
  )
  out
}

# -----------------------------
# Preconditions
# -----------------------------
stopifnot(exists("pair_df_vmean"), exists("save_plot_both"))

if (!("dist_km" %in% names(d0)) && "distance_km" %in% names(d0)) {

}
stopifnot(all(c("cluster", "dist_km", "sharing_mean") %in% names(d0)))

if (!all(c("vA", "vB") %in% names(d0))) {

}

plot_theme_cl2 <- base_theme

# -----------------------------
# 1) V00 normalization

norm_village <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- toupper(trimws(x))
  x <- sub("\\s*\\(.*\\)$", "", x)
  x <- gsub("[^A-Z0-9]", "", x)
  x <- sub("^V+", "V", x)
  num <- sub("^V", "", x)
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(num))
  ifelse(is.na(num), NA_character_, sprintf("V%02d", num))
}

d0 <- d0 %>%
  mutate(
    vA_key = norm_village(vA),
    vB_key = norm_village(vB)
  )

# -----------------------------
# 2) grp_tbl_raw: A/B/C mapping for CL2
# -----------------------------
grp_tbl_raw <- tibble(
  village_raw = c(
    "v04","v05","v06","v07","v11","v08","v09","v10",
    "v12","v14","v16","v17","v18","v13","v15","v19","v20","v21","v22","v23",
    "v24","v25","v26","v27","v28","v29","v30","v31","v33","v34","v38","v40","v42"
  ),
  block = c(
    rep("A", 8),

  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    village_key = norm_village(village_raw),
    block = as.character(block)
  )

grp_tbl <- grp_tbl_raw %>%
  group_by(village_key) %>%
  summarise(block = dplyr::last(block), .groups = "drop")

# -----------------------------

d_base <- d0 %>%
  filter(as.character(cluster) == TARGET_CLUSTER) %>%
  filter(is.finite(dist_km), is.finite(sharing_mean), is.finite(n_pairs), n_pairs > 0) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vA_key), !is.na(vB_key), vA_key != vB_key) %>%
  left_join(grp_tbl %>% rename(vA_key = village_key, blockA = block), by = "vA_key") %>%
  left_join(grp_tbl %>% rename(vB_key = village_key, blockB = block), by = "vB_key") %>%
  mutate(
    block_pair = case_when(
      is.na(blockA) | is.na(blockB) ~ "UNK",
      blockA == blockB ~ paste0(blockA, "-", blockB),
      TRUE ~ paste0(pmin(blockA, blockB), "-", pmax(blockA, blockB))
    ),
    pair_type = case_when(
      block_pair %in% c("A-A", "B-B", "C-C") ~ "Within",
      block_pair %in% c("A-B", "A-C", "B-C") ~ "Cross",
      TRUE ~ "UNK"
    ),
    group3 = case_when(
      block_pair %in% c("A-A", "B-B", "C-C") ~ "Within",
      block_pair %in% c("A-B", "B-C") ~ "Cross_AB_BC",
      block_pair %in% c("A-C") ~ "Cross_AC",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(vA_key, vB_key, .keep_all = TRUE)

stopifnot(nrow(d_base) > 10)

write_csv(
  d_base,
  sprintf("supplementary_%s_pairData_used.csv", OUT_PREFIX_SCATTER)
)

p_blockpair <- ggplot(d_block, aes(dist_km, sharing_mean)) +

    x = "Distance between villages (km)",

print(p_blockpair)

save_plot_both(

# ---- (A2) 2-color: Within vs Cross (+UNK grey) ----
pal_2c <- c(
  Within = "#1b9e77",
  Cross = "#d95f02",
  UNK = "grey70"
)

p_2color <- ggplot(d_block, aes(dist_km, sharing_mean)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = pair_type, size = n_pairs),
    alpha = PT_ALPHA, shape = 19
  ) +

    method = "loess", se = TRUE, span = LOESS_SPAN_SCATTER,

  ) +

    title = "Cluster 2: distance vs ASV sharing (Within vs Cross)",
    subtitle = "Descriptive plot; no inferential statistical test shown. Within = A-A/B-B/C-C, Cross = A-B/A-C/B-C, UNK = missing block. Solid = LOESS.",
    x = "Distance between villages (km)",

  ) +

print(p_2color)

save_plot_both(
  p_2color,
  sprintf("%s_SCATTER_2COLOR_within_cross", OUT_PREFIX_SCATTER),
  width = 11,
  height = 7.2
)

# =========================================================
# PART B) Support-window slope check
# =========================================================
if (SLOPE_MODE == "ThreeGroup") {
  d_slope <- d_base %>%
    filter(!is.na(group3), block_pair != "UNK") %>%
    mutate(group = group3)
  groups_use <- c("Within", "Cross_AB_BC", "Cross_AC")
} else {
  d_slope <- d_base %>%
    filter(pair_type %in% c("Within", "Cross")) %>%
    mutate(group = pair_type)
  groups_use <- c("Within", "Cross")
}

stopifnot(nrow(d_slope) > 10)

write_csv(
  d_slope,
  sprintf("supplementary_%s_pairData_used.csv", OUT_PREFIX)
)

find_support_window <- function(df, bin_width = 1.0, min_per_bin = 3, min_bins = 4) {
  x <- df$dist_km
  b <- floor(x / bin_width)

  tab <- tibble(bin = b) %>%
    count(bin, name = "n") %>%
    arrange(bin) %>%
    mutate(ok = n >= min_per_bin)

  if (!any(tab$ok)) return(NULL)

  tab <- tab %>%
    mutate(run = cumsum(ok != lag(ok, default = first(ok)) | (bin != lag(bin, default = first(bin)) + 1)))

  runs_ok <- tab %>%
    filter(ok) %>%
    group_by(run) %>%
    summarise(
      bin_start = min(bin),
      bin_end   = max(bin),
      n_bins    = n(),
      n_points  = sum(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n_bins >= min_bins)

  if (nrow(runs_ok) == 0) return(NULL)

  best <- runs_ok %>%
    arrange(desc(n_bins), desc(n_points)) %>%
    slice(1)

  list(
    x_min = best$bin_start * bin_width,
    x_max = (best$bin_end + 1) * bin_width,
    best = best
  )
}

fit_slope_in_window <- function(df, w) {
  dd <- df %>% filter(dist_km >= w$x_min, dist_km <= w$x_max)
  if (nrow(dd) < 10 || length(unique(dd$dist_km)) < 3) return(NULL)

  fit <- lm(sharing_mean ~ dist_km, data = dd)
  broom::tidy(fit) %>%
    filter(term == "dist_km") %>%
    transmute(
      slope = estimate,
      se = std.error,
      t = statistic,
      p = p.value,
      n_used = nrow(dd),
      x_min = w$x_min,
      x_max = w$x_max
    )
}

res <- bind_rows(lapply(groups_use, function(g) {
  dg <- d_slope %>% filter(group == g)
  w <- find_support_window(dg, bin_width, min_per_bin, min_bins)

  if (is.null(w)) {
    return(tibble(
      group = g, slope = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, t = NA_real_, p = NA_real_,
      n_used = NA_integer_, x_min = NA_real_, x_max = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  sl <- fit_slope_in_window(dg, w)
  if (is.null(sl)) {
    return(tibble(
      group = g, slope = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, t = NA_real_, p = NA_real_,
      n_used = NA_integer_, x_min = w$x_min, x_max = w$x_max
    ))
  }

  sl %>% mutate(group = g)
}))

print(res)

write_csv(
  res,
  sprintf("derived_%s_slope_table.csv", OUT_PREFIX)
)

win_tbl <- res %>%
  select(group, x_min, x_max)

d2 <- d_slope %>%
  left_join(win_tbl, by = "group") %>%
  mutate(
    in_support = is.finite(x_min) & dist_km >= x_min & dist_km <= x_max
  )

# label table for slope plot
xr <- range(d2$dist_km, na.rm = TRUE)
yr <- range(d2$sharing_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
x_left <- xr[1] + 0.02 * diff(xr)
y_top  <- yr[2] - 0.02 * diff(yr)
y_step <- max(0.06 * diff(yr), 1e-6)

label_tbl <- res %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      group,
      ": slope=", sprintf("%.4f", slope),
      " | ",
      fmt_p_label(p, "P"),
      " | n=", n_used,
      " | window=[", sprintf("%.1f", x_min), ", ", sprintf("%.1f", x_max), "]"
    ),
    label.x = x_left,
    label.y = y_top - (row_number() - 1) * y_step
  )

p_slope <- ggplot(d2, aes(dist_km, sharing_mean, color = group)) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = in_support), size = PT_SIZE) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 0.95, `FALSE` = 0.25), guide = "none") +
  geom_smooth(
    data = d2 %>% filter(in_support),
    method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = win_tbl %>% filter(is.finite(x_min)),
    aes(xintercept = x_min, color = group),
    linetype = 3, linewidth = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = win_tbl %>% filter(is.finite(x_max)),
    aes(xintercept = x_max, color = group),
    linetype = 3, linewidth = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = label_tbl,
    aes(x = label.x, y = label.y, label = label, color = group),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4.2, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Cluster 2: slope check within each group's distance-support window (", SLOPE_MODE, ")"),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Statistics: linear regression of sharing_mean ~ distance within each support window; slope P shown. ",
      "Support window rule: bin_width = ", sprintf("%.1f", bin_width),
      " km, min_per_bin = ", min_per_bin,
      ", min_bins = ", min_bins, "."
    ),
    x = "Distance between villages (km)",
    y = "Mean ASV sharing (Jaccard)"
  ) +
  plot_theme_cl2 +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_slope)

save_plot_both(
  p_slope,
  sprintf("%s_slope_plot", OUT_PREFIX),
  width = 11,
  height = 7.2
)

message("DONE: CL2 scatters + slope check.")
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({

# =========================================================
# CL4 (Cluster 4) — mountain-block analysis
# - same workflow as CL2, with CL4 block mapping
#
# INPUT:

#   - CL4_SUPPORT_WINDOW_slope_plot.png/.svg
#

#   - CL4_MOUNTAIN_pairData_used.csv

#   - CL4_MOUNTAIN_SCATTER_2COLOR_within_cross.png/.svg
# =========================================================

# -----------------------------
# Settings
# -----------------------------
TARGET_CLUSTER <- "4"

bin_width   <- 1.0
min_per_bin <- 1

PT_SIZE    <- 2.6
SIZE_RANGE <- c(2.0, 4.0)

SLOPE_MODE <- "WithinCross"   # "WithinCross" or "ThreeGroup"

fmt_p_label <- function(p, prefix = "P") {
  out <- ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    paste0(prefix, "=NA"),
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      paste0(prefix, "=", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2)),
      paste0(prefix, "=", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3))
    )
  )
  out
}

# -----------------------------
# 0) Input checks / normalize columns
# -----------------------------
stopifnot(exists("pair_df_vmean"), exists("save_plot_both"))
d0 <- pair_df_vmean

if (!("dist_km" %in% names(d0)) && "distance_km" %in% names(d0)) {
  d0 <- d0 %>% rename(dist_km = distance_km)
}
stopifnot(all(c("cluster", "dist_km", "sharing_mean") %in% names(d0)))

if (!all(c("vA", "vB") %in% names(d0))) {
  stopifnot(all(c("village1", "village2") %in% names(d0)))
  d0 <- d0 %>%
    mutate(
      vA = pmin(as.character(village1), as.character(village2)),
      vB = pmax(as.character(village1), as.character(village2))
    )
}

if (!("n_pairs" %in% names(d0))) {
  d0 <- d0 %>% mutate(n_pairs = 1L)
}

# -----------------------------
# Theme
# -----------------------------
if (!exists("base_theme")) {
  base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
    )
}

base_scatter_theme <- base_theme

# -----------------------------
# 1) V00 normalization (Vxx key)
# -----------------------------
norm_village <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- toupper(trimws(x))
  x <- sub("\\s*\\(.*\\)$", "", x)
  x <- gsub("[^A-Z0-9]", "", x)
  x <- sub("^V+", "V", x)
  num <- sub("^V", "", x)
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(num))
  ifelse(is.na(num), NA_character_, sprintf("V%02d", num))
}

d0 <- d0 %>%
  mutate(
    vA_key = norm_village(vA),
    vB_key = norm_village(vB)
  )

# -----------------------------
# 2) grp_tbl_raw: A/B/C block mapping (CL4)
# -----------------------------
grp_tbl_raw <- tibble(
  village_raw = c("v87", "v88", "v89", "v90", "v91", "v92"),
  block = c("A", "A", "B", "B", "C", "C")
) %>%
  mutate(
    village_key = norm_village(village_raw),
    block = as.character(block)
  )

grp_tbl <- grp_tbl_raw %>%
  group_by(village_key) %>%
  summarise(block = dplyr::last(block), .groups = "drop")

# -----------------------------
# 3) Build CL4 base table
# -----------------------------
d_base <- d0 %>%
  filter(as.character(cluster) == TARGET_CLUSTER) %>%
  filter(is.finite(dist_km), is.finite(sharing_mean), is.finite(n_pairs), n_pairs > 0) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vA_key), !is.na(vB_key), vA_key != vB_key) %>%
  left_join(grp_tbl %>% rename(vA_key = village_key, blockA = block), by = "vA_key") %>%
  left_join(grp_tbl %>% rename(vB_key = village_key, blockB = block), by = "vB_key") %>%
  mutate(
    block_pair = case_when(
      is.na(blockA) | is.na(blockB) ~ "UNK",
      blockA == blockB ~ paste0(blockA, "-", blockB),
      TRUE ~ paste0(pmin(blockA, blockB), "-", pmax(blockA, blockB))
    ),
    pair_type = case_when(
      block_pair %in% c("A-A", "B-B", "C-C") ~ "Within",
      block_pair %in% c("A-B", "A-C", "B-C") ~ "Cross",
      TRUE ~ "UNK"
    ),
    group3 = case_when(
      block_pair %in% c("A-A", "B-B", "C-C") ~ "Within",
      block_pair %in% c("A-B", "B-C")       ~ "Cross_AB_BC",
      block_pair %in% c("A-C")              ~ "Cross_AC",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(vA_key, vB_key, .keep_all = TRUE)

stopifnot(nrow(d_base) > 2)

write_csv(
  d_base,
  sprintf("supplementary_%s_pairData_used.csv", OUT_PREFIX_SCATTER)
)

# =========================================================
# PART A) Scatter plots
# =========================================================
pair_pal <- c(
  "A-A" = "#1b9e77", "B-B" = "#d95f02", "C-C" = "#7570b3",
  "A-B" = "#e7298a", "A-C" = "#66a61e", "B-C" = "#e6ab02",
  "UNK" = "grey70"
)

shape_map <- c(
  "Within" = 16,
  "Cross"  = 17,
  "UNK"    = 4
)

d_block <- d_base %>%
  mutate(
    block_pair = factor(block_pair, levels = c("A-A", "B-B", "C-C", "A-B", "A-C", "B-C", "UNK")),
    pair_type  = factor(pair_type,  levels = c("Within", "Cross", "UNK"))
  )

p_blockpair <- ggplot(d_block, aes(dist_km, sharing_mean)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = block_pair, shape = pair_type, size = n_pairs),
    alpha = PT_ALPHA
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess", se = TRUE, span = LOESS_SPAN_SCATTER,
    color = "black", fill = "grey70", linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pair_pal, drop = FALSE, name = "Block pair") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_map, drop = FALSE, name = NULL) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = SIZE_RANGE, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Cluster 4: distance vs ASV sharing (mountain blocks)",
    subtitle = "Descriptive plot; no inferential statistical test shown. Color = A-A/A-B/.../UNK. Shape = Within vs Cross vs UNK. Solid = LOESS.",
    x = "Distance between villages (km)",
    y = "Mean ASV sharing (Jaccard similarity)"
  ) +
  base_scatter_theme

print(p_blockpair)

save_plot_both(
  p_blockpair,
  sprintf("%s_SCATTER_blockPairs", OUT_PREFIX_SCATTER),
  width = 11,
  height = 7.2
)

pal_2c <- c(
  Within = "#1b9e77",
  Cross = "#d95f02",
  UNK = "grey70"
)

p_2color <- ggplot(d_block, aes(dist_km, sharing_mean)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = pair_type, size = n_pairs),
    alpha = PT_ALPHA, shape = 19
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess", se = TRUE, span = LOESS_SPAN_SCATTER,
    color = "black", fill = "grey70", linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_2c, drop = FALSE, name = NULL) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = SIZE_RANGE, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Cluster 4: distance vs ASV sharing (Within vs Cross)",
    subtitle = "Descriptive plot; no inferential statistical test shown. Within = A-A/B-B/C-C, Cross = A-B/A-C/B-C, UNK = missing block. Solid = LOESS.",
    x = "Distance between villages (km)",
    y = "Mean ASV sharing (Jaccard similarity)"
  ) +
  base_scatter_theme

print(p_2color)

save_plot_both(
  p_2color,
  sprintf("%s_SCATTER_2COLOR_within_cross", OUT_PREFIX_SCATTER),
  width = 11,
  height = 7.2
)

# =========================================================
# PART B) Support-window slope check
# =========================================================
if (SLOPE_MODE == "ThreeGroup") {
  d_slope <- d_base %>%
    filter(!is.na(group3), block_pair != "UNK") %>%
    mutate(group = group3)
  groups_use <- c("Within", "Cross_AB_BC", "Cross_AC")
} else {
  d_slope <- d_base %>%
    filter(pair_type %in% c("Within", "Cross")) %>%
    mutate(group = pair_type)
  groups_use <- c("Within", "Cross")
}

write_csv(
  d_slope,
  sprintf("supplementary_%s_pairData_used.csv", OUT_PREFIX)
)

find_support_window <- function(df, bin_width = 1.0, min_per_bin = 3, min_bins = 4) {
  x <- df$dist_km
  b <- floor(x / bin_width)

  tab <- tibble(bin = b) %>%
    count(bin, name = "n") %>%
    arrange(bin) %>%
    mutate(ok = n >= min_per_bin)

  if (!any(tab$ok)) return(NULL)

  tab <- tab %>%
    mutate(run = cumsum(ok != lag(ok, default = first(ok)) | (bin != lag(bin, default = first(bin)) + 1)))

  runs_ok <- tab %>%
    filter(ok) %>%
    group_by(run) %>%
    summarise(
      bin_start = min(bin),
      bin_end   = max(bin),
      n_bins    = n(),
      n_points  = sum(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n_bins >= min_bins)

  if (nrow(runs_ok) == 0) return(NULL)

  best <- runs_ok %>%
    arrange(desc(n_bins), desc(n_points)) %>%
    slice(1)

  list(
    x_min = best$bin_start * bin_width,
    x_max = (best$bin_end + 1) * bin_width
  )
}

fit_slope_in_window <- function(df, w) {
  dd <- df %>% filter(dist_km >= w$x_min, dist_km <= w$x_max)
  if (nrow(dd) < 10 || length(unique(dd$dist_km)) < 3) return(NULL)

  fit <- lm(sharing_mean ~ dist_km, data = dd)
  broom::tidy(fit) %>%
    filter(term == "dist_km") %>%
    transmute(
      slope = estimate,
      se = std.error,
      t = statistic,
      p = p.value,
      n_used = nrow(dd),
      x_min = w$x_min,
      x_max = w$x_max
    )
}

res <- bind_rows(lapply(groups_use, function(g) {
  dg <- d_slope %>% filter(group == g)
  w <- find_support_window(dg, bin_width, min_per_bin, min_bins)

  if (is.null(w)) {
    return(tibble(
      group = g, slope = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, t = NA_real_, p = NA_real_,
      n_used = NA_integer_, x_min = NA_real_, x_max = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  sl <- fit_slope_in_window(dg, w)
  if (is.null(sl)) {
    return(tibble(
      group = g, slope = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, t = NA_real_, p = NA_real_,
      n_used = NA_integer_, x_min = w$x_min, x_max = w$x_max
    ))
  }

  sl %>% mutate(group = g)
}))

print(res)

write_csv(
  res,
  sprintf("derived_%s_slope_table.csv", OUT_PREFIX)
)

win_tbl <- res %>% select(group, x_min, x_max)

d2 <- d_slope %>%
  left_join(win_tbl, by = "group") %>%
  mutate(
    in_support = is.finite(x_min) & dist_km >= x_min & dist_km <= x_max
  )

xr <- range(d2$dist_km, na.rm = TRUE)
yr <- range(d2$sharing_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
x_left <- xr[1] + 0.02 * diff(xr)
y_top  <- yr[2] - 0.02 * diff(yr)
y_step <- max(0.06 * diff(yr), 1e-6)

label_tbl <- res %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      group,
      ": slope=", sprintf("%.4f", slope),
      " | ",
      fmt_p_label(p, "P"),
      " | n=", n_used,
      " | window=[", sprintf("%.1f", x_min), ", ", sprintf("%.1f", x_max), "]"
    ),
    label.x = x_left,
    label.y = y_top - (row_number() - 1) * y_step
  )

p_slope <- ggplot(d2, aes(dist_km, sharing_mean, color = group)) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = in_support), size = PT_SIZE) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 0.95, `FALSE` = 0.25), guide = "none") +
  geom_smooth(
    data = d2 %>% filter(in_support),
    method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = win_tbl %>% filter(is.finite(x_min)),
    aes(xintercept = x_min, color = group),
    linetype = 3, linewidth = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = win_tbl %>% filter(is.finite(x_max)),
    aes(xintercept = x_max, color = group),
    linetype = 3, linewidth = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = label_tbl,
    aes(x = label.x, y = label.y, label = label, color = group),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4.2, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Cluster 4: slope check within each group's distance-support window (", SLOPE_MODE, ")"),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Statistics: linear regression of sharing_mean ~ distance within each support window; slope P shown. ",
      "Support window rule: bin_width = ", sprintf("%.1f", bin_width),
      " km, min_per_bin = ", min_per_bin,
      ", min_bins = ", min_bins,
      " (CL4 may be underpowered)."
    ),
    x = "Distance between villages (km)",
    y = "Mean ASV sharing (Jaccard)"
  ) +
  base_scatter_theme

print(p_slope)

save_plot_both(
  p_slope,
  sprintf("%s_slope_plot", OUT_PREFIX),
  width = 11,
  height = 7.2
)

message("DONE: CL4 scatters + slope check.")
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# CL4: block baseline (mean intra at x = 0) -> inter within-block (A-A/B-B/C-C)
#
# Requires:
#   pair_df_vmean : inter-only village-pair mean
#   pair_df_all   : sample-pair level
#   save_plot_both()
#
# Output:
#   - CL4_MOUNTAIN_SCATTER_blockPairs_withINTRA_baselineArrows.png/.svg
# =========================================================

TARGET_CLUSTER <- "4"
OUT_PREFIX <- "CL4_MOUNTAIN"

PT_ALPHA <- 0.90
SIZE_RANGE_INTER <- c(2.5, 9.0)
INTRA_PT_SIZE <- 5.0
BASE_PT_SIZE <- 7.0

# -----------------------------
# 0) helpers
# -----------------------------
norm_village <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- toupper(trimws(x))
  x <- sub("\\s*\\(.*\\)$", "", x)
  x <- gsub("[^A-Z0-9]", "", x)
  x <- sub("^V+", "V", x)
  num <- sub("^V", "", x)
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(num))
  ifelse(is.na(num), NA_character_, sprintf("V%02d", num))
}

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0) b else a

# -----------------------------
# Theme
# -----------------------------
if (!exists("base_theme")) {
  base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
    )
}

plot_theme_cl4 <- base_theme

# -----------------------------
# 1) Block mapping for CL4
# -----------------------------
grp_tbl_raw <- tibble(
  village_raw = c("v87", "v88", "v89", "v90", "v91", "v92"),
  block = c("A", "A", "B", "B", "C", "C")
) %>%
  mutate(
    village_key = norm_village(village_raw),
    block = as.character(block)
  )

grp_tbl <- grp_tbl_raw %>%
  group_by(village_key) %>%
  summarise(block = dplyr::last(block), .groups = "drop")

# -----------------------------
# 2) Normalize pair_df_vmean
# -----------------------------
stopifnot(exists("pair_df_vmean"), exists("pair_df_all"), exists("save_plot_both"))
d0 <- pair_df_vmean

if (!("dist_km" %in% names(d0)) && ("distance_km" %in% names(d0))) {
  d0 <- d0 %>% rename(dist_km = distance_km)
}
stopifnot(all(c("cluster", "dist_km", "sharing_mean") %in% names(d0)))

if (!all(c("vA", "vB") %in% names(d0))) {
  stopifnot(all(c("village1", "village2") %in% names(d0)))
  d0 <- d0 %>%
    mutate(
      vA = pmin(as.character(village1), as.character(village2)),
      vB = pmax(as.character(village1), as.character(village2))
    )
}

if (!("n_pairs" %in% names(d0))) {
  d0 <- d0 %>% mutate(n_pairs = 1L)
}

d0 <- d0 %>%
  mutate(
    vA_key = norm_village(vA),
    vB_key = norm_village(vB)
  )

# CL4 inter-only
d_inter <- d0 %>%
  filter(as.character(cluster) == TARGET_CLUSTER) %>%
  filter(is.finite(dist_km), is.finite(sharing_mean)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vA_key), !is.na(vB_key), vA_key != vB_key) %>%
  distinct(vA_key, vB_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  left_join(grp_tbl %>% rename(vA_key = village_key, blockA = block), by = "vA_key") %>%
  left_join(grp_tbl %>% rename(vB_key = village_key, blockB = block), by = "vB_key") %>%
  mutate(
    block_pair = case_when(
      is.na(blockA) | is.na(blockB) ~ "UNK",
      blockA == blockB ~ paste0(blockA, "-", blockB),
      TRUE ~ paste0(pmin(blockA, blockB), "-", pmax(blockA, blockB))
    ),
    pair_type = case_when(
      block_pair %in% c("A-A", "B-B", "C-C") ~ "Within",
      block_pair %in% c("A-B", "A-C", "B-C") ~ "Cross",
      TRUE ~ "UNK"
    )
  )

stopifnot(nrow(d_inter) > 0)

# -----------------------------
# 3) Intra mean per village from pair_df_all
# -----------------------------
pall <- pair_df_all
stopifnot(all(c("village1", "village2", "sharing") %in% names(pall)))

if (!("cluster" %in% names(pall))) {
  stopifnot(all(c("cluster1", "cluster2") %in% names(pall)))
  pall <- pall %>%
    mutate(cluster = ifelse(cluster1 == cluster2, as.character(cluster1), NA_character_))
}
pall <- pall %>% mutate(cluster = as.character(cluster))

intra_by_village <- pall %>%
  filter(cluster == TARGET_CLUSTER) %>%
  mutate(
    v1 = norm_village(village1),
    v2 = norm_village(village2)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(v1), !is.na(v2), v1 == v2) %>%
  group_by(village_key = v1) %>%
  summarise(
    intra_mean = mean(sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sample_pairs_intra = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(grp_tbl, by = "village_key") %>%
  mutate(block = ifelse(is.na(block), "UNK", block))

stopifnot(nrow(intra_by_village) > 0)

write_csv(
  intra_by_village,
  sprintf("derived_%s_intra_by_village.csv", OUT_PREFIX)
)

# -----------------------------
# 4) Within-block inter points + block baselines
# -----------------------------
inter_withinblock <- d_inter %>%
  filter(block_pair %in% c("A-A", "B-B", "C-C")) %>%
  transmute(
    block = sub("-.*$", "", block_pair),
    block_pair,
    dist_km,
    inter_mean = sharing_mean,
    n_pairs
  )

block_baseline <- intra_by_village %>%
  filter(block %in% c("A", "B", "C")) %>%
  group_by(block) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_intra = mean(intra_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_villages = n(),
    sum_intra_pairs = sum(n_sample_pairs_intra),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

block_summary <- inter_withinblock %>%
  left_join(block_baseline, by = "block") %>%
  mutate(
    delta = inter_mean - baseline_intra
  )

write_csv(
  inter_withinblock,
  sprintf("derived_%s_inter_withinblock.csv", OUT_PREFIX)
)

write_csv(
  block_summary,
  sprintf("supplementary_%s_block_summary_baseline_vs_inter.csv", OUT_PREFIX)
)

# -----------------------------
# 5) Plot: inter points + intra points at x = 0 + baseline->inter arrows
# -----------------------------
pair_pal <- c(
  "A-A" = "#1b9e77", "B-B" = "#d95f02", "C-C" = "#7570b3",
  "A-B" = "#e7298a", "A-C" = "#66a61e", "B-C" = "#e6ab02",
  "UNK" = "grey70"
)

shape_map <- c(
  "Within" = 16,
  "Cross" = 17,
  "UNK" = 4
)

d_plot <- d_inter %>%
  mutate(
    block_pair = factor(block_pair, levels = c("A-A", "B-B", "C-C", "A-B", "A-C", "B-C", "UNK")),
    pair_type = factor(pair_type, levels = c("Within", "Cross", "UNK"))
  )

intra_plot <- intra_by_village %>%
  filter(block %in% c("A", "B", "C")) %>%
  mutate(
    x = 0,
    block_pair = paste0(block, "-", block),
    block_pair = factor(block_pair, levels = c("A-A", "B-B", "C-C", "A-B", "A-C", "B-C", "UNK"))
  )

baseline_plot <- block_baseline %>%
  mutate(
    x = 0,
    block_pair = paste0(block, "-", block),
    block_pair = factor(block_pair, levels = c("A-A", "B-B", "C-C", "A-B", "A-C", "B-C", "UNK"))
  )

seg_df <- block_summary %>%
  mutate(
    x0 = 0,
    y0 = baseline_intra,
    x1 = dist_km,
    y1 = inter_mean,
    block_pair = factor(block_pair, levels = c("A-A", "B-B", "C-C", "A-B", "A-C", "B-C", "UNK"))
  )

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = d_plot,
    aes(x = dist_km, y = sharing_mean, color = block_pair, shape = pair_type, size = n_pairs),
    alpha = PT_ALPHA
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    data = d_plot,
    aes(x = dist_km, y = sharing_mean),
    method = "loess", se = TRUE, span = 0.75,
    color = "black", fill = "grey70", linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = intra_plot,
    aes(x = x, y = intra_mean, fill = block_pair),
    shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 1.1, size = INTRA_PT_SIZE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = baseline_plot,
    aes(x = x, y = baseline_intra, fill = block_pair),
    shape = 23, color = "black", stroke = 1.2, size = BASE_PT_SIZE
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = seg_df,
    aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1, color = block_pair),
    linewidth = 1.1, alpha = 0.85,
    arrow = arrow(length = grid::unit(0.18, "inches"), type = "closed")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pair_pal, drop = FALSE, name = "Block pair") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pair_pal, drop = FALSE, name = "Block pair") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_map, drop = FALSE, name = NULL) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = SIZE_RANGE_INTER, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Cluster 4: distance vs ASV sharing (mountain blocks) + block baseline (x = 0)",
    subtitle = "Inter-only points: color = block pair, shape = Within/Cross/UNK, size = number of sample pairs. x = 0: circles = intra per village, diamonds = block baseline mean. Arrows: baseline to A-A/B-B/C-C inter.",
    x = "Distance between villages (km) (intra shown at 0)",
    y = "Mean ASV sharing (Jaccard similarity)"
  ) +
  plot_theme_cl4

print(p)

save_plot_both(
  p,
  sprintf("%s_SCATTER_blockPairs_withINTRA_baselineArrows", OUT_PREFIX),
  width = 12,
  height = 7.8
)

message("DONE: CL4 baseline-to-inter arrow plot.")
```

```{r}
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
    )
}
```
