```{r}
make_block_map_zoom <- function(block_tbl, title_text, subtitle_text, out_base,
                                x_margin = 0.06, y_margin = 0.04) {

  plot_df <- vil_df %>%
    inner_join(block_tbl, by = "vil_id") %>%
    mutate(block = factor(block, levels = c("A", "B", "C")))

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) stop("No matched villages found: ", out_base)

  pts_sf <- plot_df %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

  block_centers <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(block) %>%
    summarise(
      lon = mean(lon, na.rm = TRUE),
      lat = mean(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  xr <- range(plot_df$lon, na.rm = TRUE)
  yr <- range(plot_df$lat, na.rm = TRUE)

  xlim_use <- c(xr[1] - x_margin, xr[2] + x_margin)
  ylim_use <- c(yr[1] - y_margin, yr[2] + y_margin)

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = kr_land, fill = "grey95", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_sf(data = kr_coast, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_sf(data = jeolla, fill = NA, color = "#999999", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_sf(
      data = pts_sf,
      aes(fill = block),
      shape = 21, size = 5.0, color = "white", stroke = 0.45, alpha = 0.98
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = plot_df,
      aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = vil_id, color = block),
      size = 5.5,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      segment.size = 0.25,
      segment.alpha = 0.6,
      show.legend = FALSE,
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
    geom_label(
      data = block_centers,
      aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = block, fill = block),
      color = "white",
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 9,
      linewidth = 0,
      alpha = 0.95,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    coord_sf(xlim = xlim_use, ylim = ylim_use, expand = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = block_pal, drop = FALSE, name = "Block") +
    scale_color_manual(values = block_pal, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = "Longitude (°E)",
      y = "Latitude (°N)"
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#eaf3ff", color = NA),
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey90")
    )

  print(p)
  save_plot_both(p, out_base, width = 8.5, height = 6.5)
  invisible(p)
}

p_cl2_zoom <- make_block_map_zoom(
  block_tbl = cl2_block,
  title_text = "Cluster 2: mountain-defined A/B/C blocks",
  subtitle_text = "Zoomed to Cluster 2 region",
  out_base = "CL2_Jeolla_map_blocks_ABC_zoom"
)

p_cl4_zoom <- make_block_map_zoom(
  block_tbl = cl4_block,
  title_text = "Cluster 4: mountain-defined A/B/C blocks",
  subtitle_text = "Zoomed to Cluster 4 region",
  out_base = "CL4_Jeolla_map_blocks_ABC_zoom"
)
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------

  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%

# -----------------------------
# 3) helper: draw hillshade map
# -----------------------------
make_block_map_hillshade <- function(block_tbl,
                                     title_text,
                                     subtitle_text,
                                     out_base,
                                     z = 10,
                                     hill_alpha = 0.90) {

  plot_df <- vil_df %>%
    inner_join(block_tbl, by = "vil_id") %>%
    mutate(block = factor(block, levels = c("A", "B", "C")))

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    stop("No matched villages found: ", out_base)
  }

  pts_sf <- st_as_sf(
    plot_df,
    coords = c("lon", "lat"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  )

  fig_ratio <- 11 / 7.2

  xc <- mean(range(plot_df$lon, na.rm = TRUE))
  yc <- mean(range(plot_df$lat, na.rm = TRUE))

  y_height <- 0.20
  x_width <- fig_ratio * y_height / cos(yc * pi / 180)

  xlim_use <- c(xc - x_width / 2, xc + x_width / 2)
  ylim_use <- c(yc - y_height / 2, yc + y_height / 2)

  bbox_mat <- matrix(
    c(
      xlim_use[1], ylim_use[1],
      xlim_use[2], ylim_use[1],
      xlim_use[2], ylim_use[2],
      xlim_use[1], ylim_use[2],
      xlim_use[1], ylim_use[1]
    ),
    ncol = 2,
    byrow = TRUE
  )

  bbox_poly <- st_sfc(
    st_polygon(list(bbox_mat)),
    crs = 4326
  ) %>%
    st_as_sf()

  dem <- elevatr::get_elev_raster(
    locations = bbox_poly,
    z = z,
    clip = "bbox"
  )

  dem <- terra::rast(dem)

  slope <- terra::terrain(dem, v = "slope", unit = "radians", neighbors = 8)
  aspect <- terra::terrain(dem, v = "aspect", unit = "radians", neighbors = 8)
  hs <- terra::shade(slope, aspect, angle = 40, direction = 300)

  hs_df <- as.data.frame(hs, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  names(hs_df) <- c("x", "y", "hillshade")
  hs_df <- hs_df %>%
    mutate(hillshade2 = hillshade^0.6)

  block_centers <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(block) %>%
    summarise(
      lon = mean(lon, na.rm = TRUE),
      lat = mean(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_raster(
      data = hs_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y, fill = hillshade2),
      alpha = hill_alpha,
      interpolate = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "grey20",
      high = "grey98",
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    geom_sf(data = kr_land, fill = NA, color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_sf(data = kr_coast, color = "grey65", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_sf(data = jeolla, fill = NA, color = "#999999", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_sf(
      data = pts_sf,
      aes(fill = block),
      shape = 21,
      size = 5.0,
      color = "white",
      stroke = 0.45,
      alpha = 0.98,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = plot_df,
      aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = vil_id, color = block),
      size = 5.5,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      segment.size = 0.25,
      segment.alpha = 0.6,
      show.legend = FALSE,
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
    geom_label(
      data = block_centers,
      aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = block, fill = block),
      color = "white",
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 7,
      linewidth = 0,
      alpha = 0.7,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    coord_sf(
      xlim = xlim_use,
      ylim = ylim_use,
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = block_pal,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = "Block"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = block_pal,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = "Longitude (°E)",
      y = "Latitude (°N)"
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#eaf3ff", color = NA),
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey90")
    )

  print(p)
  save_plot_both(p, out_base, width = 11, height = 7.2)
  invisible(p)
}

# -----------------------------
# 4) draw maps
# -----------------------------
p_cl2_hs <- make_block_map_hillshade(
  block_tbl = cl2_block,
  title_text = "Cluster 2: mountain-defined A/B/C blocks",
  subtitle_text = "Zoomed map with DEM hillshade",
  out_base = "CL2_Jeolla_map_blocks_ABC_hillshade",

)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({

# =========================================================
# CL1 / CL3 zoomed maps with DEM hillshade
# - no A/B/C block division
# - color = cluster
#
# Requires:
#   vil_tbl : label, vil_id, lon, lat
#   merged  : sampleid, village_name, cluster
#   save_plot_both()
#
# Outputs:
#   CL1_Jeolla_map_hillshade.png/.svg
#   CL3_Jeolla_map_hillshade.png/.svg
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("vil_tbl"), exists("merged"), exists("save_plot_both"))
stopifnot(all(c("label", "vil_id", "lon", "lat") %in% names(vil_tbl)))
stopifnot(all(c("village_name", "cluster") %in% names(merged)))

if (!exists("base_theme")) {
  base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
    )
}

if (!exists("clu_pal")) {
  clu_pal <- c(
    "1" = "#4E79A7",
    "2" = "#E15759",
    "3" = "#59A14F",
    "4" = "#B07AA1"
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# 0) base map layers
# -----------------------------
kr_land <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(
  scale = "large",
  country = "South Korea",
  returnclass = "sf"
)

kr_coast <- rnaturalearth::ne_coastline(
  scale = "large",
  returnclass = "sf"
)

st_kr <- rnaturalearth::ne_states(
  country = "South Korea",
  returnclass = "sf"
)

jeolla <- st_kr %>%
  filter(
    grepl("Jeollabuk|North Jeolla|Jeonbuk|전라북", name, ignore.case = TRUE) |
      grepl("Jeollanam|South Jeolla|Jeonnam|전라남", name, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )

# -----------------------------
# 1) village table + cluster map
# -----------------------------
vil_df <- vil_tbl %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    village_name = as.character(label),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    lon = as.numeric(lon),
    lat = as.numeric(lat)
  ) %>%
  distinct()

village_cluster_tbl <- merged %>%
  transmute(
    village_name = as.character(village_name),
    cluster = as.character(cluster)
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(village_name) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_base_df <- vil_df %>%
  left_join(village_cluster_tbl, by = "village_name") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster))

# -----------------------------
# 2) helper
# -----------------------------
make_cluster_map_hillshade <- function(target_cluster,
                                       title_text,
                                       subtitle_text,
                                       out_base,
                                       z = 10,
                                       hill_alpha = 0.90) {

  plot_df <- plot_base_df %>%
    filter(cluster == as.character(target_cluster))

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    stop("No matched villages found for cluster: ", target_cluster)
  }

  pts_sf <- st_as_sf(
    plot_df,
    coords = c("lon", "lat"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  )

  fig_ratio <- 11 / 7.2

  xc <- mean(range(plot_df$lon, na.rm = TRUE))
  yc <- mean(range(plot_df$lat, na.rm = TRUE))

  y_height <- max(0.14, diff(range(plot_df$lat, na.rm = TRUE)) + 0.08)
  x_width  <- fig_ratio * y_height / cos(yc * pi / 180)

  xlim_use <- c(xc - x_width / 2, xc + x_width / 2)
  ylim_use <- c(yc - y_height / 2, yc + y_height / 2)

  bbox_mat <- matrix(
    c(
      xlim_use[1], ylim_use[1],
      xlim_use[2], ylim_use[1],
      xlim_use[2], ylim_use[2],
      xlim_use[1], ylim_use[2],
      xlim_use[1], ylim_use[1]
    ),
    ncol = 2,
    byrow = TRUE
  )

  bbox_poly <- st_sfc(
    st_polygon(list(bbox_mat)),
    crs = 4326
  ) %>%
    st_as_sf()

  dem <- elevatr::get_elev_raster(
    locations = bbox_poly,
    z = z,
    clip = "bbox"
  )

  dem <- terra::rast(dem)

  slope <- terra::terrain(dem, v = "slope", unit = "radians", neighbors = 8)
  aspect <- terra::terrain(dem, v = "aspect", unit = "radians", neighbors = 8)
  hs <- terra::shade(slope, aspect, angle = 40, direction = 300)

  hs_df <- as.data.frame(hs, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  names(hs_df) <- c("x", "y", "hillshade")
  hs_df <- hs_df %>%
    mutate(hillshade2 = hillshade^0.6)

  cluster_center <- plot_df %>%
    summarise(
      lon = mean(lon, na.rm = TRUE),
      lat = mean(lat, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    mutate(cluster = as.character(target_cluster))

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_raster(
      data = hs_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y, fill = hillshade2),
      alpha = hill_alpha,
      interpolate = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "grey20",
      high = "grey98",
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    geom_sf(data = kr_land, fill = NA, color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_sf(data = kr_coast, color = "grey65", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_sf(data = jeolla, fill = NA, color = "#999999", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_sf(
      data = pts_sf,
      color = "white",
      fill = clu_pal[[as.character(target_cluster)]],
      shape = 21,
      size = 5.0,
      stroke = 0.45,
      alpha = 0.98,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = plot_df,
      aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = vil_id),
      size = 5.5,
      color = clu_pal[[as.character(target_cluster)]],
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      segment.size = 0.25,
      segment.alpha = 0.6,
      show.legend = FALSE,
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
    geom_label(
      data = cluster_center,
      aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = paste0("C", cluster)),
      fill = clu_pal[[as.character(target_cluster)]],
      color = "white",
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 7,
      linewidth = 0,
      alpha = 0.75,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    coord_sf(
      xlim = xlim_use,
      ylim = ylim_use,
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = "Longitude (°E)",
      y = "Latitude (°N)"
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#eaf3ff", color = NA),
      panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey90")
    )

  print(p)
  save_plot_both(p, out_base, width = 11, height = 7.2)
  invisible(p)
}

# -----------------------------
# 3) draw maps
# -----------------------------
p_cl1_hs <- make_cluster_map_hillshade(
  target_cluster = "1",
  title_text = "Cluster 1 villages",
  subtitle_text = "Zoomed map with DEM hillshade",
  out_base = "CL1_Jeolla_map_hillshade",
  z = 10,
  hill_alpha = 0.90
)

p_cl3_hs <- make_cluster_map_hillshade(
  target_cluster = "3",
  title_text = "Cluster 3 villages",
  subtitle_text = "Zoomed map with DEM hillshade",
  out_base = "CL3_Jeolla_map_hillshade",
  z = 10,
  hill_alpha = 0.90
)
```

```{r}
# cluster associated ASV vs diet
# diet analysis loading and setup

# =========================================================
# Diet analysis setup
# - Load absolute/raw diet metadata and cluster-associated ASV table
# - Avoid overwriting FOUNDATION objects
# - Use diet_* object names only
# - No model is fitted in this chunk
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(forcats)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Output directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_outdir <- "diet_analysis"
dir.create(diet_outdir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE)

diet_write_intermediate <- FALSE

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) File paths
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_meta_file <- "metadata_diet.csv"
diet_cluster_asv_file <- "cluster_associated_asv.csv"

# Optional fallback files if FOUNDATION objects are not already loaded
diet_asv_pa_file <- "derived_asv_pa.csv"
diet_asv_abund_file <- "derived_asv_abund.csv"

stopifnot(file.exists(diet_meta_file))
stopifnot(file.exists(diet_cluster_asv_file))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Load diet metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_meta_raw <- readr::read_csv(diet_meta_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(~ stringr::str_trim(.x))

diet_required_cols <- c(
  "sampleid",
  "samplename",
  "sex",
  "age",
  "height_cm",
  "weight_kg",
  "BMI",
  "vil_id",
  "vil_lab",
  "cluster"
)

# Absolute/raw dietary frequency variables
diet_variable_cols_absolute <- c(
  "Meat",
  "Fish",
  "Seafood",
  "Vegetables",
  "Namul",
  "Fruit",
  "Seaweed",
  "Mushrooms",
  "Kimchi",
  "Beverages"
)

# For backward compatibility with downstream chunks
diet_variable_cols <- diet_variable_cols_absolute

diet_missing_cols <- setdiff(
  c(diet_required_cols, diet_variable_cols_absolute),
  names(diet_meta_raw)
)

if (length(diet_missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns in metadata_diet.csv: ",
    paste(diet_missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

diet_meta <- diet_meta_raw %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    samplename = as.character(samplename),
    sex = factor(sex),
    age = as.numeric(age),
    height_cm = as.numeric(height_cm),
    weight_kg = as.numeric(weight_kg),
    BMI = as.numeric(BMI),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    vil_lab = as.character(vil_lab),
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
    across(all_of(diet_variable_cols_absolute), as.numeric)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Load cluster-associated ASV table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_cluster_asv_raw <- readr::read_csv(
  diet_cluster_asv_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename_with(~ stringr::str_trim(.x))

diet_cluster_asv_required_cols <- c(
  "target_cluster",
  "ASV",
  "ASV_lab",
  "delta_prevalence_pct",
  "fisher_p",
  "fisher_p_adj",
  "log2FC_detected",
  "wilcoxon_p",
  "wilcoxon_p_adj",
  "significance_category"
)

diet_missing_cluster_asv_cols <- setdiff(
  diet_cluster_asv_required_cols,
  names(diet_cluster_asv_raw)
)

if (length(diet_missing_cluster_asv_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns in cluster_associated_asv.csv: ",
    paste(diet_missing_cluster_asv_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

diet_cluster_asv_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_raw %>%
  mutate(
    target_cluster = factor(as.character(target_cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    ASV_lab = as.character(ASV_lab),
    delta_prevalence_pct = as.numeric(delta_prevalence_pct),
    fisher_p = as.numeric(fisher_p),
    fisher_p_adj = as.numeric(fisher_p_adj),
    log2FC_detected = as.numeric(log2FC_detected),
    wilcoxon_p = as.numeric(wilcoxon_p),
    wilcoxon_p_adj = as.numeric(wilcoxon_p_adj),
    significance_category = as.character(significance_category)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(ASV),
    !is.na(target_cluster),
    fisher_p_adj < 0.05 | wilcoxon_p_adj < 0.05
  )

# Annotate whether each ASV is cluster-specific or associated with multiple clusters
diet_cluster_asv_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_tbl %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  mutate(
    n_associated_clusters = n_distinct(target_cluster),
    associated_clusters = paste(sort(unique(as.character(target_cluster))), collapse = ";"),
    association_scope = if_else(
      n_associated_clusters == 1,
      "cluster-specific",
      "multi-cluster-associated"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

diet_cluster_asv_ids <- unique(diet_cluster_asv_tbl$ASV)

diet_cluster_asv_summary_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_tbl %>%
  group_by(target_cluster, association_scope) %>%
  summarise(
    n_asvs = n_distinct(ASV),
    n_pairs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(target_cluster, association_scope)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Load or use ASV presence/absence and abundance tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Prefer existing FOUNDATION objects if available.
# If not available, read from derived files.
if (exists("asv_pa")) {
  diet_asv_pa_source <- asv_pa
} else {
  stopifnot(file.exists(diet_asv_pa_file))
  diet_asv_pa_source <- readr::read_csv(diet_asv_pa_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
}

if (exists("asv_abund")) {
  diet_asv_abund_source <- asv_abund
} else if (file.exists(diet_asv_abund_file)) {
  diet_asv_abund_source <- readr::read_csv(diet_asv_abund_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  diet_asv_abund_source <- NULL
}

# Standardize first column as ASV without overwriting original objects
diet_asv_pa_tbl <- diet_asv_pa_source %>%
  rename(ASV = 1) %>%
  mutate(ASV = as.character(ASV))

diet_sample_cols <- intersect(
  setdiff(names(diet_asv_pa_tbl), "ASV"),
  diet_meta$sampleid
)

if (length(diet_sample_cols) < 5) {
  stop("Too few overlapping samples between diet metadata and ASV PA table.")
}

diet_asv_pa_cluster_tbl <- diet_asv_pa_tbl %>%
  filter(ASV %in% diet_cluster_asv_ids) %>%
  select(ASV, all_of(diet_sample_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(-ASV, ~ as.integer(as.numeric(.x) > 0)))

if (nrow(diet_asv_pa_cluster_tbl) == 0) {
  stop("No cluster-associated ASVs were found in the ASV PA table.")
}

# Long table only for cluster-associated ASVs
diet_asv_pa_long <- diet_asv_pa_cluster_tbl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ASV,
    names_to = "sampleid",
    values_to = "presence"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    presence = as.integer(presence)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    diet_meta,
    by = "sampleid"
  )

# Attach cluster-associated ASV annotation.
# Keep target_cluster + ASV pair information.
diet_asv_meta_tbl <- diet_asv_pa_long %>%
  inner_join(
    diet_cluster_asv_tbl,
    by = "ASV"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Basic QC summaries
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_qc_sample_tbl <- tibble(
  diet_scale = "absolute",
  model_type = "not_applicable_setup",
  n_diet_samples = n_distinct(diet_meta$sampleid),
  n_asv_samples = length(setdiff(names(diet_asv_pa_tbl), "ASV")),
  n_overlap_samples = length(diet_sample_cols),
  n_cluster_associated_asvs = n_distinct(diet_cluster_asv_tbl$ASV),
  n_cluster_associated_pairs = nrow(diet_cluster_asv_tbl),
  n_asv_meta_rows = nrow(diet_asv_meta_tbl)
)

diet_qc_missing_tbl <- diet_meta %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(diet_variable_cols_absolute),
      ~ sum(is.na(.x)),
      .names = "missing_{.col}"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "n_missing"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diet_scale = "absolute",
    variable = str_replace(variable, "^missing_", "")
  ) %>%
  select(diet_scale, variable, n_missing)

diet_qc_value_tbl <- diet_meta %>%
  select(all_of(diet_variable_cols_absolute)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "diet_var",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  count(diet_var, value, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(diet_scale = "absolute") %>%
  select(diet_scale, diet_var, value, n) %>%
  arrange(diet_var, value)

cat("\n===== Diet metadata: absolute/raw dietary frequency variables =====\n")
print(dim(diet_meta))

cat("\n===== Absolute diet variables =====\n")
print(diet_variable_cols_absolute)

cat("\n===== Diet samples by cluster =====\n")
print(
  diet_meta %>%
    count(cluster, name = "n_samples") %>%
    arrange(cluster)
)

cat("\n===== Cluster-associated ASV summary =====\n")
print(diet_cluster_asv_summary_tbl)

cat("\n===== Diet-ASV merge QC =====\n")
print(diet_qc_sample_tbl)

cat("\n===== Missing values in absolute diet variables =====\n")
print(diet_qc_missing_tbl)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Minimal output files
# ---------------------------------------------------------
readr::write_csv(
  diet_meta,
  file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", "diet_metadata_absolute_clean.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_cluster_asv_tbl,
  file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", "diet_cluster_associated_asv_signature_clean.csv")
)

# Optional intermediate outputs
if (isTRUE(diet_write_intermediate)) {
  readr::write_csv(
    diet_qc_sample_tbl,
    file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", "diet_qc_absolute_setup_sample_summary.csv")
  )
  
  readr::write_csv(
    diet_qc_missing_tbl,
    file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", "diet_qc_absolute_missing_summary.csv")
  )
  
  readr::write_csv(
    diet_qc_value_tbl,
    file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", "diet_qc_absolute_value_distribution.csv")
  )
}
```

#cluster-level diet summary and tests
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Cluster-level dietary pattern analysis
# - Absolute/raw dietary frequency scores
# - Descriptive cluster-level summary and non-parametric tests
# - No ASV association model is fitted in this chunk
#
# Required objects:
#   diet_meta
#   diet_variable_cols
#   diet_outdir
#
# Output naming convention:
#   diet_cluster_pattern_absolute_descriptive_*
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(purrr)
  library(forcats)
  library(stringr)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Preconditions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("diet_meta"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_variable_cols"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_outdir"))
stopifnot("cluster" %in% names(diet_meta))

dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Analysis labels for output names
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_scale_label <- "absolute"
diet_model_label <- "descriptive"

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Save helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_save_plot_both <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Nature-style theme for diet figures
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_theme <- ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10.5, hjust = 0, color = "grey30"),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10.5, color = "black"),
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.line = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 8, 8)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Variable labels and desired plotting order
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_label_map <- c(
  Meat = "Meat",
  Fish = "Fish",
  Seafood = "Seafood",
  Vegetables = "Vegetables",
  Namul = "Namul",
  Fruit = "Fruit",
  Seaweed = "Seaweed",
  Mushrooms = "Mushrooms",
  Kimchi = "Kimchi",
  Beverages = "Beverages"
)

# Interpretable order for plotting.
# Because ggplot draws the first y-level at the bottom,
# levels are reversed when applied to the y-axis.
diet_plot_order <- c(
  "Vegetables",
  "Namul",
  "Kimchi",
  "Mushrooms",
  "Seaweed",
  "Seafood",
  "Fish",
  "Meat",
  "Fruit",
  "Beverages"
)

diet_variable_cols <- intersect(diet_variable_cols, names(diet_meta))

if (length(diet_variable_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No diet variables were found in diet_meta.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Clean metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_meta <- diet_meta %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
    across(all_of(diet_variable_cols), as.numeric)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Cluster-level absolute diet summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_cluster_summary_tbl <- diet_meta %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    across(
      all_of(diet_variable_cols),
      list(
        mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        q1 = ~ quantile(.x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        q3 = ~ quantile(.x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_nonmissing = ~ sum(!is.na(.x))
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
    model_type = diet_model_label,
    .before = 1
  )

cat("\n===== Cluster-level absolute dietary frequency summary =====\n")
print(diet_cluster_summary_tbl)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Kruskal-Wallis tests across clusters
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_cluster_kw_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(diet_variable_cols, function(diet_var_i) {

  diet_test_df <- diet_meta %>%
    select(cluster, value = all_of(diet_var_i)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(cluster), is.finite(value))

  if (nrow(diet_test_df) < 3 || n_distinct(diet_test_df$cluster) < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
      model_type = diet_model_label,
      diet_var = diet_var_i,
      diet_label = recode(diet_var_i, !!!diet_label_map, .default = diet_var_i),
      n_samples = nrow(diet_test_df),
      n_clusters = n_distinct(diet_test_df$cluster),
      statistic = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  kw_fit <- kruskal.test(value ~ cluster, data = diet_test_df)

  tibble(
    diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
    model_type = diet_model_label,
    diet_var = diet_var_i,
    diet_label = recode(diet_var_i, !!!diet_label_map, .default = diet_var_i),
    n_samples = nrow(diet_test_df),
    n_clusters = n_distinct(diet_test_df$cluster),
    statistic = unname(kw_fit$statistic),
    p_value = kw_fit$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_bh, p_value)

cat("\n===== Kruskal-Wallis tests across clusters: absolute dietary frequency =====\n")
print(diet_cluster_kw_tbl)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Pairwise Wilcoxon tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_cluster_pairwise_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(diet_variable_cols, function(diet_var_i) {

  diet_test_df <- diet_meta %>%
    select(cluster, value = all_of(diet_var_i)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(cluster), is.finite(value))

  if (nrow(diet_test_df) < 3 || n_distinct(diet_test_df$cluster) < 2) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  pw_fit <- pairwise.wilcox.test(
    x = diet_test_df$value,
    g = diet_test_df$cluster,
    p.adjust.method = "BH",
    exact = FALSE
  )

  as.data.frame(as.table(pw_fit$p.value), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    rename(
      cluster1 = Var1,
      cluster2 = Var2,
      p_adj_bh = Freq
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p_adj_bh)) %>%
    mutate(
      diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
      model_type = diet_model_label,
      diet_var = diet_var_i,
      diet_label = recode(diet_var_i, !!!diet_label_map, .default = diet_var_i)
    ) %>%
    select(diet_scale, model_type, diet_var, diet_label, cluster1, cluster2, p_adj_bh)
})

cat("\n===== Pairwise Wilcoxon tests: absolute dietary frequency =====\n")
print(diet_cluster_pairwise_tbl)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Heatmap input tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_cluster_heatmap_tbl <- diet_meta %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(diet_variable_cols), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(diet_variable_cols),
    names_to = "diet_var",
    values_to = "mean_score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
    model_type = diet_model_label,
    diet_label = recode(diet_var, !!!diet_label_map, .default = diet_var),
    diet_label = factor(diet_label, levels = rev(diet_plot_order)),
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = as.character(1:4))
  )

diet_cluster_heatmap_z_tbl <- diet_cluster_heatmap_tbl %>%
  group_by(diet_var) %>%
  mutate(
    z_score = as.numeric(scale(mean_score))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Significant diet variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_cluster_sig_vars_tbl <- diet_cluster_kw_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_adj_bh), p_adj_bh < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_bh, p_value)

cat("\n===== Significant absolute dietary frequency variables =====\n")
print(diet_cluster_sig_vars_tbl)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Mean absolute score heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_diet_cluster_mean_heatmap <- ggplot(
  diet_cluster_heatmap_tbl,
  aes(x = cluster, y = diet_label, fill = mean_score)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_score)), size = 3.2, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#F7FBFF", "#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#08519C"),
    name = "Mean score"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Cluster",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Cluster-level absolute dietary frequency patterns",
    subtitle = "Cell values indicate mean absolute dietary frequency scores within each geographic cluster."
  ) +
  diet_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10.5)
  )

print(p_diet_cluster_mean_heatmap)

diet_save_plot_both(
  p_diet_cluster_mean_heatmap,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "plots",
    paste0("diet_cluster_pattern_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_mean_score_heatmap")
  ),
  width = 7.2,
  height = 5.6
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Row-wise Z-score heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_diet_cluster_z_heatmap <- ggplot(
  diet_cluster_heatmap_z_tbl,
  aes(x = cluster, y = diet_label, fill = z_score)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", z_score)), size = 3.2, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#3C5488",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#BC3C29",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Z score"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Cluster",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Cluster-level absolute dietary frequency deviations",
    subtitle = "Z scores were calculated across clusters within each dietary variable from mean absolute frequency scores."
  ) +
  diet_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10.5)
  )

print(p_diet_cluster_z_heatmap)

diet_save_plot_both(
  p_diet_cluster_z_heatmap,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "plots",
    paste0("diet_cluster_pattern_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_row_z_heatmap")
  ),
  width = 7.2,
  height = 5.6
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 13) Output tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_cluster_difference_tbl <- diet_cluster_kw_tbl %>%
  left_join(
    diet_cluster_heatmap_tbl %>%
      select(cluster, diet_var, mean_score) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = cluster,
        values_from = mean_score,
        names_prefix = "cluster_"
      ),
    by = "diet_var"
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_bh, p_value)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_cluster_summary_tbl,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0("diet_cluster_pattern_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_summary.csv")
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_cluster_difference_tbl,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0("diet_cluster_pattern_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_difference_tests.csv")
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_cluster_heatmap_z_tbl,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0("diet_cluster_pattern_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_heatmap_data.csv")
  )
)

if (nrow(diet_cluster_sig_vars_tbl) > 0) {
  readr::write_csv(
    diet_cluster_pairwise_tbl %>%
      semi_join(diet_cluster_sig_vars_tbl %>% select(diet_var), by = "diet_var"),
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "tables",
      paste0("diet_cluster_pattern_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_pairwise_tests.csv")
    )
  )
}

cat("\n===== Saved output files =====\n")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_cluster_pattern_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_summary.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_cluster_pattern_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_difference_tests.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_cluster_pattern_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_heatmap_data.csv")), "\n", sep = "")

if (nrow(diet_cluster_sig_vars_tbl) > 0) {
  cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_cluster_pattern_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_pairwise_tests.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
}

cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots", paste0("diet_cluster_pattern_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_mean_score_heatmap.png/.svg")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots", paste0("diet_cluster_pattern_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_row_z_heatmap.png/.svg")), "\n", sep = "")
```

#diet-ASV logistic association analysis
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Diet-ASV logistic association analysis
# - Absolute/raw dietary frequency scores
# - Run both unadjusted and adjusted models
#
# Models:
#   1) Unadjusted:
#        ASV presence ~ absolute diet score
#
#   2) Adjusted:
#        ASV presence ~ absolute diet score + age + sex + BMI
#
# Notes:
#   - Models are fitted once per ASV x diet variable.
#   - Cluster-associated annotations are added after model fitting.
#   - If the same ASV is associated with multiple target clusters,
#     the model result is duplicated after annotation, but the model
#     itself is ASV-level, not target-cluster-specific.
#
# Required objects:
#   diet_meta
#   diet_variable_cols
#   diet_cluster_asv_tbl
#   diet_asv_pa_long
#   diet_cluster_heatmap_tbl
#   diet_outdir
#
# Output naming convention:
#   diet_asv_logistic_absolute_*
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(purrr)
  library(stringr)
  library(broom)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Preconditions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("diet_meta"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_variable_cols"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_cluster_asv_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_asv_pa_long"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_cluster_heatmap_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_outdir"))

stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "age", "sex", "BMI", "cluster", "vil_id") %in% names(diet_meta)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "sampleid", "presence") %in% names(diet_asv_pa_long)))
stopifnot(all(c("target_cluster", "ASV") %in% names(diet_cluster_asv_tbl)))

dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Analysis labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_scale_label <- "absolute"
diet_model_types <- c("unadjusted", "adjusted")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Prepare model metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_model_meta <- diet_meta %>%
  select(
    sampleid,
    age,
    sex,
    BMI,
    cluster,
    vil_id,
    all_of(diet_variable_cols)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    sex = factor(sex),
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    age = as.numeric(age),
    BMI = as.numeric(BMI),
    across(all_of(diet_variable_cols), as.numeric)
  )

diet_asv_model_tbl <- diet_asv_pa_long %>%
  select(ASV, sampleid, presence) %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    presence = as.integer(presence)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(diet_model_meta, by = "sampleid") %>%
  filter(ASV %in% unique(diet_cluster_asv_tbl$ASV))

diet_target_asvs <- sort(unique(diet_asv_model_tbl$ASV))

cat("\n===== Absolute diet-ASV model input =====\n")
cat("Diet scale:", diet_scale_label, "\n")
cat("Number of target ASVs:", length(diet_target_asvs), "\n")
cat("Number of samples:", n_distinct(diet_asv_model_tbl$sampleid), "\n")
cat("Number of rows:", nrow(diet_asv_model_tbl), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Helper: logistic regression for one ASV and one diet variable
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_run_logistic_one <- function(df, asv_id, diet_var_i, model_type = c("unadjusted", "adjusted")) {

  model_type <- match.arg(model_type)

  diet_dat <- df %>%
    filter(ASV == asv_id) %>%
    select(
      sampleid,
      presence,
      age,
      sex,
      BMI,
      diet_value = all_of(diet_var_i)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(sampleid),
      !is.na(presence),
      is.finite(diet_value)
    )

  # Minimum sample size
  if (nrow(diet_dat) < 20) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Outcome must have both 0 and 1
  if (n_distinct(diet_dat$presence) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Diet predictor must vary
  if (n_distinct(diet_dat$diet_value) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Define model formula
  if (model_type == "unadjusted") {

    diet_form <- presence ~ diet_value

  } else {

    diet_dat <- diet_dat %>%
      filter(
        is.finite(age),
        !is.na(sex),
        is.finite(BMI)
      )

    if (nrow(diet_dat) < 20) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    if (n_distinct(diet_dat$presence) < 2) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    # If only one sex remains after filtering, omit sex to avoid model failure.
    if (n_distinct(diet_dat$sex) < 2) {
      diet_form <- presence ~ diet_value + age + BMI
    } else {
      diet_form <- presence ~ diet_value + age + sex + BMI
    }
  }

  diet_fit <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      glm(diet_form, data = diet_dat, family = binomial())
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(diet_fit)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  diet_res <- tryCatch(
    broom::tidy(diet_fit, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(diet_res)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  diet_res_term <- diet_res %>%
    filter(term == "diet_value")

  if (nrow(diet_res_term) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  tibble(
    diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
    model_type = model_type,
    ASV = as.character(asv_id),
    diet_var = as.character(diet_var_i),
    odds_ratio = as.numeric(diet_res_term$estimate[1]),
    conf_low = as.numeric(diet_res_term$conf.low[1]),
    conf_high = as.numeric(diet_res_term$conf.high[1]),
    p_value = as.numeric(diet_res_term$p.value[1]),
    n_model = nrow(diet_dat),
    n_present = sum(diet_dat$presence == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_absent = sum(diet_dat$presence == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prevalence = mean(diet_dat$presence, na.rm = TRUE),
    diet_mean = mean(diet_dat$diet_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    diet_sd = sd(diet_dat$diet_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Run all models
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_logit_result_list <- purrr::map(diet_model_types, function(model_i) {
  purrr::map(diet_target_asvs, function(asv_i) {
    purrr::map(diet_variable_cols, function(diet_var_i) {
      diet_run_logistic_one(
        df = diet_asv_model_tbl,
        asv_id = asv_i,
        diet_var_i = diet_var_i,
        model_type = model_i
      )
    })
  })
})

diet_logit_result_flat <- purrr::flatten(diet_logit_result_list)
diet_logit_result_flat <- diet_logit_result_flat[
  !purrr::map_lgl(diet_logit_result_flat, is.null)
]

if (length(diet_logit_result_flat) == 0) {
  diet_asv_logit_tbl <- tibble(
    diet_scale = character(),
    model_type = character(),
    ASV = character(),
    diet_var = character(),
    odds_ratio = numeric(),
    conf_low = numeric(),
    conf_high = numeric(),
    p_value = numeric(),
    n_model = numeric(),
    n_present = numeric(),
    n_absent = numeric(),
    prevalence = numeric(),
    diet_mean = numeric(),
    diet_sd = numeric(),
    p_adj_bh = numeric(),
    effect_direction = character()
  )
} else {
  diet_asv_logit_tbl <- bind_rows(diet_logit_result_flat) %>%
    group_by(diet_scale, model_type) %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      effect_direction = case_when(
        odds_ratio > 1 ~ "Positive",
        odds_ratio < 1 ~ "Negative",
        TRUE ~ "No change"
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(diet_scale, model_type, p_adj_bh, p_value)
}

cat("\n===== Absolute diet-ASV logistic results =====\n")
print(dim(diet_asv_logit_tbl))
print(head(diet_asv_logit_tbl))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Add cluster-associated ASV annotation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_cluster_asv_info_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_tbl %>%
  select(
    target_cluster,
    ASV,
    ASV_lab,
    delta_prevalence_pct,
    fisher_p,
    fisher_p_adj,
    log2FC_detected,
    wilcoxon_p,
    wilcoxon_p_adj,
    significance_category,
    n_associated_clusters,
    associated_clusters,
    association_scope
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    target_cluster = as.character(target_cluster),
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    prev_direction = case_when(
      delta_prevalence_pct > 0 ~ "Higher in target cluster",
      delta_prevalence_pct < 0 ~ "Lower in target cluster",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    ),
    abund_direction = case_when(
      log2FC_detected > 0 ~ "Higher in target cluster",
      log2FC_detected < 0 ~ "Lower in target cluster",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  )

diet_cluster_mean_diet_tbl <- diet_cluster_heatmap_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    target_cluster = as.character(cluster),
    diet_var = as.character(diet_var),
    target_cluster_mean_diet = mean_score
  )

if (nrow(diet_asv_logit_tbl) == 0) {
  diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl <- diet_asv_logit_tbl
} else {
  diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl <- diet_asv_logit_tbl %>%
    left_join(
      diet_cluster_asv_info_tbl,
      by = "ASV"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      target_cluster = as.character(target_cluster),
      diet_var = as.character(diet_var)
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      diet_cluster_mean_diet_tbl,
      by = c("target_cluster", "diet_var")
    ) %>%
    arrange(diet_scale, model_type, target_cluster, p_adj_bh, p_value)
}

cat("\n===== Annotated absolute diet-ASV logistic results =====\n")
print(dim(diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl))
print(head(diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Significant results
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_asv_logit_sig_tbl <- diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_adj_bh), p_adj_bh < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(diet_scale, model_type, target_cluster, p_adj_bh, p_value)

cat("\n===== Significant absolute diet-ASV logistic results =====\n")
print(dim(diet_asv_logit_sig_tbl))
print(head(diet_asv_logit_sig_tbl))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Compare unadjusted and adjusted model directions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_asv_logit_compare_tbl <- diet_asv_logit_tbl %>%
  select(
    diet_scale,
    model_type,
    ASV,
    diet_var,
    odds_ratio,
    p_value,
    p_adj_bh,
    effect_direction
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = model_type,
    values_from = c(odds_ratio, p_value, p_adj_bh, effect_direction),
    names_glue = "{model_type}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    direction_consistent = case_when(
      is.na(unadjusted_effect_direction) | is.na(adjusted_effect_direction) ~ NA,
      unadjusted_effect_direction == adjusted_effect_direction ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),
    both_significant = !is.na(unadjusted_p_adj_bh) & !is.na(adjusted_p_adj_bh) &
      unadjusted_p_adj_bh < 0.05 & adjusted_p_adj_bh < 0.05,
    unadjusted_only_significant = !is.na(unadjusted_p_adj_bh) & unadjusted_p_adj_bh < 0.05 &
      (is.na(adjusted_p_adj_bh) | adjusted_p_adj_bh >= 0.05),
    adjusted_only_significant = !is.na(adjusted_p_adj_bh) & adjusted_p_adj_bh < 0.05 &
      (is.na(unadjusted_p_adj_bh) | unadjusted_p_adj_bh >= 0.05)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(both_significant),
    unadjusted_p_adj_bh,
    adjusted_p_adj_bh
  )

cat("\n===== Absolute diet-ASV unadjusted vs adjusted comparison =====\n")
print(dim(diet_asv_logit_compare_tbl))
print(head(diet_asv_logit_compare_tbl))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Compact summary by model type, diet variable and ASV scope
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_asv_logit_summary_tbl <- diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl %>%
  group_by(diet_scale, model_type, diet_var, association_scope, effect_direction) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tests = n(),
    n_sig = sum(!is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < 0.05),
    n_asvs = n_distinct(ASV),
    n_sig_asvs = n_distinct(ASV[!is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < 0.05]),
    median_odds_ratio = median(odds_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(diet_scale, model_type, diet_var, association_scope, effect_direction)

cat("\n===== Absolute diet-ASV logistic summary =====\n")
print(diet_asv_logit_summary_tbl)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Save output files
# ---------------------------------------------------------
readr::write_csv(
  diet_asv_logit_tbl,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0("diet_asv_logistic_", diet_scale_label, "_all_models_results.csv")
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0("diet_asv_logistic_", diet_scale_label, "_all_models_annotated_results.csv")
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_asv_logit_compare_tbl,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0("diet_asv_logistic_", diet_scale_label, "_unadjusted_adjusted_comparison.csv")
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_asv_logit_summary_tbl,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0("diet_asv_logistic_", diet_scale_label, "_summary_by_model_diet_scope.csv")
  )
)

if (nrow(diet_asv_logit_sig_tbl) > 0) {
  readr::write_csv(
    diet_asv_logit_sig_tbl,
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "tables",
      paste0("diet_asv_logistic_", diet_scale_label, "_significant_results.csv")
    )
  )

  # Optional split significant results by model type for easier downstream plotting
  for (model_i in diet_model_types) {
    diet_sig_model_i <- diet_asv_logit_sig_tbl %>%
      filter(model_type == model_i)

    if (nrow(diet_sig_model_i) > 0) {
      readr::write_csv(
        diet_sig_model_i,
        file.path(
          diet_outdir,
          "tables",
          paste0("diet_asv_logistic_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_significant_results.csv")
        )
      )
    }
  }
}

cat("\n===== Saved output files =====\n")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_asv_logistic_", diet_scale_label, "_all_models_results.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_asv_logistic_", diet_scale_label, "_all_models_annotated_results.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_asv_logistic_", diet_scale_label, "_unadjusted_adjusted_comparison.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_asv_logistic_", diet_scale_label, "_summary_by_model_diet_scope.csv")), "\n", sep = "")

if (nrow(diet_asv_logit_sig_tbl) > 0) {
  cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_asv_logistic_", diet_scale_label, "_significant_results.csv")), "\n", sep = "")

  for (model_i in diet_model_types) {
    diet_sig_model_i <- diet_asv_logit_sig_tbl %>%
      filter(model_type == model_i)

    if (nrow(diet_sig_model_i) > 0) {
      cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_asv_logistic_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_significant_results.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Diet-ASV logistic association plots
# - Absolute/raw dietary frequency scores
# - Volcano-like plot
# - Significant ASV-diet dot plot
#
# Required objects:
#   diet_asv_logit_tbl
#   diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl
#   diet_outdir
#
# Input expected from previous chunk:
#   diet_asv_logit_tbl contains:
#     diet_scale = "absolute"
#     model_type = "unadjusted" or "adjusted"
#
# Outputs:
#   diet_analysis/plots/diet_asv_logistic_absolute_unadjusted_volcano.png/.svg
#   diet_analysis/plots/diet_asv_logistic_absolute_adjusted_volcano.png/.svg
#   diet_analysis/plots/diet_asv_logistic_absolute_unadjusted_significant_dotplot.png/.svg
#   diet_analysis/plots/diet_asv_logistic_absolute_adjusted_significant_dotplot.png/.svg
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(forcats)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Preconditions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("diet_asv_logit_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_outdir"))

dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Analysis labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_scale_label <- "absolute"
diet_models_to_plot <- c("unadjusted", "adjusted")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Plot helper and theme
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_save_plot_both <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

diet_theme <- ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30"),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10.5, color = "black"),
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9.5),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey90"),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Diet label order and labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_plot_order <- c(
  "Vegetables",
  "Namul",
  "Kimchi",
  "Mushrooms",
  "Seaweed",
  "Seafood",
  "Fish",
  "Meat",
  "Fruit",
  "Beverages"
)

diet_label_map <- c(
  Meat = "Meat",
  Fish = "Fish",
  Seafood = "Seafood",
  Vegetables = "Vegetables",
  Namul = "Namul",
  Fruit = "Fruit",
  Seaweed = "Seaweed",
  Mushrooms = "Mushrooms",
  Kimchi = "Kimchi",
  Beverages = "Beverages"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Volcano-like plot for each model
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_volcano_tbl <- diet_asv_logit_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    diet_scale = if ("diet_scale" %in% names(.)) as.character(diet_scale) else diet_scale_label
  ) %>%
  filter(
    diet_scale == diet_scale_label,
    model_type %in% diet_models_to_plot,
    is.finite(odds_ratio),
    is.finite(p_adj_bh),
    odds_ratio > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log2_or = log2(odds_ratio),
    neglog10_fdr = -log10(p_adj_bh),
    neglog10_fdr = ifelse(is.infinite(neglog10_fdr), NA_real_, neglog10_fdr),
    sig = if_else(p_adj_bh < 0.05, "FDR < 0.05", "Not significant"),
    diet_label = recode(diet_var, !!!diet_label_map, .default = diet_var)
  )

for (model_i in diet_models_to_plot) {

  plot_df <- diet_volcano_tbl %>%
    filter(model_type == model_i)

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    message("No absolute diet-ASV logistic results for volcano plot: ", model_i)
    next
  }

  p_diet_volcano <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = log2_or, y = neglog10_fdr)
  ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 3, color = "grey65", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_point(
      aes(shape = sig),
      size = 1.7,
      alpha = 0.75,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Not significant" = 1, "FDR < 0.05" = 16)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = expression(log[2]("odds ratio per one-unit absolute diet score")),
      y = expression(-log[10]("BH-adjusted P")),
      title = paste0("Absolute diet-ASV logistic associations (", model_i, ")"),
      subtitle = "Each point represents one cluster-associated ASV and one absolute dietary frequency variable.",
      shape = NULL
    ) +
    diet_theme +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  print(p_diet_volcano)

  diet_save_plot_both(
    p_diet_volcano,
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "plots",
      paste0("diet_asv_logistic_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_volcano")
    ),
    width = 7.2,
    height = 5.8
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Significant ASV-diet dot plot for each model
#    Uses annotated table so target_cluster and ASV_lab are available.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_sig_dot_tbl <- diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    diet_scale = if ("diet_scale" %in% names(.)) as.character(diet_scale) else diet_scale_label
  ) %>%
  filter(
    diet_scale == diet_scale_label,
    model_type %in% diet_models_to_plot,
    is.finite(odds_ratio),
    is.finite(p_adj_bh),
    p_adj_bh < 0.05,
    odds_ratio > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log2_or = log2(odds_ratio),
    neglog10_fdr = -log10(p_adj_bh),
    diet_label = recode(diet_var, !!!diet_label_map, .default = diet_var),
    diet_label = factor(diet_label, levels = diet_plot_order),
    target_cluster = factor(as.character(target_cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
    ASV_display = if_else(
      !is.na(ASV_lab) & ASV_lab != "",
      ASV_lab,
      ASV
    ),
    ASV_display = paste0(ASV_display, " | C", target_cluster)
  )

for (model_i in diet_models_to_plot) {

  plot_df <- diet_sig_dot_tbl %>%
    filter(model_type == model_i) %>%
    arrange(target_cluster, desc(abs(log2_or)), p_adj_bh) %>%
    mutate(
      ASV_display = fct_inorder(ASV_display),
      ASV_display = fct_rev(ASV_display)
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    message("No significant absolute ASV-diet associations for model: ", model_i)
    next
  }

  p_diet_sig_dot <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = diet_label, y = ASV_display)
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(size = neglog10_fdr, fill = log2_or),
      shape = 21,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.25,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#3C5488",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#BC3C29",
      midpoint = 0,
      name = expression(log[2]("OR"))
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      range = c(1.8, 5.5),
      name = expression(-log[10]("FDR"))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      title = paste0("Significant absolute diet-associated cluster ASVs (", model_i, ")"),
      subtitle = "Rows denote cluster-associated ASVs; columns denote absolute dietary frequency variables."
    ) +
    diet_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.25),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.25),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  print(p_diet_sig_dot)

  diet_save_plot_both(
    p_diet_sig_dot,
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "plots",
      paste0("diet_asv_logistic_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_significant_dotplot")
    ),
    width = 10.5,
    height = min(18, max(5.5, 0.28 * nrow(plot_df)))
  )
}

cat("\n===== Saved absolute diet-ASV logistic plots =====\n")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots", "diet_asv_logistic_absolute_unadjusted_volcano.png/.svg"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots", "diet_asv_logistic_absolute_adjusted_volcano.png/.svg"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots", "diet_asv_logistic_absolute_unadjusted_significant_dotplot.png/.svg"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots", "diet_asv_logistic_absolute_adjusted_significant_dotplot.png/.svg"), "\n", sep = "")
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Diet-ASV summary plots
# - Absolute/raw dietary frequency scores
# - Summarize significant ASV-diet logistic associations
# - Reduce complex ASV-level dot plot into cluster x diet summaries
#
# Required objects:
#   diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl
#   diet_outdir
#
# Input expected:
#   diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl contains:
#     diet_scale = "absolute"  [if absent, absolute is assumed]
#     model_type = "unadjusted" or "adjusted"
#
# Main outputs:
#   tables/
#     diet_asv_summary_absolute_<model>_cluster_diet_summary.csv
#     diet_asv_summary_absolute_<model>_diet_count_summary.csv
#
#   plots/
#     diet_asv_summary_absolute_<model>_all_signed_heatmap.png/.svg
#     diet_asv_summary_absolute_<model>_all_count_heatmap.png/.svg
#     diet_asv_summary_absolute_<model>_specific_signed_heatmap.png/.svg
#     diet_asv_summary_absolute_<model>_specific_count_heatmap.png/.svg
#     diet_asv_summary_absolute_<model>_diet_count_barplot.png/.svg
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(forcats)
  library(stringr)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Preconditions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_outdir"))

required_cols <- c(
  "model_type",
  "target_cluster",
  "ASV",
  "ASV_lab",
  "diet_var",
  "odds_ratio",
  "p_adj_bh",
  "association_scope"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns in diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_scale_label <- "absolute"
diet_models_to_plot <- c("unadjusted", "adjusted")
diet_fdr_cutoff <- 0.05

diet_plot_order <- c(
  "Vegetables",
  "Namul",
  "Kimchi",
  "Mushrooms",
  "Seaweed",
  "Seafood",
  "Fish",
  "Meat",
  "Fruit",
  "Beverages"
)

diet_label_map <- c(
  Vegetables = "Vegetables",
  Namul = "Namul",
  Kimchi = "Kimchi",
  Mushrooms = "Mushrooms",
  Seaweed = "Seaweed",
  Seafood = "Seafood",
  Fish = "Fish",
  Meat = "Meat",
  Fruit = "Fruit",
  Beverages = "Beverages"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Theme and save helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_theme <- ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10.5, color = "black"),
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9.5),
    panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
  )

diet_save_plot_both <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Normalize diet_scale column
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl <- diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    diet_scale = if ("diet_scale" %in% names(.)) as.character(diet_scale) else diet_scale_label
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Function: summarize target cluster x diet associations
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_cluster_diet_summary <- function(df, scope_label = "all") {

  if (scope_label == "cluster-specific") {
    df <- df %>%
      filter(association_scope == "cluster-specific")
  }

  df %>%
    group_by(target_cluster, diet_var, diet_label) %>%
    summarise(
      n_sig_pairs = n(),
      n_sig_asvs = n_distinct(ASV),
      n_positive = sum(direction == "Positive", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_negative = sum(direction == "Negative", na.rm = TRUE),
      signed_count = n_positive - n_negative,
      mean_log2_or = mean(log2_or, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_log2_or = median(log2_or, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_fdr = min(p_adj_bh, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    complete(
      target_cluster = factor(as.character(1:4), levels = as.character(1:4)),
      diet_label = factor(diet_plot_order, levels = diet_plot_order),
      fill = list(
        n_sig_pairs = 0,
        n_sig_asvs = 0,
        n_positive = 0,
        n_negative = 0,
        signed_count = 0,
        mean_log2_or = NA_real_,
        median_log2_or = NA_real_,
        min_fdr = NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      diet_var = as.character(diet_label),
      summary_scope = scope_label,
      target_cluster = factor(as.character(target_cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
      diet_label = factor(as.character(diet_label), levels = diet_plot_order),
      text_count = ifelse(n_sig_asvs > 0, as.character(n_sig_asvs), ""),
      text_signed = ifelse(
        signed_count > 0,
        paste0("+", signed_count),
        ifelse(signed_count < 0, as.character(signed_count), "")
      )
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Plot function: signed count heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_signed_heatmap <- function(summary_tbl, scope_label, filename_scope, model_i) {

  plot_df <- summary_tbl %>%
    filter(summary_scope == scope_label) %>%
    mutate(
      target_cluster = factor(as.character(target_cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
      diet_label = factor(as.character(diet_label), levels = diet_plot_order)
    )

  max_abs <- max(abs(plot_df$signed_count), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(max_abs) || max_abs == 0) max_abs <- 1

  scope_title <- ifelse(scope_label == "all", "all cluster-associated ASVs", "cluster-specific ASVs")

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = diet_label, y = target_cluster, fill = signed_count)
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = text_signed), size = 3.5, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#3C5488",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#BC3C29",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-max_abs, max_abs),
      name = "Signed count"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Target cluster",
      title = paste0("Direction of absolute diet-associated ASVs (", scope_title, ")"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Signed count = positive minus negative significant ASV-diet associations. ",
        "Diet scale: absolute frequency score; model: ", model_i, "."
      )
    ) +
    diet_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  print(p)

  diet_save_plot_both(
    p,
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "plots",
      paste0("diet_asv_summary_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_", filename_scope, "_signed_heatmap")
    ),
    width = 8.8,
    height = 3.8
  )

  invisible(p)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Plot function: significant ASV count heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_count_heatmap <- function(summary_tbl, scope_label, filename_scope, model_i) {

  plot_df <- summary_tbl %>%
    filter(summary_scope == scope_label) %>%
    mutate(
      target_cluster = factor(as.character(target_cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
      diet_label = factor(as.character(diet_label), levels = diet_plot_order)
    )

  scope_title <- ifelse(scope_label == "all", "all cluster-associated ASVs", "cluster-specific ASVs")

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = diet_label, y = target_cluster, fill = n_sig_asvs)
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = text_count), size = 3.5, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c("#F7FBFF", "#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#08519C"),
      name = "No. ASVs"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Target cluster",
      title = paste0("Number of absolute diet-associated ASVs (", scope_title, ")"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Cell values indicate the number of significant ASVs. ",
        "Diet scale: absolute frequency score; model: ", model_i, "."
      )
    ) +
    diet_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  print(p)

  diet_save_plot_both(
    p,
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "plots",
      paste0("diet_asv_summary_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_", filename_scope, "_count_heatmap")
    ),
    width = 8.8,
    height = 3.8
  )

  invisible(p)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Main loop: unadjusted and adjusted
# ---------------------------------------------------------
for (model_i in diet_models_to_plot) {

  cat("\n=========================================================\n")
  cat("Diet-ASV summary plots\n")
  cat("Diet scale:", diet_scale_label, "\n")
  cat("Model:", model_i, "\n")
  cat("FDR cutoff:", diet_fdr_cutoff, "\n")
  cat("=========================================================\n")

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 7.1) Prepare significant ASV-diet associations
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  diet_sig_pair_tbl <- diet_asv_logit_annot_tbl %>%
    filter(
      diet_scale == diet_scale_label,
      model_type == model_i,
      is.finite(odds_ratio),
      odds_ratio > 0,
      is.finite(p_adj_bh),
      p_adj_bh < diet_fdr_cutoff
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      target_cluster = factor(as.character(target_cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
      diet_var = as.character(diet_var),
      diet_label = recode(diet_var, !!!diet_label_map, .default = diet_var),
      diet_label = factor(diet_label, levels = diet_plot_order),
      log2_or = log2(odds_ratio),
      direction = case_when(
        log2_or > 0 ~ "Positive",
        log2_or < 0 ~ "Negative",
        TRUE ~ "No change"
      ),
      association_scope = case_when(
        association_scope %in% c("cluster-specific", "Specific") ~ "cluster-specific",
        association_scope %in% c("multi-cluster-associated", "Shared") ~ "multi-cluster-associated",
        TRUE ~ as.character(association_scope)
      ),
      ASV = as.character(ASV)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(target_cluster),
      !is.na(diet_label),
      direction %in% c("Positive", "Negative")
    ) %>%
    distinct(
      diet_scale,
      model_type,
      target_cluster,
      ASV,
      ASV_lab,
      diet_var,
      diet_label,
      association_scope,
      odds_ratio,
      log2_or,
      p_adj_bh,
      direction,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )

  cat("Significant rows:", nrow(diet_sig_pair_tbl), "\n")
  cat("Unique ASVs:", n_distinct(diet_sig_pair_tbl$ASV), "\n")

  if (nrow(diet_sig_pair_tbl) == 0) {
    message("No significant absolute ASV-diet associations were found for model: ", model_i)
    next
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 7.2) Cluster x diet summaries
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  diet_cluster_diet_summary_all_tbl <- make_cluster_diet_summary(
    diet_sig_pair_tbl,
    scope_label = "all"
  )

  diet_cluster_diet_summary_specific_tbl <- make_cluster_diet_summary(
    diet_sig_pair_tbl,
    scope_label = "cluster-specific"
  )

  diet_cluster_diet_summary_tbl <- bind_rows(
    diet_cluster_diet_summary_all_tbl,
    diet_cluster_diet_summary_specific_tbl
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
      model_type = model_i,
      .before = 1
    )

  cat("\n===== Cluster x diet summary: all cluster-associated ASVs =====\n")
  print(diet_cluster_diet_summary_all_tbl)

  cat("\n===== Cluster x diet summary: cluster-specific ASVs only =====\n")
  print(diet_cluster_diet_summary_specific_tbl)

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 7.3) Draw heatmaps
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  p_diet_asv_signed_all <- plot_signed_heatmap(
    diet_cluster_diet_summary_tbl,
    scope_label = "all",
    filename_scope = "all",
    model_i = model_i
  )

  p_diet_asv_count_all <- plot_count_heatmap(
    diet_cluster_diet_summary_tbl,
    scope_label = "all",
    filename_scope = "all",
    model_i = model_i
  )

  p_diet_asv_signed_specific <- plot_signed_heatmap(
    diet_cluster_diet_summary_tbl,
    scope_label = "cluster-specific",
    filename_scope = "specific",
    model_i = model_i
  )

  p_diet_asv_count_specific <- plot_count_heatmap(
    diet_cluster_diet_summary_tbl,
    scope_label = "cluster-specific",
    filename_scope = "specific",
    model_i = model_i
  )

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 7.4) Diet-level count summary
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  diet_asv_diet_count_summary_tbl <- diet_sig_pair_tbl %>%
    group_by(diet_var, diet_label, association_scope, direction) %>%
    summarise(
      n_sig_pairs = n(),
      n_sig_asvs = n_distinct(ASV),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    complete(
      diet_label = factor(diet_plot_order, levels = diet_plot_order),
      association_scope = c("cluster-specific", "multi-cluster-associated"),
      direction = c("Positive", "Negative"),
      fill = list(
        n_sig_pairs = 0,
        n_sig_asvs = 0
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
      model_type = model_i,
      diet_var = as.character(diet_label),
      diet_label = factor(as.character(diet_label), levels = diet_plot_order),
      association_scope = factor(
        association_scope,
        levels = c("cluster-specific", "multi-cluster-associated")
      ),
      direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Positive", "Negative")),
      .before = 1
    )

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 7.5) Diet-level barplot: unique ASV counts by diet variable
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  diet_asv_diet_bar_tbl <- diet_sig_pair_tbl %>%
    group_by(diet_var, diet_label, direction) %>%
    summarise(
      n_sig_pairs = n(),
      n_sig_asvs = n_distinct(ASV),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    complete(
      diet_label = factor(diet_plot_order, levels = diet_plot_order),
      direction = c("Positive", "Negative"),
      fill = list(
        n_sig_pairs = 0,
        n_sig_asvs = 0
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
      model_type = model_i,
      diet_var = as.character(diet_label),
      diet_label = factor(as.character(diet_label), levels = diet_plot_order),
      direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Positive", "Negative")),
      signed_n = ifelse(direction == "Positive", n_sig_asvs, -n_sig_asvs),
      .before = 1
    )

  diet_bar_y_max <- max(diet_asv_diet_bar_tbl$signed_n, na.rm = TRUE)
  diet_bar_y_min <- min(diet_asv_diet_bar_tbl$signed_n, na.rm = TRUE)

  diet_bar_y_upper <- ceiling((diet_bar_y_max + 2) / 5) * 5
  diet_bar_y_lower <- floor((diet_bar_y_min - 2) / 5) * 5

  if (diet_bar_y_lower > -5) {
    diet_bar_y_lower <- -5
  }

  diet_bar_breaks <- seq(
    diet_bar_y_lower,
    diet_bar_y_upper,
    by = 5
  )

  p_diet_asv_diet_count_bar <- ggplot(
    diet_asv_diet_bar_tbl,
```
