```{r}
    aes(x = diet_label, y = signed_n, fill = direction)
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linewidth = 0.4,
      color = "grey35"
    ) +
    geom_col(
      width = 0.72,
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Positive" = "#BC3C29",
        "Negative" = "#3C5488"
      ),
      name = "Direction"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(diet_bar_y_lower, diet_bar_y_upper),
      breaks = diet_bar_breaks,
      labels = abs,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "No. unique absolute diet-associated ASVs",
      title = "Absolute dietary variables associated with cluster-associated ASVs",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Bars show unique ASVs with significant positive or negative associations. ",
        "Diet scale: absolute frequency score; model: ", model_i, "."
      )
    ) +
    diet_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  print(p_diet_asv_diet_count_bar)

  diet_save_plot_both(
    p_diet_asv_diet_count_bar,
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "plots",
      paste0("diet_asv_summary_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_diet_count_barplot")
    ),
    width = 8.6,
    height = 4.8
  )

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 7.6) Save tables
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  readr::write_csv(
    diet_cluster_diet_summary_tbl,
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "tables",
      paste0("diet_asv_summary_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_cluster_diet_summary.csv")
    )
  )

  readr::write_csv(
    diet_asv_diet_count_summary_tbl,
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "tables",
      paste0("diet_asv_summary_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_diet_count_summary.csv")
    )
  )

  readr::write_csv(
    diet_asv_diet_bar_tbl,
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "tables",
      paste0("diet_asv_summary_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_diet_count_barplot_data.csv")
    )
  )

  cat("\n===== Saved summary files for ", model_i, " =====\n", sep = "")
  cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_asv_summary_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_cluster_diet_summary.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_asv_summary_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_diet_count_summary.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_asv_summary_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_diet_count_barplot_data.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots", paste0("diet_asv_summary_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_all_signed_heatmap.png/.svg")), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots", paste0("diet_asv_summary_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_all_count_heatmap.png/.svg")), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots", paste0("diet_asv_summary_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_specific_signed_heatmap.png/.svg")), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots", paste0("diet_asv_summary_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_specific_count_heatmap.png/.svg")), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots", paste0("diet_asv_summary_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_diet_count_barplot.png/.svg")), "\n", sep = "")
}
```

#v2: candidate cluster-matched analysis
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Candidate cluster-matched diet-ASV linkage analysis
# - Absolute/raw dietary frequency scores
# - Test whether ASVs enriched in each target cluster are associated
#   with the top absolute dietary features of the same cluster.
#
# Required existing objects:
#   diet_meta
#   diet_variable_cols
#   diet_cluster_kw_tbl
#   diet_cluster_heatmap_z_tbl
#   diet_cluster_asv_tbl
#   diet_asv_pa_long
#   diet_outdir
#
# Output naming convention:
#   diet_candidate_absolute_<model/evidence>_*
#
# Main outputs:
#   Tables:
#     diet_candidate_absolute_cluster_top_features.csv
#     diet_candidate_absolute_asv_table.csv
#     diet_candidate_absolute_pairs.csv
#     diet_candidate_absolute_asv_diet_results.csv
#     diet_candidate_absolute_cluster_diet_summary.csv
#
#   Plots:
#     diet_candidate_absolute_descriptive_cluster_top_features_heatmap.png/.svg
#     diet_candidate_absolute_unadjusted_fdr_count_heatmap.png/.svg
#     diet_candidate_absolute_adjusted_fdr_count_heatmap.png/.svg
#     diet_candidate_absolute_unadjusted_nominal_count_heatmap.png/.svg
#     diet_candidate_absolute_adjusted_nominal_count_heatmap.png/.svg
#     diet_candidate_absolute_unadjusted_top_associations_forestplot.png/.svg
#     diet_candidate_absolute_adjusted_top_associations_forestplot.png/.svg
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(purrr)
  library(forcats)
  library(stringr)
  library(broom)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Preconditions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("diet_meta"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_variable_cols"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_cluster_kw_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_cluster_heatmap_z_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_cluster_asv_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_asv_pa_long"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_outdir"))

stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "age", "sex", "BMI", "cluster", "vil_id") %in% names(diet_meta)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "sampleid", "presence") %in% names(diet_asv_pa_long)))
stopifnot(all(c("target_cluster", "ASV", "ASV_lab", "delta_prevalence_pct") %in% names(diet_cluster_asv_tbl)))
stopifnot(all(c("cluster", "diet_var", "mean_score", "z_score") %in% names(diet_cluster_heatmap_z_tbl)))
stopifnot(all(c("diet_var", "p_adj_bh") %in% names(diet_cluster_kw_tbl)))

dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_scale_label <- "absolute"
diet_candidate_top_n <- 3
diet_candidate_min_prev <- 0.05
diet_candidate_fdr_cutoff <- 0.05
diet_candidate_nominal_cutoff <- 0.05
diet_candidate_model_types <- c("unadjusted", "adjusted")

diet_plot_order <- c(
  "Vegetables",
  "Namul",
  "Kimchi",
  "Mushrooms",
  "Seaweed",
  "Seafood",
  "Fish",
  "Meat",
  "Fruit",
  "Beverages"
)

diet_label_map <- c(
  Vegetables = "Vegetables",
  Namul = "Namul",
  Kimchi = "Kimchi",
  Mushrooms = "Mushrooms",
  Seaweed = "Seaweed",
  Seafood = "Seafood",
  Fish = "Fish",
  Meat = "Meat",
  Fruit = "Fruit",
  Beverages = "Beverages"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Nature-style theme and save helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_theme <- ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10.5, color = "black"),
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9.5),
    panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
  )

diet_save_plot_both <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Clean model metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_model_meta <- diet_meta %>%
  select(
    sampleid,
    age,
    sex,
    BMI,
    cluster,
    vil_id,
    all_of(diet_variable_cols)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    age = as.numeric(age),
    sex = factor(sex),
    BMI = as.numeric(BMI),
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    across(all_of(diet_variable_cols), as.numeric)
  )

diet_asv_model_tbl <- diet_asv_pa_long %>%
  select(ASV, sampleid, presence) %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    presence = as.integer(as.numeric(presence) > 0)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(diet_model_meta, by = "sampleid")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) ASV prevalence diagnostics
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_candidate_asv_diag_tbl <- diet_asv_model_tbl %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    prevalence = mean(presence == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_present = sum(presence == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_absent = sum(presence == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(diet_scale = diet_scale_label, .before = 1)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Define cluster top absolute dietary features
#
# Criteria:
#   - absolute dietary variable differs across clusters: BH-adjusted KW P < 0.05
#   - cluster-level z-score > 0
#   - top N highest positive z-scores per cluster
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_sig_cluster_vars <- diet_cluster_kw_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_adj_bh), p_adj_bh < diet_candidate_fdr_cutoff) %>%
  pull(diet_var) %>%
  unique()

diet_candidate_cluster_feature_tbl <- diet_cluster_heatmap_z_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
    diet_var = as.character(diet_var),
    diet_label = recode(diet_var, !!!diet_label_map, .default = diet_var),
    diet_label = factor(diet_label, levels = diet_plot_order)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    diet_var %in% diet_sig_cluster_vars,
    is.finite(z_score),
    z_score > 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(cluster, desc(z_score), diet_label)

diet_candidate_cluster_top_features_tbl <- diet_candidate_cluster_feature_tbl %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = z_score,
    n = diet_candidate_top_n,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
    cluster = as.character(cluster),
    diet_var = as.character(diet_var),
    diet_label = as.character(diet_label),
    top_feature_rank = ave(-z_score, cluster, FUN = rank, ties.method = "first"),
    .before = 1
  ) %>%
  arrange(cluster, top_feature_rank)

cat("\n===== Candidate top absolute dietary features by cluster =====\n")
print(diet_candidate_cluster_top_features_tbl)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Define cluster-enriched candidate ASVs
#
# Criteria:
#   - significant cluster-associated ASV
#   - enriched in target cluster: delta_prevalence_pct > 0
#   - overall prevalence >= diet_candidate_min_prev
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_candidate_asv_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    target_cluster = as.character(target_cluster),
    ASV = as.character(ASV)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    (fisher_p_adj < diet_candidate_fdr_cutoff | wilcoxon_p_adj < diet_candidate_fdr_cutoff),
    delta_prevalence_pct > 0
  ) %>%
  left_join(diet_candidate_asv_diag_tbl %>% select(-diet_scale), by = "ASV") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(prevalence),
    prevalence >= diet_candidate_min_prev
  ) %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  mutate(
    n_associated_clusters_candidate = n_distinct(target_cluster),
    associated_clusters_candidate = paste(sort(unique(target_cluster)), collapse = ";"),
    candidate_cluster_scope = if_else(
      n_associated_clusters_candidate == 1,
      "cluster-specific",
      "multi-cluster-associated"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(diet_scale = diet_scale_label, .before = 1)

cat("\n===== Candidate cluster-enriched ASVs for absolute diet linkage =====\n")
print(
  diet_candidate_asv_tbl %>%
    count(target_cluster, candidate_cluster_scope, name = "n_asv_cluster_pairs")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Build candidate ASV x cluster-top-diet pairs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_candidate_pairs_tbl <- diet_candidate_asv_tbl %>%
  select(
    diet_scale,
    target_cluster,
    ASV,
    ASV_lab,
    delta_prevalence_pct,
    fisher_p,
    fisher_p_adj,
    log2FC_detected,
    wilcoxon_p,
    wilcoxon_p_adj,
    significance_category,
    prevalence,
    n_present,
    n_absent,
    candidate_cluster_scope,
    n_associated_clusters_candidate,
    associated_clusters_candidate
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(
    diet_candidate_cluster_top_features_tbl %>%
      select(
        target_cluster = cluster,
        diet_var,
        diet_label,
        mean_score,
        z_score,
        top_feature_rank
      ),
    by = "target_cluster"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(diet_var)) %>%
  distinct(target_cluster, ASV, diet_var, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(target_cluster, top_feature_rank, ASV)

cat("\n===== Candidate absolute ASV-diet pairs =====\n")
cat("Number of candidate pairs:", nrow(diet_candidate_pairs_tbl), "\n")
cat("Number of unique ASVs:", n_distinct(diet_candidate_pairs_tbl$ASV), "\n")
print(
  diet_candidate_pairs_tbl %>%
    count(target_cluster, diet_label, name = "n_candidate_pairs") %>%
    arrange(target_cluster, desc(n_candidate_pairs))
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Logistic regression helper
#
# Models:
#   unadjusted: presence ~ absolute diet_value
#   adjusted:   presence ~ absolute diet_value + age + sex + BMI
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_candidate_run_logistic_one <- function(df, asv_id, diet_var_i, model_type = c("unadjusted", "adjusted")) {

  model_type <- match.arg(model_type)

  dat <- df %>%
    filter(ASV == asv_id) %>%
    select(
      sampleid,
      presence,
      age,
      sex,
      BMI,
      diet_value = all_of(diet_var_i)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(sampleid),
      !is.na(presence),
      is.finite(diet_value)
    )

  if (nrow(dat) < 30) return(NULL)
  if (n_distinct(dat$presence) < 2) return(NULL)
  if (n_distinct(dat$diet_value) < 2) return(NULL)

  if (model_type == "unadjusted") {
    form <- presence ~ diet_value
  } else {
    dat <- dat %>%
      filter(
        is.finite(age),
        !is.na(sex),
        is.finite(BMI)
      )

    if (nrow(dat) < 30) return(NULL)
    if (n_distinct(dat$presence) < 2) return(NULL)

    if (n_distinct(dat$sex) < 2) {
      form <- presence ~ diet_value + age + BMI
    } else {
      form <- presence ~ diet_value + age + sex + BMI
    }
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      glm(form, data = dat, family = binomial())
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

  res <- tryCatch(
    broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)

  res_diet <- res %>%
    filter(term == "diet_value")

  if (nrow(res_diet) == 0) return(NULL)

  support_wilcox_p <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      wilcox.test(dat$diet_value ~ dat$presence, exact = FALSE)$p.value
    ),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  tibble(
    diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
    model_type = model_type,
    ASV = as.character(asv_id),
    diet_var = as.character(diet_var_i),
    odds_ratio = as.numeric(res_diet$estimate[1]),
    conf_low = as.numeric(res_diet$conf.low[1]),
    conf_high = as.numeric(res_diet$conf.high[1]),
    p_value = as.numeric(res_diet$p.value[1]),
    support_wilcox_p = as.numeric(support_wilcox_p),
    n_model = nrow(dat),
    n_present_model = sum(dat$presence == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_absent_model = sum(dat$presence == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prevalence_model = mean(dat$presence == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    diet_mean_model = mean(dat$diet_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    diet_sd_model = sd(dat$diet_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Run candidate models
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_candidate_result_list <- purrr::pmap(
  list(
    diet_candidate_pairs_tbl$ASV,
    diet_candidate_pairs_tbl$diet_var
  ),
  function(asv_i, diet_var_i) {
    purrr::map(
      diet_candidate_model_types,
      function(model_i) {
        diet_candidate_run_logistic_one(
          df = diet_asv_model_tbl,
          asv_id = asv_i,
          diet_var_i = diet_var_i,
          model_type = model_i
        )
      }
    )
  }
)

diet_candidate_result_flat <- purrr::flatten(diet_candidate_result_list)
diet_candidate_result_flat <- diet_candidate_result_flat[
  !purrr::map_lgl(diet_candidate_result_flat, is.null)
]

if (length(diet_candidate_result_flat) == 0) {
  diet_candidate_assoc_tbl <- tibble(
    diet_scale = character(),
    model_type = character(),
    ASV = character(),
    diet_var = character(),
    odds_ratio = numeric(),
    conf_low = numeric(),
    conf_high = numeric(),
    p_value = numeric(),
    support_wilcox_p = numeric(),
    n_model = numeric(),
    n_present_model = numeric(),
    n_absent_model = numeric(),
    prevalence_model = numeric(),
    diet_mean_model = numeric(),
    diet_sd_model = numeric(),
    p_adj_bh = numeric(),
    support_wilcox_p_adj_bh = numeric()
  )
} else {
  diet_candidate_assoc_tbl <- bind_rows(diet_candidate_result_flat) %>%
    group_by(diet_scale, model_type) %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
      support_wilcox_p_adj_bh = p.adjust(support_wilcox_p, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      log2_or = log2(odds_ratio),
      direction = case_when(
        log2_or > 0 ~ "Positive",
        log2_or < 0 ~ "Negative",
        TRUE ~ "No change"
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(diet_scale, model_type, p_adj_bh, p_value)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Annotate candidate association results
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_candidate_assoc_annot_tbl <- diet_candidate_pairs_tbl %>%
  select(
    diet_scale,
    target_cluster,
    ASV,
    ASV_lab,
    diet_var,
    diet_label,
    mean_score,
    z_score,
    top_feature_rank,
    delta_prevalence_pct,
    fisher_p_adj,
    log2FC_detected,
    wilcoxon_p_adj,
    significance_category,
    prevalence,
    candidate_cluster_scope,
    n_associated_clusters_candidate,
    associated_clusters_candidate
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    diet_candidate_assoc_tbl,
    by = c("diet_scale", "ASV", "diet_var")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    target_cluster = factor(as.character(target_cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
    diet_label = factor(as.character(diet_label), levels = diet_plot_order),
    evidence_class = case_when(
      !is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_candidate_fdr_cutoff ~ "FDR significant",
      !is.na(p_value) & p_value < diet_candidate_nominal_cutoff ~ "Nominal significant",
      !is.na(p_value) ~ "Tested, not significant",
      TRUE ~ "Not tested"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(diet_scale, model_type, target_cluster, top_feature_rank, p_adj_bh, p_value)

cat("\n===== Candidate absolute association results =====\n")
print(
  diet_candidate_assoc_annot_tbl %>%
    count(diet_scale, model_type, evidence_class, name = "n")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Summary table for cluster x diet heatmaps
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_candidate_cluster_diet_summary_tbl <- diet_candidate_assoc_annot_tbl %>%
  group_by(diet_scale, model_type, target_cluster, diet_var, diet_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_candidate_asvs = n_distinct(ASV),
    n_tested = n_distinct(ASV[!is.na(p_value)]),
    n_nominal_sig = n_distinct(ASV[!is.na(p_value) & p_value < diet_candidate_nominal_cutoff]),
    n_fdr_sig = n_distinct(ASV[!is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_candidate_fdr_cutoff]),
    n_positive_fdr = n_distinct(ASV[!is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_candidate_fdr_cutoff & direction == "Positive"]),
    n_negative_fdr = n_distinct(ASV[!is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_candidate_fdr_cutoff & direction == "Negative"]),
    mean_log2_or = mean(log2_or, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log2_or = median(log2_or, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_fdr = suppressWarnings(min(p_adj_bh, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    min_fdr = ifelse(is.infinite(min_fdr), NA_real_, min_fdr),
    text_fdr = ifelse(n_fdr_sig > 0, paste0(n_fdr_sig, "/", n_tested), ""),
    text_nominal = ifelse(n_nominal_sig > 0, paste0(n_nominal_sig, "/", n_tested), "")
  ) %>%
  arrange(diet_scale, model_type, target_cluster, diet_label)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Plot: cluster top absolute dietary feature heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_candidate_top_feature_plot_tbl <- diet_candidate_cluster_top_features_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
    diet_label = factor(as.character(diet_label), levels = diet_plot_order)
  ) %>%
  complete(
    cluster = factor(as.character(1:4), levels = as.character(1:4)),
    diet_label = factor(diet_plot_order, levels = diet_plot_order),
    fill = list(
      mean_score = NA_real_,
      z_score = NA_real_,
      top_feature_rank = NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    text_z = ifelse(is.finite(z_score), sprintf("%.2f", z_score), "")
  )

p_diet_candidate_top_features <- ggplot(
  diet_candidate_top_feature_plot_tbl,
  aes(x = diet_label, y = cluster, fill = z_score)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = text_z), size = 3.3, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#3C5488",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#BC3C29",
    midpoint = 0,
    na.value = "grey96",
    name = "Z score"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cluster",
    title = "Top absolute dietary features selected for candidate ASV linkage",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Up to ", diet_candidate_top_n,
      " absolute dietary frequency variables with positive cluster-level z scores were selected among variables differing across clusters."
    )
  ) +
  diet_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_diet_candidate_top_features)

diet_save_plot_both(
  p_diet_candidate_top_features,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "plots",
    paste0("diet_candidate_", diet_scale_label, "_descriptive_cluster_top_features_heatmap")
  ),
  width = 8.8,
  height = 3.8
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 13) Plot function: candidate evidence heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_candidate_evidence_heatmap <- function(summary_tbl, model_i, evidence_type = c("fdr", "nominal")) {

  evidence_type <- match.arg(evidence_type)

  if (evidence_type == "fdr") {
    fill_col <- "n_fdr_sig"
    text_col <- "text_fdr"
    title_txt <- paste0("FDR-significant absolute candidate diet-ASV links (", model_i, ")")
    legend_txt <- "No. FDR\nsignificant ASVs"
    file_stub <- "fdr_count"
  } else {
    fill_col <- "n_nominal_sig"
    text_col <- "text_nominal"
    title_txt <- paste0("Nominally significant absolute candidate diet-ASV links (", model_i, ")")
    legend_txt <- "No. nominal\nsignificant ASVs"
    file_stub <- "nominal_count"
  }

  plot_df <- summary_tbl %>%
    filter(
      diet_scale == diet_scale_label,
      model_type == model_i
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      target_cluster = factor(as.character(target_cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
      diet_label = factor(as.character(diet_label), levels = diet_plot_order)
    ) %>%
    complete(
      target_cluster = factor(as.character(1:4), levels = as.character(1:4)),
      diet_label = factor(diet_plot_order, levels = diet_plot_order),
      fill = list(
        n_candidate_asvs = 0,
        n_tested = 0,
        n_nominal_sig = 0,
        n_fdr_sig = 0,
        text_fdr = "",
        text_nominal = ""
      )
    )

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = diet_label, y = target_cluster, fill = .data[[fill_col]])
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = .data[[text_col]]), size = 3.3, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c("#F7FBFF", "#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#08519C"),
      name = legend_txt
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Target cluster",
      title = title_txt,
      subtitle = "Cell labels indicate significant / tested candidate ASVs using absolute dietary frequency scores."
    ) +
    diet_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  print(p)

  diet_save_plot_both(
    p,
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "plots",
      paste0("diet_candidate_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_", file_stub, "_heatmap")
    ),
    width = 8.8,
    height = 3.8
  )

  invisible(p)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14) Draw candidate evidence heatmaps
# ---------------------------------------------------------
for (model_i in diet_candidate_model_types) {
  plot_candidate_evidence_heatmap(
    diet_candidate_cluster_diet_summary_tbl,
    model_i = model_i,
    evidence_type = "fdr"
  )

  plot_candidate_evidence_heatmap(
    diet_candidate_cluster_diet_summary_tbl,
    model_i = model_i,
    evidence_type = "nominal"
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 15) Forest plot for top candidate associations
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_candidate_forest <- function(assoc_tbl, model_i, top_n = 20) {

  plot_df <- assoc_tbl %>%
    filter(
      diet_scale == diet_scale_label,
      model_type == model_i,
      !is.na(odds_ratio),
      !is.na(p_value),
      is.finite(odds_ratio),
      is.finite(conf_low),
      is.finite(conf_high),
      odds_ratio > 0,
      conf_low > 0,
      conf_high > 0
    ) %>%
    arrange(p_adj_bh, p_value) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    mutate(
      label = paste0("C", target_cluster, " | ", ASV_lab, " | ", diet_label),
      label = factor(label, levels = rev(unique(label))),
      sig_class = case_when(
        !is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_candidate_fdr_cutoff ~ "FDR < 0.05",
        !is.na(p_value) & p_value < diet_candidate_nominal_cutoff ~ "P < 0.05",
        TRUE ~ "Not significant"
      )
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    message("No absolute candidate associations available for forest plot: ", model_i)
    return(NULL)
  }

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = odds_ratio, y = label)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey45") +
    geom_errorbarh(
      aes(xmin = conf_low, xmax = conf_high),
      height = 0.18,
      linewidth = 0.45,
      color = "grey35"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = sig_class),
      shape = 21,
      size = 2.8,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.25
    ) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "FDR < 0.05" = "#BC3C29",
        "P < 0.05" = "#E64B35",
        "Not significant" = "white"
      ),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Odds ratio per one-unit absolute diet score",
      y = NULL,
      title = paste0("Top absolute candidate diet-ASV associations (", model_i, ")"),
      subtitle = "Candidate pairs link cluster-enriched ASVs to top absolute dietary features of the same target cluster."
    ) +
    diet_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  print(p)

  diet_save_plot_both(
    p,
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "plots",
      paste0("diet_candidate_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_top_associations_forestplot")
    ),
    width = 10,
    height = max(5.2, 0.28 * nrow(plot_df))
  )

  invisible(p)
}

for (model_i in diet_candidate_model_types) {
  plot_candidate_forest(
    diet_candidate_assoc_annot_tbl,
    model_i = model_i,
    top_n = 20
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 16) Save output tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
readr::write_csv(
  diet_candidate_cluster_top_features_tbl,
  file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_candidate_", diet_scale_label, "_cluster_top_features.csv"))
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_candidate_asv_tbl,
  file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_candidate_", diet_scale_label, "_asv_table.csv"))
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_candidate_pairs_tbl,
  file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_candidate_", diet_scale_label, "_pairs.csv"))
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_candidate_assoc_annot_tbl,
  file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_candidate_", diet_scale_label, "_asv_diet_results.csv"))
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_candidate_cluster_diet_summary_tbl,
  file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_candidate_", diet_scale_label, "_cluster_diet_summary.csv"))
)

# Split model-specific candidate results for downstream inspection
for (model_i in diet_candidate_model_types) {
  readr::write_csv(
    diet_candidate_assoc_annot_tbl %>% filter(model_type == model_i),
    file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_candidate_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_asv_diet_results.csv"))
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 17) Console summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n===== Candidate cluster-matched absolute diet-ASV linkage analysis finished =====\n")
cat("Diet scale:", diet_scale_label, "\n")
cat("Top dietary features per cluster:", diet_candidate_top_n, "\n")
cat("Minimum ASV prevalence:", diet_candidate_min_prev, "\n")
cat("Candidate ASV-cluster pairs:", nrow(diet_candidate_asv_tbl), "\n")
cat("Candidate ASV-diet pairs:", nrow(diet_candidate_pairs_tbl), "\n")
cat("Tested candidate model rows:", sum(!is.na(diet_candidate_assoc_annot_tbl$p_value)), "\n")
cat("Nominally significant model rows:", sum(!is.na(diet_candidate_assoc_annot_tbl$p_value) & diet_candidate_assoc_annot_tbl$p_value < 0.05), "\n")
cat("FDR-significant model rows:", sum(!is.na(diet_candidate_assoc_annot_tbl$p_adj_bh) & diet_candidate_assoc_annot_tbl$p_adj_bh < 0.05), "\n")

cat("\nSaved tables:\n")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_candidate_", diet_scale_label, "_cluster_top_features.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_candidate_", diet_scale_label, "_asv_table.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_candidate_", diet_scale_label, "_pairs.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_candidate_", diet_scale_label, "_asv_diet_results.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_candidate_", diet_scale_label, "_cluster_diet_summary.csv")), "\n", sep = "")

cat("\nSaved model-specific tables:\n")
for (model_i in diet_candidate_model_types) {
  cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_candidate_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_asv_diet_results.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
}

cat("\nSaved plots under:\n")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots"), "\n", sep = "")
```

#v3. shared/overlaping cluster-associated ASV diet analysis
```{r}
# =========================================================
# V3. Shared / overlapping cluster-associated ASV diet analysis
# - Absolute/raw dietary frequency scores
# - Stratify cluster-associated ASVs by cluster-signature overlap pattern
#
# Purpose:
#   Evaluate whether absolute diet-ASV associations differ by ASV overlap pattern
#   across target cluster-associated ASV signatures.
#
# Analysis:
#   1) Unadjusted:
#        absolute raw diet score ~ ASV presence
#        Wilcoxon rank-sum test
#
#   2) Adjusted residual:
#        absolute diet residual after age + sex + BMI adjustment ~ ASV presence
#        Wilcoxon rank-sum test
#
# Required existing objects:
#   diet_meta
#   diet_variable_cols
#   diet_cluster_asv_tbl
#   diet_asv_pa_long
#   diet_outdir
#
# Output naming convention:
#   diet_overlap_absolute_<model/evidence>_*
#
# Main outputs:
#   Tables:
#     diet_overlap_absolute_asv_annotation.csv
#     diet_overlap_absolute_asv_diet_results.csv
#     diet_overlap_absolute_pattern_diet_summary.csv
#     diet_overlap_absolute_diet_summary.csv
#     diet_overlap_absolute_top_associations.csv
#
#   Plots:
#     diet_overlap_absolute_unadjusted_fdr_count_heatmap.png/.svg
#     diet_overlap_absolute_adjusted_residual_fdr_count_heatmap.png/.svg
#     diet_overlap_absolute_unadjusted_nominal_count_heatmap.png/.svg
#     diet_overlap_absolute_adjusted_residual_nominal_count_heatmap.png/.svg
#     diet_overlap_absolute_unadjusted_fdr_diet_count_barplot.png/.svg
#     diet_overlap_absolute_adjusted_residual_fdr_diet_count_barplot.png/.svg
#     diet_overlap_absolute_unadjusted_nominal_diet_count_barplot.png/.svg
#     diet_overlap_absolute_adjusted_residual_nominal_diet_count_barplot.png/.svg
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(purrr)
  library(forcats)
  library(stringr)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Preconditions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("diet_meta"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_variable_cols"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_cluster_asv_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_asv_pa_long"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_outdir"))

stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "age", "sex", "BMI", "cluster", "vil_id") %in% names(diet_meta)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "sampleid", "presence") %in% names(diet_asv_pa_long)))
stopifnot(all(c("target_cluster", "ASV") %in% names(diet_cluster_asv_tbl)))

dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_scale_label <- "absolute"

diet_overlap_min_prev <- 0.05
diet_overlap_max_prev <- 0.95
diet_overlap_min_present <- 20
diet_overlap_min_absent <- 20
diet_overlap_min_model_n <- 40
diet_overlap_fdr_cutoff <- 0.05
diet_overlap_nominal_cutoff <- 0.05

diet_overlap_model_types <- c("unadjusted", "adjusted_residual")

diet_plot_order <- c(
  "Vegetables",
  "Namul",
  "Kimchi",
  "Mushrooms",
  "Seaweed",
  "Seafood",
  "Fish",
  "Meat",
  "Fruit",
  "Beverages"
)

diet_label_map <- c(
  Vegetables = "Vegetables",
  Namul = "Namul",
  Kimchi = "Kimchi",
  Mushrooms = "Mushrooms",
  Seaweed = "Seaweed",
  Seafood = "Seafood",
  Fish = "Fish",
  Meat = "Meat",
  Fruit = "Fruit",
  Beverages = "Beverages"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Theme and save helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_theme <- ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10.5, color = "black"),
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9.5),
    panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
  )

diet_save_plot_both <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Prepare metadata and residualized absolute diet variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_overlap_meta_tbl <- diet_meta %>%
  select(
    sampleid,
    age,
    sex,
    BMI,
    cluster,
    vil_id,
    all_of(diet_variable_cols)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    age = as.numeric(age),
    sex = factor(sex),
    BMI = as.numeric(BMI),
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    across(all_of(diet_variable_cols), as.numeric)
  )

# Residualize each absolute diet variable by age, sex and BMI.
# na.exclude preserves row alignment.
for (diet_i in diet_variable_cols) {
  resid_col <- paste0(diet_i, "_resid")

  fit_i <- tryCatch(
    lm(
      as.formula(paste0("`", diet_i, "` ~ age + sex + BMI")),
      data = diet_overlap_meta_tbl,
      na.action = na.exclude
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit_i)) {
    diet_overlap_meta_tbl[[resid_col]] <- NA_real_
  } else {
    diet_overlap_meta_tbl[[resid_col]] <- as.numeric(resid(fit_i))
  }
}

diet_overlap_resid_cols <- paste0(diet_variable_cols, "_resid")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Build ASV model table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_overlap_asv_model_tbl <- diet_asv_pa_long %>%
  select(ASV, sampleid, presence) %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    presence = as.integer(as.numeric(presence) > 0)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(diet_overlap_meta_tbl, by = "sampleid")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) ASV prevalence diagnostics
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_overlap_asv_diag_tbl <- diet_overlap_asv_model_tbl %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    prevalence = mean(presence == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_present = sum(presence == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_absent = sum(presence == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(diet_scale = diet_scale_label, .before = 1)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Build overlap annotation from cluster-associated ASV table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Use significant and target-enriched ASVs as the overlap universe.
diet_overlap_cluster_asv_sig_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    target_cluster = as.character(target_cluster)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    target_cluster %in% as.character(1:4)
  )

# Apply significance filters only if columns are available.
if (all(c("fisher_p_adj", "wilcoxon_p_adj") %in% names(diet_overlap_cluster_asv_sig_tbl))) {
  diet_overlap_cluster_asv_sig_tbl <- diet_overlap_cluster_asv_sig_tbl %>%
    filter(
      fisher_p_adj < diet_overlap_fdr_cutoff |
        wilcoxon_p_adj < diet_overlap_fdr_cutoff
    )
}


diet_overlap_asv_annotation_tbl <- diet_overlap_cluster_asv_sig_tbl %>%
  select(any_of(c(
    "ASV",
    "ASV_lab",
    "target_cluster",
    "delta_prevalence_pct",
    "fisher_p_adj",
    "log2FC_detected",
    "wilcoxon_p_adj",
    "significance_category"
  ))) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    target_cluster = as.character(target_cluster)
  ) %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    ASV_lab = if ("ASV_lab" %in% names(.)) first(ASV_lab) else first(ASV),
    cluster_1 = as.integer(any(target_cluster == "1")),
    cluster_2 = as.integer(any(target_cluster == "2")),
    cluster_3 = as.integer(any(target_cluster == "3")),
    cluster_4 = as.integer(any(target_cluster == "4")),
    target_clusters = paste(sort(unique(target_cluster)), collapse = ";"),
    n_clusters_shared = n_distinct(target_cluster),
    max_delta_prevalence_pct = if ("delta_prevalence_pct" %in% names(.)) {
      max(delta_prevalence_pct, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    max_log2FC_detected = if ("log2FC_detected" %in% names(.)) {
      max(log2FC_detected, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
    overlap_pattern = paste0(cluster_1, cluster_2, cluster_3, cluster_4),
    overlap_label = case_when(
      overlap_pattern == "1000" ~ "C1 only",
      overlap_pattern == "0100" ~ "C2 only",
      overlap_pattern == "0010" ~ "C3 only",
      overlap_pattern == "0001" ~ "C4 only",
      overlap_pattern == "1100" ~ "C1+C2",
      overlap_pattern == "1010" ~ "C1+C3",
      overlap_pattern == "1001" ~ "C1+C4",
      overlap_pattern == "0110" ~ "C2+C3",
      overlap_pattern == "0101" ~ "C2+C4",
      overlap_pattern == "0011" ~ "C3+C4",
      overlap_pattern == "1110" ~ "C1+C2+C3",
      overlap_pattern == "1101" ~ "C1+C2+C4",
      overlap_pattern == "1011" ~ "C1+C3+C4",
      overlap_pattern == "0111" ~ "C2+C3+C4",
      overlap_pattern == "1111" ~ "C1+C2+C3+C4",
      TRUE ~ overlap_pattern
    ),
    overlap_class = case_when(
      n_clusters_shared == 1 ~ "cluster-specific",
      n_clusters_shared > 1 ~ "multi-cluster-associated",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    ),
    .before = 1
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    diet_overlap_asv_diag_tbl %>% select(-diet_scale),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(prevalence),
    prevalence >= diet_overlap_min_prev,
    prevalence <= diet_overlap_max_prev,
    n_present >= diet_overlap_min_present,
    n_absent >= diet_overlap_min_absent
  )

# Order overlap labels by number of shared clusters and pattern
diet_overlap_label_order <- diet_overlap_asv_annotation_tbl %>%
  distinct(overlap_label, n_clusters_shared, overlap_pattern) %>%
  arrange(n_clusters_shared, overlap_pattern) %>%
  pull(overlap_label)

cat("\n===== Absolute ASV overlap annotation summary =====\n")
print(
  diet_overlap_asv_annotation_tbl %>%
    count(overlap_label, overlap_class, name = "n_asvs") %>%
    arrange(overlap_class, overlap_label)
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Helper: Wilcoxon test for one ASV and one absolute diet variable
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_overlap_run_one_test <- function(df, asv_id, diet_raw_i, diet_resid_i, model_type = c("unadjusted", "adjusted_residual")) {

  model_type <- match.arg(model_type)

  if (model_type == "unadjusted") {
    value_col <- diet_raw_i
  } else {
    value_col <- diet_resid_i
  }

  dat <- df %>%
    filter(ASV == asv_id) %>%
    select(
      sampleid,
      presence,
      diet_value = all_of(value_col),
      raw_diet_value = all_of(diet_raw_i)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(sampleid),
      !is.na(presence),
      is.finite(diet_value),
      is.finite(raw_diet_value)
    )

  if (nrow(dat) < diet_overlap_min_model_n) return(NULL)
  if (n_distinct(dat$presence) < 2) return(NULL)

  n_present_i <- sum(dat$presence == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_absent_i <- sum(dat$presence == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (n_present_i < diet_overlap_min_present) return(NULL)
  if (n_absent_i < diet_overlap_min_absent) return(NULL)

  wt <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      wilcox.test(diet_value ~ presence, data = dat, exact = FALSE)
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(wt)) return(NULL)

  effect_test_value <- mean(dat$diet_value[dat$presence == 1], na.rm = TRUE) -
    mean(dat$diet_value[dat$presence == 0], na.rm = TRUE)

  effect_raw <- mean(dat$raw_diet_value[dat$presence == 1], na.rm = TRUE) -
    mean(dat$raw_diet_value[dat$presence == 0], na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble(
    diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
    model_type = model_type,
    ASV = as.character(asv_id),
    diet_var = as.character(diet_raw_i),
    p_value = as.numeric(wt$p.value),
    effect = as.numeric(effect_test_value),
    effect_raw = as.numeric(effect_raw),
    mean_test_value_present = mean(dat$diet_value[dat$presence == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_test_value_absent = mean(dat$diet_value[dat$presence == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_raw_present = mean(dat$raw_diet_value[dat$presence == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_raw_absent = mean(dat$raw_diet_value[dat$presence == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    n_model = nrow(dat),
    n_present_model = n_present_i,
    n_absent_model = n_absent_i
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Run unadjusted and adjusted-residual tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_overlap_target_asvs <- unique(diet_overlap_asv_annotation_tbl$ASV)

diet_overlap_result_list <- purrr::map(diet_overlap_target_asvs, function(asv_i) {
  purrr::map2(diet_variable_cols, diet_overlap_resid_cols, function(diet_raw_i, diet_resid_i) {
    purrr::map(diet_overlap_model_types, function(model_i) {
      diet_overlap_run_one_test(
        df = diet_overlap_asv_model_tbl,
        asv_id = asv_i,
        diet_raw_i = diet_raw_i,
        diet_resid_i = diet_resid_i,
        model_type = model_i
      )
    })
  })
})

diet_overlap_result_flat <- purrr::flatten(diet_overlap_result_list)
diet_overlap_result_flat <- diet_overlap_result_flat[
  !purrr::map_lgl(diet_overlap_result_flat, is.null)
]

if (length(diet_overlap_result_flat) == 0) {
  diet_overlap_asv_diet_results_tbl <- tibble(
    diet_scale = character(),
    model_type = character(),
    ASV = character(),
    diet_var = character(),
    p_value = numeric(),
    effect = numeric(),
    effect_raw = numeric(),
    p_adj_bh = numeric()
  )
} else {
  diet_overlap_asv_diet_results_tbl <- bind_rows(diet_overlap_result_flat) %>%
    group_by(diet_scale, model_type) %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      diet_label = recode(diet_var, !!!diet_label_map, .default = diet_var),
      diet_label = factor(diet_label, levels = diet_plot_order),
      direction = case_when(
        effect > 0 ~ "Higher in ASV-present",
        effect < 0 ~ "Lower in ASV-present",
        TRUE ~ "No difference"
      )
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      diet_overlap_asv_annotation_tbl,
      by = c("diet_scale", "ASV")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      overlap_label = factor(overlap_label, levels = diet_overlap_label_order),
      overlap_class = factor(overlap_class, levels = c("cluster-specific", "multi-cluster-associated"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(diet_scale, model_type, p_adj_bh, p_value)
}

cat("\n===== Absolute overlap ASV-diet test summary =====\n")
print(
  diet_overlap_asv_diet_results_tbl %>%
    count(diet_scale, model_type, name = "n_tests")
)

print(
  diet_overlap_asv_diet_results_tbl %>%
    group_by(diet_scale, model_type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_nominal_sig = sum(!is.na(p_value) & p_value < diet_overlap_nominal_cutoff),
      n_fdr_sig = sum(!is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_overlap_fdr_cutoff),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Summary by overlap pattern and diet
#    - Denominator is fixed to Fig. 2j UpSet intersection size
#    - Y-axis order follows small-to-large cluster combinations:
#      C1 only, C2 only, C3 only, C4 only,
#      C1+C2, C1+C3, ...
#    - ASVs not testable in the diet subset are counted as non-significant
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Desired overlap order: small-to-large cluster combinations
diet_overlap_label_order <- c(
  "C1 only", "C2 only", "C3 only", "C4 only",
  "C1+C2", "C1+C3", "C1+C4",
  "C2+C3", "C2+C4", "C3+C4",
  "C1+C2+C3", "C1+C2+C4", "C1+C3+C4", "C2+C3+C4",
  "C1+C2+C3+C4"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9.1) Denominator table from Fig. 2j UpSet summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Prefer the same summary table used for the Fig. 2j UpSet top bars.
# This guarantees that denominators match Fig. 2j intersection sizes.
if (exists("diet_cluster_asv_overlap_summary_tbl")) {
  
  diet_overlap_total_count_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_overlap_summary_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      overlap_label = as.character(overlap_label),
      n_clusters_shared = as.integer(n_clusters_shared),
      overlap_class = case_when(
        n_clusters_shared == 1 ~ "cluster-specific",
        n_clusters_shared > 1 ~ "multi-cluster-associated",
        TRUE ~ "unassigned"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      overlap_label %in% diet_overlap_label_order,
      n_asvs > 0
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      overlap_label,
      overlap_class,
      n_clusters_shared,
      n_total_asvs = as.integer(n_asvs)
    )
  
} else if (exists("diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl")) {
  
  message(
    "Object 'diet_cluster_asv_overlap_summary_tbl' not found. ",
    "Using 'diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl' instead."
  )
  
  diet_overlap_total_count_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      overlap_label = as.character(overlap_label),
      n_clusters_shared = as.integer(n_clusters_shared),
      overlap_class = case_when(
        n_clusters_shared == 1 ~ "cluster-specific",
        n_clusters_shared > 1 ~ "multi-cluster-associated",
        TRUE ~ "unassigned"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      overlap_label %in% diet_overlap_label_order,
      n_clusters_shared > 0
    ) %>%
    count(
      overlap_label,
      overlap_class,
      n_clusters_shared,
      name = "n_total_asvs"
    )
  
} else {
  
  stop(
    "Neither 'diet_cluster_asv_overlap_summary_tbl' nor ",
    "'diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl' exists. ",
    "Run the Fig. 2j cluster-associated ASV overlap chunk first."
  )
}

# Force desired order, but keep only observed Fig. 2j intersections
diet_overlap_total_count_tbl <- diet_overlap_total_count_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    overlap_label = factor(overlap_label, levels = diet_overlap_label_order),
    overlap_class = factor(
      overlap_class,
      levels = c("cluster-specific", "multi-cluster-associated", "unassigned")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(overlap_label)

diet_overlap_label_order_to_plot <- diet_overlap_label_order[
  diet_overlap_label_order %in% as.character(diet_overlap_total_count_tbl$overlap_label)
]

cat("\n===== Fig. 2j denominator used for Extended Data Fig. 4a =====\n")
print(diet_overlap_total_count_tbl)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9.2) Count actually tested and significant ASVs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_overlap_tested_sig_tbl <- diet_overlap_asv_diet_results_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    overlap_label = as.character(overlap_label),
    diet_label = as.character(diet_label)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    diet_scale,
    model_type,
    overlap_label,
    diet_var,
    diet_label
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tested_asvs = n_distinct(ASV),
    n_nominal_sig = n_distinct(ASV[!is.na(p_value) & p_value < diet_overlap_nominal_cutoff]),
    n_fdr_sig = n_distinct(ASV[!is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_overlap_fdr_cutoff]),
    n_positive_fdr = n_distinct(ASV[!is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_overlap_fdr_cutoff & effect > 0]),
    n_negative_fdr = n_distinct(ASV[!is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_overlap_fdr_cutoff & effect < 0]),
    mean_effect = mean(effect, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_effect = median(effect, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_effect_raw = mean(effect_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9.3) Full grid: force all Fig. 2j overlap rows x all diet variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_overlap_pattern_diet_summary_tbl <- tidyr::crossing(
  diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
  model_type = diet_overlap_model_types,
  overlap_label = diet_overlap_label_order_to_plot,
  diet_label = diet_plot_order
) %>%
  mutate(
    overlap_label = factor(overlap_label, levels = diet_overlap_label_order),
    diet_label = factor(diet_label, levels = diet_plot_order),
    diet_var = as.character(diet_label)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    diet_overlap_total_count_tbl %>%
      mutate(overlap_label = as.character(overlap_label)) %>%
      select(overlap_label, overlap_class, n_clusters_shared, n_total_asvs),
    by = "overlap_label"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    diet_overlap_tested_sig_tbl,
    by = c(
      "diet_scale",
      "model_type",
      "overlap_label",
      "diet_var",
      "diet_label"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_total_asvs = replace_na(n_total_asvs, 0L),
    n_tested_asvs = replace_na(n_tested_asvs, 0L),
    n_nominal_sig = replace_na(n_nominal_sig, 0L),
    n_fdr_sig = replace_na(n_fdr_sig, 0L),
    n_positive_fdr = replace_na(n_positive_fdr, 0L),
    n_negative_fdr = replace_na(n_negative_fdr, 0L),
    mean_effect = ifelse(is.nan(mean_effect), NA_real_, mean_effect),
    median_effect = ifelse(is.nan(median_effect), NA_real_, median_effect),
    mean_effect_raw = ifelse(is.nan(mean_effect_raw), NA_real_, mean_effect_raw),
    
    # Denominator: Fig. 2j UpSet count
    text_fdr = paste0(n_fdr_sig, "/", n_total_asvs),
    text_nominal = paste0(n_nominal_sig, "/", n_total_asvs),
    text_tested = paste0(n_tested_asvs, "/", n_total_asvs),
    
    diet_label = factor(as.character(diet_label), levels = diet_plot_order),
    overlap_label = factor(as.character(overlap_label), levels = diet_overlap_label_order),
    overlap_class = factor(
      overlap_class,
      levels = c("cluster-specific", "multi-cluster-associated", "unassigned")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(model_type, overlap_label, diet_label)

cat("\n===== Heatmap summary check: denominators should match Fig. 2j =====\n")
print(
  diet_overlap_pattern_diet_summary_tbl %>%
    filter(model_type == "adjusted_residual") %>%
    distinct(overlap_label, n_total_asvs, n_tested_asvs) %>%
    arrange(overlap_label)
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Summary by diet only
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_overlap_diet_summary_tbl <- diet_overlap_asv_diet_results_tbl %>%
  group_by(diet_scale, model_type, diet_var, diet_label, direction) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tested_asvs = n_distinct(ASV),
    n_nominal_sig = n_distinct(ASV[!is.na(p_value) & p_value < diet_overlap_nominal_cutoff]),
    n_fdr_sig = n_distinct(ASV[!is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_overlap_fdr_cutoff]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
    model_type = diet_overlap_model_types,
    diet_label = factor(diet_plot_order, levels = diet_plot_order),
    direction = c("Higher in ASV-present", "Lower in ASV-present"),
    fill = list(
      n_tested_asvs = 0,
      n_nominal_sig = 0,
      n_fdr_sig = 0
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diet_var = as.character(diet_label),
    diet_label = factor(as.character(diet_label), levels = diet_plot_order),
    direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Higher in ASV-present", "Lower in ASV-present"))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Plot function: overlap pattern x diet heatmap
#     - Y-axis top-to-bottom:
#       C1 only, C2 only, C3 only, C4 only,
#       C1+C2, C1+C3, ...
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_overlap_heatmap <- function(summary_tbl, model_i, evidence_type = c("fdr", "nominal")) {
  
  evidence_type <- match.arg(evidence_type)
  
  if (evidence_type == "fdr") {
    fill_col <- "n_fdr_sig"
    text_col <- "text_fdr"
    title_txt <- paste0("FDR-significant absolute diet-ASV differences by overlap pattern (", model_i, ")")
    legend_txt <- "No. FDR\nsignificant ASVs"
    file_stub <- "fdr_count"
  } else {
    fill_col <- "n_nominal_sig"
    text_col <- "text_nominal"
    title_txt <- paste0("Nominally significant absolute diet-ASV differences by overlap pattern (", model_i, ")")
    legend_txt <- "No. nominal\nsignificant ASVs"
    file_stub <- "nominal_count"
  }
  
  plot_df <- summary_tbl %>%
    filter(
      diet_scale == diet_scale_label,
      model_type == model_i,
      overlap_label %in% diet_overlap_label_order_to_plot
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      diet_label = factor(as.character(diet_label), levels = diet_plot_order),
      
      # ggplot draws first y-level at the bottom.
      # Reversing levels makes C1 only appear at the top.
      overlap_label = factor(
        as.character(overlap_label),
        levels = rev(diet_overlap_label_order_to_plot)
      )
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = diet_label, y = overlap_label, fill = .data[[fill_col]])
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.75) +
    geom_text(aes(label = .data[[text_col]]), size = 3.0, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c("#F7FBFF", "#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#08519C"),
      name = legend_txt
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "ASV overlap pattern",
      title = title_txt,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Cell labels indicate significant / total ASVs in each Fig. 2j overlap pattern. ",
        "ASVs not testable in the diet subset were counted as non-significant. ",
        "Diet scale: absolute frequency score; test: Wilcoxon rank-sum."
      )
    ) +
    diet_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  diet_save_plot_both(
    p,
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "plots",
      paste0("diet_overlap_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_", file_stub, "_heatmap")
    ),
    width = 10.8,
    height = max(5.2, 0.38 * length(diet_overlap_label_order_to_plot))
  )
  
  invisible(p)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Draw overlap heatmaps
# ---------------------------------------------------------
for (model_i in diet_overlap_model_types) {
  plot_overlap_heatmap(
    diet_overlap_pattern_diet_summary_tbl,
    model_i = model_i,
    evidence_type = "fdr"
  )

  plot_overlap_heatmap(
    diet_overlap_pattern_diet_summary_tbl,
    model_i = model_i,
    evidence_type = "nominal"
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 13) Diet-wise barplot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_overlap_diet_barplot <- function(summary_tbl, model_i, evidence_type = c("fdr", "nominal")) {

  evidence_type <- match.arg(evidence_type)

  if (evidence_type == "fdr") {
    value_col <- "n_fdr_sig"
    title_txt <- paste0("Absolute dietary variables associated with overlapping cluster-ASVs (", model_i, ")")
    subtitle_txt <- "Bars show unique ASVs with FDR-significant higher or lower absolute diet values in ASV-present individuals."
    file_stub <- "fdr"
  } else {
    value_col <- "n_nominal_sig"
    title_txt <- paste0("Absolute dietary variables associated with overlapping cluster-ASVs (", model_i, ")")
    subtitle_txt <- "Bars show unique ASVs with nominally significant higher or lower absolute diet values in ASV-present individuals."
    file_stub <- "nominal"
  }

  plot_df <- summary_tbl %>%
    filter(
      diet_scale == diet_scale_label,
      model_type == model_i
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      signed_n = case_when(
        direction == "Higher in ASV-present" ~ .data[[value_col]],
        direction == "Lower in ASV-present" ~ -.data[[value_col]],
        TRUE ~ 0
      )
    )

  y_max <- max(plot_df$signed_n, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(plot_df$signed_n, na.rm = TRUE)

  y_upper <- ceiling((y_max + 2) / 5) * 5
  y_lower <- floor((y_min - 2) / 5) * 5

  if (y_lower > -5) y_lower <- -5
  if (y_upper < 5) y_upper <- 5

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = diet_label, y = signed_n, fill = direction)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey35") +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Higher in ASV-present" = "#BC3C29",
        "Lower in ASV-present" = "#3C5488"
      ),
      name = "Direction"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(y_lower, y_upper),
      breaks = seq(y_lower, y_upper, by = 5),
      labels = abs,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "No. unique ASVs",
      title = title_txt,
      subtitle = subtitle_txt
    ) +
    diet_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  print(p)

  diet_save_plot_both(
    p,
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "plots",
      paste0("diet_overlap_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_", file_stub, "_diet_count_barplot")
    ),
    width = 8.8,
    height = 4.8
  )

  invisible(p)
}

for (model_i in diet_overlap_model_types) {
  plot_overlap_diet_barplot(
    diet_overlap_diet_summary_tbl,
    model_i = model_i,
    evidence_type = "fdr"
  )

  plot_overlap_diet_barplot(
    diet_overlap_diet_summary_tbl,
    model_i = model_i,
    evidence_type = "nominal"
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14) Optional top association table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_overlap_top_tbl <- diet_overlap_asv_diet_results_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_value), !is.na(effect)) %>%
  arrange(diet_scale, model_type, p_adj_bh, p_value) %>%
  group_by(diet_scale, model_type) %>%
  slice_head(n = 30) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    diet_scale,

    overlap_class,
    n_clusters_shared,
    target_clusters,
    ASV,
    ASV_lab,
    diet_label,
    p_value,
    p_adj_bh,
    effect,
    effect_raw,
    direction,
    n_model,
    n_present_model,
    n_absent_model
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 15) Save output tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
readr::write_csv(
  diet_overlap_asv_annotation_tbl,
  file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_overlap_", diet_scale_label, "_asv_annotation.csv"))
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_overlap_asv_diet_results_tbl,
  file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_overlap_", diet_scale_label, "_asv_diet_results.csv"))
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_overlap_pattern_diet_summary_tbl,
  file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_overlap_", diet_scale_label, "_pattern_diet_summary.csv"))
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_overlap_diet_summary_tbl,
  file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_overlap_", diet_scale_label, "_diet_summary.csv"))
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_overlap_top_tbl,
  file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_overlap_", diet_scale_label, "_top_associations.csv"))
)

# Split model-specific result tables
for (model_i in diet_overlap_model_types) {
  readr::write_csv(
    diet_overlap_asv_diet_results_tbl %>%
      filter(model_type == model_i),
    file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_overlap_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_asv_diet_results.csv"))
  )

  readr::write_csv(
    diet_overlap_pattern_diet_summary_tbl %>%
      filter(model_type == model_i),
    file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_overlap_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_pattern_diet_summary.csv"))
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 16) Console summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n===== V3 shared / overlapping ASV absolute diet analysis finished =====\n")
cat("Diet scale:", diet_scale_label, "\n")
cat("Target ASVs after overlap and prevalence filtering:", length(diet_overlap_target_asvs), "\n")
cat("Total tested ASV-diet rows:", nrow(diet_overlap_asv_diet_results_tbl), "\n")

cat("\nBy model type:\n")

  diet_overlap_asv_diet_results_tbl %>%

      n_tests = n(),
      n_nominal_sig = sum(!is.na(p_value) & p_value < diet_overlap_nominal_cutoff),
      n_fdr_sig = sum(!is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_overlap_fdr_cutoff),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
)

cat("\nSaved tables:\n")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_overlap_", diet_scale_label, "_asv_annotation.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_overlap_", diet_scale_label, "_asv_diet_results.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_overlap_", diet_scale_label, "_pattern_diet_summary.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_overlap_", diet_scale_label, "_diet_summary.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_overlap_", diet_scale_label, "_top_associations.csv")), "\n", sep = "")

cat("\nSaved model-specific tables:\n")
for (model_i in diet_overlap_model_types) {
  cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_overlap_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_asv_diet_results.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0("diet_overlap_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_pattern_diet_summary.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
}

cat("\nSaved plots under:\n")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots"), "\n", sep = "")
```
