#diet_relative composition analysis
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Relative dietary composition analysis
# - Individual-level relative diet composition
# - Cluster summary + statistics + heatmaps
# - Descriptive analysis only; no ASV model is fitted
#
# Required:
#   metadata_diet.csv
#   diet_outdir
#
# Output naming convention:
#   diet_cluster_composition_relative_descriptive_*
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(purrr)
  library(stringr)
  library(forcats)
  library(scales)
  library(tibble)
})

# =========================================================
# 0. file and output settings
# =========================================================
stopifnot(file.exists("metadata_diet.csv"))

# Use existing diet_outdir if available.
# This keeps relative composition outputs under the same diet_analysis folder.
if (!exists("diet_outdir")) {
  diet_outdir <- "diet_analysis"
}

dir.create(diet_outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

diet_scale_label <- "relative"
diet_model_label <- "descriptive"

diet_save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext,
                                width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
  
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

theme_diet <- function() {
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12, base_family = "sans") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black", face = "bold"),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9.5),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
    )
}

# =========================================================
# 1. diet variable order
# =========================================================
diet_plot_order <- c(
  "Vegetables",
  "Namul",
  "Kimchi",
  "Mushrooms",
  "Seaweed",
  "Seafood",
  "Fish",
  "Meat",
  "Fruit",
  "Beverages"
)

diet_fill_pal <- c(
  "Vegetables" = "#4E79A7",
  "Namul"      = "#59A14F",
  "Kimchi"     = "#E15759",
  "Mushrooms"  = "#B07AA1",
  "Seaweed"    = "#76B7B2",
  "Seafood"    = "#9C755F",
  "Fish"       = "#1F77B4",
  "Meat"       = "#D62728",
  "Fruit"      = "#F28E2B",
  "Beverages"  = "#EDC948"
)

# =========================================================
# 2. read and clean metadata
# =========================================================
diet_rel_meta <- readr::read_csv("metadata_diet.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(~ stringr::str_trim(.x))

stopifnot("sampleid" %in% names(diet_rel_meta))
stopifnot("cluster" %in% names(diet_rel_meta))
stopifnot(all(diet_plot_order %in% names(diet_rel_meta)))

diet_rel_meta <- diet_rel_meta %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
    across(all_of(diet_plot_order), as.numeric)
  )

# =========================================================
# 3. compute individual-level total diet score
# =========================================================
diet_rel_meta2 <- diet_rel_meta %>%
  mutate(
    diet_total_score = rowSums(across(all_of(diet_plot_order)), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Keep samples with total > 0
diet_rel_meta_use <- diet_rel_meta2 %>%
  filter(is.finite(diet_total_score), diet_total_score > 0)

# QC table
diet_rel_qc_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
  model_type = diet_model_label,
  n_total_samples = nrow(diet_rel_meta2),
  n_samples_used = nrow(diet_rel_meta_use),
  n_samples_removed_zero_total = sum(
    !is.finite(diet_rel_meta2$diet_total_score) |
      diet_rel_meta2$diet_total_score <= 0
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_rel_qc_tbl,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0("diet_cluster_composition_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_qc_summary.csv")
  )
)

# =========================================================
# 4. long-format table with relative composition
# =========================================================
diet_rel_long <- diet_rel_meta_use %>%
  select(sampleid, cluster, diet_total_score, all_of(diet_plot_order)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(diet_plot_order),
    names_to = "diet_var",
    values_to = "diet_score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
    model_type = diet_model_label,
    diet_var = factor(diet_var, levels = diet_plot_order),
    diet_relative = diet_score / diet_total_score
  ) %>%
  select(diet_scale, model_type, everything())

readr::write_csv(
  diet_rel_long,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0("diet_cluster_composition_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_long.csv")
  )
)

# =========================================================
# 5. cluster-level summary of relative composition
# =========================================================
diet_rel_cluster_summary <- diet_rel_long %>%
  group_by(diet_scale, model_type, cluster, diet_var) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_relative = mean(diet_relative, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_relative = sd(diet_relative, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_relative = sd_relative / sqrt(n),
    median_relative = median(diet_relative, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_relative = quantile(diet_relative, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_relative = quantile(diet_relative, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_absolute = mean(diet_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diet_var = factor(diet_var, levels = diet_plot_order)
  )

readr::write_csv(
  diet_rel_cluster_summary,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0("diet_cluster_composition_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_cluster_summary.csv")
  )
)

# =========================================================
# 6. Kruskal-Wallis test across clusters
#    on individual-level relative proportions
# =========================================================
diet_rel_kw_results <- purrr::map_dfr(diet_plot_order, function(v) {
  df <- diet_rel_long %>%
    filter(diet_var == v) %>%
    filter(is.finite(diet_relative)) %>%
    drop_na(cluster)
  
  if (n_distinct(df$cluster) < 2) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
      model_type = diet_model_label,
      diet_var = v,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  fit <- kruskal.test(diet_relative ~ cluster, data = df)
  
  tibble::tibble(
    diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
    model_type = diet_model_label,
    diet_var = v,
    statistic = unname(fit$statistic),
    p_value = fit$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_bh, p_value)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_rel_kw_results,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0("diet_cluster_composition_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_kw_results.csv")
  )
)

# =========================================================
# 7. pairwise Wilcoxon test
# =========================================================
diet_rel_pairwise_list <- purrr::map(diet_plot_order, function(v) {
  df <- diet_rel_long %>%
    filter(diet_var == v) %>%
    filter(is.finite(diet_relative)) %>%
    drop_na(cluster)
  
  if (n_distinct(df$cluster) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  pw <- pairwise.wilcox.test(
    x = df$diet_relative,
    g = df$cluster,
    p.adjust.method = "BH",
    exact = FALSE
  )
  
  pw_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(pw$p.value), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(pw_df) <- c("cluster1", "cluster2", "p_adj_bh")
  
  pw_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(p_adj_bh)) %>%
    mutate(
      diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
      model_type = diet_model_label,
      diet_var = v
    ) %>%
    select(diet_scale, model_type, diet_var, cluster1, cluster2, p_adj_bh)
})

diet_rel_pairwise_results <- bind_rows(diet_rel_pairwise_list)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_rel_pairwise_results,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0("diet_cluster_composition_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_pairwise_wilcox_results.csv")
  )
)

# =========================================================
# 8. heatmap tables
# =========================================================
diet_rel_heatmap_mean <- diet_rel_cluster_summary %>%
  select(diet_scale, model_type, cluster, diet_var, mean_relative)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_rel_heatmap_mean,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0("diet_cluster_composition_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_mean_proportion_heatmap_data.csv")
  )
)

diet_rel_heatmap_rowz <- diet_rel_heatmap_mean %>%
  group_by(diet_var) %>%
  mutate(
    row_z = as.numeric(scale(mean_relative))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

readr::write_csv(
  diet_rel_heatmap_rowz,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0("diet_cluster_composition_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_row_z_heatmap_data.csv")
  )
)

# =========================================================
# 9. significance label table for plotting
# =========================================================
diet_rel_sig_label_tbl <- diet_rel_kw_results %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = case_when(
      is.na(p_adj_bh) ~ "FDR = NA",
      p_adj_bh < 0.001 ~ "FDR < 0.001",
      p_adj_bh < 0.01 ~ "FDR < 0.01",
      p_adj_bh < 0.05 ~ "FDR < 0.05",
      TRUE ~ paste0("FDR = ", formatC(p_adj_bh, format = "f", digits = 3))
    )
  )

# =========================================================
# 10. plot 1: heatmap of mean relative proportion
# =========================================================
p_diet_rel_heatmap_mean <- ggplot(
  diet_rel_heatmap_mean,
  aes(x = factor(cluster), y = factor(diet_var, levels = rev(diet_plot_order)), fill = mean_relative)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", mean_relative)), size = 3.3) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#F7FBFF", "#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#08519C"),
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.001),
    name = "Mean relative\nproportion"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Cluster",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Cluster-level relative dietary composition",
    subtitle = "Cell values indicate mean individual-level relative proportions within each cluster."
  ) +
  theme_diet() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)
  )

diet_save_plot_both(
  p_diet_rel_heatmap_mean,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "plots",
    paste0("diet_cluster_composition_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_mean_proportion_heatmap")
  ),
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

# =========================================================
# 11. plot 2: row-wise z-score heatmap
# =========================================================
p_diet_rel_heatmap_rowz <- ggplot(
  diet_rel_heatmap_rowz,
  aes(x = factor(cluster), y = factor(diet_var, levels = rev(diet_plot_order)), fill = row_z)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", mean_relative)), size = 3.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#3C5488",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#BC3C29",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Row-wise\nZ score"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Cluster",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Cluster-level relative dietary composition deviations",
    subtitle = "Tile color shows row-wise standardized cluster deviation; text shows mean relative proportion."
  ) +
  theme_diet() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)
  )

diet_save_plot_both(
  p_diet_rel_heatmap_rowz,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "plots",
    paste0("diet_cluster_composition_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_row_z_heatmap")
  ),
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

# =========================================================
# 12. plot 3: stacked barplot
# =========================================================
diet_rel_bar_tbl <- diet_rel_cluster_summary %>%
  mutate(
    diet_var = factor(diet_var, levels = diet_plot_order)
  )

p_diet_rel_bar <- ggplot(
  diet_rel_bar_tbl,
  aes(x = factor(cluster), y = mean_relative, fill = diet_var)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diet_fill_pal, breaks = diet_plot_order) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Mean relative proportion",
    fill = "Diet category",
    title = "Cluster-wise relative dietary composition",
    subtitle = "Bars sum to 100% within each cluster."
  ) +
  theme_diet() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

diet_save_plot_both(
  p_diet_rel_bar,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "plots",
    paste0("diet_cluster_composition_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_stacked_barplot")
  ),
  width = 8.5,
  height = 6
)

# =========================================================
# 13. plot 4: faceted barplot: mean ± SE
# =========================================================
diet_rel_plot_df <- diet_rel_cluster_summary %>%
  left_join(
    diet_rel_sig_label_tbl %>% select(diet_var, p_label),
    by = "diet_var"
  )

diet_rel_ypos_tbl <- diet_rel_plot_df %>%
  group_by(diet_var) %>%
  summarise(
    y_pos = max(mean_relative + se_relative, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

diet_rel_plot_df <- diet_rel_plot_df %>%
  left_join(diet_rel_ypos_tbl, by = "diet_var")

p_diet_rel_facet <- ggplot(
  diet_rel_plot_df,
  aes(x = factor(cluster), y = mean_relative, fill = factor(cluster))
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_relative - se_relative, ymax = mean_relative + se_relative),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = diet_rel_plot_df %>% distinct(diet_var, p_label, y_pos),
    aes(x = 2.5, y = y_pos, label = p_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ diet_var, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Mean relative proportion ± SE",
    fill = "Cluster",
    title = "Cluster-level differences in relative dietary composition"
  ) +
  theme_diet() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

diet_save_plot_both(
  p_diet_rel_facet,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "plots",
    paste0("diet_cluster_composition_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_facet_barplot")
  ),
  width = 10,
  height = 12
)

# =========================================================
# 14. quick console summary
# =========================================================
cat("===== Relative composition analysis finished =====\n")
cat("Output directory:", diet_outdir, "\n")
cat("Diet scale:", diet_scale_label, "\n")
cat("Model type:", diet_model_label, "\n")
cat("Samples used:", nrow(diet_rel_meta_use), "\n")
cat("Diet variables:", length(diet_plot_order), "\n")
cat(
  "Significant KW tests (FDR < 0.05):",
  sum(diet_rel_kw_results$p_adj_bh < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
  "\n"
)

cat("\nSaved plots:\n")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots", paste0("diet_cluster_composition_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_mean_proportion_heatmap.png/.svg")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots", paste0("diet_cluster_composition_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_row_z_heatmap.png/.svg")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots", paste0("diet_cluster_composition_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_stacked_barplot.png/.svg")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots", paste0("diet_cluster_composition_", diet_scale_label, "_", diet_model_label, "_facet_barplot.png/.svg")), "\n", sep = "")
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Relative diet composition - ASV association analysis
# - Individual-level relative dietary composition
# - Logistic association with cluster-associated ASV presence
#
# Purpose:
#   Test whether individual-level relative dietary composition
#   is associated with cluster-associated ASV presence.
#
# Relative diet definition:
#   relative_diet_i = diet_i / sum(all diet scores)
#
# Models:
#   1) Unadjusted:
#        ASV presence ~ relative diet proportion
#
#   2) Adjusted:
#        ASV presence ~ relative diet proportion + age + sex + BMI
#
# Required existing objects:
#   diet_meta
#   diet_variable_cols
#   diet_cluster_asv_tbl
#   diet_asv_pa_long
#   diet_outdir
#
# Output naming convention:
#   diet_asv_logistic_relative_*
#   diet_asv_summary_relative_<model>_*
#
# Main outputs:
#   Tables:
#     diet_asv_logistic_relative_qc_summary.csv
#     diet_asv_logistic_relative_asv_annotation.csv
#     diet_asv_logistic_relative_all_models_results.csv
#     diet_asv_logistic_relative_all_models_annotated_results.csv
#     diet_asv_logistic_relative_significant_results.csv
#     diet_asv_summary_relative_cluster_diet_summary.csv
#     diet_asv_summary_relative_diet_count_summary.csv
#
#   Plots:
#     diet_asv_summary_relative_unadjusted_all_count_heatmap.png/.svg
#     diet_asv_summary_relative_adjusted_all_count_heatmap.png/.svg
#     diet_asv_summary_relative_unadjusted_specific_count_heatmap.png/.svg
#     diet_asv_summary_relative_adjusted_specific_count_heatmap.png/.svg
#     diet_asv_summary_relative_unadjusted_diet_count_barplot.png/.svg
#     diet_asv_summary_relative_adjusted_diet_count_barplot.png/.svg
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(purrr)
  library(forcats)
  library(stringr)
  library(broom)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Preconditions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("diet_meta"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_variable_cols"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_cluster_asv_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_asv_pa_long"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_outdir"))

stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "age", "sex", "BMI", "cluster", "vil_id") %in% names(diet_meta)))
stopifnot(all(diet_variable_cols %in% names(diet_meta)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "sampleid", "presence") %in% names(diet_asv_pa_long)))
stopifnot(all(c("target_cluster", "ASV") %in% names(diet_cluster_asv_tbl)))

dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_scale_label <- "relative"
diet_relative_model_types <- c("unadjusted", "adjusted")

diet_relative_fdr_cutoff <- 0.05
diet_relative_min_prev <- 0.05
diet_relative_max_prev <- 0.95
diet_relative_min_model_n <- 30
diet_relative_min_present <- 20
diet_relative_min_absent <- 20

diet_plot_order <- c(
  "Vegetables",
  "Namul",
  "Kimchi",
  "Mushrooms",
  "Seaweed",
  "Seafood",
  "Fish",
  "Meat",
  "Fruit",
  "Beverages"
)

diet_label_map <- c(
  Vegetables = "Vegetables",
  Namul = "Namul",
  Kimchi = "Kimchi",
  Mushrooms = "Mushrooms",
  Seaweed = "Seaweed",
  Seafood = "Seafood",
  Fish = "Fish",
  Meat = "Meat",
  Fruit = "Fruit",
  Beverages = "Beverages"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Theme and save helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_theme <- ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10.5, color = "black"),
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9.5),
    panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
  )

diet_save_plot_both <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Build individual-level relative diet variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_relative_meta_tbl <- diet_meta %>%
  select(
    sampleid,
    age,
    sex,
    BMI,
    cluster,
    vil_id,
    all_of(diet_variable_cols)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    age = as.numeric(age),
    sex = factor(sex),
    BMI = as.numeric(BMI),
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    across(all_of(diet_variable_cols), as.numeric)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diet_total_score = rowSums(across(all_of(diet_variable_cols)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(diet_total_score),
    diet_total_score > 0
  )

diet_relative_cols <- paste0(diet_variable_cols, "_relative")

for (i in seq_along(diet_variable_cols)) {
  raw_col <- diet_variable_cols[i]
  rel_col <- diet_relative_cols[i]
  diet_relative_meta_tbl[[rel_col]] <- diet_relative_meta_tbl[[raw_col]] / diet_relative_meta_tbl$diet_total_score
}

# QC: relative values should sum to 1 for each individual
diet_relative_qc_tbl <- diet_relative_meta_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    relative_sum = rowSums(across(all_of(diet_relative_cols)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
    n_samples = n(),
    min_relative_sum = min(relative_sum, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_relative_sum = median(relative_sum, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_relative_sum = max(relative_sum, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(diet_relative_qc_tbl)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_relative_qc_tbl,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0("diet_asv_logistic_", diet_scale_label, "_qc_summary.csv")
  )
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Build ASV model table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_relative_asv_model_tbl <- diet_asv_pa_long %>%
  select(ASV, sampleid, presence) %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    presence = as.integer(as.numeric(presence) > 0)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    diet_relative_meta_tbl %>%
      select(
        sampleid,
        age,
        sex,
        BMI,
        cluster,
        vil_id,
        diet_total_score,
        all_of(diet_relative_cols)
      ),
    by = "sampleid"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) ASV prevalence diagnostics
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_relative_asv_diag_tbl <- diet_relative_asv_model_tbl %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    prevalence = mean(presence == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_present = sum(presence == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_absent = sum(presence == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Define cluster-associated ASVs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_relative_cluster_asv_sig_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    target_cluster = as.character(target_cluster)
  ) %>%
  filter(target_cluster %in% as.character(1:4))

# Apply significance filters if available
if (all(c("fisher_p_adj", "wilcoxon_p_adj") %in% names(diet_relative_cluster_asv_sig_tbl))) {
  diet_relative_cluster_asv_sig_tbl <- diet_relative_cluster_asv_sig_tbl %>%
    filter(
      fisher_p_adj < diet_relative_fdr_cutoff |
        wilcoxon_p_adj < diet_relative_fdr_cutoff
    )
}

# Keep target-cluster enriched direction if available
if ("delta_prevalence_pct" %in% names(diet_relative_cluster_asv_sig_tbl)) {
  diet_relative_cluster_asv_sig_tbl <- diet_relative_cluster_asv_sig_tbl %>%
    filter(delta_prevalence_pct > 0)
}

diet_relative_asv_annotation_tbl <- diet_relative_cluster_asv_sig_tbl %>%
  select(any_of(c(
    "target_cluster",
    "ASV",
    "ASV_lab",
    "delta_prevalence_pct",
    "fisher_p",
    "fisher_p_adj",
    "log2FC_detected",
    "wilcoxon_p",
    "wilcoxon_p_adj",
    "significance_category"
  ))) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(diet_relative_asv_diag_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(prevalence),
    prevalence >= diet_relative_min_prev,
    prevalence <= diet_relative_max_prev,
    n_present >= diet_relative_min_present,
    n_absent >= diet_relative_min_absent
  ) %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  mutate(
    n_associated_clusters = n_distinct(target_cluster),
    associated_clusters = paste(sort(unique(as.character(target_cluster))), collapse = ";"),
    association_scope = if_else(
      n_associated_clusters == 1,
      "cluster-specific",
      "multi-cluster-associated"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
    target_cluster = factor(as.character(target_cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
    .before = 1
  )

cat("\n===== Relative diet ASV annotation summary =====\n")
print(
  diet_relative_asv_annotation_tbl %>%
    count(diet_scale, target_cluster, association_scope, name = "n_asv_cluster_pairs")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Logistic regression helper
#
# Models:
#   unadjusted: presence ~ relative_diet
#   adjusted:   presence ~ relative_diet + age + sex + BMI
#
# Note:
#   Because relative diet variables sum to 1, this tests the
#   association of one food's relative share at a time.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_relative_run_logistic_one <- function(df, asv_id, rel_var_i, raw_diet_var_i, model_type = c("unadjusted", "adjusted")) {

  model_type <- match.arg(model_type)

  dat <- df %>%
    filter(ASV == asv_id) %>%
    select(
      sampleid,
      presence,
      age,
      sex,
      BMI,
      diet_total_score,
      relative_diet = all_of(rel_var_i)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(sampleid),
      !is.na(presence),
      is.finite(relative_diet)
    )

  if (nrow(dat) < diet_relative_min_model_n) return(NULL)
  if (n_distinct(dat$presence) < 2) return(NULL)
  if (n_distinct(dat$relative_diet) < 2) return(NULL)

  n_present_i <- sum(dat$presence == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_absent_i <- sum(dat$presence == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (n_present_i < diet_relative_min_present) return(NULL)
  if (n_absent_i < diet_relative_min_absent) return(NULL)

  if (model_type == "unadjusted") {
    form <- presence ~ relative_diet
  } else {
    dat <- dat %>%
      filter(
        is.finite(age),
        !is.na(sex),
        is.finite(BMI)
      )

    if (nrow(dat) < diet_relative_min_model_n) return(NULL)
    if (n_distinct(dat$presence) < 2) return(NULL)

    if (n_distinct(dat$sex) < 2) {
      form <- presence ~ relative_diet + age + BMI
    } else {
      form <- presence ~ relative_diet + age + sex + BMI
    }
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      glm(form, data = dat, family = binomial())
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

  res <- tryCatch(
    broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)

  res_rel <- res %>%
    filter(term == "relative_diet")

  if (nrow(res_rel) == 0) return(NULL)

  tibble(
    diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
    model_type = model_type,
    ASV = as.character(asv_id),
    diet_var = as.character(raw_diet_var_i),
    relative_diet_var = as.character(rel_var_i),
    odds_ratio = as.numeric(res_rel$estimate[1]),
    conf_low = as.numeric(res_rel$conf.low[1]),
    conf_high = as.numeric(res_rel$conf.high[1]),
    p_value = as.numeric(res_rel$p.value[1]),
    n_model = nrow(dat),
    n_present_model = sum(dat$presence == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_absent_model = sum(dat$presence == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prevalence_model = mean(dat$presence == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_relative_present = mean(dat$relative_diet[dat$presence == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_relative_absent = mean(dat$relative_diet[dat$presence == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_relative = mean(dat$relative_diet[dat$presence == 1], na.rm = TRUE) -
      mean(dat$relative_diet[dat$presence == 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Run all ASV x relative diet models
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_relative_target_asvs <- unique(diet_relative_asv_annotation_tbl$ASV)

diet_relative_result_list <- purrr::map(diet_relative_target_asvs, function(asv_i) {
  purrr::map2(diet_variable_cols, diet_relative_cols, function(raw_i, rel_i) {
    purrr::map(diet_relative_model_types, function(model_i) {
      diet_relative_run_logistic_one(
        df = diet_relative_asv_model_tbl,
        asv_id = asv_i,
        rel_var_i = rel_i,
        raw_diet_var_i = raw_i,
        model_type = model_i
      )
    })
  })
})

diet_relative_result_flat <- purrr::flatten(diet_relative_result_list)
diet_relative_result_flat <- diet_relative_result_flat[
  !purrr::map_lgl(diet_relative_result_flat, is.null)
]

if (length(diet_relative_result_flat) == 0) {
  diet_relative_asv_logistic_results_tbl <- tibble(
    diet_scale = character(),
    model_type = character(),
    ASV = character(),
    diet_var = character(),
    relative_diet_var = character(),
    odds_ratio = numeric(),
    conf_low = numeric(),
    conf_high = numeric(),
    p_value = numeric(),
    p_adj_bh = numeric()
  )
} else {
  diet_relative_asv_logistic_results_tbl <- bind_rows(diet_relative_result_flat) %>%
    group_by(diet_scale, model_type) %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      log2_or = log2(odds_ratio),
      direction = case_when(
        log2_or > 0 ~ "Positive",
        log2_or < 0 ~ "Negative",
        TRUE ~ "No change"
      ),
      diet_label = recode(diet_var, !!!diet_label_map, .default = diet_var),
      diet_label = factor(diet_label, levels = diet_plot_order)
    ) %>%
    arrange(diet_scale, model_type, p_adj_bh, p_value)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Annotate model results with ASV-cluster information
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_relative_asv_logistic_annot_tbl <- diet_relative_asv_annotation_tbl %>%
  select(
    diet_scale,
    target_cluster,
    ASV,
    ASV_lab,
    delta_prevalence_pct,
    fisher_p_adj,
    log2FC_detected,
    wilcoxon_p_adj,
    significance_category,
    prevalence,
    n_present,
    n_absent,
    n_associated_clusters,
    associated_clusters,
    association_scope
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    diet_relative_asv_logistic_results_tbl,
    by = c("diet_scale", "ASV")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    target_cluster = factor(as.character(target_cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
    diet_label = factor(as.character(diet_label), levels = diet_plot_order),
    evidence_class = case_when(
      !is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_relative_fdr_cutoff ~ "FDR significant",
      !is.na(p_value) & p_value < 0.05 ~ "Nominal significant",
      !is.na(p_value) ~ "Tested, not significant",
      TRUE ~ "Not tested"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(diet_scale, model_type, target_cluster, p_adj_bh, p_value)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Significant results table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_relative_asv_logistic_sig_tbl <- diet_relative_asv_logistic_annot_tbl %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(p_adj_bh),
    p_adj_bh < diet_relative_fdr_cutoff
  ) %>%
  arrange(diet_scale, model_type, target_cluster, p_adj_bh, p_value)

cat("\n===== Relative diet-ASV logistic summary =====\n")
print(
  diet_relative_asv_logistic_annot_tbl %>%
    count(diet_scale, model_type, evidence_class, name = "n")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Cluster x diet summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_relative_cluster_diet_summary <- function(df, scope_label = "all") {

  if (scope_label == "cluster-specific") {
    df <- df %>%
      filter(association_scope == "cluster-specific")
  }

  df %>%
    filter(
      diet_scale == diet_scale_label,
      !is.na(model_type),
      !is.na(p_adj_bh),
      p_adj_bh < diet_relative_fdr_cutoff,
      direction %in% c("Positive", "Negative")
    ) %>%
    group_by(diet_scale, model_type, target_cluster, diet_var, diet_label) %>%
    summarise(
      n_sig_pairs = n(),
      n_sig_asvs = n_distinct(ASV),
      n_positive = n_distinct(ASV[direction == "Positive"]),
      n_negative = n_distinct(ASV[direction == "Negative"]),
      signed_count = n_positive - n_negative,
      mean_log2_or = mean(log2_or, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_log2_or = median(log2_or, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_fdr = min(p_adj_bh, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    complete(
      diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
      model_type = diet_relative_model_types,
      target_cluster = factor(as.character(1:4), levels = as.character(1:4)),
      diet_label = factor(diet_plot_order, levels = diet_plot_order),
      fill = list(
        n_sig_pairs = 0,
        n_sig_asvs = 0,
        n_positive = 0,
        n_negative = 0,
        signed_count = 0,
        mean_log2_or = NA_real_,
        median_log2_or = NA_real_,
        min_fdr = NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      diet_var = as.character(diet_label),
      summary_scope = scope_label,
      target_cluster = factor(as.character(target_cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
      diet_label = factor(as.character(diet_label), levels = diet_plot_order),
      text_count = ifelse(n_sig_asvs > 0, as.character(n_sig_asvs), "")
    )
}

diet_relative_cluster_diet_summary_tbl <- bind_rows(
  make_relative_cluster_diet_summary(diet_relative_asv_logistic_annot_tbl, "all"),
  make_relative_cluster_diet_summary(diet_relative_asv_logistic_annot_tbl, "cluster-specific")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Diet-level unique ASV summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_relative_diet_count_summary_tbl <- diet_relative_asv_logistic_annot_tbl %>%
  filter(
    diet_scale == diet_scale_label,
    !is.na(model_type),
    !is.na(p_adj_bh),
    p_adj_bh < diet_relative_fdr_cutoff,
    direction %in% c("Positive", "Negative")
  ) %>%
  group_by(diet_scale, model_type, diet_var, diet_label, direction) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sig_pairs = n(),
    n_sig_asvs = n_distinct(ASV),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    diet_scale = diet_scale_label,
    model_type = diet_relative_model_types,
    diet_label = factor(diet_plot_order, levels = diet_plot_order),
    direction = c("Positive", "Negative"),
    fill = list(
      n_sig_pairs = 0,
      n_sig_asvs = 0
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diet_var = as.character(diet_label),
    diet_label = factor(as.character(diet_label), levels = diet_plot_order),
    direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Positive", "Negative"))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 13) Plot function: cluster x diet count heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_relative_cluster_diet_heatmap <- function(summary_tbl, model_i, scope_label, filename_scope) {

  plot_df <- summary_tbl %>%
    filter(
      diet_scale == diet_scale_label,
      model_type == model_i,
      summary_scope == scope_label
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      target_cluster = factor(as.character(target_cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
      diet_label = factor(as.character(diet_label), levels = diet_plot_order)
    )

  scope_title <- ifelse(scope_label == "all", "all cluster-associated ASVs", "cluster-specific ASVs")

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = diet_label, y = target_cluster, fill = n_sig_asvs)
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = text_count), size = 3.5, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c("#F7FBFF", "#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#08519C"),
      name = "No. ASVs"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Target cluster",
      title = paste0("Number of relative diet-associated ASVs (", scope_title, ")"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Cell values indicate FDR-significant ASVs. ",
        "Diet scale: relative composition; model: ", model_i, "."
      )
    ) +
    diet_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  print(p)

  diet_save_plot_both(
    p,
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "plots",
      paste0("diet_asv_summary_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_", filename_scope, "_count_heatmap")
    ),
    width = 8.8,
    height = 3.8
  )

  invisible(p)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14) Draw heatmaps
# ---------------------------------------------------------
for (model_i in diet_relative_model_types) {
  plot_relative_cluster_diet_heatmap(
    diet_relative_cluster_diet_summary_tbl,
    model_i = model_i,
    scope_label = "all",
    filename_scope = "all"
  )

  plot_relative_cluster_diet_heatmap(
    diet_relative_cluster_diet_summary_tbl,
    model_i = model_i,
    scope_label = "cluster-specific",
    filename_scope = "specific"
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 15) Diet-wise unique ASV barplot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_relative_diet_count_barplot <- function(summary_tbl, model_i) {

  plot_df <- summary_tbl %>%
    filter(
      diet_scale == diet_scale_label,
      model_type == model_i
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      signed_n = ifelse(direction == "Positive", n_sig_asvs, -n_sig_asvs)
    )

  y_max <- max(plot_df$signed_n, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(plot_df$signed_n, na.rm = TRUE)

  y_upper <- ceiling((y_max + 2) / 5) * 5
  y_lower <- floor((y_min - 2) / 5) * 5

  if (y_lower > -5) y_lower <- -5
  if (y_upper < 5) y_upper <- 5

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = diet_label, y = signed_n, fill = direction)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey35") +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Positive" = "#BC3C29",
        "Negative" = "#3C5488"
      ),
      name = "Direction"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(y_lower, y_upper),
      breaks = seq(y_lower, y_upper, by = 5),
      labels = abs,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "No. unique relative diet-associated ASVs",
      title = paste0("Relative dietary variables associated with cluster-associated ASVs (", model_i, ")"),
      subtitle = "Bars show unique ASVs with significant positive or negative associations with relative diet proportions."
    ) +
    diet_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  print(p)

  diet_save_plot_both(
    p,
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "plots",
      paste0("diet_asv_summary_", diet_scale_label, "_", model_i, "_diet_count_barplot")
    ),
    width = 8.8,
    height = 4.8
  )

  invisible(p)
}

for (model_i in diet_relative_model_types) {
  plot_relative_diet_count_barplot(
    diet_relative_diet_count_summary_tbl,
    model_i = model_i
  )
}
```

#Cluster-associated ASVs, -specific ASVs venn diagram
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Cluster-associated ASV overlap summary
# - Descriptive analysis of cluster-associated ASV signatures
# - Based on all ASV-cluster pairs in diet_cluster_asv_tbl
# - No additional significance or direction filtering is applied here
#
# Purpose:
#   Show how cluster-associated ASVs are distributed across
#   cluster-specific and shared / overlapping cluster signatures.
#
# Required existing objects:
#   diet_cluster_asv_tbl
#   diet_outdir
#
# Output naming convention:
#   cluster_asv_overlap_descriptive_*
#
# Main outputs:
#   tables/
#     cluster_asv_overlap_descriptive_annotation.csv
#     cluster_asv_overlap_descriptive_summary.csv
#     cluster_asv_overlap_descriptive_specific_counts.csv
#     cluster_asv_overlap_descriptive_shared_specific_summary.csv
#     cluster_asv_overlap_descriptive_set_sizes.csv
#
#   plots/
#     cluster_asv_overlap_descriptive_barplot.png/.svg
#     cluster_asv_overlap_descriptive_specific_barplot.png/.svg
#     cluster_asv_overlap_descriptive_shared_specific_summary.png/.svg
#     cluster_asv_overlap_descriptive_set_sizes.png/.svg
#
# Optional:
#   If ggVennDiagram is installed:
#     cluster_asv_overlap_descriptive_venn.png/.svg
#   If ComplexUpset is installed:
#     cluster_asv_overlap_descriptive_upset.png/.svg
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
  library(forcats)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Preconditions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("diet_cluster_asv_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("diet_outdir"))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "target_cluster") %in% names(diet_cluster_asv_tbl)))

dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(diet_outdir, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
analysis_label <- "cluster_asv_overlap"
model_label <- "descriptive"

cluster_levels <- as.character(1:4)
cluster_labels <- paste0("C", cluster_levels)

overlap_label_order <- c(
  "C1 only", "C2 only", "C3 only", "C4 only",
  "C1+C2", "C1+C3", "C1+C4", "C2+C3", "C2+C4", "C3+C4",
  "C1+C2+C3", "C1+C2+C4", "C1+C3+C4", "C2+C3+C4",
  "C1+C2+C3+C4"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Theme and save helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_overlap_theme <- ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10.5, color = "black"),
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9.5),
    panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
  )

diet_save_plot_both <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Use all ASV-cluster pairs from diet_cluster_asv_tbl
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Important:
#   Do not re-apply p-value filters or delta_prevalence filters here.
#   diet_cluster_asv_tbl is treated as the final cluster-associated ASV table.

diet_cluster_asv_all_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    target_cluster = as.character(target_cluster)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    target_cluster %in% cluster_levels,
    !is.na(ASV),
    ASV != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(ASV, target_cluster, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("\n===== Input ASV-cluster pairs =====\n")
cat("Rows in diet_cluster_asv_tbl:", nrow(diet_cluster_asv_tbl), "\n")
cat("Unique ASV-cluster pairs used:", nrow(diet_cluster_asv_all_tbl %>% distinct(ASV, target_cluster)), "\n")
cat("Unique ASVs used:", n_distinct(diet_cluster_asv_all_tbl$ASV), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Build ASV overlap annotation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_all_tbl %>%
  distinct(ASV, target_cluster) %>%
  mutate(value = 1L) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = target_cluster,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = 0,
    names_prefix = "cluster_"
  )

# Ensure all cluster columns exist
for (cl in cluster_levels) {
  col_i <- paste0("cluster_", cl)
  if (!col_i %in% names(diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl)) {
    diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl[[col_i]] <- 0L
  }
}

diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_1 = as.integer(cluster_1),
    cluster_2 = as.integer(cluster_2),
    cluster_3 = as.integer(cluster_3),
    cluster_4 = as.integer(cluster_4),
    n_clusters_shared = cluster_1 + cluster_2 + cluster_3 + cluster_4,
    overlap_pattern = paste0(cluster_1, cluster_2, cluster_3, cluster_4),
    overlap_label = case_when(
      overlap_pattern == "1000" ~ "C1 only",
      overlap_pattern == "0100" ~ "C2 only",
      overlap_pattern == "0010" ~ "C3 only",
      overlap_pattern == "0001" ~ "C4 only",
      overlap_pattern == "1100" ~ "C1+C2",
      overlap_pattern == "1010" ~ "C1+C3",
      overlap_pattern == "1001" ~ "C1+C4",
      overlap_pattern == "0110" ~ "C2+C3",
      overlap_pattern == "0101" ~ "C2+C4",
      overlap_pattern == "0011" ~ "C3+C4",
      overlap_pattern == "1110" ~ "C1+C2+C3",
      overlap_pattern == "1101" ~ "C1+C2+C4",
      overlap_pattern == "1011" ~ "C1+C3+C4",
      overlap_pattern == "0111" ~ "C2+C3+C4",
      overlap_pattern == "1111" ~ "C1+C2+C3+C4",
      TRUE ~ overlap_pattern
    ),
    association_scope = case_when(
      n_clusters_shared == 1 ~ "cluster-specific",
      n_clusters_shared > 1 ~ "shared cluster-associated",
      TRUE ~ "unassigned"
    ),
    overlap_label = factor(overlap_label, levels = overlap_label_order),
    association_scope = factor(
      association_scope,
      levels = c("cluster-specific", "shared cluster-associated", "unassigned")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(n_clusters_shared > 0)

# Add representative ASV label if available
if ("ASV_lab" %in% names(diet_cluster_asv_tbl)) {
  asv_lab_map <- diet_cluster_asv_tbl %>%
    mutate(ASV = as.character(ASV)) %>%
    select(ASV, ASV_lab) %>%
    distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)

  diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl %>%
    left_join(asv_lab_map, by = "ASV")
}

# Add representative taxonomy label if available
possible_tax_cols <- intersect(
  c("label", "Taxon", "taxonomy", "taxon", "ASV_label"),
  names(diet_cluster_asv_tbl)
)

if (length(possible_tax_cols) > 0) {
  tax_col <- possible_tax_cols[1]

  tax_map <- diet_cluster_asv_tbl %>%
    mutate(ASV = as.character(ASV)) %>%
    select(ASV, all_of(tax_col)) %>%
    distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)

  diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl %>%
    left_join(tax_map, by = "ASV")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Summary tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_cluster_asv_overlap_summary_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl %>%
  count(overlap_label, association_scope, n_clusters_shared, name = "n_asvs") %>%
  mutate(
    overlap_label = factor(overlap_label, levels = overlap_label_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(n_clusters_shared, overlap_label)

diet_cluster_specific_asv_counts_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl %>%
  filter(n_clusters_shared == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    specific_cluster = case_when(
      cluster_1 == 1 ~ "C1",
      cluster_2 == 1 ~ "C2",
      cluster_3 == 1 ~ "C3",
      cluster_4 == 1 ~ "C4",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  count(specific_cluster, name = "n_cluster_specific_asvs") %>%
  complete(
    specific_cluster = cluster_labels,
    fill = list(n_cluster_specific_asvs = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    specific_cluster = factor(specific_cluster, levels = cluster_labels)
  )

diet_cluster_shared_specific_summary_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl %>%
  count(association_scope, name = "n_asvs") %>%
  filter(association_scope != "unassigned") %>%
  mutate(
    association_scope = factor(
      association_scope,
      levels = c("cluster-specific", "shared cluster-associated")
    )
  )

diet_cluster_set_size_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl %>%
  summarise(
    C1 = sum(cluster_1 == 1),
    C2 = sum(cluster_2 == 1),
    C3 = sum(cluster_3 == 1),
    C4 = sum(cluster_4 == 1)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "cluster",
    values_to = "n_cluster_associated_asvs"
  ) %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = cluster_labels))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Save tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
readr::write_csv(
  diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0(analysis_label, "_", model_label, "_annotation.csv")
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_cluster_asv_overlap_summary_tbl,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0(analysis_label, "_", model_label, "_summary.csv")
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_cluster_specific_asv_counts_tbl,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0(analysis_label, "_", model_label, "_specific_counts.csv")
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_cluster_shared_specific_summary_tbl,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0(analysis_label, "_", model_label, "_shared_specific_summary.csv")
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_cluster_set_size_tbl,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "tables",
    paste0(analysis_label, "_", model_label, "_set_sizes.csv")
  )
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Plot 1: overlap pattern count barplot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_diet_cluster_asv_overlap_bar <- diet_cluster_asv_overlap_summary_tbl %>%
  filter(n_asvs > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    overlap_label = fct_reorder(as.factor(overlap_label), n_asvs)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = overlap_label, y = n_asvs, fill = association_scope)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_asvs), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "cluster-specific" = "#4E79A7",
      "shared cluster-associated" = "#E15759"
    ),
    name = "ASV class"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "No. ASVs",
    title = "Overlap structure of cluster-associated ASVs",
    subtitle = "All ASV-cluster annotations in the cluster-associated ASV table were used."
  ) +
  diet_overlap_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p_diet_cluster_asv_overlap_bar)

diet_save_plot_both(
  p_diet_cluster_asv_overlap_bar,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "plots",
    paste0(analysis_label, "_", model_label, "_barplot")
  ),
  width = 8.2,
  height = 5.8
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Plot 2: cluster-specific ASV counts
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_diet_cluster_specific_asv_bar <- ggplot(
  diet_cluster_specific_asv_counts_tbl,
  aes(x = specific_cluster, y = n_cluster_specific_asvs)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.68, fill = "#4E79A7", color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_cluster_specific_asvs), vjust = -0.35, size = 4.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "No. cluster-specific ASVs",
    title = "Cluster-specific ASVs",
    subtitle = "ASVs assigned to one cluster-associated signature only."
  ) +
  diet_overlap_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_diet_cluster_specific_asv_bar)

diet_save_plot_both(
  p_diet_cluster_specific_asv_bar,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "plots",
    paste0(analysis_label, "_", model_label, "_specific_barplot")
  ),
  width = 5.8,
  height = 4.8
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Plot 3: cluster-specific vs shared cluster-associated summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_diet_cluster_shared_specific_summary <- ggplot(
  diet_cluster_shared_specific_summary_tbl,
  aes(x = association_scope, y = n_asvs, fill = association_scope)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.62, color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_asvs), vjust = -0.35, size = 4.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "cluster-specific" = "#4E79A7",
      "shared cluster-associated" = "#E15759"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "No. ASVs",
    title = "Cluster-specific and shared cluster-associated ASVs",
    subtitle = "ASVs assigned to one cluster signature were distinguished from ASVs shared across multiple signatures."
  ) +
  diet_overlap_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1)
  )

print(p_diet_cluster_shared_specific_summary)

diet_save_plot_both(
  p_diet_cluster_shared_specific_summary,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "plots",
    paste0(analysis_label, "_", model_label, "_shared_specific_summary")
  ),
  width = 6.4,
  height = 4.8
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Plot 4: cluster-associated ASV set sizes
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_diet_cluster_asv_set_sizes <- ggplot(
  diet_cluster_set_size_tbl,
  aes(x = cluster, y = n_cluster_associated_asvs)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.68, fill = "#59A14F", color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_cluster_associated_asvs), vjust = -0.35, size = 4.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "No. cluster-associated ASVs",
    title = "Cluster-associated ASV set size by target cluster",
    subtitle = "Counts include ASVs shared with other cluster signatures."
  ) +
  diet_overlap_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_diet_cluster_asv_set_sizes)

diet_save_plot_both(
  p_diet_cluster_asv_set_sizes,
  file.path(
    diet_outdir,
    "plots",
    paste0(analysis_label, "_", model_label, "_set_sizes")
  ),
  width = 5.8,
  height = 4.8
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Optional Venn diagram
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (requireNamespace("ggVennDiagram", quietly = TRUE)) {

  set_list <- list(
    C1 = diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl %>% filter(cluster_1 == 1) %>% pull(ASV) %>% unique(),
    C2 = diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl %>% filter(cluster_2 == 1) %>% pull(ASV) %>% unique(),
    C3 = diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl %>% filter(cluster_3 == 1) %>% pull(ASV) %>% unique(),
    C4 = diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl %>% filter(cluster_4 == 1) %>% pull(ASV) %>% unique()
  )

  p_diet_cluster_asv_venn <- ggVennDiagram::ggVennDiagram(
    set_list,
    label = "count",
    label_alpha = 0,
    edge_size = 0.8
  ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#4E79A7") +
    labs(
      title = "Overlap of cluster-associated ASVs",
      subtitle = "Counts indicate ASVs appearing in each cluster-associated signature intersection."
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  print(p_diet_cluster_asv_venn)

  diet_save_plot_both(
    p_diet_cluster_asv_venn,
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "plots",
      paste0(analysis_label, "_", model_label, "_venn")
    ),
    width = 7.2,
    height = 6.4
  )

} else {
  message("Package 'ggVennDiagram' is not installed. Venn diagram was skipped.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Manual UpSet-style plot
#     - Stable ordering by overlap degree
#     - Active dots colored by clu_pal
#     - Inactive dots grey
#     - Connecting lines black
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {

  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(patchwork)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(dplyr)
    library(tidyr)
    library(forcats)
  })

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # A) Color palette
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  if (exists("clu_pal")) {
    upset_cluster_pal <- c(
      C1 = unname(clu_pal["1"]),
      C2 = unname(clu_pal["2"]),
      C3 = unname(clu_pal["3"]),
      C4 = unname(clu_pal["4"])
    )
  } else {
    # fallback
    upset_cluster_pal <- c(
      C1 = "#4DAF4A",
      C2 = "#E41A1C",
      C3 = "#377EB8",
      C4 = "#984EA3"
    )
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # B) Desired overlap order
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  overlap_label_order <- c(
    "C1 only", "C2 only", "C3 only", "C4 only",
    "C1+C2", "C1+C3", "C1+C4", "C2+C3", "C2+C4", "C3+C4",
    "C1+C2+C3", "C1+C2+C4", "C1+C3+C4", "C2+C3+C4",
    "C1+C2+C3+C4"
  )

  # keep only observed intersections, but preserve desired order
  present_overlap_levels <- diet_cluster_asv_overlap_summary_tbl %>%
    filter(n_asvs > 0) %>%
    pull(overlap_label) %>%
    as.character()

  present_overlap_levels <- overlap_label_order[
    overlap_label_order %in% present_overlap_levels
  ]

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # C) Intersection summary table
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  upset_intersection_tbl <- diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl %>%
    mutate(overlap_label = as.character(overlap_label)) %>%
    filter(overlap_label %in% present_overlap_levels) %>%
    group_by(
      overlap_label,
      cluster_1, cluster_2, cluster_3, cluster_4,
      n_clusters_shared
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      n_asvs = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      overlap_label = factor(overlap_label, levels = present_overlap_levels)
    ) %>%
    arrange(overlap_label)

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # D) Matrix table
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  upset_matrix_tbl <- upset_intersection_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      overlap_label,
      C1 = cluster_1,
      C2 = cluster_2,
      C3 = cluster_3,
      C4 = cluster_4
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(C1, C2, C3, C4),
      names_to = "cluster",
      values_to = "active"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      cluster = factor(cluster, levels = c("C4", "C3", "C2", "C1")),
      overlap_label = factor(as.character(overlap_label), levels = present_overlap_levels),
      active = active == 1L
    )

  # line segments for multi-cluster overlaps
  upset_line_tbl <- upset_matrix_tbl %>%
    filter(active) %>%
    group_by(overlap_label) %>%
    summarise(
      y_min = min(as.numeric(cluster)),
      y_max = max(as.numeric(cluster)),
      n_active = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n_active > 1)

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # E) Set size table
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  upset_set_size_tbl <- diet_cluster_set_size_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = c("C4", "C3", "C2", "C1"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(cluster)

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # F) Common theme
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  upset_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.35),
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)
    )

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # G) Top bar plot (intersection size)
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  p_upset_top <- ggplot(
    upset_intersection_tbl,
    aes(x = overlap_label, y = n_asvs)
  ) +
    geom_col(
      width = 0.82,
      fill = "#4C78A8",
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = n_asvs),
      vjust = -0.28,
      size = 4.2,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "No. ASVs",
      title = "Overlap structure of cluster-associated ASVs",
      subtitle = "Intersections are ordered from cluster-specific ASVs to increasingly shared ASVs."
    ) +
    upset_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank()
    )

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # H) Matrix plot
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # alternating background stripes
  bg_tbl <- tibble(
    ymin = c(0.5, 2.5),
    ymax = c(1.5, 3.5)
  )

  p_upset_matrix <- ggplot() +
    geom_rect(
      data = bg_tbl,
      aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      fill = "#F7F7F7",
      color = NA,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    # inactive dots
    geom_point(
      data = upset_matrix_tbl,
      aes(x = overlap_label, y = cluster),
      color = "grey78",
      size = 3.8
    ) +
    # black connecting lines
    geom_segment(
      data = upset_line_tbl,
      aes(
        x = overlap_label,
        xend = overlap_label,
        y = y_min,
        yend = y_max
      ),
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.65
    ) +
    # active dots colored by cluster
    geom_point(
      data = upset_matrix_tbl %>% filter(active),
      aes(x = overlap_label, y = cluster, fill = cluster),
      shape = 21,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.25,
      size = 4.4
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = upset_cluster_pal, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = c("C4", "C3", "C2", "C1")) +
    labs(
      x = "Cluster-associated ASVs",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)
    )

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # I) Left set-size bar plot
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  p_upset_left <- ggplot(
    upset_set_size_tbl,
    aes(x = n_cluster_associated_asvs, y = cluster)
  ) +
    geom_col(
      width = 0.72,
      fill = "#72B7B2",
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    scale_x_reverse(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.06, 0.06))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Set size",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.35),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)
    )

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # J) Spacer
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  p_upset_spacer <- ggplot() + theme_void()

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # K) Combine
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  p_diet_cluster_asv_upset <- (p_upset_spacer + p_upset_top) /
    (p_upset_left + p_upset_matrix) +
    patchwork::plot_layout(
      widths = c(0.22, 0.78),
      heights = c(0.58, 0.42)
    )

  print(p_diet_cluster_asv_upset)

  diet_save_plot_both(
    p_diet_cluster_asv_upset,
    file.path(
      diet_outdir,
      "plots",
      paste0(analysis_label, "_", model_label, "_upset")
    ),
    width = 11.0,
    height = 7.8
  )

} else {
  message("Package 'patchwork' is not installed. Manual UpSet plot was skipped.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 13) Console summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n===== Cluster-associated ASV overlap descriptive analysis finished =====\n")
cat("Analysis type:", analysis_label, "\n")
cat("Model type:", model_label, "\n")
cat("Total unique cluster-associated ASVs:", nrow(diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl), "\n")
cat("Cluster-specific ASVs:", sum(diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl$n_clusters_shared == 1), "\n")
cat("Shared cluster-associated ASVs:", sum(diet_cluster_asv_overlap_annot_tbl$n_clusters_shared > 1), "\n")

cat("\nOverlap summary:\n")
print(diet_cluster_asv_overlap_summary_tbl)

cat("\nCluster-associated ASV set sizes:\n")
print(diet_cluster_set_size_tbl)

cat("\nSaved tables:\n")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0(analysis_label, "_", model_label, "_annotation.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0(analysis_label, "_", model_label, "_summary.csv")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0(analysis_label, "_", model_label, "_specific_counts.csv")), "\n", sep = "")

cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "tables", paste0(analysis_label, "_", model_label, "_set_sizes.csv")), "\n", sep = "")

cat("\nSaved plots:\n")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots", paste0(analysis_label, "_", model_label, "_barplot.png/.svg")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_outdir, "plots", paste0(analysis_label, "_", model_label, "_specific_barplot.png/.svg")), "\n", sep = "")
```
