#village-level intra sharing vs diet similarity
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Diet-sharing direct analysis
# - New output directory: diet_sharing_analysis
# - Test whether villages with more similar within-village diet
#   show higher within-village ASV sharing
#
# Main question:
#   Within-village diet distance vs within-village ASV sharing
#
# Required objects or files:
#   1) diet_meta
#      - sampleid
#      - vil_id or village_name
#      - cluster
#      - diet variables:
#        Vegetables, Namul, Kimchi, Mushrooms, Seaweed,
#        Seafood, Fish, Meat, Fruit, Beverages
#
#   2) asv_pa
#      - ASV x sample presence/absence table
#      - first column = ASV
#
# If asv_pa does not exist, the code tries to read:
#   derived_asv_pa.csv
#
# Outputs:
#   diet_sharing_analysis/tables/
#     diet_sharing_within_village_metrics.csv
#     diet_sharing_within_village_spearman_results.csv
#     diet_sharing_within_village_lm_results.csv
#
#   diet_sharing_analysis/plots/
#     diet_sharing_absolute_euclidean_vs_asv_sharing.png/.svg
#     diet_sharing_relative_euclidean_vs_asv_sharing.png/.svg
#     diet_sharing_relative_bray_vs_asv_sharing.png/.svg
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(purrr)
  library(stringr)
  library(broom)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Output directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_sharing_outdir <- "diet_sharing_analysis"

dir.create(diet_sharing_outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(diet_sharing_outdir, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(diet_sharing_outdir, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_vars <- c(
  "Vegetables",
  "Namul",
  "Kimchi",
  "Mushrooms",
  "Seaweed",
  "Seafood",
  "Fish",
  "Meat",
  "Fruit",
  "Beverages"
)

min_samples_per_village <- 3

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Save helper and theme
# ---------------------------------------------------------
save_plot_both <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 7, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
  
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

theme_sharing <- ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey90"),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Load/check metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("diet_meta")) {
  stop("diet_meta object is required. Please run the diet setup chunk first.")
}

missing_diet <- setdiff(diet_vars, names(diet_meta))
if (length(missing_diet) > 0) {
  stop("Missing diet variables in diet_meta: ", paste(missing_diet, collapse = ", "))
}

if ("vil_id" %in% names(diet_meta)) {
  village_col <- "vil_id"
} else if ("village_name" %in% names(diet_meta)) {
  village_col <- "village_name"
} else {
  stop("diet_meta must contain either 'vil_id' or 'village_name'.")
}

stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "cluster") %in% names(diet_meta)))

diet_meta_sharing <- diet_meta %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    village_id = as.character(.data[[village_col]]),
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = as.character(1:4)),
    across(all_of(diet_vars), as.numeric)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(sampleid),
    !is.na(village_id),
    !is.na(cluster)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Load/check ASV PA table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (exists("asv_pa")) {
  asv_pa_source <- asv_pa
} else {
  if (!file.exists("derived_asv_pa.csv")) {
    stop("asv_pa object not found and derived_asv_pa.csv does not exist.")
  }
  asv_pa_source <- readr::read_csv("derived_asv_pa.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
}

asv_pa_tbl <- asv_pa_source %>%
  rename(ASV = 1) %>%
  mutate(ASV = as.character(ASV))

sample_cols <- intersect(
  setdiff(names(asv_pa_tbl), "ASV"),
  diet_meta_sharing$sampleid
)

if (length(sample_cols) < 10) {
  stop("Too few overlapping samples between diet metadata and ASV PA table.")
}

# Sample x ASV binary matrix
asv_mat <- asv_pa_tbl %>%
  select(ASV, all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(-ASV, ~ as.integer(as.numeric(.x) > 0))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("ASV") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  t()

asv_mat <- asv_mat[sample_cols, , drop = FALSE]

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Prepare absolute and relative diet matrices
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_sample_meta <- diet_meta_sharing %>%
  filter(sampleid %in% sample_cols) %>%
  select(sampleid, village_id, cluster, all_of(diet_vars)) %>%
  mutate(
    diet_total = rowSums(across(all_of(diet_vars)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(diet_total),
    diet_total > 0
  )

shared_samples <- intersect(rownames(asv_mat), diet_sample_meta$sampleid)

asv_mat <- asv_mat[shared_samples, , drop = FALSE]

diet_sample_meta <- diet_sample_meta %>%
  filter(sampleid %in% shared_samples) %>%
  arrange(match(sampleid, shared_samples))

stopifnot(identical(diet_sample_meta$sampleid, rownames(asv_mat)))

diet_abs_mat <- diet_sample_meta %>%
  select(all_of(diet_vars)) %>%
  as.matrix()

diet_rel_mat <- diet_abs_mat / rowSums(diet_abs_mat, na.rm = TRUE)

rownames(diet_abs_mat) <- diet_sample_meta$sampleid
rownames(diet_rel_mat) <- diet_sample_meta$sampleid

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Pairwise metric functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
calc_jaccard_similarity <- function(x, y) {
  inter <- sum(x == 1 & y == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  union <- sum(x == 1 | y == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (union == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  inter / union
}

calc_euclidean_distance <- function(x, y) {
  sqrt(sum((x - y)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

calc_bray_distance <- function(x, y) {
  numerator <- sum(abs(x - y), na.rm = TRUE)
  denominator <- sum(x + y, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (denominator == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  numerator / denominator
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Village-level within-village ASV sharing and diet distance
# ---------------------------------------------------------
calc_village_metrics <- function(village_i) {
  
  sample_i <- diet_sample_meta %>%
    filter(village_id == village_i) %>%
    pull(sampleid)
  
  sample_i <- intersect(sample_i, rownames(asv_mat))
  
  n_i <- length(sample_i)
  
  if (n_i < min_samples_per_village) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  pair_idx <- combn(sample_i, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  
  pair_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(pair_idx, function(pair_i) {
    
    s1 <- pair_i[1]
    s2 <- pair_i[2]
    
    asv_jaccard <- calc_jaccard_similarity(
      asv_mat[s1, ],
      asv_mat[s2, ]
    )
    
    abs_euclidean <- calc_euclidean_distance(
      diet_abs_mat[s1, ],
      diet_abs_mat[s2, ]
    )
    
    rel_euclidean <- calc_euclidean_distance(
      diet_rel_mat[s1, ],
      diet_rel_mat[s2, ]
    )
    
    rel_bray <- calc_bray_distance(
      diet_rel_mat[s1, ],
      diet_rel_mat[s2, ]
    )
    
    tibble(
      sample1 = s1,
      sample2 = s2,
      asv_jaccard_similarity = asv_jaccard,
      diet_absolute_euclidean_distance = abs_euclidean,
      diet_relative_euclidean_distance = rel_euclidean,
      diet_relative_bray_distance = rel_bray
    )
  })
  
  village_cluster <- diet_sample_meta %>%
    filter(village_id == village_i) %>%
    pull(cluster) %>%
    as.character() %>%
    unique()
  
  village_cluster <- village_cluster[!is.na(village_cluster)]
  
  tibble(
    village_id = village_i,
    cluster = ifelse(length(village_cluster) == 1, village_cluster, NA_character_),
    n_samples = n_i,
    n_pairs = nrow(pair_tbl),
    intra_asv_sharing = mean(pair_tbl$asv_jaccard_similarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    intra_asv_distance = 1 - intra_asv_sharing,
    intra_diet_absolute_euclidean_distance = mean(pair_tbl$diet_absolute_euclidean_distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    intra_diet_relative_euclidean_distance = mean(pair_tbl$diet_relative_euclidean_distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    intra_diet_relative_bray_distance = mean(pair_tbl$diet_relative_bray_distance, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

village_ids <- sort(unique(diet_sample_meta$village_id))

diet_sharing_village_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(
  village_ids,
  calc_village_metrics
) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = as.character(1:4))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(intra_asv_sharing),
    is.finite(intra_diet_absolute_euclidean_distance),
    is.finite(intra_diet_relative_euclidean_distance),
    is.finite(intra_diet_relative_bray_distance)
  )

cat("\n===== Village-level diet-sharing metrics =====\n")
print(dim(diet_sharing_village_tbl))
print(head(diet_sharing_village_tbl))

readr::write_csv(
  diet_sharing_village_tbl,
  file.path(
    diet_sharing_outdir,
    "tables",
    "diet_sharing_within_village_metrics.csv"
  )
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Statistical tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_distance_vars <- c(
  "intra_diet_absolute_euclidean_distance",
  "intra_diet_relative_euclidean_distance",
  "intra_diet_relative_bray_distance"
)

diet_distance_label_map <- c(
  intra_diet_absolute_euclidean_distance = "Absolute diet Euclidean distance",
  intra_diet_relative_euclidean_distance = "Relative diet Euclidean distance",
  intra_diet_relative_bray_distance = "Relative diet Bray-Curtis distance"
)

# Spearman correlation
diet_sharing_spearman_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(diet_distance_vars, function(xvar) {
  
  df <- diet_sharing_village_tbl %>%
    select(
      village_id,
      cluster,
      n_samples,
      intra_asv_sharing,
      x = all_of(xvar)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(intra_asv_sharing),
      is.finite(x)
    )
  
  if (nrow(df) < 5) {
    return(tibble(
      diet_distance_metric = xvar,
      diet_distance_label = diet_distance_label_map[[xvar]],
      n_villages = nrow(df),
      rho = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  ct <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(
      df$x,
      df$intra_asv_sharing,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  )
  
  tibble(
    diet_distance_metric = xvar,
    diet_distance_label = diet_distance_label_map[[xvar]],
    n_villages = nrow(df),
    rho = unname(ct$estimate),
    p_value = ct$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_bh, p_value)

cat("\n===== Spearman tests: within-village diet distance vs ASV sharing =====\n")
print(diet_sharing_spearman_tbl)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_sharing_spearman_tbl,
  file.path(
    diet_sharing_outdir,
    "tables",
    "diet_sharing_within_village_spearman_results.csv"
  )
)

# Linear models
# Model 1: intra_asv_sharing ~ diet_distance
# Model 2: intra_asv_sharing ~ diet_distance + n_samples
diet_sharing_lm_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(diet_distance_vars, function(xvar) {
  
  df <- diet_sharing_village_tbl %>%
    select(
      village_id,
      cluster,
      n_samples,
      intra_asv_sharing,
      x = all_of(xvar)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(intra_asv_sharing),
      is.finite(x),
      is.finite(n_samples)
    )
  
  if (nrow(df) < 8) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  fit1 <- lm(intra_asv_sharing ~ x, data = df)
  fit2 <- lm(intra_asv_sharing ~ x + n_samples, data = df)
  
  res1 <- broom::tidy(fit1) %>%
    filter(term == "x") %>%
    mutate(
      model = "unadjusted",
      diet_distance_metric = xvar,
      diet_distance_label = diet_distance_label_map[[xvar]],
      n_villages = nrow(df),
      r_squared = summary(fit1)$r.squared
    )
  
  res2 <- broom::tidy(fit2) %>%
    filter(term == "x") %>%
    mutate(
      model = "adjusted_for_n_samples",
      diet_distance_metric = xvar,
      diet_distance_label = diet_distance_label_map[[xvar]],
      n_villages = nrow(df),
      r_squared = summary(fit2)$r.squared
    )
  
  bind_rows(res1, res2)
}) %>%
  select(
    model,
    diet_distance_metric,
    diet_distance_label,
    n_villages,
    term,
    estimate,
    std.error,
    statistic,
    p.value,
    r_squared
  ) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(model, p_adj_bh, p.value)

cat("\n===== Linear models: within-village diet distance vs ASV sharing =====\n")
print(diet_sharing_lm_tbl)

readr::write_csv(
  diet_sharing_lm_tbl,
  file.path(
    diet_sharing_outdir,
    "tables",
    "diet_sharing_within_village_lm_results.csv"
  )
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Plot function
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_diet_distance_vs_sharing <- function(xvar, xlab, filename_stub) {
  
  stat_row <- diet_sharing_spearman_tbl %>%
    filter(diet_distance_metric == xvar) %>%
    slice(1)
  
  subtitle_txt <- if (nrow(stat_row) == 1) {
    paste0(
      "Spearman rho = ",
      sprintf("%.3f", stat_row$rho),
      ", BH-adjusted P = ",
      formatC(stat_row$p_adj_bh, format = "e", digits = 2),
      "; each point represents one village."
    )
  } else {
    "Each point represents one village."
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(
    diet_sharing_village_tbl,
    aes(
      x = .data[[xvar]],
      y = intra_asv_sharing,
      color = cluster
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(size = n_samples),
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      se = TRUE,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    labs(
      x = xlab,
      y = "Within-village ASV sharing\n(mean Jaccard similarity)",
      color = "Cluster",
      size = "No. samples",
      title = "Within-village dietary dissimilarity and ASV sharing",
      subtitle = subtitle_txt
    ) +
    theme_sharing +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  if (exists("clu_pal")) {
    p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = clu_pal, drop = FALSE)
  }
  
  print(p)
  
  save_plot_both(
    p,
    file.path(
      diet_sharing_outdir,
      "plots",
      filename_stub
    ),
    width = 7.2,
    height = 5.6
  )
  
  invisible(p)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Draw plots
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_abs_euclidean <- plot_diet_distance_vs_sharing(
  xvar = "intra_diet_absolute_euclidean_distance",
  xlab = "Within-village absolute diet distance\n(mean Euclidean distance)",
  filename_stub = "diet_sharing_absolute_euclidean_vs_asv_sharing"
)

p_rel_euclidean <- plot_diet_distance_vs_sharing(
  xvar = "intra_diet_relative_euclidean_distance",
  xlab = "Within-village relative diet distance\n(mean Euclidean distance)",
  filename_stub = "diet_sharing_relative_euclidean_vs_asv_sharing"
)

p_rel_bray <- plot_diet_distance_vs_sharing(
  xvar = "intra_diet_relative_bray_distance",
  xlab = "Within-village relative diet distance\n(mean Bray-Curtis distance)",
  filename_stub = "diet_sharing_relative_bray_vs_asv_sharing"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Console summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n===== Diet-sharing direct analysis finished =====\n")
cat("Output directory:", diet_sharing_outdir, "\n")
cat("Village column used:", village_col, "\n")
cat("Minimum samples per village:", min_samples_per_village, "\n")
cat("Villages analyzed:", nrow(diet_sharing_village_tbl), "\n")
cat("Samples analyzed:", n_distinct(diet_sample_meta$sampleid), "\n")

cat("\nMain interpretation guide:\n")
cat("- Negative rho means villages with more similar diet have higher ASV sharing.\n")
cat("- Positive rho means villages with more dissimilar diet have higher ASV sharing.\n")
cat("- Non-significant result means within-village diet similarity does not strongly explain intra-village ASV sharing.\n")

cat("\nSaved tables:\n")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_sharing_outdir, "tables", "diet_sharing_within_village_metrics.csv"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_sharing_outdir, "tables", "diet_sharing_within_village_spearman_results.csv"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_sharing_outdir, "tables", "diet_sharing_within_village_lm_results.csv"), "\n", sep = "")

cat("\nSaved plots:\n")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_sharing_outdir, "plots", "diet_sharing_absolute_euclidean_vs_asv_sharing.png/.svg"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_sharing_outdir, "plots", "diet_sharing_relative_euclidean_vs_asv_sharing.png/.svg"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(diet_sharing_outdir, "plots", "diet_sharing_relative_bray_vs_asv_sharing.png/.svg"), "\n", sep = "")
```

#village-level correlation between sharing-related ASV with social-interaction and diet
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Sharing-related ASV vs social/diet correlation heatmap
# - Village-level analysis
# - ASV value: village-level prevalence
# - Explanatory variables:
#     1) village-level social questionnaire variables
#     2) village-level mean dietary frequency variables
# - ASV classes:
#     Global core + Village-enriched
# - Subtypes unified to:
#     single / nearby / regional
# - Uniform core is excluded
#
# This code saves two heatmap versions:
#   1) raw P-value asterisk version
#   2) BH-FDR asterisk version
#
# Required objects:
#   prev_vil_full
#   asv_subtype_tbl
#   global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh
#   social_village
#   diet_meta
#   diet_variable_cols
#   base_theme
#   save_plot_both()
#
# Optional:
#   asv_label_tbl
#
# Outputs:
#   sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_heatmap_rawP.png/.svg
#   sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_heatmap_FDR.png/.svg
#   sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_results.csv
#   sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_rowmeta.csv
#   sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_colmeta.csv
#   sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_input_long.csv
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(patchwork)
  library(forcats)
  library(stringr)
  library(scales)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs <- c(
  "prev_vil_full",
  "asv_subtype_tbl",
  "global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh",
  "social_village",
  "diet_meta",
  "diet_variable_cols",
  "base_theme",
  "save_plot_both"
)

miss <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss)) {
  stop("Required objects are missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "vil_id", "prev") %in% names(prev_vil_full)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "subtype") %in% names(asv_subtype_tbl)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "subtype") %in% names(global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh)))
stopifnot("vil_id" %in% names(social_village))
stopifnot("vil_id" %in% names(diet_meta))

OUTDIR_COR <- "sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation"
dir.create(OUTDIR_COR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
social_vars <- c(
  "hall_attend_n",
  "hall_gather_freq",
  "hall_stability",
  "shared_meal_freq",
  "food_share_freq",
  "intervillage_freq",
  "intervillage_n",
  "within_social_score",
  "food_sharing_score",
  "intervillage_score"
)

social_vars <- intersect(social_vars, names(social_village))

diet_vars <- intersect(
  c(
    "Vegetables",
    "Namul",
    "Kimchi",
    "Mushrooms",
    "Seaweed",
    "Seafood",
    "Fish",
    "Meat",
    "Fruit",
    "Beverages"
  ),
  diet_variable_cols
)

diet_vars <- intersect(diet_vars, names(diet_meta))

if (length(social_vars) == 0) {
  stop("No social variables were found in social_village.")
}

if (length(diet_vars) == 0) {
  stop("No diet variables were found in diet_meta.")
}

var_label_map <- c(
  hall_attend_n = "Hall attendance",
  hall_gather_freq = "Hall gathering",
  hall_stability = "Hall stability",
  shared_meal_freq = "Shared meal",
  food_share_freq = "Food sharing",
  intervillage_freq = "Inter-village visit",
  intervillage_n = "Inter-village number",
  within_social_score = "Within-social score",
  food_sharing_score = "Food-sharing score",
  intervillage_score = "Inter-village score",
  Vegetables = "Vegetables",
  Namul = "Namul",
  Kimchi = "Kimchi",
  Mushrooms = "Mushrooms",
  Seaweed = "Seaweed",
  Seafood = "Seafood",
  Fish = "Fish",
  Meat = "Meat",
  Fruit = "Fruit",
  Beverages = "Beverages"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Unify ASV subtype tables
#    - Uniform core is excluded
# ---------------------------------------------------------
village_enriched_subtype_tbl <- asv_subtype_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    ASV_lab = if ("ASV_lab" %in% names(.)) as.character(ASV_lab) else as.character(ASV),
    asv_class = "Village-enriched",
    subtype_raw = as.character(subtype),
    subtype = case_when(
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "single") ~ "single",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "nearby") ~ "nearby",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "regional") ~ "regional",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    max_node_score = if ("max_node_score" %in% names(.)) max_node_score else NA_real_,
    sum_node_score = if ("sum_node_score" %in% names(.)) sum_node_score else NA_real_
  )

global_core_subtype_tbl <- global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
  transmute(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    ASV_lab = if ("ASV_lab" %in% names(.)) as.character(ASV_lab) else as.character(ASV),
    asv_class = "Global core",
    subtype_raw = as.character(subtype),
    subtype = case_when(
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "single") ~ "single",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "nearby") ~ "nearby",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "regional") ~ "regional",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    max_node_score = if ("max_node_score" %in% names(.)) max_node_score else NA_real_,
    sum_node_score = if ("sum_node_score" %in% names(.)) sum_node_score else NA_real_
  )

sharing_asv_tbl <- bind_rows(
  global_core_subtype_tbl,
  village_enriched_subtype_tbl
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(subtype)) %>%
  mutate(
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional")),
    asv_class = factor(asv_class, levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched"))
  ) %>%
  distinct(ASV, asv_class, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Optional: replace ASV labels from asv_label_tbl if available
if (exists("asv_label_tbl") && all(c("ASV", "ASV_lab") %in% names(asv_label_tbl))) {
  sharing_asv_tbl <- sharing_asv_tbl %>%
    select(-ASV_lab) %>%
    left_join(
      asv_label_tbl %>%
        transmute(
          ASV = as.character(ASV),
          ASV_lab = as.character(ASV_lab)
        ) %>%
        distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = "ASV"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ASV_lab = ifelse(is.na(ASV_lab) | ASV_lab == "", ASV, ASV_lab)
    )
}

sharing_asv_tbl <- sharing_asv_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_lab = ifelse(is.na(ASV_lab) | ASV_lab == "", ASV, ASV_lab)
  )

cat("\n===== Sharing-related ASV table after excluding uniform core =====\n")
print(
  sharing_asv_tbl %>%
    count(asv_class, subtype, name = "n_asvs")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Village-level ASV prevalence table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_village_prev_tbl <- prev_vil_full %>%
  filter(ASV %in% sharing_asv_tbl$ASV) %>%
  transmute(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    asv_prev = as.numeric(prev)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vil_id)) %>%
  distinct(ASV, vil_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Village-level social variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
social_village_tbl <- social_village %>%
  transmute(
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    across(all_of(social_vars), as.numeric)
  ) %>%
  distinct(vil_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

social_long_tbl <- social_village_tbl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(social_vars),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = as.character(variable),
    variable_group = "Social questionnaire",
    variable_label = recode(variable, !!!var_label_map, .default = variable)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Village-level diet variables
#    Individual-level diet frequency -> village-level mean
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_village_tbl <- diet_meta %>%
  mutate(vil_id = as.character(vil_id)) %>%
  group_by(vil_id) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(diet_vars), ~ mean(as.numeric(.x), na.rm = TRUE)),
    n_diet_samples = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

diet_long_tbl <- diet_village_tbl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(diet_vars),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = as.character(variable),
    variable_group = "Diet",
    variable_label = recode(variable, !!!var_label_map, .default = variable)
  )

village_variable_long_tbl <- bind_rows(
  social_long_tbl,
  diet_long_tbl
) %>%
  filter(is.finite(value))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Spearman correlation helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
run_cor_one <- function(df, asv_i, var_i) {
  dat <- df %>%
    filter(ASV == asv_i, variable == var_i) %>%
    filter(is.finite(asv_prev), is.finite(value))

  if (nrow(dat) < 8) {
    return(tibble(
      ASV = asv_i,
      variable = var_i,
      n_villages = nrow(dat),
      rho = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  if (n_distinct(dat$asv_prev) < 2 || n_distinct(dat$value) < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      ASV = asv_i,
      variable = var_i,
      n_villages = nrow(dat),
      rho = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  ct <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(
      dat$asv_prev,
      dat$value,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  )

  tibble(
    ASV = asv_i,
    variable = var_i,
    n_villages = nrow(dat),
    rho = unname(ct$estimate),
    p_value = ct$p.value
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Build ASV-variable analysis table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cor_input_tbl <- asv_village_prev_tbl %>%
  inner_join(
    village_variable_long_tbl,
    by = "vil_id"
  )

target_asvs <- unique(sharing_asv_tbl$ASV)
target_vars <- c(social_vars, diet_vars)

cor_result_tbl <- tidyr::crossing(
  ASV = target_asvs,
  variable = target_vars
) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    res = list(run_cor_one(cor_input_tbl, ASV, variable))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(res) %>%
  unnest(res) %>%
  mutate(variable = as.character(variable)) %>%
  left_join(
    sharing_asv_tbl,
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    village_variable_long_tbl %>%
      distinct(variable, variable_group, variable_label),
    by = "variable"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variable_group = ifelse(
      is.na(variable_group),
      ifelse(variable %in% social_vars, "Social questionnaire", "Diet"),
      variable_group
    ),
    variable_label = ifelse(
      is.na(variable_label) | variable_label == "",
      recode(variable, !!!var_label_map, .default = variable),
      variable_label
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(variable_group) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    sig_label_raw = case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~ "",
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    sig_label_fdr = case_when(
      is.na(p_adj_bh) ~ "",
      p_adj_bh < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj_bh < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_adj_bh < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Row and column metadata/order
# ---------------------------------------------------------
row_meta <- sharing_asv_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional")),
    asv_class = factor(asv_class, levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    cor_result_tbl %>%
      group_by(ASV) %>%
      summarise(
        max_abs_rho = max(abs(rho), na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_abs_rho = ifelse(is.infinite(max_abs_rho), NA_real_, max_abs_rho),
    max_abs_rho = replace_na(max_abs_rho, 0),
    row_display = ifelse(is.na(ASV_lab) | ASV_lab == "", ASV, ASV_lab),
    row_id = paste0(row_display, "__", ASV)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    desc(max_abs_rho),
    desc(sum_node_score),
    desc(max_node_score),
    ASV
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    row_order = row_number()
  )

# Display only ASV_lab on y-axis
y_labels <- setNames(row_meta$row_display, row_meta$row_id)

col_meta <- tibble(
  variable = c(social_vars, diet_vars)
) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = as.character(variable),
    variable_group = ifelse(variable %in% social_vars, "Social questionnaire", "Diet"),
    variable_label = recode(variable, !!!var_label_map, .default = variable),
    variable_label = ifelse(is.na(variable_label) | variable_label == "", variable, variable_label),
    col_order = row_number()
  )

x_levels <- col_meta$variable
x_labels <- setNames(col_meta$variable_label, col_meta$variable)

heat_df <- cor_result_tbl %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    variable,
    n_villages,
    rho,
    p_value,
    p_adj_bh,
    sig_label_raw,
    sig_label_fdr
  ) %>%
  mutate(variable = as.character(variable)) %>%
  left_join(
    row_meta %>%
      select(ASV, row_id, row_display, row_order),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    col_meta %>%
      select(variable, variable_group, variable_label, col_order),
    by = "variable"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variable_label = ifelse(is.na(variable_label) | variable_label == "", variable, variable_label),
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = rev(row_meta$row_id)),
    variable = factor(variable, levels = x_levels)
  )

cat("\n===== Heatmap column check =====\n")
print(
  heat_df %>%
    count(variable, variable_label, name = "n_cells") %>%
    arrange(variable)
)

cat("\nNo. columns in heatmap:", n_distinct(heat_df$variable), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Annotation data and palettes
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Manual legends
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_tile_legend <- function(pal, title, ncol = 1, text_size = 3.0, title_size = 10) {
  leg_df <- tibble(
    label = names(pal),
    idx = seq_along(label)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      col = ((idx - 1) %% ncol) + 1,
      row = ceiling(idx / ncol),
      row = max(row) - row + 1
    )

  ggplot(leg_df, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = label)) +
    geom_tile(width = 0.35, height = 0.35, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), nudge_x = 0.25, hjust = 0, size = text_size) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0.6, ncol + 3.2),
      ylim = c(0.4, max(leg_df$row) + 0.6),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}

p_class_legend <- make_tile_legend(

  title = "ASV class",
  ncol = 1,
  text_size = 3.0
)

  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Function to build and save one heatmap version
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_correlation_heatmap <- function(star_col = c("sig_label_raw", "sig_label_fdr"),
                                     label_type = c("rawP", "FDR")) {

  star_col <- match.arg(star_col)
  label_type <- match.arg(label_type)

  if (label_type == "rawP") {
    title_suffix <- "Raw P-value version"
    subtitle_txt <- "ASV values are village-level prevalence; social and diet variables are village-level scores. Asterisks indicate raw P values: * < 0.05, ** < 0.01, *** < 0.001."
    filename_stub <- "sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_heatmap_rawP"
  } else {
    title_suffix <- "BH-FDR version"
    subtitle_txt <- "ASV values are village-level prevalence; social and diet variables are village-level scores. Asterisks indicate BH-FDR-adjusted P values: * < 0.05, ** < 0.01, *** < 0.001."
    filename_stub <- "sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_heatmap_FDR"
  }

  p_title <- ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 1,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      label = paste0(
        "Sharing-related ASVs associated with village-level social and dietary features\n",
        title_suffix
      ),
      size = 5.2,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.18,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      label = subtitle_txt,
      size = 3.35,
      color = "grey30"
    ) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(2, 5.5, 2, 5.5)
    )

  p_heat <- ggplot(
    heat_df,
    aes(x = variable, y = row_id, fill = rho)
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.10) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = .data[[star_col]]),
      size = 2.7,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#3C5488",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#BC3C29",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-1, 1),
      name = "Spearman\nrho"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      limits = x_levels,
      labels = x_labels,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(
      drop = FALSE,
      labels = y_labels
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 9),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5.8),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 5.5, 0)
    )

  p_spacer1 <- patchwork::plot_spacer()
  p_spacer2 <- patchwork::plot_spacer()
  p_spacer3 <- patchwork::plot_spacer()
  p_spacer4 <- patchwork::plot_spacer()

  p_heat_body <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    p_spacer1,
    p_spacer2,
    p_col_group_anno,
    p_spacer3,
    p_spacer4,
    p_col_item_anno,
    p_row_class,
    p_row_subtype,
    p_heat,
    ncol = 3
  ) +
    patchwork::plot_layout(
      widths = c(0.045, 0.045, 10),
      heights = c(0.10, 0.10, 10)
    )

  p_left_full <- p_title / p_heat_body +
    patchwork::plot_layout(
      heights = c(0.42, 10)
    )

  p_final <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    p_left_full,
    p_manual_legends,
    ncol = 2
  ) +
    patchwork::plot_layout(
      widths = c(10, 1.9)
    )

  print(p_final)

  plot_height <- max(8, 0.115 * nrow(row_meta) + 3)

  save_plot_both(
    p_final,
    file.path(OUTDIR_COR, filename_stub),
    width = 18,
    height = plot_height
  )

  invisible(p_final)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 13) Save both raw P and FDR versions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_final_rawP <- make_correlation_heatmap(
  star_col = "sig_label_raw",
  label_type = "rawP"
)

p_final_FDR <- make_correlation_heatmap(
  star_col = "sig_label_fdr",
  label_type = "FDR"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14) Save tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(
  cor_result_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_COR, "sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_results.csv")
)

write_csv(
  row_meta,
  file.path(OUTDIR_COR, "sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_rowmeta.csv")
)

write_csv(
  col_meta,
  file.path(OUTDIR_COR, "sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_colmeta.csv")
)

write_csv(
  cor_input_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_COR, "sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_input_long.csv")
)

cat("\n===== Sharing-related ASV social/diet correlation heatmaps finished =====\n")
cat("Uniform core excluded.\n")
cat("Both raw P and BH-FDR heatmaps were saved.\n")
cat("No. ASVs:", n_distinct(row_meta$ASV), "\n")
cat("No. variables:", n_distinct(col_meta$variable), "\n")
cat("No. correlation tests:", nrow(cor_result_tbl), "\n")
cat("No. raw P < 0.05 correlations:", sum(cor_result_tbl$p_value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("No. FDR-significant correlations:", sum(cor_result_tbl$p_adj_bh < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Output directory:", OUTDIR_COR, "\n")
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Cluster-stratified sharing-related ASV vs social/diet correlation heatmap
# - Village-level analysis within each geographic cluster
# - ASV value: village-level prevalence
# - Variables:
#     1) village-level social questionnaire variables
#     2) village-level mean dietary frequency variables
# - ASV classes:
#     Global core + Village-enriched
# - Subtypes unified:
#     single / nearby / regional
# - Uniform core is excluded
#
# This code saves:
#   1) cluster-specific raw P heatmaps
#   2) cluster-specific FDR heatmaps
#   3) combined 2x2 raw P figure
#   4) combined 2x2 FDR figure
#
# Required objects:
#   prev_vil_full
#   asv_subtype_tbl
#   global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh
#   social_village
#   diet_meta
#   diet_variable_cols
#   base_theme
#   save_plot_both()
#
# Optional:
#   asv_label_tbl
#   clu_pal
#
# Outputs directory:
#   sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_cluster_stratified/
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(patchwork)
  library(forcats)
  library(stringr)
  library(scales)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs <- c(
  "prev_vil_full",
  "asv_subtype_tbl",
  "global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh",
  "social_village",
  "diet_meta",
  "diet_variable_cols",
  "base_theme",
  "save_plot_both"
)

miss <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss)) {
  stop("Required objects are missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "vil_id", "prev") %in% names(prev_vil_full)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "subtype") %in% names(asv_subtype_tbl)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "subtype") %in% names(global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh)))
stopifnot("vil_id" %in% names(social_village))
stopifnot("vil_id" %in% names(diet_meta))

OUTDIR_COR_CL <- "sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_cluster_stratified"
dir.create(OUTDIR_COR_CL, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_COR_CL, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_COR_CL, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cluster_levels <- as.character(1:4)

if (!exists("clu_pal")) {
  clu_pal <- c(
    "1" = "#4E79A7",
    "2" = "#E15759",
    "3" = "#59A14F",
    "4" = "#B07AA1"
  )
}

social_vars <- c(
  "hall_attend_n",
  "hall_gather_freq",
  "hall_stability",
  "shared_meal_freq",
  "food_share_freq",
  "intervillage_freq",
  "intervillage_n",
  "within_social_score",
  "food_sharing_score",
  "intervillage_score"
)

social_vars <- intersect(social_vars, names(social_village))

diet_vars <- intersect(
  c(
    "Vegetables",
    "Namul",
    "Kimchi",
    "Mushrooms",
    "Seaweed",
    "Seafood",
    "Fish",
    "Meat",
    "Fruit",
    "Beverages"
  ),
  diet_variable_cols
)

diet_vars <- intersect(diet_vars, names(diet_meta))

if (length(social_vars) == 0) {
  stop("No social variables were found in social_village.")
}

if (length(diet_vars) == 0) {
  stop("No diet variables were found in diet_meta.")
}

target_vars <- c(social_vars, diet_vars)

var_label_map <- c(
  hall_attend_n = "Hall attendance",
  hall_gather_freq = "Hall gathering",
  hall_stability = "Hall stability",
  shared_meal_freq = "Shared meal",
  food_share_freq = "Food sharing",
  intervillage_freq = "Inter-village visit",
  intervillage_n = "Inter-village number",
  within_social_score = "Within-social score",
  food_sharing_score = "Food-sharing score",
  intervillage_score = "Inter-village score",
  Vegetables = "Vegetables",
  Namul = "Namul",
  Kimchi = "Kimchi",
  Mushrooms = "Mushrooms",
  Seaweed = "Seaweed",
  Seafood = "Seafood",
  Fish = "Fish",
  Meat = "Meat",
  Fruit = "Fruit",
  Beverages = "Beverages"
)

# minimum number of villages for correlation within cluster
min_n_villages_cor <- 5

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Unify ASV subtype tables
#    - Uniform core excluded
# ---------------------------------------------------------
village_enriched_subtype_tbl <- asv_subtype_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    ASV_lab = if ("ASV_lab" %in% names(.)) as.character(ASV_lab) else as.character(ASV),
    asv_class = "Village-enriched",
    subtype_raw = as.character(subtype),
    subtype = case_when(
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "single") ~ "single",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "nearby") ~ "nearby",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "regional") ~ "regional",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    max_node_score = if ("max_node_score" %in% names(.)) max_node_score else NA_real_,
    sum_node_score = if ("sum_node_score" %in% names(.)) sum_node_score else NA_real_
  )

global_core_subtype_tbl <- global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
  transmute(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    ASV_lab = if ("ASV_lab" %in% names(.)) as.character(ASV_lab) else as.character(ASV),
    asv_class = "Global core",
    subtype_raw = as.character(subtype),
    subtype = case_when(
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "single") ~ "single",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "nearby") ~ "nearby",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "regional") ~ "regional",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    max_node_score = if ("max_node_score" %in% names(.)) max_node_score else NA_real_,
    sum_node_score = if ("sum_node_score" %in% names(.)) sum_node_score else NA_real_
  )

sharing_asv_tbl <- bind_rows(
  global_core_subtype_tbl,
  village_enriched_subtype_tbl
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(subtype)) %>%
  mutate(
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional")),
    asv_class = factor(asv_class, levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched"))
  ) %>%
  distinct(ASV, asv_class, .keep_all = TRUE)

if (exists("asv_label_tbl") && all(c("ASV", "ASV_lab") %in% names(asv_label_tbl))) {
  sharing_asv_tbl <- sharing_asv_tbl %>%
    select(-ASV_lab) %>%
    left_join(
      asv_label_tbl %>%
        transmute(
          ASV = as.character(ASV),
          ASV_lab = as.character(ASV_lab)
        ) %>%
        distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = "ASV"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ASV_lab = ifelse(is.na(ASV_lab) | ASV_lab == "", ASV, ASV_lab)
    )
}

sharing_asv_tbl <- sharing_asv_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_lab = ifelse(is.na(ASV_lab) | ASV_lab == "", ASV, ASV_lab)
  )

cat("\n===== Sharing-related ASV table after excluding uniform core =====\n")
print(
  sharing_asv_tbl %>%
    count(asv_class, subtype, name = "n_asvs")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Build village-level ASV prevalence + cluster table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Cluster source:
# Prefer diet_meta because diet variables use this object.
village_cluster_tbl <- diet_meta %>%
  transmute(
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = cluster_levels)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vil_id), !is.na(cluster)) %>%
  distinct(vil_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

asv_village_prev_tbl <- prev_vil_full %>%
  filter(ASV %in% sharing_asv_tbl$ASV) %>%
  transmute(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    asv_prev = as.numeric(prev)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vil_id)) %>%
  distinct(ASV, vil_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  left_join(village_cluster_tbl, by = "vil_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Village-level social variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
social_village_tbl <- social_village %>%
  transmute(
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    across(all_of(social_vars), as.numeric)
  ) %>%
  distinct(vil_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  left_join(village_cluster_tbl, by = "vil_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster))

social_long_tbl <- social_village_tbl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(social_vars),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = as.character(variable),
    variable_group = "Social questionnaire",
    variable_label = recode(variable, !!!var_label_map, .default = variable)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Village-level diet variables
#    Individual-level diet frequency -> village-level mean
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_village_tbl <- diet_meta %>%
  mutate(
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = cluster_levels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(vil_id, cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(diet_vars), ~ mean(as.numeric(.x), na.rm = TRUE)),
    n_diet_samples = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vil_id), !is.na(cluster))

diet_long_tbl <- diet_village_tbl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(diet_vars),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = as.character(variable),
    variable_group = "Diet",
    variable_label = recode(variable, !!!var_label_map, .default = variable)
  )

village_variable_long_tbl <- bind_rows(
  social_long_tbl %>% select(vil_id, cluster, variable, value, variable_group, variable_label),
  diet_long_tbl %>% select(vil_id, cluster, variable, value, variable_group, variable_label)
) %>%
  filter(is.finite(value))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Cluster-stratified Spearman correlation helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
run_cor_one_cluster <- function(df, asv_i, var_i, cluster_i) {
  dat <- df %>%
    filter(
      ASV == asv_i,
      variable == var_i,
      cluster == cluster_i
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(asv_prev), is.finite(value))

  if (nrow(dat) < min_n_villages_cor) {
    return(tibble(
      cluster = as.character(cluster_i),
      ASV = asv_i,
      variable = var_i,
      n_villages = nrow(dat),
      rho = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  if (n_distinct(dat$asv_prev) < 2 || n_distinct(dat$value) < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      cluster = as.character(cluster_i),
      ASV = asv_i,
      variable = var_i,
      n_villages = nrow(dat),
      rho = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  ct <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(
      dat$asv_prev,
      dat$value,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  )

  tibble(
    cluster = as.character(cluster_i),
    ASV = asv_i,
    variable = var_i,
    n_villages = nrow(dat),
    rho = unname(ct$estimate),
    p_value = ct$p.value
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Build cluster-stratified correlation table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cor_input_tbl <- asv_village_prev_tbl %>%
  inner_join(
    village_variable_long_tbl,
    by = c("vil_id", "cluster")
  )

target_asvs <- unique(sharing_asv_tbl$ASV)

cor_result_cluster_tbl <- tidyr::crossing(
  cluster = cluster_levels,
  ASV = target_asvs,
  variable = target_vars
) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    res = list(run_cor_one_cluster(cor_input_tbl, ASV, variable, cluster))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(res) %>%
  unnest(res) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = cluster_levels),
    variable = as.character(variable)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sharing_asv_tbl,
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    village_variable_long_tbl %>%
      distinct(variable, variable_group, variable_label),
    by = "variable"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variable_group = ifelse(
      is.na(variable_group),
      ifelse(variable %in% social_vars, "Social questionnaire", "Diet"),
      variable_group
    ),
    variable_label = ifelse(
      is.na(variable_label) | variable_label == "",
      recode(variable, !!!var_label_map, .default = variable),
      variable_label
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(cluster, variable_group) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    sig_label_raw = case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~ "",
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    sig_label_fdr = case_when(
      is.na(p_adj_bh) ~ "",
      p_adj_bh < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj_bh < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_adj_bh < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Row and column metadata/order
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Use global max_abs_rho across all cluster-stratified results for a single row order.
row_meta <- sharing_asv_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional")),
    asv_class = factor(asv_class, levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    cor_result_cluster_tbl %>%
      group_by(ASV) %>%
      summarise(
        max_abs_rho = max(abs(rho), na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_abs_rho = ifelse(is.infinite(max_abs_rho), NA_real_, max_abs_rho),
    max_abs_rho = replace_na(max_abs_rho, 0),
    row_display = ifelse(is.na(ASV_lab) | ASV_lab == "", ASV, ASV_lab),
    row_id = paste0(row_display, "__", ASV)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    desc(max_abs_rho),
    desc(sum_node_score),
    desc(max_node_score),
    ASV
  ) %>%
  mutate(row_order = row_number())

y_labels <- setNames(row_meta$row_display, row_meta$row_id)

col_meta <- tibble(
  variable = target_vars
) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = as.character(variable),
    variable_group = ifelse(variable %in% social_vars, "Social questionnaire", "Diet"),
    variable_label = recode(variable, !!!var_label_map, .default = variable),
    variable_label = ifelse(is.na(variable_label) | variable_label == "", variable, variable_label),
    col_order = row_number()
  )

x_levels <- col_meta$variable
x_labels <- setNames(col_meta$variable_label, col_meta$variable)

heat_df_all <- cor_result_cluster_tbl %>%
  select(
    cluster,
    ASV,
    variable,
    n_villages,
    rho,
    p_value,
    p_adj_bh,
    sig_label_raw,
    sig_label_fdr
  ) %>%
  mutate(variable = as.character(variable)) %>%
  left_join(
    row_meta %>% select(ASV, row_id, row_display, row_order),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    col_meta %>% select(variable, variable_group, variable_label, col_order),
    by = "variable"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variable_label = ifelse(is.na(variable_label) | variable_label == "", variable, variable_label),
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = rev(row_meta$row_id)),
    variable = factor(variable, levels = x_levels),
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = cluster_levels)
  )

cat("\n===== Cluster-stratified heatmap column check =====\n")
print(
  heat_df_all %>%
    count(cluster, variable, variable_label, name = "n_cells") %>%
    arrange(cluster, variable)
)

cat("\nNo. columns in heatmap:", n_distinct(heat_df_all$variable), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Annotation data and palettes
# ---------------------------------------------------------
row_anno_df <- row_meta %>%
  transmute(
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = rev(row_meta$row_id)),
    asv_class,
    subtype
  )

col_group_anno_df <- col_meta %>%
  transmute(
    variable = factor(variable, levels = x_levels),
    variable_group
  )

col_item_anno_df <- col_meta %>%
  transmute(
    variable = factor(variable, levels = x_levels),
    variable_label,
    variable_group,
    variable_color_label = variable_label
  )

subtype_cols <- c(
  single = "#1B9E77",
  nearby = "#D95F02",
  regional = "#7570B3"
)

class_cols <- c(
  "Global core" = "#4E79A7",
  "Village-enriched" = "#E15759"
)

variable_group_cols <- c(
  "Social questionnaire" = "#984EA3",
  "Diet" = "#59A14F"
)

social_item_cols <- c(
  "Hall attendance" = "#7B3294",
  "Hall gathering" = "#984EA3",
  "Hall stability" = "#C2A5CF",
  "Shared meal" = "#A6611A",

)

diet_item_cols <- c(

variable_item_cols <- c(social_item_cols, diet_item_cols)
variable_item_cols <- variable_item_cols[
  names(variable_item_cols) %in% as.character(col_meta$variable_label)
]

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Shared plot panels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_col_group_anno <- ggplot(
  col_group_anno_df,
  aes(x = variable, y = 1, fill = variable_group)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = variable_group_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = x_levels, labels = x_labels, drop = FALSE, expand = c(0, 0)) +

  base_theme +

    panel.grid = element_blank(),

p_col_item_anno <- ggplot(
  col_item_anno_df,
  aes(x = variable, y = 1, fill = variable_color_label)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +

  scale_x_discrete(limits = x_levels, labels = x_labels, drop = FALSE, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 0, 0)
  )

p_row_class <- ggplot(
  row_anno_df,
  aes(x = "Class", y = row_id, fill = asv_class)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.12) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_cols) +
  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 5.5, 5.5)
  )

p_row_subtype <- ggplot(

) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.12) +

  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +

  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",

  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Manual legends
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_tile_legend <- function(pal, title, ncol = 1, text_size = 3.0, title_size = 10) {
  leg_df <- tibble(
    label = names(pal),
    idx = seq_along(label)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      col = ((idx - 1) %% ncol) + 1,
      row = ceiling(idx / ncol),
      row = max(row) - row + 1
    )

  ggplot(leg_df, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = label)) +
    geom_tile(width = 0.35, height = 0.35, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), nudge_x = 0.25, hjust = 0, size = text_size) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0.6, ncol + 3.2),
      ylim = c(0.4, max(leg_df$row) + 0.6),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}

p_class_legend <- make_tile_legend(class_cols, title = "ASV class", ncol = 1, text_size = 3.0)
p_subtype_legend <- make_tile_legend(subtype_cols, title = "Subtype", ncol = 1, text_size = 3.0)
p_variable_group_legend <- make_tile_legend(variable_group_cols, title = "Variable class", ncol = 1, text_size = 3.0)

p_social_legend <- make_tile_legend(
  social_item_cols[names(social_item_cols) %in% as.character(col_meta$variable_label)],
  title = "Social questionnaire variables",
  ncol = 1,
  text_size = 2.7
)

p_diet_legend <- make_tile_legend(
  diet_item_cols[names(diet_item_cols) %in% as.character(col_meta$variable_label)],
  title = "Diet variables",
  ncol = 1,
  text_size = 2.7
)

p_manual_legends <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  p_class_legend,
  p_subtype_legend,
  p_variable_group_legend,
  p_social_legend,
  p_diet_legend,
  ncol = 1
) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(
    heights = c(1.0, 1.1, 1.0, 4.2, 4.0)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Function: one cluster heatmap panel
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_cluster_heatmap_body <- function(cluster_i,
                                      star_col = c("sig_label_raw", "sig_label_fdr"),
                                      show_y_text = TRUE,
                                      show_x_text = TRUE,
                                      show_legend = TRUE) {

  star_col <- match.arg(star_col)

  plot_df <- heat_df_all %>%
    filter(cluster == cluster_i)

  cluster_n_vil <- cor_input_tbl %>%
    filter(cluster == cluster_i) %>%
    distinct(vil_id) %>%
    nrow()

  p_heat <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = variable, y = row_id, fill = rho)
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.10) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = .data[[star_col]]),
      size = 2.5,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#3C5488",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#BC3C29",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-1, 1),
      name = "Spearman\nrho"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      limits = x_levels,
      labels = x_labels,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(
      drop = FALSE,
      labels = y_labels
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      title = paste0("Cluster ", cluster_i, " (n villages = ", cluster_n_vil, ")")
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 14,
        face = "bold",
        color = ifelse(cluster_i %in% names(clu_pal), clu_pal[[as.character(cluster_i)]], "black")
      ),
      axis.text.x = if (show_x_text) {
        element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 7.5)
      } else {
        element_blank()
      },
      axis.text.y = if (show_y_text) {
        element_text(size = 4.7)
      } else {
        element_blank()
      },
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "right" else "none",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 5.5, 5.5, 0)
    )

  p_spacer1 <- patchwork::plot_spacer()
  p_spacer2 <- patchwork::plot_spacer()
  p_spacer3 <- patchwork::plot_spacer()
  p_spacer4 <- patchwork::plot_spacer()

  p_body <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    p_spacer1,
    p_spacer2,
    p_col_group_anno,
    p_spacer3,
    p_spacer4,
    p_col_item_anno,
    p_row_class,
    p_row_subtype,
    p_heat,
    ncol = 3
  ) +
    patchwork::plot_layout(
      widths = c(0.045, 0.045, 10),
      heights = c(0.10, 0.10, 10)
    )

  p_body
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 13) Save individual cluster heatmaps
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_height_ind <- max(8, 0.115 * nrow(row_meta) + 3)

for (cluster_i in cluster_levels) {
  p_raw_i <- make_cluster_heatmap_body(
    cluster_i = cluster_i,
    star_col = "sig_label_raw",
    show_y_text = TRUE,
    show_x_text = TRUE,
    show_legend = TRUE
  )

  p_fdr_i <- make_cluster_heatmap_body(
    cluster_i = cluster_i,
    star_col = "sig_label_fdr",
    show_y_text = TRUE,
    show_x_text = TRUE,
    show_legend = TRUE
  )

  save_plot_both(
    p_raw_i,
    file.path(
      OUTDIR_COR_CL,
      "plots",
      paste0("sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_cluster", cluster_i, "_rawP")
    ),
    width = 16,
    height = plot_height_ind
  )

  save_plot_both(
    p_fdr_i,
    file.path(
      OUTDIR_COR_CL,
      "plots",
      paste0("sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_cluster", cluster_i, "_FDR")
    ),
    width = 16,
    height = plot_height_ind
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14) Combined 2x2 figures
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_combined_cluster_figure <- function(star_col = c("sig_label_raw", "sig_label_fdr"),
                                         label_type = c("rawP", "FDR")) {

  star_col <- match.arg(star_col)
  label_type <- match.arg(label_type)

  if (label_type == "rawP") {
    title_txt <- "Cluster-stratified correlations between sharing-related ASVs and village-level social/dietary features"
    subtitle_txt <- paste0(
      "Each panel uses villages within one geographic cluster. ",
      "Tile color indicates Spearman rho. Asterisks indicate raw P values: * < 0.05, ** < 0.01, *** < 0.001."
    )
    filename_stub <- "sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_cluster_stratified_combined_rawP"
  } else {
    title_txt <- "Cluster-stratified correlations between sharing-related ASVs and village-level social/dietary features"
    subtitle_txt <- paste0(
      "Each panel uses villages within one geographic cluster. ",
      "Tile color indicates Spearman rho. Asterisks indicate BH-FDR-adjusted P values within each cluster and variable class."
    )
    filename_stub <- "sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_cluster_stratified_combined_FDR"
  }

  p_title <- ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 1,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      label = title_txt,
      size = 5.4,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.25,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      label = subtitle_txt,
      size = 3.3,
      color = "grey30"
    ) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(2, 5.5, 2, 5.5))

  p_c1 <- make_cluster_heatmap_body("1", star_col = star_col, show_y_text = TRUE,  show_x_text = FALSE, show_legend = FALSE)
  p_c2 <- make_cluster_heatmap_body("2", star_col = star_col, show_y_text = FALSE, show_x_text = FALSE, show_legend = FALSE)
  p_c3 <- make_cluster_heatmap_body("3", star_col = star_col, show_y_text = TRUE,  show_x_text = TRUE,  show_legend = FALSE)
  p_c4 <- make_cluster_heatmap_body("4", star_col = star_col, show_y_text = FALSE, show_x_text = TRUE,  show_legend = TRUE)

  p_grid <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    p_c1, p_c2,
    p_c3, p_c4,
    ncol = 2
  )

  p_left <- p_title / p_grid +
    patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(0.35, 10))

  p_final <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    p_left,
    p_manual_legends,
    ncol = 2
  ) +
    patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(10, 1.5))

  print(p_final)

  save_plot_both(
    p_final,
    file.path(OUTDIR_COR_CL, "plots", filename_stub),
    width = 24,
    height = max(14, 0.13 * nrow(row_meta) + 8)
  )

  invisible(p_final)
}

p_combined_rawP <- make_combined_cluster_figure(
  star_col = "sig_label_raw",
  label_type = "rawP"
)

p_combined_FDR <- make_combined_cluster_figure(
  star_col = "sig_label_fdr",
  label_type = "FDR"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 15) Save tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(
  cor_result_cluster_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_COR_CL, "tables", "sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_cluster_stratified_results.csv")
)

write_csv(
  row_meta,
  file.path(OUTDIR_COR_CL, "tables", "sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_cluster_stratified_rowmeta.csv")
)

write_csv(
  col_meta,
  file.path(OUTDIR_COR_CL, "tables", "sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_cluster_stratified_colmeta.csv")
)

write_csv(
  cor_input_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_COR_CL, "tables", "sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_cluster_stratified_input_long.csv")
)

cluster_summary_tbl <- cor_result_cluster_tbl %>%
  group_by(cluster, variable_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tests = n(),
    n_tested = sum(!is.na(p_value)),
    n_raw_p_005 = sum(p_value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_raw_p_001 = sum(p_value < 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_fdr_005 = sum(p_adj_bh < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_abs_rho = max(abs(rho), na.rm = TRUE),
    median_abs_rho = median(abs(rho), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_abs_rho = ifelse(is.infinite(max_abs_rho), NA_real_, max_abs_rho)
  )

write_csv(
  cluster_summary_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_COR_CL, "tables", "sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_cluster_stratified_summary.csv")
)

cat("\n===== Cluster-stratified sharing-related ASV social/diet correlation finished =====\n")
cat("Uniform core excluded.\n")
cat("No. ASVs:", n_distinct(row_meta$ASV), "\n")
cat("No. variables:", n_distinct(col_meta$variable), "\n")
cat("No. clusters:", length(cluster_levels), "\n")
cat("No. correlation tests:", nrow(cor_result_cluster_tbl), "\n")
cat("No. raw P < 0.05 correlations:", sum(cor_result_cluster_tbl$p_value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("No. FDR-significant correlations:", sum(cor_result_cluster_tbl$p_adj_bh < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Output directory:", OUTDIR_COR_CL, "\n")

cat("\nCluster-wise summary:\n")
print(cluster_summary_tbl)
```

#sharing_subtype_burden_social_diet
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Sharing subtype burden vs social/diet correlation analysis
# - Village-level analysis
# - Purpose:
#     Test whether single / nearby / regional sharing subtype burden
#     is associated with village-level social interaction or diet variables.
#
# ASV groups:
#   Global core + Village-enriched
#
# Subtypes:
#   single / nearby / regional
#
# Burden metrics per village:
#   1) mean_prev
#        Mean village-level prevalence of ASVs in each class-subtype group
#   2) count_ge20
#        Number of ASVs with village-level prevalence >= 20%
#   3) pct_ge20
#        Percentage of ASVs in that class-subtype group with prevalence >= 20%
#
# Required objects:
#   prev_vil_full
#   asv_subtype_tbl
#   global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh
#   social_village
#   diet_meta
#   diet_variable_cols
#   base_theme
#   save_plot_both()
#
# Optional:
#   asv_label_tbl
#   clu_pal
#
# Outputs:
#   sharing_subtype_burden_social_diet/tables/
#   sharing_subtype_burden_social_diet/plots/
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(patchwork)
  library(stringr)
  library(forcats)
  library(scales)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs <- c(
  "prev_vil_full",
  "asv_subtype_tbl",
  "global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh",
  "social_village",
  "diet_meta",
  "diet_variable_cols",
  "base_theme",
  "save_plot_both"
)

miss <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss)) {
  stop("Required objects are missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "vil_id", "prev") %in% names(prev_vil_full)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "subtype") %in% names(asv_subtype_tbl)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "subtype") %in% names(global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh)))
stopifnot("vil_id" %in% names(social_village))
stopifnot("vil_id" %in% names(diet_meta))

OUTDIR_BURDEN <- "sharing_subtype_burden_social_diet"
dir.create(OUTDIR_BURDEN, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_BURDEN, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_BURDEN, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

if (!exists("clu_pal")) {
  clu_pal <- c(
    "1" = "#4E79A7",
    "2" = "#E15759",
    "3" = "#59A14F",
    "4" = "#B07AA1"
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
social_vars <- c(
  "hall_attend_n",
  "hall_gather_freq",
  "hall_stability",
  "shared_meal_freq",
  "food_share_freq",
  "intervillage_freq",
  "intervillage_n",
  "within_social_score",
  "food_sharing_score",
  "intervillage_score"
)

social_vars <- intersect(social_vars, names(social_village))

diet_vars <- intersect(
  c(
    "Vegetables",
    "Namul",
    "Kimchi",
    "Mushrooms",
    "Seaweed",
    "Seafood",
    "Fish",
    "Meat",
    "Fruit",
    "Beverages"
  ),
  diet_variable_cols
)

diet_vars <- intersect(diet_vars, names(diet_meta))

if (length(social_vars) == 0) {
  stop("No social variables were found in social_village.")
}

if (length(diet_vars) == 0) {
  stop("No diet variables were found in diet_meta.")
}

target_vars <- c(social_vars, diet_vars)

var_label_map <- c(
  hall_attend_n = "Hall attendance",
  hall_gather_freq = "Hall gathering",
  hall_stability = "Hall stability",
  shared_meal_freq = "Shared meal",
  food_share_freq = "Food sharing",
  intervillage_freq = "Inter-village visit",
  intervillage_n = "Inter-village number",
  within_social_score = "Within-social score",
  food_sharing_score = "Food-sharing score",
  intervillage_score = "Inter-village score",
  Vegetables = "Vegetables",
  Namul = "Namul",
  Kimchi = "Kimchi",
  Mushrooms = "Mushrooms",
  Seaweed = "Seaweed",
  Seafood = "Seafood",
  Fish = "Fish",
  Meat = "Meat",
  Fruit = "Fruit",
  Beverages = "Beverages"
)

min_n_villages_cor <- 8

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Unify ASV subtype tables
#    - Uniform core excluded
# ---------------------------------------------------------
village_enriched_subtype_tbl <- asv_subtype_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    ASV_lab = if ("ASV_lab" %in% names(.)) as.character(ASV_lab) else as.character(ASV),
    asv_class = "Village-enriched",
    subtype_raw = as.character(subtype),
    subtype = case_when(
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "single") ~ "single",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "nearby") ~ "nearby",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "regional") ~ "regional",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

global_core_subtype_tbl <- global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
  transmute(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    ASV_lab = if ("ASV_lab" %in% names(.)) as.character(ASV_lab) else as.character(ASV),
    asv_class = "Global core",
    subtype_raw = as.character(subtype),
    subtype = case_when(
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "single") ~ "single",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "nearby") ~ "nearby",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype_raw), "regional") ~ "regional",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

sharing_asv_tbl <- bind_rows(
  global_core_subtype_tbl,
  village_enriched_subtype_tbl
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(subtype)) %>%
  mutate(
    asv_class = factor(asv_class, levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched")),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional"))
  ) %>%
  distinct(ASV, asv_class, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Optional label replacement
if (exists("asv_label_tbl") && all(c("ASV", "ASV_lab") %in% names(asv_label_tbl))) {
  sharing_asv_tbl <- sharing_asv_tbl %>%
    select(-ASV_lab) %>%
    left_join(
      asv_label_tbl %>%
        transmute(
          ASV = as.character(ASV),
          ASV_lab = as.character(ASV_lab)
        ) %>%
        distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = "ASV"
    )
}

sharing_asv_tbl <- sharing_asv_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_lab = ifelse(is.na(ASV_lab) | ASV_lab == "", ASV, ASV_lab)
  )

cat("\n===== Sharing-related ASVs used for subtype burden =====\n")
print(
  sharing_asv_tbl %>%
    count(asv_class, subtype, name = "n_asvs")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Village-cluster table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
village_cluster_tbl <- diet_meta %>%
  transmute(
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = as.character(1:4))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vil_id)) %>%
  distinct(vil_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Build village-level ASV prevalence table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_prev_long <- prev_vil_full %>%
  filter(ASV %in% sharing_asv_tbl$ASV) %>%
  transmute(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    prev = as.numeric(prev)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vil_id)) %>%
  distinct(ASV, vil_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  left_join(
    sharing_asv_tbl %>%
      select(ASV, ASV_lab, asv_class, subtype),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(village_cluster_tbl, by = "vil_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(asv_class), !is.na(subtype))

# Total ASVs per class-subtype group
asv_group_size_tbl <- sharing_asv_tbl %>%
  count(asv_class, subtype, name = "n_asvs_in_group")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Compute subtype burden per village
# ---------------------------------------------------------
burden_by_village <- asv_prev_long %>%
  group_by(vil_id, cluster, asv_class, subtype) %>%
  summarise(
    n_asvs_observed = n_distinct(ASV),
    mean_prev = mean(prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_prev = median(prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_prev = sum(prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    count_ge10 = sum(prev >= 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    count_ge20 = sum(prev >= 20, na.rm = TRUE),
    count_ge50 = sum(prev >= 50, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(asv_group_size_tbl, by = c("asv_class", "subtype")) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_ge10 = 100 * count_ge10 / n_asvs_in_group,
    pct_ge20 = 100 * count_ge20 / n_asvs_in_group,
    pct_ge50 = 100 * count_ge50 / n_asvs_in_group,
    burden_group = paste(asv_class, subtype, sep = " | "),
    burden_group = factor(
      burden_group,
      levels = c(
        "Global core | single",
        "Global core | nearby",
        "Global core | regional",
        "Village-enriched | single",
        "Village-enriched | nearby",
        "Village-enriched | regional"
      )
    )
  )

# Ensure all village x group combinations exist
all_village_group_tbl <- tidyr::crossing(
  vil_id = unique(village_cluster_tbl$vil_id),
  asv_class = factor(c("Global core", "Village-enriched"), levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched")),
  subtype = factor(c("single", "nearby", "regional"), levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional"))
) %>%
  left_join(village_cluster_tbl, by = "vil_id") %>%
  left_join(asv_group_size_tbl, by = c("asv_class", "subtype")) %>%
  mutate(
    burden_group = paste(asv_class, subtype, sep = " | "),
    burden_group = factor(
      burden_group,
      levels = c(
        "Global core | single",
        "Global core | nearby",
        "Global core | regional",
        "Village-enriched | single",
        "Village-enriched | nearby",
        "Village-enriched | regional"
      )
    )
  )

burden_by_village <- all_village_group_tbl %>%
  left_join(
    burden_by_village %>%
      select(
        vil_id,

      ),

    count_ge20 = replace_na(count_ge20, 0L),

    pct_ge10 = replace_na(pct_ge10, 0),
    pct_ge20 = replace_na(pct_ge20, 0),
    pct_ge50 = replace_na(pct_ge50, 0)
  )

cat("\n===== Subtype burden by village summary =====\n")
print(
```
