```{r}
    group_by(asv_class, subtype) %>%
    summarise(
      n_villages = n_distinct(vil_id),
      n_asvs_in_group = first(n_asvs_in_group),
      mean_mean_prev = mean(mean_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_count_ge20 = mean(count_ge20, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_pct_ge20 = mean(pct_ge20, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Build village-level social and diet variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
social_village_tbl <- social_village %>%
  transmute(
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    across(all_of(social_vars), as.numeric)
  ) %>%
  distinct(vil_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

social_long_tbl <- social_village_tbl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(social_vars),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = as.character(variable),
    variable_group = "Social questionnaire",
    variable_label = recode(variable, !!!var_label_map, .default = variable)
  )

diet_village_tbl <- diet_meta %>%
  mutate(vil_id = as.character(vil_id)) %>%
  group_by(vil_id) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(diet_vars), ~ mean(as.numeric(.x), na.rm = TRUE)),
    n_diet_samples = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

diet_long_tbl <- diet_village_tbl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(diet_vars),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = as.character(variable),
    variable_group = "Diet",
    variable_label = recode(variable, !!!var_label_map, .default = variable)
  )

village_variable_long_tbl <- bind_rows(
  social_long_tbl,
  diet_long_tbl
) %>%
  filter(is.finite(value)) %>%
  left_join(village_cluster_tbl, by = "vil_id")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Build burden-variable input long table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
burden_long <- burden_by_village %>%
  select(
    vil_id,
    cluster,
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    burden_group,
    n_asvs_in_group,
    mean_prev,
    count_ge20,
    pct_ge20
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_prev, count_ge20, pct_ge20),
    names_to = "burden_metric",
    values_to = "burden_value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    burden_metric = factor(
      burden_metric,
      levels = c("mean_prev", "count_ge20", "pct_ge20")
    )
  )

cor_input_burden_tbl <- burden_long %>%
  inner_join(
    village_variable_long_tbl %>%
      select(vil_id, variable, value, variable_group, variable_label),
    by = "vil_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(burden_value), is.finite(value))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Spearman correlation helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
run_burden_cor_one <- function(df, group_i, metric_i, var_i) {
  dat <- df %>%
    filter(
      burden_group == group_i,
      burden_metric == metric_i,
      variable == var_i
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(burden_value), is.finite(value))

  if (nrow(dat) < min_n_villages_cor) {
    return(tibble(
      burden_group = as.character(group_i),
      burden_metric = as.character(metric_i),
      variable = as.character(var_i),
      n_villages = nrow(dat),
      rho = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  if (n_distinct(dat$burden_value) < 2 || n_distinct(dat$value) < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      burden_group = as.character(group_i),
      burden_metric = as.character(metric_i),
      variable = as.character(var_i),
      n_villages = nrow(dat),
      rho = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  ct <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(
      dat$burden_value,
      dat$value,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  )

  tibble(
    burden_group = as.character(group_i),
    burden_metric = as.character(metric_i),
    variable = as.character(var_i),
    n_villages = nrow(dat),
    rho = unname(ct$estimate),
    p_value = ct$p.value
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Run correlations
# ---------------------------------------------------------
burden_groups <- levels(burden_by_village$burden_group)
burden_metrics <- c("mean_prev", "count_ge20", "pct_ge20")

burden_cor_tbl <- tidyr::crossing(
  burden_group = burden_groups,
  burden_metric = burden_metrics,
  variable = target_vars
) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    res = list(run_burden_cor_one(cor_input_burden_tbl, burden_group, burden_metric, variable))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(res) %>%
  unnest(res) %>%
  left_join(
    burden_by_village %>%
      distinct(burden_group, asv_class, subtype, n_asvs_in_group),
    by = "burden_group"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    village_variable_long_tbl %>%
      distinct(variable, variable_group, variable_label),
    by = "variable"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variable_group = ifelse(
      is.na(variable_group),
      ifelse(variable %in% social_vars, "Social questionnaire", "Diet"),
      variable_group
    ),
    variable_label = ifelse(
      is.na(variable_label) | variable_label == "",
      recode(variable, !!!var_label_map, .default = variable),
      variable_label
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(burden_metric, variable_group) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    sig_label_raw = case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~ "",
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    sig_label_fdr = case_when(
      is.na(p_adj_bh) ~ "",
      p_adj_bh < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj_bh < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_adj_bh < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    burden_metric_label = case_when(
      burden_metric == "mean_prev" ~ "Mean prevalence burden",
      burden_metric == "count_ge20" ~ "Count burden, prevalence >= 20%",
      burden_metric == "pct_ge20" ~ "Percent burden, prevalence >= 20%",
      TRUE ~ burden_metric
    )
  )

make_tile_legend <- function(pal, title, ncol = 1, text_size = 3.0, title_size = 10) {
  leg_df <- tibble(
    label = names(pal),
    idx = seq_along(label)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      col = ((idx - 1) %% ncol) + 1,
      row = ceiling(idx / ncol),
      row = max(row) - row + 1
    )

  ggplot(leg_df, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = label)) +
    geom_tile(width = 0.35, height = 0.35, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), nudge_x = 0.25, hjust = 0, size = text_size) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0.6, ncol + 3.2),
      ylim = c(0.4, max(leg_df$row) + 0.6),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14) Heatmap function
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_burden_heatmap <- function(metric_i = c("mean_prev", "count_ge20", "pct_ge20"),
                                star_col = c("sig_label_raw", "sig_label_fdr"),
                                label_type = c("rawP", "FDR")) {

  metric_i <- match.arg(metric_i)
  star_col <- match.arg(star_col)
  label_type <- match.arg(label_type)

  metric_title <- case_when(
    metric_i == "mean_prev" ~ "Mean prevalence burden",
    metric_i == "count_ge20" ~ "Count burden, prevalence >= 20%",
    metric_i == "pct_ge20" ~ "Percent burden, prevalence >= 20%",
    TRUE ~ metric_i
  )

  stat_title <- ifelse(label_type == "rawP", "Raw P-value version", "BH-FDR version")

  subtitle_txt <- if (label_type == "rawP") {
    "Rows indicate class-subtype burden scores across villages. Tile color indicates Spearman rho. Asterisks indicate raw P values: * < 0.05, ** < 0.01, *** < 0.001."
  } else {
    "Rows indicate class-subtype burden scores across villages. Tile color indicates Spearman rho. Asterisks indicate BH-FDR-adjusted P values: * < 0.05, ** < 0.01, *** < 0.001."
  }

  plot_df <- heat_df %>%
    filter(burden_metric == metric_i)

  p_title <- ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 1,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      label = paste0("Sharing subtype burden associated with village-level social and dietary features\n",
                     metric_title, " | ", stat_title),
      size = 5.0,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.22,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      label = subtitle_txt,
      size = 3.25,
      color = "grey30"
    ) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(2, 5.5, 2, 5.5))

  p_heat <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = variable, y = row_id, fill = rho)
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.20) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = .data[[star_col]]),
      size = 4.0,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#3C5488",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#BC3C29",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-1, 1),
      na.value = "grey90",
      name = "Spearman\nrho"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      limits = x_levels,
      labels = x_labels,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(
      drop = FALSE,
      labels = y_labels
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 5.5, 0)
    )

  p_spacer1 <- patchwork::plot_spacer()
  p_spacer2 <- patchwork::plot_spacer()
  p_spacer3 <- patchwork::plot_spacer()
  p_spacer4 <- patchwork::plot_spacer()

  p_heat_body <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    p_spacer1,
    p_spacer2,
    p_col_group_anno,
    p_spacer3,
    p_spacer4,
    p_col_item_anno,
    p_row_class,
    p_row_subtype,
    p_heat,
    ncol = 3
  ) +
    patchwork::plot_layout(
      widths = c(0.08, 0.08, 10),
      heights = c(0.16, 0.16, 10)
    )

  p_left_full <- p_title / p_heat_body +
    patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(0.55, 10))

  p_final <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    p_left_full,
    p_manual_legends,
    ncol = 2
  ) +
    patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(10, 1.9))

  print(p_final)

  file_stub <- paste0(
    "sharing_subtype_burden_",
    metric_i,
    "_heatmap_",
    label_type
  )

  save_plot_both(
    p_final,
    file.path(OUTDIR_BURDEN, "plots", file_stub),
    width = 17,
    height = 8.5
  )

  invisible(p_final)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 15) Save heatmaps
# ---------------------------------------------------------
for (metric_i in burden_metrics) {
  make_burden_heatmap(
    metric_i = metric_i,
    star_col = "sig_label_raw",
    label_type = "rawP"
  )

  make_burden_heatmap(
    metric_i = metric_i,
    star_col = "sig_label_fdr",
    label_type = "FDR"
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 16) Summary tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
burden_cor_summary_tbl <- burden_cor_tbl %>%
  group_by(burden_metric, variable_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tests = n(),
    n_tested = sum(!is.na(p_value)),
    n_raw_p_005 = sum(p_value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_raw_p_001 = sum(p_value < 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_fdr_005 = sum(p_adj_bh < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_abs_rho = max(abs(rho), na.rm = TRUE),
    median_abs_rho = median(abs(rho), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_abs_rho = ifelse(is.infinite(max_abs_rho), NA_real_, max_abs_rho)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 17) Save tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(
  burden_by_village,
  file.path(OUTDIR_BURDEN, "tables", "sharing_subtype_burden_by_village.csv")
)

write_csv(
  cor_input_burden_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_BURDEN, "tables", "sharing_subtype_burden_input_long.csv")
)

write_csv(
  burden_cor_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_BURDEN, "tables", "sharing_subtype_burden_correlation_results.csv")
)

write_csv(
  burden_cor_summary_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_BURDEN, "tables", "sharing_subtype_burden_correlation_summary.csv")
)

cat("\n===== Sharing subtype burden correlation analysis finished =====\n")
cat("Uniform core excluded.\n")
cat("No. burden groups:", length(burden_groups), "\n")
cat("No. variables:", length(target_vars), "\n")
cat("No. burden metrics:", length(burden_metrics), "\n")
cat("No. correlation tests:", nrow(burden_cor_tbl), "\n")
cat("No. raw P < 0.05 correlations:", sum(burden_cor_tbl$p_value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("No. FDR-significant correlations:", sum(burden_cor_tbl$p_adj_bh < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Output directory:", OUTDIR_BURDEN, "\n")

cat("\nSummary:\n")
print(burden_cor_summary_tbl)

cat("\nTop raw P associations:\n")
print(
  burden_cor_tbl %>%
    arrange(p_value) %>%
    select(
      burden_metric,
      burden_group,
      variable_group,
      variable_label,
      n_villages,
      rho,
      p_value,
      p_adj_bh
    ) %>%
    head(20)
)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Food microbiome exact ASV match analysis
# - sharing-related gut ASVs vs side-dish microbiome
#
# Input files:
#   1) sharing_asv.csv
#      Required: ASV, seq
#      Optional: label, type
#
#   2) rawdata_food_microbiome.csv
#      Required: seq
#      Optional: Taxon
#      Sample columns: SideDish_*
#
#   3) metadata_food_microbiome.csv
#      Required:
#        Variable ID, Dish_ID, Group, Korean name,
#        Full English name, Figure label, Plot label,
#        Category_1, Category_2
#
# Optional existing objects:
#   global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh
#   asv_subtype_tbl
#   cor_result_tbl
#
# Main figure:
#   Rows    = sharing-related gut ASVs
#   Columns = side-dish samples
#   Circle  = exact 16S ASV sequence match detected in side-dish sample
#
# Detection:
#   food_detection_cutoff = 0.001
#   Because food abundance values are 0-1 relative abundance scale,
#   0.001 corresponds to 0.1%.
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(forcats)
  library(stringi)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Files and output directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_meta_file <- "metadata_food_microbiome.csv"
food_raw_file  <- "rawdata_food_microbiome.csv"
sharing_file   <- "sharing_asv.csv"

stopifnot(file.exists(food_meta_file))
stopifnot(file.exists(food_raw_file))
stopifnot(file.exists(sharing_file))

OUTDIR_FOOD_MATCH <- "food_microbiome_sharing_asv_exact_match"
dir.create(OUTDIR_FOOD_MATCH, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_MATCH, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_MATCH, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0-1) Detection cutoff
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# rawdata_food_microbiome.csv is assumed to contain 0-1 relative abundance values.
# 0.001 = 0.1%.
food_detection_cutoff <- 0.001

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Theme and save helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("base_theme")) {
  base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey30"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )
}

if (!exists("save_plot_both")) {
  save_plot_both <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
      plot = plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = dpi,
      bg = bg,
      limitsize = FALSE
    )
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
      plot = plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      bg = bg,
      limitsize = FALSE
    )
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
clean_seq <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    str_to_upper() %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", "")
}

reverse_complement <- function(seq) {
  seq <- clean_seq(seq)
  comp <- chartr("ACGTURYKMSWBDHVN", "TGCAAYRMKSWVHDBN", seq)
  stringi::stri_reverse(comp)
}

safe_chr <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- ""
  x
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Load metadata_food_microbiome.csv
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_meta_raw <- read_csv(food_meta_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_trim(.x))

food_meta <- food_meta_raw %>%
  rename(
    Variable_ID = `Variable ID`,
    Korean_name = `Korean name`,
    Full_English_name = `Full English name`,
    Figure_label = `Figure label`,
    Plot_label = `Plot label`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable_ID = as.character(Variable_ID),
    Dish_ID = as.character(Dish_ID),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    Korean_name = as.character(Korean_name),
    Full_English_name = as.character(Full_English_name),
    Figure_label = as.character(Figure_label),
    Plot_label = as.character(Plot_label),
    Category_1 = as.character(Category_1),
    Category_2 = as.character(Category_2)
  )

required_meta_cols <- c(
  "Variable_ID",
  "Dish_ID",
  "Group",
  "Korean_name",
  "Full_English_name",
  "Figure_label",
  "Plot_label",
  "Category_1",
  "Category_2"
)

missing_meta_cols <- setdiff(required_meta_cols, names(food_meta))
if (length(missing_meta_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing columns in metadata_food_microbiome.csv: ", paste(missing_meta_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Load rawdata_food_microbiome.csv
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_raw <- read_csv(food_raw_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_trim(.x))

if (!"seq" %in% names(food_raw)) {
  stop("rawdata_food_microbiome.csv must contain a 'seq' column.")
}

if (!"Taxon" %in% names(food_raw)) {
  food_raw <- food_raw %>%
    mutate(Taxon = NA_character_, .before = 1)
}

food_sample_cols <- intersect(food_meta$Variable_ID, names(food_raw))

if (length(food_sample_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No sample columns in rawdata_food_microbiome.csv matched metadata_food_microbiome.csv$Variable_ID.")
}

food_asv_tbl <- food_raw %>%
  mutate(
    food_seq = clean_seq(seq),
    food_seq_rc = reverse_complement(food_seq),
    food_taxon = as.character(Taxon)
  ) %>%
  select(food_taxon, food_seq, food_seq_rc, all_of(food_sample_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(food_sample_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))))

# Quick abundance-scale check
food_abund_mat <- food_asv_tbl %>%
  select(all_of(food_sample_cols)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

food_abund_mat[] <- lapply(food_abund_mat, function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)))

food_abund_mat <- as.matrix(food_abund_mat)

food_abund_check <- tibble(
  min_value = min(food_abund_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_value = max(food_abund_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_colsum = median(colSums(food_abund_mat, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
)

cat("\n===== Food microbiome abundance scale check =====\n")
print(food_abund_check)
cat("Detection cutoff:", food_detection_cutoff, "(relative abundance; 0.001 = 0.1%)\n")

cat("\n===== Food microbiome abundance scale check =====\n")
print(food_abund_check)
cat("Detection cutoff:", food_detection_cutoff, "(relative abundance; 0.001 = 0.1%)\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Load sharing_asv.csv
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sharing_raw <- read_csv(sharing_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_trim(.x))

if (!all(c("ASV", "seq") %in% names(sharing_raw))) {
  stop("sharing_asv.csv must contain at least 'ASV' and 'seq' columns.")
}

if (!"label" %in% names(sharing_raw)) {
  sharing_raw <- sharing_raw %>% mutate(label = ASV)
}

if (!"type" %in% names(sharing_raw)) {
  sharing_raw <- sharing_raw %>% mutate(type = NA_character_)
}

sharing_asv <- sharing_raw %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    label = as.character(label),
    type = as.character(type),
    human_seq = clean_seq(seq),
    human_seq_rc = reverse_complement(human_seq),
    asv_class_from_file = case_when(
      str_detect(str_to_lower(type), "global") ~ "Global core",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(type), "village") ~ "Village-enriched",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    label,
    type,
    asv_class_from_file,
    human_seq,
    human_seq_rc
  ) %>%
  distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Optional: attach subtype/class annotation from existing objects
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtype_annot_list <- list()

if (exists("global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh")) {
  subtype_annot_list[["global_core"]] <- global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = as.character(ASV),
      asv_class_from_object = "Global core",
      subtype = as.character(subtype)
    )
}

if (exists("asv_subtype_tbl")) {
  subtype_annot_list[["village_enriched"]] <- asv_subtype_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = as.character(ASV),
      asv_class_from_object = "Village-enriched",
      subtype = as.character(subtype)
    )
}

if (length(subtype_annot_list) > 0) {
  subtype_annot <- bind_rows(subtype_annot_list) %>%
    mutate(
      subtype = case_when(
        str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype), "single") ~ "single",
        str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype), "nearby") ~ "nearby",
        str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype), "regional") ~ "regional",
        TRUE ~ subtype
      )
    ) %>%
    distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)

  sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
    left_join(subtype_annot, by = "ASV")
} else {
  sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
    mutate(
      asv_class_from_object = NA_character_,
      subtype = NA_character_
    )
}

sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
  mutate(
    asv_class = coalesce(asv_class_from_object, asv_class_from_file, "Unknown"),
    subtype = ifelse(is.na(subtype) | subtype == "", "Unknown", subtype),
    asv_class = factor(asv_class, levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched", "Unknown")),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional", "Unknown"))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Optional: attach ASV-diet correlation annotation
#    Expected cor_result_tbl columns:
#      ASV, variable_group, variable_label, rho, p_value, p_adj_bh
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_vars_order <- c(
  "Vegetables",
  "Namul",
  "Kimchi",
  "Mushrooms",
  "Seaweed",
  "Seafood",
  "Fish",
  "Meat",
  "Fruit",
  "Beverages"
)

# Settings for row annotation
diet_assoc_mode <- "FDR"                 # "FDR" or "rawP"
diet_assoc_p_cutoff <- 0.05
diet_assoc_direction_keep <- "positive" # "positive" or "both"

if (
  exists("cor_result_tbl") &&
  all(c("ASV", "variable_group", "variable_label", "rho", "p_value", "p_adj_bh") %in% names(cor_result_tbl))
) {

  diet_assoc_base <- cor_result_tbl %>%
    filter(
      ASV %in% sharing_asv$ASV,
      variable_group == "Diet",
      variable_label %in% diet_vars_order
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      sig_for_annotation = case_when(
        diet_assoc_mode == "FDR" ~ !is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_assoc_p_cutoff,
        diet_assoc_mode == "rawP" ~ !is.na(p_value) & p_value < diet_assoc_p_cutoff,
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      ),
      direction = case_when(
        rho > 0 ~ "Positive",
        rho < 0 ~ "Negative",
        TRUE ~ "No change"
      )
    )

  if (diet_assoc_direction_keep == "positive") {
    diet_assoc_base <- diet_assoc_base %>%
      filter(rho > 0)
  }

  diet_assoc_all_tbl <- diet_assoc_base %>%
    filter(sig_for_annotation) %>%
    arrange(ASV, p_adj_bh, p_value, desc(abs(rho))) %>%
    group_by(ASV) %>%
    summarise(
      n_diet_assoc = n(),
      diet_assoc_categories = paste(unique(variable_label), collapse = ";"),
      diet_assoc_directions = paste(unique(direction), collapse = ";"),
      top_diet_category = first(variable_label),
      top_diet_direction = first(direction),
      top_diet_rho = first(rho),
      top_diet_p = first(p_value),
      top_diet_fdr = first(p_adj_bh),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

} else {

  message("cor_result_tbl was not found or lacked required columns. Diet-association row annotation will be set to None.")

  diet_assoc_all_tbl <- tibble(
    ASV = sharing_asv$ASV,
    n_diet_assoc = 0L,
    diet_assoc_categories = "None",
    diet_assoc_directions = "None",
    top_diet_category = "None",
    top_diet_direction = "None",
    top_diet_rho = NA_real_,
    top_diet_p = NA_real_,
    top_diet_fdr = NA_real_
  )
}

sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
  left_join(diet_assoc_all_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    n_diet_assoc = replace_na(n_diet_assoc, 0L),
    diet_assoc_categories = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_categories) | diet_assoc_categories == "", "None", diet_assoc_categories),
    diet_assoc_directions = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_directions) | diet_assoc_directions == "", "None", diet_assoc_directions),
    top_diet_category = ifelse(is.na(top_diet_category) | top_diet_category == "", "None", top_diet_category),
    top_diet_direction = ifelse(is.na(top_diet_direction) | top_diet_direction == "", "None", top_diet_direction)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Exact sequence matching
#    Match both original and reverse-complement orientation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
match_direct <- food_asv_tbl %>%
  inner_join(
    sharing_asv,
    by = c("food_seq" = "human_seq")
  ) %>%
  mutate(match_orientation = "direct")

match_revcomp <- food_asv_tbl %>%
  inner_join(
    sharing_asv,
    by = c("food_seq" = "human_seq_rc")
  ) %>%
  mutate(match_orientation = "reverse_complement")

food_match_wide <- bind_rows(match_direct, match_revcomp) %>%
  distinct(ASV, food_seq, match_orientation, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("\n===== Exact sequence match summary =====\n")
cat("No. sharing-related ASVs:", n_distinct(sharing_asv$ASV), "\n")
cat("No. matched sharing-related ASVs by sequence:", n_distinct(food_match_wide$ASV), "\n")
cat("No. matched food ASV sequences:", n_distinct(food_match_wide$food_seq), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Long detected table and full ASV x food sample grid
#    Detection cutoff applied here: abundance >= food_detection_cutoff
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (nrow(food_match_wide) > 0) {

  food_match_long <- food_match_wide %>%
    select(
      ASV,
      label,
      type,
      asv_class,
      subtype,
      n_diet_assoc,
      top_diet_category,
      top_diet_direction,
      diet_assoc_categories,
      diet_assoc_directions,
      top_diet_rho,
      top_diet_p,
      top_diet_fdr,
      food_taxon,
      food_seq,
      match_orientation,
      all_of(food_sample_cols)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(food_sample_cols),
      names_to = "Variable_ID",
      values_to = "abundance"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      abundance = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(abundance)),
      detected = !is.na(abundance) & abundance >= food_detection_cutoff
    ) %>%
    left_join(food_meta, by = "Variable_ID")

} else {

  food_match_long <- tibble(
    ASV = character(),
    label = character(),
    type = character(),
    asv_class = factor(levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched", "Unknown")),
    subtype = factor(levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional", "Unknown")),
    n_diet_assoc = integer(),
    top_diet_category = character(),
    top_diet_direction = character(),
    diet_assoc_categories = character(),
    diet_assoc_directions = character(),
    top_diet_rho = numeric(),
    top_diet_p = numeric(),
    top_diet_fdr = numeric(),
    food_taxon = character(),
    food_seq = character(),
    match_orientation = character(),
    Variable_ID = character(),
    abundance = numeric(),
    detected = logical()
  )
}

plot_grid_tbl <- tidyr::crossing(
  ASV = sharing_asv$ASV,
  Variable_ID = food_meta$Variable_ID
) %>%
  left_join(
    sharing_asv %>%
      select(
        ASV,
        label,
        type,
        asv_class,
        subtype,
        n_diet_assoc,
        top_diet_category,
        top_diet_direction,
        diet_assoc_categories,
        diet_assoc_directions,
        top_diet_rho,
        top_diet_p,
        top_diet_fdr
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(food_meta, by = "Variable_ID") %>%
  left_join(
    food_match_long %>%
      filter(detected) %>%
      group_by(ASV, Variable_ID) %>%
      summarise(
        detected = TRUE,
        n_matched_food_seq = n_distinct(food_seq),
        food_taxon = paste(unique(na.omit(food_taxon)), collapse = ";"),
        match_orientation = paste(unique(match_orientation), collapse = ";"),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("ASV", "Variable_ID")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    detected = replace_na(detected, FALSE),
    n_matched_food_seq = replace_na(n_matched_food_seq, 0L),
    n_diet_assoc = replace_na(n_diet_assoc, 0L),
    top_diet_category = ifelse(is.na(top_diet_category) | top_diet_category == "", "None", top_diet_category),
    top_diet_direction = ifelse(is.na(top_diet_direction) | top_diet_direction == "", "None", top_diet_direction),
    diet_assoc_categories = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_categories) | diet_assoc_categories == "", "None", diet_assoc_categories),
    diet_assoc_directions = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_directions) | diet_assoc_directions == "", "None", diet_assoc_directions)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Concordance classification
#    Concordant if any diet-associated category matches Category_1 or Category_2
# ---------------------------------------------------------
concordance_tbl <- plot_grid_tbl %>%
  filter(detected) %>%
  mutate(
    n_diet_assoc = replace_na(n_diet_assoc, 0L),
    diet_assoc_categories = ifelse(
      is.na(diet_assoc_categories) | diet_assoc_categories == "",
      "None",
      diet_assoc_categories
    ),
    diet_assoc_list = str_split(diet_assoc_categories, ";"),
    category_list = Map(c, Category_1, Category_2),
    category_concordant = mapply(
      function(diet_vec, cat_vec) {
        diet_vec <- diet_vec[!is.na(diet_vec) & diet_vec != "" & diet_vec != "None"]
        cat_vec <- cat_vec[!is.na(cat_vec) & cat_vec != "" & cat_vec != "None"]
        length(intersect(diet_vec, cat_vec)) > 0
      },
      diet_assoc_list,
      category_list
    ),
    concordance_status = case_when(
      n_diet_assoc == 0 ~ "Food-detected only",
      category_concordant ~ "Concordant",
      !category_concordant ~ "Discordant",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    label,
    type,
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    n_diet_assoc,
    top_diet_category,
    diet_assoc_categories,
    top_diet_direction,
    top_diet_rho,
    top_diet_p,
    top_diet_fdr,
    Variable_ID,
    Dish_ID,
    Group,
    Korean_name,
    Figure_label,
    Plot_label,
    Category_1,
    Category_2,
    detected,
    n_matched_food_seq,
    category_concordant,
    concordance_status
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Summary tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_match_summary_tbl <- plot_grid_tbl %>%
  group_by(
    ASV,
    label,
    type,
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    n_diet_assoc,
    top_diet_category,
    top_diet_direction,
    diet_assoc_categories,
    diet_assoc_directions
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    detected_in_any_food = any(detected),
    n_detected_samples = sum(detected),
    n_detected_dishes = n_distinct(Dish_ID[detected]),
    detected_categories_1 = paste(sort(unique(Category_1[detected])), collapse = ";"),
    detected_categories_2 = paste(sort(unique(Category_2[detected])), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    concordance_tbl %>%
      group_by(ASV) %>%
      summarise(
        any_concordant = any(concordance_status == "Concordant"),
        n_concordant_samples = sum(concordance_status == "Concordant"),
        n_discordant_samples = sum(concordance_status == "Discordant"),
        n_food_detected_only_samples = sum(concordance_status == "Food-detected only"),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    any_concordant = replace_na(any_concordant, FALSE),
    n_concordant_samples = replace_na(n_concordant_samples, 0L),
    n_discordant_samples = replace_na(n_discordant_samples, 0L),
    n_food_detected_only_samples = replace_na(n_food_detected_only_samples, 0L)
  )

dish_match_summary_tbl <- plot_grid_tbl %>%
  group_by(
    Variable_ID,
    Dish_ID,
    Group,
    Korean_name,
    Full_English_name,
    Figure_label,
    Plot_label,
    Category_1,
    Category_2
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_matched_asvs = n_distinct(ASV[detected]),
    matched_asvs = paste(sort(unique(ASV[detected])), collapse = ";"),
    n_global_core = n_distinct(ASV[detected & asv_class == "Global core"]),
    n_village_enriched = n_distinct(ASV[detected & asv_class == "Village-enriched"]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

concordance_summary_tbl <- concordance_tbl %>%
  count(concordance_status, name = "n_detected_asv_sample_pairs") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_detected_asv_sample_pairs))

category_concordance_tbl <- concordance_tbl %>%
  count(Category_1, concordance_status, name = "n_detected_asv_sample_pairs") %>%
  arrange(Category_1, concordance_status)

asv_concordance_class_tbl <- asv_match_summary_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    asv_concordance_class = case_when(
      any_concordant ~ "Concordant food match",
      detected_in_any_food & n_diet_assoc > 0 & !any_concordant ~ "Discordant food match",
      detected_in_any_food & n_diet_assoc == 0 ~ "Food-detected only",
      !detected_in_any_food & n_diet_assoc > 0 ~ "Diet-associated only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither detected nor diet-associated"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(asv_class, subtype, asv_concordance_class, name = "n_asvs")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Plot ordering
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_col_order <- food_meta %>%
  mutate(
    Category_1 = factor(Category_1, levels = diet_vars_order),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Control", "Fermented"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Category_1, Category_2, Dish_ID, Group, Variable_ID) %>%
  pull(Variable_ID)

row_order_tbl <- asv_match_summary_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    detected_rank = ifelse(detected_in_any_food, 0, 1),
    asv_class = factor(asv_class, levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched", "Unknown")),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional", "Unknown")),

    # Internal row_id remains unique by including ASV.
    row_id = paste0(row_label, "__", ASV)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    detected_rank,
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    top_diet_category,
    desc(n_detected_samples),
    ASV
  )

make_tile_legend <- function(pal, title, ncol = 1, text_size = 3.0, title_size = 10) {
  pal <- pal[!is.na(names(pal))]
  if (length(pal) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  }

  leg_df <- tibble(
    label = names(pal),
    idx = seq_along(label)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      col = ((idx - 1) %% ncol) + 1,
      row = ceiling(idx / ncol),
      row = max(row) - row + 1
    )

  ggplot(leg_df, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = label)) +
    geom_tile(width = 0.35, height = 0.35, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), nudge_x = 0.25, hjust = 0, size = text_size) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0.6, ncol + 3.8),
      ylim = c(0.4, max(leg_df$row) + 0.6),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}

p_leg_dir <- make_tile_legend(direction_cols, "Direction", text_size = 2.8)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Informative-only food exact match matrix
# - Run this chunk after the full-scale exact match code
#
# Rows included:
#   1) Food exact match detected above cutoff
#      OR
#   2) Diet-associated ASV
#
# Excluded:
#   ASVs with neither food detection nor diet association
#
# Left annotation strips are kept identical to the full-scale figure:
#   Class | Subtype | Diet assoc. | Direction
#
# Required objects from previous full-scale code:
#   asv_match_summary_tbl
#   plot_grid_tbl
#   food_meta
#   food_detection_cutoff
#   OUTDIR_FOOD_MATCH
#   diet_vars_order
#   base_theme
#   save_plot_both()
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(forcats)
  library(readr)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs <- c(
  "asv_match_summary_tbl",
  "plot_grid_tbl",
  "food_meta",
  "food_detection_cutoff",
  "OUTDIR_FOOD_MATCH",
  "diet_vars_order",
  "base_theme",
  "save_plot_both"
)

miss <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss) > 0) {
  stop("Required objects are missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_MATCH, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_MATCH, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Select informative ASVs
#    Include ASVs that are either:
#      - detected in at least one food sample above cutoff
#      - associated with at least one diet variable
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_asv_ids_informative <- asv_match_summary_tbl %>%
  filter(
    detected_in_any_food | n_diet_assoc > 0
  ) %>%
  pull(ASV) %>%
  unique()

if (length(plot_asv_ids_informative) == 0) {
  stop("No informative ASVs were found: no food-detected ASVs and no diet-associated ASVs.")
}

cat("\n===== Informative-only ASV selection =====\n")
cat("No. ASVs in full set:", n_distinct(asv_match_summary_tbl$ASV), "\n")
cat("No. informative ASVs:", length(plot_asv_ids_informative), "\n")
cat(
  " - Food-detected:",
  sum(
    asv_match_summary_tbl$ASV %in% plot_asv_ids_informative &
      asv_match_summary_tbl$detected_in_any_food
  ),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  " - Diet-associated:",
  sum(
    asv_match_summary_tbl$ASV %in% plot_asv_ids_informative &
      asv_match_summary_tbl$n_diet_assoc > 0
  ),
  "\n"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Column and row ordering
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_col_order_info <- food_meta %>%
  mutate(
    Category_1 = factor(Category_1, levels = diet_vars_order),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Control", "Fermented"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Category_1, Category_2, Dish_ID, Group, Variable_ID) %>%
  pull(Variable_ID)

row_order_tbl_info <- asv_match_summary_tbl %>%
  filter(ASV %in% plot_asv_ids_informative) %>%
  mutate(
    food_diet_status = case_when(
      detected_in_any_food & n_diet_assoc > 0 ~ "Food-detected + diet-associated",
      detected_in_any_food & n_diet_assoc == 0 ~ "Food-detected only",
      !detected_in_any_food & n_diet_assoc > 0 ~ "Diet-associated only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    food_diet_status = factor(
      food_diet_status,
      levels = c(
        "Food-detected + diet-associated",
        "Food-detected only",
        "Diet-associated only",
        "Neither"
      )
    ),
    asv_class = factor(asv_class, levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched", "Unknown")),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional", "Unknown")),
    top_diet_category = factor(top_diet_category, levels = c(diet_vars_order, "None", "Multiple")),

    # Display only label on y-axis to avoid "ASV | ASV" duplication.
    row_label = ifelse(is.na(label) | label == "", ASV, label),

    # Internal row_id remains unique.
    row_id = paste0(row_label, "__", ASV)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    food_diet_status,
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    top_diet_category,
    desc(n_detected_samples),
    ASV
  )

row_levels_info <- rev(row_order_tbl_info$row_id)
row_labels_info <- setNames(row_order_tbl_info$row_label, row_order_tbl_info$row_id)

plot_df_info <- plot_grid_tbl %>%
  filter(ASV %in% plot_asv_ids_informative) %>%
  left_join(
    row_order_tbl_info %>%
      select(ASV, row_id, row_label, food_diet_status),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable_ID = factor(Variable_ID, levels = food_col_order_info),
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = row_levels_info)
  )

col_meta_plot_info <- food_meta %>%

    Category_1 = factor(Category_1, levels = diet_vars_order),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Control", "Fermented"))
  ) %>%
  filter(Variable_ID %in% food_col_order_info)

row_anno_plot_info <- row_order_tbl_info %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = row_levels_info),
    asv_class = factor(asv_class, levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched", "Unknown")),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional", "Unknown")),
    top_diet_category = factor(as.character(top_diet_category), levels = c(diet_vars_order, "None", "Multiple")),
    top_diet_direction = factor(top_diet_direction, levels = c("Positive", "Negative", "None"))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------

category_cols_use <- category_cols[
  names(category_cols) %in% unique(c(

    "None"
  ))
]

# Show all diet categories in the legend, even if not selected as top category.
diet_assoc_cols_use <- diet_assoc_cols[

]

# ---------------------------------------------------------

p_col_group_info <- ggplot(

) +

p_col_cat2_info <- ggplot(

) +

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Row annotations
#    Keep identical strip composition to full-scale figure:
#    Class | Subtype | Diet assoc. | Direction
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_row_class_info <- ggplot(

p_row_diet_info <- ggplot(

) +

p_row_dir_info <- ggplot(

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Main exact match matrix

p_match_matrix_info <- ggplot(plot_df_info, aes(x = Variable_ID, y = row_id)) +
  geom_tile(fill = "white", color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.18) +

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Legends
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_tile_legend <- function(pal, title, ncol = 1, text_size = 3.0, title_size = 10) {
  pal <- pal[!is.na(names(pal))]
  if (length(pal) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  }

  leg_df <- tibble(
    label = names(pal),
    idx = seq_along(label)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      col = ((idx - 1) %% ncol) + 1,
      row = ceiling(idx / ncol),
      row = max(row) - row + 1
    )

  ggplot(leg_df, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = label)) +
    geom_tile(width = 0.35, height = 0.35, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), nudge_x = 0.25, hjust = 0, size = text_size) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0.6, ncol + 4.5),
      ylim = c(0.4, max(leg_df$row) + 0.6),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}

p_leg_detect_info <- ggplot() +
  annotate(

  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))

p_leg_class_info <- make_tile_legend(class_cols, "ASV class", text_size = 2.8)
p_leg_subtype_info <- make_tile_legend(subtype_cols, "Subtype", text_size = 2.8)
p_leg_diet_info <- make_tile_legend(diet_assoc_cols_use, "Diet association", text_size = 2.5)

p_leg_cat_info <- make_tile_legend(category_cols_use, "Food category", text_size = 2.5)

p_legends_info <- wrap_plots(

  p_leg_diet_info,

  ncol = 1
) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.9, 1.0, 1.0, 3.0, 0.9, 0.9, 3.0))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Combine figure
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_title_info <- ggplot() +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0,
    y = 1,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    label = "Food-detected or diet-associated sharing-related ASVs in side-dish microbiota",
    size = 5.3,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0,
    y = 0.25,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    label = paste0(
      "Rows include ASVs with an exact side-dish sequence match or a diet association. ",
      "Open circles indicate exact 16S ASV sequence matches detected in side-dish microbiota ",
      "at relative abundance ≥ ", food_detection_cutoff, " (0.1%)."
    ),
    size = 3.35,
    color = "grey30"
  ) +
  xlim(0, 1) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(2, 5.5, 2, 5.5))

p_top_anno_info <- p_col_group_info / p_col_cat1_info / p_col_cat2_info +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1))

p_left_anno_info <- p_row_class_info |
  p_row_subtype_info |
  p_row_diet_info |
  p_row_dir_info

p_body_info <- wrap_plots(
  plot_spacer(),
  p_top_anno_info,
  p_left_anno_info,
  p_match_matrix_info,
  ncol = 2
) +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(0.55, 10),
    heights = c(0.32, 10)
  )

p_left_full_info <- p_title_info / p_body_info +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.55, 10))

p_final_info <- wrap_plots(
  p_left_full_info,
  p_legends_info,
  ncol = 2
) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(10, 1.9))

print(p_final_info)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Save figure and source table
#    File names are unchanged, so previous informative-only outputs are overwritten.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_height_info <- max(8, 0.13 * nrow(row_order_tbl_info) + 3)
plot_width_info <- max(14, 0.18 * length(food_col_order_info) + 8)

save_plot_both(
  p_final_info,
  file.path(
    OUTDIR_FOOD_MATCH,
    "plots",
    "food_exact_match_or_diet_associated_ASVs_matrix_cutoff0p1pct"
  ),
  width = plot_width_info,
  height = plot_height_info
)

write_csv(
  row_order_tbl_info,
  file.path(
    OUTDIR_FOOD_MATCH,
    "tables",
    "food_exact_match_or_diet_associated_ASVs_row_annotation.csv"

)

write_csv(
```
