```{r}
  file.path(
    OUTDIR_FOOD_MATCH,
    "tables",
    "food_exact_match_or_diet_associated_ASVs_matrix_long.csv"
  )
)

cat("\n===== Informative-only matrix saved =====\n")
cat("Rows plotted:", nrow(row_order_tbl_info), "\n")
cat("Detected ASVs among plotted rows:", sum(row_order_tbl_info$detected_in_any_food), "\n")
cat("Diet-associated ASVs among plotted rows:", sum(row_order_tbl_info$n_diet_assoc > 0), "\n")
cat("Output figure overwritten:\n")
cat("- food_exact_match_or_diet_associated_ASVs_matrix_cutoff0p1pct.png/.svg\n")
```

#반찬 ver2
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Simplified food microbiome exact-match + concordance analysis
#
# Inputs:
#   metadata_food_microbiome.csv
#   rawdata_food_microbiome.csv
#   sharing_asv.csv
#
# Optional existing objects:
#   global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh
#   asv_subtype_tbl
#   cor_result_tbl
#
# Outputs:
#   food_microbiome_exact_match_simplified_v2/
#     tables/
#     plots/
#
# Main figures:
#   A. Exact match matrix
#      - rows: ASVs with food detection OR diet association
#      - left strips: ASV class + subtype + diet-associated status
#      - top strips: Group + Category_1
#      - dots: exact sequence match detected at RA >= 0.001
#      - row order: Global core -> Village-enriched -> Unknown
#                   within each class: single -> nearby -> regional -> Unknown
#
#   B. ASV-level food-diet concordance summary
#      - whole ASV-level concordance status bar
#      - Category_1 and Category_2 are both used for concordance
#
#   C. Diet category x food category heatmap
#      - food category uses both Category_1 and Category_2
#      - unique ASV count per diet_category x food_category cell
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(forcats)
  library(stringi)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_meta_file <- "metadata_food_microbiome.csv"
food_raw_file  <- "rawdata_food_microbiome.csv"
sharing_file   <- "sharing_asv.csv"

stopifnot(file.exists(food_meta_file))
stopifnot(file.exists(food_raw_file))
stopifnot(file.exists(sharing_file))

# Same output directory as previous v2 version
OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE <- "food_microbiome_exact_match_simplified_v2"
dir.create(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Food abundance is 0-1 relative abundance.
# 0.001 = 0.1%.
food_detection_cutoff <- 0.001

# Diet association criterion.
# Use "FDR" for p_adj_bh < 0.05, or "rawP" for p_value < 0.05.
diet_assoc_mode <- "FDR"
diet_assoc_p_cutoff <- 0.05

# Usually positive diet associations are most interpretable for exposure.
# Use "positive" or "both".
diet_assoc_direction_keep <- "positive"

# Figure A row mode:
# informative = food-detected OR diet-associated
matrix_row_mode <- "informative"

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
clean_seq <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    str_to_upper() %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", "")
}

reverse_complement <- function(seq) {
  seq <- clean_seq(seq)
  comp <- chartr("ACGTURYKMSWBDHVN", "TGCAAYRMKSWVHDBN", seq)
  stringi::stri_reverse(comp)
}

save_plot_both_simple <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

expand_palette <- function(pal, observed_levels) {
  observed_levels <- observed_levels[!is.na(observed_levels) & observed_levels != ""]
  extra_levels <- setdiff(observed_levels, names(pal))
  if (length(extra_levels) > 0) {
    extra_cols <- scales::hue_pal()(length(extra_levels))
    names(extra_cols) <- extra_levels
    pal <- c(pal, extra_cols)
  }
  pal
}

clean_display_label <- function(label, ASV) {
  label <- as.character(label)
  ASV <- as.character(ASV)
  label[is.na(label) | label == ""] <- ASV[is.na(label) | label == ""]
  
  out <- mapply(function(lab, asv) {
    lab2 <- str_replace(lab, paste0("\\s*\\|\\s*", asv, "$"), "")
    if (is.na(lab2) || lab2 == "") asv else lab2
  }, label, ASV, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  
  as.character(out)
}

split_semicolon <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- "None"
  str_split(x, ";")
}

base_theme_simple <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Load food metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_meta_raw <- read_csv(food_meta_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_trim(.x)) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_replace_all(.x, "\\s+", "_"))

required_meta_cols <- c(
  "Variable_ID",
  "Dish_ID",
  "Group",
  "Korean_name",
  "Full_English_name",
  "Figure_label",
  "Plot_label",
  "Category_1",
  "Category_2"
)

missing_meta_cols <- setdiff(required_meta_cols, names(food_meta_raw))
if (length(missing_meta_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing columns in metadata_food_microbiome.csv after name standardization: ",
    paste(missing_meta_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

food_meta <- food_meta_raw %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(required_meta_cols), as.character),
    Category_1 = ifelse(is.na(Category_1) | Category_1 == "", "None", Category_1),
    Category_2 = ifelse(is.na(Category_2) | Category_2 == "", "None", Category_2)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Load food microbiome table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_raw <- read_csv(food_raw_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_trim(.x))

if (!"seq" %in% names(food_raw)) {
  stop("rawdata_food_microbiome.csv must contain a 'seq' column.")
}

if (!"Taxon" %in% names(food_raw)) {
  food_raw <- food_raw %>%
    mutate(Taxon = NA_character_, .before = 1)
}

food_sample_cols <- intersect(food_meta$Variable_ID, names(food_raw))

if (length(food_sample_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No sample columns in rawdata_food_microbiome.csv matched metadata_food_microbiome.csv$Variable_ID.")
}

food_asv_tbl <- food_raw %>%
  mutate(
    food_taxon = as.character(Taxon),
    food_seq = clean_seq(seq),
    food_seq_rc = reverse_complement(food_seq)
  ) %>%
  select(food_taxon, food_seq, food_seq_rc, all_of(food_sample_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(food_sample_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))))

# Abundance-scale check
food_abund_mat <- food_asv_tbl %>%
  select(all_of(food_sample_cols)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

food_abund_mat[] <- lapply(food_abund_mat, function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)))
food_abund_mat <- as.matrix(food_abund_mat)

food_abund_check <- tibble(
  min_value = min(food_abund_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_value = max(food_abund_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_colsum = median(colSums(food_abund_mat, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
)

cat("\n===== Food microbiome abundance scale check =====\n")
print(food_abund_check)
cat("Detection cutoff:", food_detection_cutoff, "(0.001 = 0.1% relative abundance)\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Load sharing ASV table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sharing_raw <- read_csv(sharing_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_trim(.x))

if (!all(c("ASV", "seq") %in% names(sharing_raw))) {
  stop("sharing_asv.csv must contain at least 'ASV' and 'seq' columns.")
}

if (!"label" %in% names(sharing_raw)) {
  sharing_raw <- sharing_raw %>% mutate(label = ASV)
}

if (!"type" %in% names(sharing_raw)) {
  sharing_raw <- sharing_raw %>% mutate(type = NA_character_)
}

sharing_asv <- sharing_raw %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    label = as.character(label),
    type = as.character(type),
    human_seq = clean_seq(seq),
    human_seq_rc = reverse_complement(human_seq),
    asv_class_from_file = case_when(
      str_detect(str_to_lower(type), "global") ~ "Global core",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(type), "village") ~ "Village-enriched",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    label,
    type,
    asv_class_from_file,
    human_seq,
    human_seq_rc
  ) %>%
  distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Optional subtype annotation from existing objects
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtype_annot_list <- list()

if (exists("global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh")) {
  subtype_annot_list[["global_core"]] <- global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = as.character(ASV),
      asv_class_from_object = "Global core",
      subtype = as.character(subtype)
    )
}

if (exists("asv_subtype_tbl")) {
  subtype_annot_list[["village_enriched"]] <- asv_subtype_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = as.character(ASV),
      asv_class_from_object = "Village-enriched",
      subtype = as.character(subtype)
    )
}

if (length(subtype_annot_list) > 0) {
  subtype_annot <- bind_rows(subtype_annot_list) %>%
    mutate(
      subtype = case_when(
        str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype), "single") ~ "single",
        str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype), "nearby") ~ "nearby",
        str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype), "regional") ~ "regional",
        TRUE ~ subtype
      )
    ) %>%
    distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
    left_join(subtype_annot, by = "ASV")
} else {
  sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
    mutate(
      asv_class_from_object = NA_character_,
      subtype = NA_character_
    )
}

sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
  mutate(
    asv_class = coalesce(asv_class_from_object, asv_class_from_file, "Unknown"),
    subtype = ifelse(is.na(subtype) | subtype == "", "Unknown", subtype),
    asv_class = factor(asv_class, levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched", "Unknown")),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional", "Unknown"))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Optional diet association annotation from cor_result_tbl
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_vars_order <- c(
  "Vegetables",
  "Namul",
  "Kimchi",
  "Mushrooms",
  "Seaweed",
  "Seafood",
  "Fish",
  "Meat",
  "Fruit",
  "Beverages"
)

if (
  exists("cor_result_tbl") &&
  all(c("ASV", "variable_group", "variable_label", "rho", "p_value", "p_adj_bh") %in% names(cor_result_tbl))
) {
  
  diet_assoc_base <- cor_result_tbl %>%
    filter(
      ASV %in% sharing_asv$ASV,
      variable_group == "Diet",
      variable_label %in% diet_vars_order
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      sig_for_annotation = case_when(
        diet_assoc_mode == "FDR" ~ !is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_assoc_p_cutoff,
        diet_assoc_mode == "rawP" ~ !is.na(p_value) & p_value < diet_assoc_p_cutoff,
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      ),
      direction = case_when(
        rho > 0 ~ "Positive",
        rho < 0 ~ "Negative",
        TRUE ~ "No change"
      )
    )
  
  if (diet_assoc_direction_keep == "positive") {
    diet_assoc_base <- diet_assoc_base %>%
      filter(rho > 0)
  }
  
  diet_assoc_all_tbl <- diet_assoc_base %>%
    filter(sig_for_annotation) %>%
    arrange(ASV, p_adj_bh, p_value, desc(abs(rho))) %>%
    group_by(ASV) %>%
    summarise(
      n_diet_assoc = n(),
      diet_assoc_categories = paste(unique(variable_label), collapse = ";"),
      diet_assoc_directions = paste(unique(direction), collapse = ";"),
      top_diet_category = first(variable_label),
      top_diet_direction = first(direction),
      top_diet_rho = first(rho),
      top_diet_p = first(p_value),
      top_diet_fdr = first(p_adj_bh),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
} else {
  
  message(
    "cor_result_tbl was not found or lacked required columns. ",
    "Diet-association and concordance summaries will treat all ASVs as non-diet-associated."
  )
  
  diet_assoc_all_tbl <- tibble(
    ASV = sharing_asv$ASV,
    n_diet_assoc = 0L,
    diet_assoc_categories = "None",
    diet_assoc_directions = "None",
    top_diet_category = "None",
    top_diet_direction = "None",
    top_diet_rho = NA_real_,
    top_diet_p = NA_real_,
    top_diet_fdr = NA_real_
  )
}

sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
  left_join(diet_assoc_all_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    n_diet_assoc = replace_na(n_diet_assoc, 0L),
    diet_assoc_categories = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_categories) | diet_assoc_categories == "", "None", diet_assoc_categories),
    diet_assoc_directions = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_directions) | diet_assoc_directions == "", "None", diet_assoc_directions),
    top_diet_category = ifelse(is.na(top_diet_category) | top_diet_category == "", "None", top_diet_category),
    top_diet_direction = ifelse(is.na(top_diet_direction) | top_diet_direction == "", "None", top_diet_direction)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Exact sequence matching
# ---------------------------------------------------------
match_direct <- food_asv_tbl %>%
  inner_join(
    sharing_asv,
    by = c("food_seq" = "human_seq")
  ) %>%
  mutate(match_orientation = "direct")

match_revcomp <- food_asv_tbl %>%
  inner_join(
    sharing_asv,
    by = c("food_seq" = "human_seq_rc")
  ) %>%
  mutate(match_orientation = "reverse_complement")

food_match_wide <- bind_rows(match_direct, match_revcomp) %>%
  distinct(ASV, food_seq, match_orientation, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("\n===== Exact sequence match summary =====\n")
cat("No. sharing-related ASVs:", n_distinct(sharing_asv$ASV), "\n")
cat("No. matched sharing-related ASVs by sequence:", n_distinct(food_match_wide$ASV), "\n")
cat("No. matched food ASV sequences:", n_distinct(food_match_wide$food_seq), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Long detected table and full ASV x food sample grid
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (nrow(food_match_wide) > 0) {
  
  food_match_long <- food_match_wide %>%
    select(
      ASV,
      label,
      type,
      asv_class,
      subtype,
      n_diet_assoc,
      top_diet_category,
      top_diet_direction,
      diet_assoc_categories,
      diet_assoc_directions,
      top_diet_rho,
      top_diet_p,
      top_diet_fdr,
      food_taxon,
      food_seq,
      match_orientation,
      all_of(food_sample_cols)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(food_sample_cols),
      names_to = "Variable_ID",
      values_to = "abundance"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      abundance = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(abundance)),
      detected = !is.na(abundance) & abundance >= food_detection_cutoff
    ) %>%
    left_join(food_meta, by = "Variable_ID")
  
} else {
  
  food_match_long <- tibble(
    ASV = character(),
    label = character(),
    type = character(),
    asv_class = factor(levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched", "Unknown")),
    subtype = factor(levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional", "Unknown")),
    n_diet_assoc = integer(),
    top_diet_category = character(),
    top_diet_direction = character(),
    diet_assoc_categories = character(),
    diet_assoc_directions = character(),
    top_diet_rho = numeric(),
    top_diet_p = numeric(),
    top_diet_fdr = numeric(),
    food_taxon = character(),
    food_seq = character(),
    match_orientation = character(),
    Variable_ID = character(),
    abundance = numeric(),
    detected = logical()
  )
}

plot_grid_tbl <- tidyr::crossing(
  ASV = sharing_asv$ASV,
  Variable_ID = food_meta$Variable_ID
) %>%
  left_join(
    sharing_asv %>%
      select(
        ASV,
        label,
        type,
        asv_class,
        subtype,
        n_diet_assoc,
        top_diet_category,
        top_diet_direction,
        diet_assoc_categories,
        diet_assoc_directions,
        top_diet_rho,
        top_diet_p,
        top_diet_fdr
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(food_meta, by = "Variable_ID") %>%
  left_join(
    food_match_long %>%
      filter(detected) %>%
      group_by(ASV, Variable_ID) %>%
      summarise(
        detected = TRUE,
        n_matched_food_seq = n_distinct(food_seq),
        food_taxon = paste(unique(na.omit(food_taxon)), collapse = ";"),
        match_orientation = paste(unique(match_orientation), collapse = ";"),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("ASV", "Variable_ID")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    detected = replace_na(detected, FALSE),
    n_matched_food_seq = replace_na(n_matched_food_seq, 0L),
    n_diet_assoc = replace_na(n_diet_assoc, 0L),
    top_diet_category = ifelse(is.na(top_diet_category) | top_diet_category == "", "None", top_diet_category),
    top_diet_direction = ifelse(is.na(top_diet_direction) | top_diet_direction == "", "None", top_diet_direction),
    diet_assoc_categories = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_categories) | diet_assoc_categories == "", "None", diet_assoc_categories),
    diet_assoc_directions = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_directions) | diet_assoc_directions == "", "None", diet_assoc_directions)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) ASV-level summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_match_summary_tbl <- plot_grid_tbl %>%
  group_by(
    ASV,
    label,
    type,
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    n_diet_assoc,
    top_diet_category,
    top_diet_direction,
    diet_assoc_categories,
    diet_assoc_directions
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    detected_in_any_food = any(detected),
    n_detected_samples = sum(detected),
    n_detected_dishes = n_distinct(Dish_ID[detected]),
    detected_categories_1 = paste(sort(unique(Category_1[detected])), collapse = ";"),
    detected_categories_2 = paste(sort(unique(Category_2[detected])), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dish_match_summary_tbl <- plot_grid_tbl %>%
  group_by(
    Variable_ID,
    Dish_ID,
    Group,
    Korean_name,
    Full_English_name,
    Figure_label,
    Plot_label,
    Category_1,
    Category_2
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_matched_asvs = n_distinct(ASV[detected]),
    matched_asvs = paste(sort(unique(ASV[detected])), collapse = ";"),
    n_global_core = n_distinct(ASV[detected & asv_class == "Global core"]),
    n_village_enriched = n_distinct(ASV[detected & asv_class == "Village-enriched"]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Food category long table using both Category_1 and Category_2
# ---------------------------------------------------------
detected_pair_tbl <- plot_grid_tbl %>%
  filter(detected) %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    label,
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    n_diet_assoc,
    diet_assoc_categories,
    diet_assoc_directions,
    top_diet_category,
    top_diet_direction,
    Variable_ID,
    Dish_ID,
    Group,
    Korean_name,
    Figure_label,
    Plot_label,
    Category_1,
    Category_2,
    detected,
    n_matched_food_seq
  )

detected_food_category_long <- detected_pair_tbl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Category_1, Category_2),
    names_to = "food_category_source",
    values_to = "food_category"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    food_category = ifelse(is.na(food_category) | food_category == "", "None", food_category)
  ) %>%
  filter(food_category != "None") %>%
  distinct(
    ASV,
    Variable_ID,
    food_category,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

asv_food_category_tbl <- detected_food_category_long %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    detected_food_categories = paste(sort(unique(food_category)), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) ASV-level concordance using Category_1 + Category_2
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_concordance_tbl <- asv_match_summary_tbl %>%
  left_join(asv_food_category_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    detected_food_categories = ifelse(
      is.na(detected_food_categories) | detected_food_categories == "",
      "None",
      detected_food_categories
    ),
    diet_assoc_list = split_semicolon(diet_assoc_categories),
    food_category_list = split_semicolon(detected_food_categories),
    any_category_concordant = mapply(
      function(diet_vec, food_vec) {
        diet_vec <- diet_vec[!is.na(diet_vec) & diet_vec != "" & diet_vec != "None"]
        food_vec <- food_vec[!is.na(food_vec) & food_vec != "" & food_vec != "None"]
        length(intersect(diet_vec, food_vec)) > 0
      },
      diet_assoc_list,
      food_category_list
    ),
    concordance_status = case_when(
      detected_in_any_food & n_diet_assoc > 0 & any_category_concordant ~ "Concordant",
      detected_in_any_food & n_diet_assoc > 0 & !any_category_concordant ~ "Discordant",
      detected_in_any_food & n_diet_assoc == 0 ~ "Food-detected only",
      !detected_in_any_food & n_diet_assoc > 0 ~ "Diet-associated only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    concordance_status = factor(
      concordance_status,
      levels = c(
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant",
        "Food-detected only",
        "Diet-associated only",
        "Neither"
      )
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Diet category x food category heatmap table
#     Uses both Category_1 and Category_2.
#     Count = unique ASVs per diet_category x food_category.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_food_category_pair_tbl <- detected_food_category_long %>%
  filter(n_diet_assoc > 0) %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    diet_assoc_categories,
    food_category,
    Variable_ID,
    Dish_ID
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(diet_assoc_categories, sep = ";") %>%
  rename(diet_category = diet_assoc_categories) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(diet_category),
    diet_category != "",
    diet_category != "None",
    !is.na(food_category),
    food_category != "",
    food_category != "None"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category_concordant = diet_category == food_category
  )

diet_food_heatmap_tbl <- diet_food_category_pair_tbl %>%
  distinct(ASV, diet_category, food_category, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(diet_category, food_category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_asvs = n_distinct(ASV),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    diet_category = diet_vars_order,
    food_category = diet_vars_order,
    fill = list(n_asvs = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    concordant_cell = diet_category == food_category,
    diet_category = factor(diet_category, levels = rev(diet_vars_order)),
    food_category = factor(food_category, levels = diet_vars_order)
  )

diet_food_heatmap_samplepair_tbl <- diet_food_category_pair_tbl %>%
  group_by(diet_category, food_category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_asv_sample_pairs = n_distinct(paste(ASV, Variable_ID, sep = "||")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    diet_category = diet_vars_order,
    food_category = diet_vars_order,
    fill = list(n_asv_sample_pairs = 0)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 13) Palettes
# ---------------------------------------------------------
class_cols <- c(
  "Global core" = "#4E79A7",
  "Village-enriched" = "#E15759",
  "Unknown" = "grey80"
)

subtype_cols <- c(
  "single" = "#1B9E77",
  "nearby" = "#D95F02",
  "regional" = "#7570B3",
  "Unknown" = "grey80"
)

diet_assoc_binary_cols <- c(
  "Diet-associated" = "#CC79A7",
  "Not diet-associated" = "grey90"
)

group_cols <- c(
  "Control" = "#BDBDBD",
  "Fermented" = "#252525"
)

category_cols <- c(
  "Vegetables" = "#4E79A7",
  "Namul" = "#59A14F",
  "Kimchi" = "#E15759",
  "Mushrooms" = "#B07AA1",
  "Seaweed" = "#76B7B2",
  "Seafood" = "#9C755F",
  "Fish" = "#1F77B4",
  "Meat" = "#D62728",
  "Fruit" = "#F28E2B",
  "Beverages" = "#EDC948",
  "Others" = "grey75",
  "None" = "grey90"
)

concordance_cols <- c(
  "Concordant" = "#D55E00",
  "Discordant" = "#999999",
  "Food-detected only" = "#0072B2",
  "Diet-associated only" = "#009E73",
  "Neither" = "grey90"
)

observed_categories <- unique(c(food_meta$Category_1, food_meta$Category_2, diet_vars_order))
category_cols <- expand_palette(category_cols, observed_categories)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14) Figure A: simplified exact match matrix
#     Rows = food-detected OR diet-associated ASVs.
#     Row order:
#       Global core -> Village-enriched -> Unknown
#       single -> nearby -> regional -> Unknown
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (matrix_row_mode == "detected_only") {
  matrix_asv_ids <- asv_concordance_tbl %>%
    filter(detected_in_any_food) %>%
    pull(ASV) %>%
    unique()
} else if (matrix_row_mode == "informative") {
  matrix_asv_ids <- asv_concordance_tbl %>%
    filter(detected_in_any_food | n_diet_assoc > 0) %>%
    pull(ASV) %>%
    unique()
} else if (matrix_row_mode == "all") {
  matrix_asv_ids <- asv_concordance_tbl %>%
    pull(ASV) %>%
    unique()
} else {
  stop("Invalid matrix_row_mode. Use 'detected_only', 'informative', or 'all'.")
}

if (length(matrix_asv_ids) == 0) {
  warning("No ASVs selected for matrix plotting. Figure A will be skipped.")
} else {
  
  food_col_order <- food_meta %>%
    mutate(
      Category_1 = factor(Category_1, levels = diet_vars_order),
      Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Control", "Fermented"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(Category_1, Dish_ID, Group, Variable_ID) %>%
    pull(Variable_ID)
  
  row_order_tbl_matrix <- asv_concordance_tbl %>%
    filter(ASV %in% matrix_asv_ids) %>%
    mutate(
      row_status = case_when(
        detected_in_any_food & n_diet_assoc > 0 ~ "Food-detected + diet-associated",
        detected_in_any_food & n_diet_assoc == 0 ~ "Food-detected only",
        !detected_in_any_food & n_diet_assoc > 0 ~ "Diet-associated only",
        TRUE ~ "Neither"
      ),
      row_status = factor(
        row_status,
        levels = c(
          "Food-detected + diet-associated",
          "Food-detected only",
          "Diet-associated only",
          "Neither"
        )
      ),
      asv_class = factor(
        as.character(asv_class),
        levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched", "Unknown")
      ),
      subtype = factor(
        as.character(subtype),
        levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional", "Unknown")
      ),
      diet_assoc_binary = ifelse(
        n_diet_assoc > 0,
        "Diet-associated",
        "Not diet-associated"
      ),
      diet_assoc_binary = factor(
        diet_assoc_binary,
        levels = c("Diet-associated", "Not diet-associated")
      ),
      row_label = clean_display_label(label, ASV),
      row_id = paste0(row_label, "__", ASV)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      asv_class,
      subtype,
      row_status,
      desc(n_detected_samples),
      ASV
    )
  
  row_levels <- rev(row_order_tbl_matrix$row_id)
  row_labels <- setNames(row_order_tbl_matrix$row_label, row_order_tbl_matrix$row_id)
  
  plot_df_matrix <- plot_grid_tbl %>%
    filter(ASV %in% matrix_asv_ids) %>%
    left_join(
      row_order_tbl_matrix %>% select(ASV, row_id, row_label),
      by = "ASV"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Variable_ID = factor(Variable_ID, levels = food_col_order),
      row_id = factor(row_id, levels = row_levels)
    )
  
  col_meta_plot <- food_meta %>%
    mutate(
      Variable_ID = factor(Variable_ID, levels = food_col_order),
      Category_1 = factor(Category_1, levels = diet_vars_order),
      Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Control", "Fermented"))
    ) %>%
    filter(Variable_ID %in% food_col_order)
  
  row_anno_plot <- row_order_tbl_matrix %>%
    mutate(
      row_id = factor(row_id, levels = row_levels),
      asv_class = factor(asv_class, levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched", "Unknown")),
      subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional", "Unknown")),
      diet_assoc_binary = factor(
        diet_assoc_binary,
        levels = c("Diet-associated", "Not diet-associated")
      )
    )
  
  # Column annotations: Group + Category_1 only
  p_col_group <- ggplot(col_meta_plot, aes(x = Variable_ID, y = "Group", fill = Group)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 0, 0))
  
  p_col_cat1 <- ggplot(col_meta_plot, aes(x = Variable_ID, y = "Category 1", fill = Category_1)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = category_cols, drop = FALSE, na.value = "grey90") +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 0, 0))
  
  # Row annotations: ASV class + subtype + diet-associated binary
  p_row_class <- ggplot(row_anno_plot, aes(x = "Class", y = row_id, fill = asv_class)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = class_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 5.5, 5.5))
  
  p_row_subtype <- ggplot(row_anno_plot, aes(x = "Subtype", y = row_id, fill = subtype)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = subtype_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 5.5, 0))
  
  p_row_dietassoc <- ggplot(row_anno_plot, aes(x = "Diet assoc.", y = row_id, fill = diet_assoc_binary)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = diet_assoc_binary_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 5.5, 0))
  
  p_match_matrix <- ggplot(plot_df_matrix, aes(x = Variable_ID, y = row_id)) +
    geom_tile(fill = "white", color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.18) +
    geom_point(
      data = plot_df_matrix %>% filter(detected),
      aes(x = Variable_ID, y = row_id),
      shape = 21,
      size = 2.4,
      stroke = 0.35,
      color = "black",
      fill = "white"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      drop = FALSE,
      labels = setNames(food_meta$Figure_label, food_meta$Variable_ID)
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(
      drop = FALSE,
      labels = row_labels
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    base_theme_simple +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 8),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 5.5, 0),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  make_tile_legend <- function(pal, title, ncol = 1, text_size = 3.0, title_size = 10) {
    pal <- pal[!is.na(names(pal))]
    leg_df <- tibble(
      label = names(pal),
      idx = seq_along(label)
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        col = ((idx - 1) %% ncol) + 1,
        row = ceiling(idx / ncol),
        row = max(row) - row + 1
      )
    
    ggplot(leg_df, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = label)) +
      geom_tile(width = 0.35, height = 0.35, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
      geom_text(aes(label = label), nudge_x = 0.25, hjust = 0, size = text_size) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
      coord_cartesian(
        xlim = c(0.6, ncol + 4.2),
        ylim = c(0.4, max(leg_df$row) + 0.6),
        clip = "off"
      ) +
      labs(title = title) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
      )
  }
  
  p_leg_detect <- ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "point",
      x = 0.15,
      y = 0.7,
      shape = 21,
      size = 3.2,
      stroke = 0.4,
      color = "black",
      fill = "white"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.35,
      y = 0.7,
      label = paste0("Exact ASV match detected\nRA >= ", food_detection_cutoff, " (0.1%)"),
      hjust = 0,
      size = 3.0
    ) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    labs(title = "Matrix cell") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
  
  p_leg_class <- make_tile_legend(class_cols, "ASV class", text_size = 2.8)
  p_leg_subtype <- make_tile_legend(subtype_cols, "Subtype", text_size = 2.8)
  p_leg_dietassoc <- make_tile_legend(diet_assoc_binary_cols, "Diet association", text_size = 2.8)
  p_leg_group <- make_tile_legend(group_cols, "Food group", text_size = 2.8)
  p_leg_cat <- make_tile_legend(category_cols[names(category_cols) %in% unique(food_meta$Category_1)], "Food category", text_size = 2.5)
  
  p_legends_matrix <- wrap_plots(
    p_leg_detect,
    p_leg_class,
    p_leg_subtype,
    p_leg_dietassoc,
    p_leg_group,
    p_leg_cat,
    ncol = 1
  ) +
    plot_layout(heights = c(0.9, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.9, 3.0))
  
  p_title_matrix <- ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 1,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      label = "Exact sequence matches between sharing-related gut ASVs and side-dish microbiota",
      size = 5.3,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.25,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      label = paste0(
        "Rows show ASVs with food detection or diet association. ",
        "Left strips indicate ASV class, spatial subtype, and diet-association status. ",
        "Open circles indicate exact 16S ASV sequence matches at relative abundance >= ",
        food_detection_cutoff, " (0.1%)."
      ),
      size = 3.35,
      color = "grey30"
    ) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(2, 5.5, 2, 5.5))
  
  p_top_anno <- p_col_group / p_col_cat1 +
    plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))
  
  p_left_anno <- p_row_class | p_row_subtype | p_row_dietassoc
  
  p_body_matrix <- wrap_plots(
    plot_spacer(),
    p_top_anno,
    p_left_anno,
    p_match_matrix,
    ncol = 2
  ) +
    plot_layout(
      widths = c(0.45, 10),
      heights = c(0.22, 10)
    )
  
  p_left_full_matrix <- p_title_matrix / p_body_matrix +
    plot_layout(heights = c(0.55, 10))
  
  p_final_matrix <- wrap_plots(
    p_left_full_matrix,
    p_legends_matrix,
    ncol = 2
  ) +
    plot_layout(widths = c(10, 1.8))
  
  print(p_final_matrix)
  
  plot_height_matrix <- max(7, 0.14 * nrow(row_order_tbl_matrix) + 3)
  plot_width_matrix <- max(13, 0.18 * length(food_col_order) + 7)
  
  save_plot_both_simple(
    p_final_matrix,
    file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "plots", "A_exact_match_matrix_class_subtype_only"),
    width = plot_width_matrix,
    height = plot_height_matrix
  )
  
  write_csv(
    row_order_tbl_matrix,
    file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "tables", "A_exact_match_matrix_row_annotation.csv")
  )
  
  write_csv(
    plot_df_matrix,
    file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "tables", "A_exact_match_matrix_long.csv")
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 15) Figure B: whole ASV-level concordance summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
concordance_bar_tbl <- asv_concordance_tbl %>%
  filter(concordance_status != "Neither") %>%
  count(concordance_status, name = "n_asvs") %>%
  mutate(
    concordance_status = factor(
      concordance_status,
      levels = c(
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant",
        "Food-detected only",
        "Diet-associated only"
      )
    ),
    label = as.character(n_asvs)
  ) %>%
  arrange(concordance_status)

p_concordance_bar <- ggplot(
  concordance_bar_tbl,
  aes(x = concordance_status, y = n_asvs, fill = concordance_status)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -0.35, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = concordance_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(
    title = "ASV-level food-diet concordance",
    subtitle = "Category_1 and Category_2 were both used. Concordant means that at least one ASV-associated diet category matched at least one detected side-dish category.",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of ASVs"
  ) +
  base_theme_simple +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_concordance_bar)

save_plot_both_simple(
  p_concordance_bar,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "plots", "B_ASV_level_concordance_bar"),
  width = 8,
  height = 5
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 16) Figure C: diet category x food category heatmap
#     Uses both Category_1 and Category_2.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_diet_food_heatmap <- ggplot(
  diet_food_heatmap_tbl,

) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +

  ) +

  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#F7FBFF", "#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#08519C"),
    name = "No. ASVs"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Concordance between ASV-associated diet categories and detected side-dish categories",
    subtitle = "Food categories include both Category_1 and Category_2. Black outlines mark category-concordant cells. Cell values indicate unique ASV counts.",
    x = "Detected side-dish category",
    y = "ASV-associated diet category"
  ) +
  base_theme_simple +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_diet_food_heatmap)

save_plot_both_simple(
  p_diet_food_heatmap,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "plots", "C_diet_category_vs_food_category_concordance_heatmap"),
  width = 8.5,
  height = 7.2
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 17) Save tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(

)

write_csv(

write_csv(

write_csv(
```
