```{r}
# =========================================================
# Summary comparison figures for food category-level matching
# - Use existing v2 objects
# - No new outdir
#
# Required objects from previous v2 code:
#   OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE
#   asv_concordance_tbl
#   detected_food_category_long
#   diet_vars_order
#
# ASV inclusion:
#   diet-associated AND exact match detected
#
# Figure A:
#   two columns per category: Det / Match
#
# Figure B:
#   one cell with symbols: O O or O X
#
# Figure C:
#   color fill + point
#
# Output:
#   food_microbiome_exact_match_simplified_v2/plots/
#   food_microbiome_exact_match_simplified_v2/tables/
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(forcats)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Preconditions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE")) {
  OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE <- "food_microbiome_exact_match_simplified_v2"
}

need_objs <- c(
  "asv_concordance_tbl",
  "detected_food_category_long",
  "diet_vars_order"
)

miss <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(miss) > 0) {
  stop("Required objects are missing. Run the v2 full code first: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Select ASVs: diet-associated AND exact match
# ---------------------------------------------------------
selected_asv_tbl <- asv_concordance_tbl %>%
  filter(
    detected_in_any_food,
    n_diet_assoc > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    asv_class = factor(
      as.character(asv_class),
      levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched", "Unknown")
    ),
    subtype = factor(
      as.character(subtype),
      levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional", "Unknown")
    ),
    row_label = ifelse(is.na(label) | label == "", ASV, label),
    row_label = mapply(
      function(lab, asv) {
        lab2 <- stringr::str_replace(lab, paste0("\\s*\\|\\s*", asv, "$"), "")
        if (is.na(lab2) || lab2 == "") asv else lab2
      },
      row_label,
      ASV,
      USE.NAMES = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    desc(n_detected_samples),
    ASV
  )

if (nrow(selected_asv_tbl) == 0) {
  stop("No ASVs satisfy: detected_in_any_food == TRUE AND n_diet_assoc > 0.")
}

selected_asvs <- selected_asv_tbl$ASV

cat("\n===== Category-level summary figure ASV selection =====\n")
cat("Selected ASVs: ", length(selected_asvs), "\n", sep = "")
print(
  selected_asv_tbl %>%
    count(asv_class, subtype, name = "n_asvs") %>%
    arrange(asv_class, subtype)
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Food category detection table
#    Category_1 and Category_2 were already expanded in detected_food_category_long
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_detect_by_cat <- detected_food_category_long %>%
  filter(ASV %in% selected_asvs) %>%
  filter(!is.na(food_category), food_category != "", food_category != "None") %>%
  group_by(ASV, food_category) %>%
  summarise(
    detected = TRUE,
    n_detected_samples = n_distinct(Variable_ID),
    n_detected_dishes = n_distinct(Dish_ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) ASV x food-category grid
#    diet_match = food category is included in ASV-associated diet categories
# ---------------------------------------------------------
summary_grid_tbl <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  ASV = selected_asvs,
  food_category = diet_vars_order
) %>%
  left_join(
    selected_asv_tbl %>%
      select(
        ASV,
        label,
        row_label,
        type,
        asv_class,
        subtype,
        diet_assoc_categories,
        n_diet_assoc,
        detected_food_categories,
        concordance_status
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    food_detect_by_cat,
    by = c("ASV", "food_category")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    detected = replace_na(detected, FALSE),
    n_detected_samples = replace_na(n_detected_samples, 0L),
    n_detected_dishes = replace_na(n_detected_dishes, 0L),
    diet_assoc_categories = ifelse(
      is.na(diet_assoc_categories) | diet_assoc_categories == "",
      "None",
      diet_assoc_categories
    )
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    diet_match = {
      diet_vec <- unlist(strsplit(diet_assoc_categories, ";"))
      diet_vec <- diet_vec[!is.na(diet_vec) & diet_vec != "" & diet_vec != "None"]
      food_category %in% diet_vec
    },
    detected_and_matched = detected & diet_match
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Row order
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_order_tbl <- selected_asv_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    asv_class = factor(asv_class, levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched", "Unknown")),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional", "Unknown"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    desc(n_detected_samples),
    ASV
  )

asv_levels <- asv_order_tbl$ASV

summary_grid_tbl <- summary_grid_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = factor(ASV, levels = rev(asv_levels)),
    food_category = factor(food_category, levels = diet_vars_order)
  )

asv_label_map <- asv_order_tbl %>%
  mutate(ASV = factor(ASV, levels = rev(asv_levels))) %>%
  select(ASV, row_label)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Save source tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(
  summary_grid_tbl,
  file.path(
    OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE,
    "tables",
    "summary_category_level_detected_and_diet_matched_grid.csv"
  )
)

write_csv(
  asv_order_tbl,
  file.path(
    OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE,
    "tables",
    "summary_category_level_selected_ASVs_order.csv"
  )
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Theme
# ---------------------------------------------------------
summary_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 8, 8)
  )

plot_height <- max(5.5, 0.22 * length(asv_levels) + 1.5)

# =========================================================
# Figure A: two columns per category
# =========================================================
plot_A_tbl <- summary_grid_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    Det = as.integer(detected),
    Match = as.integer(detected_and_matched)
  ) %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    row_label,
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    food_category,
    Det,
    Match
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Det, Match),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(metric, levels = c("Det", "Match")),
    x_label = paste(food_category, metric, sep = "_"),
    x_label = factor(
      x_label,
      levels = as.vector(rbind(
        paste(diet_vars_order, "Det", sep = "_"),
        paste(diet_vars_order, "Match", sep = "_")
      ))
    )
  )

pA <- ggplot(plot_A_tbl, aes(x = x_label, y = ASV)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = factor(value)), color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("0" = "grey95", "1" = "#4E79A7"),
    name = "State",
    labels = c("0" = "No", "1" = "Yes")
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = setNames(asv_label_map$row_label, asv_label_map$ASV)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Two-column category summary",
    subtitle = "Det = exact-match detected in the food category; Match = detected category also matches an ASV-associated diet category."
  ) +
  summary_theme

ggsave(
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "plots", "D_summary_A_two_column_category_matrix.png"),
  pA,
  width = 13.5,
  height = plot_height,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white",
  limitsize = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "plots", "D_summary_A_two_column_category_matrix.svg"),
  pA,
  width = 13.5,
  height = plot_height,
  bg = "white",
  limitsize = FALSE
)

# =========================================================
# Figure B: text symbols in one cell
# =========================================================
plot_B_tbl <- summary_grid_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    cell_label = case_when(
      detected & diet_match ~ "O O",
      detected & !diet_match ~ "O X",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    fill_state = case_when(
      detected & diet_match ~ "Detected + matched",
      detected & !diet_match ~ "Detected only",
      TRUE ~ "Not detected"
    ),
    fill_state = factor(
      fill_state,
      levels = c("Not detected", "Detected only", "Detected + matched")
    )
  )

pB <- ggplot(plot_B_tbl, aes(x = food_category, y = ASV)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = fill_state), color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(aes(label = cell_label), size = 3.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not detected" = "grey95",
      "Detected only" = "#D9E8F5",
      "Detected + matched" = "#4E79A7"
    ),
    name = "Cell state"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = setNames(asv_label_map$row_label, asv_label_map$ASV)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Symbol category summary",
    subtitle = "O O = detected and diet-category matched; O X = detected but not diet-category matched."
  ) +
  summary_theme

ggsave(
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "plots", "D_summary_B_symbol_category_matrix.png"),
  pB,
  width = 10.5,
  height = plot_height,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white",
  limitsize = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "plots", "D_summary_B_symbol_category_matrix.svg"),
  pB,
  width = 10.5,
  height = plot_height,
  bg = "white",
  limitsize = FALSE
)

# =========================================================
# Figure C: color fill + point
# =========================================================
plot_C_tbl <- summary_grid_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    fill_state = ifelse(detected, "Detected", "Not detected"),
    fill_state = factor(fill_state, levels = c("Not detected", "Detected"))
  )

pC <- ggplot(plot_C_tbl, aes(x = food_category, y = ASV)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = fill_state), color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_C_tbl %>% filter(detected_and_matched),
    shape = 16,
    size = 2.2,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not detected" = "grey95",
      "Detected" = "#4E79A7"
    ),
    name = "Exact match"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = setNames(asv_label_map$row_label, asv_label_map$ASV)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "C. Fill-and-point category summary",
    subtitle = "Blue fill = exact-match detected in the food category; black point = detected category matches an ASV-associated diet category."
  ) +
  summary_theme

ggsave(
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "plots", "D_summary_C_fill_point_category_matrix.png"),
  pC,
  width = 10.5,
  height = plot_height,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white",
  limitsize = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "plots", "D_summary_C_fill_point_category_matrix.svg"),
  pC,
  width = 10.5,
  height = plot_height,
  bg = "white",
  limitsize = FALSE
)

# =========================================================
# Combined comparison panel
# =========================================================
p_compare_ABC <- pA / pB / pC +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1))

ggsave(
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "plots", "D_summary_compare_ABC_category_matrices.png"),
  p_compare_ABC,
  width = 14,
  height = max(14, plot_height * 3),
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white",
  limitsize = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "plots", "D_summary_compare_ABC_category_matrices.svg"),
  p_compare_ABC,
  width = 14,
  height = max(14, plot_height * 3),
  bg = "white",
  limitsize = FALSE
)

cat("\n===== Category-level summary comparison figures saved =====\n")
cat("Output directory: ", OUTDIR_FOOD_SIMPLE, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Selected ASVs: ", length(asv_levels), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Criterion: diet-associated AND exact-match detected\n")
cat("\nSaved plots:\n")
cat("- plots/D_summary_A_two_column_category_matrix.png/.svg\n")
cat("- plots/D_summary_B_symbol_category_matrix.png/.svg\n")
cat("- plots/D_summary_C_fill_point_category_matrix.png/.svg\n")
cat("- plots/D_summary_compare_ABC_category_matrices.png/.svg\n")
```

#반찬 final
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Final food microbiome exact-match + diet-concordance analysis
#
# Inputs:
#   metadata_food_microbiome.csv
#   rawdata_food_microbiome.csv
#   sharing_asv.csv
#
# Optional existing objects:
#   global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh
#   asv_subtype_tbl
#   cor_result_tbl
#
# Output directory:
#   food_microbiome_exact_match_final/
#     tables/
#     plots/
#
# Main figure structure:
#   A. ASV-level evidence summary across all sharing-related ASVs
#   B. ASV-class breakdown of evidence status
#   C. Category-level exact match + diet concordance matrix
#
# Supplementary:
#   D. Full ASV x side-dish sample exact match matrix
#   E. Full ASV-level screening summary table
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(forcats)
  library(stringi)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_meta_file <- "metadata_food_microbiome.csv"
food_raw_file  <- "rawdata_food_microbiome.csv"
sharing_file   <- "sharing_asv.csv"

stopifnot(file.exists(food_meta_file))
stopifnot(file.exists(food_raw_file))
stopifnot(file.exists(sharing_file))

OUTDIR_FOOD_FINAL <- "food_microbiome_exact_match_final"
dir.create(OUTDIR_FOOD_FINAL, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_FINAL, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_FINAL, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# If rawdata_food_microbiome.csv contains relative abundance values,
# 0.001 = 0.1%.
# If it is already 0/1 presence-absence, this is equivalent to >0.
food_detection_cutoff <- 0.001

# Diet association criterion.
# "FDR"  = p_adj_bh < 0.05
# "rawP" = p_value < 0.05
diet_assoc_mode <- "FDR"
diet_assoc_p_cutoff <- 0.05

# For source/exposure interpretation, positive diet associations are usually most relevant.
# Use "positive" or "both".
diet_assoc_direction_keep <- "positive"

diet_vars_order <- c(
  "Vegetables",
  "Namul",
  "Kimchi",
  "Mushrooms",
  "Seaweed",
  "Seafood",
  "Fish",
  "Meat",
  "Fruit",
  "Beverages"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------
clean_seq <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    str_to_upper() %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", "")
}

reverse_complement <- function(seq) {
  seq <- clean_seq(seq)
  comp <- chartr("ACGTURYKMSWBDHVN", "TGCAAYRMKSWVHDBN", seq)
  stringi::stri_reverse(comp)
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

expand_palette <- function(pal, observed_levels) {
  observed_levels <- observed_levels[!is.na(observed_levels) & observed_levels != ""]
  extra_levels <- setdiff(observed_levels, names(pal))
  if (length(extra_levels) > 0) {
    extra_cols <- scales::hue_pal()(length(extra_levels))
    names(extra_cols) <- extra_levels
    pal <- c(pal, extra_cols)
  }
  pal
}

make_label_with_asv <- function(label, ASV) {
  label <- as.character(label)
  ASV <- as.character(ASV)
  label[is.na(label) | label == ""] <- ASV[is.na(label) | label == ""]
  
  out <- mapply(function(lab, asv) {
    lab2 <- str_replace(lab, paste0("\\s*\\|\\s*", asv, "$"), "")
    paste0(lab2, " | ", asv)
  }, label, ASV, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  
  as.character(out)
}

split_semicolon <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- "None"
  str_split(x, ";")
}

base_theme_final <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9.5)
  )

make_tile_legend <- function(pal, title, ncol = 1, text_size = 3.0, title_size = 10) {
  pal <- pal[!is.na(names(pal))]
  leg_df <- tibble(
    label = names(pal),
    idx = seq_along(label)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      col = ((idx - 1) %% ncol) + 1,
      row = ceiling(idx / ncol),
      row = max(row) - row + 1
    )
  
  ggplot(leg_df, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = label)) +
    geom_tile(width = 0.35, height = 0.35, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), nudge_x = 0.25, hjust = 0, size = text_size) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0.6, ncol + 4.5),
      ylim = c(0.4, max(leg_df$row) + 0.6),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Load food metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_meta_raw <- read_csv(food_meta_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_trim(.x)) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_replace_all(.x, "\\s+", "_"))

required_meta_cols <- c(
  "Variable_ID",
  "Dish_ID",
  "Group",
  "Korean_name",
  "Full_English_name",
  "Figure_label",
  "Plot_label",
  "Category_1",
  "Category_2"
)

missing_meta_cols <- setdiff(required_meta_cols, names(food_meta_raw))
if (length(missing_meta_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing columns in metadata_food_microbiome.csv after name standardization: ",
    paste(missing_meta_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

food_meta <- food_meta_raw %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(required_meta_cols), as.character),
    Category_1 = ifelse(is.na(Category_1) | Category_1 == "", "None", Category_1),
    Category_2 = ifelse(is.na(Category_2) | Category_2 == "", "None", Category_2),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Control", "Fermented"))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Load food microbiome table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_raw <- read_csv(food_raw_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_trim(.x))

if (!"seq" %in% names(food_raw)) {
  stop("rawdata_food_microbiome.csv must contain a 'seq' column.")
}

if (!"Taxon" %in% names(food_raw)) {
  food_raw <- food_raw %>%
    mutate(Taxon = NA_character_, .before = 1)
}

food_sample_cols <- intersect(food_meta$Variable_ID, names(food_raw))

if (length(food_sample_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No sample columns in rawdata_food_microbiome.csv matched metadata_food_microbiome.csv$Variable_ID.")
}

food_asv_tbl <- food_raw %>%
  mutate(
    food_taxon = as.character(Taxon),
    food_seq = clean_seq(seq),
    food_seq_rc = reverse_complement(food_seq)
  ) %>%
  select(food_taxon, food_seq, food_seq_rc, all_of(food_sample_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(food_sample_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))))

food_abund_mat <- food_asv_tbl %>%
  select(all_of(food_sample_cols)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

food_abund_mat[] <- lapply(food_abund_mat, function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)))
food_abund_mat <- as.matrix(food_abund_mat)

food_abund_check <- tibble(
  min_value = min(food_abund_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_value = max(food_abund_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_colsum = median(colSums(food_abund_mat, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
)

cat("\n===== Food microbiome abundance scale check =====\n")
print(food_abund_check)
cat("Detection cutoff:", food_detection_cutoff, "(0.001 = 0.1% relative abundance; for PA data, equivalent to >0)\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Load sharing ASV table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sharing_raw <- read_csv(sharing_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_trim(.x))

if (!all(c("ASV", "seq") %in% names(sharing_raw))) {
  stop("sharing_asv.csv must contain at least 'ASV' and 'seq' columns.")
}

if (!"label" %in% names(sharing_raw)) {
  sharing_raw <- sharing_raw %>%
    mutate(label = ASV)
}

if (!"type" %in% names(sharing_raw)) {
  sharing_raw <- sharing_raw %>%
    mutate(type = NA_character_)
}

sharing_asv <- sharing_raw %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    label = as.character(label),
    type = as.character(type),
    human_seq = clean_seq(seq),
    human_seq_rc = reverse_complement(human_seq),
    asv_class_from_file = case_when(
      str_detect(str_to_lower(type), "global") ~ "Global core",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(type), "village") ~ "Village-enriched",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    label,
    type,
    asv_class_from_file,
    human_seq,
    human_seq_rc
  ) %>%
  distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Add class/subtype from existing objects if available
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtype_annot_list <- list()

if (exists("global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh")) {
  subtype_annot_list[["global_core"]] <- global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = as.character(ASV),
      asv_class_from_object = "Global core",
      subtype = as.character(subtype)
    )
}

if (exists("asv_subtype_tbl")) {
  subtype_annot_list[["village_enriched"]] <- asv_subtype_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = as.character(ASV),
      asv_class_from_object = "Village-enriched",
      subtype = as.character(subtype)
    )
}

if (length(subtype_annot_list) > 0) {
  subtype_annot <- bind_rows(subtype_annot_list) %>%
    mutate(
      subtype = case_when(
        str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype), "single") ~ "single",
        str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype), "nearby") ~ "nearby",
        str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype), "regional") ~ "regional",
        TRUE ~ subtype
      )
    ) %>%
    distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
    left_join(subtype_annot, by = "ASV")
} else {
  sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
    mutate(
      asv_class_from_object = NA_character_,
      subtype = NA_character_
    )
}

sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
  mutate(
    asv_class = coalesce(asv_class_from_object, asv_class_from_file, "Unknown"),
    subtype = ifelse(is.na(subtype) | subtype == "", "Unknown", subtype),
    asv_class = factor(asv_class, levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched", "Unknown")),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional", "Unknown")),
    row_label = make_label_with_asv(label, ASV)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Diet association annotation from cor_result_tbl
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (
  exists("cor_result_tbl") &&
  all(c("ASV", "variable_group", "variable_label", "rho", "p_value", "p_adj_bh") %in% names(cor_result_tbl))
) {
  
  diet_assoc_base <- cor_result_tbl %>%
    filter(
      ASV %in% sharing_asv$ASV,
      variable_group == "Diet",
      variable_label %in% diet_vars_order
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      sig_for_annotation = case_when(
        diet_assoc_mode == "FDR" ~ !is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_assoc_p_cutoff,
        diet_assoc_mode == "rawP" ~ !is.na(p_value) & p_value < diet_assoc_p_cutoff,
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      ),
      direction = case_when(
        rho > 0 ~ "Positive",
        rho < 0 ~ "Negative",
        TRUE ~ "No change"
      )
    )
  
  if (diet_assoc_direction_keep == "positive") {
    diet_assoc_base <- diet_assoc_base %>%
      filter(rho > 0)
  }
  
  diet_assoc_all_tbl <- diet_assoc_base %>%
    filter(sig_for_annotation) %>%
    arrange(ASV, p_adj_bh, p_value, desc(abs(rho))) %>%
    group_by(ASV) %>%
    summarise(
      n_diet_assoc = n(),
      diet_assoc_categories = paste(sort(unique(variable_label)), collapse = ";"),
      diet_assoc_directions = paste(sort(unique(direction)), collapse = ";"),
      top_diet_category = first(variable_label),
      top_diet_direction = first(direction),
      top_diet_rho = first(rho),
      top_diet_p = first(p_value),
      top_diet_fdr = first(p_adj_bh),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
} else {
  
  warning(
    "cor_result_tbl was not found or lacked required columns. ",
    "Diet-association status will be set to none for all ASVs."
  )
  
  diet_assoc_all_tbl <- tibble(
    ASV = sharing_asv$ASV,
    n_diet_assoc = 0L,
    diet_assoc_categories = "None",
    diet_assoc_directions = "None",
    top_diet_category = "None",
    top_diet_direction = "None",
    top_diet_rho = NA_real_,
    top_diet_p = NA_real_,
    top_diet_fdr = NA_real_
  )
}

sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
  left_join(diet_assoc_all_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    n_diet_assoc = replace_na(n_diet_assoc, 0L),
    diet_assoc_categories = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_categories) | diet_assoc_categories == "", "None", diet_assoc_categories),
    diet_assoc_directions = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_directions) | diet_assoc_directions == "", "None", diet_assoc_directions),
    top_diet_category = ifelse(is.na(top_diet_category) | top_diet_category == "", "None", top_diet_category),
    top_diet_direction = ifelse(is.na(top_diet_direction) | top_diet_direction == "", "None", top_diet_direction),
    diet_assoc_binary = ifelse(n_diet_assoc > 0, "Diet-associated", "Not diet-associated")
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Exact sequence matching
# ---------------------------------------------------------
match_direct <- food_asv_tbl %>%
  inner_join(
    sharing_asv,
    by = c("food_seq" = "human_seq")
  ) %>%
  mutate(match_orientation = "direct")

match_revcomp <- food_asv_tbl %>%
  inner_join(
    sharing_asv,
    by = c("food_seq" = "human_seq_rc")
  ) %>%
  mutate(match_orientation = "reverse_complement")

food_match_wide <- bind_rows(match_direct, match_revcomp) %>%
  distinct(ASV, food_seq, match_orientation, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("\n===== Exact sequence match summary =====\n")
cat("No. sharing-related ASVs:", n_distinct(sharing_asv$ASV), "\n")
cat("No. matched sharing-related ASVs by sequence:", n_distinct(food_match_wide$ASV), "\n")
cat("No. matched food ASV sequences:", n_distinct(food_match_wide$food_seq), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Long exact-match table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (nrow(food_match_wide) > 0) {
  
  food_match_long <- food_match_wide %>%
    select(
      ASV,
      label,
      row_label,
      type,
      asv_class,
      subtype,
      diet_assoc_binary,
      n_diet_assoc,
      diet_assoc_categories,
      diet_assoc_directions,
      top_diet_category,
      top_diet_direction,
      top_diet_rho,
      top_diet_p,
      top_diet_fdr,
      food_taxon,
      food_seq,
      match_orientation,
      all_of(food_sample_cols)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(food_sample_cols),
      names_to = "Variable_ID",
      values_to = "abundance"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      abundance = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(abundance)),
      detected = !is.na(abundance) & abundance >= food_detection_cutoff
    ) %>%
    left_join(food_meta, by = "Variable_ID")
  
} else {
  
  food_match_long <- tibble()
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Full ASV x food sample grid
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_grid_tbl <- tidyr::crossing(
  ASV = sharing_asv$ASV,
  Variable_ID = food_meta$Variable_ID
) %>%
  left_join(
    sharing_asv %>%
      select(
        ASV,
        label,
        row_label,
        type,
        asv_class,
        subtype,
        diet_assoc_binary,
        n_diet_assoc,
        diet_assoc_categories,
        diet_assoc_directions,
        top_diet_category,
        top_diet_direction,
        top_diet_rho,
        top_diet_p,
        top_diet_fdr
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(food_meta, by = "Variable_ID") %>%
  left_join(
    food_match_long %>%
      filter(detected) %>%
      group_by(ASV, Variable_ID) %>%
      summarise(
        detected = TRUE,
        n_matched_food_seq = n_distinct(food_seq),
        food_taxon = paste(unique(na.omit(food_taxon)), collapse = ";"),
        match_orientation = paste(unique(match_orientation), collapse = ";"),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("ASV", "Variable_ID")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    detected = replace_na(detected, FALSE),
    n_matched_food_seq = replace_na(n_matched_food_seq, 0L),
    n_diet_assoc = replace_na(n_diet_assoc, 0L),
    diet_assoc_categories = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_categories) | diet_assoc_categories == "", "None", diet_assoc_categories),
    diet_assoc_binary = ifelse(n_diet_assoc > 0, "Diet-associated", "Not diet-associated")
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Category-level food detection using Category_1 + Category_2
# ---------------------------------------------------------
detected_pair_tbl <- plot_grid_tbl %>%
  filter(detected) %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    label,
    row_label,
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    diet_assoc_binary,
    n_diet_assoc,
    diet_assoc_categories,
    Variable_ID,
    Dish_ID,
    Group,
    Korean_name,
    Figure_label,
    Plot_label,
    Category_1,
    Category_2,
    detected,
    n_matched_food_seq
  )

detected_food_category_long <- detected_pair_tbl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Category_1, Category_2),
    names_to = "food_category_source",
    values_to = "food_category"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    food_category = ifelse(is.na(food_category) | food_category == "", "None", food_category)
  ) %>%
  filter(food_category != "None") %>%
  distinct(
    ASV,
    Variable_ID,
    food_category,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

asv_food_category_tbl <- detected_food_category_long %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    detected_food_categories = paste(sort(unique(food_category)), collapse = ";"),
    n_detected_food_categories = n_distinct(food_category),
    n_detected_food_samples = n_distinct(Variable_ID),
    n_detected_food_dishes = n_distinct(Dish_ID),
    detected_food_sample_ids = paste(sort(unique(Variable_ID)), collapse = ";"),
    detected_food_dish_ids = paste(sort(unique(Dish_ID)), collapse = ";"),
    detected_food_names = paste(sort(unique(Korean_name)), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) ASV-level final summary and evidence status
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_summary_tbl <- sharing_asv %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    label,
    row_label,
    type,
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    diet_assoc_binary,
    n_diet_assoc,
    diet_assoc_categories,
    diet_assoc_directions,
    top_diet_category,
    top_diet_direction,
    top_diet_rho,
    top_diet_p,
    top_diet_fdr
  ) %>%
  left_join(asv_food_category_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    detected_food_categories = ifelse(is.na(detected_food_categories) | detected_food_categories == "", "None", detected_food_categories),
    n_detected_food_categories = replace_na(n_detected_food_categories, 0L),
    n_detected_food_samples = replace_na(n_detected_food_samples, 0L),
    n_detected_food_dishes = replace_na(n_detected_food_dishes, 0L),
    detected_food_sample_ids = ifelse(is.na(detected_food_sample_ids), "", detected_food_sample_ids),
    detected_food_dish_ids = ifelse(is.na(detected_food_dish_ids), "", detected_food_dish_ids),
    detected_food_names = ifelse(is.na(detected_food_names), "", detected_food_names),
    food_detected = n_detected_food_samples > 0,
    diet_associated = n_diet_assoc > 0,
    diet_assoc_list = split_semicolon(diet_assoc_categories),
    food_category_list = split_semicolon(detected_food_categories),
    category_concordant = mapply(
      function(diet_vec, food_vec) {
        diet_vec <- diet_vec[!is.na(diet_vec) & diet_vec != "" & diet_vec != "None"]
        food_vec <- food_vec[!is.na(food_vec) & food_vec != "" & food_vec != "None"]
        length(intersect(diet_vec, food_vec)) > 0
      },
      diet_assoc_list,
      food_category_list
    ),
    evidence_status = case_when(
      diet_associated & food_detected & category_concordant ~ "Concordant",
      diet_associated & food_detected & !category_concordant ~ "Discordant",
      diet_associated & !food_detected ~ "Diet-associated only",
      !diet_associated & food_detected ~ "Food-detected only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    evidence_status = factor(
      evidence_status,
      levels = c(
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant",
        "Diet-associated only",
        "Food-detected only",
        "Neither"
      )
    ),
    asv_class = factor(as.character(asv_class), levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched", "Unknown")),
    subtype = factor(as.character(subtype), levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional", "Unknown")),
    diet_assoc_binary = factor(diet_assoc_binary, levels = c("Diet-associated", "Not diet-associated"))
  ) %>%
  select(
    -diet_assoc_list,
    -food_category_list
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Category-level ASV matrix source table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
category_grid_tbl <- expand_grid(
  ASV = asv_summary_tbl$ASV,
  food_category = diet_vars_order
) %>%
  left_join(
    asv_summary_tbl %>%
      select(
        ASV,
        label,
        row_label,
        type,
        asv_class,
        subtype,
        diet_assoc_binary,
        diet_associated,
        food_detected,
        evidence_status,
        n_diet_assoc,
        diet_assoc_categories,
        detected_food_categories,
        n_detected_food_samples,
        n_detected_food_categories
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    detected_food_category_long %>%
      filter(food_category %in% diet_vars_order) %>%
      group_by(ASV, food_category) %>%
      summarise(
        detected_in_category = TRUE,
        n_category_samples = n_distinct(Variable_ID),
        n_category_dishes = n_distinct(Dish_ID),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("ASV", "food_category")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    detected_in_category = replace_na(detected_in_category, FALSE),
    n_category_samples = replace_na(n_category_samples, 0L),
    n_category_dishes = replace_na(n_category_dishes, 0L),
    diet_assoc_categories = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_categories) | diet_assoc_categories == "", "None", diet_assoc_categories)
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    diet_match_category = {
      diet_vec <- unlist(strsplit(diet_assoc_categories, ";"))
      diet_vec <- diet_vec[!is.na(diet_vec) & diet_vec != "" & diet_vec != "None"]
      food_category %in% diet_vec
    },
    detected_and_matched = detected_in_category & diet_match_category
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 13) Palettes
# ---------------------------------------------------------
class_cols <- c(
  "Global core" = "#4E79A7",
  "Village-enriched" = "#E15759",
  "Unknown" = "grey80"
)

subtype_cols <- c(
  "single" = "#1B9E77",
  "nearby" = "#D95F02",
  "regional" = "#7570B3",
  "Unknown" = "grey80"
)

diet_assoc_binary_cols <- c(
  "Diet-associated" = "#CC79A7",
  "Not diet-associated" = "grey92"
)

evidence_cols <- c(
  "Concordant" = "#D55E00",
  "Discordant" = "#999999",
  "Diet-associated only" = "#009E73",
  "Food-detected only" = "#0072B2",
  "Neither" = "grey90"
)

group_cols <- c(
  "Control" = "#BDBDBD",
  "Fermented" = "#252525"
)

category_cols <- c(
  "Vegetables" = "#4E79A7",
  "Namul" = "#59A14F",
  "Kimchi" = "#E15759",
  "Mushrooms" = "#B07AA1",
  "Seaweed" = "#76B7B2",
  "Seafood" = "#9C755F",
  "Fish" = "#1F77B4",
  "Meat" = "#D62728",
  "Fruit" = "#F28E2B",
  "Beverages" = "#EDC948",
  "Others" = "grey75",
  "None" = "grey90"
)

observed_categories <- unique(c(food_meta$Category_1, food_meta$Category_2, diet_vars_order))
category_cols <- expand_palette(category_cols, observed_categories)

# =========================================================
# Main Figure A: whole ASV-level evidence summary
# =========================================================
figA_tbl <- asv_summary_tbl %>%
  count(evidence_status, name = "n_asvs") %>%
  complete(
    evidence_status = factor(
      c(
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant",
        "Diet-associated only",
        "Food-detected only",
        "Neither"
      ),
      levels = levels(asv_summary_tbl$evidence_status)
    ),
    fill = list(n_asvs = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = 100 * n_asvs / sum(n_asvs),
    label = paste0(n_asvs, "\n(", sprintf("%.1f", pct), "%)")
  )

p_figA <- ggplot(figA_tbl, aes(x = evidence_status, y = n_asvs, fill = evidence_status)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -0.25, size = 3.7, lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = evidence_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Evidence status of all sharing-related ASVs",
    subtitle = "All sharing-related ASVs were classified by diet association, side-dish exact-match detection, and category-level concordance.",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of ASVs"
  ) +
  base_theme_final +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_figA)

save_plot_both(
  p_figA,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_FINAL, "plots", "Main_A_ASV_level_evidence_summary"),
  width = 8,
  height = 5.2
)

# =========================================================
# Main Figure B: ASV class breakdown
# =========================================================
figB_tbl <- asv_summary_tbl %>%
  count(asv_class, evidence_status, name = "n_asvs") %>%
  group_by(asv_class) %>%
  mutate(
    total_class = sum(n_asvs),
    prop = n_asvs / total_class
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

p_figB <- ggplot(figB_tbl, aes(x = asv_class, y = prop, fill = evidence_status)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = evidence_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Evidence status by ASV class",
    subtitle = "Bars show the proportion of ASVs within each ASV class.",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of ASVs",
    fill = "Evidence status"
  ) +
  base_theme_final +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_figB)

save_plot_both(
  p_figB,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_FINAL, "plots", "Main_B_ASV_class_evidence_breakdown"),
  width = 8.5,
  height = 5.2
)

# =========================================================
# Main Figure C: category-level matrix
#   Row = informative ASVs:
#     food-detected OR diet-associated
#   Column = food category
#   Fill = exact match detected in category
#   Point = detected category matches diet-associated category
# =========================================================
informative_asv_tbl <- asv_summary_tbl %>%
  filter(food_detected | diet_associated) %>%
  arrange(
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    evidence_status,
    desc(n_detected_food_samples),
    ASV
  )

if (nrow(informative_asv_tbl) == 0) {
  stop("No informative ASVs for Figure C.")
}

figC_asv_levels <- informative_asv_tbl$ASV

figC_tbl <- category_grid_tbl %>%
  filter(ASV %in% figC_asv_levels) %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = factor(ASV, levels = rev(figC_asv_levels)),
    food_category = factor(food_category, levels = diet_vars_order),
    fill_state = ifelse(detected_in_category, "Detected", "Not detected"),
    fill_state = factor(fill_state, levels = c("Not detected", "Detected"))
  )

figC_row_anno <- informative_asv_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = factor(ASV, levels = rev(figC_asv_levels)),
    asv_class = factor(asv_class, levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched", "Unknown")),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional", "Unknown")),
    diet_assoc_binary = factor(diet_assoc_binary, levels = c("Diet-associated", "Not diet-associated"))
  )

figC_label_map <- setNames(figC_row_anno$row_label, figC_row_anno$ASV)

p_figC_row_class <- ggplot(figC_row_anno, aes(x = "Class", y = ASV, fill = asv_class)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +

  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +

p_figC_row_subtype <- ggplot(figC_row_anno, aes(x = "Subtype", y = ASV, fill = subtype)) +

  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 5.5, 0))

p_figC_row_diet <- ggplot(figC_row_anno, aes(x = "Diet assoc.", y = ASV, fill = diet_assoc_binary)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diet_assoc_binary_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 5.5, 0))

p_figC_matrix <- ggplot(figC_tbl, aes(x = food_category, y = ASV)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = fill_state), color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(
    data = figC_tbl %>% filter(detected_and_matched),
    shape = 16,
    size = 2.2,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Not detected" = "grey95", "Detected" = "#4E79A7"),
    name = "Exact match"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = figC_label_map, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "C. Side-dish category-level exact matches and diet concordance",
    subtitle = "Blue tile = exact match detected in at least one side-dish sample of that category. Black point = detected category matched an ASV-associated diet category.",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  base_theme_final +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 0)
  )

p_figC_left <- p_figC_row_class | p_figC_row_subtype | p_figC_row_diet

p_figC <- wrap_plots(
  p_figC_left,
  p_figC_matrix,
  ncol = 2
) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(0.55, 10))

print(p_figC)

figC_height <- max(7, 0.16 * nrow(informative_asv_tbl) + 2)

save_plot_both(
  p_figC,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_FINAL, "plots", "Main_C_category_level_exact_match_diet_concordance_matrix"),
  width = 12,
  height = figC_height
)

# =========================================================
# Supplementary Figure D: full ASV x all side-dish sample matrix
#   Row = all sharing-related ASVs
#   Column = all side-dish samples
#   Cell = exact match detected
# =========================================================
sample_col_order <- food_meta %>%
  mutate(
    Category_1 = factor(Category_1, levels = diet_vars_order),

  ) %>%

full_asv_order_tbl <- asv_summary_tbl %>%

suppD_tbl <- plot_grid_tbl %>%

suppD_row_anno <- full_asv_order_tbl %>%

  )

suppD_label_map <- setNames(suppD_row_anno$row_label, suppD_row_anno$ASV)

suppD_col_anno <- food_meta %>%
  mutate(

p_suppD_col_group <- ggplot(suppD_col_anno, aes(x = Variable_ID, y = "Group", fill = Group)) +

p_suppD_col_cat1 <- ggplot(suppD_col_anno, aes(x = Variable_ID, y = "Category 1", fill = Category_1)) +

p_suppD_row_class <- ggplot(suppD_row_anno, aes(x = "Class", y = ASV, fill = asv_class)) +

p_suppD_row_subtype <- ggplot(suppD_row_anno, aes(x = "Subtype", y = ASV, fill = subtype)) +

p_suppD_row_diet <- ggplot(suppD_row_anno, aes(x = "Diet assoc.", y = ASV, fill = diet_assoc_binary)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +

p_suppD_matrix <- ggplot(suppD_tbl, aes(x = Variable_ID, y = ASV)) +

  ) +

  ) +

  ) +

    x = NULL,

  ) +

p_suppD_top <- p_suppD_col_group / p_suppD_col_cat1 / p_suppD_col_cat2 +

p_suppD_left <- p_suppD_row_class | p_suppD_row_subtype | p_suppD_row_diet

p_suppD_body <- wrap_plots(
  plot_spacer(),
  p_suppD_top,
  p_suppD_left,
  p_suppD_matrix,
  ncol = 2
) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(0.55, 10), heights = c(0.28, 10))

print(p_suppD_body)

suppD_height <- max(8, 0.12 * nrow(full_asv_order_tbl) + 3)
suppD_width <- max(14, 0.18 * length(sample_col_order) + 7)

save_plot_both(

)

write_csv(

)

write_csv(

)

write_csv(

)

write_csv(

)

write_csv(
  asv_summary_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_FINAL, "tables", "Supp_E_full_ASV_level_screening_summary.csv")
)

write_csv(
  category_grid_tbl,

)

write_csv(

)

write_csv(

)

write_csv(
  informative_asv_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_FINAL, "tables", "Main_C_informative_ASV_order.csv")
)

write_csv(
  full_asv_order_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_FINAL, "tables", "Supp_D_full_matrix_ASV_order.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 15) Console summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n===== Final food exact-match + diet concordance analysis finished =====\n")
cat("Output directory: ", OUTDIR_FOOD_FINAL, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Detection cutoff: ", food_detection_cutoff, " (0.1% if relative abundance; >0 if PA matrix)\n", sep = "")
cat("No. sharing-related ASVs: ", n_distinct(asv_summary_tbl$ASV), "\n", sep = "")
cat("No. side-dish samples: ", n_distinct(food_meta$Variable_ID), "\n", sep = "")
cat("No. food-detected ASVs: ", sum(asv_summary_tbl$food_detected), "\n", sep = "")
cat("No. diet-associated ASVs: ", sum(asv_summary_tbl$diet_associated), "\n", sep = "")
cat("No. informative ASVs in Main Fig. C: ", nrow(informative_asv_tbl), "\n", sep = "")

cat("\nEvidence status summary:\n")
print(
  asv_summary_tbl %>%
    count(evidence_status, name = "n_asvs")
)

cat("\nASV class x evidence status:\n")
print(
  asv_summary_tbl %>%
    count(asv_class, evidence_status, name = "n_asvs") %>%
    arrange(asv_class, evidence_status)
)

cat("\nSaved main plots:\n")
cat("- plots/Main_A_ASV_level_evidence_summary.png/.svg\n")
cat("- plots/Main_B_ASV_class_evidence_breakdown.png/.svg\n")
cat("- plots/Main_C_category_level_exact_match_diet_concordance_matrix.png/.svg\n")

cat("\nSaved supplementary outputs:\n")

cat("- tables/Supp_E_full_ASV_level_screening_summary.csv\n")
```

# 반찬 최종
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Clean side-dish microbiome exact-match and concordance analysis
#
# Outputs:
#   1) exact_match_sample_matrix
#   2) category_concordance_matrix
#   3) category_concordance_heatmap
#   4) asv_concordance_barplot
#
# Input files:
#   metadata_food_microbiome.csv
#   rawdata_food_microbiome.csv
#   sharing_asv.csv
#
# Optional existing objects:
#   global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh
#   asv_subtype_tbl
#   cor_result_tbl
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(forcats)
  library(stringi)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_meta_file <- "metadata_food_microbiome.csv"
food_raw_file  <- "rawdata_food_microbiome.csv"
sharing_file   <- "sharing_asv.csv"

stopifnot(file.exists(food_meta_file))
stopifnot(file.exists(food_raw_file))
stopifnot(file.exists(sharing_file))

OUTDIR_FOOD_CLEAN <- "food_microbiome_concordance_clean"
dir.create(OUTDIR_FOOD_CLEAN, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_CLEAN, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_CLEAN, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# If rawdata_food_microbiome.csv is a 0-1 relative abundance table,
# 0.001 = 0.1%.
# If it is already a presence/absence table, values > 0 are detected.
food_detection_cutoff <- 0.001

# Diet association criterion
# "FDR"  = p_adj_bh < cutoff
# "rawP" = p_value < cutoff
diet_assoc_mode <- "FDR"
diet_assoc_p_cutoff <- 0.05

# "positive" = rho > 0 only
# "both"     = positive and negative associations
diet_assoc_direction_keep <- "positive"

diet_vars_order <- c(
  "Vegetables",
  "Namul",
  "Kimchi",
  "Mushrooms",
  "Seaweed",
  "Seafood",
  "Fish",
  "Meat",
  "Fruit",
  "Beverages"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
clean_seq <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    str_to_upper() %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", "")
}

reverse_complement <- function(seq) {
  seq <- clean_seq(seq)
  comp <- chartr("ACGTURYKMSWBDHVN", "TGCAAYRMKSWVHDBN", seq)
  stringi::stri_reverse(comp)
}

standardize_names <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    rename_with(~ str_trim(.x)) %>%
    rename_with(~ str_replace_all(.x, "\\s+", "_"))
}

make_row_label <- function(label, ASV) {
  label <- as.character(label)
  ASV <- as.character(ASV)
  label[is.na(label) | label == ""] <- ASV[is.na(label) | label == ""]
  
  out <- mapply(function(lab, asv) {
    lab2 <- str_replace(lab, paste0("\\s*\\|\\s*", asv, "$"), "")
    paste0(lab2, " | ", asv)
  }, label, ASV, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  
  as.character(out)
}

split_semicolon <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- "None"
  str_split(x, ";")
}

expand_palette <- function(pal, observed_levels) {
  observed_levels <- observed_levels[!is.na(observed_levels) & observed_levels != ""]
  extra_levels <- setdiff(observed_levels, names(pal))
  if (length(extra_levels) > 0) {
    extra_cols <- scales::hue_pal()(length(extra_levels))
    names(extra_cols) <- extra_levels
    pal <- c(pal, extra_cols)
  }
  pal
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

write_csv_kor <- function(x, file) {
  readr::write_excel_csv(x, file)
}

base_theme_clean <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
    plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 6)
  )

make_title_plot <- function(title, subtitle = NULL, title_size = 16, subtitle_size = 10.5) {
  subtitle <- ifelse(is.null(subtitle), "", subtitle)
  
  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.82,
      label = title,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = title_size / ggplot2::.pt,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.25,
      label = subtitle,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = subtitle_size / ggplot2::.pt,
      color = "grey30"
    ) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(2, 5.5, 2, 5.5))
}

make_tile_legend <- function(pal, title, ncol = 1, text_size = 2.8, title_size = 10) {
  pal <- pal[!is.na(names(pal))]
  if (length(pal) == 0) return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  
  leg_df <- tibble(
    label = names(pal),
    idx = seq_along(label)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      col = ((idx - 1) %% ncol) + 1,
      row = ceiling(idx / ncol),
      row = max(row) - row + 1
    )
  
  ggplot(leg_df, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = label)) +
    geom_tile(width = 0.35, height = 0.35, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), nudge_x = 0.25, hjust = 0, size = text_size) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0.6, ncol + 4.8),
      ylim = c(0.4, max(leg_df$row) + 0.6),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}

make_point_legend <- function(title = "Matrix cell", label = "Exact ASV match") {
  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "point",
      x = 0.15,
      y = 0.72,
      shape = 21,
      size = 3.1,
      stroke = 0.4,
      color = "black",
      fill = "white"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.33,
      y = 0.72,
      label = label,
      hjust = 0,
      size = 2.8
    ) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}

make_fill_point_legend <- function() {
  tile_df <- tibble(
    label = c("Not detected", "Detected"),
    x = 1,
    y = c(2, 1)
  )
  
  p1 <- ggplot(tile_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = label)) +
    geom_tile(width = 0.35, height = 0.35, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), nudge_x = 0.25, hjust = 0, size = 2.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Not detected" = "grey95", "Detected" = "#4E79A7"),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.7, 3.8), ylim = c(0.5, 2.5), clip = "off") +
    labs(title = "Exact match") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
  
  p2 <- ggplot() +
    annotate("point", x = 0.15, y = 0.7, shape = 16, size = 2.4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.33, y = 0.7, label = "Match", hjust = 0, size = 2.8) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    labs(title = "Concordance") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
  
  p1 / p2 + plot_layout(heights = c(1.2, 0.9))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Load food metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_meta_raw <- read_csv(
  food_meta_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) %>%
  standardize_names()

# If Korean_name is already broken in R, use CP949 instead:
# food_meta_raw <- read_csv(food_meta_file, show_col_types = FALSE, locale = locale(encoding = "CP949")) %>%
#   standardize_names()

required_meta_cols <- c(
  "Variable_ID",
  "Dish_ID",
  "Group",
  "Korean_name",
  "Full_English_name",
  "Figure_label",
  "Plot_label",
  "Category_1",
  "Category_2"
)

missing_meta_cols <- setdiff(required_meta_cols, names(food_meta_raw))
if (length(missing_meta_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing columns in metadata_food_microbiome.csv after standardization: ",
    paste(missing_meta_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

food_meta <- food_meta_raw %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(required_meta_cols), as.character),
    Category_1 = ifelse(is.na(Category_1) | Category_1 == "", "None", Category_1),
    Category_2 = ifelse(is.na(Category_2) | Category_2 == "", "None", Category_2),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Control", "Fermented"))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Load food microbiome table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_raw <- read_csv(
  food_raw_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_trim(.x))

if (!"seq" %in% names(food_raw)) {
  stop("rawdata_food_microbiome.csv must contain a 'seq' column.")
}

if (!"Taxon" %in% names(food_raw)) {
  food_raw <- food_raw %>%
    mutate(Taxon = NA_character_, .before = 1)
}

food_sample_cols <- intersect(food_meta$Variable_ID, names(food_raw))

if (length(food_sample_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No food sample columns matched between rawdata_food_microbiome.csv and metadata_food_microbiome.csv.")
}

food_asv_tbl <- food_raw %>%
  mutate(
    food_taxon = as.character(Taxon),
    food_seq = clean_seq(seq),
    food_seq_rc = reverse_complement(food_seq)
  ) %>%
  select(food_taxon, food_seq, food_seq_rc, all_of(food_sample_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(food_sample_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))))

food_abund_mat <- food_asv_tbl %>%
  select(all_of(food_sample_cols)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

food_abund_mat[] <- lapply(food_abund_mat, function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)))
food_abund_mat <- as.matrix(food_abund_mat)

food_abund_check <- tibble(
  min_value = min(food_abund_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_value = max(food_abund_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_colsum = median(colSums(food_abund_mat, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
)

cat("\n===== Food microbiome abundance scale check =====\n")
print(food_abund_check)
cat("Detection cutoff:", food_detection_cutoff, "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Load sharing ASVs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sharing_raw <- read_csv(
  sharing_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_trim(.x))

if (!all(c("ASV", "seq") %in% names(sharing_raw))) {
  stop("sharing_asv.csv must contain at least 'ASV' and 'seq' columns.")
}

if (!"label" %in% names(sharing_raw)) {
  sharing_raw <- sharing_raw %>%
    mutate(label = ASV)
}

if (!"type" %in% names(sharing_raw)) {
  sharing_raw <- sharing_raw %>%
    mutate(type = NA_character_)
}

sharing_asv <- sharing_raw %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    label = as.character(label),
    type = as.character(type),
    human_seq = clean_seq(seq),
    human_seq_rc = reverse_complement(human_seq),
    asv_class_from_file = case_when(
      str_detect(str_to_lower(type), "global") ~ "Global core",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(type), "village") ~ "Village-enriched",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    label,
    type,
    asv_class_from_file,
    human_seq,
    human_seq_rc
  ) %>%
  distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Add ASV class and subtype annotation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtype_annot_list <- list()

if (exists("global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh")) {
  subtype_annot_list[["global_core"]] <- global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = as.character(ASV),
      asv_class_from_object = "Global core",
      subtype = as.character(subtype)
    )
}

if (exists("asv_subtype_tbl")) {
  subtype_annot_list[["village_enriched"]] <- asv_subtype_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = as.character(ASV),
      asv_class_from_object = "Village-enriched",
      subtype = as.character(subtype)
    )
}

if (length(subtype_annot_list) > 0) {
  subtype_annot <- bind_rows(subtype_annot_list) %>%
    mutate(
      subtype = case_when(
        str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype), "single") ~ "single",
        str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype), "nearby") ~ "nearby",
        str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype), "regional") ~ "regional",
        TRUE ~ subtype
      )
    ) %>%
    distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
    left_join(subtype_annot, by = "ASV")
} else {
  sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
    mutate(
      asv_class_from_object = NA_character_,
      subtype = NA_character_
    )
}

sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
  mutate(
    asv_class = coalesce(asv_class_from_object, asv_class_from_file),
    subtype = ifelse(is.na(subtype) | subtype == "", NA_character_, subtype),
    asv_class = factor(asv_class, levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched")),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional")),
    row_label = make_row_label(label, ASV)
  )

if (any(is.na(sharing_asv$asv_class))) {
  warning("Some ASVs have missing asv_class. Check sharing_asv$type or subtype annotation objects.")
}

if (any(is.na(sharing_asv$subtype))) {
  warning("Some ASVs have missing subtype. Check global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh or asv_subtype_tbl.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Add diet association annotation from cor_result_tbl
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (
  exists("cor_result_tbl") &&
  all(c("ASV", "variable_group", "variable_label", "rho", "p_value", "p_adj_bh") %in% names(cor_result_tbl))
) {
  
  diet_assoc_base <- cor_result_tbl %>%
    filter(
      ASV %in% sharing_asv$ASV,
      variable_group == "Diet",
      variable_label %in% diet_vars_order
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      sig_for_annotation = case_when(
        diet_assoc_mode == "FDR" ~ !is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_assoc_p_cutoff,
        diet_assoc_mode == "rawP" ~ !is.na(p_value) & p_value < diet_assoc_p_cutoff,
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      ),
      direction = case_when(
        rho > 0 ~ "Positive",
        rho < 0 ~ "Negative",
        TRUE ~ "No change"
      )
    )
  
  if (diet_assoc_direction_keep == "positive") {
    diet_assoc_base <- diet_assoc_base %>%
      filter(rho > 0)
  }
  
  diet_assoc_tbl <- diet_assoc_base %>%
    filter(sig_for_annotation) %>%
    arrange(ASV, p_adj_bh, p_value, desc(abs(rho))) %>%
    group_by(ASV) %>%
    summarise(
      n_diet_assoc = n(),
      diet_assoc_categories = paste(sort(unique(variable_label)), collapse = ";"),
      diet_assoc_directions = paste(sort(unique(direction)), collapse = ";"),
      top_diet_category = first(variable_label),
      top_diet_direction = first(direction),
      top_diet_rho = first(rho),
      top_diet_p = first(p_value),
      top_diet_fdr = first(p_adj_bh),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
} else {
  
  warning(
    "cor_result_tbl was not found or lacked required columns. ",
    "All ASVs will be treated as not diet-associated."
  )
  
  diet_assoc_tbl <- tibble(
    ASV = sharing_asv$ASV,
    n_diet_assoc = 0L,
    diet_assoc_categories = "None",
    diet_assoc_directions = "None",
    top_diet_category = "None",
    top_diet_direction = "None",
    top_diet_rho = NA_real_,
    top_diet_p = NA_real_,
    top_diet_fdr = NA_real_
  )
}

sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
  left_join(diet_assoc_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    n_diet_assoc = replace_na(n_diet_assoc, 0L),
    diet_assoc_categories = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_categories) | diet_assoc_categories == "", "None", diet_assoc_categories),
    diet_assoc_directions = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_directions) | diet_assoc_directions == "", "None", diet_assoc_directions),
    top_diet_category = ifelse(is.na(top_diet_category) | top_diet_category == "", "None", top_diet_category),
    top_diet_direction = ifelse(is.na(top_diet_direction) | top_diet_direction == "", "None", top_diet_direction),
    diet_assoc_binary = ifelse(n_diet_assoc > 0, "Diet-associated", "Not diet-associated")
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Exact sequence matching
# ---------------------------------------------------------
match_direct <- food_asv_tbl %>%
  inner_join(
    sharing_asv,
    by = c("food_seq" = "human_seq")
  ) %>%
  mutate(match_orientation = "direct")

match_revcomp <- food_asv_tbl %>%
  inner_join(
    sharing_asv,
    by = c("food_seq" = "human_seq_rc")
  ) %>%
  mutate(match_orientation = "reverse_complement")

food_match_wide <- bind_rows(match_direct, match_revcomp) %>%
  distinct(ASV, food_seq, match_orientation, .keep_all = TRUE)

if (nrow(food_match_wide) > 0) {
  food_match_long <- food_match_wide %>%
    select(
      ASV,
      label,
      row_label,
      type,
      asv_class,
      subtype,
      diet_assoc_binary,
      n_diet_assoc,
      diet_assoc_categories,
      diet_assoc_directions,
      top_diet_category,
      top_diet_direction,
      top_diet_rho,
      top_diet_p,
      top_diet_fdr,
      food_taxon,
      food_seq,
      match_orientation,
      all_of(food_sample_cols)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(food_sample_cols),
      names_to = "Variable_ID",
      values_to = "abundance"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      abundance = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(abundance)),
      detected = !is.na(abundance) & abundance >= food_detection_cutoff
    ) %>%
    left_join(food_meta, by = "Variable_ID")
} else {
  food_match_long <- tibble()
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Full ASV x food sample grid
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sample_grid_tbl <- tidyr::crossing(
  ASV = sharing_asv$ASV,
  Variable_ID = food_meta$Variable_ID
) %>%
  left_join(
    sharing_asv %>%
      select(
        ASV,
        label,
        row_label,
        type,
        asv_class,
        subtype,
        diet_assoc_binary,
        n_diet_assoc,
        diet_assoc_categories,
        diet_assoc_directions,
        top_diet_category,
        top_diet_direction,
        top_diet_rho,
        top_diet_p,
        top_diet_fdr
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(food_meta, by = "Variable_ID") %>%
  left_join(
    food_match_long %>%
      filter(detected) %>%
      group_by(ASV, Variable_ID) %>%
      summarise(
        detected = TRUE,
        n_matched_food_seq = n_distinct(food_seq),
        food_taxon = paste(unique(na.omit(food_taxon)), collapse = ";"),
        match_orientation = paste(unique(match_orientation), collapse = ";"),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("ASV", "Variable_ID")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    detected = replace_na(detected, FALSE),
    n_matched_food_seq = replace_na(n_matched_food_seq, 0L),
    n_diet_assoc = replace_na(n_diet_assoc, 0L),
    diet_assoc_categories = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_categories) | diet_assoc_categories == "", "None", diet_assoc_categories),
    diet_assoc_binary = ifelse(n_diet_assoc > 0, "Diet-associated", "Not diet-associated")
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Category-level detection using Category_1 and Category_2
# ---------------------------------------------------------
detected_pair_tbl <- sample_grid_tbl %>%
  filter(detected) %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    label,
    row_label,
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    diet_assoc_binary,
    n_diet_assoc,
    diet_assoc_categories,
    top_diet_category,
    top_diet_direction,
    Variable_ID,
    Dish_ID,
    Group,
    Korean_name,
    Figure_label,
    Plot_label,
    Category_1,
    Category_2,
    detected,
    n_matched_food_seq
  )

detected_food_category_long <- detected_pair_tbl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Category_1, Category_2),
    names_to = "food_category_source",
    values_to = "food_category"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    food_category = ifelse(is.na(food_category) | food_category == "", "None", food_category)
  ) %>%
  filter(food_category != "None") %>%
  distinct(ASV, Variable_ID, food_category, .keep_all = TRUE)

asv_food_category_tbl <- detected_food_category_long %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    detected_food_categories = paste(sort(unique(food_category)), collapse = ";"),
    n_detected_food_categories = n_distinct(food_category),
    n_detected_food_samples = n_distinct(Variable_ID),
    n_detected_food_dishes = n_distinct(Dish_ID),
    detected_food_sample_ids = paste(sort(unique(Variable_ID)), collapse = ";"),
    detected_food_dish_ids = paste(sort(unique(Dish_ID)), collapse = ";"),
    detected_food_names = paste(sort(unique(Korean_name)), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) ASV-level concordance classification
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_summary_tbl <- sharing_asv %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    label,
    row_label,
    type,
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    diet_assoc_binary,
    n_diet_assoc,
    diet_assoc_categories,
    diet_assoc_directions,
    top_diet_category,
    top_diet_direction,
    top_diet_rho,
    top_diet_p,
    top_diet_fdr
  ) %>%
  left_join(asv_food_category_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    detected_food_categories = ifelse(is.na(detected_food_categories) | detected_food_categories == "", "None", detected_food_categories),
    n_detected_food_categories = replace_na(n_detected_food_categories, 0L),
    n_detected_food_samples = replace_na(n_detected_food_samples, 0L),
    n_detected_food_dishes = replace_na(n_detected_food_dishes, 0L),
    detected_food_sample_ids = ifelse(is.na(detected_food_sample_ids), "", detected_food_sample_ids),
    detected_food_dish_ids = ifelse(is.na(detected_food_dish_ids), "", detected_food_dish_ids),
    detected_food_names = ifelse(is.na(detected_food_names), "", detected_food_names),
    food_detected = n_detected_food_samples > 0,
    diet_associated = n_diet_assoc > 0,
    diet_assoc_list = split_semicolon(diet_assoc_categories),
    food_category_list = split_semicolon(detected_food_categories),
    category_concordant = mapply(
      function(diet_vec, food_vec) {
        diet_vec <- diet_vec[!is.na(diet_vec) & diet_vec != "" & diet_vec != "None"]
        food_vec <- food_vec[!is.na(food_vec) & food_vec != "" & food_vec != "None"]
        length(intersect(diet_vec, food_vec)) > 0
      },
      diet_assoc_list,
      food_category_list
    ),
    concordance_status = case_when(
      diet_associated & food_detected & category_concordant ~ "Concordant",
      diet_associated & food_detected & !category_concordant ~ "Discordant",
      !diet_associated & food_detected ~ "Food-detected only",
      diet_associated & !food_detected ~ "Diet-associated only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    concordance_status = factor(
      concordance_status,
      levels = c(
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant",
        "Diet-associated only",
        "Food-detected only",
        "Neither"
      )
    ),
    asv_class = factor(as.character(asv_class), levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched")),
    subtype = factor(as.character(subtype), levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional")),
    diet_assoc_binary = factor(diet_assoc_binary, levels = c("Diet-associated", "Not diet-associated"))
  ) %>%
  select(-diet_assoc_list, -food_category_list)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Category-level grid for concordance matrix
# ---------------------------------------------------------
category_grid_tbl <- expand_grid(
  ASV = asv_summary_tbl$ASV,
  food_category = diet_vars_order
) %>%
  left_join(
    asv_summary_tbl %>%
      select(
        ASV,
        label,
        row_label,
        type,
        asv_class,
        subtype,
        diet_assoc_binary,
        diet_associated,
        food_detected,
        concordance_status,
        n_diet_assoc,
        diet_assoc_categories,
        detected_food_categories,
        n_detected_food_samples,
        n_detected_food_categories
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    detected_food_category_long %>%
      filter(food_category %in% diet_vars_order) %>%
      group_by(ASV, food_category) %>%
      summarise(
        detected_in_category = TRUE,
        n_category_samples = n_distinct(Variable_ID),
        n_category_dishes = n_distinct(Dish_ID),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("ASV", "food_category")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    detected_in_category = replace_na(detected_in_category, FALSE),
    n_category_samples = replace_na(n_category_samples, 0L),
    n_category_dishes = replace_na(n_category_dishes, 0L),
    diet_assoc_categories = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_categories) | diet_assoc_categories == "", "None", diet_assoc_categories)
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    diet_match_category = {
      diet_vec <- unlist(strsplit(diet_assoc_categories, ";"))
      diet_vec <- diet_vec[!is.na(diet_vec) & diet_vec != "" & diet_vec != "None"]
      food_category %in% diet_vec
    },
    detected_and_matched = detected_in_category & diet_match_category
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Select ASVs for matrix plots and barplot
#     Row order:
#       ASV class
#       subtype
#       diet-associated status
#       concordance status
#       detected food category/sample count
#       ASV ID
# ---------------------------------------------------------
selected_asv_tbl <- asv_summary_tbl %>%
  filter(food_detected | diet_associated) %>%
  mutate(
    asv_class = factor(
      as.character(asv_class),
      levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched")
    ),
    subtype = factor(
      as.character(subtype),
      levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional")
    ),
    diet_assoc_binary = factor(
      as.character(diet_assoc_binary),
      levels = c("Diet-associated", "Not diet-associated")
    ),
    concordance_status = factor(
      as.character(concordance_status),
      levels = c(
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant",
        "Diet-associated only",
        "Food-detected only",
        "Neither"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    diet_assoc_binary,
    concordance_status,
    desc(n_detected_food_categories),
    desc(n_detected_food_samples),
    ASV
  )

if (nrow(selected_asv_tbl) == 0) {

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14) Row annotation helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_row_annotations_sample <- function(row_anno_tbl, y_col = "row_id") {
  p_class <- ggplot(row_anno_tbl, aes(x = "Class", y = .data[[y_col]], fill = asv_class)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = class_cols, drop = FALSE, na.value = "grey95") +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 5.5, 5.5))
  
  p_subtype <- ggplot(row_anno_tbl, aes(x = "Subtype", y = .data[[y_col]], fill = subtype)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = subtype_cols, drop = FALSE, na.value = "grey95") +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 5.5, 0))
  
  p_diet <- ggplot(row_anno_tbl, aes(x = "Diet assoc.", y = .data[[y_col]], fill = diet_assoc_binary)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = diet_assoc_binary_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 5.5, 0))
  
  p_class | p_subtype | p_diet
}

make_row_annotations_concordance <- function(row_tbl, y_col = "row_id") {
  ann_df <- row_tbl %>%
    select(all_of(y_col), asv_class, subtype) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(asv_class, subtype),
      names_to = "annotation",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      annotation = factor(
        annotation,
        levels = c("asv_class", "subtype"),
        labels = c("ASV class", "Subtype")
      ),
      value = as.character(value)
    )
  
  ggplot(ann_df, aes(x = annotation, y = .data[[y_col]], fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(class_cols, subtype_cols), drop = FALSE, na.value = "grey95") +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    base_theme_clean +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(0, 2, 5.5, 5.5)
    )
}

  )

diet_assoc_matrix_tbl <- category_row_tbl %>%

  expand_grid(diet_category = diet_vars_order) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    diet_associated_category = {
      diet_vec <- unlist(strsplit(diet_assoc_categories, ";"))
      diet_vec <- diet_vec[!is.na(diet_vec) & diet_vec != "" & diet_vec != "None"]
      diet_category %in% diet_vec
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = category_row_levels),

    diet_assoc_state = ifelse(diet_associated_category, "Associated", "Not associated"),
    diet_assoc_state = factor(diet_assoc_state, levels = c("Not associated", "Associated"))
  )
```
