```{r}
diet_food_pair_tbl <- detected_food_category_long %>%
  filter(ASV %in% asv_summary_tbl$ASV) %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    food_category,
    Variable_ID,
    Dish_ID
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(
    asv_summary_tbl %>%
      select(
        ASV,
        diet_assoc_categories,
        n_diet_assoc,
        diet_associated
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diet_assoc_categories = ifelse(
      is.na(diet_assoc_categories) | diet_assoc_categories == "",
      "None",
      diet_assoc_categories
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    diet_associated,
    diet_assoc_categories != "None"
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(diet_assoc_categories, sep = ";") %>%
  rename(diet_category = diet_assoc_categories) %>%
  filter(
    diet_category %in% diet_vars_order,
    food_category %in% diet_vars_order
  ) %>%
  distinct(ASV, diet_category, food_category)

concordance_heatmap_tbl <- diet_food_pair_tbl %>%
  count(diet_category, food_category, name = "n_asvs") %>%
  complete(
    diet_category = diet_vars_order,
    food_category = diet_vars_order,
    fill = list(n_asvs = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    concordant_cell = diet_category == food_category,
    diet_category = factor(diet_category, levels = rev(diet_vars_order)),
    food_category = factor(food_category, levels = diet_vars_order)
  )

p_concordance_heatmap <- ggplot(
  concordance_heatmap_tbl,
  aes(x = food_category, y = diet_category, fill = n_asvs)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_tile(
    data = concordance_heatmap_tbl %>% filter(concordant_cell),
    aes(x = food_category, y = diet_category),
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(n_asvs > 0, as.character(n_asvs), "")),
    size = 3.6,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#F7FBFF", "#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#08519C"),
    name = "No. ASVs\nper pair"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Category-pair concordance between ASV-associated diets and detected side-dish categories",
    subtitle = "Cell values indicate unique ASVs within each diet-category and side-dish-category pair. Counts are not mutually exclusive.",
    x = "Detected side-dish category",
    y = "ASV-associated diet category"
  ) +
  base_theme_clean +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_concordance_heatmap)

save_plot_both(
  p_concordance_heatmap,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_CLEAN, "plots", "category_concordance_heatmap"),
  width = 8.5,
  height = 7.2
)

# =========================================================
# Plot 4: concordance bar plot
# =========================================================
bar_status_order <- c(
  "Concordant",
  "Discordant",
  "Food-detected only",
  "Diet-associated only"
)

concordance_bar_tbl <- asv_summary_tbl %>%
  filter(food_detected | diet_associated) %>%
  mutate(
    concordance_status = as.character(concordance_status)
  ) %>%
  filter(concordance_status %in% bar_status_order) %>%
  count(concordance_status, name = "n_asvs") %>%
  complete(
    concordance_status = bar_status_order,
    fill = list(n_asvs = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    concordance_status = factor(concordance_status, levels = bar_status_order),
    total = sum(n_asvs),
    pct = ifelse(total > 0, 100 * n_asvs / total, 0),
    label = paste0(n_asvs, "\n(", sprintf("%.1f", pct), "%)")
  )

p_concordance_bar <- ggplot(
  concordance_bar_tbl,
  aes(x = concordance_status, y = n_asvs, fill = concordance_status)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -0.25, size = 3.7, lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = concordance_cols[bar_status_order],
    drop = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
  labs(
    title = "ASV-level food-diet concordance",
    subtitle = "Each ASV was counted once among ASVs that were either diet-associated or detected in side-dish microbiota.",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of ASVs"
  ) +
  base_theme_clean +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_concordance_bar)

save_plot_both(
  p_concordance_bar,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_CLEAN, "plots", "asv_concordance_barplot"),
  width = 8,
  height = 5.2
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 15) Save tables with UTF-8 BOM for Excel Korean compatibility
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv_kor(
  sharing_asv,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_CLEAN, "tables", "sharing_asv_annotation.csv")
)

write_csv_kor(
  food_match_long,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_CLEAN, "tables", "exact_match_long.csv")
)

write_csv_kor(
  sample_grid_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_CLEAN, "tables", "exact_match_sample_matrix_long.csv")
)

write_csv_kor(
  detected_food_category_long,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_CLEAN, "tables", "detected_food_category_long_category1_category2.csv")
)

write_csv_kor(
  asv_summary_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_CLEAN, "tables", "asv_level_concordance_summary.csv")
)

write_csv_kor(
  category_grid_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_CLEAN, "tables", "category_concordance_matrix_long.csv")
)

write_csv_kor(
  concordance_heatmap_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_CLEAN, "tables", "category_concordance_heatmap_data.csv")
)

write_csv_kor(
  concordance_bar_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_CLEAN, "tables", "asv_concordance_barplot_data.csv")
)

write_csv_kor(
  selected_asv_tbl,

)

write_csv_kor(
  diet_food_pair_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FOOD_CLEAN, "tables", "category_pair_concordance_long.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 16) Console summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n===== Clean food microbiome concordance analysis finished =====\n")
cat("Output directory:", OUTDIR_FOOD_CLEAN, "\n")
cat("Detection cutoff:", food_detection_cutoff, "\n")
cat("Total sharing-related ASVs:", n_distinct(sharing_asv$ASV), "\n")

    filter(food_detected | diet_associated) %>%

)

cat("\nSaved plots:\n")
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Define disease-associated sharing-related ASVs for Fig. 6

stopifnot(exists("asv_assoc_tbl"))

  ) %>%

      mean_delta_prev > 0 ~ "Disease-enriched",

    )
  ) %>%
  filter(disease_direction != "No difference") %>%

    any_of(c(
      "n_testable_villages",
      "mean_prev_yes",
      "mean_prev_no",
      "n_villages_positive_delta",
      "n_villages_negative_delta"
    ))
  ) %>%
  distinct()

disease_target_asvs <- disease_sig_pair_tbl %>%
  distinct(ASV)

disease_asv_annot_tbl <- disease_sig_pair_tbl %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%

    n_disease_assoc = n_distinct(disease_var),
    disease_labels = paste(sort(unique(disease_label)), collapse = ";"),
    disease_directions = paste(sort(unique(disease_direction)), collapse = ";"),
    mean_abs_disease_effect = mean(abs(mean_delta_prev), na.rm = TRUE),
    strongest_disease = disease_label[which.max(abs(mean_delta_prev))],
    strongest_disease_direction = disease_direction[which.max(abs(mean_delta_prev))],
    strongest_disease_effect = mean_delta_prev[which.max(abs(mean_delta_prev))],
    strongest_disease_fdr = p_adj_bh[which.max(abs(mean_delta_prev))],

  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_context = case_when(
      disease_directions == "Disease-enriched" ~ "Disease-enriched",
      disease_directions == "Control-enriched" ~ "Control-enriched",
      TRUE ~ "Mixed"
    )
  )

cat("\n===== Disease-associated sharing-related ASV summary =====\n")

    count(disease_context, name = "n_asvs")
)

print(
  disease_sig_pair_tbl %>%
    count(disease_label, disease_direction, name = "n_pairs") %>%
    arrange(disease_label, disease_direction)
)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Disease-associated sharing-related ASV
# diet / side-dish microbiome context analysis
#
# Required objects from previous analyses:
#   asv_assoc_tbl
#   asv_summary_tbl
#   category_grid_tbl
#   detected_food_category_long
#   cor_result_tbl
#   diet_vars_order
#   class_cols
#   subtype_cols
#
# Optional existing functions:
#   save_plot_both()
#   write_csv_kor()
#
# Main outputs:
#   1) disease_associated_asv_diet_heatmap
#   2) disease_associated_asv_food_diet_concordance_matrix
#   3) disease_associated_asv_evidence_barplot
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(stringr)
  library(scales)
  library(readr)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Output directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------
OUTDIR_DISEASE_FOOD <- "disease_associated_asv_food_diet_context"
dir.create(OUTDIR_DISEASE_FOOD, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_FOOD, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_FOOD, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Check required objects
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs <- c(
  "asv_assoc_tbl",
  "asv_summary_tbl",
  "category_grid_tbl",
  "detected_food_category_long",
  "cor_result_tbl",
  "diet_vars_order",
  "class_cols",
  "subtype_cols"
)

missing_objs <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1))]
if (length(missing_objs) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required objects: ", paste(missing_objs, collapse = ", "))
}

if (!exists("save_plot_both")) {
  save_plot_both <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
      plot = plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = dpi,
      bg = bg,
      limitsize = FALSE
    )
    
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
      plot = plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      bg = bg,
      limitsize = FALSE
    )
  }
}

if (!exists("write_csv_kor")) {
  write_csv_kor <- function(x, file) {
    readr::write_excel_csv(x, file)
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Define disease-associated sharing-related ASVs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_sig_pair_tbl <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
  filter(
    if ("sig" %in% names(.)) {
      sig == "sig"
    } else {
      is.finite(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < 0.05
    }
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_direction = case_when(
      mean_delta_prev > 0 ~ "Disease-enriched",
      mean_delta_prev < 0 ~ "Control-enriched",
      TRUE ~ "No difference"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(disease_direction != "No difference") %>%
  select(
    disease_var,
    disease_label,
    ASV,
    label,
    type,
    mean_delta_prev,
    median_delta_prev,
    p_adj_bh,
    disease_direction,
    any_of(c(
      "n_testable_villages",
      "mean_prev_yes",
      "mean_prev_no",
      "n_villages_positive_delta",
      "n_villages_negative_delta"
    ))
  ) %>%
  distinct()

disease_target_asvs <- disease_sig_pair_tbl %>%
  distinct(ASV)

disease_asv_annot_tbl <- disease_sig_pair_tbl %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    n_disease_assoc = n_distinct(disease_var),
    disease_labels = paste(sort(unique(disease_label)), collapse = ";"),
    disease_directions = paste(sort(unique(disease_direction)), collapse = ";"),
    mean_abs_disease_effect = mean(abs(mean_delta_prev), na.rm = TRUE),
    strongest_disease = disease_label[which.max(abs(mean_delta_prev))],
    strongest_disease_direction = disease_direction[which.max(abs(mean_delta_prev))],
    strongest_disease_effect = mean_delta_prev[which.max(abs(mean_delta_prev))],
    strongest_disease_fdr = p_adj_bh[which.max(abs(mean_delta_prev))],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_context = case_when(
      disease_directions == "Disease-enriched" ~ "Disease-enriched",
      disease_directions == "Control-enriched" ~ "Control-enriched",
      TRUE ~ "Mixed"
    )
  )

cat("\n===== Disease-associated sharing-related ASV summary =====\n")
cat("Significant disease-ASV pairs:", nrow(disease_sig_pair_tbl), "\n")
cat("Unique disease-associated ASVs:", nrow(disease_target_asvs), "\n\n")

print(
  disease_asv_annot_tbl %>%
    count(disease_context, name = "n_asvs")
)

write_csv_kor(
  disease_sig_pair_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_FOOD, "tables", "disease_significant_asv_pairs.csv")
)

write_csv_kor(
  disease_asv_annot_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_FOOD, "tables", "disease_associated_asv_annotation.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Merge disease annotation into food/diet summary table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_asv_summary_tbl <- asv_summary_tbl %>%
  filter(ASV %in% disease_target_asvs$ASV) %>%
  left_join(disease_asv_annot_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    asv_class = factor(
      as.character(asv_class),
      levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched")
    ),
    subtype = factor(
      as.character(subtype),
      levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional")
    ),
    diet_assoc_binary = factor(
      as.character(diet_assoc_binary),
      levels = c("Diet-associated", "Not diet-associated")
    ),
    concordance_status = factor(
      as.character(concordance_status),
      levels = c(
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant",
        "Diet-associated only",
        "Food-detected only",
        "Neither"
      )
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Drop unused disease direction levels automatically
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_context_cols_full <- c(
  "Control-enriched" = "#3C5488",   
  "Disease-enriched" = "#BC3C29",   
  "Mixed" = "#6A3D9A"               
)

observed_disease_context <- disease_asv_summary_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(disease_context)) %>%
  pull(disease_context) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  unique()

observed_disease_context <- intersect(
  c("Control-enriched", "Disease-enriched", "Mixed"),
  observed_disease_context
)

disease_context_cols <- disease_context_cols_full[observed_disease_context]

disease_asv_summary_tbl <- disease_asv_summary_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    disease_context = factor(
      as.character(disease_context),
      levels = observed_disease_context
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Final ASV row ordering
#     ASV class -> subtype -> disease direction -> diet/food evidence
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_asv_summary_tbl <- disease_asv_summary_tbl %>%
  arrange(
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    disease_context,
    diet_assoc_binary,
    concordance_status,
    desc(n_detected_food_categories),
    desc(n_detected_food_samples),
    ASV
  )

disease_row_tbl <- disease_asv_summary_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = paste0(row_label, "__", ASV),
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = rev(paste0(row_label, "__", ASV))),
    disease_context = factor(as.character(disease_context), levels = observed_disease_context),
    asv_class = factor(as.character(asv_class), levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched")),
    subtype = factor(as.character(subtype), levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional"))
  )

disease_row_levels <- levels(disease_row_tbl$row_id)
disease_label_map <- setNames(disease_row_tbl$row_label, disease_row_tbl$row_id)

write_csv_kor(
  disease_asv_summary_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_FOOD, "tables", "disease_associated_asv_food_diet_summary.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Palettes and theme
# ---------------------------------------------------------
evidence_cols <- c(
  "Concordant" = "#D55E00",
  "Discordant" = "#999999",
  "Food-detected only" = "#0072B2",
  "Diet-associated only" = "#009E73",
  "Neither" = "grey85"
)

base_theme_disease_food <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9.5, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
    plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 6)
  )

make_tile_legend2 <- function(pal, title, ncol = 1, text_size = 2.8, title_size = 10) {
  pal <- pal[!is.na(names(pal))]
  if (length(pal) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  }
  
  leg_df <- tibble(
    label = names(pal),
    idx = seq_along(label)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      col = ((idx - 1) %% ncol) + 1,
      row = ceiling(idx / ncol),
      row = max(row) - row + 1
    )
  
  ggplot(leg_df, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = label)) +
    geom_tile(width = 0.35, height = 0.35, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), nudge_x = 0.25, hjust = 0, size = text_size) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0.6, ncol + 4.8),
      ylim = c(0.4, max(leg_df$row) + 0.6),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}

make_star_legend <- function(title = "Significance", label = "FDR < 0.05") {
  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.15,
      y = 0.7,
      label = "*",
      size = 5,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.33,
      y = 0.7,
      label = label,
      hjust = 0,
      size = 2.8
    ) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}

make_fill_point_legend_disease <- function() {
  p_exact <- make_tile_legend2(
    c("Not detected" = "grey95", "Detected" = "#4E79A7"),
    "Exact match"
  )
  
  p_assoc <- make_tile_legend2(
    c("Not associated" = "grey95", "Associated" = "#CC79A7"),
    "Associated diet"
  )
  
  p_match <- ggplot() +
    annotate("point", x = 0.15, y = 0.7, shape = 16, size = 2.4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.33, y = 0.7, label = "Match", hjust = 0, size = 2.8) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    labs(title = "Concordance") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
  
  p_exact / p_assoc / p_match +
    plot_layout(heights = c(0.9, 0.9, 0.8))
}

make_row_annotations_disease <- function(row_tbl, y_col = "row_id") {
  ann_df <- row_tbl %>%
    select(all_of(y_col), asv_class, subtype, disease_context) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(asv_class, subtype, disease_context),
      names_to = "annotation",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      annotation = factor(
        annotation,
        levels = c("asv_class", "subtype", "disease_context"),
        labels = c("ASV class", "Subtype", "Disease direction")
      ),
      value = as.character(value)
    )
  
  ggplot(ann_df, aes(x = annotation, y = .data[[y_col]], fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(class_cols, subtype_cols, disease_context_cols),
      drop = TRUE,
      na.value = "grey95"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    base_theme_disease_food +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 2, 5.5, 5.5)
    )
}

# =========================================================
# Plot 1: disease-associated ASV x diet association heatmap
# =========================================================

diet_heatmap_tbl <- cor_result_tbl %>%
  filter(
    ASV %in% disease_target_asvs$ASV,
    variable_group == "Diet",
    variable_label %in% diet_vars_order
  ) %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    variable_label,
    rho,
    p_value,
    p_adj_bh
  ) %>%
  right_join(
    disease_row_tbl %>%
      select(
        ASV,
        row_id,
        row_label,
        disease_context,
        asv_class,
        subtype
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variable_label = factor(variable_label, levels = diet_vars_order),
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = disease_row_levels),
    sig_fdr = !is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < 0.05,
    sig_positive = sig_fdr & !is.na(rho) & rho > 0,
    sig_negative = sig_fdr & !is.na(rho) & rho < 0
  ) %>%
  complete(
    row_id,
    variable_label = factor(diet_vars_order, levels = diet_vars_order),
    fill = list(
      rho = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      p_adj_bh = NA_real_,
      sig_fdr = FALSE,
      sig_positive = FALSE,
      sig_negative = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    disease_row_tbl %>%
      select(row_id, ASV, row_label, disease_context, asv_class, subtype),
    by = "row_id",
    suffix = c("", ".y")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = coalesce(ASV, ASV.y),
    row_label = coalesce(row_label, row_label.y),
    disease_context = coalesce(disease_context, disease_context.y),
    asv_class = coalesce(asv_class, asv_class.y),
    subtype = coalesce(subtype, subtype.y),
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = disease_row_levels),
    variable_label = factor(variable_label, levels = diet_vars_order)
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".y"))

p_diet_left <- make_row_annotations_disease(disease_row_tbl, y_col = "row_id")

p_diet_heatmap <- ggplot(diet_heatmap_tbl, aes(x = variable_label, y = row_id)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = rho), color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(
    data = diet_heatmap_tbl %>% filter(sig_fdr),
    aes(label = "*"),
    color = "black",
    size = 4.2,
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = 0.55
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",

    midpoint = 0,

  ) +

  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Diet associations of disease-associated sharing-related ASVs",
    subtitle = "Rows show disease-associated sharing-related ASVs. Asterisks indicate FDR-significant ASV-diet associations.",
    x = "Dietary frequency variable",

    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),

  )
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Disease-associated sharing-related ASV
# ASV-centered integrated evidence analysis
#
# Main logic:
#   Fig. 5 disease-associated sharing-related ASVs
#   -> diet association
#   -> side-dish microbiome exact sequence match
#   -> integrated ASV-level evidence heatmap + overlap summary
#
# Required objects from previous analyses:
#   asv_assoc_tbl
#   asv_summary_tbl
#   category_grid_tbl
#   cor_result_tbl
#   diet_vars_order
#   class_cols
#   subtype_cols
#
# Expected columns:
#   asv_assoc_tbl:
#     disease_var, disease_label, ASV, label, type,
#     mean_delta_prev, median_delta_prev, p_adj_bh, sig
#
#   asv_summary_tbl:
#     ASV, row_label, asv_class, subtype,
#     diet_associated, diet_assoc_binary, diet_assoc_categories,
#     food_detected, category_concordant, concordance_status,
#     n_detected_food_categories, n_detected_food_samples
#
#   category_grid_tbl:
#     ASV, food_category, detected_in_category, detected_and_matched
#
#   cor_result_tbl:
#     ASV, variable_group, variable_label, rho, p_value, p_adj_bh
#
# Outputs:
#   disease_asv_integrated_evidence_v1/
#     plots/
#     tables/
#
# Key revision:
#   Left row annotation strips now show only:
#     ASV class | Subtype
#   Disease direction is not shown as a left strip because it is already
#   represented in the Disease heatmap block.
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(stringr)
  library(scales)
  library(readr)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Output directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------
OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED <- "disease_asv_integrated_evidence_v1"

dir.create(OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs <- c(
  "asv_assoc_tbl",
  "asv_summary_tbl",
  "category_grid_tbl",
  "cor_result_tbl",
  "diet_vars_order",
  "class_cols",
  "subtype_cols"
)

missing_objs <- need_objs[!vapply(need_objs, exists, logical(1))]
if (length(missing_objs) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required objects: ", paste(missing_objs, collapse = ", "))
}

if (!exists("save_plot_both")) {
  save_plot_both <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
      plot = plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = dpi,
      bg = bg,
      limitsize = FALSE
    )
    
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
      plot = plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      bg = bg,
      limitsize = FALSE
    )
  }
}

if (!exists("write_csv_kor")) {
  write_csv_kor <- function(x, file) {
    readr::write_excel_csv(x, file)
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_assoc_p_cutoff <- 0.05
food_detect_cols_order <- diet_vars_order

# Disease-direction colors matched to disease-ASV bipartite network plot
disease_context_cols_full <- c(
  "Control-enriched" = "#3C5488",
  "Disease-enriched" = "#BC3C29",
  "Mixed" = "#6A3D9A"
)

disease_pair_cols <- c(
  "No association" = "grey95",
  "Control-enriched" = "#3C5488",
  "Disease-enriched" = "#BC3C29"
)

diet_sig_symbol <- "*"

exact_match_cols <- c(
  "Not detected" = "grey95",
  "Detected" = "#4E79A7"
)

associated_diet_cols <- c(
  "Not associated" = "grey95",
  "Associated" = "#CC79A7"
)

evidence_cols <- c(
  "Concordant" = "#D55E00",
  "Discordant" = "#999999",
  "Food-detected only" = "#0072B2",
  "Diet-associated only" = "#009E73",
  "Neither" = "grey85"
)

evidence_status_order <- c(
  "Concordant",
  "Discordant",
  "Food-detected only",
  "Diet-associated only",
  "Neither"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Basic helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
base_theme_integrated <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9.5, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
    plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 6)
  )

make_title_plot <- function(title, subtitle = NULL, title_size = 16, subtitle_size = 10.5) {
  subtitle <- ifelse(is.null(subtitle), "", subtitle)
  
  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.82,
      label = title,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = title_size / ggplot2::.pt,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.25,
      label = subtitle,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = subtitle_size / ggplot2::.pt,
      color = "grey30"
    ) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(2, 5.5, 2, 5.5))
}

make_tile_legend <- function(pal, title, ncol = 1, text_size = 2.8, title_size = 10) {
  pal <- pal[!is.na(names(pal))]
  if (length(pal) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  }
  
  leg_df <- tibble(
    label = names(pal),
    idx = seq_along(label)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      col = ((idx - 1) %% ncol) + 1,
      row = ceiling(idx / ncol),
      row = max(row) - row + 1
    )
  
  ggplot(leg_df, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = label)) +
    geom_tile(width = 0.35, height = 0.35, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), nudge_x = 0.25, hjust = 0, size = text_size) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0.6, ncol + 5.2),
      ylim = c(0.4, max(leg_df$row) + 0.6),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}

make_star_legend <- function(title = "Diet significance", label = "FDR < 0.05") {
  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.15,
      y = 0.7,
      label = diet_sig_symbol,
      size = 5,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.33,
      y = 0.7,
      label = label,
      hjust = 0,
      size = 2.8
    ) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}

make_dot_legend <- function(title = "Concordance", label = "Category match") {
  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "point",
      x = 0.15,
      y = 0.7,
      shape = 16,
      size = 2.4,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.33,
      y = 0.7,
      label = label,
      hjust = 0,
      size = 2.8
    ) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Define disease-associated ASVs from Fig. 5 logic
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_sig_pair_tbl <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
  filter(
    if ("sig" %in% names(.)) {
      sig == "sig"
    } else {
      is.finite(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < 0.05
    }
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_direction = case_when(
      mean_delta_prev > 0 ~ "Disease-enriched",
      mean_delta_prev < 0 ~ "Control-enriched",
      TRUE ~ "No difference"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(disease_direction != "No difference") %>%
  select(
    disease_var,
    disease_label,
    ASV,
    label,
    type,
    mean_delta_prev,
    median_delta_prev,
    p_adj_bh,
    disease_direction,
    any_of(c(
      "n_testable_villages",
      "mean_prev_yes",
      "mean_prev_no",
      "n_villages_positive_delta",
      "n_villages_negative_delta"
    ))
  ) %>%
  distinct()

disease_target_asvs <- disease_sig_pair_tbl %>%
  distinct(ASV)

disease_asv_annot_tbl <- disease_sig_pair_tbl %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    n_disease_assoc = n_distinct(disease_var),
    disease_labels = paste(sort(unique(disease_label)), collapse = ";"),
    disease_directions = paste(sort(unique(disease_direction)), collapse = ";"),
    mean_abs_disease_effect = mean(abs(mean_delta_prev), na.rm = TRUE),
    strongest_disease = disease_label[which.max(abs(mean_delta_prev))],
    strongest_disease_direction = disease_direction[which.max(abs(mean_delta_prev))],
    strongest_disease_effect = mean_delta_prev[which.max(abs(mean_delta_prev))],
    strongest_disease_fdr = p_adj_bh[which.max(abs(mean_delta_prev))],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_context = case_when(
      disease_directions == "Disease-enriched" ~ "Disease-enriched",
      disease_directions == "Control-enriched" ~ "Control-enriched",
      TRUE ~ "Mixed"
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Merge disease annotation into food/diet summary table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_asv_summary_tbl <- asv_summary_tbl %>%
  filter(ASV %in% disease_target_asvs$ASV) %>%
  left_join(disease_asv_annot_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    asv_class = factor(
      as.character(asv_class),
      levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched")
    ),
    subtype = factor(
      as.character(subtype),
      levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional")
    ),
    diet_assoc_binary = factor(
      as.character(diet_assoc_binary),
      levels = c("Diet-associated", "Not diet-associated")
    ),
    concordance_status = factor(
      as.character(concordance_status),
      levels = c(
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant",
        "Diet-associated only",
        "Food-detected only",
        "Neither"
      )
    )
  )

observed_disease_context <- disease_asv_summary_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(disease_context)) %>%
  pull(disease_context) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  unique()

observed_disease_context <- intersect(
  c("Control-enriched", "Disease-enriched", "Mixed"),
  observed_disease_context
)

disease_context_cols <- disease_context_cols_full[observed_disease_context]

disease_asv_summary_tbl <- disease_asv_summary_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    disease_context = factor(
      as.character(disease_context),
      levels = observed_disease_context
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    disease_context,
    diet_assoc_binary,
    concordance_status,
    desc(n_detected_food_categories),
    desc(n_detected_food_samples),
    ASV
  )

disease_row_tbl <- disease_asv_summary_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = paste0(row_label, "__", ASV),
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = rev(paste0(row_label, "__", ASV))),
    asv_class = factor(as.character(asv_class), levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched")),
    subtype = factor(as.character(subtype), levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional")),
    disease_context = factor(as.character(disease_context), levels = observed_disease_context)
  )

disease_row_levels <- levels(disease_row_tbl$row_id)
disease_label_map <- setNames(disease_row_tbl$row_label, disease_row_tbl$row_id)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Console summary and save core tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n===== Disease-associated ASV integrated evidence analysis =====\n")
cat("Output directory:", OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED, "\n")
cat("Significant disease-ASV pairs:", nrow(disease_sig_pair_tbl), "\n")
cat("Unique disease-associated ASVs:", nrow(disease_target_asvs), "\n")
cat("Disease direction levels shown:", paste(observed_disease_context, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

print(
  disease_asv_summary_tbl %>%
    count(disease_context, concordance_status, name = "n_asvs") %>%
    arrange(disease_context, concordance_status)
)

write_csv_kor(
  disease_sig_pair_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED, "tables", "disease_significant_asv_pairs.csv")
)

write_csv_kor(
  disease_asv_annot_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED, "tables", "disease_associated_asv_annotation.csv")
)

write_csv_kor(
  disease_asv_summary_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED, "tables", "disease_associated_asv_integrated_summary.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Left row annotation strips
#    Revised: ASV class + subtype only
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_row_annotations_integrated <- function(row_tbl, y_col = "row_id") {
  ann_df <- row_tbl %>%
    select(all_of(y_col), asv_class, subtype) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(asv_class, subtype),
      names_to = "annotation",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      annotation = factor(
        annotation,
        levels = c("asv_class", "subtype"),
        labels = c("ASV class", "Subtype")
      ),
      value = as.character(value)
    )
  
  ggplot(ann_df, aes(x = annotation, y = .data[[y_col]], fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(class_cols, subtype_cols),
      drop = TRUE,
      na.value = "grey95"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    base_theme_integrated +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(0, 2, 5.5, 5.5)
    )
}

p_left_strips <- make_row_annotations_integrated(disease_row_tbl, y_col = "row_id")

# =========================================================
# Plot 1: ASV-centered integrated evidence heatmap
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Disease association block
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_cols_order <- disease_sig_pair_tbl %>%
  distinct(disease_label) %>%
  arrange(disease_label) %>%
  pull(disease_label)

disease_matrix_tbl <- expand_grid(
  row_id = disease_row_levels,
  disease_label = disease_cols_order
) %>%
  left_join(
    disease_row_tbl %>%
      select(ASV, row_id),
    by = "row_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    disease_sig_pair_tbl %>%
      select(ASV, disease_label, disease_direction, mean_delta_prev, p_adj_bh) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = c("ASV", "disease_label")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_label = factor(disease_label, levels = disease_cols_order),
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = disease_row_levels),
    disease_direction = ifelse(is.na(disease_direction), "No association", disease_direction),
    disease_direction = factor(
      disease_direction,
      levels = c("No association", "Control-enriched", "Disease-enriched")
    )
  )

p_disease_block <- ggplot(disease_matrix_tbl, aes(x = disease_label, y = row_id)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = disease_direction), color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = disease_pair_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    drop = FALSE,
    labels = disease_label_map
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Disease",
    x = "Disease phenotype",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  base_theme_integrated +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.2, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 5.5, 0)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Diet association block
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_matrix_tbl <- cor_result_tbl %>%
  filter(
    ASV %in% disease_target_asvs$ASV,
    variable_group == "Diet",
    variable_label %in% diet_vars_order
  ) %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    variable_label,
    rho,
    p_value,
    p_adj_bh
  ) %>%
  right_join(
    disease_row_tbl %>%
      select(ASV, row_id),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = disease_row_levels),
    variable_label = factor(variable_label, levels = diet_vars_order),
    sig_fdr = !is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_assoc_p_cutoff
  ) %>%
  complete(
    row_id,
    variable_label = factor(diet_vars_order, levels = diet_vars_order),
    fill = list(
      rho = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      p_adj_bh = NA_real_,
      sig_fdr = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    disease_row_tbl %>%
      select(row_id, ASV),
    by = "row_id",
    suffix = c("", ".y")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = coalesce(ASV, ASV.y),
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = disease_row_levels),
    variable_label = factor(variable_label, levels = diet_vars_order)
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".y"))

p_diet_block <- ggplot(diet_matrix_tbl, aes(x = variable_label, y = row_id)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = rho), color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(
    data = diet_matrix_tbl %>% filter(sig_fdr),
    aes(label = diet_sig_symbol),
    color = "black",
    size = 4.2,
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = 0.55
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    na.value = "grey95",
    name = "Spearman\nrho"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Diet",
    x = "Dietary frequency variable",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  base_theme_integrated +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.2, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Side-dish microbiome evidence block
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_matrix_tbl <- category_grid_tbl %>%
  filter(ASV %in% disease_target_asvs$ASV) %>%
  left_join(
    disease_row_tbl %>%
      select(ASV, row_id),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = disease_row_levels),
    food_category = factor(food_category, levels = food_detect_cols_order),
    food_detect_state = ifelse(detected_in_category, "Detected", "Not detected"),
    food_detect_state = factor(
      food_detect_state,
      levels = c("Not detected", "Detected")
    )
  )

food_dot_tbl <- food_matrix_tbl %>%
  filter(detected_and_matched) %>%
  distinct(row_id, food_category)

p_food_block <- ggplot(food_matrix_tbl, aes(x = food_category, y = row_id)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = food_detect_state), color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(
    data = food_dot_tbl,
    aes(x = food_category, y = row_id),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 16,
    size = 2.0,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = exact_match_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Side-dish microbiome",
    x = "Detected side-dish category",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  base_theme_integrated +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.2, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Integrated heatmap legends
#    Revised: removed separate Disease direction legend
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_integrated_legends <- wrap_plots(
  make_tile_legend(class_cols, "ASV class"),
  make_tile_legend(subtype_cols, "Subtype"),
  make_tile_legend(disease_pair_cols, "Disease block"),
  make_star_legend("Diet significance", "FDR < 0.05"),
  make_tile_legend(exact_match_cols, "Side-dish match"),
  make_dot_legend("Concordance", "Category match"),
  ncol = 1
) +
  plot_layout(
    heights = c(
      0.8,
      0.8,
      1.1,
      0.8,
      0.9,
      0.8
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Integrated heatmap assembly
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_integrated_title <- make_title_plot(
  title = "Integrated evidence for disease-associated sharing-related ASVs",
  subtitle = "Rows show disease-associated sharing-related ASVs. Blocks show disease associations, diet associations, and exact sequence matches in side-dish microbiota."
)

n_disease_cols <- length(disease_cols_order)
disease_block_width <- max(1.7, 0.42 * n_disease_cols)
diet_block_width <- max(4.8, 0.48 * length(diet_vars_order))
food_block_width <- max(4.8, 0.48 * length(food_detect_cols_order))

p_integrated_body <- wrap_plots(
  p_left_strips,
  p_disease_block,
  p_diet_block,
  p_food_block,
  ncol = 4
) +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(0.45, disease_block_width, diet_block_width, food_block_width)
  )

p_integrated_main <- p_integrated_title / p_integrated_body +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.9, 10))

p_integrated_final <- wrap_plots(
  p_integrated_main,
  p_integrated_legends,
  ncol = 2
) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(12.5, 1.9))

print(p_integrated_final)

integrated_height <- max(7.5, 0.16 * nrow(disease_row_tbl) + 3.3)
integrated_width <- max(14.5, disease_block_width + diet_block_width + food_block_width + 4)

save_plot_both(
  p_integrated_final,
  file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED, "plots", "disease_asv_integrated_evidence_heatmap"),
  width = integrated_width,
  height = integrated_height
)

write_csv_kor(
  disease_matrix_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED, "tables", "integrated_disease_block_data.csv")
)

write_csv_kor(
  diet_matrix_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED, "tables", "integrated_diet_block_data.csv")
)

write_csv_kor(
  food_matrix_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED, "tables", "integrated_side_dish_block_data.csv")
)

# =========================================================
# Plot 2: UpSet-like evidence overlap summary
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 13) Evidence status table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
evidence_asv_tbl <- disease_asv_summary_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    diet_set = isTRUE(diet_associated) | (!is.na(diet_associated) & diet_associated),
    food_set = isTRUE(food_detected) | (!is.na(food_detected) & food_detected),
    concordant_set = isTRUE(category_concordant) | (!is.na(category_concordant) & category_concordant),
    evidence_status = case_when(
      diet_set & food_set & concordant_set ~ "Concordant",
      diet_set & food_set & !concordant_set ~ "Discordant",
      !diet_set & food_set ~ "Food-detected only",
      diet_set & !food_set ~ "Diet-associated only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    evidence_status = factor(evidence_status, levels = evidence_status_order),
    disease_context = factor(as.character(disease_context), levels = observed_disease_context)
  )

evidence_count_tbl <- evidence_asv_tbl %>%
  count(evidence_status, name = "n_asvs") %>%
  complete(
    evidence_status = factor(evidence_status_order, levels = evidence_status_order),
    fill = list(n_asvs = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n_asvs),
    pct = ifelse(total > 0, 100 * n_asvs / total, 0),
    label = ifelse(n_asvs > 0, paste0(n_asvs, "\n", sprintf("%.1f", pct), "%"), "")
  )

write_csv_kor(
  evidence_asv_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED, "tables", "asv_level_integrated_evidence_status.csv")
)

write_csv_kor(
  evidence_count_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED, "tables", "asv_level_integrated_evidence_status_counts.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14) Top bar for UpSet-like summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_upset_bar <- ggplot(
  evidence_count_tbl,
  aes(x = evidence_status, y = n_asvs, fill = evidence_status)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    vjust = -0.25,
    size = 3.3,
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = evidence_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20))) +
  labs(
    title = "Evidence overlap among disease-associated sharing-related ASVs",
    subtitle = "Each ASV was counted once. Concordance indicates matching diet-associated and side-dish-detected categories.",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of ASVs"
  ) +
  base_theme_integrated +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 0, 6)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 15) Dot-matrix for evidence status
# ---------------------------------------------------------
evidence_matrix_tbl <- tibble(
  evidence_status = factor(evidence_status_order, levels = evidence_status_order),
  `Diet-associated` = c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE),
  `Side-dish detected` = c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE),
  `Category-concordant` = c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE)
) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Diet-associated`, `Side-dish detected`, `Category-concordant`),
    names_to = "evidence_layer",
    values_to = "active"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    evidence_layer = factor(
      evidence_layer,
      levels = c("Category-concordant", "Side-dish detected", "Diet-associated")
    ),
    point_state = ifelse(active, "Active", "Inactive")
  )

evidence_line_tbl <- evidence_matrix_tbl %>%
  filter(active) %>%
  group_by(evidence_status) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  ungroup()

p_upset_matrix <- ggplot(
  evidence_matrix_tbl,
  aes(x = evidence_status, y = evidence_layer)
) +
  geom_line(
    data = evidence_line_tbl,
    aes(group = evidence_status),
    linewidth = 0.45,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = point_state),
    size = 3.0
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Active" = "black", "Inactive" = "grey82"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  base_theme_integrated +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 8, 6, 6)
  )

p_upset_final <- p_upset_bar / p_upset_matrix +
  plot_layout(heights = c(3.2, 1.45))

print(p_upset_final)

save_plot_both(
  p_upset_final,
  file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED, "plots", "disease_asv_evidence_overlap_upset"),
  width = 9.5,
  height = 6.8
)

# =========================================================
# Plot 3: Evidence status by disease direction
# =========================================================

evidence_direction_tbl <- evidence_asv_tbl %>%
  count(disease_context, evidence_status, name = "n_asvs") %>%
  complete(
    disease_context = factor(observed_disease_context, levels = observed_disease_context),
    evidence_status = factor(evidence_status_order, levels = evidence_status_order),
    fill = list(n_asvs = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(disease_context) %>%
  mutate(
    total_in_direction = sum(n_asvs),
    pct = ifelse(total_in_direction > 0, 100 * n_asvs / total_in_direction, 0),
    label = ifelse(n_asvs > 0, paste0(n_asvs, "\n", sprintf("%.1f", pct), "%"), "")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(total_in_direction > 0)

write_csv_kor(
  evidence_direction_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED, "tables", "asv_level_integrated_evidence_status_by_disease_direction.csv")
)

p_evidence_direction_bar <- ggplot(
  evidence_direction_tbl,
  aes(x = evidence_status, y = n_asvs, fill = evidence_status)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    vjust = -0.25,
    size = 3.1,
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ disease_context, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y", drop = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = evidence_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.22))) +
  labs(
    title = "Food-diet evidence by disease direction",
    subtitle = "Each disease-associated sharing-related ASV was counted once within its disease-direction group.",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of ASVs"
  ) +
  base_theme_integrated +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_evidence_direction_bar)

save_plot_both(
  p_evidence_direction_bar,
  file.path(OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED, "plots", "disease_asv_evidence_status_by_disease_direction"),
  width = 11,
  height = 5.5
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 16) Final console summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n===== Integrated disease-associated ASV evidence summary =====\n")
cat("Output directory:", OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED, "\n")
cat("Disease-associated ASVs:", nrow(disease_asv_summary_tbl), "\n")
cat("Diet-associated ASVs:", sum(evidence_asv_tbl$diet_set), "\n")
cat("Side-dish detected ASVs:", sum(evidence_asv_tbl$food_set), "\n")
cat("Category-concordant ASVs:", sum(evidence_asv_tbl$concordant_set), "\n\n")

cat("Evidence status counts:\n")
print(evidence_count_tbl)

cat("\nEvidence status by disease direction:\n")
print(
  evidence_direction_tbl %>%
    select(disease_context, evidence_status, n_asvs, pct) %>%
    arrange(disease_context, evidence_status)
)

cat("\nSaved plots:\n")
cat("- plots/disease_asv_integrated_evidence_heatmap.png/.svg\n")
cat("- plots/disease_asv_evidence_overlap_upset.png/.svg\n")
cat("- plots/disease_asv_evidence_status_by_disease_direction.png/.svg\n")

cat("\nSaved tables are written with write_excel_csv() to reduce Korean text encoding issues in Excel.\n")
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# 3-column ASV-level evidence summary heatmap
#
# Purpose:
#   Summarize the three evidence layers for disease-associated
#   sharing-related ASVs:
#     1) Disease direction
#     2) Diet association
#     3) Side-dish exact match
#
# Additional marker:
#   Black point on the Side-dish column indicates category-level
#   concordance between ASV-associated diet category and detected
#   side-dish category.
#
# Output:
#   plots/disease_asv_three_column_evidence_summary.png/.svg
#   tables/disease_asv_three_column_evidence_summary_data.csv
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(stringr)
  library(scales)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Check required objects
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_objs_summary3 <- c(
  "disease_asv_summary_tbl",
  "disease_row_tbl",
  "disease_row_levels",
  "disease_label_map",
  "observed_disease_context",
  "disease_context_cols",
  "class_cols",
  "subtype_cols",
  "OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED"
)

missing_objs_summary3 <- need_objs_summary3[!vapply(need_objs_summary3, exists, logical(1))]
if (length(missing_objs_summary3) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required objects: ", paste(missing_objs_summary3, collapse = ", "))
}

if (!exists("save_plot_both")) {
  save_plot_both <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
      plot = plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = dpi,
      bg = bg,
      limitsize = FALSE
    )
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
      plot = plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      bg = bg,
      limitsize = FALSE
    )
  }
}

if (!exists("write_csv_kor")) {
  write_csv_kor <- function(x, file) {
    readr::write_excel_csv(x, file)
  }
}

if (!exists("base_theme_integrated")) {
  base_theme_integrated <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9.5, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
      plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 6)
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Palettes
# ---------------------------------------------------------
diet_evidence_cols <- c(
  "Not associated" = "grey92",
  "Diet-associated" = "#CC79A7"
)

food_evidence_cols <- c(
  "Not detected" = "grey92",
  "Detected" = "#4E79A7"
)

three_col_evidence_cols <- c(
  disease_context_cols,
  diet_evidence_cols,
  food_evidence_cols
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Legend helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_tile_legend_summary3 <- function(pal, title, ncol = 1, text_size = 2.8, title_size = 10) {
  pal <- pal[!is.na(names(pal))]
  if (length(pal) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  }
  
  leg_df <- tibble(
    label = names(pal),
    idx = seq_along(label)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      col = ((idx - 1) %% ncol) + 1,
      row = ceiling(idx / ncol),
      row = max(row) - row + 1
    )
  
  ggplot(leg_df, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = label)) +
    geom_tile(width = 0.35, height = 0.35, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), nudge_x = 0.25, hjust = 0, size = text_size) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0.6, ncol + 5.2),
      ylim = c(0.4, max(leg_df$row) + 0.6),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}

make_dot_legend_summary3 <- function(title = "Concordance", label = "Category match") {
  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "point",
      x = 0.15,
      y = 0.7,
      shape = 16,
      size = 2.4,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.33,
      y = 0.7,
      label = label,
      hjust = 0,
      size = 2.8
    ) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Row annotation strips: ASV class + subtype only
#    Disease direction is now shown as the first main column.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_row_annotations_summary3 <- function(row_tbl, y_col = "row_id") {
  ann_df <- row_tbl %>%
    select(all_of(y_col), asv_class, subtype) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(asv_class, subtype),
      names_to = "annotation",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      annotation = factor(
        annotation,
        levels = c("asv_class", "subtype"),
        labels = c("ASV class", "Subtype")
      ),
      value = as.character(value)
    )
  
  ggplot(ann_df, aes(x = annotation, y = .data[[y_col]], fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(class_cols, subtype_cols),
      drop = TRUE,
      na.value = "grey95"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    base_theme_integrated +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(0, 2, 5.5, 5.5)
    )
}

p_summary3_left <- make_row_annotations_summary3(disease_row_tbl, y_col = "row_id")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Build 3-column evidence matrix data
# ---------------------------------------------------------
summary3_base_tbl <- disease_asv_summary_tbl %>%
  left_join(
    disease_row_tbl %>% select(ASV, row_id),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = disease_row_levels),
    disease_evidence = as.character(disease_context),
    diet_evidence = ifelse(
      !is.na(diet_associated) & diet_associated,
      "Diet-associated",
      "Not associated"
    ),
    side_dish_evidence = ifelse(
      !is.na(food_detected) & food_detected,
      "Detected",
      "Not detected"
    ),
    category_concordant = ifelse(
      is.na(category_concordant),
      FALSE,
      category_concordant
    )
  )

summary3_matrix_tbl <- summary3_base_tbl %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    row_label,
    row_id,
    disease_context,
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    disease_evidence,
    diet_evidence,
    side_dish_evidence,
    category_concordant,
    concordance_status,
    n_detected_food_categories,
    n_detected_food_samples,
    diet_assoc_categories,
    detected_food_categories
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(disease_evidence, diet_evidence, side_dish_evidence),
    names_to = "evidence_layer",
    values_to = "evidence_state"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    evidence_layer = factor(
      evidence_layer,
      levels = c("disease_evidence", "diet_evidence", "side_dish_evidence"),
      labels = c("Disease", "Diet", "Side-dish")
    ),
    evidence_state = as.character(evidence_state),
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = disease_row_levels)
  )

summary3_dot_tbl <- summary3_matrix_tbl %>%
  filter(
    evidence_layer == "Side-dish",
    category_concordant
  ) %>%
  distinct(row_id, evidence_layer)

write_csv_kor(
  summary3_matrix_tbl,
  file.path(
    OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED,
    "tables",
    "disease_asv_three_column_evidence_summary_data.csv"
  )
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Main 3-column summary heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_summary3_heatmap <- ggplot(
  summary3_matrix_tbl,
  aes(x = evidence_layer, y = row_id, fill = evidence_state)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_point(
    data = summary3_dot_tbl,
    aes(x = evidence_layer, y = row_id),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 16,
    size = 2.1,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = three_col_evidence_cols,
    drop = TRUE,
    na.value = "grey95"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    drop = FALSE,
    labels = disease_label_map
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Three-layer evidence summary for disease-associated sharing-related ASVs",
    subtitle = "Columns summarize disease direction, significant diet association, and exact sequence detection in side-dish microbiota. Black points indicate diet–side-dish category concordance.",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  base_theme_integrated +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 0)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Legends
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_summary3_legends <- wrap_plots(
  make_tile_legend_summary3(class_cols, "ASV class"),
  make_tile_legend_summary3(subtype_cols, "Subtype"),
  make_tile_legend_summary3(disease_context_cols, "Disease"),
  make_tile_legend_summary3(diet_evidence_cols, "Diet"),
  make_tile_legend_summary3(food_evidence_cols, "Side-dish"),
  make_dot_legend_summary3("Concordance", "Category match"),
  ncol = 1
) +
  plot_layout(
    heights = c(
      0.8,
      0.8,
      max(0.8, 0.35 * length(disease_context_cols)),
      0.8,
      0.8,
      0.8
    )
  )

p_summary3_final <- wrap_plots(
  p_summary3_left,
  p_summary3_heatmap,
  p_summary3_legends,
  ncol = 3
) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(0.45, 3.2, 1.6))

print(p_summary3_final)

summary3_height <- max(7.5, 0.16 * nrow(disease_row_tbl) + 2.5)
summary3_width <- 8.8

save_plot_both(
  p_summary3_final,
  file.path(
    OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED,
    "plots",
    "disease_asv_three_column_evidence_summary"
  ),
  width = summary3_width,
  height = summary3_height
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Optional: compact count summary table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
summary3_count_tbl <- summary3_base_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    evidence_group = case_when(
      !is.na(diet_associated) & diet_associated &
        !is.na(food_detected) & food_detected &
        !is.na(category_concordant) & category_concordant ~ "Diet + side-dish + concordant",
      
      !is.na(diet_associated) & diet_associated &
        !is.na(food_detected) & food_detected &
        (is.na(category_concordant) | !category_concordant) ~ "Diet + side-dish, discordant",
      
      !is.na(diet_associated) & diet_associated &
        (is.na(food_detected) | !food_detected) ~ "Diet only",
      
      (is.na(diet_associated) | !diet_associated) &
        !is.na(food_detected) & food_detected ~ "Side-dish only",
      
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    evidence_group = factor(
      evidence_group,
      levels = c(
        "Diet + side-dish + concordant",
        "Diet + side-dish, discordant",
        "Diet only",
        "Side-dish only",
        "Neither"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  count(disease_context, evidence_group, name = "n_asvs") %>%
  group_by(disease_context) %>%
  mutate(
    total_in_direction = sum(n_asvs),
    pct = ifelse(total_in_direction > 0, 100 * n_asvs / total_in_direction, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write_csv_kor(
  summary3_count_tbl,
  file.path(
    OUTDIR_DISEASE_INTEGRATED,
    "tables",
    "disease_asv_three_column_evidence_summary_counts.csv"
  )
)

cat("\n===== Three-column evidence summary finished =====\n")
cat("Saved plot:\n")
cat("- plots/disease_asv_three_column_evidence_summary.png/.svg\n")
cat("\nEvidence group counts:\n")
print(summary3_count_tbl)
```

#FIG 6 FInal
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Fig. 6 clean pipeline:
# Sharing-related ASV social/diet association and side-dish microbiome evidence
#
# Figure logic:
#   Fig. 5 identified disease-associated sharing-related ASVs.
#   Fig. 6 tests whether sharing-related ASVs are linked to
#   social questionnaire variables, diet frequency, and side-dish microbiota.
#
# Outputs:
#   fig6_sharing_diet_banchan_clean_v1/
#     plots/
#       01_sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_heatmap.png/.svg
#       02_exact_match_sample_matrix.png/.svg
#       03_category_concordance_matrix_veg_namul_merged.png/.svg
#       04_category_concordance_heatmap_veg_namul_merged.png/.svg
#     tables/
#
# Required input files:
#   metadata_food_microbiome.csv
#   rawdata_food_microbiome.csv
#   sharing_asv.csv
#
# Required existing objects:
#   cor_result_tbl
#     columns: ASV, variable_group, variable_label, rho, p_value, p_adj_bh
#     variable_group should include:
#       "Social questionnaire"
#       "Diet"
#
#   asv_assoc_tbl
#     Fig. 5 disease-ASV association result
#     columns: disease_var, disease_label, ASV, mean_delta_prev, p_adj_bh, sig
#
# Optional existing objects:
#   global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh
#   asv_subtype_tbl
#
# Notes:
#   - 01 heatmap uses all sharing-related ASVs.
#   - 01/02 disease strip uses disease direction:
#       Control-enriched / Disease-enriched / Mixed / Not disease-associated
#   - For source-like diet/side-dish concordance, diet-associated categories
#     are defined by FDR-significant positive diet correlations by default.
#   - Vegetables and Namul are merged only for category-level concordance plots.
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(stringi)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(forcats)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
OUTDIR_FIG6 <- "fig6_sharing_diet_banchan_clean_v1"
dir.create(OUTDIR_FIG6, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_FIG6, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_FIG6, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

food_meta_file <- "metadata_food_microbiome.csv"
food_raw_file  <- "rawdata_food_microbiome.csv"
sharing_file   <- "sharing_asv.csv"

stopifnot(file.exists(food_meta_file))
stopifnot(file.exists(food_raw_file))
stopifnot(file.exists(sharing_file))

food_detection_cutoff <- 0.001

diet_assoc_p_cutoff <- 0.05
diet_assoc_direction_for_concordance <- "positive"
# Options:
#   "positive" = FDR-significant positive diet associations only
#   "both"     = FDR-significant positive or negative diet associations

diet_vars_order <- c(
  "Vegetables",
  "Namul",
  "Kimchi",
  "Mushrooms",
  "Seaweed",
  "Seafood",
  "Fish",
  "Meat",
  "Fruit",
  "Beverages"
)

diet_vars_order_merged <- c(
  "Vegetables+Namul",
  "Kimchi",
  "Mushrooms",
  "Seaweed",
  "Seafood",
  "Fish",
  "Meat",
  "Fruit",
  "Beverages"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
clean_seq <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    str_to_upper() %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", "")
}

reverse_complement <- function(seq) {
  seq <- clean_seq(seq)
  comp <- chartr("ACGTURYKMSWBDHVN", "TGCAAYRMKSWVHDBN", seq)
  stringi::stri_reverse(comp)
}

standardize_names <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    rename_with(~ str_trim(.x)) %>%
    rename_with(~ str_replace_all(.x, "\\s+", "_"))
}

write_csv_kor <- function(x, file) {
  readr::write_excel_csv(x, file)
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white") {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

make_row_label <- function(label, ASV) {
  label <- as.character(label)
  ASV <- as.character(ASV)
  label[is.na(label) | label == ""] <- ASV[is.na(label) | label == ""]
  
  out <- mapply(function(lab, asv) {
    lab2 <- str_replace(lab, paste0("\\s*\\|\\s*", asv, "$"), "")
    paste0(lab2, " | ", asv)
  }, label, ASV, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  
  as.character(out)
}

merge_veg_namul <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  case_when(
    x %in% c("Vegetables", "Namul") ~ "Vegetables+Namul",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

split_semicolon <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- "None"
  str_split(x, ";")
}

expand_palette <- function(pal, observed_levels) {
  observed_levels <- observed_levels[!is.na(observed_levels) & observed_levels != ""]
  extra_levels <- setdiff(observed_levels, names(pal))
  if (length(extra_levels) > 0) {
    extra_cols <- scales::hue_pal()(length(extra_levels))
    names(extra_cols) <- extra_levels
    pal <- c(pal, extra_cols)
  }
  pal
}

base_theme_fig6 <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9.5, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
    plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 6)
  )

make_title_plot <- function(title, subtitle = NULL, title_size = 16, subtitle_size = 10.5) {
  subtitle <- ifelse(is.null(subtitle), "", subtitle)
  
  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.82,
      label = title,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = title_size / ggplot2::.pt,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.25,
      label = subtitle,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = subtitle_size / ggplot2::.pt,
      color = "grey30"
    ) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(2, 5.5, 2, 5.5))
}

make_tile_legend <- function(pal, title, ncol = 1, text_size = 2.8, title_size = 10) {
  pal <- pal[!is.na(names(pal))]
  if (length(pal) == 0) return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  
  leg_df <- tibble(
    label = names(pal),
    idx = seq_along(label)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      col = ((idx - 1) %% ncol) + 1,
      row = ceiling(idx / ncol),
      row = max(row) - row + 1
    )
  
  ggplot(leg_df, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = label)) +
    geom_tile(width = 0.35, height = 0.35, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), nudge_x = 0.25, hjust = 0, size = text_size) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0.6, ncol + 5.2),
      ylim = c(0.4, max(leg_df$row) + 0.6),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0),

    )
}

make_dot_legend <- function(title = "Concordance", label = "Category match") {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("point", x = 0.15, y = 0.7, shape = 16, size = 2.4, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.33, y = 0.7, label = label, hjust = 0, size = 2.8) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
```
