# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Palettes
# ---------------------------------------------------------
class_cols <- if (exists("class_cols")) {
  class_cols
} else {
  c("Global core" = "#4E79A7", "Village-enriched" = "#E15759")
}

subtype_cols <- if (exists("subtype_cols")) {
  subtype_cols
} else {
  c("single" = "#1B9E77", "nearby" = "#D95F02", "regional" = "#7570B3")
}

disease_direction_strip_cols <- c(
  "Control-enriched" = "#3C5488",
  "Disease-enriched" = "#BC3C29",
  "Mixed" = "#6A3D9A",
  "Not disease-associated" = "grey92"
)

disease_direction_cols <- c(
  "Control-enriched" = "#3C5488",
  "Disease-enriched" = "#BC3C29",
  "Mixed" = "#6A3D9A"
)

diet_assoc_binary_cols <- c(
  "Diet-associated" = "#CC79A7",
  "Not diet-associated" = "grey92"
)

group_cols <- c(
  "Control" = "#BDBDBD",
  "Fermented" = "#252525"
)

category_cols <- c(
  "Vegetables" = "#4E79A7",
  "Namul" = "#59A14F",
  "Vegetables+Namul" = "#4E9A62",
  "Kimchi" = "#E15759",
  "Mushrooms" = "#B07AA1",
  "Seaweed" = "#76B7B2",
  "Seafood" = "#9C755F",
  "Fish" = "#1F77B4",
  "Meat" = "#D62728",
  "Fruit" = "#F28E2B",
  "Beverages" = "#EDC948",
  "Others" = "grey75",
  "None" = "grey90"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Check external objects
# ---------------------------------------------------------
need_external_objs <- c("cor_result_tbl", "asv_assoc_tbl")
missing_external_objs <- need_external_objs[!vapply(need_external_objs, exists, logical(1))]
if (length(missing_external_objs) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required existing objects: ", paste(missing_external_objs, collapse = ", "))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Load food metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_meta_raw <- read_csv(
  food_meta_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) %>%
  standardize_names()

required_meta_cols <- c(
  "Variable_ID",
  "Dish_ID",
  "Group",
  "Korean_name",
  "Full_English_name",
  "Figure_label",
  "Plot_label",
  "Category_1",
  "Category_2"
)

missing_meta_cols <- setdiff(required_meta_cols, names(food_meta_raw))
if (length(missing_meta_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing columns in metadata_food_microbiome.csv after standardization: ",
    paste(missing_meta_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

food_meta <- food_meta_raw %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(required_meta_cols), as.character),
    Category_1 = ifelse(is.na(Category_1) | Category_1 == "", "None", Category_1),
    Category_2 = ifelse(is.na(Category_2) | Category_2 == "", "None", Category_2),
    Category_1_merged = merge_veg_namul(Category_1),
    Category_2_merged = merge_veg_namul(Category_2),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Control", "Fermented"))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Load food microbiome abundance table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
food_raw <- read_csv(
  food_raw_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_trim(.x))

if (!"seq" %in% names(food_raw)) {
  stop("rawdata_food_microbiome.csv must contain a 'seq' column.")
}

if (!"Taxon" %in% names(food_raw)) {
  food_raw <- food_raw %>%
    mutate(Taxon = NA_character_, .before = 1)
}

food_sample_cols <- intersect(food_meta$Variable_ID, names(food_raw))

if (length(food_sample_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No food sample columns matched between rawdata_food_microbiome.csv and metadata_food_microbiome.csv.")
}

food_asv_tbl <- food_raw %>%
  mutate(
    food_taxon = as.character(Taxon),
    food_seq = clean_seq(seq),
    food_seq_rc = reverse_complement(food_seq)
  ) %>%
  select(food_taxon, food_seq, food_seq_rc, all_of(food_sample_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(food_sample_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))))

food_abund_mat <- food_asv_tbl %>%
  select(all_of(food_sample_cols)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

food_abund_mat[] <- lapply(food_abund_mat, function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)))
food_abund_mat <- as.matrix(food_abund_mat)

food_abund_check <- tibble(
  min_value = min(food_abund_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_value = max(food_abund_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_colsum = median(colSums(food_abund_mat, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
)

cat("\n===== Food microbiome abundance scale check =====\n")
print(food_abund_check)
cat("Detection cutoff:", food_detection_cutoff, "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Load sharing ASVs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sharing_raw <- read_csv(
  sharing_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_trim(.x))

if (!all(c("ASV", "seq") %in% names(sharing_raw))) {
  stop("sharing_asv.csv must contain at least 'ASV' and 'seq' columns.")
}

if (!"label" %in% names(sharing_raw)) {
  sharing_raw <- sharing_raw %>%
    mutate(label = ASV)
}

if (!"type" %in% names(sharing_raw)) {
  sharing_raw <- sharing_raw %>%
    mutate(type = NA_character_)
}

sharing_asv <- sharing_raw %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    label = as.character(label),
    type = as.character(type),
    human_seq = clean_seq(seq),
    human_seq_rc = reverse_complement(human_seq),
    asv_class_from_file = case_when(
      str_detect(str_to_lower(type), "global") ~ "Global core",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(type), "village") ~ "Village-enriched",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    label,
    type,
    asv_class_from_file,
    human_seq,
    human_seq_rc
  ) %>%
  distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Add ASV class and subtype annotation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtype_annot_list <- list()

if (exists("global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh")) {
  subtype_annot_list[["global_core"]] <- global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = as.character(ASV),
      asv_class_from_object = "Global core",
      subtype = as.character(subtype)
    )
}

if (exists("asv_subtype_tbl")) {
  subtype_annot_list[["village_enriched"]] <- asv_subtype_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = as.character(ASV),
      asv_class_from_object = "Village-enriched",
      subtype = as.character(subtype)
    )
}

if (length(subtype_annot_list) > 0) {
  subtype_annot <- bind_rows(subtype_annot_list) %>%
    mutate(
      subtype = case_when(
        str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype), "single") ~ "single",
        str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype), "nearby") ~ "nearby",
        str_detect(str_to_lower(subtype), "regional") ~ "regional",
        TRUE ~ subtype
      )
    ) %>%
    distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
    left_join(subtype_annot, by = "ASV")
} else {
  sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
    mutate(
      asv_class_from_object = NA_character_,
      subtype = NA_character_
    )
}

sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
  mutate(
    asv_class = coalesce(asv_class_from_object, asv_class_from_file),
    subtype = ifelse(is.na(subtype) | subtype == "", NA_character_, subtype),
    asv_class = factor(asv_class, levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched")),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional")),
    row_label = make_row_label(label, ASV)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Define disease-associated ASVs from Fig. 5 result
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_sig_pair_tbl <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
  filter(
    if ("sig" %in% names(.)) {
      sig == "sig"
    } else {
      is.finite(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < 0.05
    }
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_direction = case_when(
      mean_delta_prev > 0 ~ "Disease-enriched",
      mean_delta_prev < 0 ~ "Control-enriched",
      TRUE ~ "No difference"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(disease_direction != "No difference") %>%
  select(
    disease_var,
    disease_label,
    ASV,
    label,
    type,
    mean_delta_prev,
    median_delta_prev,
    p_adj_bh,
    disease_direction,
    any_of(c(
      "n_testable_villages",
      "mean_prev_yes",
      "mean_prev_no",
      "n_villages_positive_delta",
      "n_villages_negative_delta"
    ))
  ) %>%
  distinct()

disease_asv_annot_tbl <- disease_sig_pair_tbl %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    n_disease_assoc = n_distinct(disease_var),
    disease_labels = paste(sort(unique(disease_label)), collapse = ";"),
    disease_directions = paste(sort(unique(disease_direction)), collapse = ";"),
    mean_abs_disease_effect = mean(abs(mean_delta_prev), na.rm = TRUE),
    strongest_disease = disease_label[which.max(abs(mean_delta_prev))],
    strongest_disease_direction = disease_direction[which.max(abs(mean_delta_prev))],
    strongest_disease_effect = mean_delta_prev[which.max(abs(mean_delta_prev))],
    strongest_disease_fdr = p_adj_bh[which.max(abs(mean_delta_prev))],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_context = case_when(
      disease_directions == "Disease-enriched" ~ "Disease-enriched",
      disease_directions == "Control-enriched" ~ "Control-enriched",
      TRUE ~ "Mixed"
    ),
    disease_assoc_binary = "Disease-associated"
  )

sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
  left_join(disease_asv_annot_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    disease_assoc_binary = ifelse(
      is.na(disease_assoc_binary),
      "Not disease-associated",
      disease_assoc_binary
    ),
    disease_assoc_binary = factor(
      disease_assoc_binary,
      levels = c("Disease-associated", "Not disease-associated")
    ),
    disease_direction_strip = case_when(
      !is.na(disease_context) & disease_context %in% c("Control-enriched", "Disease-enriched", "Mixed") ~ as.character(disease_context),
      TRUE ~ "Not disease-associated"
    ),
    disease_direction_strip = factor(
      disease_direction_strip,
      levels = c(
        "Control-enriched",
        "Disease-enriched",
        "Mixed",
        "Not disease-associated"
      )
    )
  )

observed_disease_direction_strip <- sharing_asv %>%
  filter(!is.na(disease_direction_strip)) %>%
  pull(disease_direction_strip) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  unique()

observed_disease_direction_strip <- intersect(
  c("Control-enriched", "Disease-enriched", "Mixed", "Not disease-associated"),
  observed_disease_direction_strip
)

disease_direction_strip_cols_use <- disease_direction_strip_cols[observed_disease_direction_strip]

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Define diet/social association annotation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cor_tbl_clean <- cor_result_tbl %>%
  filter(ASV %in% sharing_asv$ASV) %>%
  mutate(
    variable_group = str_squish(as.character(variable_group)),
    variable_label = str_squish(as.character(variable_label)),
    rho = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rho)),
    p_value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(p_value)),
    p_adj_bh = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(p_adj_bh)),
    sig_fdr = !is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < diet_assoc_p_cutoff
  )

cat("\n===== cor_result_tbl variable_group check =====\n")
print(
  cor_tbl_clean %>%
    count(variable_group, name = "n_rows") %>%
    arrange(variable_group)
)

diet_assoc_base <- cor_tbl_clean %>%
  filter(
    variable_group == "Diet",
    variable_label %in% diet_vars_order,
    sig_fdr
  )

if (diet_assoc_direction_for_concordance == "positive") {
  diet_assoc_base_for_concordance <- diet_assoc_base %>%
    filter(rho > 0)
} else {
  diet_assoc_base_for_concordance <- diet_assoc_base
}

diet_assoc_tbl <- diet_assoc_base_for_concordance %>%
  mutate(
    diet_category_original = variable_label,
    diet_category_merged = merge_veg_namul(variable_label),
    direction = case_when(
      rho > 0 ~ "Positive",
      rho < 0 ~ "Negative",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(ASV, p_adj_bh, p_value, desc(abs(rho))) %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    n_diet_assoc = n(),
    n_diet_assoc_merged = n_distinct(diet_category_merged),
    diet_assoc_categories = paste(sort(unique(diet_category_original)), collapse = ";"),
    diet_assoc_categories_merged = paste(sort(unique(diet_category_merged)), collapse = ";"),
    diet_assoc_directions = paste(sort(unique(direction)), collapse = ";"),
    top_diet_category = first(variable_label),
    top_diet_category_merged = first(diet_category_merged),
    top_diet_direction = first(direction),
    top_diet_rho = first(rho),
    top_diet_p = first(p_value),
    top_diet_fdr = first(p_adj_bh),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sharing_asv <- sharing_asv %>%
  left_join(diet_assoc_tbl, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    n_diet_assoc = replace_na(n_diet_assoc, 0L),
    n_diet_assoc_merged = replace_na(n_diet_assoc_merged, 0L),
    diet_assoc_categories = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_categories) | diet_assoc_categories == "", "None", diet_assoc_categories),
    diet_assoc_categories_merged = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_categories_merged) | diet_assoc_categories_merged == "", "None", diet_assoc_categories_merged),
    diet_assoc_binary = ifelse(n_diet_assoc > 0, "Diet-associated", "Not diet-associated"),
    diet_assoc_binary = factor(diet_assoc_binary, levels = c("Diet-associated", "Not diet-associated"))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Exact sequence matching against side-dish microbiome
# ---------------------------------------------------------
match_direct <- food_asv_tbl %>%
  inner_join(
    sharing_asv,
    by = c("food_seq" = "human_seq")
  ) %>%
  mutate(match_orientation = "direct")

match_revcomp <- food_asv_tbl %>%
  inner_join(
    sharing_asv,
    by = c("food_seq" = "human_seq_rc")
  ) %>%
  mutate(match_orientation = "reverse_complement")

food_match_wide <- bind_rows(match_direct, match_revcomp) %>%
  distinct(ASV, food_seq, match_orientation, .keep_all = TRUE)

if (nrow(food_match_wide) > 0) {
  food_match_long <- food_match_wide %>%
    select(
      ASV,
      label,
      row_label,
      type,
      asv_class,
      subtype,
      disease_assoc_binary,
      disease_direction_strip,
      disease_context,
      diet_assoc_binary,
      n_diet_assoc,
      diet_assoc_categories,
      diet_assoc_categories_merged,
      top_diet_category,
      top_diet_category_merged,
      top_diet_direction,
      top_diet_rho,
      top_diet_p,
      top_diet_fdr,
      food_taxon,
      food_seq,
      match_orientation,
      all_of(food_sample_cols)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(food_sample_cols),
      names_to = "Variable_ID",
      values_to = "abundance"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      abundance = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(abundance)),
      detected = !is.na(abundance) & abundance >= food_detection_cutoff
    ) %>%
    left_join(food_meta, by = "Variable_ID")
} else {
  food_match_long <- tibble(
    ASV = character(),
    Variable_ID = character(),
    detected = logical(),
    abundance = numeric(),
    food_seq = character(),
    food_taxon = character(),
    match_orientation = character()
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Full ASV x food sample grid
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sample_grid_tbl <- tidyr::crossing(
  ASV = sharing_asv$ASV,
  Variable_ID = food_meta$Variable_ID
) %>%
  left_join(
    sharing_asv %>%
      select(
        ASV,
        label,
        row_label,
        type,
        asv_class,
        subtype,
        disease_assoc_binary,
        disease_direction_strip,
        disease_context,
        diet_assoc_binary,
        n_diet_assoc,
        diet_assoc_categories,
        diet_assoc_categories_merged,
        top_diet_category,
        top_diet_category_merged,
        top_diet_direction,
        top_diet_rho,
        top_diet_p,
        top_diet_fdr
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(food_meta, by = "Variable_ID") %>%
  left_join(
    food_match_long %>%
      filter(detected) %>%
      group_by(ASV, Variable_ID) %>%
      summarise(
        detected = TRUE,
        n_matched_food_seq = n_distinct(food_seq),
        food_taxon = paste(unique(na.omit(food_taxon)), collapse = ";"),
        match_orientation = paste(unique(match_orientation), collapse = ";"),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("ASV", "Variable_ID")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    detected = replace_na(detected, FALSE),
    n_matched_food_seq = replace_na(n_matched_food_seq, 0L),
    n_diet_assoc = replace_na(n_diet_assoc, 0L),
    diet_assoc_categories = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_categories) | diet_assoc_categories == "", "None", diet_assoc_categories),
    diet_assoc_categories_merged = ifelse(is.na(diet_assoc_categories_merged) | diet_assoc_categories_merged == "", "None", diet_assoc_categories_merged),
    diet_assoc_binary = ifelse(n_diet_assoc > 0, "Diet-associated", "Not diet-associated"),
    diet_assoc_binary = factor(diet_assoc_binary, levels = c("Diet-associated", "Not diet-associated")),
    disease_direction_strip = factor(
      as.character(disease_direction_strip),
      levels = observed_disease_direction_strip
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Category-level food detection tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
detected_pair_tbl <- sample_grid_tbl %>%
  filter(detected) %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    label,
    row_label,
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    disease_assoc_binary,
    disease_direction_strip,
    disease_context,
    diet_assoc_binary,
    n_diet_assoc,
    diet_assoc_categories,
    diet_assoc_categories_merged,
    top_diet_category,
    top_diet_category_merged,
    Variable_ID,
    Dish_ID,
    Group,
    Korean_name,
    Figure_label,
    Plot_label,
    Category_1,
    Category_2,
    Category_1_merged,
    Category_2_merged,
    detected,
    n_matched_food_seq
  )

detected_food_category_long <- detected_pair_tbl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Category_1, Category_2),
    names_to = "food_category_source",
    values_to = "food_category"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    food_category = ifelse(is.na(food_category) | food_category == "", "None", food_category)
  ) %>%
  filter(food_category != "None") %>%
  distinct(ASV, Variable_ID, food_category, .keep_all = TRUE)

detected_food_category_long_merged <- detected_pair_tbl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Category_1_merged, Category_2_merged),
    names_to = "food_category_source",
    values_to = "food_category_merged"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    food_category_merged = ifelse(is.na(food_category_merged) | food_category_merged == "", "None", food_category_merged)
  ) %>%
  filter(food_category_merged != "None") %>%
  distinct(ASV, Variable_ID, food_category_merged, .keep_all = TRUE)

asv_food_category_tbl_merged <- detected_food_category_long_merged %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    detected_food_categories_merged = paste(sort(unique(food_category_merged)), collapse = ";"),
    n_detected_food_categories_merged = n_distinct(food_category_merged),
    n_detected_food_samples = n_distinct(Variable_ID),
    n_detected_food_dishes = n_distinct(Dish_ID),
    detected_food_sample_ids = paste(sort(unique(Variable_ID)), collapse = ";"),
    detected_food_dish_ids = paste(sort(unique(Dish_ID)), collapse = ";"),
    detected_food_names = paste(sort(unique(Korean_name)), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 13) ASV-level summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_summary_tbl <- sharing_asv %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    label,
    row_label,
    type,
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    disease_assoc_binary,
    disease_direction_strip,
    disease_context,
    disease_labels,
    disease_directions,
    strongest_disease,
    strongest_disease_direction,
    strongest_disease_effect,
    strongest_disease_fdr,
    diet_assoc_binary,
    n_diet_assoc,
    n_diet_assoc_merged,
    diet_assoc_categories,
    diet_assoc_categories_merged,
    top_diet_category,
    top_diet_category_merged,
    top_diet_direction,
    top_diet_rho,
    top_diet_p,
    top_diet_fdr
  ) %>%
  left_join(asv_food_category_tbl_merged, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    detected_food_categories_merged = ifelse(
      is.na(detected_food_categories_merged) | detected_food_categories_merged == "",
      "None",
      detected_food_categories_merged
    ),
    n_detected_food_categories_merged = replace_na(n_detected_food_categories_merged, 0L),
    n_detected_food_samples = replace_na(n_detected_food_samples, 0L),
    n_detected_food_dishes = replace_na(n_detected_food_dishes, 0L),
    detected_food_sample_ids = ifelse(is.na(detected_food_sample_ids), "", detected_food_sample_ids),
    detected_food_dish_ids = ifelse(is.na(detected_food_dish_ids), "", detected_food_dish_ids),
    detected_food_names = ifelse(is.na(detected_food_names), "", detected_food_names),
    food_detected = n_detected_food_samples > 0,
    diet_associated = n_diet_assoc > 0,
    diet_assoc_list_merged = split_semicolon(diet_assoc_categories_merged),
    food_category_list_merged = split_semicolon(detected_food_categories_merged),
    category_concordant_merged = mapply(
      function(diet_vec, food_vec) {
        diet_vec <- diet_vec[!is.na(diet_vec) & diet_vec != "" & diet_vec != "None"]
        food_vec <- food_vec[!is.na(food_vec) & food_vec != "" & food_vec != "None"]
        length(intersect(diet_vec, food_vec)) > 0
      },
      diet_assoc_list_merged,
      food_category_list_merged
    ),
    concordance_status_merged = case_when(
      diet_associated & food_detected & category_concordant_merged ~ "Concordant",
      diet_associated & food_detected & !category_concordant_merged ~ "Discordant",
      !diet_associated & food_detected ~ "Food-detected only",
      diet_associated & !food_detected ~ "Diet-associated only",
      TRUE ~ "Neither"
    ),
    concordance_status_merged = factor(
      concordance_status_merged,
      levels = c(
        "Concordant",
        "Discordant",
        "Diet-associated only",
        "Food-detected only",
        "Neither"
      )
    ),
    asv_class = factor(as.character(asv_class), levels = c("Global core", "Village-enriched")),
    subtype = factor(as.character(subtype), levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional")),
    disease_assoc_binary = factor(
      as.character(disease_assoc_binary),
      levels = c("Disease-associated", "Not disease-associated")
    ),
    disease_direction_strip = factor(
      as.character(disease_direction_strip),
      levels = observed_disease_direction_strip
    ),
    diet_assoc_binary = factor(
      as.character(diet_assoc_binary),
      levels = c("Diet-associated", "Not diet-associated")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-diet_assoc_list_merged, -food_category_list_merged)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14) Category-level grid with Vegetables+Namul merged
# ---------------------------------------------------------
category_grid_tbl_merged <- expand_grid(
  ASV = asv_summary_tbl$ASV,
  food_category_merged = diet_vars_order_merged
) %>%
  left_join(
    asv_summary_tbl %>%
      select(
        ASV,
        label,
        row_label,
        type,
        asv_class,
        subtype,
        disease_assoc_binary,
        disease_direction_strip,
        disease_context,
        diet_assoc_binary,
        diet_associated,
        food_detected,
        concordance_status_merged,
        n_diet_assoc,
        n_diet_assoc_merged,
        diet_assoc_categories_merged,
        detected_food_categories_merged,
        n_detected_food_samples,
        n_detected_food_categories_merged
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    detected_food_category_long_merged %>%
      filter(food_category_merged %in% diet_vars_order_merged) %>%
      group_by(ASV, food_category_merged) %>%
      summarise(
        detected_in_category = TRUE,
        n_category_samples = n_distinct(Variable_ID),
        n_category_dishes = n_distinct(Dish_ID),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("ASV", "food_category_merged")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    detected_in_category = replace_na(detected_in_category, FALSE),
    n_category_samples = replace_na(n_category_samples, 0L),
    n_category_dishes = replace_na(n_category_dishes, 0L),
    diet_assoc_categories_merged = ifelse(
      is.na(diet_assoc_categories_merged) | diet_assoc_categories_merged == "",
      "None",
      diet_assoc_categories_merged
    )
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    diet_match_category = {
      diet_vec <- unlist(strsplit(diet_assoc_categories_merged, ";"))
      diet_vec <- diet_vec[!is.na(diet_vec) & diet_vec != "" & diet_vec != "None"]
      food_category_merged %in% diet_vec
    },
    detected_and_matched = detected_in_category & diet_match_category
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

make_row_annotations_corr <- function(row_tbl, y_col = "row_id") {
  ann_df <- row_tbl %>%
    select(all_of(y_col), asv_class, subtype, disease_direction_strip) %>%

    mutate(
      annotation = factor(
        annotation,
        levels = c("asv_class", "subtype", "disease_direction_strip"),
        labels = c("ASV class", "Subtype", "Disease direction")
      ),
      value = as.character(value)
    )
  
  ggplot(ann_df, aes(x = annotation, y = .data[[y_col]], fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(class_cols, subtype_cols, disease_direction_strip_cols_use),
      drop = TRUE,
      na.value = "grey95"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    base_theme_fig6 +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(0, 2, 5.5, 5.5)
    )
}

plot3_category_order <- setdiff(diet_vars_order_merged, "Beverages")

main_selected_asv_tbl <- asv_summary_tbl %>%
  filter(diet_associated | food_detected) %>%
  arrange(
    asv_class,
    subtype,
    disease_direction_strip,
    diet_assoc_binary,
    concordance_status_merged,
    desc(n_detected_food_categories_merged),
    desc(n_detected_food_samples),
    ASV
  )

  mutate(
    row_id = paste0(row_label, "__", ASV),
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = rev(paste0(row_label, "__", ASV))),
    disease_direction_strip = factor(as.character(disease_direction_strip), levels = observed_disease_direction_strip)
  )

category_matrix_tbl <- category_grid_tbl_merged %>%
  filter(
    ASV %in% main_selected_asv_tbl$ASV,
    food_category_merged %in% plot3_category_order
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    main_row_tbl %>% select(ASV, row_id),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = main_row_levels),
    food_category_merged = factor(food_category_merged, levels = plot3_category_order),
    fill_state = ifelse(detected_in_category, "Detected", "Not detected"),
    fill_state = factor(fill_state, levels = c("Not detected", "Detected"))
  )

diet_assoc_matrix_tbl <- main_row_tbl %>%
  select(ASV, row_id, diet_assoc_categories_merged) %>%
  mutate(
    diet_assoc_categories_merged = ifelse(
      is.na(diet_assoc_categories_merged) | diet_assoc_categories_merged == "",
      "None",
      diet_assoc_categories_merged
    )
  ) %>%
  expand_grid(diet_category_merged = plot3_category_order) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    diet_associated_category = {
      diet_vec <- unlist(strsplit(diet_assoc_categories_merged, ";"))
      diet_vec <- diet_vec[!is.na(diet_vec) & diet_vec != "" & diet_vec != "None"]
      diet_category_merged %in% diet_vec
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = main_row_levels),
    diet_category_merged = factor(diet_category_merged, levels = plot3_category_order),
    diet_assoc_state = ifelse(diet_associated_category, "Associated", "Not associated"),
    diet_assoc_state = factor(diet_assoc_state, levels = c("Not associated", "Associated"))
  )

center_dot_df <- category_matrix_tbl %>%
  filter(detected_and_matched) %>%
  distinct(row_id, food_category_merged)

right_dot_df <- center_dot_df %>%
  rename(diet_category_merged = food_category_merged) %>%
  mutate(
    diet_category_merged = factor(diet_category_merged, levels = plot3_category_order),
    row_id = factor(row_id, levels = main_row_levels)
  ) %>%
  distinct(row_id, diet_category_merged)

make_row_annotations_main <- function(row_tbl, y_col = "row_id") {
  ann_df <- row_tbl %>%
    select(all_of(y_col), asv_class, subtype, disease_direction_strip) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(asv_class, subtype, disease_direction_strip),
      names_to = "annotation",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      annotation = factor(
        annotation,
        levels = c("asv_class", "subtype", "disease_direction_strip"),
        labels = c("ASV class", "Subtype", "Disease direction")
      ),
      value = as.character(value)
    )
  
  ggplot(ann_df, aes(x = annotation, y = .data[[y_col]], fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(class_cols, subtype_cols, disease_direction_strip_cols_use),
      drop = TRUE,
      na.value = "grey95"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    base_theme_fig6 +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(0, 2, 5.5, 5.5)
    )
}

p_main_left <- make_row_annotations_main(main_row_tbl, y_col = "row_id")

shared_x_title_size <- 11.5
shared_x_text_size <- 7.2

p_food_cat <- ggplot(category_matrix_tbl, aes(x = food_category_merged, y = row_id)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = fill_state), color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(
    data = center_dot_df,
    aes(x = food_category_merged, y = row_id),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 16,
    size = 2.0,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Not detected" = "grey95", "Detected" = "#4E79A7"),
    name = "Exact match"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    drop = FALSE,
    labels = main_label_map
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Detected side-dish category",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  base_theme_fig6 +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = shared_x_title_size, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = shared_x_text_size, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 5.5, 0)
  )

p_diet_cat <- ggplot(diet_assoc_matrix_tbl, aes(x = diet_category_merged, y = row_id)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = diet_assoc_state), color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(
    data = right_dot_df,
    aes(x = diet_category_merged, y = row_id),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 16,
    size = 2.0,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Not associated" = "grey95", "Associated" = "#CC79A7"),
    name = "Associated diet"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "ASV-associated diet category",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  base_theme_fig6 +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = shared_x_title_size, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = shared_x_text_size, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)
  )

p_main_title <- make_title_plot(
  title = "Side-dish category-level exact matches and diet concordance",
  subtitle = "Vegetables and Namul were merged as a vegetable-based category. Black points indicate category concordance."
)

p_main_body <- wrap_plots(
  p_main_left,
  p_food_cat,
  p_diet_cat,
  ncol = 3
) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(0.65, 4.8, 4.8))

p_main_panel <- p_main_title / p_main_body +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.9, 10))

p_main_legends <- wrap_plots(
  make_tile_legend(c("Not detected" = "grey95", "Detected" = "#4E79A7"), "Exact match"),
  make_tile_legend(c("Not associated" = "grey95", "Associated" = "#CC79A7"), "Associated diet"),
  make_dot_legend("Concordance", "Category match"),
  make_tile_legend(class_cols, "ASV class"),
  make_tile_legend(subtype_cols, "Subtype"),
  make_tile_legend(disease_direction_strip_cols_use, "Disease direction"),
  ncol = 1
) +
  plot_layout(
    heights = c(
      0.8,
      0.8,
      0.7,
      0.8,
      0.8,
      max(0.8, 0.35 * length(disease_direction_strip_cols_use))
    )
  )

p_main_final <- wrap_plots(
  p_main_panel,
  p_main_legends,
  ncol = 2
) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(11.8, 1.8))

print(p_main_final)

main_matrix_height <- max(8, 0.13 * nrow(main_row_tbl) + 3.2)
main_matrix_width <- 15.2

save_plot_both(
  p_main_final,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FIG6, "plots", "03_category_concordance_matrix_veg_namul_merged"),
  width = main_matrix_width,
  height = main_matrix_height
)

write_csv_kor(
  category_matrix_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FIG6, "tables", "03_category_concordance_food_matrix_data_veg_namul_merged.csv")
)

write_csv_kor(
  diet_assoc_matrix_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FIG6, "tables", "03_category_concordance_diet_matrix_data_veg_namul_merged.csv")
)

# =========================================================
# Plot 4: Main-style category-pair concordance heatmap
# Vegetables + Namul merged
# - Fruit and Beverages removed
# =========================================================

plot4_category_order <- setdiff(diet_vars_order_merged, c("Fruit", "Beverages"))

diet_food_pair_tbl_merged <- detected_food_category_long_merged %>%
  filter(ASV %in% asv_summary_tbl$ASV) %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    food_category_merged,
    Variable_ID,
    Dish_ID
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(
    asv_summary_tbl %>%
      select(
        ASV,
        diet_assoc_categories_merged,
        n_diet_assoc_merged,
        diet_associated
      ),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diet_assoc_categories_merged = ifelse(
      is.na(diet_assoc_categories_merged) | diet_assoc_categories_merged == "",
      "None",
      diet_assoc_categories_merged
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    diet_associated,
    diet_assoc_categories_merged != "None"
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(diet_assoc_categories_merged, sep = ";") %>%
  rename(diet_category_merged = diet_assoc_categories_merged) %>%
  filter(
    diet_category_merged %in% plot4_category_order,
    food_category_merged %in% plot4_category_order
  ) %>%
  distinct(ASV, diet_category_merged, food_category_merged)

concordance_heatmap_tbl_merged <- diet_food_pair_tbl_merged %>%
  count(diet_category_merged, food_category_merged, name = "n_asvs") %>%
  complete(
    diet_category_merged = plot4_category_order,
    food_category_merged = plot4_category_order,
    fill = list(n_asvs = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    concordant_cell = diet_category_merged == food_category_merged,
    diet_category_merged = factor(diet_category_merged, levels = rev(plot4_category_order)),
    food_category_merged = factor(food_category_merged, levels = plot4_category_order)
  )

p_concordance_heatmap <- ggplot(
  concordance_heatmap_tbl_merged,
  aes(x = food_category_merged, y = diet_category_merged, fill = n_asvs)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_tile(
    data = concordance_heatmap_tbl_merged %>% filter(concordant_cell),
    aes(x = food_category_merged, y = diet_category_merged),
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(n_asvs > 0, as.character(n_asvs), "")),
    size = 3.6,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#F7FBFF", "#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#08519C"),
    name = "No. ASVs\nper pair"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Category-pair concordance between ASV-associated diets and detected side-dish categories",
    subtitle = "Vegetables and Namul were merged as a vegetable-based category. Cell values indicate unique ASVs per diet–side-dish category pair.",
    x = "Detected side-dish category",
    y = "ASV-associated diet category"
  ) +
  base_theme_fig6 +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_concordance_heatmap)

save_plot_both(
  p_concordance_heatmap,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FIG6, "plots", "04_category_concordance_heatmap_veg_namul_merged"),
  width = 8.5,
  height = 7.2
)

write_csv_kor(
  diet_food_pair_tbl_merged,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FIG6, "tables", "04_category_pair_concordance_long_veg_namul_merged.csv")
)

write_csv_kor(
  concordance_heatmap_tbl_merged,
  file.path(OUTDIR_FIG6, "tables", "04_category_concordance_heatmap_data_veg_namul_merged.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Final summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n===== Fig. 6 clean pipeline finished =====\n")
cat("Output directory:", OUTDIR_FIG6, "\n")
cat("Total sharing-related ASVs:", n_distinct(sharing_asv$ASV), "\n")
cat("Disease-associated ASVs:", sum(asv_summary_tbl$disease_assoc_binary == "Disease-associated"), "\n")
cat("Diet-associated ASVs used for concordance:", sum(asv_summary_tbl$diet_associated), "\n")
cat("Side-dish detected ASVs:", sum(asv_summary_tbl$food_detected), "\n")
cat("Concordant ASVs after Vegetables+Namul merge:", sum(asv_summary_tbl$category_concordant_merged), "\n\n")

cat("Main selected ASVs for category-level matrix:\n")
print(
  main_selected_asv_tbl %>%
    count(disease_direction_strip, concordance_status_merged, name = "n_asvs")
)

cat("\nPlot 1 variables included:\n")
cat("Social questionnaire variables:", length(social_vars_order), "\n")
cat("Diet variables:", length(diet_vars_present), "\n")

cat("\nSaved plots:\n")
cat("- plots/01_sharing_asv_social_diet_correlation_heatmap.png/.svg\n")
cat("- plots/02_exact_match_sample_matrix.png/.svg\n")
cat("- plots/03_category_concordance_matrix_veg_namul_merged.png/.svg\n")
cat("- plots/04_category_concordance_heatmap_veg_namul_merged.png/.svg\n")

#Geographic distance summary
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(geodist)
  library(tibble)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Village-to-village Haversine distance summary
# Requires:
#   vil_tbl with columns: label, lon, lat
# ---------------------------------------------------------

stopifnot(exists("vil_tbl"))
stopifnot(all(c("label", "lon", "lat") %in% names(vil_tbl)))

# 1) unique village coordinate table
vil_cent_df <- vil_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    village_name = as.character(label),
    lon = as.numeric(lon),
    lat = as.numeric(lat)
  ) %>%
  distinct(village_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat))

# 2) pairwise Haversine distance matrix (km)
dist_mat <- geodist::geodist(
  x = vil_cent_df %>% select(lon, lat),
  measure = "haversine"
) / 1000

rownames(dist_mat) <- vil_cent_df$village_name
colnames(dist_mat) <- vil_cent_df$village_name

# 3) upper triangle only (unique village pairs)
upper_idx <- upper.tri(dist_mat, diag = FALSE)

dist_vec <- dist_mat[upper_idx]

# 4) summary
dist_summary <- tibble(
  n_villages = nrow(vil_cent_df),
  n_pairs = length(dist_vec),
  mean_km = mean(dist_vec, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_km = median(dist_vec, na.rm = TRUE),
  min_km = min(dist_vec, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_km = max(dist_vec, na.rm = TRUE)
)

print(dist_summary)

# 5) optional: exact range string
dist_range <- sprintf(
  "%.2f-%.2f km",
  min(dist_vec, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(dist_vec, na.rm = TRUE)
)

cat("Mean distance:", round(mean(dist_vec, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "km\n")
cat("Median distance:", round(median(dist_vec, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "km\n")
cat("Range:", dist_range, "\n")
```
